tei:div.tei:p: ༷༵༵||0nihūṃ///༵༵/༵༵༵༵mu~X7/dh+ri~X:30pa(00⑤0kha/0( ga50yig03/ga7/khu3/ kha07༅0(5⑤//5 kha༅
— ——smad cha/ ༄
dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston/smad cha/dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs/chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs las brgyad pa sgrub rgyud garma gam tshang gi chos byung rgyas pa bzhugs so/ /

le' brgyad pa karma nam tshang gi chos rgyang /nor rig ra dpal garma bka' rgyud kyi rnam thar gyi sa bon brjod pa rgyal ba thams cad kyi rang bzhin mi gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrug pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mar rnam pa thams cad du phyag 'tshal lo/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i gter/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba gdul slad du/ /mchog sprul rgyun mi chad ston pa/ /kurma pa yi zhabs la 'dud/ /de yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ma 'ongs pa na thuṭa rje chen po'i sprul pa thod rgal ba re skabs su byung nas 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che byed ces lung bstan pa dpal kurma pa ni bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas drug pa seng ger zhang rin po ches gter thon pa'i lung bstan las kyang byung zhing paṇa chen shāsgris kyang gsungs/ bskal bzang gi byang sems thams cad ni sngon bska'ajupa dpag tu med pa nas sangs rgyas shing spyan ras gzigs dang rang bzhin dbyer med pa yin pas de dag gi rnam par thar pa ji lta ba brjod par su zhig gis spobs/ yul dus de dang de'i gdul bya mir gyur pa spyi mthun du snang ba shar ba rags pa tsam re rang rang gi rnam thar du bkod pa ltar cung zad brjod na rje dus gsum mkhyen pa ni mdo khams kre shod du sgom pa rdo rje mgon dang lha thog bza' sgang lcam ming 'dren gyi sras su lcags pho stag la 'khrungs/ rngog lo tsā ba gshegs pa'i phyi lo yin/ mtshan dge 'phel du btags/ mes po sgom pa bgres po dang yab la lha mo rang byung rgyal mo zhus te bsgrubs pas dgung lo bdun brgyad nas lha mo'i grub rtags thon brag la zhabs rjes byung / rang gi sku dgra btul/ dgung lo bcu drug la chos 'khor ka brag bya bar mkhan po mchog 859

gi bla ma dang slob dpon chag seng ge grags las rab tu byung / dpal chos kyi grags par mtshan gsol/ gtsug phud dor ba'i tshe ye shes kyi ḍā gi ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis mkha' 'gro'i dbu skra las byas pa'i zhwa nag gi cod pan bcings te sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus su mdzad pa'i phyir kurma pa zhes mtshan gsol bar gzigs pas phyis dbu zhwa nag po bsnabs/ dgung lo nyi shu la dbus su phebs te stod lungs se thang du rgya dmar gyi gra sar rta sga phog ste stod lung rgya dmar ba/ phya pa chos kyi seng ge gnyis la dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum tshad ma sde bdun byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu la mkhas par mdzad/ gsang phur yang bzhugs te khams pa mi gsum du grags/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags la rigs tshogs dang thal 'gyur ba gsan/mkhan po mal 'dul 'dzin/ las slob ye shes blo gros/ gsang ston mkhan po'i gcung gis mdzad de dge slong du bsnyen par rdzogs nas 'dul ba la mkhas par mdzad/ dge bshes sha ra ba/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje dpal rga lo/khams pa a seng / yol chos dbang / rong pa 'gar dag spen phug pa ston rgyal/ skyab mo spang kha ba sogs mang du bsten te bka' gdams gzhung man ngag sbyor drug mgon po bya rog ma/ phag mo rin chen rgyan drug dgyes rdor gdams bshad lam 'bras zhi byed sogs bod yul na spyir grags pa'i gzhung man ngag thams cad gsan/ dgung lo sum bcu pa chos rjes re gcig bzhes pa'i sa mo lug lo la rje sgam po pa khu dbon dang mjal/ thabs lam bskyangs pas zhag dgu nas drod 'bar ras rkyang mdzad de zla ba dgu lag pa rdul dang ma bral bar bsgoms/ spyir sgam por lo gsum bar ma chad du bsgoms/ sgom chen brgyad brgya'i nang nas sgom sran che bar grags/ yon tan dpag med 'khrungs/chos rjes lung bstan te zangs ri tes phug phag mo grwa/ 'ol kha sogs sru phyi60 ོ— —

bsgoms/ lo ror ras chung pa'i drung du byon pas ras chung pa'i mnal lam du bud med shin tu mi sdug pa cig 'ongs nas sang sprul pa cig sprul pa mjal du 'ong bas gdams ngag ston zhig zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ phyi nyin phebs te zla ba gnyis su bsten/ mi la dang te bu'i gdams ngag gi phu thag bcad/ la stod dang spa gro sogs su byon rje mi la'i dngos slob sngags skyes lhan cig skyes pa'i sgron ma/ rtse mo nam mkha' gsal sgron/ dge tshul spun gnyis sogs bsten/ spyir rje mi la'i dngos slob bdun gyi gdams ngag tshang sprugs su rdzogs pa yin gsung / phag ri khar thog gis gnod par ma nus/ mon dom tshang du sgom du byon pas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro stag tu sprul bas bskor ba byas/ zhing skyong gi ḍāki ma mi mo'i gzugs 'dzin pa gnyis kyis ku ba'i thod gzugs bdud rtsis bkang ste drangs/ tshur byon pas lam du gangs chen po bab pa'i tshe ḍā ki mas gtum mo la bar ma gnang ste gangs gseb tu sku gcer bur bzhugs pas nye 'khor gyi kha ba chur zhu/ ras phyam nye gnas la bkab/ jo mo gangs su ḍā kis 'tsho ba sbyar te sgrub pa mdzad/ ston ser ldom bu la byon pas snye mo'i smad du bde mchog gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi mi mor snang bas bal yul pham thing nas khyim bdag a sho ga'i bu mo dharma sid+dhi bya ba skye ba bdun pa'i ro kurti ku'i dur khrod tu bskyal ba skad cig gis blangs pa'i sor mdzub kyi tshod ma dang lha'i bdud rtsi 'o ma 'dra ba drangs te gsol/ phyag tshang ba'i bud med de'i mthe bo la bde mchog gi sku rdzogs par gzigs/ rdzong dgon par bla ma rdzong pa dang mjal te de kun mkhyen nas 'di lta bu'o zhes gsung zhing de rnams kha che'i dur khrod sam pa tar tshogs 'khor la song zin gsungs/ thugs bsam mdzad tshad la lan btab pas bsam mno mdzad ma spobs/ phyag chen thog babs dang bde mchog lo nag dril gsum skyed rdzogs sbrags sa ma sogs chos mtha' yas 861

gsan/ slar sgam por byon pas de thams cad mkhyen te bla mas tshur gsungs/rje sgom pas kyang bla ma chen po'i drung du mjal ba dang gsung gleng mdzad pa de thams cad mkhyen te tshur gsungs/ spyir rje khu dbon/ ras chung ba/ rdzong pa/ sben phug pa/ rga lo/ a seng / krar ba/ dngul chu be+e ro ba ste grub pa thob nges kyi bla ma dgu yod gsung / bla ma chen po la rtogs ba phul bas khams pa se bo khyod la nga re che ba yin pa la khyod kyis nor nas 'dug da dung sgoms gsungs/ nor sa mi gda' ste gsung sgrub snyam nas zla ba drug tu bsgoms te kho bo la lo brgyar bsgoms kyang skyed 'don rgyu mi gda'/ nor na yang nor kho bo rang gi de ka sgom pa lags zhus pas phyag spyi bor bzhag ste bu 'khor ba dang 'brel thag chod pa yin no gsungs nas gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod dang /rtags mtshan la rlom sems mi rung ba dang gsang dgos par gsungs/lo gsum na chos rje sku 'da' ba tsam na dge bshes khams pa yang byon te khams pa mi gsum 'dzoms/ chang khrims dam par yod pa la khong gsum gyis tshogs 'khor mdzad pas nyams 'ur te gsol 'debs spro mo che byas pas zhal ta pas gnas nas phyung / mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad phyir 'brengs/ shing rtsi kun rtse gug chos rje yang thang rkyang dang sba ber bsnams te khong gsum gar 'gro bar nga yang 'gro gsung nas byon/ dri ba dris lan gyi mgur mdzad pas nyams 'ur te pha bong zhig gi steng du gsum po'i zhabs rjes kyis gang ste slar byon nas kun gyis rtsod med du bkur/ chos gdams ngag thams cad tshang sprugs su gnang zhing khyad par du gzhan la ma gnang ba skyed rim lhan cig skyes ma dang rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med gnang ste bu khyod sgrub pa khams kyi rkam po gangs rar gyis/ 'gro don dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab par 'byung ngo zhes lung bstan te 'phan yul ja bzang brag gzhu'i lha ri rgyan po/ byug po sogs su bzhugs/862

brag la mi thogs pas bla ma brag par grags/ sku chab bdud rtsi zhal lung sogs thams cad kyang yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs pa dbyibs sku yig 'bru mchod rten phyag mtshan sogs mtha' yas pa byon/ 'phan yul ja bzang gi brag phug gang yod par grags/ mngon sum du sgra 'od dang bcas te 'phar zhing lding pa dang 'phel ba dang 'grib pa sogs byung bas thams cad kyi sgro 'doṭa chod skad/ dgung lo zhe gnyis nas mkha' 'gro'i gnas gzhu gru bzhi bzung ste tshogs pa bzhi bcu tsam re bskyangs/ 'tsho ba 'dzom po med kyang ci yod bzhi sde dang tshogs sog mdzad de smyung gnas bcud len mkha' 'gros phul ba sogs bsten te ting 'dzin gyis 'tsho bar mdzad de sto rgyab kyi ched du sgrub pa gtong ma myong gsung skad/ chos rje sku yal ba mkhyen nas byon pas 'ol kha'i pho rog rdzong chung du rje sgom pa dang bla ma 'phags pa dang mjal gsol ba btab pas chos rje mngon sum du byon pa gsum gas gzigs/ gru bzhir rlung dhu tir dag pa'i ltas su sbrul chen pos mid pa byung ste de'i zhag 'ga' phyin nas thugs dam mnyam rjese dang bral dus gsum la sgrib thogs med sku bu chung gi spyod pa mdzad pa zhig byung /dgung lo lnga bcu pa la rje sgom tshul lha lung na bzhugs pa la khams su bzhud pa'i phyi phyag mdzad pas kho bo ni yun ring por mi sdod 'chi ba yin/ khyod khams su skyid sdug ci byung yang yar shog gsungs zhing rdo rje'i gdan skad cig gis bskor nus pa dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag med gzigs pa'i bkod pa ngo mtshar can gsungs/ de dus bla ma phag mo gru pas ye shes 'od la 'phrin bskur nas khyed khams su ma 'byon/ 'byon na yang dbang skur dang rab gnas mang po ma mdzad sku tshe la bar chad byung dogs yod ces byung bas khong nga la thugs brtse ba yin te kho bo bzhon ma lnga med na 'brog gi ming mi 'thob/ de tsam gyi yid ches med na dbang skur dang rab gnas mi byed/ dbang bskur yang brgyad bcu 863

rtsa bzhi ma bskur yang brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi bla ma mi la'i sku tshe tsam zhig thub de la blo bur ba mi yong gsung / byang lam dang kre bo sogs su 'gro don mdzad/nga lda la gnas nang du phebs te mnal 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa rgyun chad med pa de nas byung / chos rjes de mkhyen nas lung bstan par 'dugabaka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyang yin te 'ong gsung / der rā hu la 'grim pa'i dug gis ma tshugs/ chu ma 'phrod pas bzhud par dgongs pa na dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis sman chu phul te bzhugs par gsol ba btab/dgung lo don bzhi la 'bri klungs rgu phebs te 'bri chu rgyud kyi skya ser thams cad smin grol du mdzad/ krer byon 'khrug pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi/ don bdun bzhes pa'i shing sbrul la gle du sgar mal du byon te dgon ba btab/ 'gro don mdzad cing lho rgyud la lam bton nas dbus su byon/ rje 'jig rten mgon po sgam por bzhugs pas bla ma rin po che'i gdan sa nged tsha bos 'dzin dgos pa'i skabs byung / bu chen gyi nang na nyid las lhag pa ma mchis pas nged rnams kyi mgon du phebs dgos zhes gsol ba btab kyang ma phebs par lam 'bri khung thil brgyud pas rje 'jig rten mgon pos 'bam thang nas bsu ba mdzad/ chos gsan zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ khyed 'gro mgon klu sgrub yin zhes bla ma rin po ches lung bstan/ spyir kho bo dbus su 'ongs pa la dgos pa bzhi yod/ rje sgom pas khyod khams su skyid sdug gang byung yang dbus su yar shog gsung ba'i bka' sgrub pa dang / gdan sar gser chos brgya 'bul byed pa dang / zhang tshal ba sgom chen pa 'khrug pa mdzad pa 'di rna bar ma snyan pas bshol 'debs pa dang / gzhu mtshur gyi bar du dgon pa zhig bya snyam pa ste don 'di bzhi la 'ongs gsung nas tshal du byon 'khrug pa bsdums pas bla ma zhang gis rin po che la dag snang mtha' yas pa gzigs te phyag nas 'jus te bro brdungs/ phyis sku ma 864

'das kyi bar du 'khrug pa ma mdzad/ spyir dgung lo lnga bcu pa khams la thegs ga'i dus mtshur phu'i brag rgyab yol du byon te gtor ma dang sa gzhi byin rlabs mdzad/ gzims lcil chung ngu zhig mdzad de dgon gnas kyi rten 'brel bsgriṭa/phyis brgyad bcu bzhes pa'i tshe mtshur phu'i mchod khang gong mdzad/ zhang rin po ches lha chen dpal 'bar grub pa'i ka ru ma la nya byus kyi gdugs chen po 'dom brgyad tsam gyis 'khor ba phul/ zhang rin po ches kyang mchod khang gong gi ka ru ma gdugs khams gsum zil gnon sogs sna gsum phul/ spyir sa ra ha dang mai tri pa dang rdo rje dril bu pa dang dzā lan+dha ra dang bla ma lha rje khu dbon sogs bla ma dang / phag mo dbu stong spyan stong ma dpa' mo so drug dang bcas pas/'di ni he ru ka dpal rgyud/ /ces sogs rgyud tshig gsung ba dang / dgyes mdzad 'od kyi ra bar bzhugs pa gzigs shing bar do'i gdams pa dang dgyes mdzad kyi bstod pa gsan pa sogs bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gziṭa snang ni da lta rnam thar na 'khod pa yang bgrang gis mi lang / sku'i bkod pas rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la byon te rgyal po zla bas rnam par gnon pas ha ha sgrog pa'i dur khrod du grub thob rnams la gsol ba btab pa na rgya gar nas nag po spyod pa/ shing lo pa/ dza lan+dha ra pa/ in+d+ra bo dhi bar pa ste bzhi/ bod nas bla ma rin po che dang dharma shī la ste gnyis dang drug byon nas tshogs 'khor mdzad/tshur lam yud tsam gyis kha che dang pu rangs nas lam phyung ste la stod thang chung du dge bshes gtsang so ba la in+d+ra bo dhi bar pa la gsan pa'i rnam bzhi rgyud grol gsungs shing mtshur phur song zhig par lung bstan nas sngon skye ba bzhir slob ma yin gsungs nas sgrub pa la bcug phyis mi nyag rgyal po'i bla mchod du gnang ba sogs lam ring thung la ma bstos par slob mas gsol ba gar btab tu skad cig gis 'byon pa dang / rab gnas mang po mdzad pa na me tog rten la 865

rang 'thor ba dang / rten la chags pa dang snod nam mkha' la bzhag pa dang lha khang 'khor ba dang rten yo ba rnams drang por gyur pa sogs byung ba dang / byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis zha bo dang sgur po sogs sos pa dang / mthong snang tha dad pa sogs de lta bu ni ches mang ba rnam thar rnams na gsal zhing / rang gzhan thams cad kyi sngon dang da ltar dang phyi mi'i gnas mtha' dag sgrib med du gzigs pas sngon shar phyogs be+e ḍūr+ya'i zhing du dge slong du gyur pa dang / 'dzam gling dang ba lang spyod kyi bar gyi gling phran dha ri thar bla ma lha rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug su ra tar gyur pa dang dpon slob mdzad pa dang / o rgyan gyi gling zur tarti gar mgar ba'i rigs rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa a tiṣ+ṭha zhes nus pa mchog thob pa dang / nub ba lang spyod du bram ze'i dge slong dharma a tiṣ+ṭha zhes te lo pa'i slob mar gyur pa dang / de nyid du glang bo che bdun brgya'i nang na stobs che bar gyur nas sdig spyod kyi rgyal po brdzis te gnas 'phangs pas phyis yon bdag dgon pa bar gyur pa dang / shar ka liṅkar rgyal po zla bas rnam gnon du gyur te bla ma lha rje sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang rje mi la 'jam dpal bshes gnyen du gyur pa la bsten zhing dpal ldan 'bras spungs bskor bas thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob pa dang / o rgyan du te lo pa'i slob ma shi la danyi zhes pa nus pa mchog thob pa dang / 'dzam gling gi byang shar zad pa'i mtshams chu klung pad+ma can du bram ze sadz+dza na'i mkhan bu dge slong dharma girtir gyur te dge bshes phya pa paṇa chung zhig tu yod pa la slob dpon zhus shing ḍim+bi he ru ka la ri bo bya skyibs su gsol ba thebs pa dang / shar lus 'phags por rgyal po'i bu mo shes rab bzang mor gyur te bla ma lha rje dge slong dharma sidzhair bzhugs pa mnyes par byas pa dang / shar gling dang lho gling gi bar gyi gling phran na pha la'i grong khyer rā dzā pha lar rje rigs su kha kirtir 'khrungs te bla ma lha rje dpal gyi nya66

srus pa zhes bya bar gyur pa la gdams pa zhus te spyod pa nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa lo brgya dang re bzhi thub cing de dus bla ma la tshogs 'khor zhig zhus pa'i sar da lta'i slob ma khyed nyi shu tsam yod cing yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di khyim bdag phyug po zhig gi bur gyur pas yon bdag byas shing da ltar yang byas phyi mar yang byed ces sogs rang gi 'das ba'i tshul ma nga po dang / dge bshes gtsang so ba skye ba bzhir rjes su bzung ba dang rje mi la slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yin pa sogs gzhan gyi 'das pa'i tshul dpag med gsungs/ nyid kyi sprul pa da lta dus mtshungs pa tsam mchis zhus pas spyir nges pa med kyang shin tu gsal ba la bzhi tsam yod pa 'dra mnga' ris dang kha che'i bar spu rang na dge slong dge ba'i blo gros zhes gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs shing slob ma btsun chung zhig shi ba der skyes pa sogs mang po'i don byed/ bal bod kyi mtshams lan de na dge bsnyen chos kyi grags pa zhes brda chos 'ba' zhig ston pa yod/ rgya gar shar phyogs na rnal 'byor pa thugs rje chen po dngos yin zer ba 'dir bzhugs 'dir byon gyi nges pa med pa zhig dang / shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten rgyal po min pas mi thul ba zhig na grub thob rgyal po'i tshul 'dzin pa grags pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba yod/ gzhan yang du ma yod pa 'dra gsung ba sogs rang gi da ltar ba'i tshul dang / mi nyag gi rgyal po de dpal phag tshang pa'i skye ba yin pa dang / sngar slob ma zhig shi ba 'dzam yul du skyes gsungs nas phyis 'dzam yul du byon tshe byis pa des skye ba dran phyag phyir 'brangs pas 'dzam skye ba gsum par grags pa sogs gzhan gyi da lta ba mkhyen pa dpag tu med cing khyad par rje mar pa nga/ pal gyi ri dang nye ba shri nā ga ra'i grong na paṇ+ḍi ta zhig tu bzhugs rnal 'byor pa mdzad de 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ bla ma lha rje kha che dang rgya gar gyi bar grong pad+ma can du zhi ba'i go cha bya bar 'khrungs/ spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad/cing der 'di 867

nas slob ma bzhi bcu tsam skyes 'dug bla ma lha rje la sku'i sprul pa'ang nub phyogs bde ba bkod ba'i zhing na byang sems dri med grags pa dang / shar phyoṭa mu tig bye bas brgyan pa'i zhing na zla ba'i 'od ces pa yod cing sku dngos zhi ba'i go chas mu stegs kyi rgyal po btul nas yul de thams cad sangs rgyas par btsud de sku dngos yal nas 'jig rten gyi khams a sho kur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya rje sgom tshul nub phyogs kong ka nar 'khrungs te mu stegs kyi rgyal po btul nas don mdzad/ ras chung pa rgya bal gyi mtshams na rat+na su kha zhes spyod pa sna tshogs pa mdzad/ grub chen rdzong pa kha che dang o rgyan gyi bar na sngar gyi nye gnas ma de dang bcas te spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad/ spen phug pa la stod gtsang sor dga' ba'i ye shes bya bar 'khrungs/ dpal rga lo byang phyogs mu tig dra bas brgyan pa'i zhing du dpal gyi 'byung gnas sbas pa zhes par gyur/ dngul chu be+e ro pa stong kun rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs/ slob dpon phya pa kha che khri brtan du paṇ+ḍi tar 'khrungs pa sogs dpag tu med pa gzigs/ yang shar na dgas po phag sgom pa dang sgom pa zhi mdzes/ nub na ya zi sngon mo dang gser sgom ye shes snying po ste bla ma lha rje'i bu chen bzhis da lta 'gro don rlabs po che byed gsung ba sogs da ltar gyi tshul dpag med gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa yang smon lam bla ma khyod 'di nas tshe 'phos nas nub phyogs pad+ma can du mkhan po mnga' ris pa tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa de'i mkhan bur 'gyur ba dang / yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di skye ba gsum nas lam rnal ma la tshud par 'gyur gsung ba sogs dang /nyid phyi ma gar 'khrungs zhus pas o rgyan gyi byang shar /rti /ra rnal 'byor pa rat+na sid+dhi zhes par byas te yul de'i rgyal po 'dul/ bla ma lha rje dang yang mjal/ yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di sngags pa zhig tu gyur te kho bo la rab tu 'byung / yon tan 'od sogs khyed bdun rje rigs su skye kho bo dang 'phrad/868

yu'/ phyogs der slob dpon rin rgyal sogs mang du skye zhing bla ma lha rje dang mjal bar 'gyur/ yang lho brag grub pa'i gnas bdun du slob ma zhig gi don du skye ste yun ring po ni der mi sdod/ yang rgya gar lho phyogs u ru dang ḍā ki ma'i gnas kong ga bya bar skye zhing yon bdag dgon pa ba rgyal po zhig tu skyes nas lam rnal ma la der tshud gsungs shing / kho bo sangs rgyas pa'i dus na 'khor gyi dang skopo ni rgya gar lho phyogs kyi rnal 'byor pa mi tra dzo gi dang / mnga' ris stod kyi dge slong dge ba'i blo gros/ mi nyag rgyal po'i bla ma rgya byang chub sems dpa'/ dge bshes dkon mchog seng ge ste bzhi yin gsung zhing sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mi gsung yang zhang rin po ches drug pa seng ge yin gsungs/ de la sogs pa dus gsum thams cad sgrib med du mkhyen zhing gdul bya'i don du 'gyur ba cung zad tsam re gsungs pas mtshan yang dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags shing gdams ngag yang phag mo zhal bzhi ma/ rnam bzhi rgyud grol/ rmi lam 'brel ba gsum ldan/ lha 'dre stong gi sgrib shing sogs sngon ma grags pa'i zab gnad mtha' yas pa dag snang la gsan zhing mnga'/ rgya gar rdo rje'i gdan nas dpal rdo rje gdan pas sngon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bus pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung bskur te da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan ba'i dngos gzhi bod na gnas pa yin/ de'i bstan pa'i bdag po sa ra ha chen po shrī dharma kirtir bzhugs pa la phul zhig zhes 'bul du btang ba da lta gasto la'i mchod shoms la bzhugs/ de ltar don gnyis mthar phyin dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi pa chu mo glang gi lo'i zla ba brgyad pa tsam nas sgra 'od dang sa g.yo ba sogs kyi ltas rgyun ma chad par je 'phel du byung / bcu gcig pa stag gi zla ba'i tshes gsum la gdan sa ma zhig par gyis la 'dir sdod gsung ba dang / sgang lo tsā ba zham ring du yod pa la gzhon nu khyod kyis lo shas 'dir sdod la kho bo'i sku gsung thugs 869

rten rnams yi ge gcig kyang ma 'thor ba gyis ngas kyang chos skyong la bcol ba yin zhes sprul pa'i sku dngos su 'byon par don gyis lung bstan te yar tshes gsum du nye ba nas g.yos breng ma chad pa dang / yang dgon gyi steng du 'jade tshon gdugs 'dra bas khebs pa dang / nam mkha' la ḍa ma ru'i sgra mang po grag pa'i tshe sku'i bkod pa bsdus/ gdung bzhu ba'i sar dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten bzhengs te de bzhin gshegs pa glang po'i gdung nyer gcig dang rje nyid kyi rten ring bsrel sogs mtha' yas par bzhugs shing phyis mi nyag nas dge bshes gtsang so bas bskur te gser dzings kyis g.yogs/ thugs ljags kyi bzhugs khang gdung rten chen mo sgom chen ras pa bzhis mdzad do/ /rje de la bu chen byon tshul rnam thar rin chen phreng ba sogs dang kun khyab snyan pa'i ba dan sogs na mi snang yang sngon gyi rnam thar khungs ma gzhan mthong ba na 'di ltar snang ste mngon shes kyi bka' babs lde chung sangs rgyas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bka' babs 'bal tsha stag del ba/ rnam thar gyi bka' babs bra ba bka' gdams pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs dbra ye dge chos brtson/ 'gro don gyi bka' babs 'gro mgon ras chen te bka' babs kyi bu lnga/ gya ba gangs pa/ rang byung sangs rgyas/ gtsang so ba dkon seng / 'gro mgon ras chen bsnan pas rgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhi/ nam mkha' 'od/ ye shes 'od/ yon tan 'od/dge 'dun 'od de nye gnas 'od bzhi/ ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/'byung gnas bla ma/ rgyal mtshan bla ma ste bla ma bzhi/ dge slong brtson 'grus shes rab/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mdog mkhas pa/ rmeng ge jo sras te snga bu bzhi/ gtsang ston tshul seng / tre bo dkon mchog dpal/rdo rje shes rab/ sgang lo tsā ba ste phyi bu bzhi ste yongs grags kyi bu chen rang nyid kho nas smin grol du mdzad pa rnams dang / sto la yag pa byang chub 870

dngos grub/ dwags po 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ 'bri khung gi 'jig rten gsum mgon/ stag lung gi thang pa chen po/ rna phu'i gling ras pa/ ra lung gi gtsang pa rgya ras/ man ngag lung pa'i dran ston mtha' bral/ ri gong gi sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ rgya pho ba lung pa sogs ni dam pa'i chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen no/ /zhes snang zhing deb sngon du zhang rin po che yang bu chen du bgrangs so/ /de la lho la yag pa thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub dngon/ grub dang / dwags po 'dul 'dzin chog po ni bla ma lha rje'i dngos slob mched grogs kyi tshul nyid las bla ma rin po che la dad pa thob nas zhabs la gtugs pa yin la bla ma rin po che sku gshegs nas lho pas mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo gnyis gsum du mdzad/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa'i rnam thar du/ bla ma lho pa mdo po dgon na dbang bskur byed cing yod zer nas rmi lam bzung ltar phyin pas bla ma de bde mchog dngos su byas nas dbang bskur zhing 'dug ste bdag gis kyang thob/ da lta bod na bde mchog dngos kyis dbang bskur nus pa bla ma lho pa las mi 'dug go zhes bris pa de yin/ rje sgam po pa'i sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu yang mtshur phur bzhengs te spyan drangs nas slar sgam po'i gdan sa la byon/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin gyis kyang de'i 'og tu sgam po'i gdan sa mdzad/ grub thob gling ras kyis ni lo gtsang ra gsum rje dbu se zhang rin po che dpal phag gru pa rnams rtsa ba'i bla mar mtshungs par 'dzin te gsol 'debs sku lnga rab rdzogs las/ snang ba chos skur shar ba'i rgyal ba lo/ /dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i dam pa rje/ /zhes lo gtsang dang /thugs dgongs mkha' ltar dag pa'i mtha' tsa pa/ /thams cad mkhyen par rtsod med grags chen po/ /bde gshegs kun gyi dpal ldan rin po che/ /zhes rje phag gru pa dang / grub thob kun gyi rtsod med dbu se'i zhabs/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad 'gro mgon skye med zhang / zhes pas tshal mtshur gnyis bstan pa yin la/nya71

de bzhin du/ ras chung pa dang de yi sras/ /dpal ldan dam pa rnam gsum dang / /sgam pho pa dang rin po che/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mtshur phu pa/ skye med zhang dang rin chen mchog /zhes dang / mtshu ra phu mdo po'i dgon pa na/ /de na khams pa dbu se bzhugs/ /dus gsum ma lus mkhyen pa'i rje/ /rje des kyang bu tsho byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sogs gling gi gsung mgur du ma na snang ngo / /'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis kyang mtshur phur byon/ chos du ma gsan/ kho bo gtsang pa rgya ras bdag /nyams myong glu ru len lags pas/ /rje rin po che 'di la gsan par zhu/ /zhes sogs nas lung bstan rjes su gnang du gsol/ /zhes sogs kyi rtogs pa phul/ lung bstan gyi dgon pa bzhi la yang dbu ses lung bstan nas klong rdol btab/ ces gcig tu byed/ rna phu ba'i brgyud pa btsun pas 'dzin zhes pa'i lung bstan yang mtshur phur bzhugs dus byung bas phyis zhang rin po che las rab tu byung / bar zhig zhwa khra zhig kyang bzhes yod par snang ste byang tshwa kha la byon nas tshur res sgom du 'ongs nas nor khyer na rten 'brel 'chug pas snod dkrogs shig gsungs bkrogs pas rlung sgom gyi sgod nas krad pa zhig byung ba'ang bskyur/ tshur laca/ sgo pa lho pa'i jag pas mda' mdung gzings byung bas bla ma dbu se'i lugs kyi dbu zhwa zhig yod pa de mthong nas mtshur phu bar 'dug zer nas bshol/ da res dbu zhwa des srog mgo bton gsung bya ba rnam thar na snang zhing de'i mgur na yang / srin po sgo ba lho pa yis/ /mi bsad nor khyer mthong tsa na/ /nged btson du ma bzung mkhar rje che/ /bka' rgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa 'dra/ /'di yang bla ma rje yi drin/ /zhes byung ngo / /nye gnas 'od bzhi'i nam mkha' 'od kyi skye ba rim par brgyud pa sha grags pa seng ge nas bzung ste zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa rnams yin no//lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa sgam po la thegs rjes stod lungs gram du 'khrungs pa'i 872

rang byung sangs rgyas kyis gdan sa mdzad/ de nas gya ba gangs pa / de nas rgya mtsho bla mas mdzad de 'di gsum ga rje dus mkhyen gyi dngos slob yin/ de nas gdan sa rin grags kyis mdzad/ phyi ma gsum ga 'khrungs yul gya ba'i 'brog pa yin zhing de nas rje kurma pa phebs pa yin no/ /rgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo 'gro mgon ras chen ni gtsang pa'i yon tan mkhan po zhig gi sras su yar lungs su 'khrungs/ dgung lo dgu nas skyes bu chung 'bring gi blo ji lta bar 'khrungs te zangs ri ras gel gtugs/ do ha dang thun 'jog snyan rgyud sogs gsan/bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams khor yug tu byung / na za ras rkyang mdzad pas ras chen du grags/ gdung rus las gras te gru gu ras pa yang zer/ dgung lo bco lnga la bla ma bsnyung nas khyod la bka' rgyud zin pa cig yong bar shes te bla ma rje btsun pa'i lugs kyi dang po nas gdams ngag chal chol du mi ston par nges shes thob nas gdams ngag thams cad dus gcig tu ston pa yin pa la kho bo da lo bar chad byung da rgya sgom la gdams ngag rdzogs par yod pas kho la sten/lar ji ltar byas kyang bu khyod legs par 'ong gi gsungs nas 'das/ de nas dol gyi tshur ston dbang nge/ dpel phag mo gru pa/ gnyal du gtsang ston dkon mchog yab sras/ rje sgom zhig po sogs dang mjal/ gsar rnying gi gdams ngag mang du gsan/ chu 'dus su rje sgam po pa'i slob ma grub thob dar ma shes rab bya ba rlung dbu mar tshud 'od gsal khor yug tu gyur pa zhig la dbang byin rlabs zhus/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan du ma byung yar lungs su thugs so ma sod nas rang yul rna bas mi thos pa cig tu 'gro dgongs nas g.ye dwags kong po brgyud nal khams la byon pas lam du thod pa bsam 'grub la gcod kyi skor dang / mnga' ris pa la phyag rdor gos dmar can dang rdo rje legs pa'i byang bu nyer gcig pa sogs mang du gsan/ po bor gnyal ba jo sras dang mjal te 873

'jam dpal zhi khro'i skor dang khyad par mgon po lcags par ma gsan te zhal gzigs/ yum gyica/ 3bod mi btang byung ba la mi 'byon pa'i phyir nor med par log na mi yong zhes thabs kyes brid nas tsha ba sgang rong smar khams sogs su byon/ pu 'bor gyi 'bu yul du nang 'khrug bsdums/ bon po btul te sngags gra chen po bco brgyad tsam btsugs pas deng sang gi bar du dar zhing ma mgon grub pa mang du byung / rtsa rlung gi yon tan dang nus pa dang mkhyen pa che bas thuṭa khengs pa ltar yod pa na/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa gam po gnas nang na bzhugs pa'i snyan grags cher gsan pas chos zhu rgyu med phyag zhig 'tshal du 'gro snyam nas byon pas chos rjes khyod sngags chung shes rab can nga'i slob ma'i slob ma byas na 'ong bar 'dug pa la gsungs/ khyed la slob ma ci 'dra yod zhus pas/ lde chung sangs rgyas dang 'bal tsha stag del ba sogs yod khyod rang de pa'i sar song gsungs/ lde chung can du byon pas khyod sngags chung shes rab can nga'i bla ma'i slob ma byas na 'ong bar 'dug pa la da 'bal tsha stag del ba can du song zer/byon pas phug pa cig na stag chen po cig nyal nas 'dug skrag ste bros pas da dung song zer phyin pas stag gi shul na mtsho chung zhig 'dug bskor ba byas rde'u 'ga' bskyur nas phyin pas da dung song zer phyin pas mtsho med par sgom chen zhig 'dug pa'i pang pa na sngar bskyur pa'i rde'u yang 'dug des kyang de skad zer bas slob ma 'di 'dra na bla ma'i yon tan lta ci smos snyam nas dad pa dbang med tu skyes te gdams ngag zhus nas lo bdun dbu sngas la mi 'jog par dam bcas nas bsgoms pas rtogs pa'i phu thag chod/'di ni rnam thar bdud rtsi bum bzang ma ltar yin la gnaca/ nang pa rnams kyi ngag sgros la ras chen pas nus pa 'gran par bzhed de rje dus mkhyen gyi drung du byon pas phug pa zhig na sgom chen bgres po zhig 'dug pa mthong bas zil 874

ma bzod de phyag byas/ nga khyed dang nus pa 'gran dgos byas pas nga rgas pas khyod dang 'gran pa mi 'ong khyod la mgron zhig bya gsungs nas chu ka pā la do khogs mar blug se ru rus pa skud pa la btags pa zhig thab gong na bkal 'dug pa lan gnyis dkrugs te 'khol ba dang gnyi gas ka la re gsol bas sngon ma myong ba'i ro bcud dpe med par myong bas dad pa skyes/ khyod rang nus pa 'gran na nga'i slob ma lde chung sangs rgyas kyi sar song gsungs/ khong gis sngar ltar 'bal tsha stag del ba lung bstan nas lus sprul bsgyur zad par gyi bkod pa mthong / der khong dang gtum mo'i drod 'gran par byas nas dgun sgang chen mtshan mo phu chu'i chab rom gyi steng du stod du stag del bas gcer bur bzhuṭa/ras chen pas rdo rgyang gang tsam gyi smad du de ltar bzhugs pas stag del ba'i 'dom skor gsum gyi chab rom zhu nas chu tshan ltar gyur yang 'thur du 'bab ma bcug par gyen du bskyil bas khong rang gi sku lus la gyen du 'khyil zhing rlangs pa dang 'dres pas sprin brtsegs pa ltar gyur te 'dug ras chen pa bzhugs pa'i skus gar khyab yid tsam zhu nas cung dro bar gyur kyang khong gis chu rlung gi zer btang bas shin tu grang bar gyur pa'i tshe tho rengs kyi cha la rje dus mkhyen nam mkha' la byon nas stag del ba khyod kyis sngags chung 'di 'khyags rir ma gsad gsungs pas khong gis ting nge 'dzin glod pa na chu tshan gyi rgyun gyis chab rom thams cad dus gcig du khyer skad/ der dad pa cher skyes nas bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs zhes sgrog cing snang ngo / /de nas slob dpon bka' gdams ba'i drung du yang lo gsum bsgoms/ 'di yan rnal 'byor pa lcang lo can du yod pa la chos rje dang bka' gdams pa'i gsung mnyan te mkhan po khroms pa las dgung lo so bdun la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad 'di sngon nas byas na 'tshengs te snyam pa byung / mtshan bsod nams grags par btags/ yang 875

marmar chos rje'i drung du lo gsum bzhugs te chos gdams ngag thams cad tshar bar mdzad/ sngon chos rje kho bo dbus su 'gro khyod kyang dbus dga' ba yin gsung ba la dbus pha yul yin pas mi 'gro ba'i dam bca' yod pa lags/gzhan gar phyin na legs zhus pas me mdor zhing khams dkar chos byed kyi 'dug sa yang bzang / lar khyod gang du phyin yang legs par 'ong gsung ba yod pas drung du dbus su bzhud dam dris pas nga na ning nas kyi de yin mod gsungs nas rin po che dbus su byon pa la rta shod rnam rgyal gyi bar du bskyal/ lar dbus su phyin na 'gro phan 'di bas che bar 'dug ste de dus dbus kyi 'dun pa btang nas nyal bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'od zer dpag med 'phro bar mthong gsungs/ chos rje rin po che rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang bde mchog dang rje btsun ma dpag med kyis bskor ba sogs lan du mar gzigs/slob dpon bka' gdams pas dbang bskur zhig mdzad pa'i tshe khong gis dmiṭa pa ji ltar bsgoms pa dang / ye shes 'bebs tshe sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na ḍā ki ma lcags kyi mda' gzhu can bzhi khong gis dmigs pa gar gtad du mda' gzhu wang wang byed pa gzigs pas mkhan po dad de dbang bskur tshur zhus/ spyir yi dam chos skyong thams cad nam 'dod du gzigs/ bya byed legs nyes thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mas sku'i rnam 'gyur gyis brda'i tshul du ston/mtshur phur chos rje rin po che sku yal ba mkhyen te gsol 'debs mdzad/ phyis 'das mchod mdzad tshad la dag snang mtha' yas pa shar te bla ma'i 'das mchod 'di rang ngo mtshar che bar 'dug gsung zhing zhal rtag tu gzigs/ bon po thams cad nus mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyis btul te bon po las rgyal ba'i mgur bzhengs/ kurma dang gnas nang sogs su bzhugs nas chos rje rin po che'i rgyal tshab mdzad de 'phrin las bskyangs/ dgung lo bdun bcu bzhes pa'i dus mnal 876

lam na bka' rgyud kyi bla ma kun byon te rab byung 'ga' tsam las phal cher rnal 'byor par 'dug te lo pas/ nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin du/ /thogs med shes rab bzang po 'gro /gsung nas lho nub kyi nam mkha' la bzhud/ de bzhin du re res tshigs bcad re gsungs te bzhud pa'i phyi bzhin nyid kyang 'phur nas bzhud pa rmis gsungs/ de nas sku cung zad bsnyun par bstan te nga'i bla ma gong ma rnams lho nub tu bzhud pas nga yang der 'gro ba yin gsungs te nyer lnga'i tho rangs zhi bar gshegs/ gdung bzhus pas ring bsrel nam mkha' las char gyi tshul du 'bab ba dang lha'i rol mo byung / rten du ma dang khyad par thugs shel lta bu byon pa sogs sku 'bum du bzhugs so/ /slob ma'ang nyid kyis nga'i 'khor rnams la dge sbyor skyong rgyu med pa med/ sems ngo shes pa shin tu mang / nga mi dgos pa'ang 'ga' re yod ces gsungs shing / slob ma'i gtso bo ni rgyal sras sprong brag pa yin te 'bri dam pa chos phyug tu 'khrungs/ dgung lo lnga nas 'bri klog mkhas par mkhyen/ dgu nas gnyan lha khang sgang pa la ma rgyud gsan/ bcu bzhi'i tshe rje 'gro mgon gyi snyan pa gsan/ mtshan thos pas ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skyes/ bud med dmar mo bud med mang pos bskor ba zhig gis khyod kyi bla ma dwags po sgom chung gi skye ba 'gro mgon ras chen yin zhes lung bstan/ de nas zhag bcu na 'bob skar sgang du rje ras chen byon pa dang mjal/ rab tu byung ste mtshan bsod nams rdo rjer gsol/ bla ma phyag na rdo rje dngos su thag chod pa byung / rje btsun ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba zhig gi dbang bskur mdzad pas ye shes 'bebs tshe phyogs bcu ka rje btsun ma'i dkyil 'khor du yun ring du gsal bas bla mas btsun chung 'dis nga'i dbang bskur thob pa yin gsungs/ de phyin chad pha bu phrad pa ltar thugs la btags/ skungs dgon par 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs gzigs pa la yun ring du yengs/ de'i rjes 877

su gnas lugs sems kyi ngo bo spros bral ji lta bar rtogs gsungs/ de nas ring por ma lon par thang shing zhig gi mdun du ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas de'i yal ga re re'i steng na yang rje dus mkhyen dpag med bzhugs te mgrin gcig tu/skye med kyi don la goms par mi byed par dmigs pa sna tshogs la zhen par ma byed gsung ba yun ring du gzigs/ de'i mod la sgom med kyi ngo bo rnal ma de rtogs gsungs/ /mar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos bla ma la bskor ba byed pa gzigs/ lha phu gnam rdzong du dpal lha mos phyag btsal/ sgrol dkar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ sngags bdag gis yon bdag tu khas blangs/ mi g.yo ba la khro bo mang pos bskor ba sogs gzigs snang mang du byung / bla ma la zhus pas sgom chen pa'i lam rtags mgo ma tsam yin/ de tsam la rlom sems byar mi rung gsungs/ ras chung pa rtogs ldan yin zhes yang yang gsung zhing yon tan can du grags pas stoms chung yin yang gra pa stong gi nang na kun gyis bkur zhing bla ma mchog tu dgyes/ yon sgom grags shes 'bul chen khyer nas chos skyong gi gtor dbang zhus pa'i zhar la zhus pas ma mgon gnyis phyag bzhi pa dang gsum dus gcig tu gzigs/ bla ma'i zhal nas chos skyong la'ang gtad ba mi 'dugayon sgom gyis zas nor 'di tsam btang ba las ras chung pa la chu phul gang gtang rgyu med pa la dgyes par 'dug gsungs/ der bla ma bka' drin can 'di la zang zing gi 'bul ba zhig bya dgos snyam nas sa smad du gra ge'i bla mchod la 'byon par dgongs tsa na/ bla mas ras chung pa kho 'dud kyis khyer/ bla ma'i zhabs tog sgrub pa yin pa la zhes yang yang gsungs/ de skad zhur phyin pas sa smad du ye ma 'gro mi khams shin tu gnag bar chad byung nyen yod sgrub pa 'di gar byas na dga' gsungs/ sku 'da' khar nga'i slob ma kun gyis rang mgo thon tsam re yod/ blo gros rin chen dang khyed gnyis la bstan pa'i bdag po re/ khyad par 878

du khyod la 'phrin las chen po 'byung / khyod kyi bu slob yang slob kyi ring nas bstan pa phyogs med du rgyas gsungs/ de'i tshe bla ma shākya thub pa sangs rgyas dpag med kyis bskor bar gzigs pas bstan pa'i bdag po byed pa'i brda yin gsungs/ bla ma 'das nas gdung sbyang ba'i dus su rgyal ba rigs lnga dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs dpag med gzigs shing 'og min lta bu'i snang ba shar nas gdung dbyangs dang gar bsgyur ba sogs spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad pas kha cig nged tsho sdug bsngal ba'i tshe 'di ltar byed pa zer ma dga' ba byung skad/ de nas rmen 'dor la byon thugs phyogs med kyi ri la gtad ba'i tshe rje dus mkhyen gyis gar yang ma 'gro 'di nyid du sgoms don gnyis mthar phyin par 'gyur ro gsung ba gsan nas ba le gong du bsgoms pas yon tan mtha' yas pa 'khrungs/rtsol sgrub med par 'phrin las rnam bzhi grub/ mi dang mi ma yin thams cad 'dus/ longs spyod char ltar du bab snyan pas phyogs thams cad du khyab ste gnas der lo bcu drug bzhugs/ de dus ka thog gtsang ston pa de snyan pa che bas mnal lam gtad pa na longs sku'i lha tshogs dang khong gi dbu thog na 'ja' 'od dang he ru ka mang po gzigs pas chos gsan pas slar mkhyen pa phyogs med du rgyas/ de nas khru shod spong brag tu gdan sa bzung zhabs cung zad ma bde ba na bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad dang khyad par rje 'gro mgon byon te/skye ba med la mnyam rjes med/ /na tsha sdug bsngal 'khrul pa ste/ /skye shis 'jiṭa na sgom chen min/ /zhes gsung ba rgesan pas mnyam rjes rang sar daṅka ste sku gsum gyi ngo bor grub bo/ /gzhan don rgya cher mdzad nas re zhig smar khams su phebs pa na sku khams ma bde bas rje darma pa phyag phyir bzhugs pa la da ni kho bo 'gro bar 'dug rje /3gro mgon gyi gsung nas smar khams su ma 'gro yang yang gsung ba la glo bur du 'ong dgos byung bas bla ma'i gsung bcag pas lan nya79

par 'dug 'on kyang kho bo rkyen gyis mi brdzi nyam nga dang bral ba'i gdeng yod ces mgur mang po gsungs/ skad cig gis dga' ldan du byams pa'i snang ba 'char/ nga dang byams pa la gsol ba thob/ nga'i sprul ba cig garti ka na rje dus mkhyen gyi sprul pa de'i rgyal tshab byas nas gzhan don cher byed gsungs/yang rje /rma pa la bka' rgyud 'di slob dpon las slob ma 'phrin las che bar 'byung ba yin zhing kho bo yan gyi bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyi 'phrin las khyod gcig pu la brten nas 'byung bar 'dug bu slob skal ldan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ngo gsungs nas sku 'das te mtshan ltas dpag med byung ngo / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal kurma pa ni sngon rdzogs ldan gyi tha ma rtsod ldan gyi dang po mang bskur rgyal po'i dus rdo rje 'chang in+d+ra bhū ti ye shes sgrib pa med pa'i skur bstan pa'i tshe shākya'i rigs mthong na yid 'ong gi mdun du rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'od ye shes dbyings su gyur/ yang sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi drung du bka' bsgrubs dgongs pa rdzogs par byas/ nyan thos mchog brgyad/ sems dpa' brgyad/ rnal 'byor grub chen brgyad dang gnyis su med pas sngags kyi grub thob mtha' yas par bsten/ rgyal po dza'i khab tu chos kyi glegs bam babs ba'i tshe rgyal po dza'i tsha bo badz+ra shrīr gyur pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa lha'i bu kun dga' snying po dga' rab rdo rjer byas nas rdzogs pa chen po ston pa'i tshe tog tse rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu gyur nas rdzoṭa chen thams cad rtogs nas da lta'i bar sngags gsar rnying thams cad ji lta bar mngon du gyur pa brjod pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i drung du rgyal po chen po zhig tu gyur pas rgyal srid thams cad chags thogs med par byin/ de bzhin du klu sgrub kyi sgob ma dge slong yon tan blo gros zhes nus pa mchog tu gyur/ rgya nag stong kun du rig 'dzin rnal 'byor par gyur nas lha 'dre mi gsum 880

dam la btags te bstan pa drag po'i sgo nas btsugs/ byang phyogs lcang lo can du gnod sbyin gyi bdag po'i bur gyur pas gnod sbyin rnams kyi don byas/ dge slong ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes bya bar gyur te khro gnyer can grub/ mes srong btsan sgam po'i dus su shar phyogs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba seng ge rab tsol du gyur te da lta'ang rgyal po de yod/ slob dpon zhing gi rdo rje zhes bya ba zhig kyang yin te 'di rnams dus mtshungs/ nub ba lang spyod du rnal 'byor pa nyi ma'i 'od zer du gyur te mu stegs btul bas da lta 'dul sla ba yin/ de'i tshe nub phyogs su mgon po nag po la dbang bsgyur ba'i sngags pa cig tu gyur nas mgon po dngos su grags/ yang rgya gar nub phyogs su rnal 'byor pa seng ge ye shes can du gyur te brtul zhugs kyis 'gro ba btul/ de'i tshe nyid na rnal 'byor ma chang tshong mar gyur nas snang srid dbang gi 'phrin las kyis rgyal 'bangs smin grol la bkod/ de'i tshe da lta'i 'di lta bu rgyal khams kun tu rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul ba zhig kyang byung zhes sogs sngon gyi tshul dus mnyam pa dang snga phyi can sogs mtha' yas par gsungs shing da ltar yang yu gur gyi nang na brtul zhugs kyis 'dul ba dang / bal bod kyi mtshams na rngon pa'i gzugs can dang yar lungs na chags lam pa zhig ste sku'i bkod pa dus mtshungs su gsungs pa las sku dngos 'di ni/spyir chos sku rang byung mtshon du med pa in+d+ra bhū ti dang po'i o rgyan dang / longs sku bde chen cung zad mtshon du yod pa in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa'i o rgyan de nyid dang /sprul sku bems po rtsi shing nags tshal can sems can gyi gnas in+d+ra bhū ti mtha' ma'i o rgyan te gsum las sprul sku in+d+ra bhū ti nyid bram ze chen po sa ra har bstan pa bod yul du grub thob dbu se zhes grags pa rje dus mkhyen mya ngan las 'das nas lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe bod chen po mdo khams 'bri chu'i rgyud dam pa chos kyis phyug pa'i yul stong byi le'i tshag to zhes bya bar btsad po u'i 881

rigs yab rgya dbang tshur tsha dang yum seng bza' mang skyid kyi sras chung shos su me pho stag gi lo la /3khrungs/ deb sngon du ni de las lo gnyis kyis snga ba'i shing byi de 'khrungs lor 'chad/ mtshan chos 'dzin du gsol/ lo lnga nas yig klog mkhas par mkhyen te dgung lo bcu pa'i bar du gsung rab mtha' dag gzigs pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ sems nyid g.yo 'gul med pa ri bo ltar brtan pa byung yang rang ngo cung zad ma rtogs pa rje spong brag pas ngo sprad de sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa lta bur gyur/ de ring nam mkha' dpa' bo mkha' 'gros gang ba dang khyod 'dug pa'i thad na rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma sprin gtibs pa lta bu snang ste khyod ni las can du 'dug khyod dang 'phrad phyin dag snang la zad pa med gsungs nas dgung lo bcu gcig pa la rab tu phyung dpal chen po chos kyi bla mar mtshan gsol/ dbang gdams ngag thams cad tshangs sprugs su gnang / phyis dgung lo'i tshigs tshang nas ka thog pa byams pa 'bum gyis mkhan po/ rin po che sbong brag pas slob dpon/ spyan snga mang phu bas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ gtum mo sgyu lus 'od gsal phyag chen dbyer med pa rlung sems gnad kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor bas bde drod kyis gangs ri zhu nus pa byung / brgyud pa 'di'i gdams ngag la khyod lta bu'i brtson 'grus dgos pa yin gsungs nas mnyes/ ma mgon gyi dbang zhus pas zhal gzigs 'phrin las thogs med du sgrub/ thun bar du rje btsun ma'i snying po bzlas zhal rgyun du mthong / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bgrang gis mi lang ba rtag tu gzigs pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas rlung sems kyi 'dus tshul yin/ sgom chen pa'i rtags snang 'go ma tsam gsungs/brag go tshang can du gcig pur bsgoms pas thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i sna la yig drug dmar po shas che ba gsal zhing 882

nam mkha'i khams thams cad du yig drug 'ur dir du grag pa'i nang nas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje yi/ /'phrin las 'od zer phyogs bcur rgyas/ /zhes rang byung du grags shing sems can re re'i mdun na yang de lta bu snang ba thams cad rang nyid la thim zhi nga 'phro ba dang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rigs lngas/rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /zhes gsung ba gsan pas rgyud sde stong dang bdun brgya'i sgo phyed/ lung pa dmar po yangs shing che ba zhig na chang gi rgyun chu bo dbyar 'brub pa lta bu 'bab pa la bud med cig gis 'di'i phu la yar song dang gang nas 'bab mthong bar 'gyur la 'di ni khyod kyi yin te da dung yun ring du 'bab po zer/ phu der byon pas ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba zhig nas 'bab cing 'dug pa'i steng gi nam mkhar rje btsun ma gtso 'khor bcu bdun gzigs/ bla mas kyang brgyud pa'i gdams ngag gi che ba thon/ bka' rgyud kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa khyod la 'byung zhes lung bstan/chos skyong gi zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gnam sa khyab pa spyan nyi zla shar ba tsam zhig nyin gcig tu hūX sgra sgrog cing snang srid zil gyis non pa'i 'phrin las 'byung gsung ba gsan/ gtum mo'i drod kyis dgun sgang chen yang bzhugs pa'i lung par chab rom mi chags/ bzhugs phug gi brag zhu rdo bcal gyi rdo dkar nag thams cad lugs blug pa ltar 'dres pa sgrub rdor grags pa da lta yang mjal du yod/ shar phyogs spung ri'i gzhi bdag gis spyan drangs te ri 'di nye ba'i gnas yin pas pho brang gdab par zhus/ 'phrin las la bskul ba'i lung bstan du ma byung na'ang thugs cung zad kyang ma g.yos par lo bcu gcig tu ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ sa g.yo ri 'gul thog char ltar 'bab pa'i cho 'phrul rnams zil gyis mnan/ rtsol sgrub sna tshogs kyis 'phrin las re re zung zung grub pa dang / yul khams re re zung zung gi slob dpon la dgos pa med dgongs te phyag rgya chen 883

po'i srog mthu/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nor sgrub/ byang chub sems kyi dbang sdud/ gcig shes kun grol gyi mkhyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo bskor/ gra pa lnga brgya tsam la rgyags rtsol med du bkye nas rtse gcig tu sgom du bcug lha srin sde brgyad bran du bkol/ ma mgon lcam dral pho nyar bkye ste rgya dang 'jang yan la lam rgya dang 'phrin las bzhi dngos su mdzad/ sgo rig tu smyo ba btul te gtor ma chen po mi bzhis mi theg pa phyag gcig gis 'phangs/ yab legs ldan nag pos sa smad lha dmag gis bkang ste tsan+da na'i beng gis/ bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal/ /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab/ /ces pa'i brdar sa la ri mo gsum byas/ zhabs sa la drag por brdabs pa 'phrin las kyis 'dzam gling g.yo nus pa'i brdar dgongs nas mtsho rong mchod khang gi sgo la nged kyis 'dzam gling tsam la khyab pa kun gyi bdag po 'ong ngam sus shes bya ba bris bcu gcig zhal nam mkha' khyab pas yi ge drug pa'i 'phrin las kyis 'gro don gyis shig ces dang / rigs bzhi mkha' 'gros chos 'dis 'dul ba'i dus la bab bo zhes bskul bas gtso bor yig drug gis gdul bya 'dul/ gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor bas ma ṇi dbyangs su gyer zhing 'di ltar zlos shig mthong thos thams cad byin gyis rlob po zhes gsung ba gsan pas de phyin ma ṇi dbyangs su gyer bas khrom thams cad rig pa 'ur ba'i byin rlabs byung / thugs rje chen pos rnam snang gangs can mtsho nga'i sprul pa yin/ thams cad smon lam la rag las pas smon lam rgya cher thob cig gsung bas/ kun gzhi byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bya ba'i smon lam btab/ spung ri'i rtser gtor ma mdzad pa na 'dam chen spong ra'i ri rtse na tshur sprin shel lta bu gangs ri dang tha mi dad pa'i nang du thugs rje chen po skyu mdog ser la dmar ba'i mdangs can gar 884 ༄

stabab/ su bzhugs steng 'og phyogs mtshams mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor ba zhig gis 'gro ba kun la nged kyis 'od zer bkye ba yin gyis da phyin yig drug gis 'phrin las dpag med 'byung / phyogs ris med par ston cig gsung ba gsan/de phyin sgrub thabs kyi mjug tu dbang ma thob pa dang slob dpon gyis chos ma rdzoṭa par nyams su len pa rnams kyang 'phrin las thugs rje chen po dang mnyam par gyur cig ces 'bri bar mdzad de/ grub thob chen po'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor rnams la mos pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blangs na shes mi shes/ thob ma thob/ tshang ma tshang / dag ma dag ji ltar byung yang / byin rlabs rtsol med du 'jug pa yin te 'di ni thugs rje chen po'i rgyud rnams las kyang nyon mongs pa'i sems kyis sam ku re dang kyal ga'i ched tsam du'ang bdag gi rig pa 'di brjod na phan yon 'di dag ma grub na bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bslus pa lags so zhes gsungs pa nyid do/ /shar phyogs sman bla'i zhing dang 'jig rten gyi khams pad+ma can la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho gzigs shing dam pa'i chos 'gro /thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong dang zhal phyag grangs med dang gsang ba ye shes zhal phyag rab 'byams la sogs pa'i yi dam gzhal du med pa rtag par 'du 'bral med par gzigs/ slob dpon pad+ma/ dpal rta mgrin/dam pa rgya gar mi tra dzo gi rnams dang rang nyid tha mi dad par mkhyen/ kha che gos dmar ba'i sde pa las rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul tshad mngon gsum gsan te 'dul ba rgya mtsho mtha' yas la sogs pa bka' 'bum na bzhugs/ bod chen po mdo khams sgang drug du rdzu 'phrul dang nus pas bon dang log lta thams cad btul te bstan pa nyin mo ltar mdzad/ de'i tshe dpal lha mo nag mo 'bum sde dang bcas pas mtshur phur 'dong zhes nub gsum du bskul zhing rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad kyang lha mo'i tshogs su gyur nas lam la ma thogs par byon zer 885

zhing sngon la thal/ lam cung zad nor tshe mgon po la drag tu bos pas mgon po'i lha dmag 'bum stes sna drangs pa phal cher gyis mthong / 'bri gung thil bas gus par byas/ skyi shod du jo bo rje dang 'phan yul rag mar dam pa rgya gar dpag med gzigs te de dag gi 'phrin las kyi rgyun yod par dgongs/ lha sar jo bo las 'od zer byung ba sku la mngon sum du thim/ gser gsol gyi dus rta mgrin dbu stong phyag stong la slob dpon pad+ma grangs med pas bskor ba 'od zer nyi zla ltar 'bar ba gzigs te snang srid zil gyis non pa'i brdar dgongs/ ca ra nas ma mgon thams cad kyis bsus te mtshur phur phebs/ de'i tshe mtshur phu'i dgon gling dang be ris nyams par byas te stong par bzhag pa'i tshe phebs te lha mo'i pho brang yang byang shar nas der spos par gzigs gzhan snang du 'ur sgra sa g.yo ba lta bu zhag du ma byung / lo drug tu bzhugs te zhig gso mdzad dar rgyas su gyur/ lha mos /ma tshang gi chos rgyud 'dzin phyin sgrub thabs mi shes kyang sdong grogs thams cad bgyid par srog snying phul/ sgam po nas bla ma lha rje ri rab tsam rang la thim par gzigs te sgrub rgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i brdar dgongs/ bram ze chen po la grub thob mtha' yas pas bskor te skye med kyi sgra skad phyogs bcur sgrog pa gzigs te mchog gi grub thob mang du 'byung ba'i brdar dgongs/ bde mchog kun tu zhal dang rje btsun mi la sogs gzigs/tsā rir byon te dag snang rab 'byam du gzigs/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku grangs med pas/ sprul skus 'gro don mdzad pa la/ /rtsol sgrub ci yang med pa yin/ /gsungs te 'phrin las rtsol med du 'byung bar dgongs/ gtsang la byon pa'i tshe bde mchog gi lha tshogs thams cad gtsang la 'byon par gzigs te gtsang du bstan pa dar par mkhyen/ tshong 'dus 'gur mo sogs su 'gro mang smin grol du mdzad/ btsan brag tu rgya gar gyi mkha' 'gro ma dpag med byung ste do nub 886

gnas mang por tshogs kyi 'khor lo yod pas tshogs kyi gtso bo la 'byon par zhu zer te/ kurti ga o rgyan/ ha ha sgrog pa/ dpal gyi ri sogs gnas mang por dus gcig tu sku'i bkod pas grub thob mang po dang tshogs 'khor byas/gzhan snang du khams mi bde bar mngon pa zhig byung 'dug brtan ma bcu gnyis/ ha bo gang bzang / gnyan chen thang lha sogs srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis gus pas srog snying phul/ klu dung skyong gi bu dbus gtsang gi bdag po gnyan chen khar nag gis dbus gtsang gi mi nor sa gzhi dang bcas pa khyed la 'bul zer te de'i phyir dbus gtsang du'ang bstan pa dar bar 'ong gsungs/gtsang 'gram la byon tshe kun gyis mthong bar klu thams cad kyis sbrul mgo zings se phyag btsal/ gzang khri zam khar nye 'don chen mo mdzad tshe skya ser dpag med 'dus pa la 'gro don tshad las 'das shing da dung yang nye 'don gyi srol de yod/ gru gu sgang du gral dpon mdzad nas g.yor bo byang thang la 'byon par dgongs pa'i tshe gru pas gru ma btang bas mkha' 'gro ma mang pos nam mkha' la gdan drangs pa'i snang ba byung / gzhan snang du 'ja' tshon gyi lam la 'byon pa dang chu la ma reg pa dang brgal bar snang ba sogs mthong snang sna tshogs pas dpon slob thams cad chu la ma thogs par lho khar phebs/ de'i tshe lho phyogs su rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i sku 'od zer nyi ma ltar 'bar ba la 'khor sangs rgyas grangs med pas bskor nas theg chen gyi chos sgra sgrog pa yun ring du byung bas lho phyogs 'dir yang bstan pa dar bar 'ong ngam sems gsungs/ mtshur phur rnam thos sras mdung dmar can 'brug la bzhon pa 'khor gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum sde rta ljang la bzhon pas phyag btsal te nga'i pho brang du 'byon par zhu zer ba byung / de nas ring po ma lon par go be la rgyal bus/ mtha' 'khob tu chos kyi sgron me spar ba la 'byon par zhu zhes pa'i lung byung / sngags bdag gis kyang 'phrin las 887

'byung bas 'byon par bskul/ da bus gtsang gi brtan ma dang lha klu thams cad kyis bzhugs par zhus pa la nged kyi gdan sa rnams skyongs myur du sleb 'ong zhes gsungs pas bka' bzhin sgrub par khas blangs/ mdo khams brgyud de shing byi la 'khrungs na dgung lo nga gnyis bzhes pa yos lo la rong yul gser stong ces bya bar rgyal bu dang mjal/ sems bskyed gnang / slar khong gi pho brang du byon mu stegs dang zin shing rdzu 'phrul gyis btul/ ke chur 'jam dpal ser po phyag stong spyan stong pa gzigs pa sku tshe phyi ma gnyis kyi 'phrin las kyi brdar 'dug rgyal bu dang yon mchod 'phrod pas rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang ma 'ongs pa phra dog 'byung bar mkhyen zhing thugs rje chen pos kyang / 'di na yun ring ma 'dug cig /chags sdang mang po 'byung bar snang / /zhes lung ston pa gzigs pas zhal gyis ma bzhes pas rgyal bu cung zad yi chad/ mi nyag snyar byon rnam sras dang chos skyong gis bskul te zhag brgya dang gcig la 'phrul snang sprul pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ hor mi nyag gi mtshams su gdug byed sbrang bu'i 'jigs pa nyi ma 'grib pa byung ba rdo rje srin po'i lta stangs kyis btul/ sa dang bye ma rnams byin gyis brlabs pas da lta yang sbrang ma byung na bye ma gtor bas thub pa yod de thun mong gi grub rtags dang por grags/ byang phyogs li chu'i mkhar du rtog ge ba dang mu stegs du mas phrag dog byas pa rdzu 'phrul gyis btul ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sprin gtibs pa lta bus grogs mdzad/ tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can dang / gnam lha dkar pos spyan drangs te hor yul dngos su byon/ gam chu mkhar du sa'i lha mo brtan mas gser gyi bum pa dang nor bu rin po che phul/ sngon glang po che'i gzugs kyis sdig spyod kyi rgyal po btul nas gnas spar ba de rje dus mkhyen tham po gnas nang na bzhugs tshe kham po rdza la bya bar bon po 'byor pa can zhig tu gyur/ zhabs thog thams cad 888

bsgrubs ci yod chos rje'i phyogs su btang bas yon bdag dgon pa bar grags pa de rgya mi nyag hor bod thams cad kyi rgyal po mong gor gan du gyur te rgyal sar bzhugs nas lo bzhi 'das shing 'phags pa rin po che dang go be la glang lo la mjal nas lo gsum lon pa me 'brug gi lo la 'ong ge'i yul khams pho brang chen po zir 'ur rdor byon/ pho brang du phebs la khad par gnam lcags kyi thog char bzhin du byung ba rta mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan pas char pa bab pa tsam las su la yang ma gnod/ spyan ras gzigs kyi lta stangs kyis rgyal po byin gyis brlabs te 'ja' dang 'od zer gyi dag snang bstan/ rgyal po'i zhal nas nged kyi bar chad zlog cig gsung ba na sang nyin lan du 'dzam gling la dbang ba'i rgyal po khyod lta bu shin tu dkon/ khyed kyi bar chad kyang nga min pas zlog par mi nus/ bar chad chen po 'dug ba zlog pa'i phyir gnam phyogs med du mchod/ yo byad dang bang mdzod thams cad kun la khye/ btson thams cad thong zhes bka' bsgos/ rgyal po de sog po erga bo'i lta grub 'dzin zhing 'dug pa las ldog ste sangs rgyas par bsgyur/ rgyal po la zhag du mar dbang bskur zhing sku bzhi ngo sprod kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe bram ze chen po la grub thob brgyad bcus bskor te re res kyang sprul pa dpag med bkye nas hor thams cad byin gyis rlob cing rang nyid la thim pa'i snang ba nyin zhag gsum tsam du byung / de'i tshe rgyal po 'khor bcas sems gzung 'dzin las grol/ chos nyid kyi don rtogs/mdzod dang bang ba thams cad phyogs med du bkye/ nam mkha' las/ gtong ba che dang blo che ba/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra chen po byung / btson khang sprung/ thebs bcu gsum zhus pa gnang / hor gyi mi yur chen mo bcad/ chab 'og thams cad du dus chen bzhi la srog mi gcod pa/ nya stong la bsnyen gnas srung ba/ gnam mchod thams cad rang rang gi sdom pa la gnas dgos pa dang thams cad dge 889

bcu la spyod dgos par dril bsgrags/ rgyal po la phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa rtsol med du shar/ sngon rje dus mkhyen gyis yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di skye ba gsum pa la lam rnal ma la tshud/ gzod nga mi dgos pa yin zhes pa ltar ming yongs su grags pa kurma pa rgyal po mong gor gan gcig po'i don du byung zhing skyes pa yin yang rgyal khams thams cad la phan par byung zhes gsungs/gu rum du rgyal po nyid kyis phyag len mdzad nas lha khang dpag med bzhengs/ rgya hor mi nyag yu gur thams cad du lha khang mchod rten rnying gso gsar bzheng gi lung dang yo byad bkye/ thams cad du smin grol dbang gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar te yig drug gi sgras gang / hor gyi rgyal po la chos kyi rgyal khrims mdzad pa rgyal po 'di kho na yin no/ /'brug gi lo de nyid la 'ur rdor rgyal rgyud thams cad rgyal po chen po'i spyan sngar 'dus pa'i tshe klu gdug pa can dang rā hu la'i rnam 'phrul sprin nag gza' bdud kyi gzugs su 'khrigs/ thog bu yug ltar 'tshubs pa'i tshe grub thob chen pos khro bcu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis hūX sgra sgrog bzhin pas rta rgyugs mdzad pas thog sprin ded pa ltar bros te rang yal/ de'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes drug la mgon pos bskul te rtog ge sgra tshad mkhan rnams la rtsod pa dang nus pa 'gran par byas pas gang yang ma rkyes te zhabs la gtugs/yang pho brang 'khor na chang tshong bye ba phrag du ma yod pa thams cad kyi khu ba dus gcig tu gsol ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/ sngon 'phrulasnang sprul pa'i lha khang bzheng ba'i dus rnam snang kun tu zhal zhing khams thams cad skus khyab pa dang / li chu khru ba khar gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo bskor tshe thugs rdo rje sems dpa' chos dbyings khyab pa dang / kum chu dang mi nyag dang hor gyi mtshams su 'phrin las kyis sa chen po g.yo nus pa tsam gyi tshe gsung snang mtha'i lha tshogs chos dbyings gang ba'i 'od can dang / tsong ga se bu na bzhugs tshe 'phrin las don 890

grub kyi lha tshogs 'od ljang gu spro ba dang / hor dang sog po'i mtshams cha gan ha'i rgyal sar mu stegs thams cad kyis gus 'dud byed pa'i tshe yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan 'od ser po can de rnams thams cad kyang chos kyi dbyings garnga zhing rang dang tha mi dad par gzigs pas sku lnga rang la rdzogs shing sku gsung thugs 'phrin las yon tan mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go 'phang thob par dgongs/ de dag gi rten 'brel las 'dzam gling bdag pos dngul bre chen stong grangs phul ba las yul de dag tu rigs lnga'i lha khang sum stong lhag pa'i zhig gso dang gsar bzhengs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ lu pan shan du mchod yon lhan cig tu bzhugs nas dbang bskur dang byin rlabs mdzad pa'i tshe chos dbyings rab 'byams yum chen mo shes phyin ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du 'khor 'das thams cad gcig tu rdzogs par shar bas da res rgyal po kho na'i don du byung yang sems can mtha' yas pa smin grol du byas par gzigs/ yang mchod yon thams cad rgya hor gyi mtshams su mya ngam gyi thang chen por skom pas gdungs pa la sngags bdag gi 'phrin las bskul te skad cig la kha ba cher bab pas tshad gdung bsal/ rgya nag gyi than du bzhugs dus rlung nag dang thog ser sogs cho 'phrul dpag med byung ba rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur mdzad de zhal bcu drug gis snang srid thams cad brngubs te btul/ rgyal po nyid gus ches pas ji srid 'tsho'i bar 'bral med du bzhugs par gsol ba ba tab kyang dus kyi 'pho 'gyur rnams mkhyen/ rgya mi nyag gi mtshams su rje dus mkhyen seng ge la bcibs pa nam mkhar byon te/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyas 'grib 'byung / /da lo bod du gshegs kyang 'tshal/ /gsung ba gsan pas zhal gyis ma bzhes te bod du 'byon par zhus/ rgyal rbes lung chen po gnang /thams cad khyed shes su chug /ban+dhe thams cad chos byed du chug khrims legs 891

par gyis gsungs na'ang 'jig rten gyi lung ma bzhes/ de'i phyir grub thob chen po'i phyag tham yang rin po che las rgyal ba rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bkod pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' btags kyi phyag rgya ma gtogs rgya hor gyi mtshan yig can gyi tham ga mi mdzad pa yin/ yar byon te ming thang hu chu mkhar sogs su byon/ mkhar nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gser shing dbang rnams 'dus nas de'i phu na naṭa tshal dang yul khyad par can yod par gdan dbab par zhus tshe steng 'og thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus khyab pas thams cad mi rtag cing sgyu ma dang 'dra bas yid brtan par mi bya ste sems can gyi bsod nams 'grib pa'i dus la bab bo zhes sgra grags pas zhal gyis ma bzhes te sngar dus la bab pa'i tshe 'dzam gling pa rnams kyi don byas phan bde la bkod pa yin/ da phyin zla ba mar gyi ngo bzhin sems can gyi bsod nams 'grib dogs yod pa'i phyir gnas dgon mang pos ci zhig bya zhes gsungs te byon/ 'grongs ltas kyi mnal lam las grol/ da dung khyod la gzugs can gzugs med thams cad bdud du langs nas 'jigs pa chen po 'ong ste des khyod kyi che ba bton nas rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur ro zhes pa gsan no/ /spyir bod phyi dus 'dir ma brtags par 'jug pa mang pos 'phags pa rin po che hor yul la 'byon dus grub thob kurma pak+ki ma ṇi ba yin zhes zer ba sogs gleng zhing 'bri bar 'dug kyang de 'dra ba ma yin te/ spyir rgya nag hor mi nyag gsum yul tha dad yin yang rgyal po re mos su byed pa cig byung ba'i shākya'i rgyal po gzhu brtan dang dus mtshungs pa'i ce'u'i rgyal po byung ste ce'u'i rgyal po sum cu so drug sogs rus tshan mi gcig pa bco lnga la rgyal po brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu tsam du rgya mi nyag hor gsum rgya nag gis bskyangs/ de nas mi nyag gi rgyal po si hu byung ste rgyal rabs bdun nam bcu gnyis tsam du mi nyag gis gsum ga'i bdag po byas te bod yul gyi bstan pa la zhabs tog cher byas/892

zla ba mig lag la lo drug cu bskor gnyis byin nas gsum pa'i so drug pa chu stag la hor jing gi rgyal po skyes nas so brgyad pa sa yos la rgya hor mi nyag gsum gyi bdag po byas drug cu rtsa gcig la 'das/ khong gis lo nga brgyad 'gro ba sa phag la bod thams cad kyis hor la ngo lta byas te 'bri khung pas mong gor gan dang a ri bo ga la bltas/ sa tshal gyis go be la la gtad pa sogs rgyal bu dang btsun mo sogs so so la ngo bltas te sil bur song / de'i phyi lo lcaṭa byi la byang ngos rgyal bu go dan gyi sa nas hor dor tog gi dmag 'ongs te 'phan yul rgyal bsregs/ 'bri khung rje spyan snga bla mchod du bos pa thabs kyis rje btsun sa paṇa spyan 'dren par bskul/ 'bri khung rang nas kyang bod spyi'i don du thegs dgos par zhus te shing 'brug la sa paṇa dgung lo re gsum pa 'phags pa rin po che dgung lo bcu pa phyag na dgung lo drug pa ste khu dbon gsum 'bri khung pas rdzong ba'i 'bul chen mdzad de byon nas byang ngos go dan gyi sar bzhuṭa nas bla mchod mdzad/ 'di'i dus grub thob pak+ki mtshur phu na bzhugs/ de — nas lo brgyad pa lcags phag la sa paṇa thegs/ de'i phyi lo go dan gyis do pe ta'i hor dmag gtang ste mon mkhar mgon po gdod sogs bcom/ de'i phyi lo glang lo la 'phags pa dang go be la mjal/ de nas lo gnyis kyi yos lo la grub thob pasdil go be la'i gdan 'dren mtshur phur slebs te yos lo de nyid la mjal/ phyi lo 'brug la grub thob chen po rgyal po mong gor gan gyi bla ma mdzad pa yin te tshal pa la sogs pa'i yig tshang khungs thub rnams stos shig go dan ni byang ngos kyi rgyal bu nyid las rgyal por ma bskos la/ go be la ni mong gor gan gyi 'og tu rgyal por phyung ba yin gyi de yan rgyal bu nyid yin pas rgyal bu dang rgyal po'i rnam par dbye ba yang shes dgos so/ /de lta mod kyi ma ṇi ba zhes pa'ang deng sang lta bu zhig sngon thams cad la yod pa ma yin te grub thob chen po 893

'di rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang gi 'phrin las grub nas mkha' 'gro sde lngas ma ṇi 'di ltar khrom thams cad la 'dren du chug cig mthong thos thams cad nged kyil byin gyis rlob bo zhes gsung ba gzigs pas chos 'brel gyi dmigs pa dang bstun nas bskul ba mdzad/ lha sa'i bka' chems gter nas thon rjes mnga' bdag myang yab sras kyis kyang khrom la bskul/ gu ru chos dbang gis kyang ma ṇi'i rigs du ma mdzad pa rnams nas dar zhing phyis ma ṇi ba zur du sko ba'i srol dar ba yin no/ /de ltar me 'brug la hor gyi rgyal po mong gor gan chos su btul te de nas lo lnga pa lcags spre la rgyal po chen po de sman tse'i yul du gshegs/ rgyal po'i sras dang blon po rnams kyis jing gi sras bdun pa a ri bo ga rgyal sar bton/ rgyal bu go dan sogs mi nyag na yod pa rnams kyis jing gi sras bzhi pa go be la se chen gan rgyal sar bton te rgyal po gnyis su chad/ sa tshal phyi slob ma rga ras bya ba gshin rje la nus pa thob pa zhig gis rgyal po a ri bo ga 'gugs chog gis bkug ste bkrongs/ rgyal khams thams cad 'khrugs/spyir sa skya'i dpon chen shākya bzang po/ tshal pa'i zi na shes rab skyabs/khams su rin po che ston tshul rnams go be la rgyal bur bzhugs dus kyis bskyangs pas sa chod shin tu che ba'i tshe 'bri khung pa'i khri dpon rdo rje dpal dbus kyi dpon byed pas rgyal po mong gor gan gyi drung du phyin te a ri bo ga la brten nas go be la dang gdong bsher byas/ bden rdzun sna tshogs pa zhus te go be la'i gdong la ngo mchil btab nas 'ongs te dmag byas pas sa ber log go be la yang des mong gor gan khu dbon la thugs ma rangs par yod pas/ grub thob chen po khong rang gi sar ma bzhugs par pho brang du bzhugs pa la cung ma mnyes/grub thob chen po chos kyis gdul bya 'dul ba las gzhan mi mdzad kyang ma dag nga 'i skye bos/ kurma pa la nye ring med/ /a ri bo ga rgyal gyur cig bya ba'i 894

kha dngags byung / sngon go be la zhes ming 'bod byas pa thugs la bzhag kyang zer/ rgyal bu mang po la dbang gnang tshe snod dang mi ldan pa rnams phyir dengs shig zhes phaṭa btab bas go be la 'phar te dbang khang gi phyi rol du slebs pa'i snying nad byas so yang zer/ gtso cher skye bo du ma'i phra ma la brten te grub thob chen po la 'byon dgos pa'i lung bsgrags te gshed ma la gtad pas gshed ma kha cig khrag bskyugs te shi/ mtshon cha rnams dum bur 'thor bas rgyal po khros te gshed ma rnams bsad/ me phung nang du bsregs pa'i tshe/ /me lha lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /chu bo'i nang du bskyur ba'i tshe/ /nya chen g.yor mo'i nyams shig shar/ /nya che che rnams kyis bskor ba byas/ /chung chung rnams kyis lha phyag btsal/ /dug chu phor gang blud ba'i tshe/ /rma bya lta bu'i nyams shig shar/brag chen g.yang la 'phangs pa'i tshe/ /bya rgyal lta bu'i nyams shig shar/ /bya che che rnams kyis bskor ba byas/ /chung chung rnams kyis lha phyag btsal/ /de thams cad kyis ma gnod pa na rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram rgya mtsho'i chu ni btung du mi rung chu shing gzhan med par lo ril po gnyis ngo gsum du sprugs pa na bdud rtsi'i char phab/ shing thog 'bras bu phun tshogs mang du skyes te lha'i yul lta bur gyur cing mtha' 'khob kyi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ 'jam dpal dang zhus lan nyer lnga pa mdzad/ de rnams grub rtags bar mar grags shing da dung brtag ba'i phyir spyan drangs te zas skom med par lha khang cig tu bcug sgo la btab/ srung ma rim pa du ma bzhag ste zhag bdun du bsrungs pa'i tshe phyi nas kyang khang pa shel ltar dwangs pa mi sgrib par rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bhe ga la'i rgyal po'i gsol zas blangs te 'dren pa dang gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gros bdud rtsis mchod pa dang / bram ze'i bu mo dpal ldan ma skye bdun gyi ro mkha' 'gros tshogs 'khor du mchod pa sogs mthong / gzi mdangs nyi ma ltar 'bar 805

bar gyur/ spyir chos skyong thams cad kyang khros phra ma byed pa'i mi dpag med skad cig skad cig gis shi/ grong khyer chen po du ma mes tshig bskal pa'i chu 'od lta bu byung ste yul du ma brlag lha mo'i rlung gi cho 'phrul ri rtse rnams nyil/ grong khyer du ma zhig nad yams kyang char ltar bab pas thams cad mgon skyabs dang bral sdug bsngal bar gyur te rnam thar gdug pa tshar gcod las/ drag cing rtsub pa'i gdul bya yis/ /tsha zhing rtsub pa'i mtshon phyung ste/ /gshin rje'i skye bos bshegs pa bzhin/ /ha ha 'jigs pa'i sgra sgrog tshe/ /skye med zhi ba ta la la/thub pa'i bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyar/ /sogs dang / u tsusma la sogs pa yi//yi ge'i tshogs dang bral gyur kyang / /snang srid dpe char shar ba yis/ /dgag par nus sam a re 'khrul/ /'on kyang chos la bdag po yod/ /'dze lhog phol dang smyo 'bog dang /rims dang ltas ngan sna tshogs kyi/ /bskal pa'i tshul la da tshur stos/ /log chos pa yi khrims lugs la'ang / /sma ra ag tshoms gnyan par bshad/ /de 'dra'i lugs ni ngan pa la/ /sbyar tshe gshed ma cir 'gyur ba'i/ /tshul la rab tu lta bar gyis/ /sogs dang / bstan srung mgon po'i bka' 'khor rnams/ /sha khrag dmar la rol ba mthong / /dpal ldan lha mo'i spyan snga na/ /dmar gyi rak+ta 'khyil ba mthong / /sogs dang / le bar nyis brgya 'phags pa na/ /sa 'dzin de yi pho nya ba/ /e margan zhes bya ba yod//sdig par gyur pa'i sems can ni/ /las tshar ngan la zhen pa can/ /tshig rtsub gad mo cher sgrog la/ /yul khamaca/ gang ba'i thog ser phab/ /srid pa 'khrugs pa'i shā rbud kyis/ /rigs can mi dang 'dab chags bya/ khyi glang rnga mong nor lug sogs/ /ma lus rgya mtsho'i gling du bskyal/ /kye ma kye ma ma rdag pa/ /sdig can de dag snying re rje/ /dpal ldan lha mo'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /sdang ba'i dgra la skyoXbh+yoXzer/ /gza' bdud rmya btsan 896

thams cad kyis/ /'phrin las thams cad sgrub bo zer/ /rang byung rdo rje la gtogs pa'i/ /bu slob yon bdag 'khor bcas kun/ /thams cad sems kyi dpa' rtsal skyes/ /sogs dang / me chu 'byung ba'i 'jigs dang bral/ /sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /cho 'phrul 'di la da tshur stos/ /sogs dang /dus kyi tha mar gyur pa dang / /phrag dog can gyis tshig rtsub smras/ /sa 'dzin rgyal po rab tu khros/ /gshed ma pa la rang dbang med/ khros 'khrugs rngams pas rab tu g.yos/ /rnal 'byor sems la g.yo ba med/ khams gsum gang ba'i 'ja' tshon 'khrigs/ khrims gcod rang sems khong du chud/ /sa 'dzin rgyal po rab tu khros/ /gshed ma rang srog rang la phab/ /sogs dang / de nas lha mo rab khros te/ /rlung lha nag mo zhal gsum ma/ /'jigs su rung ba'i pho nya bskul/ khams gsum gang ba'i rlung thog phab/ /sa rdo ri brag mkha' la khyer//smyo 'bog nad kyi bu yug 'khrigs/ /gur dang shing rta thams cad kyang / /bya spu gtor ba bzhin du thal/ /mi rnams kye ma kye hud 'bod/ /lha rnams dkar po'i rgyal mtshan 'phyar/ /dpal ldan lha mos 'gyings shing 'gyings/ /sa rnams 'dar zhing ri rnaca/sa g.yos/ /la la rin chen srog dang bral/ /nad kyis btab pa bsam mi khyab/ /la la baspu g.yo zhing 'dar/ /kun kyang dad pa rab tu skyes/ /sngon chad cho 'phrul 'di lta bu/ /kun gyis mthong dang thos pa med//sogs dang / rgya mtsho'i gling gi tshad 'gram du/ /lo gsum bar du 'gro don byas/ /rnam thos srab/ kyi 'byor dang ldan/ /sngags kyi bdag po pho nyar bkye/ /char rgyun bsil ba'i ngad dang ldan/ /thams cad bde skyid ldan par byas/ /ces dang / da dung ma dad dad bya'i phyir/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang du/ /zhag bdun bar du grub rtags bstan/ /sgo ni lcags gzer khro chus bsdams/ /srung byed skye bo sum rim gyis/ /res byas nas ni mel tshe byed/ /de tshe bde 897

chen nyams dang ldan/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas/ /rje btsun lha mo zhal gcig ma/ /dngos su byon nas ma bsgribs zhal/ /gsal ba nyid du kun gyis mthong / /ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam bzhi yis/ /ha ha la yi dur khrod nas/ / bram ze'i bu mo dpal/ ldan ma/ /'pho bas lus srog bral ba'i ro/ /gtsang zhing dri ma med pa zhig /mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byas/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /ma la ya yi nags khrod nas/ /dri zhim ro mchog ldan pa yi/ /shing thog sna tshogs blangs te phul/ /dkar phyogs nam mkha'i lha phran rnams/ /dri zhim ro mchog char du 'phebs/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mas/ /bhaX ga la yi pho brang nas/ /rgyun ldan rgyal po'i kha zas rnams/ /sna tshogs 'ongs nas drag tu drangs/ /ces so/ de'i tshe rgyal po go be la yang dad cing 'jigs par gyur te ji skad du/de nas dgung bdun 'das pa dang / /sa bdag rgyal po dga' gyur te/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma cod pan la/ /blangs nas dgyes pa'i tshig brjod pa/ /phrag dog ldan pa'i gang zag kun/ /e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am/ /sgrub rgyud 'dzin pa'i sgom chen kun/ /bka' rgyud rgyal sa ma zin nam/ /dge slong dge 'dun bcas pa kun/ /shāka thub bstan pa ma rgyas sam/ /mthu dpung ldan pa'izhusngags pa kun//bstan srung che ba ma bton nam/ /zhe sdang ldan pa'i dpa' bo kun/ /zhi zhing dul bar ma byas sam/ /byang sems ldan pa'i rgyal sras kun/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan ma tshugs sam/ /zhes ched du brjod de zhabs la sbyi bos gtugs/ /nongs pa bzod par gsol te bzhugs par zhus pa la ma gnang bas gar bde bar bzhuṭa la nged la smon lam bzang po thob cig zhus te mchod sprin cher byas/ dus min 'chi zlog ma chung ba'i gsol 'de bas mdzad nas rgyal khams de thams cad nad dang me chu'i 'jigs las bskyabs pa ste grub rtags phyi ma'o/ /spyir rgyal pos mi 898

'tshams pa'i chad pa brgyad byas shing ma rungs pa'i gdug rtsub ci yang byed pa'i tshe bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang 'dus/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'od zer bkye ste gdug pa can 'di lta bu shin tu gdul bar dka' bas nus pa'i dpung skyed cig ces mnga' gsol/ de'i tshe rang don du dus min 'chi zlog ma che ba'i gsol 'debs mdzad/ 'bri khung gi gcung rin po che/ stag lung gi sangs rgyas yar byon sogs de dus bzhugs pa'i bka' rgyud kyi grub thob yang phal cher nam mkha' la grogs su byon/ khyad par rgya mtsho'i 'gram na bzhugs tshe zhing skyong gi ḍā ki ma gsum 'ja' tshon gyi dbus su byon te spyan ras gzigs karma pa khyod kyis mtshur phur byon la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku pho 'dom bcu gesum pa cig bzhongs dang gdul bya mthar phyin zhing dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rdzogs par 'gyur ro gsungs kyang cir yang mi snyam par zhag bdun du bzhugs pa na nam mkha' la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku tshad de tsam pa gtso 'khor gsum 'khor sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med kyis bskor ba byon te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang karma pa/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi sras gcig pu/ /sngon du ḍā kis bskul ba ltar/ /sku gzugs bzheng la brtson 'grus gyis/ bar chad thams cad nged kyis srung / /zhes gsan pas 'grub par dgongs/ yang lha gzo ba 'phan yul na pak+ki bya ba yod/ zangs rag ram pa zangs khung nas thon zer ba'i sgra byung ste nye gnas ldan sgom la gser drel rgyab bdun sogs mtha' yas par bskur te 'dam cog tse la nas gaṇ+ḍi ra mthong ba gyis gsungs te brdzangs/ mdzad spyod rol ba'i rnam thar las/ hor 'di dga' rab dbang phyug dang gnam the'u'i sprul par 'dug pas bstan pa thams cad 'jig par 'dug pa 'di sus kyang ma tshor bar 'dug pas ngas 'phrin las bzhis btul te bstan pa gzhig mi nus par byas 899

pa yin gsungs te grub thob chen po'i rdzu 'phrul des ma btul na bla mchod bcol yang dam tshig la mi 'dzems par 'dug pas bstan pa mtha' dag 'jig rgyur snang ba bstan pa spyi la 'di lta bu'i bka' drin can gzhan su yod/ de ltar rgyal po gdug pa can btul te pho brang cong to mkhar nas gdan bteg lo brgyad kyis mtshur phur phebs/ rgya yul hun ci mkhar du phebs dus nad yams sna tshogs pas yul de nyog nyog por gyur ba la mgon skyabs su gsol ba btab pas sman gyi bla'i thugs rje bskul/ rdzing dang khron pa dang chu mig rnams la phyag nas dang zhal chab 'thor te sman gyi chur byin gyis brlabs pas chu 'thungs tshad kyi nad zhi/ thams cad dad de bkur bsti mtha' yal shing shing kun mkhar dang nye ba rgya nag gi mgor rgya'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis cho 'phrul bstan/ rlung nag gis sa rdo khyer ba byung / chibs rta rgod cig yod pas 'phags nas sku sa la lhu nga /de ma thag rta mgrin dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad par bzhengs te rta skad gshugs glur blangs pas zil gyis mnan te srog snying phul/ mi rnams kyis sku mdog shin tu dmar bar mthong / rgya hor mi nyag yu gur sogs kyi skye bo thams cad 'dus pa chos la bkod/ gar byon gyi nad yams chad 'khrug rtsod zhi/ dgon sde mchod khang 'khogs pa rnams gsor bcug ban+dhe mi gtsang ba thams cad tshul khrims la sbyar/ sngags pa rnams skyed rdzogs la brked/ bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad/ sngon mdo khams na bzhugs dus gam bo rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis gnas nang 'dir sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku che ba zhig bzheng bar zhus /ma po gnas nang 'di phal chen nas gsungs pa byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje can gyi gnas yin zhing sham po rdo rje dpal brtsegs 'di sa thob pa'i byang sems skal pa'i tshe can sangs rgyas stong gi sbyin bdag yin gsungs/ kurmar thugs rje chen pos 'dir rgyal ba byams pa'i sku che ba bzhengs shig zhes lung 900

bstan pa ltar gdan sa bar ma dang 'og mar 'das ma 'ongs kyi de bzhin gsheṭa pa'i sku ngo mtshar can bzhengs/ nye gnas ldan sgom gyis mtshur phur mchod khang chen po'i dri gtsang khang khyams dang bcas pa brtsigs pas snang srid kyi lha 'dres grogs byas te myur bar tshar/ lha gzo dang zangs rag kyang ji ltar gsung ba ltar byung / rus shing logs nas lo gsum na lha chen po 'dom bcu gsum pa zangs rag las lugs su blug pa grub/ rgya gar gyi yul gru zhig tu hor dmag drangs nas gtsug lag khang chen po zhig gi gaṇ+ḍi ra dang gser gyi bya mdabs dmag gis hor yul du khyer ba mi 'tshams pa'i cho 'phrul gyis sus kyang bdag gir byed ma nus pa grub thob chen pos ltas ngan g.yang du blangs te rgya bod kyi mtshams ga chu'i 'gram du rdzu 'phrul gyis drangs kyang rten 'brel zhig ma 'grig pas bya mdabs g.yon las ma 'drongs par de nyid du mdzod nag chen mo da lta sus kyang reg mi nus pa zhig na yod/ phyis bya mdabs g.yon gyi chung ba de nyid dum bu gnyis su byas te rgyab mdun gyi thog tu bkal/ bya mdabs chung ba gnyis stong par bzhag rtser gaṇ+ḍi ra chen mo gser bya khung gi gter nas byung ba'i gser bya zung dang bcas pa btsugs/ de'i tshe grub thob chen po 'dam cog tse lar phebs/ dbus gtsang na yod pa'i hor bod kyi mi dpo—na/ bla ma dpon chen/ zon 'u'i sri'i mi dpon khri dpon rnams thams cad kyis so so nas ja 'dren bsu ba bsnyen bkur byas/ tshogs chos chen mo gsungs/ zhwa nag gi bstod pa yang mdzad pas thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes te mtshan grub thob chen po 'ba' zhig tu sgrog nye gnas so/gas kyi nga rgyal bcag phyir cog tse la dang gnam la dang sbrid la rnams nas rim par ma tshar ba e yin gaṇ+ḍi ra ma mthong gsung zhing bkyon/ mtshur phur phebs tshe mchod khang yang rgang / lha chung 'di 'dra ba gsungs nas bkyon/ nye gnas dang lha bzos/ nyid lta bur ma 901

song 'di las che ba blo khog tu gtan ma shong ba yin/ lar sa 'di yangs pa zhig yin na gaṇ+ḍi ra cog tse la las thag ring ba nas mthong zhus pas/ da lta cher gtong thabs yod dam gsung ba la de ma mchis lhag rnams la ldem gnyis dang rigs lnga bzheng zhus pas shin tu mnyes te lha legs par grub 'dug khyed la nyam sad byas pa yin gsungs nas slar byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs rgyal ba rigs lnga rnams kyi lha chen re bzhengs/ gtso bo la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bre gang / rje sgam po pa'i thugs ljags spyan gsum/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i tshems/ rje mi la'i gsol zhal phyag mkhar/ skyer sgang ba'i snam sbyar nyan thos mchog zung gi lhung bzed mkhar gsil snam sbyar/ gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur po ti brgya lnga bcu/ tshogs dung dkar po rgyang grags sogs mtha' yas par bzhugs/ gzung bzhugs grub nas lha chen g.yon du shin tu yo bas lha gzo bas thabs med cing sdug bsngal ba'i tshe grub thob chen pos khyod de 'dra mi dgos nga rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas bcos kyi khyod rang tshod gyis shig gsungs te lha chen gyi mdun du skyil krung gis bzhugs te rlung ro lan gsum bus nas bum can bzung ste sku g.yon du yon por mdzad nas g.yas su rim gyi sa bsrang bas lha chen po tsheg tsheg zer nas 'drongs/ drang por gyur pa na bla ma rin po che da ran da ran zhus pas shin tu legs par byung /rtsa rlung bsgoms pa la yon tan de 'dra yong ba yin gsungs/ rab gnas la rgyal ba byams pa 'byon pa yod pas chos khri chen po rtsigs gsungs te byams pa chos khri brtsigs/ gdugs rgyal mtshan gser 'phan dar mo che bkra shis khra ring sogs chos khri nas mchod khang chen mo'i bar du khyab/ de'i tshe dbang po rab kyis rgyal ba byams pa gtsug tor dbu ri dang mnyaca/ pa dang / la las khri de skus khyab pa'i na bza'i lhubs khri las 'phyang ba mthong / kha cig gis grub 902
