thob chen po nyid sku lha chen las che bar der bzhugs garma pa grangs med pas bskor nas phyag nas 'thor ba mthong / thams cad kyi mthun snang du grub thob chen po nyid sku sngar bas che ba zhig bzhugs nas phyag nas mdzad pa dang lha chen gyi drung na mchod pa mdzad pa dang bla yil chen mor chos gsung ba ste sku'i bkod pa gsum dus mnyam dang gzhan yang du ma mthong / zla gcig tu me tog gi char dang spos kyi dri sngon ma tshor ba rgyun ma chad/ lha chen dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du mtshan gsol/ rje dus mkhyen gyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs par gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar dang / phyis rje nyid kyi thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs pa'i bkra shis lhun grub dang ldem gnyis rigs lnga dang bcas pa dang / phyis thugs rje chen po'i lha khang dang yig bcu'i khang pa mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang da lta der bzhugs te bod yul na zla dang bral ba'i gtsug lag khang yin la sa der rdog pa bzhag pa'i skye bo la yang ngan song med par rje na rim thams cad kyis gsungs so/ /lo rgyus rgyas pa las ni/ lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan sangs rgyatho rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs khro bo rnams kyi mthu stobs dang chos skyong rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis sgyu ma lta bur rnam par 'phrul zhing bzhengs nas snang ba khri thog tu thon pa'i tshe bdud dang mu stegs log par lta ba can la dga' ba'i lha 'dre mthu stobs can rnams kyi bar chad rtsom zhing thams cad 'khrug par byed pa'i snga ltas su zhag gnyis la sa 'gul thengs drug tu byung / ka ba 'then pa'i thag pa chad nas ban+dha lha gzo ba rnams de'u bsad byas/ lha gzo gra pa phyi nang kun gyi snying du bdud zhugs nas 'thab rtsod kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor bar brtsams/ dge 'dun tshal pa la gtogs pa'i so nam pa 'ga' zhig gi snying du bdud zhugs nas rje dus mkhyen gyi ༄dbon po byang chub 'das lam la bkod/yul khams— kun tu nad 'khrug gnod pa sna tshogs 'byung bar 'dug pa la sngags 903

'chang rang byung rdo rjes de rnams bdud kyi cho 'phrul du go zhing rtogs nas rta mgrin rdo rje srin po dang gsang ba mchog gi sku bdag yak+ṣa rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs su dkyil 'khor du gsal zhing brtan pa 'dzam gling khyab pa tsam du zhag bdun gyi bar du thams cad zhal du bstabs shing zil gyis gnon pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer cho 'phrul chen po bkye nas zil gyis mnan pa'i dus su sa rdo rtsi shing nags tshal khyad par du mtshur nang phu mda'i ri klung thams cad rdo rje srin po'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs/ sgos su dgon gsar gyi phar thad kyi brag la rta mgrin rdo rje srin po'i 'od zer brtan par byas pas rta mgrin rdo rje srin po yum gsang ye dpon g.yog gsum me ri dang bcas pa rgyang nas bltas kyang gsal bar bstan zhing byin gyis brlabs/ khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du chos thams cad kyi ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid rnam par spros pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal pos rgya che ba 'dzam gling yang zhi rgyas su rab tu gnas par byin gyis rlob pa dang / khyad par du lha chen po rab tu gnas shing 'gyur ba med pa brgya tso brgyad kyi 'od zer 'phro 'dus mtshur phu'i ri brag thams cad kyang rgyal ba sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs shing rab tu gnas pa'i 'od zer ting 'dzin phyogs med du spros pa ste ri brag thams cad la yang 'gyur ba med pa 'gyur med rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis rab tu gnas par byas shing khyad par du so ring zam kha'i rdo ba zhig la ting 'dzin gtad pas 'gro ba mos shing yid chags pa nyes pa'i skyon rnams 'dag par nus pa ste rten gyi bya ba dang dgos pa de yin pa ste kun bzang yangs pa'i rgyud las/ de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bskal pa bdun nam nyi shu gcig /rab gnas 'jig par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing sku gsum lhun grub kyi rab gnas dang ldan pa'i rten la sems can rnams yid 'jug cing chos thams 904

cad kyi de bzhin nyid kyis rab tu gnas pa'i rten rnams kyi drung du sus phyin kyang sems gnas shing 'bral mi phod pa dang bde gsal mi rtog pa'i sems gnas pa'i phyir na/ sems can rnams kyi yid la 'jug /sems can rnamyas kyi yid 'phrog pa/ /zhes gsuje sa so/ /sngar gyi bar chad de rnams las ma rgyal na rgya chung ba dbus gtsang che ba 'dzam gling tsam du cho 'phrul dang 'khrug rtsod chen po 'byung bar 'dug kyang gsang mchog kun gyi bdag po'i rgyal po chen po dpal rdo rje srin po'i mthu stobs dang ting 'dzin gyi rtsal chen po rdzogs pas phyi nang gi 'thab rtsod dang bdud kyi dmag tshogs rnams zhal du bstabs shing zhi bar mdzad pa'i phyir na zhi ba lhun gyis grub ba'i 'phrin las yul khams 'di thams cad du byung zhing 'byung la 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir na lha chen po'i 'phrin las dus gsum rgyun chad med par je che je bzang la 'byung ba ste skad ris mi gcig pa'i mi rnams kyis kyang thag ring po nas mos gus byed cing bdag du 'dzin pa dang mchod pa byed pa mang du 'byung la snang ba dag pa rnams kyis sku g.yo 'gul dang 'od zer dang gsung 'byon pa thos pa dang 'bring dang tha mas kyang dad pa skye zhing na tsha sdug bsngal zhi sems gnas nas phyir 'gro mi 'dod pa sogs nyams ltas mang po 'byung ste lha chen po 'dzam gling rgyan mthong thos phyag mchod bgyid pa rnams 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan dang dngos grub mtha' yas pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ye shes mgon po lcam dral rnams kyang rang bzhuṭa la lha 4srin sde brgyad khyad par du rdo rje legs pa tsha zhang myur mgyogs can dang bod khams kyi brtan ma 'dzam gling skyong ma gnyan chen thang lha mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa klu dang sa bdag rnams kyang dam tshig chen ngo/'i dbang gis dkor srung dang yon bdag dang lha chen po'i chos skyong dang bka' srung du rang dam rang4 gis bcas te rgyun chad med par 'phrin las sgrub pa'i phyir na lha rten lha 90 5

dkor rnams la thag thug ma byas shing mchod na 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub cing bstan pa yun du gnas pa'i phyir shin tu gnyan zhing rab tu gnyan par shes par bya'o zhepo/ gsungs so/ / yang 'bum thang thams cad rgyal ba rgya mtsho lha lngas gang bar gzigs te thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs shing yig bcu dang phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la tsha ba'i rgyun btsugs te thugs rje chen po dang sems can sdug bsngal can rnams tha dad med pa ni nga'i yi dam yin gsungs/ de ltar rgya hor bod mi nyag yu gur sogs yul gru skad ris mi gcig pa brgya phrag mang por lha khang mchod rten rnying gso gsar 'dzugs stong phrag bdun brgyad las mi nyung ba mdzad de chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi 'phrin las las mi dman pa yin te 'dzam gling kun tu rgyu ba'i kurma pa la mnar sems gnod sems byed pa sna tshogs byung yang lha mo 'od zer can gyi gzungs kyi yon tan bzhin legs pa phun sum tshogs pa lnga lhun gyis grub cing rab 'byams bka' la lung chen thob pas bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas dang ye shes rgya mtsho mtha' yas man chad tshig bzhi'i tshigs su bcad pa yan chad la bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gnyis tsam 'dzam gling khyab par bstan cing de rnams su sprul pa'i rnam thar mang po 'thor nas yod pa ste rnal 'byor rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar gleng gzhi rgyas bsdus thams cad khyab par tshad gzhal du med pa'o zhes so/ /'phags pa rin po che bod la phyi ma phebs pa'i tshe me glang gi lo la rje dgung lo don gnyis pa dang bla ma chos kyi rgyal po zhe gsum bzhes pa mtshur phur mjal/ phyag dang bzhugs stan mnyam po mdzad/ sngar ngas khyed la pho brang du byang chub sems dpa' mthong na dga' bar mtshan btags pa ma yin nam gsungs/ 'di kha cig na gnam du mjal bya ba yang 'dug gzhan yang 'khor lo sdom pa kun snang sgyu 'phrul gyi zhing khams phyogs mtshams thams cang/ yi ga 906

bdun gyi sgra dang char du 'bab cing gsang ba'i mdzod kyi sgo phyogs med du phye zhig zhes grags/ /phyis mtshur phu'i bla brang du rdo rje 'chang grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad phyogs mtshams kun khyab pa gcig go gcig gis mi sgrib par skyil krung sa gnon mdzad de ma hā mu dra zhes phyogs med du sgrog pa zhag 'ga'ar gzigs pas da phyin chad gar yang ma 'gro zhes par dgongs nas de phyin rtse gcig du bzhugs/ skal ldan gyi slob ma mtha' yas pa 'dus pa thams cad gzhi tshul khrims dang byang chub kyi sems kyis bzung / thos bsam sgom pas sgro 'dogs phyogs med du bcad/ smin grol dbang gi rgyal mtshan 'phyar te gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor lo nyin mtshan med par bskor bas bka' rgyud kyi rgyal ༄sa zin pa'i grub thob mtha' yas pa byung / yang rdo rje 'chang dang bla med kyi lha tshogs kyi 'od zer sngon pos ma khyab pa med pa dang / bud med rus rgyan can mang pos ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phyogs med du 'thor ba dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs 'od dang gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du khyab pas da dung phyi mtha'i bar du rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bgrang las 'das pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes sgrog pa gsan/ yang cung zad mnal ba na bdag nyid dang phyi nang thams cad bde mchog gi ngo bor gsal zhing te lo na ro sogs kyang de'i rnam 'phrul du snang ba sad nas kyang zhag mang por gzigs/ yang mnal lam du nam mkha'i dbyings shig tu byon pas rnal 'byor pa chang ka pā la gang 'thung ba zhig snang / in+d+ra bhu ti yin snyam pa na/ nga ni sku gsum sa ra ha/ /rnal 'byod bdun la sogs pa yi/ /grub thob thams cad nga las byung / /nga las byung zhing nga ru thim/ /zhes chang nam mkha' la gtor bas rnal 'byor pa dpag med du gyur te ā li kā li'i rang sgra sgrog pa gsan pas bde mchog rgyud bla ma la sogs pa'i don tham sa cad rtogs/ rang gis kyang chang thod phor gang sprul nas gtor 907

bas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med par gyur te de thams cad nam mal/ 'a la 'phur te song bas rang nyid kyang sgyu mas sgyu ma sprul rmi lam gyis rmi lam sprul zhing phyin pas sngar gyi rnal 'byor pa de steng phyogs shig na bsdad nas/ sems kyi mtha' la thug pa med/ /nam mkha' la ni mtha' dbus bzhin/ /ma rig 'khrul pa'i skyes bu rnams/ /'khrul pas nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol ba/ /rmongs pa nam mkha' mtho la 'jal/ /zhes zer/ de thams cad rang nyid la thim pa snyam byed/ de la sogs pa'i dag pa'i gzigs snang rab 'byams ni deng sang yi ger snang ba kho na yang gzhal du med na de las gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ yang mnal lam na yul chen po mtha' yas pa mtho dman mang du snang ba la zam pa phra mo mang du yod pa brul na gnam sa tsam du 'gro dgos pa 'dug pa'i tshe ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi rtsal gyis skad cig ma bskal par byin gyis brlabs te mtho zhing mtho ba'i rtse mor phyin pa na dwags lha sgam po yin zer ba'i rin po che'i ri dbu rgyan prog zhu dang rtse bran gyi dbyibs thams cad kyang shel gyi rang bzhin dpag tu med pa thams cad kyang thang shing gi 'bras bu ltar mchod rten gcig rgyab gcig gi phreng ba can dbus ma mtho khyad dang ldan pa'i rtser bzhugs pa na rje sgam po pa chos gos gsol be 'od kyi rab bzhin can bzhengs te phyag mdzub phyogs thams cad du gtad nas ltos shig gsungs te thams cad sgrib pa med par sku dang mchod rten gyi rang bzhin du gsal ba mnal ma mnal med par zhag bdun du byung ste bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar mkhyen/ yang rje dus mkhyen sku bltams pa'i gnas kre kum khyim mi ngan gyis bshig pa rnams bsgral nas mgon po ber nag can ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su khyab pa snying gi phreng ba se ral khar khur ba la grangs ba rgya dang lnga bcu tsam yod pa phyogs bcu mgon pos bskor ba thams cad du gsal te/ bstan pa dar zhing bstan pa rgyas/ /phyogs bcur 908

bstan pas khyab par byas/ /zer te kre bo nyag chu rab sgang shar dmar tsha'i sgang la so— skas par yang ma 'ongs pa bstan pas khyab par lung bstan/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyis kyang rten 'di rnams dang khyed kyi bya ba thams cad nged kyis sgrub/ da dung du yang khyed ma 'ongs pa 'khrul pa med par bsams bzhin dī srid pa nye bar len zhing khams gsum khyab par gdul bya sems can rnams kyi don byed par 'gyur ba'i dus su yang nged rnams kyis bstan pa srung zhing bya ba sgrub bo zhes khas len pa gzigs/ rta lo rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha khang grub pa nas bzung ste mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa'i gsung mang du byon/ de'i tshe grub thob chen po o rgyan pa dgung lo nga gsum pa zhig dbus gtsang gi 'gro don chen mo la byon/ gtsang phyogs su than mo che byung ba gar phebs su char pa bab pas zhi bar ma dzad/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gis bgegs thams cad 'dul zhing byon/ rong chen dang sil ma la nas 'byon par dgongs/ stag gru khar phebs tshe da res rin po che /rma pa mjal dgos par 'dug gsungs nas gtsang po byang la byon/ grub thob chen pos kyang kye mtshur phu ba kha 'khyags rnams longs/ grub thob o rgyan pa gnam sa gnyis kyi ka ba lta bu de 'byon zhing 'dug gsungs nas grabs yul cher byas/ o rgyan pa'i gsung nas garma pa'i gra pa rnams brel bdo 'dug cag mal gyis gsungs nas lam zhig tu cag mal mdzad/ yang byon te dbu ri brgal bar bzhugs nas mngon mkhyen e 'dug lta'o gsungs nas mtshan 'gros kyis btegagrub thob chen pos mkhyen nas tho rengs bsu ba rnams btang ba byams pa chos khrir mjal bas o rgyan pa'i thugs rgyal dang po chag phyir gzims sbra chen mo la bzhugs nas rin po che'i gzims khang na rten mchod dang bkod pa 'di ltar 'dug gsungs pas mtshur phu ba rnams mos/ nang du phebs te gus pas grub thob chen pa'i zhabs la phyag mdzad/ stan bzang po bshams pa la bzhugs/909

grub thob chen pos khyed dpon slob rnams ngas yos dkrugs pa 'dra ba zhig bya'am gsungs pas mdzad par zhu gsungs/ de ma thag rlung dang lta stangs mdzad pas grub chen pa dpon slob thams cad nyams 'ur te bkrabs pas da sdod gsungs te thugs rgyal gnyis pa chag da lta bod na khyed pas grub thob che ba med ang gsungs/ de tsam gyi rlom pa mi bdog zhus pas 'o na khyed kyis a su ra'i brag phug tu blangs pa'i mgur de long dang gsungs/ der thugs rgyal rtsa ba nab/ chag e o rgyan pa khyed sil ma la nas 'gro tshis 'dug ste nga'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang dbang med par bkug pa yin e shes gsungs/ ka to ra nas kyis bkang ba rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sba cag gis dkrugs nas spyi bor bzhag ste dbang bskur/ zhag gsum du gdams ngag mtha' yas pa gnang / khyed kyi brgyud pa la zhwa nag can du mchi zhus pas/ spyir gang byas nyan/ gya ba gangs pas gu ba byas/ de'i skye mched la brten nas zhwa nag po gyon pa'i brgyud pa chad/'on kyang da dung nyi ma nub phyogs nas zhwa nag po gyon pa zhig yong pa yin gsungs/ 'di ni rje rang byung ba lung bstan pa dang spyir gya ba gangs pa'i mdzad pa la rje dus mkhyen ma mnyes pas bar der sprul sku cung zad 'gyangs pa la dgongs pa yin no/ /de nas gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad/ sre 'pho'i zhal gdams dang sku gsum ngo sprod sogs kyi phyag dpe khyad par ba dang dbu zhwa zhwa nag cig gtad de 'di rnams khyed kyis mgo 'don byed dgos pa zhig yong bas de la gtod/ khyed 'di nas lho phyogs su song dang 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub /nga dang myur du 'phrang do gsungs/ sku tshe 'di la zhag gsum kho na las ma mjal yang pha dang bu lta bur gyur/ grub thob o rgyan pa yang de phyin rje rgod tshang ba dang tha mi dad pa'i rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ spyir thugs rgyud tha mi dad pa'i sku'i bkod pa'ang yin par snang la brgyud pa gtad cing phyis lam bar kun tu'ang 910

gdams ngag gi shog dril yang yang du gnang skad/ grub chen pa thegs 'phral zhig tu mang yul gyi gangs zhur mo'i mdun phyogs kyi mi mang po jo bo bskor ba la 'ongs te lam gzhu'i phu nas grub thob chen po mjal du 'ongs pa rnams la chos dang byin rlabs gnang / de'i nang nas do ha dang rnying ma dang zhi byed rgyud phyi la mkhas pa'i ston pa chos dpal bya ba soms chang zhig yod pa la khyod cang //// ri gi ni ri zad sdod gsungs/ zas gos dang gnang sbyin bzang po mdzad nas nged khyod la gnas tshang zhig g.yar dgos par 'dug pas de thong zhig gsungs/ khong gis kyang ma go bar gzhan la smras pas khyod rang gar sdod med pa la gnas tshang gar 'ong zer nas bzhad gad du song skad/ spyir rta lo sogs la nad bgegs kyi rkyen mang du byung ba thams cad lhan skyes ye shes su ro stoms pas zhag bzhi bcur zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor lhun grub tu byung ba'ang gshegs pa'i ltas su mkhyen/ bu slob rnams kyis kyang sku rim chen po byas/ khang sgo'i them len gyis sku char gnang ba yang rlung bum can khug pa gcig gis skyon bsal te /rma pa min na skye shi lan drug tsam gyi snang ba de nyid du 'char ba 'dug gsungs/ rtogs ldan rang byung rdo rje 'chi ba'i bye brag su zhig gis shes/ dper na mar me 'da' khar gsal ba bzhin grub thob chen po o rgyan pa byon pa dang 'dra ste mkhas par 'dod pas the tshom dris/ grub par 'dod pas bdar sha chod gsung zhing lug lo zla ba dang po la thang dpal mo dpal thang gi stod du rje btsun mi la thod par bdud rtsi gsol zhing 'od zer 'gyed pa dang ma 'ongs pa 'di nas 'phrin las 'byung ngo zhes lung ston pa gzigs te bstan bcos mdzad/ de phyin snga gzhis pa rnams gangs zhur mo'i mdun du song ngo zhes yang yang gsungs/lug lo zla ba gsum pa nas brtsams te sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba yang yang du byung zhing me tog gi char rtag par bab/ rtags 'di dag dge 'am mi dge zhus 911

pas byang chub sems dpa' 'khrung ba dang 'da' ba la rtags 'di lta bu 'byung ba yin shes sam gsungs/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs su gsung chen po phyung ste khyed rang rnams zhu rgyu yod tshad zhus/ ma bde ba yod tshad dris/ rje dus mkhyen gyi gdan sa rnams kyi zhig ral gsos na bstan pa'i dar rgyas yun ring du 'byung bar bka' rgyud gong ma'i lung bstan yod pas ngas kyang gdan sa 'di rnams la bya ba byas/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par byas pa yin/'dzam gling gi bya ba skor gcig tshar nyi ma do nub nub kyang sang 'char ba bzhin re zhig 'di nas mi snang bar gyur kyang 'phrin las kyi dbang gis gdul bya dang mthun par sprul pa'i sku shes bya kun la mkhas pa cig gnam nas bya babs pa bzhin myur du 'ong ngo zhes gsungs/ yang dbon rin po che la sprul pa'i sku 'dir ma byon gyi bar du khyod kyis skyongs shig gsungs te chu mo lug lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum gyi snga dro la zhag bdun du gdung la ma reg cig gsungs te chos dbyings su bzhugs/ de'i tshe slob ma dag pas dga' ldan dang mngon dga' dang bde ba can du byon par mthong / thun mong du 'ja' dang rol mo dang me tog gi char dang nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyis ring bar snang / tshes dgu la gdung bzhu ba na ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa cher snang zhing thugs ljags ring bsrel sogs byon pa rten so sor bzhugs shing bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur to/ /grub thob chen po nyid kyi zhal nas da res mi'i 'gro don las mi ma yin pa'i 'gro don che ba yin te rgya gar ka ma rū pa'i gzhi bdag gi slob ma kho na yang grangs kyis mi chod ces gsungs pas de lta bu ni blos gzhal bar mi nus/ dngos su snod ldan gyi slob ma'i gtso bo rgyal po mong gor gan nyid dang spangs rtogs mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa dang / se chen gyis chad pa'i las mer bsregs pa'i tshe dpon slob gsum lhan du bsregs kyang mes ma gnod pa'i ye shes dbang phyug dang rin 9/ 2

chen dpal/ tshad ma paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gyis khengs te grub thob chen po la rjes dpag tshad ma gang la zer mngon sum tshad ma gang yin zer ba na phyag sdigs mdzub btad pas de sna khrag thim bu btang ba ltar bab ba la 'di rjes dpag tshad ma yin/ da mngon sum tshad ma dgos sam gsungs pas skrag nas zhabs la gtugs pa tshad ma paṇa chen dang / g.yag ru ras pa/ rtogs ldan zhwa ser ba/ zhwa dmar ba/ zhwa khra ba/ stag mgo ba/ gzig mgo ba/ dom mgo ba/spyan snga stag shod pa/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng ge dpon rin po che/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ gnam mtsho ba chen po/ grub thob gnyan ras la sogs pa rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mtha' yas pa byon no/ /de ltar slob ma mtha' yas kyang sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par mngags shing bstan pa gtad pa ni grub thob o rgyan pa yin te/ 'di ni slob dpon pad+ma'i dngos slob mdo khams kyi rgyus nag byang chub gzhon nu'i gdung rgyud rta mgrin dang phur pa'i grub thob zam ma chad pa'i brgyud pa byang chub rgya mtsho sku mched gtsang du byon te ar tsho ban+dhe bco brgyad btul/ las stod sto nas blum du gdan chags pa'i brgyud pa yab jo 'phan dang yum phyug mo dug ge las lcags pho stag gi lo la sku bltams/ mtshan seng ge dpal du gsol/ rang byung gi ting 'dzin skyes/ 'khor ba la snying po med pas chos byed/ de yang thos bsam sngon du btang nas sgom byed/ sems sgom pa la da lta byis pa'i sems dang gzod sgom dus kyi sems la khyad ci 'dug lta dgos snyam nas lta ba byung ste khyad mi 'dug gsung / dgung lo bdun nas ma phur sogs yab chos thams cad mkhyen/ rje rgod tshang ba las dge bsnyen mdzad/'di la thos grol 'ong gsungs/ lo bcu drug nas bu dong rin rtse'i drung du mngon pa gong ma la mkhas par sbyangs/ zhag gsum la gzhung phyed zin zhag gsum po'i gzhung skyor zhig gsung ba na phyed po bskyor/ de man yang thugs la 913

bkra lam me 'dug nas 'di man ma bzung ba'i gzhung lags byas nas bskyar bas sprul pa'i sku la slob gnyer bya ma dgos par 'dug gsungs/ gzham yang dbu tshad byams chos mtha' dag sbyangs/ rtsod pa bzang ba'i mchog tu grags/nyi shu la mkhan po bu dong rin rtse las slob zhang bsam gling ba gsangs te ba bsod 'od sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs te 'dul ba mtha' dag gsan zhing lo bcu gnyis su stan gcig gi brtul zhugs mdzad/ khu bo go lung pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs la dus 'khor chag lugs rwa 'bro sogs kyi lugs mang du gsan/ khyad par dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje la tsa mi lugs gsan/ dus 'khor la mkhas pa thams cad la gtugs/ yan lag drug gi rna'/ 'byor smar khrid du mdzad kyang rgyud 'grel gyi sgro 'dogs ma chod/ srog rtsol yan gyi khrid kyis kyang thugs ka ma gang ste sham+bha lar rigs ldan gyi drung du 'byon par dgongs nas zla bo 'tshol ba la snya nam bde chen steng du byon pa'i tshe rje rgod tshang bas mdang rje ras chung ba byon gsungs shing nyid kyang sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus skyes shing mjal ba tsam gyis rtogs pa shar/ dus 'khor gyi ma bde ba phal cher 'bru non re mdzad pas khrol/ kha cig rgya gar shar phyogs su shes par lung bstan/ mnal lam du byon nas dbang rdzogs par gnang / nga sngon tsā ri na sdod dus rdo rje rnal 'byor mas po ti cig byin pa mid pas chos thams cad la mi shes pa cung zad kyang med gsungs/ sham+bha lar ma 'gro bar o rgyan du song don 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs te mtsho mo dang ra sogs brgyud/ ti se dang gad+dha la dang dza lan+t+ra ra rnams su sgrub pa mdzad cing o rgyan du byon/ sog po dang gcan gzan dang mi ma yin mtha' dag zil gyis mnan/ pho brang dhu ma tha la'i tshogs can ma'i gtso mo rigs ldan ma sa mu dra mu kha bya bas zas 'brel thug phor gang byin pa gsol bas rtsa mdud mtha' dag zhig ste rigal drug gi 914

gnas sbyong mang du byung / sa khol bur g.yos/ rdo rje theg pa'i sa dang po brnyes te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos su byon nas rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub gnang /rje rgod tshang bas sprul pa'i gru gcig smin pa la lo so gnyis sgom dgos pa yin/lo so gnyis ma lon gyi bar 'gro don ma byed gsung ba ltar o rgyan gyi mar lam mang yul gyi bdag po bla chen de khyim gyis bzhug4par zhus kyang ma gnang / rje rgod tshang ba gshegs pa lam du mkhyen 'od gsal gyi ngang du mjal zhing snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa'i sras kun dga' 'od zer du 'khrungs pa gzigs/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan du byon/ dzñā na gabhe sogs bzhis ma hā bo dhi'i drung du smon lam btab pas mgon pos bskul ba ltar gar log gi dmag bzlog tshogs bdag gis srog snying phul/ rdo rje gdan du lo gsum bzhugs/ 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang du sdud zer yang ji tsam sdod nga rang mkhas 'dzam gling sum gnyis kyis nga ci byed gsungs nas zhen log gi seng ge'i sgra bsgrags/ bsil ba tshal gyi gzhi bdag btul/ bod du byon nas 'gro don cung zad mdzad/ phyis kyang rdo rje gdan du lan gnyes su byon/ gar log gis nyams par byas pa'i tshe sid+dha gling gi rgyal po sogs gsum gyis phyogs gsum dang byang phyogs grub chen rin po ches bsos/ 'bul ba byung tshad rdo rje gdan du sngo/ byang sgo la bod kyi sgor grags/ de'i tshe dzo gi lnga brgyas tshogs 'khor byas tshad kyi tshogs gral du mi re shi bas byed ma nus pa na tshogs dpon du spyan drangs pas thams cad la byin rlabs zhugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha sna tshogs par mthong nas rtsod med kyi grub thob chen por bkur/ ram shing rgyal po la brtul zhugs mdzad/ phyi ma res byon pa dang man lung gu ru po ṭa lar byon pa dus mtshungs/ dza ye pur gyi rgyal pos ston pa'i phyag g.yas kyi 'theb tshigs dang po'i gdung phul/ bsnyen sgrub kyi snod rnarin po che mkhar chu ba lung bstan bzhin byon nas gnang zhing yi ge mdzad/ 915

dbus gtsang gi 'gro don chen mo sogs 'gro don mtha' yas/ rin po che kurma pa mjal te thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres/ bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid mdzad pas gces phrug brgyad bcu la sogs pa'i grub thob byung ste ngas bsnyen sgrub btab na lung pa grub thob kyis 'gengs par 'dug kyang tshe la yang gzan/ bka' rgyud kyi khrid srol la cung zad gnod par 'dug gsungs nas gtso bor rje dwags po'i phyag chen gsungs/ hor rgyal po se chen gyis bod la lam byas nas bal po dang rgya gar la dmag 'dren pa'i lam lta ba'i gser yig pa btang byung ba la chu bo rabs kyi phreng ba mdzad/ rgyal po la bstod pa sdeb sbyor can mdzad nas dmag gis lam mi bgrod par don gyis bka' gnang bas dmag bshol te rgya bal bod gsum 'jigs pa las bskyabs kyang 'di lta bu bka' drin du go mkhan yang cher mi snang / se chen gyis spyan 'dren lan gsum btang ba'i mtha' ma la byon/ ma bsgo bar stan la bzhugs pas ma bcos pa gsungs nas rgyal po mnyes/ gdung ma chen po cig bstan nas shing cir 'dug zer ba na rgya mtsho'i nya chen po cig gi rmang ra yin gsungs pas rgyal pos mngon shes 'dug zer/ sa skya pa rnams thams cad la phyin pa'i nor nyams chen po 'dug zer/ rgyal po'i phyag bsnyung ba sus kyang 'chos ma thub pa de dbyug pa mdzad pas phan/ rgyal po la chos gsungs/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i shel tham 'bul gsung yang ma bzhes/ gong ma'i sku la dus sbyor dgu 'gags zin pas bsdad kyang phan mi thogs gsungs nas zhu ba nan can mdzad pas 'byon pa'i lung khrol/ shing rta kha sprod cig gser bre dang dngul bres bkang ste phul ba blon po tsho'i blor ma shong 'u lag gis mi lcogs zer bas ma bzhes par rgyal po nyid la phul/ nga la nor gyis dgos pa med/ nga'i 'khor rnams bya bral ba yin/ de la nor gyis ci byed/ chos mi byed na ni dad can gyi rdzas mi 'ju/ nga la nor dgos na sman tsi bo che'i las sgo 916

sogs las sgo rin thang can dpag med dbyer yod ste ma phye/ rgyud sde nas gsungs nga/'e gser 'gyur byas na lcags thams cad gser du 'gyur gsungs pas rgyal ngo sa gcig ston dang zer gsha' tse dkar po dngul du bsgyur lcags gser du bsgyur te bstan pas ngo mtshar che ste nga'i mdzod chud 'dza' su la yang ma bstan zhig zer/ mi chen du ma la bde mchog gi dbang bskur mdzad pas 'bul ba du ma byung ba bzhes pas rgyal po ma mnyes nas o rgyan pasdi ngas bos pas mi sdod 'phral la 'gro nga'i 'bul ba mi len gzhan gyi len zer nas bka' bkyon du byung ba la/ slob mas bla ma dam tshig la bka'ar ba gang na'ang mi 'dug brgya byin mdun du byung rung mgo bregs la klad pa ldag b.lam pa min pa nyam nga med gsungs nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan pas 'dar phri li li spyan chab phrom phrom 'dug se chen de 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa yin zer mkhan 'dug pas ngas brtag pa'i phyir gsang ba'i bdag po'i ting 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan pas non 'gro'i 'dug 'jam dpal min par 'dug spyir bsod nams kyi zil chen po 'dug gsungs/ re gsum pa chu 'brug la hor la byon nas phyi lo sbrul lo'i lo dus la sbu bkrar phebs/ phyi lo rta lo la se chen lo brgyad bcu 'gro ba gshegs/ spyir yul nyer bzhi'i dgu la byon/ lta stangs grub/ bsad gso nus/ las chen bcu gnyis thams cad rlung sbyor gyis 'grub/ sgom med 'bring po'i rtogs par zhal gyis bzhes/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan ba nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad nas dgung lo brgyad bcu pa sa bya la mya ngan las 'das/ de'i slob ma ni sngon rje nyid rgod tshang pa'i drung du bzhugs dus dus kyi 'khor lo la nga lar+sha mkhas pa med/ chos rje pa la'ang ngas dus 'khor slob pa yin gsungs pas/ pha rgan byang dpal na re/ chos rje ba rang khyed kyi slob mar cang 'ong ngam zer ba la/ de shin tu 'ong nga la slob ma grub pa thob nges pa lnga 917

drug cig 'ong / gcig rtsod ba med pa'i sprul sku zhig 'ong zhes gsungs pa bzhin slob ma'i gtso bo ni rtsod med kyi sprul sku rje rang byung rdo rje/ gzhan snye mdo ba sku mched/ g.ya' bzang gi chos rje drin can mkhar chu ba/ glang 'khor gyi /rijam dbyangs bsod nams 'od zer ste yongs grags kyi sras bzhi/ a lung ba 'jam dbyangs rdo rje/ 'bri khung chos blo/ mus sku zhang pa/ lha rje pak+ki/ me shel ba/ mkhro phug pa/ mkhan po sgrub rin/ gdan sa pa ste nye ba'i bu brgyad/snye mo gā pa/ tsha chung ba/ g.yag mgo ba/ zla seng ba ste mchog tu gyur pa bzhi/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang dzo gi mang po/ a re dga'/ zur phug pa/sharti ras ba/ ra ca/ rgya ri ba sogs rtogs ldan dpag med dang / chag lo bstan 'dzin dpal/ shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun ye shes 'od sogs mkhas grub mtha' yas pa byon no/ / de la grub thob chen po garma ba nyid kyis 'phrin las kyi lhag ma ji ltar mdzad ce na/ spyir rgyal sras bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chi 'pho ston pa rnams kyi rol pa yang dpag par dka' na rtag bde gtsang bdag gi pha rol du son ba rnams kyi sku'i bkod pa ni sa bcu rgyun tha pas kyang bsam par gar nus/ 'on kyang dga' ldan na byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen du rtag par bzhugs shing grub thob chen po nyid kyis 'di nas lus kyi bkod pa gcig dga' ldan du 'gro 'dzam gling gi 'brel tshad der 'dren/ gcig shar phyogs kyi zhing rin po che mtha9na yas bkod par 'khor los bskyur rgyal pad+ma rnam rol du 'gyur/gdul bya kha cig shar lus 'phags por skyes pa'i don du'ang bkod pa gcig 'byung / gzhan yang du ma 'ong gsung zhing / khyad par du nyi ma nub phyogs nas sprul pa'i sku shes bya kun la mkhas nga cig bya babs pa ltar 'ong zhes lung bstan pa'i sku dngos ji ltar byon pa ni/ 'di phyin rnam thar bar do ma dang bsres nas 918

brjod par bya ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i ska da cig la dga' ldan dang lha'i gnas thams cad du sku'i bkod pa cig car du snang pa la mchod sprin mtha' yas pas mchod pas cung zad yengs pa ltar gyur/ zhag brgyad 'das/ de ma thag snying rje chen pos bu slob la gzigs te sku gdung la 'jug par bzhed de byon pa na/ sku gdud sbyangs/ lung pa cho nges gang ba gzigs pas snying rje'i ngang du cung zad brgyal/ da dung grong 'jug cig byas la 'gro ba'i den bya'o zhes dgongs te stod lungs 'phar tshang na rgan rgon gnyis kyi bar na khye'u lo bcu gsum tsam lon pa cig gi ro bzhag ste ngu ba gzigs nas ro de la zhugs/ spyan hrig mdzad pas shi mig gson la lta ba ltas ngan yin zer nas thal ba btab khab kyis btsabs pas mig med pas 'gro don mi 'grub par dgongs thon nas byon/slar thams cad btsal yang byang phyi gong na phug ron 'bus khyer gyi ro zhig las ma rnyed/ der 'gro don gyi dus la ma bab par mkhyen nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid la rtse gcig du bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mdun na mdzes pa'i bud med nyi shu rtsa lngas phyag 'tshal te thugs rje'i mnga' bdag zhi la mi bzhuges bar/ /brtse pas dag pa'i mi lus zung du gsol/ /nyam thag 'gro ba'i pha ma mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zung du gsol/ /zhes zer ro/ /'di ltar snang ba 'di dag ni rang snang 'khrul pa'o zhes dgongs nas bshig ste bzhag pa na yang yang du gsol ba 'debs pa gsan pas/ dal 'byor mi lus rin chen len pa la/ /ma dag 'khrul pas ma gos pha ma med / /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'ang dus kyis dka'/ /nged kyis ma bzhin brtse ba'i sems yod kyang / /rjes su 'dzin pa'i dpal dang skal yod nyung / /ma 'ongs byams pa'i dus su ngag bzhin sgrub/ /ces gsungs pas de rnams na re/nged rnams mi yul mthil nas 'ongs/ /yin pa zhing skyong mkha' 'gro yin/ /919

khyed la bskul ma mi 'tshal yang / /sems can don du skul du 'ongs/ /brtse ba'i yul la mi brtse na/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ji ltar lags/ /zhes zer nas sde tshan so sos ming dang srog snying phul ba/ gsang ba rdo rje thog 'bebs ma / /gtsug na rdo rje dpal 'bar ma/ /mtha' na rdo rje stobs mo che/ /lag na rdo rje mthu rgyal ma/ /zhing skyong gtso mo lnga po lags/ /kun grags ma dang kun bzang mo/ /ya ma skyong dang bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud 'dul gtso mo bzhi po lags/ /gtad dkar 'gro bzang glang bzang ma/ /tshe ring ma dang khyung mgo ma/ /chos srung gtso mo bzhi po lags/ /gangs dkar sha med rlung mo che/ kha rag khyung btsun drag mo rgyal/ /bdud 'dul gtso mo bzhi po lags/ /khri bzang ma dang sgo mo che/ /stobs mo che dang ral gri ma/ /sgo srung gtso mo bzhi po lags/ /bod khams skyong dang sman gcig ma/ /g.yar cho/ gsil dang si la mi/ /yid 'gyur gtso mo bzhi po lags/ /ces zer te so so'i ming sde tshan dngos grub sgrub thabs thams cad smos te srog snying phul lo/ /yang bud med bzhi sleb byung ste/ nga ni rdo rje sa tram̐ yin/ /li btsun rdo rje bu skyong ma/ /phu chu rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /de 'og rdo rje g.yu chung ma/ /sbas pa'i yul bzhi srung ma yin/ /zhes srog snying phul te thams cad mgrin gcig tu/ 'gro drug sems can snying re rje/ /'khor ba'i gnas na nyon re mongs/ /sems can 'gro don mdzad re ran/ /'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal 'di/ /cung zad bsams kyang mchi ma 'chor/ /bdag 'dras kyang ni mi phod na/ /brtse ldan khyod kyis phod dam ci/ /de phyir gsol ba 'debs su 'ongs/ /zer ro/ /der bag chags 'khrul snang yin dgongs te bshig kyang 'phror ma 'dod nas lan gsungs pa/ bdag 'dzin rnam rtog brag pas sra/ /nga rgyal ri bo gnam las mtho/ /'di la thos pa'i gzong btsugs te/ /sgom pa'i rgyogs rdo 'phangs lags kyang / /'jig pas 920

ser ka cung ma mthong / /'gro drug sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /zhing skyong ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa dang / bar snang gi lha phran nas sa 'og lto 'phye'i bar lhags te thams cad kyis lus sa la brdabs pa'i phyag byas te gsol ba btab pa/ gson dang rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku/ /lha rnams ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /lha min rtsod pa'i sdug— bsngal dang / /mi rnams skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang / /byol song glen lkugs sdug bsngal dang / /yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal dang / /dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal rnams/ /dran zhing bsams na glo snying 'dar/ /mi bzod tshor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /shin du nyam thag 'o dod 'bod/ /'di 'dra su yis bzod par nus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa su yis 'dzin/ /'gro drug pha ma su yis byed/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang su yis bstod/ /kye hud kye hud sdug re bsngal/ /zhes zer nas thams cad ngu zhing mya ngan byed par snang tre / /de'i tshe slar gsungs pa/ spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams bsam mi khyab/ /sgos khyad par dzasbu'i gling shed na/ dge bshes bgrang las 'das pa bdog /chos mdzad bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /lung bstan rgyal tshab gzhan du tshol/ /'gro drug pha ma de ru tshol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa chos mdzad rnams kyis srungs/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang zhing skyong rnams kyis bstod/ /'gro drug pha ma dge bshes rnams kyis mdzod/ khyed rang tsho ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /ces gsungs te ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa dang /yang zhing skyong rnams kyis gsol pa/ dge bshes rnams ni phrag dog che/ /chos pa rnams ni 'gran sems che/ /'gro drug kun yang rgyud ngan rengs/ /de la phan thabs mi gda' bas/ khyed la bskul ma cis kyang 'debs/ /zhes zer ro/ /de nas thugs rje chen po g.yos te lan gsungs pa/ dal 'byor mi lus blang sa med/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rnyed par dka'/ /snyigs dus mngal de grib 921

re che/ /'das ma 'ongs kyi dran pa stor nas 'gro /sems can 'gro don bya bang dka'/ /lar de skad zer ba'i gting shed la/ /rigs ldan pha ma rnyed srid na//mtshan ldan bla ma mjal ba na/ — /zhing skyong tshos chos skyong byed pa na/ /dbang dang sre ba rdzogs par zhu/ /brda dang byin rlabs rdzogs par stsol/ /de skad ces gsungs pa dang zhing skyong de rnams kyis skad cig gis bde mchog yab yum spyan drangs nas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod de lha dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pa 4bskur/ ā li kā li'i glegs bam bkod de rig pa ye shes lnga'i dbang yin skad/ dbang po lnga la ngo sprad nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dbang yin skad/ skye med don gyi dbang 'di ni/ /tshig tu bskur du tshig lam chad/ /brda yis mtshon du brda lam chad/ /dpe yis mtshon du dpe lam chad/ /'khrul bas mtshon du 'khrul lam chad/ /dbang 'di sus kyang bskur mi 'dod/ /nged kyis zhal ce mtshon ma stub/ /rang la lhang nge lhan ner 'char/ /sa le sing nge hrig ger 'char/ /wal le khyug ge lam mer 'char/ /'khor 'das snang ba ma nub kyang / /sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par 'byung / /sems can 'gro don de ru 'grub/ /ces gsungs shing zhing skyong gtso mo rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ 'khor rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ gzhan rnams kyis me tog gi char dang rol mo'i sgra dkrol bar byed do/ /de nas khong rnams na re/ re yang re ste byung yang byung / rin chen 'ja'— yi lam sna bdog /dal 'byor mi lus blang sa bdog /mang yul bkra shis gung thang na/ /jo mo bkra shis g.yu chung ma/ /zhur mo gangs kyi mdun shed na/ /'om lung bkra shis 'khan thang du/ /pha thig le 'od gsal khang pa bdog /rtsa phu rin chen che ba'i gangs/ /phu gsum 'dzom pa'i klung shod na/ /rtsa lung mi la'i 'khrungs sa bdog /lho ri dmar smug mdangs gsal ba/ /byang 922

ri dkar po'i mdog ldan na/ /ma dgos 'dod lus sgrom bu bdog /zhes glu len zhing bar snang la 'ja' kha dog sna lnga pa nar byung ba'i steng la phar 'gro zhing 'dug ltad mo che ba snyam nas de na phar byon pas shel gyi khang pa ginam sgo can phyogs bzhi'i steng dkar dwangs 'od dmar smug phyogs mtshams 'ja' tshon du shig ge ba'i nang du byon pa dang / 'dod chags khrag gi rba rlabs byung zeng nas /long rnams 'bros kyi 'dug pa mthong / der gnam /tung dgu la skas re 'dug pa'i gcig la 'dzegs pas ma thar te las kyi rnam smin thar ba dka'/zer ba'i sgra byung ba dang nag mun gyis song ste cung zhig brgyal/ dran pa mdo long mdo long byung ba na nag la mun pa lci zhing 'thib pa khams 'tshub pa/ res 'ag/'a chu yi rba rlabs bskyod pa 'dra/ /res 'ga' ri yis mnan pa snyam/ /res 'ga' tsha zhing bsregs pa nyadra/ /res 'ga' grang zhing 'khyags nas non/ /rang rig thon pa'i rlung yang med/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal de na che/ /dus da lta dran yang snying rlung ldang / /zhes rnam thar bar do ca/ra gsungs la/ dag pa'i gdul bya kha cig la ni/ ma'i mngal de shel gyi khang pa bde ba'i rang bzhin can du snang zhing der yang sems can mang po'i don byas so zhes gsungs so/ /grub thob o rgyan pa yang rin po che'i bka' bzhin sham po'i gangs dang gnyal mtsho sna so gas su byon/ de'i tshe rin po che korma pa chibs dang dbu zhwa nag po can shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la byon song bar gzigs te spyan chab byung /bzhugs par zhus pas da res cis kyang 'gro myur du 'phrad 'ong gsungs nas bzhud pa gzigs/ mdang rmi lam ngan rin po che lam pa mi bzhugs pa 'dra gsungs nas d+dha/chod pa chen po mdzad do/ /de ltar snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa /gcig pu ba thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje de ni la stod kyi cha mang yul 7/gung thang 'o ma lung 'khan thang ga rtsi phur yab sngon bkas gnang ba'i sto na pa chos 923

dpal de nyid las yum jo mo g.yang 'dren gyi lhums su zhugs shing de srid du yum gyis kyang sngon ma myong ba'i bde bas nyin mtshan 'da' zhing dag snang rgya mtsho la spyod do/ /de nas yab yum de dag ding ri glang 'khor dang ches nye rbar byon nas sru mo zhig gi khyim du bzhugs pa na shing pho spre'u'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad kyi phyi dro khang steng zhig tu yum la ma gnod par bltams ma thag tshog tsog pur bzhugs zhal phyag gis phyis te zla ba la gzigs nas tshes brgyad kyi zla bar 'dug ang gsungs/ de sru mo des ma bzod nas skyes ma thag nas smra ba 'di mi rung bas med par gyis zer bas yab yum gyis de 'dra gar 'ong gsungs nas gnas gzhan du bskyas/ snyigs ma'i sems can blun po'i rang bzhin mkhyen pas de nas re zhig gsung 'byon pa dang bzhengs pa sogs nus bzhin du ma mdzad/'di'i zla ba snga ma la o rgyan pa snye mo ca ba lung na bzhugs tshe gtad med du zil chen po zhig byung / der rin po che kurma pa gzi brjid nyi ma lta bu byon te zhwa nag cig gnang / byin rlabs kyi zil gyis gzhan rnams brgyal ba ltar gyur/ grub chen pa nyid kyang spyan chab chu rgyun ltar bab cing / 'gyur med rang byung rdo rje'i sku/ /rnam dag rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang / /chos sku dri med gdan la bzhugs/ /ces sogs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad pa ste sprul pa'i sku myur du 'byon pa'i ltas so/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor bzod pa dang byams pa la goms pa'i phyir dang tshogs gnyis su dang yang mi mtshungs pa'i phyir khye'u de sus mthong yang ngo mtshar gyi mig bgrad de e ma 'di rmi lam min na rung ste zhes sems pa dang mchod pa'i 'tshog chas sna tshogs kyis mchod cing snyan par grags so/ /re zhig btang stoms pa ltar mdzad nas dgung lo gsum pa la phying pa nag po la zhwa 'di 'dra ba bzos shig gsungs te zhwa nag chung ngu zhig bsnabs te rdo'i khri thog nas byis pa mang po 'a/ sku gsum ngo sprod gsung zhing sngon gyi de ma brjed par snang gsung / sna tshogs 92

rol ba'i snang ba 'di dag kun/ /sgyu ma mig sgyu 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du/ /snang yang bden pas stong bar kho bos rtogs/ /ma rtogs byis pa khyed rnams snying re rje/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di tshigs bcad gsungs pa'i thog mar grags/ mngon mkhyen gyi thog ma yum gyi dar kha 'ga' zhig brlag pas sdug bsngal ba na khyod de tsam du dar la dad na nga la mtshur phu na dar shing sgrom chen po du ma yod pa byin chog gsungs/ yab lug khyu la brnab sems skyes pa na mdo khams na rta khyu yang 'di bas che ba du ma nga la yod pas byin chog gsungs/ bdag gi sems mkhyen pa tsug lags zhus pas nga ni rin po che dam pa'o gsungs/ sngon gnang sbyin dang bka' lung gnang ba dran te mchi ma phyung zhing zhabs la gtugs/ de phyin yab yum gnyis kyang grub thob chen po dngos kyi mos gus yod kyang bkas bcings te gzhan la mi sgrog nam zhig yab zas skom gyi rtog pa 'gyus tshe zhal nas de lta na grong pha gir 'gro bar bya'o zhes gsungs te byon pa na yab yum bzhed pa'i longs spyod byung / yab dga' ches pa dang chang gis bzi bas rin po che garma pa byon pa yin byas pas khrom thams cad 'ur te 'bul ba ri ltar spungs pa byung / kun gyis chos deng byin rlabs zhus/ khyad par la stod kyi bshes gnyen thams cad kyi bla ma sems dpa' chen po gser khang pa der gral dbu la byon pas dri ba zhib tu zhus pa na rnam thar bar do ma gsungs te khong gis yi ger btab cing zhabs gtsug tu blangs/ glang 'khor spyi mchod kyi dus sku gdung ka ru la ngo mtshar gyi gzigs snang du ma dang 'od zer rang nyid la thim par gzigs shing yab las zhi byed so lugs dang rgyud phyi gsan/ shel gyi khri rgyab yol can la bzhugs te 'od zer 'gyed bzhin pas nam mkha' la bya ltar rgyu zhing lha mi thams cad 'dud pa sogs gzigs/ thun mong gi mthong bar byis pa'i kun spyod kyi mthun 'jug ston zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad sbyang ba dang lkog gyur gyi 925

gdul bya mtha3 yas pa'i don mdzad pa'o/ /kyi rong bi 'phags pa wa ti mjar tshe spyan ras gzigs dngos su gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs/ dgung lo lnga pa la grub chen o rgyan pa mjal bzhed pas rim pas byon/ grub chen pa la 'od gsal gyi ngang du rin po che karma pa byon nas sang nga 'ong bar shes par gyis shis gsungs/ grub chen pa shin tu snga bar bzhengs nas mdang rin po che kurma pa dang mjal ba rmis gsung zhing gzims khang si rtse la bskor ba mdzad/ mo phug gnas brtan mjal ba la sleb ste mdang mo phug na rna'/ 'byor pa pho mo gnyis kyi byis pa de garma pa yin zer gyi 'dug de 94 lta ba lags mod da nang bdag dang 'grogs 'dir sleb bdog zer bas/ 'o de ka yin/ da lta dung thong tshogs pa thams cad bsdus la bsu ba cher gyis/ nga'i gong 'dir stan mthon bo shoms/ dam pa yin na mi skrag par sdod kyi gsungs/ tshogs pas spyan drangs te byon pa na grub chen pas nyam sad pa'i phyir gsang bdag gi ting 'dzin mdzad pas zil gyis ma non/ grub chen pa la phyag mi mdzad par phyag gis dril gdang dkrol bas grub thob pa'i gsung nas bu chung thu mo cig 'dug snyan grags chen po 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ khri chen po de la shad kyis byon nas bzhugs/khyod su yin gsungs pas phyag nam mkha' la brkyangs te nga ni ming yongs— su grags pa kurma pa'o gsungs sngon gyi ma jal lugs shod cig gsungs pas/ la stod kyi jo btsun o rgyan pa/ kho bori mdun du 'ongs nas kyang / /rgya gar shar nub kyi gleng mo gtong / /rdo rjo gdan gyi bkod pa byin/ /ca khyen pa dam chos kyi gleng mo 'chad/ /ces sogs gsungs/ nga la ci byin dran nam gsungs pas ngari zhwa nag dang dpe cha yod pa gsungs/ de bden gsungs nas phul/dbu zhwa bzhes ḍa sa bzhad gad chen༄ po byung / slar khri las babab/ nas sngar nga bla ma yin yang da ste/ nga kyis bskyang du gso'/ kasungang/ nas phya4/ dzo/dzad/ khyod nga'i bla 926

ma yin na klog shes te 'ong bas thon gsungs nas dpe cha gtad pas 'a la na thogs me/da du shar re byung / la lar tshig sdud ma byang ba/ la lar sbyar klog sna tshogs byung bas 'di bas god bro ba'i klog mthong ma myong gsungs nas bzhad/dgung lo dris nas nga'i bla ma lug lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs pa yin khyod spre lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad /la skyes na bar na zla ba lnga las mi 'dug nga'i bla ma'i sku skye min par 'dug gsungs pas/ ngas mngal gyi lus chags nas zla ba bzhi lon pa cig la rnam shes zhugs pa yin/ snga gzhis gangs zhur mo'i mdun du song tshar zhes yang yang bzlas pa ma gsan nam gsungs/ 'di ltar na snga ma zla ba bzhi ni kun gzhi'i cha cig zhugs pas mngon byang lnga las gzugs su dod pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs dang / phyi ma ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes rdzogs par zhugs pa las lhan cig skyes ba'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa la zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi glus bskul las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sems dpa' gsum rdzogs su bzhengs par snang ngo / /gzhan ci dran gsungs pas/ /'phar tshang gi grong 'jug gi tshul gsungs/ bden rdzun lta gsungs nas 'phral du mi btang bas nges pa 'drongs/ mngal du phyi rol gyi yul ma bsgribs par gzigs pa dang / yum gyis 'di skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'dug pas bu mor 'ong / yab kyi rmi lam las bur 'ong zer ba gsan gsungs pas yab yum bos gdong 'dzom mdzang pas kun yid 'ches te rgya gar du sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang bod yul chu khyod sa ོgetogs pa mngal gyi dri mas gtan ma gos pa gzhan pyung ba med gsungs nas bstod bsngags cher mdzad/ nga'i bla ma'i gsang mtshan rang byung rdo rje yin pas de ka 'dogs so gsungs nas rang byung rdo rjer mtshan gsol/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang / bde dgyes ma phur dus 'khor sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa'i dbang rgyud/ sku gsum ngo sprod la sogs pa'i man ngag mtha' yas 927

gsan/ lkog gyur gyi gnas du ma gzigs pa cung zad gsungs pas bar chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir mngon mkhyen gsang bar gdams/ lo gnyis su bsten dgung lo bdun pa'i tshe khro phu ba kun ldan shes rab kyis mkhan po de'i dbu che zhig gis slob dpon mdzad de rab byung dang dge tshul du bsgrubs/ 'dul ba ci rigs gsan/ mtshan snga ma las ma spos pa 'dra/ de'i tshe mtshur phu na grub chen gnyan ras bzhugs pa la thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa zhig gis nyi ma nub kyi phyogs na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sku nyi ma shar ba lta bu yod kyi spyan 'dren pa'i dus la bab bo zhes bskul ba byung / snyan grags kyis kyang sa chen po khyab ste bstod pa dang 'bul ba bskur/bde mchog gi dbang gsan pa'i tshe bla ma bde mchog dngos su gzigs/ rgod tshang pas lhan cig skyes sbyor gsungs ba'i snang ba byung ste rtogs ba'i gzhi rtsa chod/ dpon slob thams cad lhan cig par thegs pa'i lam thams cad du lha 'dre dpag med kyis bsu zhing 'dud ba dang dbang du 'dus shing / rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su gzigs/ ma mgon dang sngags bdag gis mtshur phur myur du byon zhes bskul te phebs/ grong 'jug mdzad pa'i byis pa'i ma de bos nas mdzo mo zhig gnang khyod kyis nga'i mi/ga la ci byas gsungs/ sa zhig btab lags zer/ bla ma gnyan ras kyis mjal ba'i tshe sa ra ha la bka' rgyud kyi grub thob dpag med kyis bskor ba gzigs te brgyud pa'i byin rlabs zhugs par gzigs/ de'i tshe slob ma dam pa rnams the tshom zad pa'i nges shes thob na'ang skal dman nga rgyal can kha cig gis ma dad pa cher byas pa na brag gdong skam po cig tu nga dam pagi yin na 'dir chu mig 'byung bar gyur cig gsungs ma thag chu mig che ba zhig byung / yog pa phyed tshig pa zhig de nyid du btsugs te nga kurma pak+ki yin na 'di da lta skye la min na mi skye bar gyur cigagasungs pas skad cig de nyid du skyes te sgrub chu dang sgrub shing du grags te da 928

lta'ang yod/ mtshur phur phebs ma thag nas ma mgon rnams shin du dgyes pas 'phrin las mdzad pa gzigs te bstod pa mdzad/ rta lo la sa g.yos byung ba'i tshe sku'i rtsa mdud phyogs med du grol zhing chos thams cad rang sems su mkhyen pa la brtan pa thob/ lha mo zhi drag gis bskul nas chos khrims gsar du mdzad/mnal lam du sto phyogs dpal gyi ri bor sa ra ha dang mjal te do ha'i don rtogs/ slob dpon shes rab dpal la sdud 'grel pañtsi ka dang bshad sbyar gsan/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od la dgyes rdor dang spyod 'jug gnam mtsho ba la ma gcig gi gcod skor sogs gsan/ gtso bor grub chen gnyan ras la kham tshang gi zab chos thams cad dang / mar mi dwags gsum gyi gdams pa'i tshogs dang / rngog mtshur mes ras chung pa khro phu ba sogs nas brgyud ba'i chos dang gter kha gong 'og sogs gsar rnying gi chos mtha' dag gsan/ 'jam dbyangs shāka gzhon pa la tshad ma mdo sde bdun yan lag dang bcas pa/ mngon pa gong 'og sa sde dang bcas pa/ byams chos lnga 'grel bcas/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug gzhi gsum 'grel pa dang bcas pa la sogs mtshan nyid kyi theg pa che chung gi gzhung luṭa mtha' dag gsan/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa bshol dang mngal zla brtsis pa'i nyi shu pa tshang ba na dge 'dun sgang pa'i 'dren pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gathon nu byang chub pas mkhan po/ mkhas pa dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob mdzad de dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs/ spyir dge slong gi bslab pa la ming rje ba red mo da na'ang 'dir mkhan pos rang gi mtshan las gras nas ched du tshul khrims gzhon nu zhes gsol ba 'dra ste gnas sgor o rgyan pa mnal lam du byon pa'i skabs las/ tshul khrims gzhon nu zhes bya'i rnal 'byor bdag /ces so/ /mkhan slob gnyis las 'dul ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag gsan/grub chen o rgyan pas slar shangs kyi tsha rir 'byon pa zhu khros gdams ngag gams 929

cad tshang sprugs su 'bul gsungs na'ang sku tshe 'di la mjal ba'i rten 'brel med gsungs nas ma thegs pa de ma thag grub chen rin po che gshegs/ dgongs pa rdzogs phyir snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub la dus kyi 'khor lo sogs grub chen rin po che'i chos mtha' dag gsan/ de'i tshe ko ber bas bar chad byas pa drung nyid mgon po ber nag can du mdzad nas btul ba rtogs ldan grags seng ba'i mnal lam du gzigs/ dpon slob bdun gyis dpa' bo'i ston mo zhig mdzad tshe o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma gsum nam mkha' la 'ongs te glu gar gyi mchod pa byas/ mnal lam du grub chen pa byon te bsnyen sgrub sogs gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs/ mkhas pa rba ras sogs la gso ba rig pa gsan/bshes gnyen tshul rin pa la gsang 'dus 'phags skor sogs mdor na bod kyi yul du bka' bstan bcos man ngag 'gyur ro cog thams cad gsan par mdzad de dam pa'i chos la gus pa dang / bla ma med par rang gzos mi 'jug pa'i gdams ngag mig ltos su ston par mdzad/ de thams cad kyang tshar re gsan pa tsam gyis tshig don mtha' dag skad cig res thugs su chud kyang ched chung dang brnyas thabs mi mdzad par nan chags su mdzad/ sa ris kho na mdzad pas lcags smyug bdun zad par grags gsan yig gi chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ming kho na'ang deng sang gi skye bo'i spyod yul du mi chud/ snying thig gsan pa na snang gsum bde blag tu rdzogs te chos nyid zad pa'i snang bar la zlos/ mkha' 'gro chos/ skyong thams cad kyis bskul nas gzhan don 'byung bar dgongs te kurmar byon/ der bai ma la rang gi mdzod pur thim pa gzigs pas rdzogs chen gyi don thams cad rtogs shing snying thig gi yig cha mdzad/ gzhan phan gyi ltas mkhyen nas lha steng gi ri khrod btab pa'i tshe rgyal ba'i ring bsrel mang du snang ba 'od che chung sna tshogs par gzigs te bsam gtan pa mang du 'byung bar mkhyen/ bde 930

ba can gyi zhing dang shākya'i rgyal po'i sku'i bkod ḍa4 du ma gzigs te mnal lam gyi mdo sde'e bstan bcos mdzad/ ri rab kyi rtser khang brtsegs drug tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsum gyis byams chos ca/grin gcig tu gsung ba gsan pas byams chos mtha' dag gi don thugs su sngar bas kyang gsal bar chud/ khang brtsegs de'i 'og gser ri'i steng nas thugs rje chen po'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa gsol zhing gzhan la bkye bar snang bas snyigs dus kyi gdul bya'i tsha gdung sel nus par dgongs/ kun spyod kyi 'grel pa mdzad tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che du ma stsol bar gzigs/ lha steng gi khor yug nags tshal chen po yod pa la glo bur du me shor nas thams cad ci bya'i gtol dang bral te mkhas btsun gzhon nu 'bum gyis me'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol zhes zhus pas/ bdag ni lhag bsam rnam dag dang ldan te/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams la tshoṭa bsags shing / /da ltar sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin gyur na/ /bden pa 'di yi bden tshig brjod ba'i mthus/ /me chen 'bar ba'i tshogs 'di zhi gyur cig /ces se gol mdzad pa'i mod la du ba kham nag nam mkha' khyab par me lce dang 'dres mar 'khrigs pa las char rgyun chen po byung nas me thams cad skad cig gis zhi zhing 'phags ma sgrol ma gsal bar gzigs/ yang 'khor dang snyan graṭa ma bzod pa'i skye bo phrag dog gi khyad nor can kha cig gis mthu byed par brtsams te mi brgyad kyis phutha zupar gshin rje drag tu bsgrubs nas rbad pa de'i tshe 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed zha'i sa/sum phyag drug pa me phung gi nang na khros pas rig sngags zlog par gzigs pa na phug pa rdib ste de dag pha rol du song zhing gzhan yang cho 'phrul mi 'tshams pa du ma byung bas de dag 'khor bcas skrag ste 'bul bshags rgya cher byas/ rong btsan kha ba dkar po dang /ma po rdo rje dpal brtsegs sogs kyis spyan drangs te yul gru de dag du phan bder mdzad/ shar 931

kol ti'i 'khrug chen sus kyang ma zlums par yun ring ba de lha 'dre 'khrugs par mkhyen nas ting nge 'dzin gyis lha 'dre rnams bkug ste zil gyis mnan pas bka' sgrub par dam bcas te de nyid du rang zhir song / slar mtshur phur byon pa na gnyan chen thang lha sogs kyis bsu bar dpon slob du mas gzigs/ gzhan dag gis na bun gyi phreng bar mthong / lha sar jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser gyi gdugs ngo mtshar can phul tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par mchod sprin byung ༄bar gzigs/ dgyes rdor brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa mdzad pa na byang chub sems 'grel mtha' dag thugs la ma bsgribs par gsal/ mtshur phu'i ri khrod skungs su phyi nang gi gza' skar dus sbyor thams cad ji lta bar gzigs te rtsis kun bsdus pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ jo mo gangs la sogs par dben pa mdzad pa na slob dpon pad+ma rang nyid la thim ba dang / byang phyogs kyi zhing khams cig na 'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa dang / mi ma yin rnams phyag dang bskor ba byed pa dang / dus gsum mkhyen pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor ba gzigs/ gru bzhir bzhugs tshe 'gro don gyi ltas gzigs nas mtshur phu bde chen btab/ der rgyal ba'i ring bsrel 'od zer 'phro ba mang du rnyed pa'i gziṭa snang byung ste bka' rgyud kyi gral thub pa'i sgom chen mang du 'byung bar mkhyen/yar lha sham bu'i gangs su phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs te rten 'brel gyi mkhyen pa mthar phyin/ gzhan yang da ltar sangs rgyas spos kyi glang po'i mdzad pa dang / de'i gsung rab kyi rtsig pa nam mkha' gang ba tsam gzigs/ mnal lam du rgyal ba byams pa 'khor mang po can gzigs pas steng gi nam mkha' la 'byon pa mi 'tshams par dgongs nas sa 'og nas byams pa'i drung du sprul pa'i pad+ma la bzhugs te chos gsan/ mngon dga'i zhing mi 'khrugs pa'i drung na byang sems spos glang gi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 932

gzigs/ bde chen gyi chu mig brgya rtsar khrid mdzad tshe 'od gsal sgyu lus nyin mtshan khor yug tu song ba'i sgom chen mang du byung / ngag rlung gi rten 'brel nam mkha'i khams gser gyi yig 'brur snang ba sku'i spu khung du thim zhing 'phro bar gzigs la phung khams ngo bo nyid kyis 'dus pa'i lha tshogs su rtogs te bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i dgongs don bkral/ rdor sems he ru gas byin gyis rlob pa dang phyi rol du'ang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i 'ja' 'od kyis nam mkha' khyab par gzigs te dam tshig rgya mtsho rtsa 'grel mdzad/ jo mo gangs dkar gyi phug par slob dpon pad+ma'i sku bzhengs tshe de'i 'phrin las kyi lhag ma da dung ring du 'byung bar mkhyen/ g.yas ru shangs la byon te so nam kho ma'i 'brong la byed zer zhing 'brong nas bra byi yan gsod pas 'tsho ba'i lung nag de'i skye bo rnams btul te srog gcod spong ba la ring du bkod/ dpal ldan sa skya la sogs pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde dgon gnas/ lha khang thams cad du yo byad thams cad chags med du bkye/ yul khams de thams cad kyi mi dang mi ma yin pa mchog dman thams cad kyis ris med du bkur zhing 'bul nor ni de bas kyang rgya che/ o rgyan pa'i sku'i skye ba byon pa gtso bor gyur pa'i skal ldan mtha' yas pa rjes su bzung / nyang stod nyid bar gsum dam pa'i chos kyis btul nas nyang stod nas ya 'brog la 'byon pa'i ༄tshe kha ro'i la rgyab tu ha bo gang bzang sang grang mo ma gtong zhig ces lan gnyis gsung rba mdzad/ kha ro'i la rgyab tshe hor zla bcu gnyis pa yin yang shin tu dro ba sos ku'i tshad༄ pa 4sta bu byung / mtshur lha lung du sku 'bum la zhig gso dang gser gsol ba'i tshe ma 'ongs pa dge slong dung du gyur pas rgyal ba byams pa'i mchod rten byed par mkhyen/ skye bo mtha' yas pa la chos gsung tshe bka' rgyud kyi bla ma rnams gzigs shing nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyis ring bar grags/ kong po'i rgyal khams chen po'i mi dang mi ma yin ོ 933

pa thams cad kyis dad pas spyan drangs te thugs rje chen pos bskul zhing lung bstan te lam du dwags lha sgam por bla ma lha rje dpag med mjal zhing phyag rgya chen pos gzhan don 'byung bar mkhyen/ tsā ri ma chen du 'byon par dgongs pa yul stod kyi chos khri bar du byon/ rten 'brel cung ma 'grig kyang phag mo'i phyag dpe lung nang de phyogs su rlung gis khyer te ma 'dus pas nga'i chos kyi bstan pa 'byung gsung ste phyis phag mo kur lugs gnas der dar/ tsā ri gsar rnying thams cad du ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa gzigs shing gnas mi gsal ba du ma zhal phye/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du gtsang pos zhing nga/nga tshal khyer nas mtshor gyur pa la skyabs zhus pas gru kha cung zad 'gyur 'ong khri rtsigs shig gsungs nas gagong 'gram du chos khri brtsigs/ der bzhugs te bden tshig gis phyag na7sa 7rithor bas tshur ngos kyi chu skad cig gis je chung du song / zla gcig gi khongs su sto ngos su 'gyur/ mtsho'i shul sas gang ba la slar zhing dang tshal byas te deng sang du'ang yu/ma du yod/ rnam thos tshal du byon te kong ral gsum gyi skye bo thams cad la chos rgya dkar po mdzad de gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la bzhag phrag tu rab gnas mdzad tshe sa g.yo ba dang me tog gi char kun gyis bzung du yod ba byung / ma 'ongs ba'i 'gro don mkhyen nas nags phu'i ri khrod 'debs par dgongs/ nags mdar bzhugs nas 'di'i phu na gnas ngo mtshar can yod pas der 'gro gsungs pa na su yang 'gro bar ma spro/ yul mis kyang mi thar ba'i tshul zhus pas do nub rmi lam lta'o gsungs nas sang nyin ri dang lam sogs bkod pa 'di ltar 'dug zhib par gsungs pas yul mi rnams dad pa thob ste der thegs nas sgrub sde btab/ gnas de shin tu grang na'ang sgrub pa po rnams kyi chu skor la dgun sgang chen yang wa chu sogs mi 'khyag pa dang dkon mchog gi mchod pa byed gsungs nas sgrub sde'i gdong thad kyi bam sur dang stag 934

ma rnams dgu 'dren dus me tog 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs te da lta'ang de bzhin yod/ lo gcig gi nang du sgru ba sde dgon gnas dpag med mdzad/ lkog phred du nang don rang 'grel ma dzad/ thugs dam shin tu 'phel/ shar phyogs las gshin gyi gnas gzigs te ngan 'gro dpag med drangs/ bang ram spang du phebs tshe tshad ma paṇa chen pas chibs rags kyi khrod du gnas chen tsā ri'i mkhris su sleb nas ma ca/jal zhus pas/ tsā ri'i gnas dgun gyi kha bas non pas ngas bstan mi thub/ tsā ri'i mkha' 'gro dgos na bstan gyi gsungs/ ston par zhu zhus pas rlung bus lta stangs mdzad de chibs sngon la shar gyis bzhud/cung zad na na bun dang 'ja' tshon 'dres ma nar byung ba'i khrod nas bu mo bco brgyad snyan pa'i glu len zhing byung / chibs 'then te phyag dbang dang dar mdud re gnang nas da lta song zhig gsungs te pha tshad du yal/ sku 'khor rnams la'ang phyag mdud re gnang nas khyed rnams de'i rjes su yid ma 'phro zhig snga res nga'i 'khor mang po 'di tshos khyer/ da res kurma nang so'i chibs pa de khyer song bas thub ste 'ong gsungs/ de nas yar phebs tshe so chag 'phrang gi brag 'og mtsho chen por yod cing ri rtse bskor dgos pa la de'i tshe bye ma'i sgang lam chen po byung ste de la thegs/ 'di lta bu sngon ma byung bar gleng / phebs nas zhag gnyis gsum na lam de mi snang bar sngar bzhin mtshor gyur/ slar mtshur phu la sogs par phebs te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen mja da/ g.yag sdecapaṇa chen gyis tshal pa'i sar bzhugs tshe mjal du byon/ phyag ma phul bar bdag dad na dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsten pa lags pas zhag 'ga' zhabs phyir bsdad de brtag par zhus pas mnyes bzhin gnang / nyin par dge bshes mtha' yas pa la mdo sngags kyi bshad chen rgya mtsho lta bu mang du mdzad/ mtshan mo dbang rjes gnang zab khrid dpag med gnang / bar rnams su skye bo dpag med la mjal 935

kha gser yig pa dpag med la zhal bkod/ tshal pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po da/ nga khyad par bka' bstan 'gyur gyi zhal bkod sogs rlabs chen gyi mdzad ba rgya mtsho rnams gcig go gcig gis mi 'gag cing sku gsung thugs dal zhing lhod chags pa las mi g.yo bar gzigs/ chos kyi dka' ba'i gnas rnams dris pa na de tsam ni dka' ba ma yin te de las gzhan 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes gsung ba na sngon rna lam du yang ma gsan pa kho na gsan/ nyin re re bzhin mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mtha' je mi dpogs su song / blo'i ra ba las brgal te zhabs la spyi bos gtugs nas sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'dzin/ 'pho ba zhus pas rnam shes tshangs bug nas 'pho ba yin gsungs/gzer lnga zhus pas gzer lnga mi dgos gcig gis bsdoms te mchi gsung bas de kho na ltar 'dug ces lhag par dad/ gzhan yang thos pas dregs pa mang pos mjal ba na kho rang gi nga rgyal dang bstun pa'i ming nas 'bod/ bsngags pa mdzad/ kho rang gi sngon gyi byed spyod dang zhar la phyis 'byung sogs yi ger bkod de gnang bas nga rgyal zhi ste sgod ldan du gyur pa mang du byung / nyan gyi phur sman chu gsol ba'i tshe ljags la reg ma thag 'di la chu phal pa sum gnyis sman gyi chu sum cha gcig tu snang ste lce'i dbang pos shes so gsungs chu mi/ga tu phyag bcug ste shar nas skye ba'i dron mo shed med 'di chu phal pa ste sum gnyis snang / nub nas skye ba'i grang mo shed can 'di sman gyi chu ste sum cha gcig snang ngo gsungs/mkhas pa shes rin pa de la yid 'ches ma skyes/ de nas byin rlabs kyis chu phal pa skye ba nub nas skaca chu de cher 'phel bas yul mi rnams sngon chu 'di'i sum cha tsam las mi yong / rje phebs nas sum 'gyur du 'phel sngar bas ches grang zhing nus pa che bar 'dug zer ba gsan/ zhal nas ngas de skad byas te dge bshes 'di nga'i tshig la yid mi 'ches par 'dug gsung bas zhum zhing dad de/ shin tu 936

skog gyur thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul/ /mngon sum nyid du 'jal ba'i blo ldan la/ /byol song phyugs kyi phyugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /bdag blos nongs par gyur pa mthol zhing bshags/ /slan chad khyod kyi rnam shes tshongags drug 'di / /bya ba sgrub dang so sor rtogs pa yi/ /ye shes dag pa dri med yin min gyi/ /the tshom gcod mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes ched du brjod pa byas/ yang rnam thos tshal du rgyal ba'i tshems bstan pa'i tshe lo tsā sgyur zhig gsungs/ khong gis skad 'gags nas mi thon mchi zhus pas khyod rang sgyur zhis skad nga nyid kyis shes gsungs/ de'i tshe skad che zhing snyan pa byung / de tshar nas yangar sngon bzhin du thal bas/ tshangs pa dang ni dri za'i rgyal po la'ang / /gzhan ༄gyi ngag la dbang bsgyur 'di med na/ /bdag gi ngag la dbang bsgyur chos kyi rje/ /mtshung4 ))med ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ khong pas tsā ri'i zhol du /'dir lo gsum sgrub pa bgyid byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhus pas/ bar chod 'ong dbus gtsang du'ang 'khrug pa chen po 'ong / nga'i phyags phyir khams su 'dong gsungasaṣa de nas de ma thag tshal khams gnyis 'khrugs/ 'di lags sam zhus pas 'di ni 'go 'dzugs kyi chung ngu ste rim par 'ong gsungs te bzhi thog dang dpon chen nang zhig sogs dbus gtsang kun ma bde/ hor dmag mang du 'grims pa sogs gsung ji lta ba bzhin byung bas/ dus gsum la ni sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /kun mkhyen sgrib med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod snang ngo / de ltar dwags kong skyi shod sogs de thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od dang chos khri g.yo ba sogs ngo mtshar mang du snang zhing / zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las du ma mdzad/ lha sar phyags phyi'i dge bshes rnams so sos bstan pa dar rgyas 'byung ba'i ltas mang du 937

mthong / slar kurmar byon te zhi lhag zung du chud pa'i bsam gtan pa shin tu mang po byung zhing chos dbyings bstod pa'i 'grel pa mdzad/ dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po'i gnas sog gi chu la zam pa mdzad pa na klu des 'phrin las thams cad sgrub par khas blangs/ spyan ras gzigs kyis/ snyigs dus g.yeng ba byas na bar chad 'byung / /dben gnas gzhan du phyin yang chos mi 'phel/ /de bas dpal ldan nags phu'i ri khrod song / /zheb/ bskul bas nags phur byon te ting 'dzin shin tu 'phel/ mkha' 'gro'i brda las/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum pa'i don legs par dgongs te rnal 'byor gsum snyi nga gi dgongs pa bkrol/ nor ngazang gis bla ma bsten pa'i tshul yang yang dran parnga/ kun bzang gi spyod pa'i smon lam mdzad/ mnal lam du 'jam dpa' gyis bskul te hor yul du lo gsum na 'byon dgos par mkhyen nas gdul bya rnams nyams len la bskul/ tsā rir byon pa'i tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ dben pa bsten na ting 'dzin yon tan 'phel/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la 'gro ba yang / /gzhan gyi rkyen gyis gsa' / dang 'grib pa yod/ /mkha' la rgyu skar rnam par bkra ba yang / /nyi zla'i rkyen gyis gsal dang mi gsal yod/ /rang gzhan don la legs par brtag par gyis/ /zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur cing mkha' 'gro'i ltas du ma gzigs pas sku skye ba phyi ma'i bzhugs gnal su dgos par mkhyen nas skyar du dgon gsar lhun grub steng btab/ phal chen zhing bkod kyi bstan bcos mdzad/ de'i tshe hor rgyal po'i gdan 'dren byung / de yang se chen gyi rgyal sa lo so lnga/ the mur ol ja dus lo bcu gnyis/ ha shan ol ja dus lo lnga/ bu yan du rgyal pos lo bcu gnyis/ ge gan rgyal pos lo brgyad/ ra khyi phag gis zhag bzhi bcu/ gu thug rgyal pos zla ba gcig rnams rgyal sa rim par byas shing 'das/thog the mur 'ja' yan du rgya'/ po sa mo sbrul lo la rgyal sar spron nas lo gsum 938

pa lcags lug la mgon po tshang ching gang la 'ja' sa dang 'bul ba gser gyi tham ka dang bcas pa bskur nas spyan 'dren du slebs pas lug lo zla ba bdun pa la bteg ste dbus su byon/ lha sa gung thang du ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang zhal 'dzoms/ 'dam gzhung gi bar byon pa na rgyal gyi zla ba la 'brug dang thog byung / nyi ma gzaru/ bzung kha ba chen po bab pas rgyal po'i sku tshe la bar chad yong / da rerba/ mi slebs par 'dug gsungs nas mtshur phur phebs slar spre lo zla ba gnyis pa /ma bteg mjal na rgyal po'i sku tshe cung zad sring pa'i rten 'brel mkhyen nas myur bar byon yang zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la sa g.yos sogs bar chod kyi ltas byung / gin jang hur rgyal bu rat+nas rtsa ba'i bla ma zhus kur sde btsugs/ de'i tshe rgyal po 'ja' yan du gnam du gshegs pa mkhyen nas bang chen sogs ma slebs kyang de ma thag sgrib sbyong dang gnas spar mdzad/ da dung rin chen dpal rgyal po yang sku tshe thung bar lung bstan/ spre lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la pho brang du phebs/ rin chen dpal rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis gus 'dud cher byas/ sku tshe thung bar mkhyen nas 'pho ba la sogs par rjes su bzung ste zla gcig nas gnam du song ste sgrib sbyong mdzad/ de'i gcen po tho gan the mur sman tse'i yul bya ba rgya nag chen po na bzhugs pa rgyal sar bsko ba la rtsis pa rnams kyis zla ba drug 'then nas bskos na se chen dang mnyam pa 'ong zer/ chochu/ rje rin po ches kyang lung bstan te de'i ring ol the mur gyis srid bskyangab / bya lo zla ba dang po'i nya la rgyal po spyan 'dren pa'i mi bye ba phrag mang po tshogs te dmag dpung chen po ma gtogs sus kyang lam mi phyed pa la chos rje rin po ches zhwa nag gsol ma ṇi'i dbyangs mdzad cing byon pa na gar byon gyi khrom thams cad lam rang bzhin gyis bye/ smon lam dang gsol ba 'debs/ rgyal po gur dkar chen po na gser khri la bzhugs pas rgyang ring po 939

nos sdun bsus te zhabs la spyi bos gtugs/ yon mchod lhan cig par pho bunge du phebs/ rgyal po rgyal rgyud/ ol thi mur/ tha'i shri sogs rgyal blon thams cad dad pas 'dud cing dam pa'i chos la sbyar/ mi dpon mang pos tha'i shri la ngan brtsams 'khrug pa chen po yong bar byung ba zhal tas bde 'jam la bkod/nyid gong du bzhugs ring rgyal khams bde ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad pa thog tu phebs/ bya lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la pho brang shang mdor rgyal po chen po'i go sar dbang bsgyur te shis brjod mdzad/ chos skyong rnams kyis bar chad srung ba dang byin gyis rlob pa'i ltas dang gzigs snang khyad par can shar/ gong ma'i lung gis drung gi nye gnas grags brtson las ka chen por spar/ rgyal po chen po btsun mo sras dang bcas pa la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe khong rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa gang shar ba mkhyen te lan bstsal bas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ khyi lo zla ba dang po'i tshe thugs rje chen pos bod yul du song zhig sems can la phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsung ba gsan/ rgyal pos kyang khyed chos kyi dbang phyug lags pas bdag la rig 'dzin pad+ma'i tshe chu stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab bas de lta na bsam yas nas 'don dgos gsungs shing chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kurma pa zhes pa'i mtshan dang shel gyi sbel ka gser yig sgor mo rnams 'ja' sar phul/ nyid kyi zhal slob mdo khams su ting 'dzin bzang po/ tshal pa dge sbyong chen po/ sogs la si bhu'i dam ga sogs las ka che ba dang / tsā ri gsar rnying sogs la gser bre la sogs pa'i sku 'khyos kyi yo byad che bar phul/ mtshur phur 'ja' yan du rgyal po'i yin thang 'dzugs rgyu dang / mtshur lung ba dar rgan du phul/ khyi lo zla ba lnga pa'i nya la bteg ste ri bo rtse lngar byon/ 'jam dpal gyi 'phrin las kyi bkod pa gzib/ / mi nyag 'gar byon te lha khang dgon gnas zhig pa rnams bsos/940

chos kyi ring lugs pa du ma bskos/ mi nyag ring mor mi skya phal pa gcig gis thu ba nas gser srang nyis brgya cig car du bton nas phul/ 'khrug pa kun bsdums/ smar khams nas kurma brgyud phag lo zla ba lnga ba'i nyer lnga la 'dam du phebs te dbus gtsang ba thams cad kyis ja 'dren phul/ da dung shar phyogs su 'gro don yong ba'i ltas byung / dgu pa la mtshur phur phebs/ dgun mchims phur zla ba drug bzhugs/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du ma shar/ mkhas btsun mang po la phan par gzigs/ rin po che las bka' bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs shing rab tu gnas pa mdzad pas ngo mtshar du ma byung / sa phyogs 'bar tshe chu brus pa ma thon pa ltar mdzad/ ngo bo rdzu 'phrul gyis bsam yas phu nas tshe chu spyan drangs pa sku 'khor kun gyis ma tshor bar phyag tu bzhes/ gong nas 'bul chen gdan 'dren yang yang byung bas byi ba lo zla ba brgyad pa la byon nas bco lnga la 'dam nas thegs/ lam du 'gro don dpag med mdzad de gong du phebs/ blon po tha'i shri dang mchod yon gsum po kho na yod sar gong ma la tshe dbang dang tshe chu gnang bas hor gyis rgyal sa mnan pa la sku tshe ring ba de byung / shad mdor sems can dpag med kyi srog 'gag pa'i ltas chen po zhig byung ste thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab pas mi dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin zhig gis gong ma dang chos byed kyi skyes bu rnams la gnod pa mi 'byung zhes dbugs 'byin pa gsan/ gyi mi shan du bzhugs tshe sa g.yos byung nyen 'dug pas 'o skol phyir sdod pa yin gsungs nas phyir gzims gur la bzhugs/ gong ma'ang gsung la brten nas gur mdzad/ de'i tshe sa mo glang lo zla ba brgyad pa la sa g.yos chen po byung ste grong thams cad zhig sngon nas rje'i gsung nyan pa dang skyabs zhur 'ongs pa rnams dang dpon slob mchod yon la gnod pa gang yang med/ skabs der rgya dang mdo smad pa'i ban+dhe ngan pa 'ga'i spyod pa la brten nas 941

chos la mi dga' ba'i mi dpon rnams bgros phyogs kun du ban+dhe mi gtsang ba thams cad mi nag tu 'bebs/ khral dmag 'u lag bskul/ de rnams kyi dgon pa bshig par lung bsgrags/ ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa sogs ban+dhe thams cad kyis zhus pas ma grub/ de'i tshe pho brang gi khrims ra chen po 'u mon gdong du thams cad tshogs pa'i sar chos rje rin po che glo bur du phebs/ khrims ra'i mdor khri'u btsugs pa la bzhugs pas tha'i shri sogs mi dpon skya ser thams cad sngar ti shri la gdong phyogs nas yod pa la thams cang chos rje rin po che la kha phyogs te drung du tshogs nas dad pas 'dug pa la gsung seng ge'i nga ro lta bus khyed rgyal blon rnams ti shri la sogs pa'i nged ban+dhe rnams dbang med tu 'dir bkug bstan pa'i bya ba mi byed kyi steng du bstan pa snub lugs 'di 'dra byed pa ci yin/ nged tsho tshe 'di'i sto rgyab ma phyid par khyod tsho la zhur yong snyam mam/ sngar gyi se chen rgyal po la sogs pa'i bya ba nor nas khyed tshos 'chos pa yin nam/ rgyal po'i sku tshe dang rgyal khams spyi'i khag khyod blon po re re tsam gyis theg pa yin na khur/ nged thams cad bod du 'gro ba yin gsungs nas bkyon pas mi chen kun skrag cing 'jigs/ de ma thag lha khang rnying pa rnams gan nas gso ba/ badzhai gtsang mi gtsang gnam mchod thams cad dar gan la 'don pa'i 'ja' sa phyogs thams cad du bsgrags/ ta'i tu dang shing kun tā kur sde btsugs/ 'bri phag gi rin po che la shel gyi sbel ka dang mtshur phu ba la gser tham gnang / gong ma'i gsung gis gzhan bla mchod thams cad la sbyin bdag dang sa cha'i zhal ta zhu rgyu 'dug nyid la de lta bu med pa lags sam zhus pas kho bo la yang shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams bya ba mi khyim 'bum phrag gcig tsam yod gsungs/ 'o na de'i mi dpon la nged kyis gnang sbyin dang las ka chen po byed zhus pas/ de nged rang gis thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab 942

nas chos kyis 'dul ba yin yul khams de mi dpon gyis 'dul mi nus gsungs/spyir chos rje rin po che nyid kyi zhal bzhes la yang sku tshe ring bar yod rgya'i rtsis pas kyang sku tshe ring ba'i rtsis shar/ bod du phebs nas ring du 'gro don mdzad par dgongs na'ang gong ma rgyal blon gyis thegs par yang ma gnang / slar yang ha ching sang zer ba nag po'i blon po zhig gis gnam mchod rnams la rtsod pa byung bas chos rje rin po che'ang thugs chad/ thugs 'byung bas dga' ldan du gshegs par bzhed de stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la rgyal blon kun 'dzoms sar rnal 'byor nga ni nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ gar 'gro mi shes pas rang rang gi chos kyis don sgrub par 'dod pa rnams myur du sgrubs shig gsu ngas pa la bod du 'byon gsung ba tsam las ma go /yos lo zla ba lnga ba'i tshes lnga'i tho rangs mnal ma sad par 'od gsal gyi ngang nas mgur bzhengs pa/ lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa la/ /rnam rtog mtshan ma med pa yin/ /sgom pa gsal stong 'dzin med pa/ /mkha' la bya ltar rgyu ba yin/ /spyod pa spang blang bral ba la/ /blang dang dor ba med pa yin/ /e ma skal ldan skyes bu rnams/ /nyams su blangs na de ltar 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa gsol ja ba shāka yes sogs kyis thos/ de'i mod la 'ur sgra dang 'od dang sa g.yos chen po byung ste nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'gro mgon chos kyi rje mya ngan las 'das so zer ba'i sgra chen po grag 'di ni 'og min gyi lha la sogs pas ma bzod pa'i cho nge yin par khums/ zla ba lnga pa'i bcu bzhi la pho brang chen po ta tu nas bteg ste chu tshan 'jams su phebs tshe chu tshan la sku khrus mdzad de/ chu 'di rnams ni kun la khyab par gyil/ /bla ma'i lus dang 'brel na lus sgrib 'dag /ngag gis ngag dang yid kyica/ yi da sgri ba sbyong / /gsungab/ te rdzing yang yang du bskyil ba'i khrus chu sku 'khor ba kun gyis 'thungaca pas thams cad la nyams rtogs bzang po skyes/ de'i 943

tshe steng gi nam mkha' la sprin nag por 'khrigs shing de'i 'og thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba dang me tog gi char gyis yog pa byung ba la mkhan chen 'dul 'dzin pas ci'i ltas lags zhus pas dge bshes shig la lta ste 'ong gsungs/ nyer gcig gi nyin brag rtsa 'jam du dkon mchog 'byung gnas sogs la bka' bstsal pa/ e ma sngon gyi bsod nams shugs kyis dal 'byor rin chen longs spyod ldan pa thob dus 'dir/ /na rga 'chi dang mi rtag 'gyur ba dran pas sdig pa mi dge spongs/ /rang gzhan phan pa'i sbyin sogs pha rol phyin la brtson na mkhas pa yin/ /'dod yon phra mos brid nas 'khor ba'i mtshor lhung nyam thag gyur par ma byed cig /zhes gsungs/ shang tor phebs kyi bar lam thams cad du 'ja' 'od dang me tog rgyun ma chad/ shang tor phebs nas chos kyi 'phrin las mdzad/tshes brgyad nas cung zad bsnyun par yang bstan/ gong ma dpon blon la nyin bzhin du chos dang zhal ta mdzad/ yos lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin phyed kyi dus rgyal blon kun gyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i tshe 'dul 'dzin pa la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad byon 'dug mchod pa shoms gsungs/ sku'i dbugs sngar bas brel bar mthong nas blon po chen po ba yan tha'i shis ngus te bdag cag rnams la thugs rjes gzigs te mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol zhus pas nga bod du 'gro snyam pa yin te khyed rgyal blon la ma grub/nga'i bka' las kyang 'das gsungs/ slar yang da res sku khams dngas par mdzad du gsol/ bod du spyan 'dren zhus pas da snga 'phar yang song zin/'di tsam du song nas zlog mi nus pas zhing gzhan du 'gro rgyal blon rnams bstan pa dang khrims chos bzhin du skyongs shig gsungs/ ta'i dben go'i shri dkon mchog rin chen gyis zhus pas stag lo zla ba gsum pa la smras pa bzhin mdzod gsungs/ slob ma kun gyis zhus pas chos la brtson par gyis/ bod kyi 944

gdul bya kun la phab/ lo nas byi lo'i bar /la ta byas tshar/ dpon slob myur du 'phrad par bya'o gsungs/ phyag mchod mdzad de bdud rtsi gsol/ bde mchog gi sngags ring gsung bzhin par ṭa ma ru bkrol te/ rnal 'byor nga ni zhing khams gzhan du 'gro khyed rnams dam pa'i chos la brtson par gyis/ gsungs te de nyid du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan/ sang bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba'i tshe gong ma'i pho brang nang ma'i sgo srung ba'i res pa rje ba las res dpon du ran the mur gyis zla ba'i steng du chos rje rin po che mchod rten nang na sku dngos su bzhugs par mthong ste grogs la sbran pas res pa bco brgyad kyis mthong / gnyis kyis ma mthong / res dpon gyis gong ma la zhu ba thengs pas gong ma dpon blon phal cher gyis gzigs/ gong mas de'i yin thang gnyis bzhengs te sku 'dra zla zhal ma zhes sku dngos dang byin rlabs mtshungs par byed/ de dang mtshungs par sngon nyed kyis srog bskyabs pa'i sog po dpon g.yog gsum gyis chu dong 'ja' mor byon pa mthong ste bod du 'gro gsung ba dang / zir 'ur rdor sku 'khor mang po can mdo li la chibs pa hor hu dpon g.yog gis mthong / slob ma zhig na ba'i sar bya btang gi tshul gyis byon pa 'dul ba 'dzin pas kyang gzigs/ rtse lnga'i gar sder slob dpon seng ge la sogs pa bsam gtan pa nyi shus snang ba mthun par mjal te dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs/ de la sogs pa dag pa'i snang ba du ma bstan/ zhag bcu bzhir rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen pos mchod de gor shri dang mi chen thams tsad kyis rkang thang du mdo li spyan drangs te nyer lnga la tsan+dan dang a ga ru nag pos/ sangs rgyas dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi gdung ltar sbyangs/'ja' tshon sna tshogs pas nam mkha' khyab pa'i gseb nas drung gi sku mang du snang ba phal cher gyis mthong / nam mkha' la ā li kā li'i sgra grag nyer drug gi nyin gdung zhal phye ba na nub byang nas ut+pal spungs pa 'dra pa'i sprin 'ja' 945

tshon gyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos rje rin po che bzhugs pa mang pos mthong zhing slar nub phyogs su bzhud par mthong / tshang bug tu bde mchog lhan skyes/smin mtshams su chos 'byung bsnol ma yi ge lnga dang bcas pa/ srin mdzub kyi rkang gi nang du thugs rje chen po sogs ngo mtshar gyi rten mtha' yas pa bzhag ste rgya hor bod mi nyag gi yul thams cad du mchod pa'i zhing gcig pu par gyur to/ /zhal slob ni nyid kyi bla ma kun gyis kyang tshur chos gsan te gus pa tshad med par ca/dzad/ gsang phu ne'u thog gung thang chos 'khor gling / bde skyor zul gsum la sogs pa'i gdan sa ba snga phyi dang slob dpon mtha' dag yo rgyan pa'i sprul sku/ bram ze mgon po/ rmog lcog pa/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi rtsal mnyam pa rtogs ldan grags seng / rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa rtogs ldan bsam rin/ nus pa mthar phyin pa g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ sbas pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin pa rgyal ba ri khrod pa/ phug po che pa/ lha rje rnam gnyis/ chu sgom pa/ kho ye dge slong / khu yor rtogs ldan/ rtogs ldan khrag skyug rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/ ye rgyal ba/ lha bu ba kun yas/ ldong ston gzhon nu 'bum/ spyan snga rdor rin pa/ stag lung kun spangs rin po che/ mkhas grub dharmacho dzā/ bla ma ngar 'byung / mkhen rtsi bar ba/ slob dpon 'jam nyag klog skya bka' bzhi ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mngon pa ba/ sman lung ba/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po mkhas btsun pa sogs mkhas grub dpag med dang / go'i shri kun dga' rgyal po/ ta'i dben go'i shri/ siju dge sbyong chen po/ bla ma ting 'dzin bzang po sogs rgya dbus khams kong gi gdan sa skyong ba mtha' yas shing / rdog brnga ma rin pas thang lha'i gangs rtsar bsgoms pas gtum mo'i drod kyis gangs kyi rtse zhu ste thang lhas bdag gi gnas mi gzhig par zhu zhes gnas gzhan khyad par ba phul zhing rang gzhan gyi rtsa rlung thig le thams cad gzigs pa 946
