dang / rtegs ldan kre bo bya ba mngon shes can gyis dbus gtsang gi mtshams kyi lam phreng du bzhugs nas gtsang na byang sems zla rgyal gyi skye ba rgyal sras thogs med pa sogs bzhugs pa la zhal mjal gyis zhes bskul bar grags pa denadag la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang bar byon zhing mtshur bde chen nas sgom chen brgya dang brgyad sku 'u/sa 'dis cig car mkha' spyod du byon par grags/ khyad par tshal pa'i drung chen smon lam rdo rje rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad de dge ba'i blo gros su mtshan gsol/ sngon nas rje 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung ste lung rtoṭa kyi rtsal rdzogs/ rab byung mdzad ma thag nas dge bshes chen po rnams 'bel gtam gyis zil gyis non/ sku 'khor ba rnams kyis rab byung mdzad ma thag nas 'di lta bu'i mkhyen pa ngo mtshar che zhus pas 'di 'dra sngon nas shes pa yin gsungs/ 'o na sngon 'bel gtam gtan mi mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtags kyi che ba yin/ nged rang mi nag pas dge 'dun la chos skad byas na dkon mchog la brnyas par 'gro ba yin/ da rtags dang bslab pa mtshungs pa yin pas byas chog pa yin gsungs / de lta bu'i si dhu thams cad mkhyen pa des hor yul du phyi ma bzhugs dus phul ba'i zhu yig dngos mthong ba na/ 'di nas thegs kur zla ba re re'i tshes gcig byung ngo cog gi tho rengs 'od gsal gyi ngang du byon nas bdag la dbang bskur gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes pa de lo gnyis zla ba gnyis gsum gyi bar du zhal bzhes ji lta bar yid shin tu 'ches par byung / de phyin zla ba re gnyis gnang ma byung ba bar du mos gus kyi rtsol ba chung pa'am thugs rtse ma gtad pa'am ji ltar lags/ zhes snang ste de lta bu'i dpon slob yod par snang / gzhan yang dwags kong gtsang dbus mdo khams sogs yul gru mtha' yas pa'i ri khrod dben pa dag na 'dir rje rang byung pas lo gsum dang bcu gnyis sogs bzhugs ther ba yul gru re re na mtha' 947

yas par snang bas thun mong gi sku tshe'i mthong ba dang shin tu mi mtshungs pas sku'i bkod pa kho na mtha' yas pa zhig bstan par snang la/ sgrub rgyud kyi slob ma la bltas na khrid kho na bskyangs pa 'dra ba/ mkhas pa thon pa la bltas na bshad pa kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba/ sgrub gnas tsho la bltas na sgrub pa kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba/ bstan bcos tsho la bltas na thugs rtsom kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba blos gzhal bar mi nus pa zhig kho na snang ngo/ /de la rje rang byung rdo rjes bstan pa gtod par dgongs pa ni rtogs ldan chen po grags seng ba yin yang bde chen gyi gdan sar bskos pa ma mdzad pa dang / yang kum po gnam nang du 'byon par bkas bskul nas byon pa na lam du gzims drel dkar mo mtshur mda'i ri la 'dzegs pa ma bzlog nas ri steng gi spang thang spro ba'i chu mig rtsar nyal 'dug pas der thugs phebs nas thog mar tsha ba mdzad/ de nas gdan phab ste rten 'brel gyis gnas nang du btags nas mtshur gnas nang kho nar bzhugs pa shar bas sku skye ba phyi ma dang mjal ma thub/ des na zung 'jug ma'i rgyud rim la bzhugs pa ni rgyal ba g.yung yin ste ru lag gi tshong 'dus 'gur mor sngags rnying ma'i nus ldan bar ma chad pa'i sras su shing spre la 'khrungs mtshan rdo rje 'bum/gzhon nu nas sgra tshad bzo gso mdo sngags mang du sbyangs te mkhyen pa zla med par grags/ zur byams pa seng ge la mdo sgyu sems gsum mtha' dag gsan/shangs pa shāka 'bum la gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor ma lus pa gsan te 'khrul 'khor dang las chen thams cad la mnga' brnyes/ mdos chog kho na'i mkhyen pa yang bgrang las 'das/ gsar rnying gi sngags pa la yon tan che bar hor yul tshun chad du grags/ rgyal pos sku rim du spyan drangs/ ha shan rgyal po dang /ti sri grags 'od pas 'di lta bu'i sngags pa ni ban+dhe bon po zim shing sogs thams cad la mkho bas ris med du bkur zhig zhes bdag rkyen mdzad/ rgyal po'i 948

sku rim du srid pa'i spyi mdos chen mo sngags pa lnga brgya tsam gyis zla ba gsum du bsags zla gcig tu bsgrubs nas btang bas cho 'phrul dang ngo mtshar mang du byung / sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu ma'i rtsed mo du ma gzigs pas chos thams cadz+wasgyu ma lta bur shes/ chos kho na la thugs gzhol yang rgyal pos ma gnang / rgyal po gshegs nas bod du byon/ phyag rdzas thams cad ngo shes grogs po sogs su la yang ma gnang bar yum khrid de sa skya khro phu zha lu gsang phu sogs dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad du 'gyed dang 'bul ba mdzad/ yum rang bsngo ba zhur bcugagadung rgyud chad mi nyan pa'i yum gyi bka' ma bzlog par jo mo zhig bzhes pa la sras gcig byung ma thag 'di la yum gyi sems kyi gtad so gyis shig gsungs te de ma thag rab byung mdzad/ mtshan rdo rje dpal du spos/ rje rang byung pa las gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gsan te thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs/phung po ri bo che mon spa gro sogs su sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad pas mchog gi grub par brnyes/ rtsig pa la rdo sbyor gyi zhal ba byas pas brag tu gyur pa sogs rten 'brel mang du mdzad/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa kun la dri yig bskur ba la sus kyang lan ma byung ba la lan mdzad pa dang / mdo sngags kyi sangs rgyas kyi khyad par bstan pa'i bstan bcos 'dis mdzad pa gzigs pas g.yag sde paṇa chen shin tu gus pas slob mar gyur/ gtso bor sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad de gya gnyis pa shing sbrul la nam mkha/2 thams cad 'ja' 'od dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pas gang bablo ltas zla sbrel du snang ba dang bcas te mya ngan las 'das/ rnam thar nyid kyis mdzad pa/slob mas brtsams pa'i rnam thar phal cher ni/ /bstod sgra ches pas bla ma zog por btang / /zhes sogs pa dang / rang myong rang rgyus che bas cung zad 'bri//zhes gsungs pa rgyas bsdus gnyis yod pas zhib par der lta zhing bka' rgyud 949

gser phreng du yang de nges par ba/zhug go de la rje rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ sngon pho brang shang tor sku'i bkod pa bsdus shing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas 'dzam gling la gzigs te skad ci ga gis dga' ldan du lha'i drang srong legs skyes su gyur pa la bcom ldan 'das byams pas bskul te shel gyi skas las gser gyi sa gzhir gshegs pa'i snang ba bstan la/ bde ba can /la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' dag nas kyang zhing 'dir ba/shegs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis yum gyi lhums sbyangs te sum pa'i yul lho 'u/nga chen bco brgyad dang mi ring ba rdod a la rong du ku cor gyi gdung las yab bsod nams don grub dang yum brtson 'grus rgyan las 'brug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams te de ma thag tsog pur bzhugs te ma ṇi dang dbyangs ba/sal gsung ba na yab the tshom du gyur tshe yum gyis nga la nyi bla /bong du chud pa dang phrag gong na nyi zlas brgyan pa sogs rmi lam dang dngos kyi ngo mtshar mang bas the tshom mi dgos so gsungs/ lte ba bcad pa'i tshe dri bzang po byung ste yul khams khyab/ sngon chos rje rin po che 'da' kur slob dpon chen po gu ri gung pas zhing gang du 'byon pa der bdag gsol ba 'debs pas bka' bstsal du gsol zhes zhus pa na kho bo shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams su 'ong bas der shog gsungs pa bzhin dgung 'o/ gsum pa la kong lung ral gsum gyi ya gyal nyang por phebab/ ma thag yuca/ la nga kurma pak+ki yin 'dzam gling du gdul bya ca/nga du yod pas 'ongs pa yin ltos shig 'chi med 'khrul 'khor bya'o gsungs nas mdzad/ ngas khyod kyi khong du'ang 'di ltar byas pas khyod 'phar ba dang hub phor bo ba sogs byung ba yin/ zho kha brag phyi nags phu rnams su phyin nas lta dgos/ gshin rje dong kha'i 'og na dmyal ba'i zangs kha yod pa nas sems can dpag med 'dren pa yin/ 'di rnams da dung po la yang ma bshad cig gsungs/ khyed garma pak+ki yin na rang byung rdo rje min nam zhes zhus pas de gnyis gcig nga'i zhal mthong ba la yang ngan song med da 950

dung rgyal po'i pho brang gi bar du 'gro/ gdul bya mtha' yas pa 'dul du yod gsungs/ yum spyan bsnyung ba na mig zhar dogs med khyod ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gcig yin/ sang da tsam nas khyod la phyag 'tshwal ba mang po yong gsungs/ nyang long la sogs pa'i yul de rnams su sngar rje gong ma'i yon bdag rnams kyis 'bul ba ji ltar byas pa dang khang pa'i bkod pa bsgyur ba sogs gsal bar gsungs pas the tshom gyi dra ba bsal/ dwags lha sgam por bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad zhal gzigs/ nags phur byon pas dus mchod dang 'dzoms pas khong rnams nga'i mchod pa byed zer nas nga la ci yang mi ster bar 'dug gsungs/ khong rnams na re khyod /rma pa yin na bla ma kun dga' byams pa phar bzhugs 'dir nam 'byon zer bas/ de 'byon rgyu 'dug pa ma mthong rus thum zhig byung 'dug gsungs pas ma dad de khyod garma pa la 'dis mi gnod kyi zer nas dom gyi khar 'phangs pas dom des zhabs la lces bldags te bskor ba byas/ nags phu'i gdan sa pa bla ma kun dga' byams pa hor yul du gong ma'i ti shri mdzad de gshegs pa dang dus mtshungs par snang /brag phyi lha khang du byon nas bya rgya'i steng du gshegs bzhud mdzad/ 'gro mgon la sngon gyi dbu zhwa khyer shog gsungs nas dbu la bsnabs nas dus gsum mkhyen pa yang nga yin/ kurma pak+ki yang nga yin/ rgya dang hor sog btul ba yang nga yi na/ da dung 'dul 'phro yod/ sprin gyi steng nas lta ba yang nga yin/ nga'i bla ma stong pa nyid yin/ khyed rnams kyi bla ma nga yin/ nga'i sprul pa gcig blo gros rin chen gyi drung na yo da/ gcig shar phyogs mngon dga' na yod/ 'dzam gling 'dir nga rang yong ba yin/ mi rnams da lta nga la the tshom byed de myur du sol 'gro/ khyed dge bshes rnams kyang za 'dod che rtsod ma byed par sgrub pa la brtson par gyis gaju/ngas/ rnam thar zhus pas bar do'i rnam thar nyung shas shig gsu ngas/ yang tshogs gral zhig tu/ nga lo bzhi lon nas pad+ma dkar po sa khar 951

skyes/ /lo lnga lon nas 'gro la chos bshad byas/ /lo bdun lon nas 'gro ba'i gdul bya bskyangs/ /rin chen nga yis bshad pa yin/ /nga dang mjal la ngan song med/ /ces gsungs/ gcig gis drung gi zhal yang yang mthong ba dka(3 zhes bskyar gyin bltas pas/ stos shig ltos shig nga la stos/ /da res mthong ba don ldan yin/ /dmus long rnams kyi dpal du shar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nub nas dar/ /gsung yi ge drug ma'i nyi ma shar/ /zhes gsungs/ srod la 'dre me kem kem mang du snang ba na sngon gyi mi ma yin 'dul 'phro yin gsungs nas drag sngags dang se gol mdzad pas zhi/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal bas mjal te tshogs gral du me bus pas tshad pa tsha nas gsil yab kyis g.yabs pas rgya yul gyi dbyar sos kyi tshad pa dang 'dra bar gsil yab g.yabs kyang tsha 'ub 'ub byed gsungs/ khong gis dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhir bzhugs par zhal bzhes yod pa la lnga bcu rtsa drug las mi bzhugs pa ci lags zhus pas/ sdig spyod grangs mang bas skyo ba skyes pa yin gsungs/ rtogs ldan grags seng bas dga' ldan du gshegs par gzigs 'dug pa dang zla ba'i steng na bzhugs par mang pos mthong 'dug pa de ltar lags sam zhus pas/ de yang yin/ de dus hor rnams 'di ltar byed kyi 'dug gsung pus btsugs zla ba ston pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ lar dga' ldan thag ring po na med/ zla ba'i steng na 'dug pa dang seng ge dang glang po'i steng na 'dug pa sogs de thams cad nga yin gsungs/yang co 'dri zhus te/ dga' ldan na chang yod dam zhus pas/ myos byed 'di med/ lha'i bdud rtsi yod gsungs/ bdud rtsi nag po bzang zer ba bden nam zhus pas/ bdud rtsi nag po ma mthong dkar po 'o ma 'dra ba la ro brgya dang ldan pa yin gsungs/ tshal gung thang gi dar gdugs lta bu mang mchi zhus pas/bla ma pa mi yul gyi 'dod yon kun g.yas chung / dga' ldan gyi me tog re yang lkob phreng du mi shong ba yod gsungs/ yar gtsang lta bu'i chu chen po med mchi 952

rtam nyog gi mkhar khang 'dra ba yang med dam zhus pas/ dga' ldan na chu thams cad bdud rtsi yin/ mkhar khang thams cad rin po che 'ba' zhig las sa rdo phal pa med gsungs/ rtam nyog gi rta rag pa 'dra ba mchis sam zhus pas /chos la dus tshod med na ban rgan 'chal ba yin/ de tsam la mdzod gsungs/slob dpon chen pos sngon gyi gsol ja ba shāka seng mngags te khong gis nye gnas byas/ mi ring bar slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa phebs te mchog gi sprul ra pa'i skur nges shes thun mong ma yin pa 'drongs te seng ge'i khri chen po la spyan drangs/ sngon rje gong mas rnam thos tshal du chos khri'i rgyab tu shug pa skam po cig btsugs te 'di chos khri dang mnyam pa'i tshe kho bo 'dir 'ong zhes gsung ba dang /zho kha'i thang du 'dir lha khang zhig 'ong bar 'dug de'i rab gnas la sleb pa yin gsung ba dang / snye bor shing sdong yal ga mtho dman shin tu che ba zhig la sku rgyab bstan te chos gsungs nas yal ga 'di gnyis mtho dman mnyam pa'i tshe kho bo 'dir 'ong gsung ba rnams ji lta bar thog tu phebs te so sor sngon 'di skad byas pa yin zhes gzhan gyis ma zhus par gsungs/ dgon gsar lhun grub steng du phebs te kun bzang gi zhing gzigs thugs dam khyad par can mngon du gyur cing ring du bzhugs/ dgung lo bdun pa la na ro chos drug gi khrid gnang bas ras pa so dkar can bya ba'i rtog pa la khrid gsung ba mkhyen par 'dug ste gegs sel mi mkhyen nam snyam pa'i mod la tshogs gral du gegs sel gnad kyi lde mig rdo rje'i mgur mdzad/ tsā rir dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas/ snyan grags kyis sa chen po khyab ste dgung lo dgu pa sa byi la tshal pas ja 'dren phul ba nas bzung mdo dbus kyi mi chen thams cad kyis ja zhus 'bul ba phul/dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i tshe rtogs ldan grags seng ba gshegs pa mkhyen/ stag lo la mtshur phu nang pas gdan 'dren la byon te bcu gsum pa chu 'brug la 953

dwags po dang 'ol kha brgyud dbus su byon yar klungs su mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug ta si byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bkur bsti gus 'dud cher byas/ 'di ta sis dbus gtsang gi bdag po byas nas lo bzhi pa'i sgang yin/ tshal du si dhu thams cad mkhyen pa dang dpon slob mjal sngon gyi gsung gleng mtha' dag mdzad cing da ni rgan po shi yang sems kyi lhag ma med ces thugs tshim/ mtshur phur rgyal ba g.yung gis mjal du byon te sngon gnas bka' bstsal bas thugs tshim zhing brgyud pa rin po che'i dbang gdams ngag thams cad gsan/ sngon dgung lo bdun pa 'a/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba la na ro'i chos drug dang sbyor drug la sogs gsan pa nas bzung / rtogs ldan ye rgyal ba la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdza shongs pa shes rab dpal la bka' bstan 'gyur gyi lung / slob dpon blo gros seng ge las byams chos gsan pa sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams tshul bzhin du bsten zhing gsan bsam sgom pa khor yug tu mdzad/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen don grub dpal dang / slob dpon bsod nams 'bum las rab byung dang dge tshul mdzad/ dpal chos kyi grags par mtshan gsol/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba mtha' dag gsan/ bsam yas kyi bla ma mkhas grub pas sngon gyi bka' shog sogs phul nas mthar dri ba'i yi ge zhig phul bas re zhig cang mi gsung nan gyis zhus pas 'di'i dri lan sngon lha sa rkyang thang du btab zin pa yin mod gsungs pas spyan chab lhug par phyung ste zhabs la yang yang du gtugs/ gnas nang bde chen mtshur phu sogs su dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas shing nyid ye shes kyi mgon por bzhengs pa'i gri gug gis 'byung po ma rungs pa thams cad tshar bcad/ gzims chung chung ngu zhig tu sku 'khor mang po yangs par 'khod pa'i snang ba bstan te/ re gos sum brtsegs gyon pa dang / dar gos sum brtsegs gyon pa gnyis/ khyad par med pa'i gdeng zhig dgos/ /sogs kyi 954

mgur bzhengs te/ yangs dog med pa'i gnas su blangs/ zhes gsungs/dgu/nga lo bco brgyad pa bya lo la dpal ldan bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang mja/ / phyag rtse sprod du mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi chos 'brem yang gsan/ skyor mo lung pa la 'bri nang gis dmag rdeg par byung nas kyi shod kyi lha sde thams cad kyis spyi zhus byas te lha sa rkyang thang du spyan drangs/ mi chen thams cad zi'/ gyis ma nan te dmag rang sar zhi/ kun gyis spyi bor khur/snye thang rgya grong du gong ma'i sku rim chen mo la bsang zul bde gsum sogs tshogs pa khri phrag mang po'i dbu la khri gsum bsham sa pa'i dbus ma la rje nyid dang g.yas su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ g.yon du bzhi thog pa bzhugs/ khrom thams cad kyang dad pa'i 'ur langs te gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'ur ding du song /ngam shod dang gtsang gi byang rgyab la 'gro don la lan re byon/ dpon chen rgyal bzang la sogs pa'i chen po thams cad dbang du 'dus/ mtshur phur gzhal yas khang bsos/ rgyal bu rat+nas gsan nas 'bul chen byung / gong du gsan yang sgro 'dogs ma chod pa la ding chu lang chung dbus nas gong du sleb dus dris pa la/ tshal pa si dhu chos rje gong ma'i slob ma dngos shes rab che dam tshig gtsang ba na re chos rje gong ma yin ngas su 'dug zer/ rtog dpyod can gzhan thams cad kyang rtsod med du ngo mtshar gleng gi 'dug byas pas gong ma phyag thal mo sbyar nas spyan chab byung / des mdun gyi mi chen thams cad kyang de ltar gyur te hor rgyal pos bla ma'i mtshan gsan pas spyan chab byung ba 'di las med skad/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa me bya la sngar gyi mkhan slob dang mkhas pa gzhon nu dpal gyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad sha chang gi dri bro ba tsam yang sku'i nye lam dang gzigs sar mi 'grim/ sku 'khor rnams la sha chang gi ston mo mi byed pa sogs theg chen so thar gyi bcas pa dang thun mong gi 'dul ba'i bcas 955

pa shin tu phra ba yan chad la nan tan du mdzad cing sku 'khor yang dge slong dag pa tshul ldan mang thos kyi bsam gtan pa rig grol gyi spobs pa can 'ba' zhig tshogs/ dag ba'i gzigs pa shar ba ni spyir bgrang gis mi lang mod kyang rags pa tsam yang yi ges 'jigs pas zhal gzigs dang bstod pa mdzad tshul rnams rnam thar rab gsal me long nyid du blta/ khyad par mnal lam la mnga' brnyes te phyag dpe gzigs bzhed pa'i po ti du ma zhal phye ste sku 'khris kyi phyogs so sor bkram/ mnal lam du sku'i bkod pa mdzad de gzigs pas mnal las bzhengs pa na thams cad thugs su chud de 'ong / dang por phyogs bcu re rer lus kyi bkod pa bcu bcu bkye/ des sangs rgyas tha dad pa bcu re la chos mi 'dra ba bcu re nyan pa la sbyangs pas dang por ni dka' ba ltar byung / 'bad rtsol skyed pas myur du 'byongs te da lta ni phyogs bcu re rer yang lus kyi bkod pa grangs med 'gyed cing sangs rgyas grangs med mchod/ chos grangs med 'dzin pa la dka' ba med de mdor na nga'i rmi lam sprul bsgyur dang sgyu ma mkhan shin tu byang pos sgyu ma ston pa la khyad med pa yin gsungs/ khyad par mnal lam gyi bkod pas ngan song mtha' yas pa drangs te spyan ras gzigs kyi za ma tog bkod pa las gsungs pa'i rnam par thar ba grub/ sku khams cung zad bsnyun pa na sangs rgyas sman gyi blas shel bum nas bdud rtsis sku khrus gsol bar gzigs ma thag dwangs/ o rgyan du rdo rje rnal 'byor mas sems skye med kyi ngang la zhog skabs su skyed rim bzlas brjod gyis/ tshogs dang gtor ma la brtson na zhag brgyad kyis 'grub/ /ces gsung ba gsan/ dam pa rgya gar dang mjal te gdams pa cung zad gsan pas zhi byed kyi chos thams cad skad cig gis thugs sa 'chud/ shar phyogs kyi zhing dpal gyi sing po rab ta rgyas pas brgyan pa na ri gi //// ri byisangs rgyas dpal dam pa'i snying gi mun pa sel ba rin chen 'od kyi gtsug ces nga 956

bya ba theb chen 'ba' zhig gsung ba sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam bklas pa gzigs/ dga' ldan du byon pas byams pa'i zhal nas 'dzam gling nas 'dir yong ba'i tshe pad+ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs pas rin po chezhi pad+ma gzhan pas kha dog bzang zhing che ba zhig la 'dir skye bar bya'o zhes bdag gir mdzad/ rigs lnga'i zhing dang sku re res chos dbyings ji snyed pa khyab par rnam par 'phrul zhing de thams cad sku'i rtsa sbubs ji snyed pa thams cad du sdud cing sku dang zhing gnyi ga sngar las che chung du ma gyur pa sogs kun bzang gi rnam par thar pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad/ bla ma dar rgyal ba la khyed la da ltar gyi snang ba 'di cir snang gsung dran pas nam zin na sgyu ma rmi lam lha sku sogs gang bsgoms su wal tsam re snang / ma zin dus rdos bcas rang rgyud par snang zhus pas/ kho bo ra thams cad chu zla ltar gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang nas dag pa'i 'khor lo 'ba' zhig tu yod/ 'ga' zhig kho bo sa gcig tu bsdad na legs bsam pa 'dug ste kho bo rgyal khams thams cad du 'gro dgos pa yin/ kho bo mthong ba dang thos pa thams cad dga' ldan nam bde ba can du 'dren pa la the tshom med pa yin gsungs/ bde chen du slob dpon chen po la rgya hor gyi rgyal khams dang pho brang chen po tas tu'i bkod pa zhib mor gsungs nas ma brjed par gyis phyis mthong ste 'ong gsungs/ mtsho mo ru khyung sogs byang rgyud mtha' dag tu gzhan don mdzad/gong nas kyi gdan 'dren gyi 'ja' sa snyan ngag chen po'i 'bul chen dang bcas pa bskur nas ding chu dben dpon dang gar sde'i mi dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan sogs mngags pa bya lo la drung du slebs/ bya lo'i ston yar klungs ta sis rdzong ba'i 'bul chen phul/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa sa khyi zla ba dang po dang gnyis pa'i ma'oms su lha sa gung thang du spyan drangs/ tshal pa dang 'bri khung bas zhabs 357

tog cher byas/ slar mtshur phu nas sbrid la la brgyud/ kong dgon sngags dgon gad skya lho lung mo che rnams su byon/ chos rje gong ma bas kyang non che thugs zhib 'phrin las che bar byung / mtshur shar gyi nad paru/ lam gyi gros dang sku rim zhu bar byas pa mkhyen nas khyed rang tsho gros mang mi dgos nga'i rjes su shog gsungs/ cog rtse la gong du char ches pas nag chu la mi thar zer ba na chu chung du 'gro gsung ste ba/nga nyin chu chung dus ltar gyur/ gzhi bdag gis chos yon du chu bsgyur ba yin gsungs/ sha pho nas gser yig pas thu lag chibs pa zhus pas sems can la gnod 'tshe mi byed/ khyed rang rnams kyang 'u lag ma zhon gsungs/ khal gzhon za ma thams cad nang nas gnang / za ma 'u lag ma dgos pas 'ja' mo ba thams cad dga'/ rgya tsho ya gsum dmag 'jams sogs 'jam che chung thams cad du bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba mtha' yas/ ngo skog gang du'ang sgar du sha mi 'grim pa'i bca' ba dam pas dud 'gro dpag med kyi srog thar zhing snyan pa mtha' yas/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la sog zam khar phebs pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la 'dan klong thang du phebs pa'i bar du/ ga re sgom sde ras tshang ba chab la kha/ garma/ zi dgon sogs su 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ kurmar tshogs pa khri tsho la chos gsung tshe gser yig pas nam mkhar nyi zla'i bar na shel gyi mchod rten na drung bzhugs par ring zhig mthong / 'di skabs shig tu rgya gar gyi dzo gi lnga 'ongs te nged rnams rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro/ 'di byang chub kyi shing la 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis phyag brkos mdzad pa yin pas re zhig phyag tu 'chol/ nged rang lnga ga ma 'dzom gyi bar su la yang mi gtong ba zhu zer nas jo bo gadzhai la phul/ de rnams chos skyong gi sprul par grags te phyis gar song ma rnyed/ de nas bzung ste mchod yul gyi gtso bor mdzad nas nyin re zhing mchod pa thun res kyis rje ba dang nyin mtshan du thun 9 58

bzhir phyag dang bskor ba mdzad/ des sku 'khor thams cad kyang yid bskul te dge ba la rtse gcig par gyur/ byang lam la 'byon par zhus kyang 'di 'gro don che gsungs nas kre la byon/ de thams cad du 'phrin las chos rje gong ma las kyang che/ khyi lo bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la rma chu gling khug tu phebs par nye ba na rang re rta kha bag tsam thal 'dug lho pha gi na 'bob gangs dkar yod pa la sgom zhing sdod rgyur 'dug ste da shing kun bar du 'gro ba las 'os med gsungs/ 'di'i dus hor yul du ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan gshegs/ sog po'i mi dpon ngo log pho brang shang to bsregs pa mkhyen par 'dug phag lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes drug la bya khar phebs/ rgyal bu saṅgha shrīs bsus te ga chu dang la bar rgyal bu'i lha khang dang nye bar bzhugs/ de rnams su cha ga ba'i gnod pas nyi ma 'grib pa byung ba zhus/ bka' shog gnang ba bsgrags pas gar song cha med du song / rgyal rgyud dang mi dpon thams cad dang pradzha dbang dam phab 'dug pa bde bar btang / dbang hu rnams btson las bkrol/ zla ba drug tsam bzhugs/ dharma cing dbang dang ding ju phing chang dmag bsags 'thab dus btab nas rtsod par 'dug pa zhal tas 'khrug pa bcag gong ma yab sras kyi spyan 'dren drag par slebs/ de rnams su chos khri'i rtsa bar sngon sus kyang ma mthong ba'i me tog rtsa ba gcig la yal ga brgya/ yal ga re re la me tog brgya re/ me tog re re la lte ba dmar po 'dab ma ser po stong re yod pa zhig skyes te thams cad kyis me tog gi gzugs par du btab nas phyogs kun du khyer te ngo mtshar du byas/ khrims dmag gis rim pas pho brang du spyan drongs gsung ba'i lung 'dug kyang 'ja' mo ma tshugs kyi bar la 'then gsungs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la sa'i char bab ltas ngan pa byung bas dus ngan pa shar/ gtam ngan chen po zhig myur du 'ong gsungs/ de'i nyin ti shri'i gdung sa skyar spyan 'dren pa dang dbus 959

gtsang du chos 'khor sgrub pa'i yo byad gnangs chen rnams yar yong ba ngo 'o/ga yingo/ bcom par 'dug lnga pa'i bcu gnyis la sa skya'i dpon chen dpal 'bum gyi zhu ba ti shri'i gdung chos 'khor 'byon gyi yod pas mdzo 'chi med lnga bcu zhu zer ba slebs pas mi nyung sar bzhad nas/ mi rdzun ma 'di tsho mtshar/ gdung chos 'khor byung na de dga' ste bcom pa'i lhag ma dwa phrug 'ga' zhig zhag lnga na sleb 'ong gsungs te de kho na ltar byung / klu chu phan chad du ma byon pas de rnams lo nyes/ gar byon gyi sa thams cad lo legs/ de nas gser yig pa rnams ga chur ldog ste sbyor drug pa chen po tsha go shes rab dpal zer ba'i 'phrin las can des spyan drangs te lho phyogs yar lam khugs/ rta bab lam/ gnyan tshe de gong / bshal/ tsha grang / lcags mo brgyud de phebs/ gong du sgor mo 'dab mi btang / rgyal mo rong la byon/ tshugs zhe bdun gyis rab sgang du phebs/ dbra 'dru/ sgo lding 'khrug pa'i dmag sog mtha' yas pa 'dug pa rnams zhi bar mdzad de yig khrims nyis brgyar nye ba mdzad/ zla ba dgu pa nas byi lo zla ba gnyis pa'i bar 'gor/ 'khrug sdums la gser srang nyis stong rta bdun brgya/ ja sig chen lnga brgya sogs gnang / rab stod du seng ge sgang btab/ yon btsun bkras rin mtshur phu'i bya mdabs lha khang gso ba la 'di dus brdzangs/ gser yig pa rnams la spyan ma 'drongs pa'i rtsa ra yong bar byung ba sgor mo 'dab mis zhus pas khrol/ nged la dgongs nas mdo smad du phebs 'dug kyang mi dpon rnams go ma chod pas slar bod la byon 'dug byang chub kyi seXs bde chen gyi smon lam rdzogs par byed pa dang / nged la dgongs nas mgyogs por 'byon pa zhu byas nas gdan 'dren la shes rab btang ba yin zhes pa'i lung dang huri shri shes rab sogs mi chen mang du 'ongs pa mi sde la mi gnod pa'i phyir 'jam dbyangs go'i shris khyer ba'i spyan 'dren slebs te byi 'o/ bdun 960

pa'i bco brgyad la rab sgang nas gong du thegs/ shing kun bde chen du mkhan po dpal ldan mchog sogs dge 'dun 'bum tsho smin grol du mdzad/ rje sa paṇa gyi bzhugs gnas sprul pa'i sder phebs/ 'di phyin nas skad ris cha lugs mi gcig pa'i rgyal khams tha dad pa'i skye bo bgrang gis mi lang ba 'dus te bzhugs khri'i g.yas su hor dang yu gur gyi lo tsā ba g.yon du mi nyag dang rgya nag gi lo tsā ba bzhag ste gsung byon pa chos gsungs pa rnams so so'i lo tsā bas rang rang gi skad du brda sprod cing skal ldan mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad/ rgya'i ngo log gi mi dpon che ba zhig srog bskyabs te rab byung byas/ mi sde thams cad bde bar thar/ bcu gnyis pa'i bcu dgu la pho brang chen por phebs/ mchod rten sngon por bzhugs/ nyer gsum la mchod yon mjal/ 'di dus gong ma tho gan the mur rgyal sar bzhugs pa'i lo nyer brgyad pa yin/ nyer drug la rgyal bu'i sras mi rta pa la 'khrungs/ gong ma yab sras gus pa mtha' yas/ gan che chung so so nas 'bul zhabs bkur bsti gzhal gyis gar lang / gnam mchod thamab/ cad kyis gtsug tu zla med par bkur/ nyes pa can spyir thar ba'i 'ja' sa dang /khyad par rgyal bu chen pos ban+dhes gong ma la phyag mi dgos par bkur ba la phyis rgyal rgyud dang mi chen gyis ban+dhe'i phyag blangs 'dug rgyal khams mi bde ba des lan/ da phyis de 'dra ma byed zer ba sogs bstan pa shed skyed kyi 'ja' sa rnams gnang / bod du sgrog pa la sde dgon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang chos rje pa nyid kyi dpon mgo gsum rnams btang / thugs byams pa chen po'i byin gyis phyi nang gi ngo log thams cad zhi/ nad yams dpag med yod pa thams cad chad/ sngon ma byung ba'i lo legs btud mar byung bas rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos la yid 'ches shing gus pa 'phel bar gyur/ chornga/ rje nyid kyi bka' drin las 'bri gdan tshal pa mtshur kur sogs la las ka rnying gso 961

gsar gnang mang du byung / rgyal khams bde ba la bkod do/ /rgyal po chen po dam pa'i chos kyi dgongs pa bzhed pa bzhin grub/ rgyal bu chen po ni mkhyen pa dang rtogs pa zla med par gyur te bstan bcos mkhas pa dgyes nu ru pa du ma mdzad/ de nas slob dpon chen po la bka' bstsal ba/ gong ma'i chab srid dang sku tshe la'ang 'gyur ldog cung zad kyi mtshan ma snang / shar phyogs 'di'i 'dul 'os kyang thul/ nub phyogs na gdul bya mang du yod pas 'degs pa'i zhu ba byed dgos gsung zhing zhu ba yang yang du mdzad pas gong ma yab sras kyis nan gyis bzhugs par zhus/ la'o jang ching sang dang zhi ra mo ching sang bya ba'i mi chen gnyis kyis drung du pus mo btsugs te bla ma chen po la zhu na/ sngar sman tse 'di'i 'dab sgo lo dgu chad/ lo nyes/ phyi nang gi ngo log mang / dngul bre re la 'bru 'jag lnga ma las med pa'i mu ge byung / bla ma khyed phebs pas nad yams thams cad chad/ ngo log thams cad rang sar zhi/ phyogs kyi 'dab sgo thams cad dus gcig tu 'dus/ lo legs/ dngul bre re la 'bru 'jag lnga bcu mar 'phel/ da lta ni 'bru 'jag brgyad bcu mar song 'dug rgyal bu chen po'i sras 'khrungs/ rgyal khams kyi mi thams cad kyang 'bru 'phel zhing bkra shis pa'i bla ma zhes mtshan gcig nas 'don/ gong ma yab sras spyan chab bton nas bzhugs pa'i zhu ba byed cing 'dug 'di lta bu'i dus su bod dam der byon nas ci mdzad/ sngar bla ma 'phags pa dang se chen rgyal po'i mchod yon bzhin du rgyal khams kyi bya ba khyed rang mchod yon gyis dbyer med du mdzod zhus pas/zhal nas khrom thog chod pa la rtsed mo 'phro bshol na ngo mtshar che ba yin/ nged la gong ma yab sras kyi sku rim du dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa ma gtoṭa rgyal khams kyi bya ba la kha gtogs pa'i lung ling ji'i dgos ched shes sgo ci yang med/ ban+dhe bya ba gar bder 'gro bstan pa dang sems can la gang phan byed 962

dgos pa yin/— gang la'ang ma chags ma zhen pa zhig byung na chos pa bzang bayin/ zhes sogs gsungs pas mi chen de gnyis mchi ma lhug par 'byin zhing gsung de yu gur gyi yi ger btab nas mos gus kyi rten du bzung skad/ tshe rabs thams cad tu bla ma'i gnas rnams kyi ngag ma bcag pa bskal pa rgya mtshor goms pa'i bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi gsung ni bem pos kyang mi zlog na sems dang bcas pas lta ci smos pa ni chos nyid yin pas re zhig byon chog pa'i lung dang 'bul zhabs rgya cher mdzad de stag lo zla ba dang po'i bcu bzhi la btegadung tshang du bla chen bsod blo dang zhal 'dzoms/ nag can mang po chad pa las bskyabs/ lam du ho ya zi'i rgyal khams kyi 'khrug chen bcag lu ban shan du rgyal bu rat+na btsun ma pusbyo dha ri dang bcas pa smin par mdzad/ mi nyag gi yul tha thal la brgyud de byang ngos su phebs/ go ra dgon mo cher gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs shing bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshe ston pa'i sku'i bkod pa gzigs te rang gzhan gyi ston pa'i khyad par gsal bar byed pa'i bstod pa mdzad/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ral gri dang bdar stsol ba gzigs pas rtsom pa'i spobs pa sngar bas kyang myur bar gyur/ dbyangs can mas 'o ma phul ba bzhes pas snyan ngag me long ma gzigs par skad cig gis thugs su chud/ gam chu dang nye ba'i ma gya si la sogs par bzhugs tshe yu gur/ mi nyag kam log hor/ sog po sogs zla ba gnyis gsum gyis tshun chod nas snyan pas drangs te gom pa gsum la phyag re byed pa dang gom pa bdun la phyag re byed pa sogs gom phyag gis 'ong ba'i skye bo sa steng du mi shong ba snyam pa rnams kyi 'bul nod rgya cher bzhes te de dag gi dge ba spel/ dam pa'i chos bstan pas phyir mi ldog pa nas thar pa'i sa bon gyi bar du bzhag nam nangs sa sros kyi bar phyag dbang byin rlabs gnang ste de ring thob pa rnams sang 'gro bskyar du med pa'i khrims bcas te zhag 963

dgu bcu'i bar de ltar mdzad kyang rdo rje'i sku la ngal ba mi mnga' zhing 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad/ de'i tshe stod hor gyi rgyal po tho lug the mur gyis gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba 'bul nod rgya chen dang bcas pa byung yang 'byon par ma gnang /dam chu sogs su nad yams kyi 'jigs pa cher byung bas ma gya sir yang byung dogs pa'i tshe slob dpon chen pos 'di zlog pa'i thabs mchis sam zhus pas thabs bya'i gnyid ma dkrog cig gsungs te cung zad mnal bar mdzad/ dar cig na gzim dra/ khang gi steng du tsheg sgra dang 'ur chom chen po byung / de ma thag bzhengs te sham chu'i zhing thams cad gshog pas khyab pa'i bya khyung du byas te nad bdag mi ma yin mang po 'dug pa rnams zos shing gtor/ khong du mes bsregs nas slar thog khar babs pa yin/ nad yams chad par 'gyur gsungs te de bzhin du byung / /ma chur cung zad bsnyun pa na rdo rje rnal 'byor mas ka pā la'i bdud rtsi drangs pa gsol bar gzigs pas de ma thag dwangs shing rdo rje theg pa'i gnad gsang du ma gzigs pas phyag rgya bzhi ldan gyi rdo rje'i mgur gsungs/ go ra dgon mo cher bzhugs dus 'brum nag chen po byung ba yang nam mkha' lding gi cho 'phrul gyis nad bdag btul te zhi bar mdzad/ shar phyogs tsong kha'i rgyal khams su phebs/ dpal blo bzang grags pa rten gzhon nur yod pas rab byung zhus pa na dge bsnyen du bsgrubs te dbus gtsang du song zhig par 'u/nga bstan te phyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ston pa gnyis pa'i phrin las mdzad pa 'di byung / tsong kha yul chen bco brgyad kyi lha mi thams cad shin tu gus shing ngagon gnas chen po btab nas rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang / lta ba ngan sel gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ yul khams 'di yang phyis ring por mi thogs par ri dwags kyis 'dzin par 'gyur zhes lung bstan zhing phyis kho na ltar gyur/ spyir byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' mdzod la dge 964

slong lnga brgyas bla gos phul ba rnams skad cig gis ngur mig can gyi zhing du song nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed pa ltar bdag nyid chen ngo / 'di rnams la zang zing gi dngos po phul ba rnams ni la la skad cig gis sangaru/ rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dang gzhan du mchod sprin du gyur pa dang / bem po de dag kyang ngan song gi gnas su song nas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las byed pa sogs mtha' yas pa yod pas yul khyad par can 'di dag la phul ba tsam gyis rang gi tshogs rdzogs pa yin gyis dngos po de dag gang du song dang bya ba gang byas ni so skyes mi shes mod/'on kyang byis pa'i mthong ba la yang 'bul nod mtha' dag dkon mchog gi rten phyogs med du mchod/ sems can ris med la sbyin pa mdzad/ tha na gru gzings dge zam yan gyi rgyur sbyar/ zang zing gi sbyin pas 'khrug rtsod 'khon 'thab thams cad zhi bar mdzad pas zang zing rnams don ldan 'ba' zhig mdzad par kun gyis mthong la/ khyad par skabs 'dir dbus gtsang mdo khams kyi dgon pa ban+dhe bcu yod pa yan chad la mang ja bdun re spyi 'gyed bla ma la gnang sbyin/ lha sa mtshur phu sogs su gser bre dngul bre mang po las byas pa'i kong bu/ kong rgyags/ lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan gser shog gis g.yog pa sogs la bla ma ri bo sgang pa sogs btang nas rab byung thams cad 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis mi phongs pa dang / dkon mchog gi rten thams cad la chos rgyal mya ngan med slar yang byung ba lta bu'i mchod sprin mdzad/ des na 'dul ba las/ gang na 'du ba mngon la 'ged pa mi mngon pa der yang rtsis gdab par mi bya'o/ /gang na 'ged pa mngon la 'du ba mi mngon pa der yang rtsis gdab par mi bya'o/ /gang na 'du ba yang mngon la 'ged pa yang mngon pa der rtsis gangab par bya'o zhes gsungs pa yin la/ 'on kyang 'byed sdud kyi las len byed pa po rnams kyis rang gi snang ngor 'du 'god gnyi ga mthong bar 'gyur bas gdu'/ bya rnams kyis dge ba byas 965

ba des bdag nyid la sdig par mi 'gyur zhing gnas su gtod la gnas mi/na du ma god pa 'di lta bu bya dgos so/ /de ltar rje bla ma'i bzhed pa mtha3 dag phyag len du thebs par mdzad pa'i slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal de'i mdzad pa ni phyag bya ba'i gnas kho nar snang ngo zhes pa ni zhar la 'ongs pa dang phyi rabs la gdams ngag tu bya ba'o/ /dpal mtsho bkra'i dben gnas ri bo yid bzhin gyi snying po'i spo la bzhugs te skal ldan gyi don mdzad/ cung zad bsnyun pa na po ṭa lar 'phags pa'i phyag gis bum pa gtad pa las bdud rtsi bzhes par gzigs te de ma thag dwangs/ btsun mo purte dha ris rmi lam du ba dan yang dben gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhengs dang 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes pa zhig byung ba de 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhus pas gos dar las grub pa gyis shig gsungs/ de lta bu bzo bo sus kyang khong du ma 'chud pa la drung nyid kyis ri ngos de la rdo dkar po rnams bsgrigs pas sku'i bcad mdzad/ 'di la chibs kyi rmig rjes gang byung du rdo dkar re zhog cig gsungs nas de ltar byas zhes ngag gi lam las sgrog bzo bo rnams kyis de nyid la hor gos bzang po bkab cing gras te sku gser mdog na bza' ta hun sogs byas/ snyan g.yas nas g.yon gyi bar la 'dom bcu gcig tshad des sku yongs rdzogs steng nas lhas mchod cing 'og nas pad gdan dang bye'u phrug kha can/g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang 'jam dpal/ sku dngos la dos chen po sum bcu so gnyis/ ldem gnyis la dos brgyad rnams shin tu legs par grub/rgyu gang song gi bcu cha nang nas 'bul gsungs nas gser srang stong dang dgu bcu'i nor mthud mar mdzad/ phyag tshad dang ldan pa 'dzam gling na zla med par grub ste ri de nyid la bkram nas rab gnas mdzad tshe 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char gyis sa gzhi dang bar snang yog pa byang / slar drang nyid da phul ba/ lde ma ༄ ༄ ༄966

'a4/nyis 'bri gdan la so sor gnang / sku dngos zho khar bzhugs pa phyis sku stod kyi dos lnga tsam ma tshang nas rje chos grags rgya mtshos rtse lha sgang du gso ba mdzad de sku stod rtse lha sgang dang gzhan zho kha na bzhugs la/ rten 'brel 'dis bar du sham tshang gi bstan pa la sel cung zad byung ba yin pas da dung phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa gal che bar yod do/ /spyir sku 'di lha sar bzhugs na rten 'brel shin tu legs snyam/ gzhan yang sa phyogs de dag na sngon gyi sprul pa'i rgyal po dang skyes chen mang pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang bya mdabs bdun pa dang dgu pa sogs ngo mtshar can sum stong bdun brgya yod de de thams cad du nyams pa gso ba dang mchod pa'i tshogs rgya cher mdzad/ mar me'i rgyun dpag med btsugs pas mtshan mo ni tha snyad du gdags pa tsam du mdzad/ lu pan shan du bzhugs tshe li ci ci'i dmag nye bar slebs zhes mi rnams skrag pa na nged kyis su la yang bsam sbyor gang gis kyang gnod pa byed ma myong bas phyogs bcu nas dmag lhags kyang 'bros mi dgos shing khyad par da res ni 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs te dbugs phyung bas de kho na bzhin du gyur/ gcan gzan ma rungs pa'i 'jigs pas yul gru dag nyen pa la bka' shog gnang bas byer te phyin chad 'jig pa zhi/ de ltar shar phyogs kyi rgyal khams chen po thams cad kyi gdul bya mchog dman thams cad rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i smin grol mdzad de bod du phebs pa'i tshe sus kyang lam ngo shes par ma byung bas 'di ltar phyin na mdo stod du bde blag tu phyin par 'gyur ro gsungs nas byang dmar tsha sgang brgyud de myur zhing bde bar 'dan gyi yul du phebs/ rim gyis garma la sogs par byon/ sngon drung gong mas/ lar thams cad 'du ba'i gnas gcig yod//ces lung bstan pa'i ri shod nying phug steng chen du byon nas gtsug lag khang chen ོ bzhengs/ byang phyogs dmu ri'i gzhung du sngags bon mthu bo che 'gas thog 967

ser phab pa byed pa po nyid la log ste 'jig rten gzhan du song / drung bzhugs pa'i rgyang grags gnyis tshun chad nyi 'od gsal zhing 'ja' tshon gyis dkrigs/shag gi sar 'bri khung gi si dhu ye shes rgyal mtshan pas mjal te mi phyed pa'i dad pas rab byung mdzad/ byang chub tu sems bskyed/ smin grol la 'god par mdzad de gdan sa mdzad nas phyis spyan snga nyer gnyis par grags/ nyid phug tu cung zad bsnyung ba na po ṭa lar spyan ras gzigs be ḍūr+ya sngon po'i kha dog can gyis bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur ba gzigs pas dwangs/ nor bzang gi rnam par thar pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams gzigs te bsdus don gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ dge bsnyen drag 'dul gyis gus par btud/ sbom nyag tu yang nag po'i bsam gtan pa dag gis byas pa'i rig sngags kyi nus pa phyir log ste gzhi med du tshar bcad/ yang sku khams cung zad ma bde ba na/yud tsam mnal ba las bzhengs pa na shin tu bde bar gyur/ ji ltar lags zhus pas/ ngas bya khyung du byas te bar chad rtsom pa'i gdon rnams 'dab gshog gis brdabs pas ri 'di yang na bun chung ngu rlung gis ded pa ltar song snyam tshe nad sos 'dug gsungs/ ci zhig na cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshe thugs rje chen po i n+d+ra nī la'i mdog can gyis bum pa las bdud rtsi stsol bar gzigs te legs par dwangs nas sngar bas sku zo mdog bde bar gyur/ mtshan thos pas yon tan dpag med 'thob pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems mtha' dag lhag par gsal bar gzigs te de dag gi mtshan sgrog pa'i srol btsugs/ slar kong po'i rgyal khams kyi lha mi thams cad kyis spyan drangs te gtsang po'i gnod pas nyen pa'i yul du mar phyag nas dpa bden tshi ga mdzad pas chu bo yang rta cang shes ltar bka' nyan/skog phreng gi nyi shar mthon po'i spo la sogs par ting 'dzin mdzad/ na ring rin po che la sogs skyes bu dam pa mang du 'dus pa chos kyi bdud rtsis ngoms par 968

mdzad/ tsā ri'i gnas ci rigs/ par dur khrod kyi gling khyad par ba sogs gnas du ma zhal phye zhing khyad par thugs kyi tsā ri dpal mtsho dkar gyi gnas sngon rje rang byung rdo rjes klo bo nas thegs par brtsams pa la rten 'brel cung ma 'grig pas sgo srung la skye ba phyi ma khyod kyi steng du bya babs pa lta bu zhig bya'o zhes bka' bstsal pa nyid zhal bzhes ltar sngar skye bo su yang mi rgyu ba shar rme mo gong gi la phyes nas gnas kyi snying por phebs/ rang byung gi mchod rten khyad par can gyi bang rim 'og ma la zhabs rjes bkod/ 'di yan gu ru chos dbang la sogs pas byon bya ba'i grags pa tsam las skye bo phal pas ma bgrod pa las 'di phyin skye bo dag gis bskor zhing mjal ba dang bsam gtan pa mang po rtag tu gnas pa'i sgrub gnas chen por gyur to/ /de nas slob rom khrom nag gi gnas 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas sgo sngon ma ma bye ba phye ste rin sbug gi gnas su phebs/ gzims khang zhig mdzad par bzhed pa na sgam po lha rjes gnas 'di rnams khyed la 'bul/ sgrub khang 'debs pa da lta cung sngas pas 'debs mi gzhan zhig 'ong zer ste phyis rgyal ba lo ras kyi skye ba gtsang chen chos rjes btab nas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa la phul ba yang de'i rten 'brel du snang /gdul bya'i dbang ji lta ba mkhyen pas rnam thos kyi ri bor byon te srog la nyen pa'i skye bo mang po gzigs nas bden tshig mdzad pas 'jigs pa las thar/ spo bo'i lam gre mo gru so'i chu chen 'a zam pa mdzad tshe sa g.yos chen po dang 'jiṭa su rung ba'i sgra skad sogs byung ba zil gyis mnan/ skye bos gang ba'i gru chus khyer te rba klong chen por nub tu cha ba la rje btsun ma sgrol mas 'di dag chu'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes gsungs pa'i mod la gru slar log ste skam sar thon/ rje gong ma'i zhal bzhes ltar spo bo'i phur rma kur lung mkha' 'gro'i gnas kyi sgo phye/ /rma la sogs pa'i mdo stod ci rigs par byon te zhal bkos 969

su 'os pa mdzad nas nged dang yang myur du 'phrad bar bgyi'o zhes gsungs pas dpyod ldan dag the tshom du gyur/ 'dzam gle mtsho khar 'bri khung rin po che chos kyi rgyal po dang dpon slob slar yang mjal te na ro chos drug la sogs pa'i zab khrid du mas thugs tshim par mdzad/ tshogs su dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs gnang / rim gyis kong po'i gdul bya rnams la mtha' ma'i 'phrin las cha/ dzad de shu ding thang gi 'phrang stod du phebs pa na chibs kha then mdzad de slob dngo/na chen po gu'i gung pa la gzigs nas nyang bdam la phyag mdzub gtad de sang da gzod ri pha gi'i mgul nas mi grags pa can zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ zho tsā/ ra phebs nas 'phan chen mo dang phyag dpe rnams la bkur bsti cher mdzad/ 'dir me'i gnod pa byung dogs yod pas zon chen po gyis gsungs nas ma 'ongs pa lung bstan/ sngar me'i gnod pa lan gsum byung yang 'phan chen la ma gnod/byang gi sa gtsang sa zhig tu 'gro ma shing dkon po byung dogs yod pas shug pa shogs la khyer gsung ba dang / chos rje gong ma'i gdung gan nas tsan dan dang a ku ru shing rta gang gis bzhu bar 'dug bod du tsan+dan gyi dod shug pa yin pas khyer gsungs pa dang / tsan+dan dang a ka ru sogs su la mkho mi shes pas thams cad kyis ci rnyed zung gsung ba sogs bka' bstsal ste byang lam du chibs kha bskyod do/ /dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pa shar ba dang des rkyen byas te bstod pa dang bstan bcos khyad par can mang du mdzad pa dang rdo rje'i mgur du ma gsungs pa sogs ni brjod kyis mi lang / bstan bcos dang snyan ngag thams cad kyang don bzang po tshig 'bru bzang po nyams dang rnam 'gyur du ma can rje 'dis mdzad pa lta bu ni bod kyi mkhas pa gzhan su la yang mi snang ngo / /sngon dgung lo dgu pa'i dus bsnyung ba na gsol ba btab pas kho bo bud med la soṭa yod sar mi 'chi da gdod sa gtsang sa zhig tu 'chi ba yin gsung ba dang / rdza 970

a ban gangs kyi zhol du bsnyung ba na yang khyed rang rnams sems khral mi 'tshal/da gzod sha rgyang mang po 'phyo ba zhig tu khams bzang ngan byung na dpe cha rnams ma 'thor ba byed dgos pa yin zhes sngon nas bka' bstsal ba ltar byang phyogs thag ring po'i sa spang ri legs shing gtsang ba zhig gi drung du phebs pa na 'o skol 'dir sdod/ ri 'di'i ri rtser dge slong gtsang ma zhig gi pur bzhu na bod la rgya'i dmag mi yong ba yin gsungs nas gdan phab/ snyigs dus kyi sems can rmu rgod rnams legs pa'i lam bstan yang mi 'jug pajo 'dug skyo ba skyed pa'i thabs 'dra byas na phan nam zhes sngar nas tshogs dben du mar gsungs/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa chu phag gi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum nas sku khams cung zang ma stoms par bstan pa nas sa yang yang du g.yos/ 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad/ bco lnga'i mtshan mo sku gsung thugs rten la bskor ba lnga bcu rtsa gnyis mdzad de tho rengs kyi tshe/ byams chen 'jam dpal dbyangs dang kun tu bzang / /spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob la sogs/ /ces yang yang du gsung zhing de dag dang gnyis su med par chos kyi dbyings su zhugs te de'i tshe ri dwags dpag med 'dus nas bskor ba byed/ ri rtse der gdung sbyangs pa'i tshe phyoṭa thams cad nas blta bar byed cing der pur khang gi sa rdo rnams las mchod rte na ngus pa deng sang yang ri dwags rnams kyis rtag tu bskor ba byed pa cig 'dug par thos so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas bsgos pa'i sku gdung chos sku 'e rten dang gzugs sku rten sna tshogs pa'i dbyibs can rnams ni nang a ka ru dang phyi dngul bre chen brgyad bcu las bsgrubs pa'i mchod rten la sogs pa slob dpon chen pos phyag len du thebs par mdzad de de la sogs pa skye 'gro'i bsod ma/ra sa kyi zhing rgya cher spel lo/ /bu slob kyang kun spangs kun dga' don grub/'bri khung chos kyi rgyal po/ sto rin po che grags pa yon tan/ rje btsun nags 971

mgo ba/ ri mgo ba/ shar pa/ mtsho dkar mo ba/ byams chos pa byang chub rgyal mtshan/ dbal mkha' spyod dbang po sogs skyes chen mtha' yas pa byon la/khyad par slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa rin chen dpal ni rje rang byung rdo rje stod lung mda'i ne thang la sgar bzhugs tshe byis pa du ma lci ba 'thu zhing rtse ba'i tshe gzims khyi zhig shor bas gzhan thams cad gar 'gro ma rnyed/ byis pa gcig gis me shing 'thu ba'i sdod tse po kha sbub pa'i 'og tu zhugs te thag pa nang nas bzung bas khyis bskor yang thabs ma rnyed pas log thams cad ya ca/tshan du byas/ de drung gis pha ma la bka' lung gnang bas phul te lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa sus kyang gzhal du med drung na rim gsum gyi gu'i gung pa mdzad de phyag rjes mtha' yas rgya hor gyi rgyal bu mi chen/ bod kyi dpon chen khri dpon si dhu sogs las ka can thams cad kyis rtsod med du bkur/ mtshan slob dpon chen po las gzhan nas mi 'bod/ garma pa'i bstan pa la slob mas bya ba byas pa la 'di che ba yin/ lo tshigs nges pa can ma rnyed kyang rje rang byung ba'i sku tshe'i sgang smad nas mjal te phyis rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang mjal zhing gsung chos kyang mang du phul bar snang ngo / /mkhas pa chen po garma pa dkon gzhon ni rje rang byung pa'i zhabs la thug tsam dang gtso bor rje rol ba'i rdo rje'i slob ma yin/gsang phur mtshan nyid sbyangs/ bod kyi ston pa zhig la mkhas par grags/ red mda' pa gzhon nu blo gros/ lo chen skyabs mchog bzang po/ tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa rnams 'dus nas gnam tseng ldeng gi chos 'khor du grags pa mdzad tshe chos 'khor gyi gral dpon mdzad/ mkhan chen g.yag pa dang kun mkhyen rong pos kyang byams chos phyi ma rnams gtso bor 'di las gsan/ spyir mtshur phu'i kurma de mgor bzhugs pa yin no/ / de —ltar slob ma'i thu bo bsam gyis mi khyab kyang bstan pa'i srog shing 972

'dzin pa'i bka' rgyud kyi gral la bzhugs pa ni dpal mkha' spyod dbang po ste de yang thun mong gi gdul bya'i ngor ni dpal ldan bla ma kurma pa nyid rnal 'phyor gyi dbang phyug su pa kirti dang me tog ma shes rab bzang mo la sogs par gyur pa'i tshe rma bya'i phru gu dang char rlung gis bdas pa'i bung ba dang nags khrod kyi rteg phrug dang ri dwags kyi phru gu rngon pas gtses pa sogs las srog bskyabs cing ngan 'gro las drangs pa mang po dang / de lta bu'i tshul gyis skye ba mtha' yas par thun mong ma yin pa'i dpon slob tu byung ste yang dag pa'i lam bstan pas spangs rtogs rim gyis rdzogs pa dpon slob mchog dman gyi rnam par bstan pa ste drin mang thugs rje'i lcags kyu las gsungs pa ltar dang / khyad par te lo pa dha ri ma'i khol bo mdzad pas yul khams de btul ba na de'i khol po dga' ba zhes bya bar gyur te skad cig gis grol ba dang / na ro ba'i slob ma bram ze kun rig dang / rgya gar phyag na'i slob ma bal bo'i gzhon nu gsang tshol du gyur te sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes lhas bskul nas bod du 'ongs pas rje btsun mi la dang mjal te/ khyod ni kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ /yang yang skyes zhing chos spyod de/ /mi las 'das kyang mi gzugs kyis/ /'gro ba 'dren pa rnams deng phrad/ /ces sogs kyi lung bstan thob/ dbur stod du bka' gdams kyi ston pa tshul khrims dpal du gyur te sgam po ba'i slob mar gyur cing rje dus mkhyen la dad pa thob/ so bdun la gshegs/ de nas ru mtshams su 'khrungs te lo brgyad dgu nas rje dus mkhyen dang mjal zhing shin tu mnyes mtshan nam mkha' 'od/ lo bcu bdun lon tshe chos rje khams su byon ring jo mo gangs dang se mo do la sogs par sgrub pa mdzad/ chos rje don bdun bzhes pa mtshur phur phebs tshe gdams ngag lhag ma rnams gsan zhing bsten/ gshegs rjes lo bcu bdun du sgrub pa mthar bskyal te re bdun la 973

ba/shegs/ mdo khams su 'khrungs te stag lung sku yal ba chen po dang sangs rgyas yar byon bsten/ mtshan bkra shis grags/ spyir rdzu 'phrul las g.yag ru ras par grags/ stag lung gling du sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad tshe grub thob kurma pak+ki byon nas rtogs pa'i bogs bton khyod skye ba thams cad du nga'i slob ma yin/ da dung kho bos rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro gsungs/ sgrub pa'i ngang nas gya gsum la gshegs te sha grags seng du 'khrungs pa yin la gzhan yang nga/ku' thub spyod pa sgrib 'dzin dang / grub pa'i gnas rnams su rgyu ba mis byin dang / chu la mi bying ba dril 'dzin dang / nyi ma 'ching bar nus pa'i ma kha' grol dang / mtshan mo med snang ba kun tu rgyu gos med dang / gangs khrod du rlung gis 'tsho ba spyod pa ba la sogs pa sngon gyi tshul du ma skye ba snga 'grel du gsungs so/ /cung zad skal ba mchog gi gdul bya la ni sngon gyi sangs rgyas du mar bstan zhing da ltar longs sku'i zhing na rgyal ba gar gyi dbang por mya ngan las 'da' ba med par bzhugs pa dang sku'i bkod pa ni mtha' yas par gsungs so/ /shin tu skal ba mchog gi ngor ni dpal ldan bla ma rigs kyi bdag ngo/ kurma pa nyid dang sku gsung thugs tha mi dad pa brnyes pa ste rnam thar dgongs pa lung ston las/ lung bstan skyes bu rnam gnyis dang / /dbyer med rang byung rdo rje nga / /zhes rje rol ba'i rdo rje dpon slob gnyis la lung bstan skyes bu rnam gnyis su bstan nas nyid dang tha mi dad par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / yang rin po che kurma pas/ kho bo skye ba nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byams pa'i bstan pa rgyas par byed do zhes gsungs pa dpal mkha' spyod pa nyid kyis zhwa'i brda ston du zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bstam pa yin no/ /de las zhwa dmar gyi cod pan 'dzin pa dang po rtogs ldan chen po grags pa seng ge ni mdo smad bum 'bor gyi yul sha 'bu lam sha'i yul du gdung dbrang gu yab stag chung 974

dang yum dbra rgod bza' las chu lug la bltams/ yum de ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro yin par rtogs ldan rin po che nyid kyis gsungs/ dgung lo lnga nas sgrol ma dang rta mgrin gyi zhal gzigs shing mngon par shes pa mnga'/ stag lung thang pa dang bla ma sbas sogs sngon gyi 'dren pa du ma gzigs/ bcu gsum la rdza khol ba'i slob ma blo gros grags pa las dge bsnyen mdzad/ gshin rje kha thun la bzlas pa mdzad pas nus pa thon/ rje dus mkhyen gyi dngos slob rgya pho ba lung pa'i slob ma bla ma ye shes seng ge la lo bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe mjal nas rab tu byung / dbang gdams ngag skyed rdzogs mang du gsan/ gtum mo bsgoms pas drod chen po skyes ras rkyang mdzad pas dbrang gu ras par grags ber nag can zhal gzigs te dbus su song zhig gsungs/ thos bsam yang mdzad par bzhed de yab kyis ma gnang yang yo byad bsnams gsungs te byon pas sog gi chu khar mnal lam du ber nag can gyis ngas grogs bya'o zer ba byung / lo nyer drug pa sa spre la natshur phur rta sga phog 'di dus rje rang byung pa kong po na bzhugs dus yin/ slob dpon tshul rin la gsang 'dus gsan/ gnam bar gyi dbu ma pa la bde dgyes dang yo ga gsan zhing mkhyen/ rgya brag pa la zhi byed gsan dad pa thob/ gsang phur byon 'jam dbyangs shāka gzhon dang zur chos pa blo gros mtshungs med la sa sde lnga byams chos lnga tshad ma bsdus 'bring spyod 'jug rnams mkhas par sbyangs/ dbus gtsang na phar phyin mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/ nyer brgyad pa lcags khyi la rje rang byung ba tshal pa dga' bde gshegs pa'i chos 'khor gyi gral dbu mdzad pa'i tshe thog mar mjal bas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ lo bdun du slob gnyer cha/dzad/ sgos gsar rnying gi chags sdang la skyo ba skyes te chos rje rin po che dpon slob bcu tsam mdzad nas skungs na bzhugs pa'i drung du byon/ mdang ber nag can slebs byung khyod la chos skyong 975

'khor bar 'dug gsungs/ de lo tshes rjes mtshur bde chen brtab/ chos drug gi khrid zhus nas seng ge lung du rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas drod rtags dpag med shar/ sems ting nge 'dzin gar gtad du sdod/ yi dam chos skyong gi dag snang ma tha' yas/ dgun bde chen du bsgoms pas sgyu lus rmi lam la rtsal thon stod hor gyi dmag mtsho ma pham nas log par gzigs/ rmi lam du o rgyan gyi gnas dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yang yang gzigs nas 'byon par zhus pas nyams myong gi rta rgod bya ba mtshar gsungs/ chos rje rin po che snye mor byon pa'i phyag phyi nas gtsang la byon te grub thob kurma pak+shi'i gsol ja ba phyis jo nang gi gdan sa mdzad pa byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes dang mjal dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma dang sbyor drug zhus sngon gyi nyams myong phul bas sor bsam srog 'dzin gyi yon tan mthar phyin nas rjes ting gi dus la slebs 'dug gsungs/ mnal lam du sgrol mas o rgyan du mi thon gsungs/ byang sems chen pos kyang da rgya gar gyi bstan pa nub/ tu ruska'i bar chad 'ong bas o rgyan la ma 'byon gsung bas spros pa bcad/ shong lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la don dam bsnyen pa dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho zhus/ dngos rig gi rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig la gdams pa 'ga' gsan/ lo gsum du rdzong drug rnams su gnas skor dang sgrub pa spel/ rje btsun mi la dang rgod tshang ba sogs mnal lam du mjal/ skyi rong gi bar byon/ bal ras snyi ston chen po/ grub thob ring mo/ mkhas btsun bsod nams 'od zer/ grub thob 'dam zhig yo rgyan pa'i sprur sku sogs mjal/ shrī rir chos rje rin po ches jo mo gangs su/gson dang skal ldan grags seng khyod/ /nam mkha' 'di la phar bltab/ pas/ /lta ba rkyen thub tur gyis dran/ /zhes sogs kyi mgur gsungs pa gsan/ phyis mjal dus zhus pas shin tu mnyes/ slar bde chen du lo lngar sgrub pa mdzad/976

malan po gzhon nu byang chub dang slob dpon bkra shis rin chen sogs las bsnyen nga/ra rdzogs/ sngon la stod du bsnyung dus chos rje rin po che byon nas a ru ra zhig thong dang phan par 'gyur ro gsung bas de kho na bzhin du gyur/mnal lam du sgam por byon rje sgam po ba mjal bas ston pa tshul khrims dpal phyin gyi skye ba gsal bar dran zhing de'i mgur mdzad/ chos rje'i zhal nas 'o skol la mthu byed mi 'dug pas rtogs ldan rnams kyis sku rim mdzod gsungs te so sos sku rim tha dad mdzad/ rje 'di dang rtogs ldan tshul blos gshin rje'i zlog pa mdzad pas zla gcig tsam na la stod man 'od gsal gyi ngang du gsam lam gzigs pa las sngags dgon zhig na mon bu mang po ku lhang lhang ngu ba gzigs/phyi nyin de skad zhus lta rtog pa btang bas mthu byed rnams la dmar nad byung ste sngags pa rnams 'das 'dug skad/ chos rje rin po che sku khams dwangs/ rje btsun ma'i sgrub pa mdzad tshe chang phud dri ro nus ldan gyi gong bur gyur pa dang gtor ma la mar gyi rgyan rang rdol ba sogs byung / chos rje rin po che rgya yul du snga ma spyan 'dren pa dang phyi ma'i tshe sku 'da' ba sogs ji lta ba mnal lam du gzigs te cung zad gsungs/ nub gcig la sangs rgyas —sum bcu rtsa lnga'i zhing sbyong ba dang yul nyer bzhir rnal 'byor ma'i bkod pa ston pa sogs mnal lam gyi yon tan mtha' yas mnga'/ legs nyes thams cad chos skyong gis brdar ston/ gang 'dod pa'i don sgrol ma la dngos dang rmi lam du zhu/ bar do'i rnam shes gzigs/ rta mgrin dang bya khyung du mdzad nas gdug pa can thams cad 'dul/ de la sogs pa'i rtogs ldan gyi yon tan mtha' yas pa mnga' yang rje btsun ma phyag ya gcig gis nyid kyi zhal bkab pa gzigs pas nyams myong cher mi gsung / yab ra tshag tu jo mo ca/kha' spyod ma'i drung du mchod pa mdzad pa na o rgyan dngos yin par gzigs shing rang nyid dang bcom ldan 'das ma tha mi 977

ngang par mkhyen/ yang mkha' 'gro ma mang po'i spyan 'dren rgyung ba la sgrol ma cung zad khros pas zlog pa dang / yang byang sems chen po rdo rje 'chang du mdzad nas bzlog ste sku tshe'i bar chad bsal/ sangs rgyas dpag tu me da pa'i gtso bo chos rje rin po ches mdzad par gzigs/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas mngon sum du mdzad/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon par shes pas gdul bya'i log rtog ldog de la sogs pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa'o/ /rje dus mkhyen gyi slob ma grub thob chu sgom ma bsam gtan rgyan gyi sgrub gnas rta phug mkha' 'gro gling du bzhugs tshe chu sgom ma nam mkha' la byon nas sa pha gir dgon pa cig btab na 'gro don chen po 'ong / kho mo skye ba dma' bas ma thebs pas ming pos thob ces byung / sa dpyad legs par gzigs te so dgu pa lcags bya la gnas nang btab/ ber nag can gyis khal rnams der phog par gzigs te gzims khang 'og ma mdzad/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis na dgon pa thebs te dge 'dun brgya lhag tshogs/ thams cad chos drug gi yon tan rdzogs pa kho na byung /'dir mi rabs gsum du sgrub pa po mang du 'byung de nas thong gshol 'dzin pa 'ong gsungs/ 'gro don yun ring du mdzad/ ston pa gdan sar bskos te gzims khang yang dben du sgrub pa lo gcig tu mdzad/ chos rje rin po ches pho brang nas bka' shog dang zhwa dmar gnang ba phebs pas bde chen du bzhugs te gzims khang brtsigs/ yos lo bde chen du bzhugs tshe chos rje rin po che pho brang du sku yal ba gzigs/ dgung lo re gcig la cung zad bsnyung ba na sgrol ma rgyan bzang ba zhig gzigs pas dwangs/ re drug pa sa byi la cung zad bsnyung ba na rje btsun ma lhan cig skyes ma gral rim du bzhugs pa'i bar bar na bu mo mang po shoca/ rtse ba gzigs pas dngas/ mdor na sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung ste nyams rtogs/ tshad du 'khyo'/ ba'i rtogs ldan gyi slob ma bgrang las 'das 978

pa byung ngo / /dgung lo re bdun pa glang gi lo'i dpyid zla tha chung la bsnyung bar bstan te 'ja' lus su yal ba zhig bya bsam na'ang gzhan don gyis g.yengs nas ma grub bar dor mchog thob par 'dug lus 'di chas gos dmar po dang rus rgyan gyis g.yogs la dngul gyi mchod rten dkar sang nge ba zhig tu kha shar du ston la zhog 'brel tshad la ngan song med do/ khyed rnams sdug bsngal ma byed bla ma la gsol ba thob skye med kyi ngange la 'gag med kyi rtsal sbyongs gsungs te tshes bcu dgu'i snga dro 'khor lo bde mchog sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis bsu ba'i bkod pas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /me tog gi char chen po bab pa'i tshe sngon gyi rten 'brel gyis stag lung du yang bab skad/ bu chen yang rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba dang g.yag sde paṇa chen sogs rje rang byung ba dang dpon slob thun mong gi slob ma ni ches mang la gnas nang gi gdan sar bzhugs nas khrid kyis 'gro don mdzad pa ni mkhas grub dar rgyal ba ste thang lha'i nye loṭa su yum gyi rmi lam du rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa mkha' 'gro ma lngas bskor ba zhig gis dbang bskur 'khor rnams gtso bo dang de smin mtshams su thim pa rmis tshe lhums su zhugs te zhag bdun du zas skom ma dgos pa'i ting nge 'dzin byung /'khrungs 'phral nas rigs sad pa'i spyod pa byed/ rtsed mo byas pas lus gnad pa'i sdug bsngal gyis skyabs 'gro'i blo drag po skyes/ tshe rabs dran te glu mang po blangs/ nye bar rje rang byung rdo rje dang mjal bas spyan ras gzigs su mthong dad pas phyag phyir phyin te bde chen du chos rjes mkhan po dang gzhon byang bas las slob mdzad de lo bcu dgu la chigs rdzogs mdzad/ khrid bskyangs shing dka' thub kyis sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/ bla ma du ma bsten/ khyad par phug mo cher rje grags seng ba'i drung du gdams ngag thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/dbu sngas la mi 'jog rgyab rten la mi snye/ chu dang rdo'i dka' thub rlung sbyor 979

zab mo rnams la gnad du bsnun shig nad drag po lo gsum/ 7 thugs rlung lo gnyis/ 'dzag gegs lo gcig rnams byung ba mtshan mar ma pozung bas lam du stongs te gegs skyon las grol/ nyams rtogs tshad du 'khyol/ rmi lam 'od gsal 'byongs te nub re la o rgyan lan bcu gsum re 'khor/ yi dam gyi lhar dngos su ston nus/ rgyud 'dzin gyi sras su gzigs nas gnas nang gi gdan sar bskos/ gzhan don rgya cher mdzad/ bde ba can du thogs med du 'gro gsungs nas gshegs so/ /de la zhwa dmar cong pan 'dzin pa gnyis pa ni dpal mkha' spyod dbang po ste byang gnam gzhung gi bye ma lung na kha bar pa bya bar yab lha rgyal dang yum 'brog mo'i sras su lcags pho stag lo la bltams/zla ba bdun lon pa na rje rang byung rdo rje me tog kha ma bye ba 'dzin pas/ me tog rnam par smin yang kha ma bye/ /dal 'byor snying po thob kyang stobs ma rgyas//rang gi ngo bo mthong yang tha mal pa/ /nga ni rtag tu mthong ba bstan bya bu/ /zhes gsung ba na dad pas lus 'phar zhing mchi ma'i rgyun byung bas yab yum sogs 'jigs sdangs dang ngo mtshar du gyur/ yang zhag bdun phrag gcig na bla mas se gol lan gsum mdzad pa mthong bas skye ba snga ma gsum gsal bar dran te cung zad gsungs pas dad ldan gyi skye bo dag 'dus shing bkur/ zla ba bcu bzhi tsam lon pa na rje rol pa'i rdo rje phebs te skye bo mang pos mchod pa na ri'i sgang zhig na yum gyi drung na gnas pas mthong ste dngos su mchi bar ma nus pas phyag 'tshal zhing sngon gsung ba'i tshig gi mthar/ kye ma da ni byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bshums shing gsol ba btab pas dbu gdugs kyi steng du drung gi sku 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba yun ring du gzigs/ yang rje dus mkhyen sngon gyi gnas su sdigs mdzub mdzad pa mthong bas nam mkha' 'od kyi skye ba gsal bar dran/ sngon gzigs pa'i grub chen brgyad bcu yang mi gsal tsam du gzigs 980

te de'i tshul gsungs pas dad par mdzad/ dgung lo gsum pa nas skye bo'i tshogs la chos gsungs pa dang / sngon gnas rjes dran dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes du ma gsungs pas gzhan gyi log rtog bsal/ de lta bus rtoṭa ldan rin po che'i sku skyer mchog dman kun yid 'ches te dgung lo drug pa la mkhas grub dar rgyal bas gdan 'dren la byon/ mnal lam brtags pas kyang seng ge'i phru gu shin tu legs pa cig lha'i bus phyag tu gtad par gzigs/mjal ba tsam gyis yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod de gus pas spyan drangs/ lam bye lung gi chu mdor chu ches pa'i rab 'khor nas dpon slob mang po chu dbus su lhung ba na rje btsun ma sgrol ma nam mkhar gzigs pa'i mod la bde bar thon/mtshur phu dang gnas nang du byon/ dge slong dar ma tshul khrims la nam mkha' 'od kyi skyes rabs rgyas par gsungs/ dgung lo bdun pa la rje rol ba'i rdo rje dang mtsho smad du mjal dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos byang chub tu thugs bskyed/dbang gis smin par mdzad de phyag chen chos drug gi khrid bskyangs/ chos rje dang ma mjal tsam nas rje'i sku nam mkha' la dal bus gshegs pa zhig gis bu bstan par bya yis bstos shig gsungs nas gar mdzad nas skad cig gis rdo rje 'chang du gyur sprul pa du ma spro ba gzigs pas nyid kyang bzod med du gar du ma mdzad cing / dpal rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje mkhyen pas gzigs la byin gyis rlobs/ /ces gsol ba btab cing sems nyid sgrib bral du gzigs/ mjal nas zhag 'ga' na rje na rim bzhi po phyag na bum pa bsnams mtha'i bdud rtsi dbus mar bsdus nas dbang rim pa gsum re mos su bskur te/sku drug dbang drug thig le drug /sbyor drug gsang ba ye shes mdzod/ /ces gsung ba gzigs/ bla mas dbu la 'tshams rnga/'i cod pan dmar po bcings pa na/ rje dus mkhyen dang ḍā ki ma bdun gyis shis pa brjod cing gur gum dang mu 981

tig bsres ba'i char 'bebs par gzigs/ de bzhin du rje7bla ma man shel dag pa'i sku can gyis mtshan bstsal ba dang / grub thob mang po'i dbus na bzhuṭa pas de kho na nyid bstan pa dang / cod pan lan dgur bcings par gzigs pa dang / phyag gis spyi bor byugs shing ljags mchil btab pas gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags la reg pa ltar gyur te rten 3brel gyi sgo du ma gzigs/ zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol can gyi bla ma las shes rab bzhi sbyor gyi man ngag gsan/ rta mchog gi khri la bzhugs pas kyang na bzas g.yogs te bu zhes dgyes par mdzad pa gzigs/ yang bla ma'i sku nyi ma ltar 'bar bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bdun sdigs mdzub kyis rtse zhing / ma shar nyi ma gang du nub par 'gyur/ /mi g.yo sdigs mdzub 'di ni gar byed de/ /ye shes nyi bdun gsang ba'i rol mo dang / /lha mo'i 'og pag nor bu'i rang bzhin ldan/ /zhes gsung ba gsan/ spos kyi glang chen la bzhugs pa'i skus 'od zer rnam par bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo ston par gzigs te/ kun nas 'gag med nam ca/kha'i sgo/ /gang du'ang ma bcad ma phye ba/ /mi shes rang gis rnam par bcad/ /shes pa rnam par grol ba nyid/ /'on kyang 'gog snang de lta na/ /sgo glegs mnyam par bzhag pa nyid/ /sus kyang bsdams dgrol med pa la/ khyod g.yengs ma byas tsam gyis so/ /phyi dang nang dang bar dag las/ /ji ltar 'ong 'di byung song gnas/ /brtags kyang med do de bas na/ /'od 'di stong nyid 'od po che/ /'di ji lta ba de lta bur/ /chos rnams thams cad rnam par stos/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po mchog /'di ni rnam par 'phrul ba'i sgo/ /zhes gsung pa gsan/ rje dus mkhyen pad+ma rā ga'i mdog can gyis shel gyi za ma tog gnang ste sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi sku gdung zung zhig zhes bstsal ba gzigs/ zhing dang sku mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa dang ldan pa las kun sbyor sum dril gyi man ngag gsan/ bla ma'i sku'i bkod pa dga' 982

ldan na bzhugs pa rgyal ba dri ma med pas rjes su bzung ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na sangs rgyas 'od dri med du bzhugs pa gzigs/ o rgyan du khrid de 'khor lo'i 'du ba las rdo rje theg pa'i nges pa bstsal/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu bdun bstsal te gsang ba'i 'jug ngogs bstan/ ṭom+bhi pa'i rdor dril gtad de 'khor lo lam gsang gi sgo phye/ rin po che'i bang mdzod du ma byin te man ngag so gsum pa bstan/ shel gyi pi wang reg pa tsam gyis snyan pa'i sgra 'byung ba las mi shigs rgyan drug gi chos sgra gsan/ ri bo chen po dngos grub 'dzin du rgyal ba nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i skur bzhugs pa las lus sems 'chi med kyi nges pa rnyed pa sogs bshes gnyen byin rlabs kyi rnam thar brjod kyis mi lang ba mnga'/ 'khrungs ma thag mkha' 'gro ma su kha sid+dhi gzigs te gnad kyi me long gsungs/ de ma thag spyan ras gzigs gsal bar gzigs te de kho na ltar gzhan la sgom bzlas gsung ba las tshig thugs la bzung ma dgos/ nam skrag pa na sgrol ma byon te dbugs 'byin/ rje ri khrod pa las bde mchog gi dbang gsan tshe bde mchog gi lha tshogs ji lta bar gzigs/ yang ut+pal la bzhugs pa'i sgrol ma mu tig gi rgyan can dang / rta mchog gser gyi rdo rje nam mkhar gsor zhing bzhad pa'i sgras sa g.yo ba dang / bde mchog dkar po shel bum 'dzin pa dang / dmar po drug bcu rtsa gnyis pa kun nas chags pa dang /dgyes rdor seng po zhal phyag mtha' yas pa sogs gzigs/ spyan ras gzigs gser mdog mnyam pa'i stabs can phyag gnyis pa yum dkar mo can gzigs shing / bde ba'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'dzin/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho skyed pa'i yab/ /rigs drug 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sku/ /rnam dag ye shes ro' pa che/ /zhes pa'i sgra gsan/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma yab sngo bsangs phyag gnyis pa can 'khor bcas kyi 'du ba'i 'khor lo gzigs de dag 983

skad cig gis rgyal po in+d+ra bha ti 'khor bcas su gyur par gzigs shing rdo rje mdud 'grol gyi gnad gsadro gzigs/ bdag med ma dkar mo lha mo bco lnga la sogs par gar bsgyur zhing / sgyu 'phrul chen mor rab tu dag zhes sgrog pa gsan/ sher phyin dkar mo la phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas bstod pa dang mod de nyid la dam pa'i sku che chung sna tshogs pas 'jig rten khyab cing man ngag gi gsang du ma gsan/ snang mtha' yum bcas dang slob dpon pad+ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros mchod pa'i cho 'phrul dang ldan pa gzigs/ sangs rgyas kun gzigs chos 'chad can dang de'i zhing mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa dang / sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa zhing dang bcas pa gzigs shing de dag gi zhing sbyong dang smon lam mdzad/ de la sogs pa yi dam zhal mthong gi rnam par thar pa ni nam mkha'i mthas gzhal bar mi nus so/ /bde chen du gnas brtan chen po don grub dpal gyis mkhan po dang chos rje rin po ches las kyi slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung / mtshan dri med dpal ye shes su gsol/ phyis dgung lo bco brgyad na mkhan po de nyid dang slob dpon 'jam dbyangs chos rdor ba gsangs ston gzhon nu dpal dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i tshe nam mkha' la nyi ma bzhi shar ba dang rang nyid chos gos gsum gyis g.yogs te lha mi du ma la chos ston pa sogs rmang lam du gzigs/ bde ba can pa nam rin la byams chos lnga dang tshad ma rnam nges 'dul ba mdo rtsa sogs gsan/ rgyal ba g.yung la sgrol dkar dang / rje rang byung pa'i slob ma mkhan chen kun dga' 'od zer ba la rdo rje phreng ba sogs dbang bskur du ma dang mkhan chen 'od zer rgya mtsho la snying thig gi skor/ 'od zer dpal ba la rnying ma'i rgyud 'grel dang gter kha gong 'og gi chos sogs snga 'gyur dang g.ya' bzang pa bsod nams 'od la khrid du ma gsan/ ri khrod pa ma/bas grub dar rgyal ba la dbang lung man ngag bzhugs so 984

'tshal ba/san/ lha sar mnal lam du rje rang byung ba las sems bskyed gsan zhing mi pham dpal ldan du mtshan gsol bar snang / lhag pa'i lha dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros tsaṇ+ḍi pa dang mkha' spyod dbang por mtshan gsol/ ra tshag jo mo'i smin mtshams nas g.yung drung dmar po byung ste sku lus la phog pas lhan cig skyes dga' shar/ sku gzhon dus phal cher sku mtshams dam pa'i sgrub pa rtse gcig par mdzad pas gnas nang gi sgom chen thams cad ci byed gzigs te tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi zhal ta mdzad pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te sus kyang bag med kyi spyod pa mi nus/ byang gi 'dam dang sog las brgyud de re shod kyi bar du byon/longs spyod zad mi shes pa rnams gnas nang du sgrub rgyags su gnang / ri khrod pa gshegs rjes grwa pa rmya rgod rnams la thugs skyo nas bla ma bsod nams 'bum la gdan sa gtad de gnas nang gi rgyab ri sogs la ri khrod kho na mdzad/ rtsod pa cung zhig byung bas/ kye ma chos dang mi mthun pa'i/ /chos pa'i gzugs kyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes byang chub lam glu gsungs nas dpon slob bcu tsam zhig dbur stod nas lam phyung nyang bo rgya mdar rje dus mkhyen gyis lung ston pa gziṭa/kong po'i gnas ci rigs par dben pa mdzad/ khyad par tsā ri gsar ma'i byin legs su bzhugs shing chos rje'i bkas ba yu ri dgon bskyangs/ tsā ri ma chen gyi brag dkar mor lo gsum bzhugs shing brag logs la zhabs rjes gsal bar yod/ ri sked dang phan tshun 'phur nas nyi ma la bzhugs par grags/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bkod pa du ma gzigs shing rdo rje'i glu gsan/ tsā ri gsar mar bzhugs dus chos rje rin po che gshegs pa gzigs nas gdung dbyangs mdzad/—nyer dgu pa sa rta la stag rtse rnam rgyal sgang btab/ so brgyad pa me yos la rje de bzhin gshegs pa dgung lo bzhi bzhes pa stag rtser spyan drangs chos dang zang zing gis mchod de rje des kyang yongs 'dzin gcig pu par bkur/ so bdun pa 985

shing stag la dga' ldan ma mo btab/ spyir sgom chen pa gtsang ma sum brgya las mi nyung ba rnacha/sa dbyar dgun la zla ba gsum re mtshams gcod cing khrid kyi 'phrin las khor yug tu mdzad pas rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grangs las 'das pa byung / kong ra la gsum la chos rgya dkar po lo du ma mdzad/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa dang dpon slob lhan cig par dbus su byon te mtshur phu la soṭa par 'phrin las rgya chen mdzad/ slar kong por 'phrin las bskyangs shing chos gsung ba na rgyang grags gnyis tsam nas gsung ma nyams par thos skad de/ sngon rje grags pa seng ge gsung mi bzang bas skye ba phyi ma la skad kyi rten 'brel sgrig gsungs nas dung dkar bzang ba zhig btsal te rje rang byung rdo rje la phul ba'i rten 'brel gyis rje mkha' spyod pa tshangs pa'i gsung lta bu yod par snang / dung 'di la phyis gan nas gser ljang brdungs kyi gshog pa phul te rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung dang lhan gcig gaṇ+ḍi la'i mchod rdzas la da lta'ang yod do/ /mi ma yin gdug pa can cha/nga po dge bsnyen la bkod/ khrid yig nyams mgur sogs ngo mtshar ba'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad pa 'di rnams ni bstan pa la mdzad pa shin tu che'o/ /gnyid 'od gsal du tshud cing smi lam sgyu lus su dag pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs snang la yang gser gyi ra bas bskor ba'i pho brang du rgyal po yon tan rmad byung gi bu gzhon nur gyur pas gser ri'i rtser shel gyi mchod rten la bskor ba na rin chen bdun gyis dbang bskur zhing shel gyi mchod te na sna tshogs pa'i char babs pa dang / gser g.yu 'ba' zhig gi ri bo'i phug rnams su grub pa'i slob dpon bstan pa 'dzin pa dang gzi brjid blo gros dang mun pa rnam se la dang blo gros rnam nges dang grags pa'i cod pan dang seng ge brtan pa dang lhun po'i rgyal mtshan dang nyi zla brtsegs pa dang nam mkha'i tog dang ye shes dbang po dang rgya mtsho rnam rgyal dang yid bzhin kun 'byung zhes bya ba'i sku'i cha byad sna 986

tshogs pa rnams kyis man ngag bstan pa ngang / mdzes pa'i puṇ+ḍari las sidha rak+ṣa'i man ngag rnyed pa dang / lha'i tshogs du mas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i yo byad rgyal chen bzhis 'dzin pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha'i dbyings— gang ba'i tog nor bu nyi ma ltar 'bar ba can las ba dan dkar po nam mkha' khyab par spro ba phyag gis 'dzin pa dang / pad+ma rā ga'i cang te rang sgra 'byung ba 'dzin pas gar mdzad pa na'i gi ma'i tshogs kyis ka pā la bdud rtsi can phul ba dang / 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi sras thu bor gyur pa lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod par snang ba na yid 'ong bde ldan gyi bkod pa dran pa dang / lus thams cad g.yu 'od 'bar bas byugs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs kyis zab mo'i don gyi glu dang gar byas pas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung du 'phel ba dang / nam mkha' rten med par bzhugs te phyag g.yas kyi mthil nyi ma las lhag pa'i 'od kyis 'jig rten snang bar mdzad pa dang / gser gyi khang pa yangs par gser gyi rnga bo che bdun sgrigs su snang ba'i gcig brdungs pas kun las sgra byung ste/ zab cing rgya che nam mkha'i rnga bo che/ /nam mkha'i yid can su zhig rdung bar rtog /ma brdungs pa yang mkha' khyab chos kyi sgra/ /mi chung mi zad nam mkha' mnyam par grag /phyi dang nang gzhan dbye ba med pa'i sgra/ /dbyangs gsal rdo rje gser gyi rnga chen 'di/ /byung gnas 'jig pa med cing 'gyur bas dben/ /'di ni lhun grub rtag dngos yid bzhin bde/ /zhes grag pa gsan/ ri'i tshad tsam gyi skyes bu rta mchog la gnas pas dpag tshad tsam gyi gser gyi ral gri gdengs bas rnga bo che lta bu'i sgra grag par gzigs/ rnal 'byor ma dar yol zhig gis 'dul ba gsung ba gsan/ rin po che'i mchod rten sgo bye ba can gyi nang du byon pas bde bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa gzigs/ ri brag me tog dang mchod rten gyis gang bar dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lang long du 987

gzigs shing man ngag gi gnad kyis tshim/ nam mkha' la ḍā ki ma kha dog sna tshogs pa mngon par dga' bar 'khor lo 'du ba la 'gro'o zhes zer zhing khyeng cag kyang 'dong ngo zer ba na/ kho bo mi 'gro ste 'khor lo 'du ba 'di nyid du 'byung ngo / /'o na 'khor lo 'du ba rgyan gyi ting nge 'dzin ston zhig zer ba na skad cig de nyid du rnam 'phrul dran rdzogs su bkod pas rab tu tshim/ pad+ma rā ga'i me tog rgyang grags tsam gyis khebs par ting nge 'dzin mdzad pa na nam mkha' thams cad nyi zla spel mas gang ba las dngul gyi me tog gi char reg na bde ba 'bab cing lha'i bu mo mtha' yas pas rdo rje'i glu blangs pa las zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i nges pa rnyed/ glang po che shin tu che ba'i ro grogs gcig dang gnyis kyis bshus pa las sha rus thams cad ring bsrel 'ba' zhig tu gyur te de dag sngags kyi sgra sgrog cing lding ba dang rgyal ba'i sku mang du 'phro bar gzigs/shel gyi ral gri 'dom gang ba'i rtse la me 'bar zhing yu ba las bdud rtsi 'bab ba cig rnyed de des rang lus grangs med du bsil bas ral gri dang mnyam pa'i lus rdzogs pa de snyed du snang / yang bcom ldan 'das ma lhan cig skyes ma'i sku snang ba na sgyu 'phrul gyi bkod pas gro ha de wa na bzhugs te dzā lan dha ra nas byung zhing slar yang hi ma la ya dang ra mi shā ra'i gnas sogs nas bzhugs shing chos kyi 'khor lor rab tu brtan pa la sogs pa'i rol pa du ma mdzad de mdor na gsal snang phran tshegs gyi rna ma thar las cung zad byung ba smos par zad de ye shes can rnams kyi mnyam bzhag thun gcig gi gzigs pa yang bskal ba brgyas brjod par ga la nus/ ma 'ongs pa'i tshul yang shar gyi phyogs chu klung chen po dang glang po sna ljags brkyangs pa lta bu'i ri dang nye bar bsam gtan byed do zhes bya ba dang / sngon gyi 'phen pa'i lhag mas byang phyogs kyi rgyud bla ma'i gnas su spyod cing 'di 'phrin las sgrub par byed do zhes dang / rje btsun badzā swā dzā'i 988

dgongs pa sgrub par dga' bas de'i gnas dang nye bar kun tu rgyu'i spyod pas 'jug go zhes pa dang / mthar spyod pa'i nor 'dzin gyi bu gzhon nur byas te rdzas kyi nus pa mi zad pa'i gsang 'tshol bar byed do zhes pa dang / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas bgrod cing bdud rtsi 'thung bar dga' bas lan bzhir brgyud ma kho nar rtse zhing phyogs thams cad du 'gro'o zhes bya ba dang / o rgyan dang kha che'i bar du slob dpon la ba pa'i man ngag 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dang /rgya nag stong kun la nye bar rdzogs pa chen po la mchog tu spyod par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba la sogs nges pa du ma mthong yang bris shing brjod pas mtha' gtuṭa par ma mthong ste 'di ni ma 'ongs zhing sbyong gi rnam par thar pa'o zhes byung la/'di la shar gyi chu klung chen po glang po sna ljags brkyangs pa lta bu'i ri dang bcas pa ni rtse lha sgang du rje chos dpal ye shes kyis zhi ba'i tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad pa de yin la sngon gyi bla ma'i gnas ni byang stag lung du chos rje byang chub rgya mtshor gyur pa ste dus mnyam du sku'i bkod pa gnyis bstan pa yin la gnyi ga'i zhabs la hor yig gsar gyi yi ge rgyal zhes pa yod pa mtshungs skad/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi bas rnam thar 'di la 'grel pa mdzad par yang de ltar gsungs shing rje btsun badz+ra rā dzā'i sogs ni bdag gis bde gshegs rdo rje rgyal po'i gdan sar bya ba cung zad byas pa 'di yin snyam la ma 'ongs pa rnams kyang rim par shes par bya'o zhes byung ngo / /de bzhin du kho bo'i mtshungs med bla ma 'di spyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bor grub la de ni 'od dpag med dang tha mi dad pas bde ba can du 'jug pa la tshegs med pa dang / rigs gsum mgon po ni tha mi dad pas kun gzigs kyi zhing sbyong ba la dka' ba med pa dang / dga' ldan na lha sras dri med du bzhugs pas byams pa dang mjal bar sla ba dang / sa ra ha nyid yin pas dpal gyi ri bo bgrod sla ba dang / in+d+ra bhu ti nyid yin zhing 'khor lo sdom par nges pas o rgyan sogs lag na 'dug 989

pa lta bu yin pa'i tshul rgya cher gsungs so/ /rje de bzhin gshegs pa rgya yul nas phebs pa dang zhal mjal te rtse lha sgang sogs su chos mang du phul zhes deb sngon na snang yang mchod yon mjal ba'i yi ger me pho khyi lo'i mjug dang me mo phag lo'i stod la mchod yon mjal bar bshad cing shing bya la dpal mkha' spyod pa gshegs nas me khyi la sprul sku 'khrungs pa yin pas cung zad ma dag pa snyam mo/ /dgung lo nga drug la bab tshe dga' ldan ma mor phebs nas phyag dpe rnams phyag rtags kyis mnan zhing phyogs 'dir myur du sleb pa 'dug gsungs/ khams pa'i gra slob kyis nan gyis spyan 'dren zhus pa la lam du rten 'brel mi 'grig pa 'dug gsungs kyang nan zhus kyis chu nyil bar byon der sgar phebs ma thag chos 'phro rnams tshar ba mdzad de cung zad bsnyung ba'i tshul gyis shing mo bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer dgu la gshegs par bstan/sku gdung rin po che mdo li la spyan drangs te dga' ldan ma mo gser 'bum gyi bum par bzhugs su gsol ba sogs dge slong dbon grags pa dang ba yo chos bzang pas bsgrubs so/ /bu slob ni gtso bor rje de bzhin gshegs pa ste phag mo'i skyed rdzogs dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha khrid sogs gsung gi zin bris kyang du ma mdzad/ sog dbon rigs ral gyis kyang chos gsan pa'i rgya dpal mkha' spyod pa kho na che/ gzhan yang rdza dgon pa chos kyi ye shes/ zur dgon bka' bzhi ba rin chen dpal/ ri mi 'babs pa bsod nams rin chen/ chab kha ba shes rab dpal sogs gzhan don nus pa mang du byung zhing bum 'bor sgang chung du 'khrungs pa'i 'ger nyag rtogs ldan chos dpal ye shes bya ba 'phrin las can slob ma'ang dri med pa sa tham rgyal po'i ti shri mdzad pa dang / sri dkar sangs she zhes pas sa gser dgon btab pa sogs du ma byung / lha gzigs rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis ring du bsten te phag mo'i skyed rdzogs rnams la zin bris mdzad cing mang du 'phel/ 'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum ni gnas nang dang nye ba'i 990
