g.yu mar 'khrungs te slob ma'i dam par gyur nas gnas nang gi gdan sa mdzad cing lcags rdo bla ma rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i slob ma byung / ba yo chos bzang pa ni 'khrungar yul ca3kas shod pa yin/ sras kyi thu bor mdzad/ ba yo dngu stag rtse'i gdan sa ma /ngo da/ dge slong dpon grags pa ni dgas po sku rab pa'i zhal ngo yin par thos/ rtse lha sgang gi gzims khang dang dga' ldan ma mo sogs 'debs pa'i phyag len mdzad pas gar bstan la phyag rjes shin tu che/ bla ma rin bzang dkar po yang 'khrungs yul nags shod pa dgon pa grib gdong btab/ 'di rnams re re zhing 'phrin las che'o/ /dpal kurma pa na rim lnga pa ni rje de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ de yang sngon rje rol pa'i rngo rje byang du sku gshegs pa'i dus gdul bya rnams la so sor snang ba du ma byung ste/ lha sar jo bo'i drung du dpon slob bdun mdzad de dngul sder gser gyis bkang ba 'thor zhing bskor ba mdzad nas nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon du yal ba dang / mtshur phur nam mkha' la byon nas kho bo dga' ldan du 'gro skye ba myur du 'ong gsungs nas shar gyi nam mkha' la gshegs te rnam par mdor 'ja' 'od du yal ba mang pos mthong /mon yul nas bya bral ba byung ba na re chos rje dpon slob brgyad bcu tsam byon mon gyi rgyal po gsum rab tu phyung na ro ni gu'i chos drug gsung zhing yod zer/sa le'i bar du a tsa ra dang tshong pa lam nor ba la mdun du byon nas rin po che mang po gnang lam bstan nas nged 'dir mi 'dug gsungs nas seng ge la chibs te gshegs par mthong / slob dpon chen po sogs sgar pa rnams dbus na phebs tshe steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa sgar pa byin gyis mthong / zho khar phebs la khad pa chibs mgo nag gi steng na bzhugs pa thams cad kyis yud tsam mthong / rtse lha sgang du phebs tshe dpon slob bco lnga tsam byon nas gru khyer shog gsung ba mthong / gru khyer tshe chu'i steng gi nam mkha' la byon nas gzims khang du byon par mthong / zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'ja' 'od kyi steng na 991

bzhugs pa kong po'i khrom phal cher gyis mthong / sgom chen pa 'gas rgya la'i seng 'dam du mja'/ te chos thob nas 'ja' tshon du yal bar snang / khyad par du myang 'dam gyi stod du bla ma zhig phyi dro nyi ma la 'dug pa na drung nyid seng ge la chibs 'ja' 'od kyi dbus su mu tig gi khang par bzhugs pa zhig nam mkha' la byon te myang 'dam du bzhud par mthong bas chos rje kurma pa de seng ge la bcibs 'ja' 'od dang khang bzang du bzhugs pa zhig byon ste thal sku khams ma bzang ba yin nam zer nas dad pas ngus/ kun gyis mthong bar yang myang 'dam gyi sar 'ja' tshon 'khrigs me tog gi char 'bab pa nyin re bzhin rtag tu byung zhing dri bzang gis yul thams cad khyab/ 'khrungs sa'i khang pa la 'ja' rtag tu zug yul mi mang po la yang nyi zla shar ba sogs dang chos rje rin po che phebs pa sogs rmi lam bzang po rmis te sngon lung bstan pa dang lhas bskul bas thams cad kyang chos rje rin po che ni nged rang gi yul 'dir 'khrungs pa gdon mi za'o zer nas mgrin gcig tu sgrog sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gzhan don la mngon par bskul ba dang / bod yul rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i dus su mkhyen nas kong ral gsum las nyang po'i yul myang 'dam gyi sar gdung sna nam zhang yab sngags pa gu ru rin chen yum lha mo skyid la gzigs par mdzad de lhums su 'jug par bstan/ de'i tshe yum gyi rmi lam du byang phyokas nas skya mi chas bzang ba mang du byung ba'i nang nas gsum bzhi tsam sdun du 'ongs nas gtso bo des gnas mal g.yar zer nas lus la thim zhing gzhan rnams kyis bskor ba byed pa dang / khang ltag gi zhing chen po zhig dung dkar gyis gang 'dug pa las thu ba gang bsdus/che ba cig 'bud par brtsams tshe gnyid sad/ nam mkha' la nyi zla shar ba'i 'od kyis thams cad rtsa/nga ba dang gser gyi me tog 'thu ba sogs rtag tu ngo mtshar 'ba' zhib/ rmi/ lus yang zhing bde la zas kyi sred pa med/ skabs su lhums 992

nang nas yig drug dang ā li kā li dang oṃ.āXhūṃ yang yang gsung / bud med du ma dang lhan zhig yur ma byed pa na de ltar gsung ba thams cad kyis thos te gang du grag g.yas g.yon du lta zhing the tshom du gyur/ ngo tsha ba dang gzhan la mi sgrag pa'i phyir pha tshad du gcig pur yur ma byas pas gsung che bar grag pa thams cad kyis thos nas sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar can zer zhing phyag 'tshal khyod kyis ci thod byed mi nyan zer/ yab kyi rmi lam du'ang dkyil 'khor rab tu bkra pa'i dbus su bum pa bzang po 'dug pa la phyag mchod byas gsol ba btab pa rmis/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs brjod las 'byung ba ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di dag gi bsod nams kyi tshogs ni gzhal bar dka' bas de'i mthus sngar yab kyis lus la nad gzhi zhig yod pa yang sangs/ sngar yo byad kyis phongs pa zhig yod pa de phyin ci dgos byung / gsang phur sgom chen bzang ba zhig gis kyang rmi bltas las gsal bar mthong ste dar cog mang po btsugs nas gnas 'di 'drar sprul sku myur du 'byon no zhes bsgrags/ yon bdag mo mgon rgyas bya bas de'i steng gi nam mkhar nyi zla zung gi bar du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na chos rje rin po che bzhugs par mthong / yon bdag mo sangs rgyas bya bas kyang yul der chos rje yang yang du phebs pa sogs kyi rmi lam mthong zhing yul phyogs de dag gi nad dang 'khrug pa chad de lo legs/ khyim de la rtag tu 'ja' 'od dang me tog 'byung bas khyim de nyid du 'khrung par yang thams cad kyis shes/yab la 'gran sems yod pa'i sngags pa gcig gnyis phrag dog dang zur za byed/de ltar lhums na gnas pa'i mdzad pas skye 'gro mgu bar byas te shing pho byi ba'i lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyi shar la bltams/ sa cung zad g.yo ba dang me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od dang dri bzang yul khams khyab pa byung /sngags pa phrag dog byed pa de bud med kyi rmi lam du bud med rgyan can mang pos 993

gzims khang la phyag bskor byed pa dang khyad par rgyan shin tu bzang ba bakhris mar me thogs te bskor ba byed pa yang yang rmis pas phyin chad dad gus dang zhabs tog byas so/ /'khrungs lo la nye gnas shāka 'od kyis bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar las khrag mig glang gi lo la zhes pa snang yang khrag mig ni mig dmar gyi 'gyur khyad yin pas de ni me yos dang rab byung sbyor ba'i tshe shing byi yin pas glang ma yin la/ rje snyag phu pas/ phag gi lo la kho bo 'chi tshul ston/ /byi ba'i lo la myang 'dam phyogs su skye/ /'brug gi lo la gzhan don byed do zhes/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin byon la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa tshad mar byas so/ /de ltar lhums na bzhugs pa nyid nas chos rje rin po che nyid sku dngos su byon par thams cad kyis yid 'ches shing rtsod med du bkur ba las bltams ma thag tu yul gyi skye bo dag gis bkur sti mtha' yas pas mchod cing bltams nas zla phyed na slob dpon chen po ku'i gung pas ja 'dren du phyis mkhan chen mgon blon par grags pa dbon po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dpon g.yog btang ste phye mar na bza' la sogs pa mang du phul yum gyi pang na bzhugs pa las dbon po la zhal 'dzum dang mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du mdzad/ dbon po'i mdzub mo la 'jus nas pang du byon mnyes par mdzad pas the tshom dang bral bar yid 'ches/ de nas ring po ma lon par slob dpon chen po nyid kyis drung gong ma'i dngul 'bum chen mo kong por bzhengs pa mtshur phur spyan 'dren pa dang lhan cig tu byon te zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig la mjal/ 'khrungs nas zla ba drug lon pa tsam yin yang ja zhal zhus pa la phyag gis reg mdun du bu ram drangs pa na bcab nas gsol/ bzhad cing mnyes par mdzad/ der dbu zhwa na bza' gser dngul gyi gsol zhal sder bzhugs stan sogs phul nas bla ma shāka 'od pa dpon g.yog sku'i rim gro bar bzhag khong rnams kyis sku rim du zla ba re la 994

yum rgyas 'bring bsdus ba/sum bskal bzang la sogs pa 'i gsung sgrog gtsug tor stong bzlog rnam 'joms tshe chog sogs ma chag par 'bad cing / zla ba dgur sku mtshams dam par bcad de mjal mi rnams la gsol ras dang na bza'i byin rlabs tsam las ma gnang / 'di dag gi tshe stan la skyil krung brtan por bzhugs kyi gog po ye mi mdzad/ glang lo'i zla ba dang po'i yar tshes kyi snga dro zhig drung na yod pa rnams yengs pa'i bar la ji ltar bzhengs ma mthong ba la phar cham tshur cham mdzad nas bzhad cing 'dug pa la gog ma dgos par 'byon thub pa lags /sam zhus pas 'gro thub gsungs/ rnam thar shāka 'od ma na 'di la stag lo zer ba 'dug kyang gong gi lo ming 'phyugs snang ba des lan pas 'di 'khrungs nas zla ba bdun song ba'i skabs yin/ yang khang pa'i ka sgrog gseg ma'i bar lag pa thar tsam gyi zang zing can zhig yod pa la sku rtsed kyis phar thal tshur thal du 'byon zhing gda' bas shāka 'od kyis de ltar ma mdzad sku bsnad 'ong zhus pas/ bla ma ba de 'dra'i thugs khral mi 'tshal nga rang bde mor 'gro 'phro yod pa gsungs/ yang gnam g.yos nas ser ba phrum phrum byung ba la gzigs nas sdigs mdzub dang phu mdzad pas ser rkang skad cig gis yu la gzhan du 'gyur te 'di lta bu lan mang du mdzad/ nyin gcig shāka 'od la slob dpon chen po bod nas 'ong yod ja 'dren la song gsungs te de ma thag phyin pas nyi zla thang du mjal/ slob dpon chen pos drung du mjal te dbus gtsang gi 'bri gdan tshal pa sogs yon bdag bu slob so so nas ja 'dren 'bul ba rnams phul te rtse lha sgang du byon/ drung nyid de kur bzhugs mtshur phu rkarma nags phu sogs phyogs 'di dang 'di na yod/ de rnams kyi tshul 'di ltar yod ces nges pa dang bcas te gsungs/ slob dpon chen po slar byon par thos pa nas bla ma yab sogs ja 'dren la song ba zhag mang du 'gor ba la da nam 'ong zhus pas/ phyag mdzub 995

gnyis brkyangs te zhag 'di na 'ong gsung ba de bzhin byung / zla ba bzhi bzhes tshe drung na rim bzhi'i mtshan smos te de rnams gang na bzhugs zhus pas thugs kur phyag mdzub gtad de 'di na gsungs/ khyed lags sam zhus pas yin yin gsungs nas bzhad/ yon bdag theb grol la sogs pa nad kyis gzir ba du ma la byin rlabs mdzad de 'di tsam na phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa bzhin so sor byung / sgang pa nyang por byon pa yun ring du song / da nye bar byon nam zer nas ja 'dren la 'gro zhus pas 'gro ma ran gsungs/ zla phyed tsam na shāka 'od la da song dang khyed la gser zhig kyang ster bar 'dug gsungs te ci gar mjal zhing de bzhin du byung / slob dpon chen po sogs phebs nas mjal/bzhugs pa'i khri chung zhig yod pa de mtho bar gyis gsungs nas slar yang brtsigs/ thams cad la phyag tshol gsung zhing phyag dbang yang yang du mdzad cing bzhad/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin nas drung gong ma gnyis la rta brgya 'bul du ma byas pa'i yon bdag chen po rgan mo blo bde'i bu brgyud a dpal sogs kyis rta brgya 'bul byed pas phebs par zhu zhu bar yong ba la gzigs ma thag yon bdag dpyal pa phyin 'dug ang gsungs te de lta bu ni bgrang gis mi lang / spyir yang bus ba chung ngu la sdas smra ba slob pa ltar rang gi tshul sbas nas de dang mthun par ma bstan na ha cang spyod yul ma mtshungs pa'i phyir snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba 'dul mi nus pas 'jig rten mthun 'jug 'di lta bu ston par zad kyi bdag nyid chen po 'di dag gi rang bzhin la bstos na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la me khyer gyi 'od tsam du mthong nas bsngags pa ltar zad do/ /rtogs ldan rin po che mkha' spyod pas sprul sku mjal bar byon te 'bul ba mang po dang sngon gyi dbu zhwa phul ba na phyag gis blangs te dbu la bsnabs pa na dbu la yangs dog gi skyon med par 'tshams pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ tsā ri nags phu skog phreng rtse lha sgang pa rnams 996

so sos spyan 'dren nan tan zhus pa na nyid kyis thog mar nyang po dang nab/sa phur 'gro gsung zhing gzhan yang dad ldan so sos nye lam du spyan drangs shing bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher spel/ lam rnams su rlung dmar chen po byung ba na phyag mdzub bstan pas gzhan du byol te 'gro/ sloze dpon chen pos gtsos pa'i sgang pa rnams kyang e thang du phebs/ der seng ge'i khri la spyan drangs te rim pas nags phu la sogs par byon zhing so sor sngon tshul mang du gsungs shing gdul bya rnams nges pa 'drongs/ shāka 'od rta rbab kyis rtsib ma chag pa la phyag reg pa tsam gyis nad zug zhi ste de ma thag sos/ dgun gangs la chen po zhig la na bza' srab mo rkyang pa zhig bsnabs nas gshegs shing sku gzi 'od du 'bar/ tshad rong dro sar dbyar sos na bza' mang du brtsegs nas sku bser bser ltar mdzad/ long po lcags mkhar dang nye ba'i thang du bzhugs pa na zhabs 'chag par byon nas lam las mi ring ba na pha bong chen po zhig la sku rtsed du phyag lcag phyogs du ma nas btsugs pas phur bu'i shul lta bu byung ste bar bye ba gses shig gsungs/ bses pa'i bar nas srog chags glo ba 'dra ba khru gang tsam la phyi srog chags nag po dang nang dkar po til 'bru tsam gyis them ber du gang ba byung ste ljags mchil btab/ ting 'dzin gtad pas mod la shi nas 'ja' zug me tog gi char byung / ro de bsreg sbyang mdzad/ de'i rgyu zhus pas sngon rol pa'i rdo rje'e dus yul 'di'i gshin gson gyi dkor za ba'i bla ma zhig gis ngan song langag 'dren par zhus nas khas blangs pa yin/ de'i srog chags nag po rnams khos gshin zas zos pa'i gshin po rnams dang dkar po rnams gson dkor zos pa rnams lan chags snyag pa'i phyir lus la za ba yin/ de thams cad nga sa khas blangs ltar bde ba can du drangs pa yin zhengo5 gsung zhing de'i pha bong phyed bshags kyi nang phan tshun la srob/ chags de'i shul gsal por yod pa zhig da lta 997

mngon sum du yod do/ /'di kha cig rje rang byung ba'i dus su srog chags de drangs pa dang sdigs pa'i shul snang zhes kyang thos la rnam thar rnams la mi snang ngo / /zho khar 'phan chen mjal zhing bkur sti mdzad/ gnas gzhir bzhugs tshe rtogs ldan rin po che de ring phebs zer nas sgar pas grabs byas/ khyad par dge bshes shāka rdor bya bas drung du yang yang zhus pas mthar de ring mi 'byon/ sang nged dang lam na 'phrad gsungs te de kho na ltar byung nas sang nyin khong la gzigs te nga e bden par 'dug gsungs te de phyin zhu mi spobs par gyur/ yang shāka 'od la khyed kyis 'di skad kyis gsungs te/ 'gro ba'i don la bsams bzhin du/ /dge ba'i phyogs la 'god pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te de phyin yul gru thams cad du rim par byon/ gar phebs thams cad du ri rgya klung rgya/ chos rgya dkar pos thams cad bde legs dang ldan pa srong btsan gyi 'phrin las ltar mdzad/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du yon bdag gis rta bzang po brgya 'bul dang / skye bo khri phrag mang po la sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i ston mo byas pa'i nyin nam mkha' la nyi zla skar gsum 'dzoms pa la me tog gi char kha ba ltar bab/ snye bor spyan drangs pa na zhabs rjes du ma byon/ g.yang kha steng du phebs pa na chos skyong rnams kyis bsu ba'i tshul gzigs te de'i tshul yang mdzad/ dad can gyi longs spyod rgya mtsho ltar 'phyur/ de'i tshe slob dpon chen po la 'di skad zlos shig gsungs te/ 'gro rnams dge ba'i phyogs la 'god pa'i phyir/ /thams cad chos kyi phyogs su gtong ba yin/ /gyis gsung ba na slob dpon chen pos kyang dgongs pa mkhyen te phyi nang thams cad du sku rim la yo byad thams cad bkye ste don ldan da mdzad/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi gzigs pa grangs las 'das mod kyang cung zad re bka' bstsal zhing de dag gi rnam 'gyur la sogs pa gsungs/ a ma yum slebs byung sgo phye zhes lan kha cig gsungs pa'i mthar bsdo 998

ba mdzad cing snang ba dang dus mtshungs su yum gshegs par snang / than pa byung ba na bka' shog dang bden tshig sogs kyis de ma thag char chen byung ba ches mang / sbru/la lo dgung lo drug bzhes pa lkog phreng na bzhugs tshe shāka 'od la kurma phyogs nas mi mang po yong gi 'dug gsung nas zhag 'ga' na sibhu ba 'byon pa'i skad byung / ja 'dren la myur du song gsung ba na 'o thang gru khar phebs pa dang 'grig de nas drung du mjal zhing mchod sprin cher mdzad/ de ma thag 'bri gdan tshal pa sogs dbus gtsang gi bdag po thams cad kyis gdan 'dren 'bul ba so so dang mtshur phu go'i shri bzang po rin chen sogs byon/gong nas rgya'i rgyal po'i ja 'dren dbu zhwa dang chos gying gi phreng ba sogs 'bul nod rgya chen bla ma lo tsā bas phul so so nas gdan 'dren gyi zhu ba drag par phul ba'i tshe/ spyan 'dren pa kun 'dzoms sar nged sngon la gamar 'gro ba yin gsungs pas dpon po bzang po rin grub pas sngon la mtshur phur 'byon dgos zhal bzhes mdzod/ mi mdzad na ngas khri thog tu sdod pa yin zer nas zhu phod byas pas/ khyed kyis cang mi shes nged gar 'gro nged rang mkhas gsungs nas bka' bkyon dang phyag 'jug mdzad pas thams cad zhum zhing drung nyid ji ltar dgongs pa las zhus stabs su mi 'gro bar go /'di phyin nas skye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pa la chos gang 'dod thogs pa med par gsungs/ thog mar slob dpon chen po la phyag chen chos drug sbyor drug la sogs pa'i khrid lung dbang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/ rtogs ldan rin po che la nag rgyal phag gsum sogs brgyud pa'i zab chos mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs nyams su bzhes pas spangs rtogs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ ba yo dang dgon sar gyi bar du byon te gzhan don rgya cher mdzad/ drung gong ma'i rtsa ba'i slob ma dang sgar dpon yin zhing ba yo sogs kyi gzhis pa yang mdzad rtse lha sgang du khyams la rje dus mkhyen gyi rnam thar brgya 999

rtsa ma'i ri mo dang ba yor drung gong ma'i sku yang kho rang gis phyag bzo mdzad pa gter bton sangs rgyas gling pas spyan drangs/ phyag gi gser gyi pa tra dang rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sba lcag khong gi phyag na yod pa la/ khyed la nga'i pa tra dang sba lcag yod pa khyer shog ces gsungs nas phul/ khyod kyis sba lcag nas bcad 'dug ang gsungs pas zhabs la gtugs shing bshums/ dgung lo bdun pa lcags rta zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig la rtse lha sgang du tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa phebs te mkhan po snyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po dang las slob dgra bcom pa yon tan blo gros sogs mkhas btsun gyi dge 'dun 'dus par rab byung dang dge tshul bzhes te mtshan chos dpal bzang por gsol zhing phyis dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa'i chu rta la gnas de nyid du mkhan slob de nyid dang dad pa'i dge slong sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa brgyad bcu'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs par dge slong gi dngos po bzhes/ bod du dge slong gi las gral byung ba la bzang zhing mang bar grags/ so so'i phyag gi tshe bar bar dus 'ja' li la sku brten pa'i ngal gso mdzad dgos pa byung skad/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char byung / snyag phu ba chen po 'di ni nyid kyis 'phags pa'i gnas brtan ba ku lar zhal gyis bzhes/rje rol ba'i rdo rje la chos du ma gsan zhing rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla ma yi na yang thugs dad slob ma gzhan las che ste lhag bsam ma'i bstod pa mdzad/ snga phyir mkhan slob las 'dul ba'i phyogs mtha' dag dang jo gdan gyi chos skor mtha' dag dang gzhung lugs chen po du ma ba/san/ slob dpon bka' bzhi ba las kyang gzhung lugs mtha' dag sbyang ba'i tshul mdzad/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa chu spre zla ba brgyad pa'i bco lnga la zho kha nas phyag bteg ste bra shod ri bo che ngom rnams su mchog dman rnams smin grol la bkod/ bya lo zla ba dang po la garmar phebs/ skye 'gro mtha' yas pa chos kyis btul/ rke rags pa/ rga a nyan pa/1000

shar rke'i dpon chen khro bo rgyal/ khri dpon da ra kha che/ go 'gyo dpon chen nam mkha' 'od zer sogs lha sde mi sde'i gtso bo thams cad kyis spyan drangs/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ so sor ngo mtshar gyi ltas mtha' yas/ 'brog tu byon pa'i lam zhig tu mjal mi 'gas drung gi rnam thar zhig zhu zhus pas/ skye 'chi med par sems la dbang thob kyang / /dbang med 'khor ba'i 'gro ba sgrol slad du/ /snying rje'i dbang gi srid par nying mtshams sbyor/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mdzad pa rgyun mi chad/ de la gyis gsungs/ 'bom mtsho phyug mo'i 'gram du bden tshig gis char phab cing gzhan phan cher mdzad/ go 'gyo'i yul du cha ga pa'i dmag gis gnod pa chen po byung ba bka' shog bsgrags pas chad/ pu 'bor ba'i spyan 'dren nan tan slebs pa la phyis kyi zhal bzhes mdzad de slar kong por phebs nas bsnyen rdzogs dang 'gro don mdzad/ sngar hor gyi rgyal po tho gan thi mur gyis lo so lnga rgyal sa mdzad/ rje rol ba'i rdo rje bod la phebs nas lo lnga na rgya'i ngo log byung bas gong ma hor yul la byon te rgya nag gi rgyal po ba'i jus rgyal sa cung zad dang / de nas ta'i ming rgyal po chen pos rgya hor mi nyag thams cad kyi rgyal po mdzad/ rgyal khams thams cad bde/ chos rje rin po che'i snyan pas thugs phrogs te spyan 'dren yang yang du btang zhing khyad par du/ bla ma khyed kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos zab mo mkhyen pa'i don la nub phyogs kyi sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa kun kyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang gus par sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu'i/ khyed thabs shes rab yon tan 'phrin las ca chog gi dngos grub ma thob na de bzhin du sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po la la 'byung / nged sngar byang phyogs su yod pa'i dus su/ khyed kyi mtshan bzang po thos nas lan gcig mjal bsam pa'i sems bzhin da lta go sa chen po la bzhugs/ yul dbus kyi rgyal khams kun bde bar 'dug yun ring 1001

du bsams pa la mun pa bsal ba lta bu drin mnyam pa nyid phan yon thun mong du mdzad dgos/ sngar shākya thub pas thugs rjes bzung nas sems can thams cad kyi don byed/ thub pa'i chos kyi dngos grub zab mo thob ba'i don la/ khyed thub pa'i thugs dang gnyis su med par 'dug pas yul dbus 'dir byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang rgyal khams kyi phan bde la dgongs nas nged kyis sngar bsams pa bzhin rjes su 'brengs nas/ bla ma khyed cis kyang 'byon par mdzod/ sngar gyi rgyal pos yul dbus kyi rgyal khams bde ba'i sgo nas bcos pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dad pa sngon du 'gro ba/ nged kyi yab tha'i rgyal po hu hang dang dad pa can gyi btsun mo hu hāng bu gnam la gshegs nas yun ring / drin gsab dgos pa thabs gang yang ma rnyed/ bla ma khyed thabs shes 'phrin las kyi sgo nas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i don gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid yin par 'dug cis kyang myur bar byon nas 'das pa rnams la sgrol pa'i cho ga sgrub pa'i don la da lta'i li skyam/ sha'u skyam/ hu'u rkyen la sogs pa mngags nas yi ge'i rten bskur gdan 'dren song yod/ bla mas thugs rjes bzung la mnyes par mdzod la myur du 'byon pa zhu/ yi ge'i rten gyi dngu'/ bre chen gsum la srang brgya dang lnga bcu/ gos yug mdog mi 'dra ba phyi bcu/ nang dar mdog mi 'dra ba bcu/ tsan+dan dum cig spos dkar rgya ma bcu/ zu'u hang spos rgya ma gang / ja dkar rgya ma brgya dang lnga bcu/ sna drug yun lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang chen po nas bris/ ces pa'i lung gdan drangs pa'i gser yig pa rnams kyi snga 'phar byung bas dbus su phebs/ 'bri gdan dang sne'u bas zhabs tog cher byas/ lha sa dang mtshur phur phebs/ rim pas byang lam brgyud nas 'gro don rgyun mi chad par dgung lo nyer gsum pa me khyi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum la lha steng dang tshes brgyad la kurmar phebs te 1002

der rgya'i mi chen rnams kyis mjal lung dang 'bul ba bzhes/ tshes bco brgyad la bteg ste rke stong dang ker rgyang du zhag nyer lnga tsam bzhugs te bdag po chen po kon ting go'i shri dang cha'u thob pa sogs mi chen dang smar khams kyirage 'dun mtha' yas pa thams cad dad par mdzad/ shar kha'i skye bo mtha' ya sa pas mjal/ de nas tshugs drug gis 'bri chu'i klong thang gi gru brgal/ gling tshang gi 'bul ba mtha' yas/ ra rgya gru so'i bar la tshugs bcu/ khrom bu rong bar du tshugs bcu drug khrom bu ba rnams kyis rta lnga brgya dus gcig tu phul/ de nas tshugs gcig na ta'i zhing chen po gdan 'dren la slebs/ tshugs gnyis kyis ga chur byon/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la ga chu nas bteg ste 'jam tshugs na gsum nyi ma na gnyis kyis shing kun tu phebs/ tshugs gnyis kyis chu ma mkhar/ de nas 'jam tshugs bcu dgu na zam shing rgyal bus mjal/ 'jam tshugs nyi shu na pan yang rgyal bus mjal/ 'di thams cad du 'bul ba zhabs tog dad gus mtha' yas shing thams cad du zla lam lhag pa'i skye bo 'dus/ 'jam tshugs bcu bzhi na hung mang du dge 'dun mtha' yas pas mchod pa'i sprin spros 'jam tshugs gsum na chu gun pho brang gi rgyal bu gnyis kyis nga/jal/ 'jam tshugs gsum nas pho brang gi mdun na chu chen snang ba'i gru kha re na shan stong phrag gsum re 'dug gom pa sum brgya drug bcu la sa le bar rer rtse gru'i nang du khang bzang rgyan can yod par bzhugs te sa le bar sum brgya brgyad bcu'i tshod la gru'i bzhon pas byon/ chu'i phar kha nas glang po che sum bcu tsam la rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang dge 'dun khri tsho tsam gyis bsu ba byas/ nam mkha' dwangs pa la 'ja' tshon byung ba kun gyis casku thong /tshes grangs me mo phag lo zla ba dang po'i nyi shu gcig yin/ de'i nyin gong ma pho brang nas phyi'i lcags ri nang du byon/ drung du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs 1003

stong yod pa zhig phul/ ja zhal khong rang bzhengs nas mdzad cing dpon slob kun la chab tsha gnang / mchod yon mjal ba'i yi ger 'di tsam snang la da lta gsung rgyun la gong mas mngon mkhyen yod na mjal dar gcig pa bsnams yod dgongs nas phyag shubs kyi cang du dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bcug nas thog mar phul/ chos rjes kyang ca/khyen te de ma thag sku phag nas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil zhig bton nas gnang bas thugs lhag par dad/ phyis gnyi ga la gser gshog re sbran nas phul bar lta gat+t+waṃ la'i mchod rdzas kyi g.yas 'khyil mkhyed gang tsam pa gnyis po 'di yin gsungs/ mjal khang gsar du byas par de nub bzhugs/ sang tho rangs nas phyag phyi ba thams cad la gos bzhi bzhi re lham re mi drag pa rnams la zhwa theb re gnang / gong ma phugs nas tshur bzhugs/rgya'i lugs g.yon che bar byed pas drung g.yon nas tshur bzhugs/ gzhan rnams mdun g.yon g.yas su bzhugs te bkur sti mdzad/ de nas gong ma pho brang du byon/ dpon slob rnams mjal khang du bzhugs/ nyi shu gnyis kyi phyi nang snga mo nas pho brang du byon te bsu ba la rgyan chas mtha' yas pa can gyis lag na gos dar gyi khang bzang dang gser g.yu'i khang bzang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phan ba dan phur ma la sogs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang glang po che dkar po gcig gzhan gnyis dang gsum la gser gyi rgyan cha the ga tshad kyis spras pa dang / gzhan glang po che sum brgya tsam la rgyan chas sna tshogs bkal ba dang / dge 'dun snam sbyar can khri tsho lnga tsam gyis lag tu me tog dang rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs pa bzung ba dang / rgyal bu chen po dgu ta'i zhing stong tsho gsum gyis mgo byas las ka can gyi mi chen 'bum tsho gcig la dmag mi 'bum tsho bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba'i la las khrab gyon la las phub khur phal cher gyis mdung bzung ba dang / gser gyi tho ba sta gri yob chen rtse gsum 1004

ral gri sogs re re'ang bzung ba brgya re dang / gser dngul gordo dar las byas pa'i nyi zla'i gzugs bzung ba bzhi stong tsam 'dug de nas pho brang gi sgor gong ma chen po nyid bsu ba la byon/ phyi na gsu ba'i bkod pa ci 'dug nang na yang 'dug cing khyad par gser gyi khrab rmog kho na gyon pa nyis brgya tsam 'dug mjal 'dzom gyi khang pa de'i sgo lhor lta ba rim pa lnga'i nang ma gser 'ba' zhig las byas pa gser thog gser ka can bod kyi ka ba so gnyis kyi mal la phyogs bzhi gar sgo sum ral re 'dug mchod yon bzhugs lugs sngar ltar mdzad/ drung gi ma tshad du bla ma rnam gsum gra pa rnams g.yon phyogs su bzhagasgo bzhir gser khrab gyon pa lnga bcu re/ gong ma'i g.yas g.yon du phub khur mda' gzhu btags pa bzhi bcu tsam re 'dug zas sna mtha' yas pa'i gung tshigs gnang / de nas gong ma'i mdun du rtsed sna rnams mus kyis yong 'duga'abyon dus gong ma mchod yon sgo dbus ma la byon nged rnams g.yon la 'gro ba bcol/ gong mas pho brang gi sgo'i bar du bskyal/ sngar gyi bsu ba rnams kyis dgon gyi bar bskyal/ spyir hor dus nas pho brang na kur sde mang du yod mod kyang khyad par du rgya lugs kyi bkod pa can gyi lcags ri phyir ling gu si'i sde dang nang du tā tu kur sde gsar du btab pa la bzhugs gnas mdzad/ 'di gnyis dang ri bo rtse lnga'i kur sde rnams la bla ma'i sko bzhag sgar nas phyi mo'i bar mdzad bzhin du yod 'dug cing gtsug lag khang bla brang dang bcas pa'i deb rtse lha sgang na 'dug pa yang bdag gis mthong / phyi nyin nyi shar tsam la gong ma dgon du tshur byon/ drung gis gzims khang gi nang sgo dang bla ma rnams kyis bar sgo nas bsus/ 'bul ba la rta dkar po gsum la chibs sga bstad pa/ gzhan rta dkar po bco brgyad/ 'di la rgya nag na rta dkar po mchog tu byed la sngon po rgas pa'i dkar po min par thog ma nas dkar po yin/ gser bre bdun/ dngul bre sum 1005

bcu rtsa bdun/ gos yug brgya lhag nga sar sig sum bcu/ ga ḍā ra gyi rdor dril bco lnga/ gser gyi bum pa gnyis/ dngul gyi bum pa lnga/ ka nge garngo dngul gyi ting man+ti cha/ gser dngul gyi pad sder lnga re/ gzhan yang mchod cha srid tshad /gser dngul gyi gsol zhal sde ra dpag med phul ba gardo la'i 'bul ba yin pa'i lung byung / nyi shu gsum gyi nang par yin/ nyer bzhi la bla ma rnam gsum gyis mgo byas pa'i phyag phyi ba rnams pho brang du shog gsungs te pho brang gi khyams su mjal kha btang/ phyag re re las mi dgos pa'i lung byung / 'brong bu go'i shi ba/ slob dpon dkar bzhi ba rin chen dpal/ mkhan chen ma gon blon pa ste bla ma rnam gsum la dngul bre phyed gsum pa re/ gser gyi mchod cha rgyas pa re/'phyar dar re/ gtor cha re/ gos sbyor re/ gsol zhal sder re/ gos phyi nang bcu gnyis re/ cha'u nyis stong re/ rdo dril cha bzhi re/ phreng dkar re rnams gnang / gra pa spyi la rab rnams la dngul bre chen re/ cha'u brgyad brgya re/gos yug drug re/ dar yug drug re gnang / 'bring rnams la dngul bre sum gnyis re/ gos dar yug drug re/ cha'u bzhi brgya re/ tha ma rnams la dngul bre phyed re/gos dar yug bzhi re/ cha'u sum brgya re/ thams cad la phreng dkar re/ gos sbyor re/ rdor dril cha gnyis re gnang / nyer bdun gyi nang par gong ma drung gi gzims khang du byon te tsan+da dkar po las bzhengs pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong brkyangs khru do yod pa cig dang de'i mchod cha dngul kong sogs dngul spyad dang shel gyi mchod cha mtha' yas par phul/ de nas zla ba phyi ma'i yar tshes gcig la lo gsar byas pa la/ 'di ltar na hor zla gnyis pa la deng sang gi rgya'i zla ba dang po byed yod par snang / drung nas dbu mdzad dpon slob thams cad tho rengs nas pho brang gi shar sgo nas yar byon nas khyams shig tu bzhugs/ gong ma der drung du byon nas ja zhal mdzad/ nam nangs pa dang pho 1006

brang gi phyogs bzhi ga nas khyams kyi dben chen po yod pa'i nang du gong ma la las ka can gyi me chen 'bum phrag lnga tsam gyis phyag 'bul 'dug stag gnyis / bse lnga/ g.yi —dkar gnyis/ glang po che brgya tsam dang lag cha sngar bsu ba ba la byung rnams re re'ang stong stong 'dug mdung bzung khrub gyon pa 'bum tsho re re 'dug gar pa nyis brgya tsam gyis mgo byas rtsed sna mi gcig pa stong tsam 'dugade rnams la mchod yo na gyis yud tsam gzigs nas pho brang du byon te sngar ltar bzhugs/ ston mo bzang po gnang / de phyin gra pa rnams kyis phyag mi dgos pa'i lung byung / rtsed mo ba thams cad rim pa ltar mchod yon gyi mdun du 'ong bcug nas rtsed mo dang glu gar rol mo rnams byed cing rim pas phyir song / dgong mo phyir byon pa la gong mas sgo gsum bar du bskyal/ rgyal bu rnams kyis dgon par bskyal/ gong mas mi chen de thams cad la ston mo gnang / yang bco lnga'i nang par dpon slob nyi shu spyan drangs te rtsed mo ston mo rnams sngar bzhin 'dug de nub pho brang gyi khyams chen po der me'i me tog dang bkra shis rtags brgyad soṭa me rtsed kyi rigs mang po dang rtsed mo'i rigs 'bum phrag tsam 'dug pa la gziṭa/srod tsam na dgon par phebs/ gzims khang gi sgor yang de dang 'dra ba'i mchod pa dang rtsed sna sna tshogs pa 'dug de nas nyi ma thams cad la gong ma la chos rim par gsungs/ nyi shu lnga la dpon slob thams cad pho brang du spyan drangs shar sgo nas gser khang du dang por byon/ de nas sngar gyi mjal 'phrad byas sar byon spyan gzigs drangs/ drung du dngul srang stong la dngul bre lnga byas pa dang 'bu' ba mang du mdzad/ rtsed mo dang sngar gyi rnams pha'/ cher 'dug khyad par spre nag ṇa/nga thang dang spre dkar rta bzhon sogs 'dug pa la nub sgo nas gzigabashe mo mdzad/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes lnga nas dkyil 'khor phyi nang rnams kyi thig btab pa la drung gis rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rin po ches phur pa/ bka' bzhi 1007

bas gsang 'dus/ dpon po bas mi tra/ gzhan rnams kyis rdor dbyings chos dbyings gsung dbang / dgyes rdor/ rje btsun ma/ kun rig sman bla/sgrol chog thugs rje chen po'i gzungs sgrub sogs dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bzhengs/ dbu 'dzugs la gong ma byon nas drung du rnam gsum tshang ma'i 'bul ba dang / bla ma rnams la gos phyi nang bzhi re/ gzhan dkyil 'khor re la gos phyi nang re/ gong ma'i phyag gis blangs nas gnang / tshes bco brgyad kyi bar du cho ga mdzad pa la nyin gcig bzhin gong ma yab yum byon pa la drung gis dbang bskur re mdzad/ gzhan rnams kyis sgrol chog mdzad/ tshes bcu bzhi la 'ja'i gur phub/ gong ma mchod yon gyis gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal gzigs shing rgya'i mi dpon gsum gyis kyang mthong / shing sdong po gcig gi mgo la bdud rtsi bab/ shug pa gcig gi mgo la gser gyi me tog skyes/ spyir cho ga'i dbu tshugs nas ma thon gyi bar du 'ja' 'od sna tshogs /'khrug pa dang me tog gi char nyin gcig bzhin bab pa skye bo thams cad kyis mthong ngo / /bcu dgu'i mtshaca/ mo gong ma'i yum gyi mtshan byang drung gis bzhu/ gzhan rnams kyis rdul tshon rgya mtshor skyel ba'i tshe glang po che la rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang dge 'dun bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pas bskyal/ slar drung gis gong ma la bkra shis brjod/ sang du 'bul ba la gser bre dgu dngul bre bco brgyad la sogs rgya cher phul/ bla ma rnam gsum la gos phyi nang cha dgu re dngul bre chen gsum re cha'u stong re rta gsum re dar khang la gos yug brgyad re dar yug lnga bcu re/chos dbyings pa rdor dbyings pa gnyis la dar khang la dar yug bdun bcu re/kun rig pa sogs gzhan rnams la dar khang yug lnga bcu re/ cho ga ba gra pa re re la dngul srang bcu gsum re/ gos yug bzhi re cha'u phyed dang bzhi brgya re gnang / yang tshes nyi shu nas pho brang du spyan drangs te dkyil 'khor bzhengs 1008

nas tshe dpag med kyi dbang gong ma la mdzad/ zla ba phyi ma'i yar tshes brgyad la chos drug gi khrid dbu btsugs nas gong mas nyams len mdzad/ phyag dpe bsgyur nas phul/ zla ba de'i nang du drung de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che chos kyi rgyal po nub phyogs kyi byams pa chen po zhi ba dbang phyug gi sangs rgyas/ zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ gser srang brgya las brdungs pa'i 'ja' sa dang shel gyi phyag tham yid bzhin nor bu phul/ bla ma rnam gsum la go'i shri chen po'i las ka gser gyi tham ka shel gyi tho shu gnang / rgya ban stong tsam gyis nyes pa byas pa'i don la btson du bzung nas shi ba'i nyen 'dug pa zhal ta bam̐dzad de srog bskyabs/gzhan yang snga rting du rgyal khams chen por yod pa'i nag can btson du gang yod la nan cher zhal ta mdzad pa'i don du snga rting gsum du yangs pa'i lung shes byed ban bon zin shing sogs chos lugs so so thams cad rang rang gi lugs tshul bzhin du gyis gnam mchod 'di thams cad la sus kyang btser ba ma byed/ byas na so so'i rgan pas nged la 'phral du gtugs khrims lugs ji ltar byed pa nged kyis shes zhes sogs bstan pa shed skyed kyi lung 'ja' sa rgyal khams thams cad du gnang / phag gru pa la dbang gi las ka dang gser gyi tham ka sngon du song / gling dang gon gyo la dbang gi las ka dang tham ka gnang / zla ba bzhi pa'i nang du drung gis rtse lngar dbyar bzhugs mdzad de de nas gong ma yab sras kyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram bar skyel ma mdzad de slar bod du byon no zhes mchod yon mjal ba'i yi ge na 'di tsam las ma bris snang la/ spyir tha'i dzu rgyal po bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab pa des ta'i zhing chen po mngags nas dang por bismri pa spyan drangs/ding phon bzang po chung tshang dbu chings dang sham thabs chung ngur phul/ de nas gnas brtan bcu drug spyan drangs pa la ding phon che ba bla gos dang mthang gos su phul/ phyis rje de bzhin gshegs pa spyan 'dren par bzhed pa'i tshe sku gshegs 1009

pas de'i sras ta'i ming rgyal po chen pos yab yum gyi thugs dgongs rdzogs dgos par yang dgongs khyad par rgyal po 'di 'jam dpal gyi sku'i ngalod pa yin yang / lhag par btsun mo dam pa sgrol ma'i sprul pa des dbe/ ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bya ba byas pa ste/ rgyal po'i bgyi ba chen pos g.yengs/ dam pa'i chos las re zhig g.yel bar gyur tshe mnal lam du po ṭa lar spyan ras gzigs mjal du 'gro bar brtsams nas ri la 'dzegs pas ngal te ldog par 'dod tshe ut+pal sngon po che zhing mtho ba rgyas pa zhig 'dug pa la bzang po'i stabs kyis ngal bsos nas slar phyin pa na ri rtser thugs rje chen po dang mjal byin gyis rlabs pa'i snang ba byung / de nas btsun mo dam pa des dam pa'i chos la bskul/ chos kyi rje spyan 'dren pa yang mnyel bsos pas gong mas kyang nga'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni btsun mo 'di yin zhes rtag tu bsngags pa mdzad skad/ cho ga mdzad pa'i tshes so so la 'ja' sprin glang po che dang seng ge sogs sna tshogs pa'i gzuṭa dang / bas ha'o zhes bya tshe ring byung ba dang / me tog gi char tha dad bab pa dang / rab tu byung ba sngon ma mthong ba du ma dkyil 'khor khang pa la bskor ba byed cing de ma thag sprin gyi steng na snang ba sogs dgra bcom pa mang du mthong ba dang / sprin gseb tu sangs rgyas byang sems snang ba dang / lhas mchod pa mngon sum du mthong ba sogs dang / khyad par tha ma'i nyin nub phyogs nas gser gyi 'od chen po byung bas rgya nag gi rgyal khams thams cad khyab pa bde ba can nas tshe dpag med kyi 'od zer du gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa byung ba rnams nyin so so'i ling tse bkod/ bod rgya yu gur sogs yig rigs du ma'i zhal yig dang bcas pa dar yug chen po gcig gi dkyus tsam pa'i ngo mtshar 'ja' sa zhes gsi thang yug dril du cha/ da bhe yo da par lta/ yab yum gyi mchod rte na gyi rgyu rkyen 'bras bu rnams rab tu gnas par ma dzad/ de re re 'a/ ngo mtshar /010

mang du byung ba dang khyad par chos kyi rje pho brang nas thegs te rtse lngar bzhugs dus nyin re zhing mchod rten gyi grib ma la 'ja' 'od 'khrug ci nga rijari 'od las sku gzugs kyi rnam pa sogs ngo mtshar mang du byung ba rnams gong mas lung gi zhu yig 'phral 'phral du phul te 'di kho na'i lung yang bcu lhag cig snang ba so so nas ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi lang ba 'dugade skabs cig gong mas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mtho gang tsam pa nyi ma ltar 'bar ba gzigs/ zla ba phyi ma'i tshes de'i nyin ston pa'i tshems mche ba rgya gar gyi yul gru chung ngu zhig na bzhugs pa de gong ma'i phyag tu byung bas chos rjes rin po che'i thugs rjer mkhyen te gser gang blugs kyi ston pa'i sku ji ltar ga ziṭa pa de tsam pa byas nas rgyu mtshan de dag gi zhu ba'i lung dang bcas te phyag tu phul/ spyir gong ma nyid kyi dgongs pas dmag gi sgo nas hor dus ltar bod khrims zhabs su 'jug sa hor ltar mchod yon srid cig pas rgyal khams gnon par dgongs kyang chos rje rin po ches chos chos bzhin du bstan pas rgya dmag mdzad ma bde/ mthar gong mas bod yul de na chos rgyud mi gcig pa sna tshogs pa yod par 'dug pas de rnams rtsod pa 'ong / dmag dngos btang na chos kyi rje mi mnyes par 'dug pas gser thog gi gyo mo ga chur lus pa rnams skyel ba dang sbrags nga'i rta pa thor tsam zhig gtong / de tshos rta'i rnga sha la gyo mo re khyer bas bde bar 'drongs 'gro chos rgyud thams cad khyed rang gi lugs su 'dril/lo lo bzhin mdo khams rnam rab sgang dang dbus gtsang rnams lha sar chos 'khor chen po skor ba byed pas gnang ba zhu zhus kyang / chos rgyud cig kho nas sems can mi thul so sos mos pa bzhin sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'jug pa yin/so so rang rang gi lugs kyi chos tshul bzhin du byas na des chog pa yin gsung nas ma gnang / phyis kyang gong ma'i gser yig pa bod du yong ba 'bri khung gi 1011

rgyab se ru rong du bcom pa dang bod nas snyan phra zhu mi yang du ma byung nos rgya dmag yong la khad byung ba'i tshe phag mo gru pa'i dbang grags pa rgyal ma tshan gyis chos kyi rje'i drung du mgon med skyabs med kyis smre sngags mgo 'bul lus 'bul gyi zhu yig sum sbrengs dngos su mthong / de dag gi tshe'ang thugs byam/sa pa chen pos ni khyab/ khe grags dang dbang che 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni mi mnga'/thams cad la phan bde 'ba' zhig dgongs pas bka' rin po che yang yang du bstsal bas rgyal po chen po des kyang bla ma'i gsung gi cod pan spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkod pas rgya rna~Xs phyi ma'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs/ bod rnams tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal las bskyobs/ mdor na bod yul rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa'i bka' drin gzhal du med kyang bod yul du bka' drin du go ba ni su yang mi snang zhing cung zad bde bar bsdad chog pa 'di rang rang gi pho rgod du rlom mod/ 'di 'dra ba kho na las na rgyu 'bras mi shes pa 'di dag snying rje'i gnas kho na'o/ des na mkhan chen bsod nams bzang pos/ de nyid phyi mar skye 'gro dpag med kyi/ /'jigs skyob dge legs 'grub pa'i dus mkhyen nas/ /bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i kurma pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes gsung pa yin zhing drung rol pa'i rdo rjes ri 'di'i rtser dge slong gtsang ma zhig gi gdung sbyangs na bod la rgya dmag gi 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhes rten 'brel gyi gnad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs te sku skye ba phyi mar dngos su zlog pa yin no/ /de ltar bod yul ba 'jigs pa las bskyabs par ma zad drung 'di'i bka' drin las/ phag mo gru pa la chen ha wang bod skad du sprul pa spel ba'i rgyal bu zhes bya ba'i lung las ga 'bri khung pa chen kya'u wang bstan pa spel ba'i rgyal bu/ gtsang stag tshang pa hu kya'u wang bstan pa skyong ba'i rgyal bu/ gling tshang pa tsen shen wang dge la rton pa'i rgya' bu/ gon gyo hu kya'u wang 1012

bstan pa srung ba'i rgyal bu zhes sogs kyi lung las ka du ma banang ste bod yul bde bar mdzad do/ /spyir mchog gsum gre/ spyan drangs pa ni yab sras 'di'i dus su snang la gnas brtan bcu drug ni sngon yang byon pa dang / birlu ba phyis ye dbang gi dus su'ang byon snang ngo / /ri bo rtse lnga'i gar sder bzhugs tshe rtse lnga'i ri re re la 'jam dpal sku mdog phyag mtshan tha dad pa re gzigs shing dam pa'i chos kyi bgro ba yun ring du mdzad/ dngos grub kyi chu mib cher 'phel zhing gsar pa du ma brdol/ de ltar rgya nag hor yu gur mi nyag mdo stod smad kyi bar gyi skye bo mtha' yas pa mngon mtho dang nges legs la sbyar 'brel tshad don ldan du mdzad nas bod chung ngu'i phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur 'dam cog tse lar phebs tshe dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zhal ngo/ 'bri gdan stag gsum sogs rgya nag gi mnga' thang la bstos na dbus gtsang lho byang kun bsdoms kyang rgya'i mi dpon chung ngu'i chung ngu gcig gi 'byor pa la mi do bar snang mod/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas che ba'i phyir bod yul so so na lugs gnyis kyi bdag po bsam gyis mi khyab par bskur zhing bsnyems pa rnams kyis ja 'dren 'bul nod sdun bsu dang / rje tsong kha pa chen pos/ jo bo'i thugs dam ra sgreng gi rten khyad par can me brdugs ma rgyal ba byams pa'i sku li dmar rkang gang tsam gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba/ sangs rgyas nyid du bstod bsngags mdzad pa'i zhu yig zhabs la phyag bgyid par spro yang lo gsum gyi mtshams kyi bcad rgya zhig byas yod pa 'dis sgrub par ma nus zhu ba sogs dang / 'di tshe dge ldan btab nas lo lnga drug song ba tsam du 'dug kun mkhyen rong ston shes bya kun rig sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bzhugs so 'tshal gyis sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon par nges pa 'drongs pa'i zhu yig so so nas 'dug pa mang du bdag gis kyang mthong / 'dam gzhung la chibs rags thegs bzhin pa la sa g.yos chen po byung 1013

nas ri bo'ang rgyug par cha ba'i tshe zhal snga nas rten gazlo la myur du phob cig gsungs te sar bzhugs su gsol drung gi chibs gzhol te thub pa bdud 'dul ma'i tshul du bzhug/sa ma thag zhi ste sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa las skye 'gro skyob par mdzad/ dpal ldan mchur phu dang lha ldan gyi ljongs su phyag phebs/ jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi snam rnyu ra rin thang med par gsol/ dbus gtsang gi dgon gnas ban+dhe lnga yod pa yan thams cad la ris med du mang ja gnang sbyin bzang po dang gtsug lag khang thams cad du mchod rdzas rgya cher gnang / sngar drung rang byung ba'i dus nas tshal pas phul ba'i g.yor po dol gyi mchod gzhis rnams rje nyid kyi ca/khan po snyag phu pa la lha 'bangs su gnang ste des tshal min gyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i sde mdzad/ skyi 'phan gyi bdag po gzhis ka sne'u pas lha sa po ṭa la phul nas gzims khang mdzad nas bzhugs/ 'dir ting nge 'dzin shin tu 'phel/ ring por ma thogs par gzhan don rgya chen po gzhan zhig yong bar 'dug gsungs nas mtha' ma'i mdzad pa lung du bstan/ bod gangs can gyi skye bo mchog dman skya ser thams cad rgyun mi chad par 'dus te shākya'i dbang po dang spyan ras gzigs lhan cig pa'i zhal lta/ chos kyi 'khor lo ni gaṅgā ltar rgyun mi chad/ nyin gcig gis 'gro ba smin grol du mdzad pa yang sus bgrang par nus/ gong ma'i 'bul chen yang lan gsum du slebs pa'i gcig la kur gangs 'brug sder lnga ma 'khyil ba bdun re'am lnga re logs la yod pa/ mthil du gong ma'i mtshan gyi rgya nag gi yi ge sngo khra bzhi yod pa shubs bcas kho na mi res lag pa so sor re re bzung ba lha sa'i phyi skor chen mo la sbrengs shing de nas po ṭa lar bzhugs khri'i drung gi bar sbrengs pa phul bar grags/ spyir yang pho brang du phebs dus gsol dkar du me tog gan dkar zhes grags pa phyi nang cung zad kyang mi sgrib pa dar las kyang srab pa phul ba phyis gsol ja bas phyi ba shed 1014

ches pas 'thor te de bas cung zad thug tu btang ba'i khyad dkar du ma phul zhing de dag i/ 'og nas khyad dkar 'di mchog tu gyur pa ste bdag gis gre/zhon dus kyang 'ga' zung mthong la da ni cher mi snang mod/ 'di la bltos na deng sang gi gar gangs snang ba 'di rnams snyigs ma ltar snang ngo / /ja yang bzhes ja la pad+ma'i ge sar khyad par can dang rgya mtsho'i pha ri'i ja zhes sogs phul bar grags so/ /gan dril yang gser dmar po las rdza ma dang gser ser po las mgo rdor blug pa rdo rje pha lam gyis rwa rtse dang rwa'i logs rnams su phra byas pa dang / zi khyim las dril bu byas pa de 'dra ba sogs mang du phul ba da lta'ang phyag na du ma bzhugs te khyad dril dngos ni 'di yin la rdor dril 'di ni gong ma 'di'i dus ma gtogs rgya nag snga ma mi nyag hor gang gi dus su'ang ma byung snang ngo / khyad dril du grags pa rwa log can gzhan las legs pa 'di rnams ni bla ma rnam gsum la gnang ba'i tshan no/ /de'i tshe mdo stod smad kyi mi chen lha sde mi sde tham sa cad kyis spyan 'dren yang yang du btang / khyad par rje nyid kyi gsung las skyes pa'i slob ma'i thu bo mi nyag rab sgang gi rma se'i 'dren pa/mkhas pa mi lngar grags pa'i dge bshes khri phrag brgyad dgu'i nang na 'gran zla dang bral ba mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yon tan gzhal bar mi nus pa rab sgang nyid kyi mkhas pa mi nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa de la spyan 'dren du khyed byon na cis kyang spyan 'drongs te yong bas 'byon dgos zhes thams cad kyis zhus pas chos kyi rje rin po che spyan e 'drongs mi shes 'on kyang khyed tshos bskul pas zhal ltar 'gro gsungs nas 'bul nod mtha' yas pa dang bcas te byon/ chos rje rin po che'ang khyed dang 'phrad pa dga' gsungs nas shin tu mnyes/ khong gis dbus gtsang 'di na sgra mi snyan na bstan pa med zer yod 'dug pa der bstan pa yod par thal/ der bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu sder 1016

longs pa yod pa'i phyir te/ der gnas brtan bsku la 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i phyir/ 'di la lan thob cig ces sogs mang du bkod pa'i shog dril ring mo rdo ring dang khyams khru'i 4sgo la sbyar/ gra sa so sor bsrings pa na pū sa kyang lan 'debs mi ma byung snang bas rab dge gcig gis dbus dge de tsam zil gyis mnan snang ste lan ma thebs pa ni rtsod kyang rung ma rtsod kyang rung pham pa'i tshad du bshad pa yin no/ /de bzhin du kurma'i sibhu drung rin po ches gdan 'dren la byon/ mjal dar la kha btags nyin mo bde legs ma che ba zhig phul bas phyag gis bzhes te de gar phyag mdud gnang nas phyag gis gtad de sidhu pa 'di ma nyams par zung zhig gsungs pas dad rten sgam du bzhag mdor na grub thob chen po nyid rgyal po mo gor gan kho na'i don du byon pa ltar rje 'di yang 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang bka' 'gros pa'i 'phrin las kyis gong ma rgyal po'i don dang bod rgya dmag las skyob pa'i don kho nar byon pa yin yang gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol du zhar gyis mdzad/ sngon dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i dus su slob ma zhig la khrid mdzad pas khos ma bsgoms par nyal bsdad pas kho'i khang thog nas dbu rib tsam sku stod rib tsam yang yang gzigs phyis kho drung du byung dus zhal 'dzum 'dzum mang du mdzad pas skrag ste tshul bzhin du bsgoms pas sgom chen ches bzang ba zhig byung / de lta bu'i thabs mkhas dang thugs rje phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa las slob ma rtogs ldan gzhan don nus pa thon pa ni rje 'di kho na mang bar grags la spyir gzhan las rmad du byung ba ngo snatshar gyi mdzad pa brgya rtsa brgyad bstan par grags so/ /de ltar sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams 'dul bar mdzad nas sgar pa kha cig gis mi srun pa'i spyod pa byung ba na rma se rtogs ldan gyis 'di pa la drag po'i bka' bkyon re tsam zhu zhus pas kho bo la zhe sdang skye ma myong bas khro mi shes par 'dug 'on kyang khyed 1016

kyi bsam pa gang ba zhig myur du bya'o zhes gsung ba 'dis sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang bar ngag sgros las 'chad/ mdor na mkhas pa thams cad kyi the tshom bsal/ bsam gtan pa thams cad yang dag pa'i lta sgom la bkod/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mi chen thams cad la phyag gis dbang bskur zhing chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ mthong thos dran reg la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag ste mdo khams kyi spyan 'dren pa rnams la yang myur du 'phrad par bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas dgung lo so gnyis pa shing mo lug gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i yar ngo la bsnyun drag po zhig byung ba na brtan bzhugs phul bas rten 'brel zhig gis mdo khams kurma'i nye logs su 'dun pa btang zin der gsol ba thob thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin gsung ba dang / gzims dpon la dpe cha lha rten rnams ma 'thor ba gyis bdag po zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs te zla ba brgyad pa'i bco lnga'i nyin dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su sdu bar mdzad cing mkhan chen rin po che bsod bzang po sogs phebs te mchod pa'i bya ba mdzad/ sku gdung rin po che zhugs la bzhen pa na yang ring bsrel las grub pa'i bde dgyes kyi sku sogs dpag med byon la lha sa'i skor gyi nam mkha' mtha' dag zla ba du ma'i bar du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad/ mchod sbyin gyi dge rtsa spel ba'ang garmar cung rgyas pa dang de 'og mtshur phu de 'og dge 'dun sgang pa dpon slob sogs dang lha sar mchod sbyin ji ltar mdzad tshul yi ge cung zad tsam snang zhing dngul gyi gdung 'bum dang sku 'dra rin po che mtshur phur bzhugs shing zhal bzhugs dus kyi thugs dam bka' bstan 'gyur gser las bsgrubs pa shin tu legs shing dag pa de'i bka' 'gyur mtshur phu dang gzhan kurma na bzhugs so/ /khyad par gdung skal gong ma rgyal po'i mchod gnas su phul ba rnamarnga la ngo mtshar gyi ltas lhag par rgya che ba dang mchod pa'i rten khyad par bar bzhugs te mchod 1017

sprin bzhal du med pa byung bar snang ngo / /slob ma'i gtso bo'ang go'i shri sangs rgyas rin chen/ go'i shri blo gros rgyal mtshan/ go'i shri rin chen dpal/ go'i shri don grub 'od zer/ go'i shri chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ go'i shri shākya bzang po/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes/ dom pa bya bral/ rma se rtogs ldan/ mi nyag rtogs ldan la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bgrang gis mi lang ba rgya bod hor mi nyag thams cad du byung ngo / /de las go'i shri blo gros rgyal mtshan pa ni drung gong ma'i dus nas mkhan chen gu'i gung pa'i phyag phyir lugs gnyis kyi bya ba mdzad/ gu'i gung pa gshegs rjes drung 'di'i gu'i gung pa'i las ka bzhes te lugs gnyis kyi bya ba chen po rnams mdzad/ phyis mchog gi sprul pa'i sku seng ge'i khrir spyan drangs/ gu'i gung pa re zhig mdzad de rtse lha sgang du gshegs nas sku 'bum yang bzhugs so/ /'jam dbyangs chen po don grub 'od zer ba ni grub thob chen po rkarma pani'i mched ya gtsugs tor skyabs kyi brgyud pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sras che ba yin/ chos rje rin po che las gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs/ gzigs rgya dang mkhyen pa che bas 'jam dbyangs chen por mtshan gsol/ chos rje'i bka' drin las gser gyi tham ga kon ting ta'i go'i shri'i las ka ka bo ming dang bcas pa gnang / mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum mdzad/ chos kyi gnad khyad par ba mang po gsungs pas gzhan rnams kyi blor ma chud/ kun mkhyen rong pos lung pa 'di'i phu na gzhan mi zer ba mang po zer ba zhig yod 'dug pa ltar 'gro gsungs nas byon te mjal/ chos kyi bgro bas dad de 'jam dbyangs chen po la chos gsan phyis lo tsā ba chen po bsod nams rgya mtshos kyang khams su 'bul sdud la 'gro ba la kurma pa mang bas de'i chos bshad rgyu tsam re dgos par /'dug dgongs nas mjal du byon pas stan las bzhengs nas gom pa du 1018

mas bsus/ phyag lan rtse sprod mdzad/ bzhugs stan mnyam par bshams/ston mo bzang po mdzad cing chos ye ma gsungs/ nyin re zhing chos kyi 'bel gtam byung ba la ni tshad gzhal bar ma nus nas mkhyen pa'i thugs rgyal zhi/ blos je mi dpogs su song / thugs ni rings par yod kyang de lta'i ngang du zla gcig tsam song tshe mtshan mo zhig thugs mthong 'di 'dra mdzang cing chos ye mi gnang ba ci yin snyam/ ga re chos chos bzhin du nyan dgos pa la nged rang nga rgyal ches lta ba mthos chos la yang nor 'tshol ba'i yon gyi 'du shes las dad pas ma nyan/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes ma skyes par 'phral 'grogs dang so skye'i 'du shes las ma byung bas chos kyi snod ma yin par 'dug snyam nas rang la thugs skyo ste spyan chab mang du byung / 'jam dbyangs chen po rang la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes kyis gsol ba drag tu btab pas nang zhogs gzhan las snga bar gdan 'dren byung / byon pa la bla ma nyid khri la bzhugs/ldang ba dang phyag kyang mi mdzad/ byin rlabs kyang phyag gis mdzad mdun na brum ze zhig bting 'dug pa la der bzhugs gsungs nas 'o chos 'dod pa bya ba de ltar byed dgos pa yin gsungs nas de ma thag nas zab mo nang don gyi dbu btsugs mtha' drug tshul bzhi dang sbyar ba'i bshad pa rgyud lugs su mdzad pa la khong gis zin bris mdzad snang ba nang don gyi ṭīka byed sog 'grel sogs phyi ma thams cad las khyad par du 'phags par snang zhing thugs rings pa bzhag ste gdams ngag nyams khrid du gsan/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa yang skyes/yang paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen/ kun mkhyen bkras rnam pa/ rdog byang chub dpal ba/ rje 'di rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma gang la 'chol 'a ma snyam pa na 'jam dbyangs chen pos khyed rang dang las 'brel yod pa paṇa chen nags rin yin pas rtsa ba'i bla mar zung gsung ba dang brtag pa yang de ltar du shar nas phyis 1019

paṇa chen gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa ma gtogs rtsa ba'i dad pa 'dir thob pa yin no//bstan bcos kyang du ma mdzad de deng sang mtshur lugs su grags pa rnamab/ 'jam dbyangs pa'i mdzad byang can yin no/ /'on kyang de'i tshe las tshan rnams mang zhing rags pas nang so tshang mdzad dka' cung zad yod pas las tshan rnams la kha gnon gyi rten 'brel mang du mdzad snang ba ni cung phyi nang gnyis kur du non ches pa'i mtshan ma snang ngo / /gdan sa lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum mdzad/rje mthong ba don ldan mya ngan las 'das rjes go'i shri chen po dpal 'byor don grub kyis dgongs rdzogs su gser thog gi bya mdab chung ba gnyis4 bskyon par phebs tshe 'di nged la gnod pas re zhig zhog gsungs kyang ma gsan/ mdzod nag chen mo'ang / dus ngan byung na yul ngan skyid pa yin gsungs nas rtse lha sgang du drangs pa la'ang thugs cung ma rangs/ sgar pa'i gser thog 'grub par 'dug ste kho bo'ang 'degs dgos par 'dug mchog gi sprul sku'i zhal mi mthong bar 'dug gsungs nas gshegs/ zhag bdun du pur la ma reg gsungs kyang zhag bdun pa la reg pas thugs gar drod tsha chil chil ba 'dug pa de ma thag tu yal gyis song / 'di kun mkhyen rong pos gsan pas mtshur phu ba la mi med par 'dug zhu ba glus bskul byas na bzhengs par 'dug pa la gsung skad/drung na rim ma gtogs ba'i mtshur phu'i gdan rabs la mkhyen rab dang 'phrin las 'di che bar khums/ mi nyag rtogs ldan grags pa rin chen ni gtso bor sgyu lus dang rmi lam 'byongs pa ste/ khong rang gis sgyu lus 'byongs pa'i rtags 'ga' gsal bar byung / zhes pa ltar mtshur phur gzims chung 'og gi mdzod cig tu khong mun mtshams la yod steng na chos rje rin po che bzhugs pa'i tshe mos gus kyi nyams kyis sku mdun gyi zha/la ba'i khrod na yar sbyi bo nas brtsams te rim pas thon skyil krung du lam byung ba dang / mtshur phu'i skungs phyogs kyi phug pa 1020

zhig tu thugs dam la bzhugs tshe sgyu ma rang shar byung ste phug pa'i brag la thogs med du song / ri de'i nub phyogs gzhu'i nang de'i thad kyi phug pa zhig na sgom chen zhig bsdad yod pa'i rgyab kyi phug pa nas lus rim pas yer gyis thon byung ba na sgom chen de skrag nas bros skad/ 'di 'dra ba mang du byung zhing mi tra dzo gis lung bstan pa ltar/ rgya gar gyi paṇa chen shrī pu tra yang rmi lam sgyu lus kyi nus pa la ngo mtshar skyes nas mi tra khrid drug gi gdams ngag byin pa de lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa dang / khyad par 'phrin las che ba rma se rtogs ldan ni mi nyag gi tshang du 'khrungs/ drung de bzhin gshegs pa mul phyogs der phebs pas shin tu dad nas mjal/ shin tu phyug par yod pas 'bul zhabs cher byas/ dpon che chung rnams dang yang longs spyod kyis shin tu 'dris par byas/ chos gdams ngag gsan zhing nyams len mdzad/ sgar pa dbus na bzhugs dus lha sar mjal du byon/ dang po zhal 'dris pa'i bsnyems kyis sku drung du byon pas dpon bkra shis 'byung gnas pas mdor bton/ gur sgo nas phyag btsal bas ral pa rdog pas brjis nas brdungs/ de nas rim gyis mtshur phur sku mdun du tshud/ dge 'dun sgang pa las rab tu byung / chos rjes thugs la shin tu btags te sku mdun du nam 'dod 'byon/ zab chos gzhan la ma gnang ba du ma gnang ste deng sang zur mang snyan brgyud du grags/ thugs dam rtogs pa mtho zhing nyams myong bzang bas khyod kyis gzhan don nus pas pha yul du song la dgon pa thob 'gro don gyis shig par lung bstan/ chab la kha sogs su gzhan don bskyangs/dgon pa mdzad bzhed nas yab tshan la sa slongs pa ster ma nyan pas nyin zhig rmon pa dor gcig bshams/ de'i thong khong rang gis bzung nas sa rgya che ba zhig rol gyis bskor te 'di nga dbang ngo gsungs pas yab tshan gyis rgol ma nus/ der dgon pa btab pa bkra shis zur mang du grags te mdo khams kyi 1021

dgon pa zhig la che zhing dngos gtsang / gling na sdod pa dang ri khrod 'dzin pa'i gra gnyis byung zhing ri khrod so so 'dzin pa ni mtha' yas/ slob ma mchog kyang rtogs ldan ya brgyad/ 'ja' mo mi/ gsum sogs byung / de'i kun rgyal che chung gis 'dan stod du dgon pa btab/ bsod yes pas zur mang du zur chos pa mdzad pas slob ma mang du thon/ chu ga sol 'od zer bzang po dang khu dro rtogs ldan gnyis kyis kyang so sor dgon pa btab/ zur mang bka' rgyud 'di deng sang du'ang dar rgyas dang 'phrin las che'o/ /ngom pa bya bral ba ldong nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni dang po gzhon dus lings la phyin te sha ba pha ri na 'dug pa la tshu ri nas pha bong la pus mo gtad nas mdas bsnun pas pha bong la zhabs rjes byung bar grags/ rtogs pa shin tu mtho/ chos rje mya ngan las 'das nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs tog pa'i thog ma yun ring bar mdzad/ phyis 'dag char la yun ring du bzhugs pa las nam zhig na zag bcas kyi phung po shul du ma bzhag par mkha' spyod du gshegs te ji nas mtshan ldong mkha' spyod par yang grags/ gong ma ye dbang gis piṅka pa spyan drangs pa'i tshe be+erlu pa'i phyag phyir yang byon zer/ de la sogs pa'i skyes chen gzhal gyis mi lang bar byon/de las bka' rgyud kyi gral la bzhugs pa ni sog dpon rin chen bzang po ste sog zam khar 'brong bu go'i shri chen po'i gdung rigs su 'khrungs/ rnam thar rgyas pa zhig ma mthong / rje don ldan zhabs kyis thang sku mdzad phyir tshig rkang brgya rtsa brgyad pa zhig mdzad pa yo da pa'ang da ltar dpe cha ma rnyed la rnyed na de nyid 'bri bar bya'o/ /dpal ldan gsang phur sde snod la sbyangs te thog mar bka' bzhi'i gra skor mdzad pas mtshan de grags/ spyir mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs mtha' dag gi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la 'gran zla dang bral te mtshan rigs pa'i ral grir gsol/ rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin rlabs mtha' dag zhugs 1022

de srungs rtogs kyi yon tan rdzogs/ phyis mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i yongs su 'dzin pa mdzad tshe/ gnas lugs mchog gi don rtogs shing / /nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba yi/ /rat+na bha dra la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces gsol 'udebs mdzad de zung 'jug ma'i rgyud rim bka' rgyud kyi gral la bzhugs pa yin no/ /sprul sku chos dpal ye shes ni zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa gsum pa ste/ phyi dus sngags spyod rnal 'byor kun tu rgyu/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar nyang po'i yul khe brag mdor gdung rus khu yab bsam grub dang yum bar za las me khyi dbyar ra'i bcu bzhi rgyal dang ldan pa'i nyi shar la bltams/ yum la rmi ltas bzang zhing lhums nas yig drug gi sgra grag pa gzhan gyis thos pa dang mkhar de la phyogs bzhir 'ja' tshon gyi ka ba dang logs su dar 'phyar ba 'dra ba'i 'ja' tshon yang yang mthong nas ngo mtshar gyi grags pa cher byung / sku mdzes shing zhabs la hor yig gsar gyi rgyal gyi yi ges mtshan pa zhig byon/ zla ba lnga tsam bzhes pa nas kun la byin rlabs mdzad/ sngon gyi gra slob du ma la nges pa skyed de sri zhu byas/spyan drang bar cung dka' nas dge slong dpon grags pa sogs kyis sku khrus la gshegs pa'i tshul gyis nyang chu'i gzhung ko la thabs mkhas pos spyan drangs te stag rtser sku skyed bsrings/ brag gi bya skyibs shin tu mtho ba bya rgod kyi gnas su rung bar skad cig gis byon te bzhugs pa dang / yang de ma thag gzims khang na bzhugs pa dang / rtsig pa la thogs med du gshegs pa lan du mar bstan/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyis log rtog sel ba dang / sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon par shes pas mar steng dang dga' ldan ma mo la sogs par sngon gyi rabs du ma dang / khyad par rje mkha' spyod pa thegs gar zhal chem/sa kyi shog dril sbas pa byung nas the tshom bsal/ ba yu chos bzang pa la nag rgyal phag gsum phyag chen chos drug rgyud 'bum sogs gsan zhing / rgod tshang 1023

ba'i sku'i bkod par gzigs/ dge slong dpon grags pa la snying thig gnyis dang rgyud bcu bdun sogs gsan/ po bo'i ye gong la sogs par byon/ dgung lo brgyad pa chu sprul zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum la kong dbus kyi mtshams pad mdor chos kyi rje rin po che dang mjal te de ma thag yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen gnang zhing shin tu mnyes pa'i bsngags pa mdzad/ de'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la stag rtse'i gzims khang du mkhan po chos kyi rje dang las slob mgon blon pas mdzad de rab byung dang dge tshul mdzad/ chos kyi dpal ye shes su mtshan gsol/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skyed rdzogs rmi lam 'brel ba gsum ldan rlung sems gnad kyi lde mig sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos kun dang / na ro ne gu'i chos skor/ ras chung pa dang / o rgyan pa'i bsnyen sgrub/ sbyor drug rdzogs chen/ lam 'bras la sogs gdams ngag che chung mang du gsan zhing de rnams kyi don mngon du mdzad/ zla dgon kun spangs pa la'ang chos du ma gsan/ta'i ming rgyal pos kyang bstod bsngags dang gnang sbyin bzang po byung / kong po'i dgon gnas rnams skyong bar bkas bskos te ba yu la sogs par bzhugs/dgung lo bcu bzhes pa na chos rje rin po che mya ngan las 'das/ snye bo la sogs par byon zhing 'gro don mdzad/ tsā rir tshe dpag med kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal gzigs dang lung bstan byung / rje mthong ba don ldan sku gzhon nu nas kong por phebs pa la chos dang zang zing gi mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/ chos kyi rjes dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa'i yos lo la dpon slob lhan du dwags po brgyud de 'ol kha bkra shis thang du phebs/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bsod nams bzang po mdo li la spyan drangs te chos kyi rjes dge tshul mdzad pa'i skabs su rje 'dis bsnyen par rdzogs/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan dang phag gru spyan snga la sogs pas ja 'dren phul/ slar kong po dgon gsar du dpon slob lhan cig 1024

4 pas sog dbon pa la byaca/sa chos dbu ma la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad lung gdams ngag mang du gsan/ yang sprul sku'i zhabs phyir glang lo nas/ nyang lung pa nas brag gsum gyen la brgyud/ 'jam ne smar tsha thung / rngod sogs dang sgom sde dang a rig gi bar du byon te dpon slob thun mong gis 'gro don mdzad/ nags shod du dkar po rin bzang pas spyan drangs te khong la chos kyang du ma gsan/ sprul pa'i sku ma—do khams su thegs/ rje 'di byang lam nas mtshur phur byon/ gangs pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la chos kyang gsan/ gzhan don mdzad cing sne'u gdong pas spyi bor bskur/ slar kong por phebs/ mtshur ston chos rin la dga' ldan ma mor chos mang du gsan/ chos rje rin po che spyan drangs te stag rtser 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pa dang skye bo thams cad kyang sbyin pas tshim par mdzad/ sa phyogs de rdo dkon pa la rdo'i gter chen po phyung nas dga' ldan ma mo'i lha khang mdzad/ stag lung kun spangs pa byang chub rgya mtsho phebs pa na mkhyen bzhin pas mjal te gcig la gcig chos gsan pa ltar mdzad/ ma ra steng du nor rdzas mang du spungs te so sor gnang nas nyin lam bcu gnyis kyi bar 'khrug rtsod thams cad bablums/ chos rgya dkar po btsugs te thams cad bde 'jam du mdzad/ re re tsam gyis rgya las 'gongs pa byung ba la chos skyong bskul bas gtsang po grong la 'gyur ba dang / dar nag 'dzin mkhan med par 'grengs pa dang / nad yams kyis grong brlag pa sogs cho 'phrul dpag med kyis tshar bcad/ spyir yang drag po'i las la mnga' brnyes pas chos skyong bran bzhin du nyan/ lha bzo'i rjes 'breng gi 'gegs bskrad pas skad ngan sna tshogs pa 'don zhing bros pa mang pos thos/ gdon gnod pa rnams la gzigs pa tsam gyis zhi ba ches mang ngo / khyad par chos kyi rje kurmar sku shin tu bsnyung ba na kong po nas myur bar skyod/ ngom chu 'gram du tsong kyang go'i shi 1025

gu'i gung pa sogs sgar dpon rnams kyis bsu ba mdzad de dpon slob ma jal/sku rim mdzad de gdug pa can btul pas sku khams dngas/ chos rje rin po che phebs par gsol ba btab ste sgom sde khyung po sto stod brgyud nas sngon du kong por phebs/ chos kyi rje phyi nas phebs te 'bul zhabs rgya cher mdzad nas sku tshe 'di'i bzhed don grub pa'i gsung byon/ bzhi bcu rtsa bdun bzhes pa chu pho spre'u'i lo ston zla ra ba la dga' ldan ma mor sku cung zad bsnyun par bstan/4dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus/ /gos ser mo byon yang tha mal pa/ /blo chos dang 'dres pa mi 'dug pa/ /'gro drug rnams la thugs rjes zungs/ /nor zang zing bsags nas sdod tshis byed/ /'chi ba dran pa mi 'dug pa/ /pha bla ma'i mdzad spyod rnam thar la/ /log rtog sgom pa ma gtogs par/ /dad gus byed pa mi 'dug pa/ /rtsa thig rlung gsum man ngag la/ /nyams len byed pa mi 'dug pa/ /chos zab mo mang du bshad na yang / /dam tshig rtsi mi mi 'dug pa/ /rje btsun bla ma rin chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs pa mi 'dug pa/ /sems nyid nor bu rin chen la/ /lta rtog byed mi mi 'dug pa/ /gang shar chos sku'i rol pa la/ /dgag sgrub byed pas gang 'dug pa/ /dal 'byor mi lus da res la/ /stong log byed mkhan mang 'dug pa/ /'gro drug rnams la thugs rjes zungs/ zhes snyigs dus kyi tshul mgur du mdzad de yar chos bzhi'i nyi shar nam mkha' dag pa la me tog gi char lang long du byung ba'i tshe rje btsun sgrol ma dang chos rje rin po che de bzhin gshegs pa byon mchod pa shoms shig gsung zhing zhal ta yang mdzad de seng ge'i gzims stabs kyis mya ngan las 'das/ gdung mchod kyi tshe ḍā ma ru'i sgra mang du grag sku gdung rin po che byang chen mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol lo/ /bu slob kyang chos kyi rje mthong ba don ldan gyi bu chen phal cher yang dpon slob thun mong gi slob ma yin la/ chos rje yid bzang rtse pa 1026

dang chong 4 rje nam pa sogab/ kyis kyang rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin no/ / na rim drug pa rje mthong ba don ldan ni/ sngon chos kyi rjes mdo khams gama'i nye logs su 'dun pa btang zin gsung ba dang / khams kyi spyan 'udren pa rnams la mdo khams nyid du myur du 'phrad par bya'o zhes bka' bstsal ba ltar garma dang nye ba ngom gyi sar yab sngags 'chang nus pa che ba zhig dang yum rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma zhig las spre lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la bltams/de ma thag tshog pur bzhugs te yum la gzigs shing bzhad/ dri bzang gis yul khyab/ ngom pa bya bral ba la yang sprul sku byon pa'i ltas byung nas gang na bzhugs brtag pa'i phyir slong mo bar brdzus te btsal bas bltams nas zla gcig zhag bzhi song pa zhig dang mjal ma thag dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad/ ā li kā li gsungs/ lkog tu khyed su yin byas pas khong gi mdzub mo la 'jus te bzhengs nas/ nga ni skye med brjod pa kun dang bral/ /gnas med gnas bral 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ma lus thar pa'i gnas su 'dren pa'i phyir/ /skye 'gro kun gyi dpal du bdag gyur te/ /na ma tshar bar yul gzhan mi spo 'dug /zhes bka' bstsal nas re zhig songs shig gsungs pas dad pa thob ste de phyin zhabs tog pa mdzad do/ /skog gyur gyi gnas dang ma 'ongs pa mkhyen pa du ma bka' bstsal/ zla ba bdun bzhes pa nas khri thog tu bzhugs shing byin rlabs mdzad/sangs rgyas kyi mtshan mang du sgrog cing yig drug gi sgom lung mdzad/ nya khang du spyan drangs pas rten rnams la gzigs khyad par zhwa nag can la gzigs shing bzhad/ 'di su yin zhus pas thugs kur phyag mdzub btsugs nas nga yin zhes bskyar nas gsungs/ yab kyi pang du bzhugs pa la ngom pa bya bral bas glo bur du phyag la 'jus nas khyod su yin gsungs pas nga de bzhin gshegs pa yin shes sam gsungs/ re ne dgon ma zhus par mkhyen der dbu zhwa zhwa nag gzigs 1027

pa na nga rang gi yin gsungs te bsnams/ bla ma gcod dig pa la dag snang mang du shar bas dad pa thob ste thams cad la sprul pa'i sku byon par bsgrags/ la/rma naca/ gnyer pa ja 'edren la 'ongs pa'i ming nas bos/ /rmar phebs phyag nas 'thor bas 'brum pa'i nad yams chad/ sngon tshul du ma bka' bstsal bas yid ches bskyed/ thang sku zhig la rab gnas mdzad pas 'bru bdun nam mkhar chaṭa/yi ger ma bkod snang yang gsung rgyun la/ garma drung rin po ches thog mar mjal ma thag tu ngas phyag mdud byin pa de yod dam gsungs/ de blangs nas phul bas har gyis bzhengs te sku la tshad pa na sku bongs dang mnyam khad kyis byung bas sngon gyi lung bstan du dgongs nas spyan chab mang du bsil zhing zhabs la btugs/ de dus dmar dge lugs kyi sngags chog mang du btsugs nas sgrub mchod byed pa'i gral dbu la byon pa na drung rin po che la bka' bkyon/ 4 der 'di 'dra zhig dgos 'dug pa la nged rang gi yig cha mi 'dug pas lan pa yin zhus pas yig cha ngas brtsams pas chog gsungs nas rdor dbyings la sogs pa'i mngon dkyil rgyas shing legs pa bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa rnams rtsomyo/ par mdzad ces gsung ngo / /mkhan chen mgon blon pa dbus na bzhugs pa la yang mnal lam du thugs rje chen pos lung bstan byung bas sgar pa rnams la dar chen kha re bkye/ nga'i bla ma khams na byon yod 'khrungs sa dang yab yum gyi sha rtags kyang 'di 'dra yod/ nga'i bla ma thugs chad yong nga 'gro gsungs nas byon zhing sprul pa'i skus kyang mkhan chen pa'i lad mo mdzad cing nged rang gi phyi gzhis sleb kyi 'dug gsungs/ garma'i yang dgon du mjal/ chad ja'i gral du kurma kun spangs pa ༄ khyed rang gi thugs la btags pa zhig la gsol ras gnang ba zhu zhus pas ston pa gsungs nas gnang / tshur mthong rnams kyang yid 'ches shing gdong mchi ma'i rlubs can du gyur/ yum 'da' ba na a ma dang dge' ldan na /0ཿrgyu

'phrad do gsungs/ lha steng du zla ba gzas bzung ba na rgya nag gi rgyal po'i 'al ras 'dra gsung zhing de'i tshul rgyas par gsungs/ yi dam chos skyong gi zhal gzigs pa ni bgrang ba las 'das/ gon gyo bdag pos zhwa nag la bltas pa na 'di hor dus kyi yin rgya'i min zhes khyad par sngon ma thos pa du ma gsungs/dgung lo gsum ma rdzogs tsam yin yang skya ser khri phrag mang po la chos 'brel thogs med du gsung ba khrom thams cad kyis 'tshams par thos/ gzhan la ku re co 'dri lta bu'i tshul gyis chos kyi tshigs bcad thogs med du gsung zhing sus kyang gsung gi lan ldon par mi spobs/ than pas nyen pa'i tshe res chu rtsed kyi rnam pa mdzad/ res bden stobs mdzad/ res bka' lung bsgrags pa tsam gyis char gang 'dod bab pa tsam ni ches mang / dga' ldan la sogs pa dag pa'i zhing mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa gsungs/ sog dpon bka' bzhi pa las lung bshad pa dbang sgrub thabs sogs mtha' dag gsan/ rim pas kong por phebs te sprul sku chos dpal ye shes las gtso bor yi dam chos skyong gi skor gsan zhing gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad pa la 'ol kha bkra shis thang du gnas brtan chen po bsod nams bzang po mdo li la spyan drangs te rab byung dge tshul mdzad/ chos grags dpal bzang por mtshan gsol/ mkhan chen mgon blon pas sprul pa'i sku 'di'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan4 po yang rje nyid la zhu bas de srid zhabs brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes/ phyis dgung lo'i tshigs tshang du nye ba na kurma pa bsnyen rdzogs la yar 'byon gyi 'dzug gam zhes thams cad la 'dri ba mdzad/ sgar dpon zhig dbus gtsang la gser yig la yong pa tshal min du phyin/ nye gnas pa dang ma mthun par kha 'thaX cig byung bas nye gnas des khong bsnyen rdzogs mdzad tshar yod 'dug pa zhes rdzun zhus pas de bden nam gsungs zhal ngo nag log song ste zhag gsum na gshegs par snang /102zhu

kun mkhyen rong ston chen po shes bya kun rig gis ma/jal bar byon chos khabrel gsan/ thugs shin tu dad pas/ steng nas lha yis gdugs dkar legs bzung zhing / /'og nas klu yis mchod sprin rgya mtshochu/ mchod/ /mdun nas mi yis bstod dbyangs snyan sgrog pa/ /lha ma'i yon gnas dam par gyur la 'dud//ces sogs rang gi gzigs snang dang bstun pa sangs rgyas nyid du bsngags pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ sprul pa'i skus kyang gzhung lugs dang man ngag du ma gsan pas nga la sangs rgyas slob mar yod pa yin zhes seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrog par mdzad skad/ sngon rma se rtogs ldan gyi zhu ba'i rten 'brel las drung 'di ni gtso bor sku drag po'i rnam par byon te las 'grig gi man ngag ye shes me'i ral gri sogs mdzad de gdug pa can rnams btul/ sku 'khor rnams kyang rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis skyed rdzogs la bkod/ gang 'chams dbyangs thig sogs lag len kyang gzugs brnyan tsam yin par rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dngos ni de'i dus dar zhing rgyas/ dwags kong mdo dbus rnams su skal ldan gyi gdul4 bya smin grol du mdzad pa ni bgrang gis mi lang / tsā rir bzhugs pa'i dus rnga yab gling nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam+bha was grub chen la ba pa pho nyar mngags te tshe dpag med phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs phul/ de la sogs pa snod ldan gyi gdul bya la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nyid kyi 'phrin las mdzad de dgung lo so bdun pa chu pho spre'u'i lo la rtse lha sgang na bzhugs tshe mo ma rmi ltas pa rnams sku la shin tu rtsub zer ba la slob dpon sangs rgyas seng ge bas brtan bzhugs phul ba na da lo nged la skyon mi 'ong zla ba dgu nged rang gis khag 'khur ba yin gsungs/de nas gsang phu bde mchog gi pho brang du phebs nas rten thams cad la na bza' dang mchod pa phul/ so so'i rten sgam du gzhag nas phyag tham gyis mnan/dbu zhwa dang sre 'pho'i zhal gdams kyi phyag dpe sogs go shri rin po che la gtad /0kyi0

de lung bstan bka' rgya can mdzad/ nged ma— slebs kyi bar du rten 'di rnams rgya ma nyams par gyis/ sham+bha la pa dang ma kha ba rtsod par yod pas kho bo rigs ldan gyi grogs la 'gro dgos par yod gsungs/ brtan bzhugs kyi gagol ba btab kyang ma gnang / mgur du ma mdzad cing khyad par ka bzhi seng chen ma byang nas dbu tshugs gsung te yang yang bzhengs/ sa yang yang g.yos/ nyi zla la 'od med pa dang / 'dab chags che chung thams cad so so sde tshan du 'dus nas mi bzod pa'i ca co dang 'phur lding byed/ sngar bka' lung gnang ba nas zla ba dgu zhag gcig gi lhag chad kyang med pa tshang ba bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro/ da ni kho bo yang bka' rgyud kyi gral la sdod pa yin pas/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i rin po che/ /thugs rje bdag nyid mthong ba don ldan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gsol 'debs byin rlabs char rgyun dbab tu gsol/ /zhes gsol ba thob cig gsungs te mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan/ slob ma'i gtso bo ni go'i the rin po che dpal 'byor don grub dang kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po yin la/ go'i shri rin po che ni snye bor 'khrungs/ sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par dgongs nas skyes chen mang po la dam pa'i chos gsan par mngags bka' bstan 'gyur gnyi ga'i lung gis thog drangs bod na bzhugs pa'i chos ma gsan pa med par grags/byin rlabs kyi bka' babs gu'i gung par mnga' gsol te lugs gnyis kyi bstan pa'i bdag por bskos/ slob dpon pad+ma'i slob ma 'od bran dpal gyi dbang phyug dang ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi sprul pa'i skur lung bstan/ chos bzhugs so 'tshal mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la phul/ thugs kyi bzhed pa yongs su rdzogs pas sprul pa'i sku dgung lo nyer lnga bzhes pa'i tshe mtshur phur mya ngan las 'daso te me tog gi char cher bab pa'i me tog dkar sngo yu ba dang bcas pa da lta phyag sgam 103—1

na snang ngo / kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po ni grub thob snye mo rdzong pa'i gdung brgyud zhal ngo yin phyin rten ring bsrel ngo mtshar can 'byung bar grags shing drung na rim gyi bla ma mdzad pa'ang brgyud pa la lnga tsam byung bas grags pa'i ban sgar du 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen rong po la sogs pa'i drung du sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ khyad par rje don ldan zhabs rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten ste bka' ji lta bar bsgrubs/ thugs dam rtse gcig tu gnad du bsnun pa'i byin rlabs zhugs te dwags po bka' rgyud kyi sgom chen tsam la mkhas pa dang btsun pa dang bzang ba dang grub pa'i mchog tu gyur te mchog gi sprul pa'i sku yang thugs dam nyams khrid kho na la sbyor bar mdzad/ sku tshe yang mthar phyin par bzhugs nas bsam pa ma rdzogs par byas pa mchog gi sprul sku 'di la bsnyen rdzogs 'bul ma grub pa tsam las med gsungs nas ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang bcas byang gi phyogs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan/ slob ma'ang rje btsun skya se sogs rang gzhan gyi don nus pa mang du byon no/ /de la sprul pa'i sku bdun pa ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ sngon chos kyi rje mthong ba don ldan gyis spre lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes la go'i shri rin po che la zhal chems bka' rgya shācu gsum dang bcas pa gnang byang phyogs spyi lha zhes bya bar sprul sku 'byon par yab zhum yul bcas lung bstan te chu bya zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la gzugs sku bsdus/ bar do'i rnam thar ni phyis nyid kyi gsung las/ bka' rgyud rnams dang sings rgyas byang chub sems/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi rnam 'phrul chos kyi rje/ /'das nas bdag cag ma skyes par/ /rnam thar bsdus pa brjod par bya/ /bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la/ /gzugs sku bde ba chen por bsdus pa yin/ /'od gsal ngang la mnyam par bzhag /gdung bzhu4mnyam du 'og min du/ /phyin pas rdo rje 'chang chen dang / /thub pa 10༅

longs sku'i cha lugs 'dug pa mthong / gzhan yang longs sku bsam mi khyab/ /lhag pa'i lha yang mang po snang / /de rnams thams cad dang ni mjal/ /rdo rje 'chang gi gsung las kyang / khyed kyi pha ni grub pa ces bya ba/ /ma ni sangs rgyas khong nas grub pas skyid/ /sems can rnams la phan pa 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar longs sku'i zhing sbyangs te dga' ldan du byams pas khyod kyis 'gro don dpag tu med pa gyis shig gsungs/ mngon dgar mi 'khrugs pas khyod khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung la dge bsnyen dang dge tshul dang dge slong dang rdo rje theg pas gzhan phan gyis gsungs/ lho /phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan gyis khyod kyis sngon 'gro don dpag med byung / da yang 'dzam gling gi gdul bya la soms la 'gro don gyis shig gsungs/ bde ba can du 'od dpag med kyis khyod kyis sngon sems can la phan thogs sam gsungs/ thogs zhus pas da yang pha rol du phyin pa drug gis sems can la phan thogs shig gsungs/ o rgyan du mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du byon pas khyod su yin gsungs/ nga ni sngon chad dus gsum mkhyen pa dang / /kurma paski rang byung rdo rje dang / /rol pa'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /skye ba rnam dag mthong ba don ldan yin/ /zhes gsungs pas 'o na tshogs kyi slob dpon zhu gsungs te rdo rje'i slob dpon mdzad/ mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis 'phrin las sgrub par dam bcas/ byang phyogs su don yod grub pas khyod dzaspu'i gling du pha grags pa dpal grub dang ma lha mo skyid las skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs zhes phyis sprul sku nyid kyis bka' bstsal/ mtshur phu 'jam dbyangs chen pos kyang bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i skabs shig ja gral ba mang du yod pa zhig la nga'i rmi lam ltar na da res sprul sku'i yab la dpal grub bya ba zhig yong ba 'dug gsungs/ kun mkhyed ban sgar bas kyang mtshur phu nas shar phyogs drang por sprul sku 'byon zhes lung bstan/1033

sku bltamasā pa'i yul der dri bzang gi ngad me tog gi char skya ser thams cad la rmi lam khyad par can mang du byung bas ci lta zhig zhes gleng / de ltar gdul ba'i dus mkhyen zhing sngon lung bstan pa'i yab yum yul dang bcas pa la gzigs te thog mar o rgyan ri khrod bya bar yab sngags spyod kyi grub thob grags pa dpal grub dang yum rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma jo dar bza' lha mo skyid ces bya ba gnyi ga sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug tu bzhugs pa na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ltar sgo drug gi mdzad pas 'gro ba thams cad rnam snang du bkod cing rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i mngon par byang chub pa'i ye shes rnam pa lnga las yum gyi lhums pho brang dag pa rnam snang gi ngo bor rigs thams cad pa'i gzugs sku'i gtso bor bzhengs te skal ldan rnal 'byor gi dbang phyug ri rab kyi rdul snyed smin grol du mdzad la tshu rol mthong ba pa skal pa cung zad dge ba rnams kyi ngor ni yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa dang yum gyi kha dog dang spyod tshul sogs kyang sngon las ches 'phags par snang ba zhig go /de'i tshe yum gyi sa cung zad g.yo zhing lus 'ja' tshon gyis rtag par 'khor/ bde dro da 'bar 'od gsal rtsol med du zin/ rmi lam du'ang rje mthong ba don ldan dang yang yang mjal/ rgyab ri la brag lha mgon po rang byon 'dug pa khong rang gi dngos grub yin zer ba dang / ring bsrel gyi rdo rje 'chang gi sku dang gser gyi rdo rje dang shel gyi mchod rten rnyed pa pung khug tu bcug pa dang / nyi zla mang du shar ba sogs dag snang 'ba' zhig rmis/ zla ngo gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la nam mkhar rol mo'i sgra mang po lan gsum du grag lhums su 'phrul 'khor lan gsum mdzad pas yum gyi sku g.yos/zla ngo drug gi nyi shu brgyad la yig drug gsung ba yum gyis gsal por thos/ de phyin dus bzang thams cad la ā li kā li dang yig drug gsung ba nye 'khor ba kun gyis thos/ yum shing 'thu ba na brdabs phog pas a na na ci byed pa yin 1034 4
