gsungs/ yum btung ba 'thung tshe 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas btung ba bo/ bu mo zhig gis zhwa nag byin zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor mas khyod kyi lus la garma pa 'khrung rgyu yod zer thugs ka stong pa'i nang na spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sku mdog dkar po zhig 'dug par snang / phyag g.yas pa'i gung mdzub kyi tshigs gsum rigs gsum mgon por snang ba la spyan ras gzigs shin tu gsal zhing gzhan gnyis cung mi gsal bar gzigs/ de sogs dag pa'i snang ba'i dngos nyams rmi lam gyi snang ba ni mtha' yas/ mi dkar po zhig gis dung chen po zhig 'bud cing 'di phyogs thams cad du grag par 'gyur ro/ khyod 'dir mi 'dug rngod a la na song zhig zer/ yab de sngon lho smad na sgrub pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe rmi lam na bla mas lung bstan te o rgyan ri khrod du song zhig 'gro don mtha' yas pa 'byung ngo zhes byung bas de ma thag byon pa na yum la yang lung bstan byung ste der byon tshe dri bzang gi ngad kyis phyogs thams cad khyab/ rmi lam du bu sha rtsa dkar ba zhig 'dug pas chos rje kurma pa yin zer ba dang / dag snang mtha' yas shing dus rtag par rje kurma pa dang mi 'bral ba'i snang ba shar/ rngod spyi mdar song zhig par yang yang lung bstan pa byung / phyis sku bltams pa'i sa der nyi zla zung zhig 'dug pa dang gser sbram rnyed pa sogs gnyi ga la rmis te rngod du byon rmi lam du byung ba'i gnas de spyi mda'i mkhar yin par shes nas der bzhugs/ de'i tshe 'bri khung ba'i sgom chen der yod pa zhig gis spyi mda' mkhar nang gi bya bral pho mo gnyis las chos rje kurma pa sku 'khrung bar yod zer ba rmis/de skor gyi skya ser phal cher la chos rje phebs pa sogs rmi ltas mtha' yas/ lung pa dri bzang gis khyab cing mkhar de la 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char rtag tu byung bas thams cad kyis chos rje rin po che der 'byon par shes shing phyag dang bskor ba byed/ gnas 'di yang grub pa'i gnas mkha' 'gro'i sbas yul zhig ste 1035

gzhi bdag spyi lha zhes bya ba sngon rje rang byung rdo rje la mtshur phur dge bsnyen zhus/ yu la der phebs par zhus te zhabs kyis bcags/ ma 'ongs pa sprul sku zhabyon pa'i zhing du byin gyis brlabs/ de yang lung pa rin po che'i gter mdzod kha phye ba 'dra ba/ rgyab ri rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa dang dar dkar gyi thod bcings pa lta bu'i gangs kyi rtse bran can/ spyi lha la sogs pa'i nags ri dang spang ri dbyibs sna tshogs pas 'bangs 'dug pa ltar bskor ba/ de dag la zhwa nag rang byon sogs rang byon mang du yod pa/ mdun na spang ljongs g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal lta bu la ri chung rin po che sna tshogs dang ne le'i rkyal pa lta bu brgya rtsa brgyad dang de'i bar bar du a rig thang la sogs thang brgya rtsa brgyad sa mtsho khru ring sogs mtsho brgya rtsa brgyad dang nagal tshal 'bras bu can gyis gang zhing bya dang ri dwags sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ shar du sha wa ra mgo lhor brkyang lha nub tu so ba stag rtse byang du dzam bu lug ru ste sgo srung gi lha bzhi gnas pa de lta bu'i gnas chen spyi nang 'di na drung gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa'i gnas gsa' phu'i byang drang por yod pa'i sngon ka bzhi seng chen ma byang nas dbu tshugs gsung bar snang zhing bla ma dbang brgya ba'i lung bstan ltar mtshur phu'i shar drang por yod/ der dngos po zhes bya ba shing pho khyi'i lo hor zla dang po'i tshes bco lnga skar ma mchu la zla bas longs spyod pa'i snga dro nam mkha' yongs su dwangs pa la 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga'i ri mo cung zad snang zhing me tog gi char kha ba ltar 'bab/ 'brug gi sgra lta bu gar yod mi mngon pa yang yang grag pa'i tshe yum la zug rngu med par sku bltams/ de ma thag zhal nas a la la gsung zhing bzhad/sku la me tog gi rnam pa mang po dang dbu ltag tu rdo rje 'chang gi sku thugs kur rtsa ris kyi a yig gsang gnas su chos 'byung dang 'khor lo zhabs la 'khor lo ste sku la rang byon drug gsal bar snang / gsang chab 'o mar 'bab cing dri 1036

bzang gi ngad kyis thams cad khyab/ yab yum gyis kyang dad pas 'dud cing de ma thag yab kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i slad du mtshan mi pham mgon po dang yum gyis sku tshe brtan pa'i slad du mtsho skyes rdo rjer mtshan gsol/ zhag bdun na gsung mang du byon pa na yab kyis sngags mang du gsung bar go/ yum gyis dbyangs yig gsung bar go/ gzhan rnams kyis ma ṇi gsung bar go/ yab yum gyis gsang bar byas kyang spyi— nang du bya bral pho mo gnyis las chos kyi rje sku 'khrungs 'dug zer nas phyogs thams cad du rlung ltar khyab/ nyin lam gsum gyi lha dpon mi dpon skya ser thams cad 'dus te gsang ma thub/ snye bo da ra steng gi gdan sa pa chos dpal 'byor gyis thos nas mjal du 'gro bsam pa na rmi lam du yum gyi pang na bzhugs 'dug pa la dbu zhwa nag po phul ba rmis pas bla ma smres po la kha skad 'di 'dra 'dug ces bzlas pas nga'i rmi lam na spyi lha'i la khar nyi zla gnyis shar ba mal gcig tu 'dus song ba rmis pas the tshom mi dgos drung gong ma'i dbu zhwa na bza' phyags rnams khyer la song gsungs te phyin pas sku 'khrungs nas zhag bco lnga song ba'i thog tu slebs/ khong gzigs pas bzhad cing dgyes par mdzad/ drung gong ma'i na bza' dang dbu zhwa dang drung rtogs ldan pa'i na bza' dbu zhwa rnams phul bas drung gong ma'i rnams phyag gis bzhes te gzhan ma bzhes/ khyed thams cad mkhyen pa mthong ba don ldan yin na nga la byin rlabs mdzad dgos zhus pas phyag gnyis ka spyi bor bkod de byin rlabs yang yang mdzad pas the tshom chod/ de yang spre lo la sprul sku chos dpal ye shes gshegs/ bya lo gsar ma thag drung mthong ba don ldan gshegs/ sprul sku yang bya lo la kre khang dmar du rje zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa bltams/ ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung zhing 'khrungs 'phral garma pa gsung bas kurma pa yin gsung bar go nas re zhig rje bdun pa yin par yang grags/ phyis sku dngos bltams 1037

ba na yang zhal rnam pa gnyis gang gi sprul sku yin the tshom cung zad byung ba 'dis chod/ kre'i sprul sku yang sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid kyis zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin par ngos 'dzin mdzad pa yin no/ /da ra gdan sa pas de phyin zhabs phyir bzhugs te sku rim zhabs tog mdzad/ zla ngo gnyis bzhes nga/ na rngod pa'i lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis a rig thang du gdan drangs drung gong ma'i chos khri la bzhugs nas khrom chen po la zhal bstan tshe phyag rten rnams phyag gis rim par bzhes/ byin rlabs gnang nas khrom rnams la dal bus gzigs te phyag g.yas kyis zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lan gsum dal gyis phyis nas mnyam bzhag dang lta stangs mdzad de sku gzi brjid dang ldan par bzhugs pas zil gyis non zhing dad pa thob/ gdan sa bas kyang dbus dang kurma sogs su gtam snyan skyel mi btang drung go'i shri pas dbu mdzad pa'i sgar pa dbus su dgongs rdzogs kyi gser thog sgrub pa'i tshe gtam snyan sleb pa nyi ma shar ba lo de'i khu byug gi skad thog ma grag pa dang 'brug sgra grag pa rnams dus mtshungs pas shin tu mnyes/ drung 'jam dbyangs chen po la zhus pas yab yum gyi ming 'khrungs pa'i yul rnams rmi lam dang mthun par 'dug gsungs nas go'i thi rnam pa gnyis kyis rtsod med du thugs thag bcad/ gsol gzims gnyis ja 'dren la btang / mjal pa na shin tu mnyes par mdzad kurmar gtam snyan zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la slebs/ de dus mdo khams su than pa cher byung ba la de'i nub mo nas kha ba chen po bab/ 'brug grag bla ma tshogs chen pa bsod nams rdo rje sogs mang po'i rmi lam du mdun ri'i rtse mo nas bkra shis dar chen 'then nas byung ba dang ri gling gi khang thog thams cad du dar 'phyar dung 'bud pa sogs rmis pas thams cad kyang the tshom chod/ zla ngo gsum bzhes tshe rngod kyi ber bsnol du bzher blas co 'dri zhus te mi rnams khyed garma pa min pa 'dra zer/1038

drung gong ma rnams kyis zla ba 'di la gsung 'di byon sogs 'dug grub rtags mang du bstan 'dug pa/ rang re mthong ba don ldan yin na yid 'ches pa'i rtags dang gsung 'byon dgos zhus pal/ nga ni kurma'i ming can te/ /nga lta'i gang zag dkon pa yin/ /nga dang 'brel ba gang yod pa/ /nga yis mi bslu'i smon lam yod/ /bcu gsum zla ba ma rdzogs par/ /tshig 'di gsang chen rgya dang ldan/ de nas kho bo rtsod bral ba'i/ /rtags rnams rim gyis gsal bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas snye bo'i yul du spyan drangs da ra steng du bzhugs pa'i tshe kurma si bhu ba'i zhu yig lcags mo dbon po/ gser bya bral ba bsod yes sogs kyis phul nas zhu yig phyag gis bzhes yig phreng phyag mdzub kyis mnan zhing rim pas gzigs nas gsung mi go tsam chung ngu 'byon zhing klog pa'i tshul mdzad/ dpal ldan rdo rje gsungs rnas lcags mo'i pang par byon/ gyobral gyi lag pa la 'jus shing mnyes mnyes mdzad/ slob ma rnying pa phal cher gyi ming gsungs pas thams cad dad ches sngon gnas dran pas dad pa'i yul kyis ngu zhing brgyal/ — de phyin gser bya bral bas lus dang grib ma ltar phyag phyi bsgrubs/ zla ngo lnga bzhes pa snye bo'i ga gor khar bzhugs dus kha cig gis sku drung der tho co 'dra byas pas zhal nas/ a haX bde stong sgyu ma'i rtsal/ /sna tshogs ye shes rol pa la/ /byis pa rnams kyis bden par mthong / /nga ni skye 'gag gnas dang bral/ /gsungs/ zla ngo dgu bzhes pa na go'i shri rin po che dbus nas phebs te snye bo'i dgon gsar du mjal ba na sku gzi brjid dang ldan pas mnyes par mdzad cing phyag rten rnams phyag tu bzhes/ sgar dung phyag tu bsnams te nga'i yin gsung ba sogs ngo mtshar bsam gyis mi khyab par dgongs te rang byung kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal por mtshan gsol/ sgar chen 'dzam gling gi rgyan chen por seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ zla ngo bcu gcig bzhes pa na nags phu 10byo 9

bas spyan drangs nags mdar khrom chen po la ā li kā li gsungs/ phag lo gsar nas mdo chen du bzhugs pa na nga rdo rje 'chang yin gsungs/ cig gis sngo yig phul bas dga' ldan du skye bar gyur cig gsungs/ yang gzhan gyis co 'dri zhus pa na/ the tshom mi dgos bka' rgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal la ltos/mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis 'phrin las sgrub cing yod/ sa ra ha birla pa ku ku ri pa gsum nam mkhar bzhugs/ 'di gsum gyi rnam thar 'dzin mi nga yin gsungs nas phyag mdzub nam mkhar gtad/ yum gyis kyang de rnams kyi zhal mjal/mdo tshan gyi phu na gcod la 'byon gsungs/ gcod ji ltar byed zhus pas sems nyid rtsad nas gcod pa yin gsungs/ rtsad nas ji ltar gcod zhus pas sgom gyis gsungs/ mi shes zhus pas nam mkhar phyag mdzub gtad de mtha' dbus med pa zhig yin gsungs/ long por spyan drangs thams cad mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ byi ba'i lo la sdug do bor bzhugs dus rta mgrin mtshon cha 'khor lor sprul pa yum gyis gzigs/ 'di 'dra mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas bgegs btul pa yin su la'ang ma bshad gsungs/ tshes bcu'i dus shig nga darma pa ni 'gro ba 'dren gsungs nas gar mdzad/ de ma thag sku lus mi snang bar gyur te yang lam gyis byon/ dgung lo lnga pa stag lo gsar gyi bar du gsa' phu chos mi brgyud ba yu tsā ri bkra shis ljongs sum mkhar rnams su phebs/ mi la seng gi la chibs pa shar na slob dpon pad+ma gtso 'khor gsum lho phyogs nas ra ha mda' srong ba'i tshul nub na mi la mgur mdzad pa byang na dam pa bal thul bsnabs pa 'dug 'di rnams kho bo yin gsungs/ 'khrul 'khor mdzad cing yum la ngas khyod kyi sto bar 'di ltar byas pas khyod kyi hub bo ba yin gsungs/yig drug dang ā li kā li gsung zhing khyod kyis khong nas 'di skad smras pa thos sam gsungs/ tsā ri la 'gro tsā ri ni gang zag byin gyis rlob nus pa'i gnas 1040

yin/ gnas sgo phye rgyu yang yod tsā ri'i gdul bya kho bos skyong kho bo'i bar chad gnas kyis sel gsungs/ bla ma yab la bzhugs khri shoms gsungs nas khri la bzhugs dbu zhwa dang na bza' bsnabs ja'i gsol ras yab yum la gnang zhing phyag tshol zhal la stos gsungs/ sngon dgongs khrel byung ba'i kun dga' rgyal mtshan bya bas blo bur du 'ongs te phyag btsal bas de phyir phud gsungs te bka'abakyon/ slob bu zhig mjal ma thag a bla gsungs te ngos bzung / drung mthong ba don ldan pas ming gnang ba zhig yod zhus pas bkra shis yin gsungs/ ya gi gsa' phu yin pha ri sham po'i ri yin gsa' phu na kho bo'i mchod rten yod pas mgyogs thor 'gro gsungs nas chibs shar te byon/ sngon gyi gzims gur du byon nas nga'i yin gsung zhing gsol lcog steng 'og can gzhan gyis mi shes pa zhig yod pa drung du bzhag pa na steng ma de yar khyog gsungs/ thang sku ma ṇi ma'i gong sham can zhig la gzigs nas mthong ba don ldan dang 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs rnams nga yin 'di sgrol ma 'di phyag drug par 'dug gsung zhing ljags klog ma phul ba'i skabs yin rung ma ṇi rnams la phyage mdzub btsugs te dbyangs snyan pos rim par gsungs/ na gu le bzung mi 'di su yin gsungs/ mi shes zhus pas rnam sras red gsungs/ rgyal po a nyag la ming nas bos te phyag nas mang du gnang bas yid 'ches/ rnam thos ri bor sgo rnams phye gsungs nas mdzod narge sogs la gzigs rtog mdzad/ sngon 'di ltar yin sogs gzhan gyis mthong thos med pa rnams kyang gsal bar gsungs/ spyir thugs rje chen po rje mar mi gnyis rnams yang yang gzigs shing de gsum nyid yin par zhal gyis bzhes/ rgan mo blo bde'i bu rgyud rnams ja 'dren la byung tshe yon bdag lhun grub dang rgan gog gnyis la ming nas bos yar shog gsungs nas gsol ras gnang bas shin tu dad pa thob/ mar me'i snum zad pa la chu 1041

ting phor gang phyag gis blug pas sngon pas ches gsal zhing yun ring bar thub/sgar pa dbus na yod pa rnams nyang kha nas yong rtsis byed pa la de nas mi 'ong dwags po nas 'ong gusungs te sgar dpon rnams ba yur mjal/ dge bshes 'jam seng gsungs nas gsol ras gnang zhing gsol gzims sogs rnying pa phal cher gyi ming gsungs/ de rnams su yi dam chos skyong gi gzigs snang shin tu mang zhing de dag nyid la thim pa dang thang sku la thim pa sogs mang du gsungs/khyad par cho 'phrul chen po zhig byung ba slob dpon pad+ma rta mgrin nag po ber nag can rnams kyis bsal/ bkra shis ljongs su thog mar gzims khang du phebs grabs byas pa sus kyang ma zhus par nged 'di la 'gro gsungs nas drung gong ma'i bzhugs khri'i phyogs su byon te khri la bzhugs nas 'di nga rang gi khri yin gsungs/ nyin zhig chu rong lam bgrod dka' ba zhig la mgyogs par bzhud pa'i zhabs phyir brgyugs pa na rta mgrin rang byon sku mdog zhal phyag tha dad pa rta mgo gnyis pa dang gsum pa sogs ches mang ba rta mgrin gling gi sgo phye/ rta mgrin rigs bsdus kyi lha tshogs thams cad gzigs nas sngags gsung zhing thams cad kyis thon gsungs/ sngar drung gong mas rta mgrin rigs thams cad pa'i sgrub thabs mdzad pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug byin legs su mkha' 'gros bdud rtsi drangs shing gnas sgo du ma dbyer yod par lung bstan/ rtsi ma khar chibs thog tu gzims yur ba na 'phrang ngan pas chibs 'dred mchi zhus pas gzims sad nas slob dpon pad+ma gar yod gsungs/ mi shes 'phrang ngan 'di 'dra la thugs sgrims zhus pas slob dpon pad+ma nga rang yin pas chog 'phrang ngan yang skyon mi 'ong gsungs/ zla gcig tshun la 'bul ba dngos can ci 'ong mkhyen zhing 'di 'dra zhig 'ong bar 'dug pa 'di ltar gyis sogs gsung ba rnams thog tu bab/ sum mkhar rgyal pos rta brgya 'bul sogs 'bul nod rlabs chen 1042

byas/ skya ser dpag tu med pa mngon mtho dang nges legs la bkod/ dga' ldan ma mor bzhugs tshe dge bshes 'jam seng dang jo bzang bsam gtan gyis kre khang dmar na bzhugs pa'i sprul sku de drung rtogs ldan pa'i sku skye lags sam gdan 'dren gtang ba e 'thad zhus pas rtogs ldan pa'i sku skye yin/ nged khams na ma phebs bar spyan mi 'drongs gsungs/ yang ja skol lung pa'i phu nas ja mang po 'ong ba yod gsungs tsa na phyi nang gar dbon dbu gsar dang mi nyag blo gros bzang po sogs kyis ba so'i tham ga dang ja gos dar dpag med phul/mi nyag byung ma thag blo gros bzang po rgas 'dug gsungs nas gsol ras gnang /ngal brog dgon gsum gyis 'bul zhabs cher byas/ skyen dgon gsar gyi gzims khang gzigs ma thag drung rang byung ba'i gzims khang yin gsungs/ tsā ri rnying ma'i phyag chen pa zhig gis drung gi sku lan gnyis su yal zhing yang gsal lam la ma byon pas lus la rtag 'dzin ma che gsung bar 'dug bsams nas nyam/sa rtogs bzang po skyes/ 'di dag tu gnas bzang ba'i rten 'brel gyis rta mgrin nyid la thim pa sogs gzigs snang mtha' yas shing zhing skyong spyan sngar byung ba bla ma bsam gtan la bstan pas khong gis kyang mthong / mi nag po rwa co can zhig byung gsungs nas rta mgrin gyi skur bzhengs te drag sngags kyis tshar bcad/blo gros bzang po la sngon gnas 'di 'drar ngas gar dang phyag rgya bslabs pa de gyis dang gsungs/ sngon rje gong mas go'i shri rin po che la bstan pa gtad pa'i rten 'brel gyis khyod kyis chos lung phul zhig gsungs/ sngon du tshe dpag med dang yi ge drug pa dgos gsungs te dgung lo lnga pa sa stag gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor yod pa'i nyin tshe dpag med phyi nang gsung gsum gyi dbang dang gtor ma'i byin rlabs/ yig drug yi ge'i phyi mo rgya bod kyi dbyangs gsal rnams phul bas/ rdor dril bum pa sogs 'dzin lugs dbang 1043

gi rnam gzhag dpag dka' ba mang du gsungs/ rje dwags pos lung bstan zhing de'i tshems kyi mchod rten bzhugs pa ri mi dgon du phebs/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes gcig nas bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dbang phul tshe rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba shin tu lci ba zhig phyag tu phul yod pa dkyil 'khor dang drung bzhugs sa'i bar thag ring bar yod kyang de nyid nas dor ba gtso bo'i tshom bu'i steng du dal bus bzhag pa ltar gyur te tshom bu la cung zad kyang ma gnod pa'i ngo mtshar bstan/ ma hā mā ya'i dbang phul tshe de nyid gzigs te de'i bzhugs stangs mdzad nas khyed tsho la 'di mi ston gsungs/ rjes gnang zhig gi tshe gar zhig mdzad dgos zhus pas bzhengs nas stang stabs dang par skor zhig ca/dzad/ sngar ngas khang dmar zur mang darma rnams su byas pa de yin/ de dus nged chen po yin/da nged chung ngu red zin pas mi shes gda'o gsungs/ der than pa byung ba zhus pas dkon mchog gis da lta char phob gsungs ma thag nas char cher bab ste bden pa'i tshig grub par skye bo kun yang yid 'ches/ sgar 'degs dus char che yang de ring ba yur ma slebs bar mi 'bab par byed gsungs pas de bzhin du byung / kur dbon dbus sar 'gro dus si bhu pa la zhal ta cig zhu zhus pas khong la go chod par gyis smros zhal ta de yin gsungs/ a 'tsho gsol ja bas sngar chibs nor lha zer ba zhig phul zhus pas nged kyis kyang rta bra bo zhig byin gsungs/ shes rab bzang pos sngar 'chi gu zer ba zhig yod pa da ga na yod zhus pas khyod rang yin mod gsungs/ stag lo zla ba drug pa'i tshe bya bral zur mang ba zhwa khra can ag tshoms dmar po yod pa de kurma pa mkhyen zer nas 'chi ba de smon lam byed gsung zhing bsngo ba mdzad/ phyis zla ba bcu pa la de'i bsngo rten 'bul mi byung ba ji skad gsung ba'i dus der lho lam khra sgo'i sar shi bar 'dugasngar bla ma hor gyi rnam shes gzigs pa dang blo gros bzang po'i ma bde ba can du 1044

'phangs pa sogs bar do'i don mdzad pa ni ches mang / garma nas 'bul ba sleb cing 'dug phor pa 'di 'dra gnyis kyang 'dug gsungs nas sgam tshang ging ma zhig la phyag mdzub btsugs pa de bzhin byung ba sogs ni deng sang rnam thar na bris pa kho na yang mtha' yas/ phrag yul du bzhugs/ rje rang byung bas btul ba'i kla klo'i rgyal brgyud sogs kla klo mang pos snyan pa thos te mjal du 'ongs rang yul gyi yo byad mang du phul kurma pa /rma pa zer nas dad pa dbang med du skyes shing ji ltar nus pa'i dge ba la bkod/ gter bton rat+na gling pas gter nas bton pa'i dam rdzas drung nyid kyi lung bstan dang bcas pa der phul/ hor ston ka bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dang rab sgang gi ka bzhi rma se sogs mkhas pa mi drug gi lha sde mi sde thams cad kyi spyan 'dren pa'i ja 'dren gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal rgyan can du ma dang bla re sna tshogs/ ja dkar sig chen brgya phrag soṭa phul te phebs par zhal gyis bzhes shing bsngo ba smon lam mdzad/ kong btsun de mos ja 'dren phul zhing spyan 'dren par gzigs te chibs kha bskyod/ gung dkar du yon bdag pad+ma rgyal mtshan bya ba nad drag pos thebs 'chi bar thag bcad pa la byin rlabs mdzad pas de ma thag sos/ kong btsun de mo'i thang du yos lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du yon bdag gi rta brgya 'bul sogs bzhes shing grong dang zhing la chus 'jig par brtsams 'dug pa gru kha cung zad 'gyur 'ong chu zlog pas chog gsungs te phyag nas gnang bas rta bar gyi stod rgyang ring po nas chu sto phyogs su 'gyur/ stag khrom ri khrod du bzhugs tshe kho bo la sprul ba pu rangs su shākya/ sham+bha lar rgyal po/ kha che khri brtan du nya pa sogs 'gro don byed pa rgya bod kun na mang du yod gsungs/ zur mang ba bkra shis rdo rjes bzhugs stan phul ba na khong gi ming rus gsungs yid la bsams pa thams cad la lan gnang / ma 'ongs pa du ma lung du bstan pas nges shes 1045

thob/ yos lo nag pa'i bco lnga la dus 'khor gyi dbang yongani rdzogs phul/nyi shu la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang phul tshe rgya shing gi dbyug pa spor+sha ring zhig phyag gis 'phangs pa dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'phred nyal du phog kyang rdul tshon la cung zad kyang ma gnod/ spyir mda' 'phen stangs mdzad nas thabasna shes kyi mda' gzhu yin nga ni sa ra ha pa'o zhes dang grub thob brgyad bcu las 'di dang 'di'i bzhugs stangs so gsung zhing de thams cad dang kho bo dbyer med gsungs/ rta mgrin nag po byon gsungs nas ral gri 'bul tshul mdzad pa dang spyir spyan ras gzigs zhi khro'i rigs mang po yak+ṣa me dbal gnod sbyin lcags ral can mon pa bdun ber nag can sprin las dbu thon pa rta mgrin nag pos sde brgyad zhabs kyis mnan pa dang rta mgrin 'brug la chibs pa slob dpon pad+ma gtso 'khor lnga sogs gzigs pa ni yi ger 'khod pa yang bgrang gis mi langs na spyir ye shes kyi gzigs pa dag pa'i mnyam bzhag thun gcig gi dag snang yang 'dzam gling gi mi rnams kyis lo brgyar yang brjod par ga la nus/ des na gnas 'di ni mtshan ma'i spyod yul ma yin no/ /thugs dam rten sgam bzhi drung du gdan drangs pa na jo bo gad+dhā la'i sgo phye gsungs/ gang lags zhus pas tsham tshom med par 'di yin gsungs te phye de nas grub chen pagi la byon pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gzigs su phul nas su la byon pa lags zhus pas kurma pa min pa 'di lta su la 'byon gsungs/ snyan phu pa bla ma sangs rgyas dpal la rdzogs chen gyi ngo sprod mdzad de phyag g.yon pas se chal gyi lung bsnams g.yas pas de'i mtha' bskor te 'di 'khor ba zo chun ltar 'khor ba'i dpe yin/ phan tshulo 'od 'thab par mdzad nas 'di nyams kyi dpe yin/ 'od med par mdzad nas nyams zad pa yin gsungs te shin tu spros med kyi gnas lugs kyi steng du chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba ngo sprad pas nges shes khyad par can 1046

skyes/ g.yang /ba steng du nyi zhur phra mo'i steng du yi dam dpag med gzigs/mdor na kong lung ral gsum klo mon dang bcas pa 'thab rtsod dang sdig zas kyis 'tsho ba rnams la gang 'dul gyi chos bstan/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro don mdzad/ ma ṇi dung phyur/ gzungs sngags 'don pa/ ri rgya klung rgya lam rgya/ tshe thar srog sdom sogs la bkod/ sha btson sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams bton/ 'khrug rtsod rnams bsdums te gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyi gar du bde bar mdzad/ mang zhig smin grol la bkod do/ /de nas 'brug lo'i lo gsar g.yang kha sted du mdzad nas mdo khams kyi gdul bya rnams kyi spyan 'dren snga phyir mang ba'i dbang gis phyag bteg po bor thor yams chen po 'dug na'ang skyon mi yong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar yul gyi yams nad chad/ sgar pa la nyes skyon ci yang med/ grub thob 'a.ar dam pa'i gdan sa phu lung dgon pa ba sogs lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis mchod/ de dag gi tshe kha ba nyin mtshan bar med du bab pas khyung tho'i la chod par dogs nas zhus pas la la bab pa med lam mi chod pa'i khag nged rang gis byed gsungs nas gtor ma bka' bsgo gnang / po bo'i yul mi rnams kyis la la mi thon par bsku bcad/ khrang pa phyoṭa su spyan 'dren sogs zhabs tog gi 'khos cher byas kyang ma gsan te the tshom med par byon/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nas bzung la ma rgal gyi bar dbyar nyi ltar dro bas kha ba thams cad zhu/ de'i nyer drug gi dgong sa khyung tho la thog tu bzhugs pa'i tshe nam mkha' g.ya' dag cing shin tu dro/ khyung tho dge bsnyen gos chen sna tshogs kyi gos gyon/ na bun gyi gur nang nas rnga brdung zhing bsu bar byung gsungs/ nyer bdun la la brgal/ lam ches bde bas thams cad ngo mtshar du byed/ nyer brgyad nas kha bas lam chod de phar 'gro rnams la la ma thon par log skad/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes lnga la rdzong gsar du phebs/ lho 1047

rong go'i sri kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis 'bul zhabs rgya mtsho lta bus mchod/de skabs than pa byung ba la char pa 'bebs par zhus pas la las phob zer la las chod zer/ mdang zhag gzhi bdag la char ma gtang byas yod pas 'bab pa med/ than pa'i skyon yang mi yong gsungs te de ltar byung / der rtogs ldan bsam gtan pa ches bsnyung ba 'grongs par thag bcad de smon lam zhus pas bsngo ba mi dgos mi 'chi gsungs te phyag mdung gnang ba na'ang thams cad the tshom mod kyi myur du dwangs/ sngon drung gong ma rdzong gsar du phebs tshe ru shod bla ma blo gros bzang pos ru shod du phebs par zhus pas rten 'ga' zhig yang gnang / khyod rang dgon pa der lha khang zhig gyis dang rab gnas la sleb pa byed gsungs pa ltar lha khang de tshar ba dang dus mtshungs te spyan 'dren du byung ba na lam ngan pas phebs thabs med par thams cad kha mthun yang drung gis sngon khas blangs yod pas 'gro gsungs te phyag nas mdzad pas lhag par dad/ sbrul lo'i lo gsar rdzong gsar du mdzad tshe bka' rgyud kyi bla ma kun dang sprin gseb tu sku stod thon pa'i rta mgrin nag po ye shes kyi khyung kha dog sna tshogs sogs gzigs/ lho'i dbang lha 'od phrom sprul gyis brgyan pa'i mgo thog tu drung na rim mgo'i g.yas g.yon du pad+ma dang rta mgrin mjug ma'i g.yon du nyi zla g.yon zar da khyung tho dge bsnyen gnas pa rnams kyis 'phrin las sgrab par gzigs/ri tsā gi shu ri tsā rta mgrin dang yak+ṣa me dbal sogs kyis gnod byed rnams bsad cing gtub par gzigs/ skabs shig rang byung pad+ma chu zla bzhin/ /gangs dkar rtse la 'gran zla med/ /rnam snang dri med kun dang bral/ /chos rnams 'jig rten dregs byed de/ /rang byung don dang ldan par shog /ces thol gyis gsung ba na ci lags zhus pas/ dang po gnyis nga thams cad kyi gtso bo dang mi la ras pa yin/'jig rten gyi chos rnams dregs pa'i rgyu yin snying po med par sgoms bya ba yin/1048 nga

tha ma smon lam yin gsungs/ der mi la'i g.yas g.yon du mtsho skyes rdo rje ljang gu dang dkar po gnyis g.yon ka pā la dang g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo brkyangs nas snyan pa'i bstod dbyangs sgrog pa dang / dgyes rdor dang ṭosti he ru ka sogs gzigs/ sgrol ma gzigs pa zhig la/ khyod ni bdud rtsi dam pa ste/ /dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ phyi nang gzhan gsum 'phags ma khyod yin te/gzhan gyi don la sgrol ma khyod yin no/ /nang gi don la sgrol ma khyod bzhin shog/ces bstod/ mi la'i dbu thog tu gdugs rang 'khor zhing rdo rje'i gur nyi zlas brgyan pa lañtsa'i yig drug gis gtams pa gzigs te/ byar med chos sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro la sku drin rdo rje 'chang / /mi la rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin te/ /'gro ba'i mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ bka'abazhi pa rin chen bzang po la ras pa bcus bskor ba gzigs/ bkra shis tshe ring mas bum pa dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba drangs/ gser yig nam mkha' gang ba'i dbus su mi la bzhugs pa sogs gzhan gzigs snang mtha' yas/ de ltar nang so go'i shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas lo zla du mar mchod sprin mtha' yas mnga' zhabs kyi lha sde mi sde thams cad phan bde la bkod/ der bzhugs ring thugs dam ches smar gsung zhing gzigs snang yang sngon pas mang / spyir lho rong pa zhal ngo srab pa'i tshe nang so nyid 'khor ba la snying po med par dgongs nas chos la thugs gzhol/rgyal srid thams cad drung mthong ba don ldan pa la phul/phyag phyir bya bral gyi sgom chen mdzad par dgongs pa na slar bkas garneng phyag mdzod kyang bzhag ste go'i shri gnang nas rgyal po byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gyis shig gzhan don du 'gyur gsungs te khong gis kyang bka' bzhin bsgrubs/'di phyin yang sto rong pas garam̐ bstan la bya ba mdzad pa mang bas 'di dag la dgongs nas bka' bskos par snang rda / /zla ba drug pa nas gdan bteg tar 1049

tig stag g.yag la kha rdza stod dpal 'bar dgon sogs su byon/ gser gyi pad+ma la phag mo lha lnga bzhugs pa dang khrag mtsho'i pad+ma dmar po la lha mo rang byung ma gtso 'khor dmar mo kho na can yang gzigs/ rgyal ba g.yung dang tshe bdag gzigs pa na/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma mchog /rang byung don rtogs grub pa brnyes/ /bde chen don rtogs rdo rje dpal/ /sgrub pa mthar phyin bkra shis shog /ces bstod/ dgu gtor gyi skabs shig mgon po gzigs pa na/ rgyal ba'i bka' srung mgon po yang dag mchog /brgyud pa'i bka' nyan 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub/ /bdag gi bka' srung yon tan 'phrin las mdzad/ /'gro don lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces bstod bskul gsungs/ pad sdong dmar po mdab ma sngon po can la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bsgrigs/sgrol ma dkar ljang so sor bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon du dung dkar g.yas 'khyil snang ba gzigs tshe/ sgrol ma dbyings nyid bde chen rol pa'i mchog /'gro la thugs brtse skal ldan rjes 'dzin ma/ /sprul pa grangs med bde chen dbyings la spyod/ /bdag dang 'gro kun bde chen da byings nyid shog /sgrol sngon bde chen rol pa'i mchog /srid par rgyal ba'i yum dag cing / /bde chen rol pas 'gro ba khyab/ /'gro rnams sku lnga yongs rdzogs shog /ces gsungs/ dpal 'bar dgon sde dgon ma lag dang bcas pa phul te der gtsug lag khang gi logs bris gal bka' rgyud kyi bla ma rnams 'bri ba na so so'i zhal dbyibs 'di ltar gyis kyi 'dra 'bag zhal bkod zhib par mdzad/ de ltar lho stod kyi 'gro ba smin par mdzad nas rngod du phebs/ a rig thang sogs su gzigs snang ni mtha' yas/tsha rag thang du kham dang lha steng pa'i ja 'dren pas mjal ma thag a khro bkra shis dbang phyug gi sgom thag gzigs nas 'di nged kyis byin pa de yin par 'dug gsungs/ tang lar sa ra ha gzig lgags la bzhugs pa zhig gzigs te/ ye 1050

shes lhun grub bde chen rol pa'i dbyings/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes sgyu ma'i rtsal/ /rgyal ba'i sras zung thub chen gsang ba 'dzin/ /grub pa brnyes pas 'khrul pa'i snang ba dag /sar ha yi bkra shis shog /ces gsungs/ brgyad gshong 'khor chen du go'i shri rin po che la gzigs nas/ sdug bsngal chos kyi dbyings su dag /stong nyid ye shes dbyer meng la/ /ma 'gags sna tshogs rol pa'i rtsal/ /rang byung nga yi rnam thar yin/ /zhes ngon gyi rnam par thar pa gsungs/ re rgyab sgang du gsol dpon tshe'i dus byed pa na/ snying re rje/ snang — srid thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ /bde sdug thams cad sems kyi rol pa yin/ /de la skye 'gagab ba ga la yod/ /ma bcos ngang du rang sar gnas par gyis/ /zhes ngo sprad/ 'dir yang rat+na gling pas mjal te rta mgrin nag po'i shog ser nas byung ba'i lung bstan phul/ der rje dus mkhyen gyi sku 'khris su rje nyid bzhugs pa'i drung na lho'i dbang lha 'od phrom srin po'i gzugs su byas nas gtor ma slong bar gzigs te gnang / khra tshang gong du rta mgrin gyis/ /bdag gis nad yams bar chad zlog /ces rngam rngam gtsigs gtsigs mdzad pa na dus mkhyen dang rdo rje 'chang shin tu mnyes par 'dug gsungs/ yel lung du 'byung bo sbal sbrul sna ring can du ma cho 'phrul ston pa na skad cig la rje mi la byon zhing dpal rta mgrin thog ltar babs pas de dag sgrol bar gzigs/g.yag pa lha rjes mjal ma thag sngon sman dpyad phul tshul sogs gsungs pas mi phyed pa'i nges shes skyes/ sprul lo zla ba dgu pa'i nyer lnga'i dus mchod kyi tshe bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad byon nas snang srid byin gyis rlob par gzigs te thams cad gsol ba thob gsung zhing gsol 'debs mdzad pas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha cher byung / mgon po la/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rab gtum pa/ /thugs dang shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dgra bgegs thams cad rab tu gsol/ /'phrin 1051

las bka' yi las mdzod cig /ces dang / lha mo la/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro mgon skyob pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin du/ /'phrin las tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i bka' nyan ma/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan khyod ma thogs par/ /'phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig /ces bskul/ sog gi ka chen du bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad byon pa na/ ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /ngo bo nyid kyis thams cad mkhyen/ rdo rje 'chang chen rin po che/ /skye rga na ༈richi zlog tu gsol/ /'gro don lhun grub pho brang du/ /ye shes sku ni thams cad mkhyen/ /te lo ting 'dzin pha rol phyin/ /bka' rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /zhes gsungs/ der rgyud 'bum gyi lung phul tshe/ bdag ni skye ba sprul pas 'gro don byed/ /thar lam brnyes pas 'gro don lhun gyis grub/ /chos nyid spros bral sems can don la brtson/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gsungs/ der rta lo'i lo gsar mdzad nas nags shod du byon/ nags shod glang thang bkra shis steng sing thang go rdzong rmegs su 'phrin las che/ zhal gzigs mang zhing bstod pa du ma dang rta mgrin dpa' bo lha bzhi'i mngon rtogs mdzad/ bkra shis steng du bla ma rin po che ban sgar bas thog mar mjal/ tshe dpag med kyi sku dang slob dpon pad+ma'i sku byin rlabs can phyag na bzhugs pa'i gang 'bul dgongs nas tshe dpag med kyi sku phul bas slob dpon pad+ma'i sku de yang phul gsung bas thugs mi phyed pa'i gus pa dang po thob/ sogo tu zam chen dang lcags zam gyi zhal bkod mdzad/ tsarnan dgon gyi dge 'dun gyi bca' ba sogs bstan pa'i zhal bkod gnang / rta lo zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes nas dam phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ stag la rong chen gyi 'brug mdo'i chos khri thang du bla chen zla ba rdo rje dang zhing gi mi chen zo'u yi graṭa pa rgyal mtshan khu dadon gyis gtsos pa'i mi nyag rab sgang gi lha sde mi sde thams /05lha

cad kyi zhu yig ja 'dren ja gos dar sogs 'bul nod mtha' yas pa dge bshes chos grags kyis phul te der phebs par gsol ba btab/ 'brug lcang sum mdor rnam sras yab yum sbags sgrub gzigs/ spyi stod bzhi mdor drung si dhu pa dpon slob brgya lhag ja 'dren la phebs dus bstan pa'i bdag po gzigs/par stod gri gu stag snar sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyis khri rwa can gyi 'bul ba byas/khrom khri phrag tshogs pa rnams phan bde la bkod/ nang chen tshang gsar gnyis rtsod yun rings pas thams cad sdug bsngal ba la bka'i bdud rtsi bstsa' bas gnyi ga'i zhal ngo gdan sa pa phyag phyir 'brengs/ rtsod pa rang sar zhi sgom sde spun gnyis ces sgar du grags shing thugs mdza' bar gyur/ mdo kham sa zal mo sgang du bstan pa'i gtso bor bka' rgyud bla mas bskor ba ring du gzigs/chas la kha la sogs par byon/ 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhal ta gnang sbyin gyi sgo nas bsdums/ garmar phebs kur garma'i bzhi bdag rgyal po chen po dpal ldan shes rab la/ dam dpal she khyod kyis sang nyin sgar pa kurmar 'gro ba la bar chad ma gtong gsungs te bka' bsgos/ rta lo hor zla dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la garmar phebs/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu bzhi byang chub sgrub skar dang ban chos pa'i bla skar du grags pa nam gru dang pa sangs kyi grub sbyor gyi nyin jo bo gazlo la'i drung du dbu lo dang gtsug phud phul zhing go'i shri rin po ches dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs dang byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed 'bul ba'i tshe 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char cher byung / bstan gtso zhal gzigs te/ kun mkhyen ldem bag thob pa yi/ /bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /shes rab 'phags pas yid bzhin ldan/ /thos bsam sgom la rab brtson pas/ ) /yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa bzhin/ /kun las rgyal ba'i mchog yin te/ /thams cad 'dus pa'i skur gyur pa'i/ /ye shes dbyings kyis ma lus kun/ /thos bsam sne 05nyi

yid bzhin don du 'grub/ /ces gsungs/ de'i nyin mkhas pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal bzang po la chos 'brel gyi thog mar tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang gsan pas zhal gzigs te/ ye shes 'gro ba'i don skyob pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon por rnam sprul pa'i/ /dbang po rnam par rgyal ba'i 'od/ /rnam par rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos sgrub stsol/ /shes rab go 'phang thob par shog /zhes gsungs/ gcod skor rnams phul ba'i tshe stongs tshad tshar tshad du ma dang nyid keng rus su snang ba dang slob dpon pad+mas gcod kyi man ngag mang du gsungs nas de rnams gter gnas 'di 'drar yod gsung ba byung /bde ba can dang 'og min sogs gzigs te/ bde ba chen po'i gnas mchog dang / /'og min zla ba lta bur gsal/ /ut+pal rab dkar dri ma med//—rab mdzes nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /pad+ma la gnas rdo rje 'chang / /dpal chen te lo na ro mthong / /zhes gsungs/ yang slob dpon pad+mas gcod dang dpal chen po'i dbang bskur ba gzigs nas/ /kun mkhyen thugs las rdol ba yi/ /slob dpon pad+ma zhes byar grags/ /ye shes kun+da'i snying po can/ /'gro ba'i mgon po de la 'dud/ /rab dkar pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru dang / /gtsug gi nor bu bzhin du mdzes/ /dzaspu'i chu bo ltar gsal ba'i/ /bla ma yi 5ma mkha' 'gro bstod/ ces dang / yang / na mo gu ru bhuX/ longs sku rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'gro ba mar gyur sdug bsngal thar 'dod nas/ /snying rje chen po rab tu skyes gyur pa'i/ /myur du sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i 'thab slad du/ /bdag gis 'gro ba de don slang du ni//sprul mang 'gro don phyir ni sprul pa yin/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /zhes nyid kyi rnam thar gsungs/ lug lo'i lo gsar garmar mdzad nas zur mang du phyag bteg der sprul sku zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa'i khu bo 1054

dge bshes chos grags kyis nged kyi sprul sku 'di'i yin lugs gsung sgros gsal po zhig zhu zhus pa la sprul sku nyid la zhal lta'i tshul du bka' bstsal ba/ rgyal bas lung bstan drug pa seng ge sgra/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bka'as bskul /rma pa/ /bdag gis yang yang slob ma'i tshul bzung ba'i/ /zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa khyod nyid ni/ /sngon gyi dus su kun tu rgyu zhes grags/ /da lta skal ldan don du sprul pa'i sku/ /bdag gi 'phrin las ji srid de srid du/ /skyes bu zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa khyod/ /bde chen rigs bsdus tsā ri'i zhabs tog dang / /gdul bya lhag ma'i don du khyod nyid ni/ /shar phyogs kong bo'i yul du 'gro don gyis/ /zhes gsungs/'di la 'phral kong por bzhugs gsung ba 'dra zhig yod kyang / sngon gyi dus na kun tu rgyu zhes grags/ zhes sngon gyi sprul sku chos dpal ye shes dang /da lta skal ldan don du sprul pa'i sku/ zhes pas da lta'i sprul sku nyid dang / ma 'ongs dus su/ zhes dang / gdul bya lhag ma'i don du zhes pa'i sgras sku skye ba phyi ma ste 'di nas sku skye phyi ma kong por longs shig ces gdams pa dang / tsā ri'i zhabs tog ces pas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa tsā ri'i yon bdag kong po skyon du 'khrungs pa ches gsal bar bstan to snyam du bdag kho na sems so/ /rtsar gshis lhun grub dgon du phebs/ ngo mtshar du ma byung / tshang gsar dbon chung tshang gsar nang so bsod nams rin chen yin pa dang / bu chung dkon mchog dbang phyug mgron gnyer ba bkra shis 'byung gnas yin gsungs/ri bong zhig byung ba la gzungs sngags dang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gsung zhing ja ma gsum rgan yin/ 'di nas dga' ldan du skye gsungs/ gzhan yang rten bzang ngan sna tshogs pa'i lung bstan mang du mdzad/ tshems brjes pa na mche ba g.yas pa la ā dkar po dang tshems gzhan la mi la'i sku dung dkar g.yas 1055

'khyil yi ge ha rnams dkar zhing gsal ba phyir ma 'bur ba me long la gzugs brnyan lta bur byon/ bdud rtsi del du nang so'i gzigs khang du zhag gcig bzhugs par zhus pas druje gong ma'ang der zhag gcig bzhugs gsungs nas de ltar mdzad/ mdor na zur mang / dran thang / rtsar gshis mtsho ske mdo rnams su zhabs kyis bcags/ thams cad du khrom mjal gyi tshe 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char bab/ sde phan tshun gyi 'khrug rtsod rnams 'jags par mdzad/ ban bon skye bo'i tshogs chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad de phan bde la bkod/ slar kurmar phebs/ slob dpon pad+ma yab yum pad sdong la bzhugs pa la gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas su thub pa la paṇ+ḍi ta dang gsar ma'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yon du rdo rje 'chang la bka' rgyud kyi bla mas bskor ba ring du gzigs/ yang slob dpon pad+mas sbas yul mang po'i lung bstan mdzad/ tshes bcu'i tshe slob dpon pad+ma sku shin tu che ba dang / yang sku shin tu chung ba gzigs/ ber nag can ri rab tsam la shin tu chung ba mang pos bskor te gtor ma gsol/ dam can pa dgyes shing 'khrub pa dang rigs lnga'i zhing du ma'i bkod pa gzigs/ dge bsnyen dpal shes bsnyen zhing bkur/sngags bdag sbrul mgo bdun pa sbrul mjug g.yon du 'khyil ba shin tu mdzes pas zhabs la btud/ gdan sa 'og na dpal gnas sgo ba dang stong mgo rin chen gling pa'i ja 'dren 'bul ba rgya chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sang rin dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnams kyis phul te spyan 'dren pa'i gsol ba btab/ sgom sde tshang gsar pas rtsi'i bya nga se por spyan drangs/ khri rwa can gyi 'bul ba byas/thams cad smin grol la bkod/ bla ma rgyal mtshan bzang pos skyo mdar dang / bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor gyis sa mdor spyan drangs so so'i dgon ma lag gi sde dang bcas pa phul zhing so so la bskos ja gnang / bya lo'i lo gsar 1056

mdzad/ tsha sgang gdan sa pas spyan drangs ngom stod smad thams cad la phan bder mdzad/ kurmar phebs te sa skyong shing mo bya'i lo dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la sangs rgyas kyi dus chen gaku/ma 'dzoms pa sa ga'i nya'i nam langs ma thag gi tshe gzims khang ka gnyis mar jo bo garnyo la dang siṅgha gling btul ba'i thub pa chu lon ma sogs kyi drung du brtan pa'i yan lag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu phrag du ma 'das shing mkhas pa'i yan lag sde snod gsum la 'dzin mkhas gsal rig bzhi'i yang rab tu son pa/ theg chen slob pa'i zag med kyi phung po lnga'i lnga phrugs can kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang pos mkhan po dang / yon tan gyi rgya mtsho gting dpog par dka' zhing rgya bod kyi chen po thams cad kyis gtsug tu slob dpon chen por bkur ba rgyal sras go'i shri dpal 'byor don grub kyis las kyi slob dpon mdzad de rab tu byung bar mdzad la mtshan chos grags rgya mtsho dpal bzang por gsol zhing dge tshul gyi dngos po yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ mkhan po las 'dul ba'i mdo bstan bcos bslab bya rnams nyin bzhin du gsan par mdzad cing 'di phyin bslab bya phra mo'ang khyad du mi gsod pa dgra bcom pa'i ngang tshul du bzhugs so/ /de nas gnas sgo ba sogs bum 'bor ba rnams dang kre kum khyim phris kyi gdan sa pa dang lcags mo kre bo sogs shar rdomar rdza sgang pa rnams dang dar rtse mdo'i mi chen dang mi nyag rab sgang gi lha sde mi sde chen po rnams kyis snga phyir gsol ba lan du ma btab pas de rnams su 'phrin las dus la bab par dgongs te bya lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu —bzhi la garma nas phyag bteg tshe sa cung zad g.yos/ rje mthong ba don ldan la —bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad kyis bskor te re re'i sprul pa mtha' yas pa ston par gzigs pas 13phrin las gnad du 'gro bar mkhyen/ zur mang du khyi lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ rga/ zur dgon/ 'dan rnams su zhabs kyis bcags/ gling 1057

gi sar phebs/ nang dme dang 'khrug rtsod mtha' yas pa 'dug pa rnams zhal ta gnang sbyin gyis bsdums/ dpon chen gsar du bskos/ lha sde mi sde thams cad rang mal du bcug ste gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde la bkod pas bka' drin tshad med par mdzad/ rdza yir zhi gong du rma se ba'i ja 'dren dang zhabs bskul bla ma ka thog pa sogs slebs pa la phebs par zhal gsar gyis bzhes/ lcags mo dang kre bor phebs/ yang mkhas grub chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i bu chen rnams dang zhing gi mi chen gyi 'bul zhabs rgya chen slebs nas nan gyis phebs par zhus/ der rtogs ldan mig rtsa mkhan pos drung nyid rnal 'byor pa dkar po dbu skra sngon po'i thor tshugs can zhal tshems dkar po shin tu che ba zhig tu yun ring du mthong / phyi nas sems yengs pa zhig nas sku dngos su snang skad/ dben pa lha khang du ras bud mdzad tshe 'ja' dmar po'i nang nas bka' rgyud kyi bla mas ras pa rnams byin gyis rlob par gzigs/ der phag lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ gling tshang can shing dbang thar pa rgyal mtshan gyis gser khang du spyan drangs/ 'bul zhabs rgya chen gyis mchod cing 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan la phyag nas zhus/ shal khog stod smad du phebs/ ban bon gyi 'khrug pa sogs sde phan tshun gyi 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams gtan zhir mdzad/ skye bo btson dong na gnas pa rnams phyung ste phan tshun thams cad bde bar mdzad/ der wa ga shi ba/ ga zhi pa/ a ri dgon pa sogs lha sde mi sde'i ja 'dren 'bul zhabs rgya chen po bka' bcu pa sgo rgecig pas phul/ gso ros bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis drung nyid 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku lus kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa ches gsal bar yun ring du mjal bas nges shes tshad med pa thob/ dzo gi bla mas ba thang shing rgyal ba'i dben gnas su spyan drangs te rab gnas mdzad/ gnas nang du nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang zhing bstan gtso 1058

dang slob dpon pad+ma dang bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad zhal gzigs te/ 'os min chos kyi pho brange nas/ /sogs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'jam dpal— bzang po rdo rje 'chang du gzigs nas gsol 'debs dang mgur mdzad/nyag rong du byon/ ār+ya gling la sogs par gzhan phan ma7dzad/ slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal gzigs nas/ mtsho las skyes pa yid 'ong pad+ma'i steng / /zhes soṭa kyi bstod pa mdzad/ khrom spyi thog tu phebs/ ka thog pa sogs sde phan tshun dang ban bon gyi 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhal ta gnang sbyin gyis zhi zhing bka' drin 4du mdzad/ gnas sgo gdan sa pa gdan 'dren du byon pa la myur du 'byon ḍa4ra zhal gyis bzhes nas re zhig kre shod du phebs/ shug ri thang du bzhugs pa na gzigs snang ches mang zhing gsung mgur gnang gzhan snang du'ang rtag tu 'ja' dang me tog gi char gyis 'khrigs/ der yang rab sgang gi lha sde mi sde'i ja 'dren 'bul zhabs rgya che ba dang nan gyis phebs bskul slebs/ de nas shar pa'i gdul bya la dgongs nas rim par phebs/ thod che dang tshe ba'i rtsod chen ོdang rdo ser gyi rtsod chen rnams bsdums/ rag phrom dang gser gyi bkra shis lung du dgun bzhugs4nas phyogs de'i dge 'dun mtha' yas pa phyag chen chos drug gis smin grol du mdzad/ der byi ba lo'i lo gsar mdzad nas cho 'phrul gyi tshes bcu'i dgong bcom ldan 'das ma rnam 'gyur sna tshogs mdzad pa zhig gziṭa pas rten 'brel du ma dgongs/ der sgom chen ye shes dpal gyis mjal bas 'gyu ba dbyings su dag ste brtan pa thob pas mos gus phul phyin pa skyes/ brag can du lcags mo'i spyi 'dun chen mo'i zhal bkod gnad/ 'dzi ga lha mo dar thang du chos rje gzhon nu ba sogs lha sde mi sde rnams kyis mchod cing phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi zhing btson rnams thar bar mdzad/ a mdo ba phur tsha nang so/ hor ser gyi ri thang gnyis/ be ri'i seng ge mi log gi yon mchod sogs 7 1059

kyis gdan 'dren du sngar khyi lo'i nang du mi mgo bya bral dang rgyal mchog dbon po sogs krer lan gnyis ja 'dren phul/ phag lo la bya bral bsam grub sogs kyis rag phrom dang gser bkra shis lung du lan gnyis phul/ byi ba lo la rdo'i thang yag tu phur tsha nang so nyid dang bya bral bsam grub sogs kyis chibs pa grangs can rnga mong sogs phul zhing phebs par nan gyis zhus pas hor ser gyi yul dngos su phebs mi thub kyang khad nye bar phebs par zhal gyis bzhes rdo dang dar brgyud/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sgrub gnas rma stod ra rgod mthon po nyi shar du phyag phab/ der seng ge mi log gi yon mchod rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya che/ 'khrug rtsod rnams 'jags par mdzad/ phur tsha nang so shes rab 'od zer/ hor ser ri ba'i dpon a nu rgyal/ kho ldan thar pa/ bal dur bkra shis mgon sogs hor dpon g.yog rnams kyis mjal/ gser dngul gos dar chibs pa brgya lhag sogs phul te 'di phebs zhu'i ja 'dren 'bul ba yin/ ar ma la sogs pa'i sdig chen 'bul/ bka' ci bstsal sgrub pas hor yul du phebs dgos par nan gyis zhus kyang khad kyis phebs par zhal bzhes tsam las ma gnang / ma ṇi dung phyur tshe thar dpag med dang nang mtshams kyi 'khrug rtsod thams cad dang lo gcig phyi nang gar yang dmag mi byed pa'i dam bca' phul te de thams cad du 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char gyi ngo mtshar chen po yang mthong bas dad gus mi phyed par thob bo/ /dar gyi snyan mo rir a byam rtogs ldan pa'i rtsod pa rnams zhi bar mdzad/ gangs pa yon mchod kyis mchod/ rdo sar la lam mdzad nas rab sgang gi ngogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ lam gtsang bor/ ta'u/ri shod rnams su phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod thams cad bablums/ pag yu gser phye thang du phebs/ sgo sdong gi shag shig lo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ jag phran lo gsum/rkun ma rnams phul/ do ber ras bud dang glang lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ lha khang 1060

du phyi thag ring cas phyag nas cha/dzad pas rten gtso dang bcu gcig zhal la phyag nas mang du zug a ri dgon dang wag shi seng ge dgon rnams su gzims/ gur la 'ja' ka ba lta bu zug cing me tog lang long du byung / phyug mor slob dpon bsod rtses rmi lam du mjal bas byin rlabs zhugs te nges pa skyes/ ne bar du lha khang zhig la phyi nas phyag nas mdzad pas rten gtso'i mdzod pu dang mgrin pa dang thugs ka rnams su nas zug mdzod pu'i nas de kha cig gis mthong kha cig gis mi mthong ba 'dug skad/ ra ti'i mkhan slob dge 'dun gyis bsu ba byas tshe bka' brgyud kyi bla ma kun dang mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor bcas gzigs/kurma pa na rim gnyis kyi slob ma 'gu thom chos grags kyis dar rtse mdor spyan drangs nas byon tshe slob dpon bsod rtse sogs skya ser mang pos mdo smad kyi gzhi bdag thams cad kyis bsu bar dngos su mthong / dngos su'ang nam mkha' la rol mo'i sgra grag gangs chu 'gram du sgar phebs/ mi chen grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs dar rtse mdo pa dang 'gu thom gyi lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis mchod sprin mtha' yas pas mchod/ der slob dpon bsod rtses drung bstan pa'i bdag por mthong / yang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas spyi bor 'od sngon po byon te rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa mthong / rgyal rong pa bla ma tshul khrims kyis thog mar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku ri tsam pa dang / gser gyi rdo rje 'ba' zhig gi khri la thub pa chen por bzhugs pa mthong / de phyin lkog gyur gyi tshogs drug gi yul thams cad kyang dran pa tsam gyis mngon sum du longs spyad du byung skad/'di ni grub thob o rgyan pas/ o rgyan de sprul pa'i zhing rang du yod/ der slebs nas zla ba gsum song ba phyin gzhan gyis phud mchod byas pa yan khar mngon sum du sib sib yong gi 'dug gsung ba lta bur snang / gangs chu 'gram du chos gsungs pa lcags zam pas mi chen gyis khang thog nas thos shing spyan rag 1061

gzigs nam mkha' gang ba zhig tu mthong / grong gi phyi rol rgyang ring nas phyag nas gnang ba mi chen gyi khang par phyin zhing bstan gtso'i thugs gar zug ril bu khang du yang mang du phyin/ la mo rtse'i bde chen steng du'ang rten la phyag nas zug pa mang zhing phyi nas 'thor ba gzims khang du phyin/ mdo nas nyin gcig lhag pa'i sa u ta dgon du phyag nas zhus pa mdo nyid nas gnang bas lha khang dang dgon du phyag nas mang du slebs pas de'i lha mi rnams dad/ slar yang ra ti bas mchod sprin cher byas shing chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ gtso bor thugs dam la bzhugs pa na ting 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal po 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu la brtan pa thob/ thugs dam gyi lha thams cad zhal gzigs shing nyid dang tha mi dad par rtag tu gzigs/ bla ma rnam gnyis la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bcos min du 'khrungs/ gdams ngag thams cad gnad du phog pas nyon mongs rang sar grol ba'i rtogs pa mnyam rjes dang bral ba brnyes so/ /rang grol mchod rten/ nu 'og steng / rdza bkra dgon/ 'ba' ga dgon/ rag po kha bzhi/ byams sar/ yul lhung/ stod mgo rin chen gling /gter byi rin chen steng rnams su byon/ de re rer yang phyag nas phyin zhing zug pa dang zhal gzigs dang 'ja' 'od sogs bgrang las 'das/ 'di nas gong du chibs ka ba dpon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs mngags/ khong rnams 'jang nag ra bar slebs dus rgya yul du 'ja'i gar dang me tog gi char dang sprin kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa'i ngo mtshar byung / stag zhing rnacha sa dang 'bras mdzod pa sogs mi chen mang po la rmi ltas khyad par can rmis pas khong dpon g.yog la dad mos dang mchod pa cher byas te mtshan thos pa tsam gyis rgya rnams dad cing gsol ba 'debs/ de nas mi nyag dang 'jang gi ca/tshams sgo ro yul du byon/ 'khrug chen rnams lo nyi shu rtsa lnga 1062

jag phran dang rkun ma lo gsum phul zhing thams cad dge ba la bkod/ der nga sa bud dang sha yul du stag lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ gzhi bdag sdo gzi 'dzo dge bsnyen du bkod de rdo rje bod khams skyong du ming btags/ skya khing ma se la li sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ 'di thams cad du phyag nas phyin pa sogs ni mtha' yas/ dzā lan dha rar ka bzhi rma se sogs mkhas pa mi lnga'i chos gra chen po rnams la chos 'khor bskor zhing chos khrims nyams pa rnams bsos te 'chad nyan gra skor sogs snga srol bzang po la bkod/ 'bru'i 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhi phyir phyag phebs te zhal ta gnang sbyin gyis zhi bar mdzad/ de ltar mi nyag gi yul rab stod tshar sgang gi lha sde mi sde thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad cing phan bde la bkod/ stag lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum nas bum 'bor gyi phyogs su phyag bteg nyag rong ba sogs kyi lam khrul rnams phul/ bde chen steng du phebs/ 'go log ma khrom sogs kyi 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhi bar mdzad/ dgon sar gyi lha khang gi phyi ring po nas phyag nas mdzad pas nang du phyin zhing thang sku dril ba rnams kyi nang du'ang mang du phyin/ nyi ma nyis 'gyur gyis ring bar mthun snang du grub der ras bud dang lo gsar mdzad/ phyag nas zug pa'ang mang/ garma'i bla ma thugs rje 'od zer gyis drung nyid rgyal ba rgya mtsho byang sems mang pos bskor zhing lha'i bu mo me tog dkar dmar gyi thod bcings pa skra grol ba bzhis glu len pas mchod pa dang / yang yang du rgyal ba rgya mtshor lam lam byung bar mthong / nyag gre dbon pos 'jam dbyangs su mthong / zhig po sangs rgyas grags kyis rta mgrin du mthong / gzhan ban skye mang pos spyan ras gzigs dkar por mthong / khrom spyis kyang res dkar res dmar res ser ba sogs sna tshogs par snang zhing dad pa mi phyed par gyur der hor se chen gyi gdung brgyud rgyal bu dbang bas dbu mdzad/ hor 1063

ོklu mo bu gsum la thang pa'i dpon khro bo rgyal/ khro bo dbang phyug ga'un hor ri pa'i dpon a nu rgyal rnams kyis 'bol rgan gyi slag pa chibs pa grangs can thon ti grangs can/ be ri'i khri dpon khag gsum/ seng ge mi log gi phur ba thar sogs kyis gser dngul mu tig mang du bkur nas bya bral bsam grub dang bya bral mi mgo gnyis gdan 'dren du mngags/ drung phebs par zhu dang hor ser gyi a ram 'bul/ ban bon la ngan mi byed/ zhal ta gang gnang gi lo grangs can la phyi nang bar gsum du 'khrug pa mi byed par zhu ba nan can slebs/ chos 'khor gling sgom lung mgo al yon mchod kyi sa le thang rnams su byon/ phyi nang gi rtsod chen rnams zhi bar mdzad/ phyag nas phyin pa dang zug pa mang / gnas sgo'i lam 'bri gi 'gal stod du ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi lha khang du phyag nas mang du zug cing nang du phyag nas mang bar phyin/ yos lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la gdan sa gnas sgo'i ka ka ri phug tu phebs/mkhan nang dge 'dun gyis bsu tshe 'ja' 'od me tog dang ngo mtshar gyi gzigs snang du ma byung / grub chen pak+ki'i sgrub gnas nor bu gling mkha' 'gro gling bya rgod gling thar pa gling rnams su phebs/ nang so bsod nams rgyal mtshan sri kur sangs rgyas blo gros sogs mkhan nang rnams kyis byang 'bos su spyan drangs/grub thob chen po'i sku 'dra gsung 'byon ma sogs la mchod pa cher mdzad/ phyag nas mang du zug chos 'byung steng gi pha wang zhig la zhabs rjes drug rga lo phug tu zhabs rjes drug bzhag chos khri gsar par kun gyis mthong bar zhabs gnyi ga'i rjes shin tu gsal bar bzhag rtogs ldan chos 'bum la rga lo phug gi lam du chibs pa lhun grub kyi zhabs rjes yod zer ba rmis pa dang nam nangs pa dus mnyam du byung ste phyin pas gsal bar mjal/ dbyar bzhugs gam po gangs ra'i gnas nang byang 'bos su mdzad/ dus mkhyen yab sras kyi bu slob kyi gra rgyun 1064

rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i rong kha bzhi bum 'bor sgang che chung gi lha sde mi sde mtha' dag 'dus te mchod sprin gyis mchod/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas ston pa dngos lta bu'i 'phrin las byung / der grub thob nyag se'i skye ba grub ཿna chu 'phur bas mjal/ 'bul zhabs mtha' yas mdzad/ khong gis 'bri chu khar drung na rim rnams drug brtsegs su bzhugs pa gcig la gcig thim nas rje mthong ba don ldan spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi par gyur zhing slar drung 'di nyid du gyur par snang / dbra thog tu dang por bcu gcig zhal dang ci zhig na drung nyid du snang / bsam gtan gling gi chos khri bar rgyal ba rgya mtshor mjal/ der sgrub khang du be+eḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la pad dmar gyi steng du drung 'od dpag med du bzhuṭa pa la/ bka' rgyud bla mas bskor bar gzigs/ bel phur bsam gtan gling du sgrub gra btsugs te sgrub dpon du grub chen pa bskos/ a 'jang gis gdan drangs rdzong nag gi gnas gzigs/ 'bom nyag tu phyag phab khrom khri dpon nam mkha' rgyal mtshan khu dbon sogs khrom gzhung gi ban bon skya ser thams cad smin par mdzad/ sbud ri dang sar mar du phebs/ 'das log pa yon mchod kyis 'bul zhabs cher byas/ khong gis dang por drung nyid spyan ras gzigs 'khor ba dong sprugs dmar po zhag bdun mjal/ khrom spyi thog tu spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ gnas nang du bstan gtso dang spyan ras gzigs gnyis su re mos kyis mthong / sa dmar du thugs rje chen por mthong ba'i mdzod pu nas 'od zer nyi ma lta bu byung ba khong rang la thim pas nyams rtogs bzang du skyes te dad pa'i phul du gyur/ sbud rir phebs/ phyag nas mang du zug cing chu mig chung ba la phyag nas mdzad pas de ma thag cher 'phel/ sgrub pa ba mang du bzhagagrub chen bzhi'i dge bsnyen 'dam chen tso ra'i g.yu mtsho khar phebs sgrub pa ba mang —bya bzhag bar gang du chu mig chung ba la phyag nas mdzad pas cher 'phel/1065

'ba' thang du phebs/ 'khrug rtsod chen po rnams zhi bar mdzad/ smon bzang bka' bcu ba dang stag tsha mkhan po gnyis kyis spyan drangs/ bde chen gling du sgrub gra btsugs/ re ni stong dpon/ spyi sum/ gshe 'bum stod smad sogs su byon te lha mi rnams tshim par mdzad/ lde chung sangs rgyas dang bra ba bka' gdams pa'i sgrub gnas 'bo de dgon du phebs/ sgrub gra btsugs/ mchog rab tu phebs te 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi/ ras bud mdzad/ sgrub gra btsugs/ru lon pa/ ngo khro/ 'bri chu brgyud pa'i lha sde mi sde rnams smin par mdzad/rtsang bar du sgrub sde btsugs/ spyor sgang du 'brug lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ der/sgo gsum shing rta tshogs gnyis lam du drangs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo legs spyod srol 'dzin pa/ /gdul bya'i gling du mdzel par phyin pa yi/ /lhag bsam dge ldan gzhan gyi skyon mi rtog /rang gi skyon la legs rtog chos la dga'/ /'gro la brtse ldan rtag tu phan par spyod/ /blo yi spyod mkhas kun tu spyod mkhas spyod//ga zhan gyi tshe la phan 'dogs 'dul bar mkhas/ /che la len mkhas chung la dor mkhas na/ /dus rnams kun du legs par 'gyur ba yin/ /zungs thub legs gnas smra ba nyung ba dang / /rtag tu thar par brtson pa'i stobs skyed na/ /rmad byung dge legs dbus su mdzes pa yin/ /bla ma'i zhabs bsnyen chos la dad brtson zhing / /grogs la phan 'dogs skyo ba spang bar dga'/ /srid la skyo ldan rnam mkhyen sgrub par dad/ /tshe rabs kun tu legs par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes sogs rang gi rnam par thar pa gsungs/ grub chen bzhi'i dge bsnyen rgyal 'bar gyi zhol du sngon gyi chos khri byin rlabs can 'gong chos khri khar dge 'dun ru gsum gyis spyan drangs/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad/ rma chu rgyud kyi lha sde mi sde rnams tshim par mdzad nas 'gro mgon ras chen gyi slob rgyud bcu gnyis bskor pas tshem tsi dgon du spyan drangs/ yang dgon du sgrub gra 1066

mdzad/ der phyag mchod mdzad pa na smon bzang bka' bcu pa brtson 'grus dpal gyis drung gi phyag mthil du 'od gong dmar po 'od sna tshogs 'phro ba zhig mthong bas byin rlabs zhugs/ gnas sgor phebs/ dbra 'dru gnyis gyi 'khrug chen bzlums/ ka ka ri phug bsam grub gling du dbyar bzhugs bug sgo mdzad/de'i tshe nyid kyis gsungs pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i sgrub pa ni yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten yin te grub pa'i rten yul mchog tu gyur pa kham po ri khrod du bdag kyang dkon mchog la gus pa skyed cing yang dag 'jog dang kha ton la brtson par bgyis pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan cung zad thob pa snyam mo/ /byang chub sems kyang skyes shing nyon mongs mgo bsnyams so/ /bdag med pa yang mngon sum du gyur to/ /gzhan yang yon tan mngon du bgyis te de lta na yang 'dod pa thams cad dge bas 'grub pas sems can gang 'dod pas 'phongs pa rnams dge ba'i chos 'ba' zhig la 'bad bar bya'o zhes gsungs/ de nas sha 'bu khrid gsum rong kha bzhi sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ 'brug lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bdun nas sgar bteg a bzang nang so/ 'bu'i mi sde/ gtor ma stod smad/ rgya ldang ba/ la yu ba/ kha ba dkar po/ e waX nang so/ 'dur nang so/ rtogs ldan chos bzang ba sogs lha sde mi sde rnams kyis gus pas mchod/ kha ba dkar por sgrub gra mdzad/ sngags sde cho/mas kyis spyan drangs te sha khrid du byon/ khrid lcags rar ras 'bud dang sbrul lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ khrid lcags ra 'di na rang byung ba'i thugs dam rdog po gtsugs pa las skyes pa'i krodhe tse thams cad las ches bzang ba'ang yod/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad/ rdor seng pa bkra shis chos 'phel bas spyan drangs/ der dbus pa bla ma'i rmi lam du drung naso/ phyag rgya che la skye 'gag 'gro 'ong med/ /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /1067

ces gsungs de phyin chad mnyam rjes kyi dbye ba zad skad/ 'bul chen gyi tshe ngo mtshar mang zhing 'dir yang phyag nas zug pa dang chu mig 'phel ba sogs mang du byung / yom po/ yang sde rdza khol ba rnams kyis 'dob tu spyan drangs/ 'dob snar gyi 'khrug rtsod zhi/ snar bor mchod rten la rab gnas mdzad tshe nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khyab pa'i 'ja' 'brug dang seng ge sogs kyi dbyibs sna tshogs pa byung / rje dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas spang phug tu sku 'dra gsung byon la mchod/ der dbyar bzhugs mdzad/ zla ba gsum 'dag sbyar la bzhugs/der 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i 'bul zhabs rgya cher slebs/ yang rgya nag nas gong ma rgyal po chen po ching hā'i lung dbu zhwa zhwa nag khyad par can dang mu tig gi snam sbyar/ yol ba bla res sogs mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang gseru bre chen gos dar khri phrag sogs kyi 'bul ba rgya chen kon ting go'i shri bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / du gang bkra shis bzang po/ gsol ja ba 'od zer rgya mtsho/ nyi ma 'od zer rnams kyis phul zhing gong ma sku tshe brtan pa'i smon lam gyi rgyun mdzad/ pum 'bor sgang chen du phyags phebs/ sa stod du dge 'dun dpag med la chos gsung dus ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang / khang dkar dgon gsar/li thang chos 'khor gling rnams su phyags phebs/ de rnams su po ti bsdams pa'i nang du'ang phyag nas mang du phyin/ gong du gser yig pa rnams brdzangs/spyir gdan sa 'og ma gnal sgo'i gra slob yon bdag gi gtso bo bum 'bor sgang che chung gnyis/ sgang chung la rong kha bzhi ru yon gnyis/ sma chu rgyud/ bshal n+ta rgyud/ 'dob rdza la rong / 'ba' thang sogs dang / dbra/ 'dru/ bzhagali thang sogs pum 'bor sgang chen dang / khyad par rje dus mkhyen gyi nye gnas 'dob byang chub 'od kyi slob rgyud sri dkar ba/ 'phel rkang pa/ rdzal gangs dkar ba sogs dang / lde chung sangs rgyas dang rje kurma pagi'i slob ma khring chen 1068

7 la slob ma khing chung / 'bu chung / byur chung gsum las/ khing chung gi slob rgyud bkra shis chos 'phel sgang pa rdza la rong gangs dkar ba rnams dang / khing ye shes seng ge'i dpon slob/ yom bo ba/ khing lcags ri ba sogs shal chung brgyud pa dang / 'bu chung gi dpon slob tshal rog pa dang tsang bar pa sogs ru drang ba rnams dang / byur chung gi slob rgyud mchog rab pa dang ru yon pa rnams dang / 'gro mgon ras chen gyi slob rgyud bcu gnyis skor gyi sngags sde chen po rnams la ru yon nas tsang zher gyi gra lan/ 'bri7 chu rgyud khrom ber gyi gsang thun/ ru drang nas༄ dge dog gi spra leb/ ma zhi'i tsaṇ+ḍa/ shal chu brgyud nas sha la sta gor gyi sngags sde/ khing ban gyi bcu dpun/ rag po'i mdo sngags/ tong ma'i rgya dpun/ nags ska rags kyi bcu bzhi dpun mgo sngon gyi gra chung / rdzal gangs dkar gyi sngags sde/ 'dob sa nag gi sum bcu dpun sogs sngags gra chen po da lta'ang gshin rje dang ma mgon la bsnyen sgrub sa nyal ma lo bcu gnyis las mi nyung ba byed pa ches mang ba yod pa rnams dang / gdan sa gnas sgo'i nang so bcu gnyis/ de mo ba/ stag tsha ba/ bde tsha ba/ bshes pa mkhan po ste mkhan po bzhi'i slob rgyud dang / gnas chen spung ri/ 'dam chen tsor/ dge bsnyen byang chub chos dge/ 'bo ta/ spang khru/ dbral gyi gangs dkar mched gsum/ dpal spang phug rnams su zhabs kyis bcags/ slar rnam si bhu pas zhus te zla ba bcu pa'i nang du /rma'i phyogs la phyag bteg ār+ya gling pa bla ma thar dpal gyis spyan drangs pas lam zhag bar nas mdzad/ mtsho khar phebs/ras 'bud dang rta lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ gzha' gsar rnying gi 'khrug rtsod bsdums/ khrom spyi thog tu phebs/ khrom khri dpon khu dpon sogs khrom gzhung gi skye bo thams ca da dang ka thog pa yon mchod gyis dad pas mchod/ sbrul lce rnam rgyal steng / ri mgo bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi chos rdzong / stag mgo byang chub gling 1069

rnams su byon/ der sgrub sde mdzad/ dri'i jo lha nang du sprul sku zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa dang gling tsan shin wang gis mjal dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang / shug ri thang du phebs/ chibs pa lhun grub 'das pa'i so la dung dkar mchin pa dang rus pa thams cad ring bsrel du song zhing a dkar po mang du byon/ 'ja' 'od kyis thams cad khyab/ ri chen du gdan drangs te 'bul zhabs kyis mchod/brag rgya dgon du phyag nas mdzad/ slar kre shod du phebs/ rje dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas lha mo phug tu lha mo'i pho brang thod pa skam rlon gyi gur dang bcas pa gzigs te bstod bskul mdzad/ de nas gling tsan shin wang gis spyan drangs/del lung thang brgyad du phebs/ mched ya dang sras po phul/ bdag po'i thang sku la phyag nas mang du zug gling bar tshang gi du si ting 'dzin ye shes kyis gdan sa lung khar spyan drangs/ dbon po ting 'dzin 'od zer dang ting 'dzin grags pa gnyis phyag phyir phul/ chos sde btab/ khang dmar dang 'dan tsan khang lha khang du byon/ khri dpon 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis dbon rnam rgya'4 grags pa phul/ nyi ldan steng du chos sde btab/ mtsho bshis su mtshur phu rin ngo che gdan 'dren la phebs/ zur mang du phebs te bde chen rtser sgrub sde mdzad/ras 'bud dang / lug lo'i lo gsar mdzad nas garmar phebs/ dga' byed sgang du dbyar bzhugs bug sgo mdzad/ mgon po ber nag can yang yang gziṭa nas shin tu khros pa gdong pa gsum pa zhes pa'i zhal gzigs ltar gyi chag tshad dang bstod bskul mdzad/ par khar phebs/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyi 'dun ma sogs 'di phyi'i don mdzad/ sma ri dwags su bzhugs dus dgun sgang chen la me tog gi sdong po gcig la me tog kha bye ba bdun yod pa/ me tog re re yang ge sar ser po 'dab ma ut+pal ltar sngo ba bcu gsum re yod pa skyes te ngo mtshar du gyur/ lho rdzong gsar du phebs/ nang so grags pa rgyal mtshan pas mchod/1070

bla ma 'od zer bzang po dang dpon rin chen bzang pos lha steng du spyan drangs/der ras 'bud dang spre lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ kong po nas bla ma dpal 'byor dang yon bdag seng ges rtse lha sgang gi rten gsum nyams pa rnams bsos nas phyag nas gnang bar zhus/ dus tshod bsgrigs te khrom chen po tshogs pa'i sang nyin nyi ma shar dros tsam la phyag nas gnang bas khrom gseb tu'ang 'bru sna tshogs pa char ltar byung / nang gi rten rnams la mang du zug lho stod du phebs/ rabazher yul/ bshis shod/ rdza dgon/ dpal 'bar rnams su zhabs kyi bcags/ bdud rtsi phug gad 'om/ sgo shar/ ri dkar dgon/ dpal 'bar rnams kyi so so'i lha khang gsar rnying la phyag nas zug de nas ri bo che dang ngom rnam rgyal sgang brgyud/ shar ti phug tu ras bud mdzad/ rel ne stong dpon gyis spyan drangs pa'i lam dang rdza pa stong dpon nor bus spyan drangs te sab mdor phebs/ bya lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ skyo mdar spyan drangs/ sde dpon ma lag dang bcas pa phul/ dbus po dang rngod shod brgyud/ ku dor dgon pa dang la pa mkhan po grags rgyal ba sogs kyis mchod/ gtsug lag gzhung gsum gyi skye bo rnams btul/ 'or du byams chen mjal zhing mchod pa cher mdzad/ la pa dang rdor 'be+e dpon g.yog gis byams chen chos 'khor gyi sde dgon btab/ gzhon nu dpal bla ma la bskos/ 'tshams na mo che brgyud/rel ne rgyal dgon du phebs/ stong dpon sogs kyis mchod/ 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi/ der skyes rabs brgya rtsa'i don bsdus mdzad tshe me tog gi char cher byung /dbra re dge chos brtson gyi dbon rgyud dang / rje rol pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma rdzoṭa chen pa che chung gi slob rgyud dpal ri dgon gso re ke/ chu rgyud pa sogs kyis gang steng du spyan drangs/ smar khams ma do drug pas drung mthong ba don ldan gyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes ngo mtshar can gzigs 'bul bar khyer te gzigs/ 'khrug 1071

rtsod rnams 'jags/ slar re ne nas rje dus mkhyen gyi yon tan gyi gdan sa 'phar dgon du phebs/ sku 'bum sogs mchod/ dngul dkar bkra shis phun tshogs kyi dgon pa btab ste brtson 'grus dpal bskos/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sgrub gnas rdo rje gro lod du phebs/ dri bzang gis yul gang / sgo stod/ 'bom mtsho kha/ khra tsong dgon/ 'bos di rnams su byon/ 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad/ rdzal sgang ko le rgyal mo'i zhol du phebs/ kha ba dkar po'i gnas bstod mdzad/ rang byon las rgya za kong jos gsal bar bzhengs pa'i rnam snang nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa la mchod pa cher mdzad/ dpon bsod nams kyis dhe wan du spyan drangs shing mchod/ bra pa bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa 'du long dgon du phebs/ dgon pa gsar du yang mdzad de smon bzang bka' bcu pa bskos/ gnas bstod kyang mdzad/ phyi nang gi 'khrug rtsod rnams gzhil/ re 'bur dang dmar bshis dpal 'bar dgon gser kha rnams su phebs/ 'bug rdzong nas phyag nas mdzad pas bka' bzhi pa'i lha khang dang tshong dpon tshul rgyan gyi lha khang du phyin/ kurmar phebs te lha chen bzhengs/ rab gnas kyi dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas byung / dbus phyogs su phyag bteg phebs pa'i lam 'dam du rgyal chen bco brgyad sdun bsur byung ba gzigs/ 'bab rom pa chen po'i zhabs rjes sngon ma mthong ba gsal bar bstan/ 'dam gzhung du yor dgon btab pa'i rmang bzhag nyin dgu na 'brug gi sgra dang me tog gi char byung /der sku mtshams la bzhugs pa na yang dgun char 'bab pa dang chos gsung ba'i nyin zhig chos grar nas kyi char byung / chu mig gsar du brdol/ de nas mtshur phur phebs te lha chen 'dzam gling rgyan sa g.yos kyis cung zad gnod pa'i zhig gso dang rab gnas mdzad tshe bstan pa'i bdag po dngos 'a/bor bcas thim par gzigs/ gong ma rgyal po'i gser yig pa che na shri du gang sogs kyis lung 1072

'bul zhabs dpag med phul/ lha sar phyag bskyod de dge bon khar sne'u rdzong pa sku mched dpon g.yog gis lha'i 'byor pa lta bus bsu ba dang bcas te lha sar phebs/ bco lnga'i nyin jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi snam sbyar/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje la snam sbyar gser ma sogs mchod sprin mtha' yas pa dang smon lam mdzad tshe ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang / rim pas byang gi phyogs thang lha'i zhol du bzhugs/ chos 'khor mang du bskor/ sneb lung dgon phul zhing rab gnas mdzad pas 'phel/ 'dam cog tse la kha nas gong du gser yig pa rnams mngaṭa/gnam mtsho'i do bskor mdzad de bkra shis do bo cher bka' rgyud kyi bla ma thams cad gzigs/ ra sgreng du jo bo yab sras gzigs/ dgon pa gong gi gdan sa pas dgon pa gong dbang ba'i bskor lam yan chad phul te bskos ja gnang / yang dgon gyi sgrub sde mdzad/ ra sgreng gi bka' srung laṅka mgrin bcu gzigs/jo mo gangs su phebs par dgongs/ gsil snar jo mo gangs dkar mas bsu bar gzigs/ 'brong bu dgon rnying du sngags pa zhig gi thang sku la phyag —nas gnang bas phyag nas la ring bsrel mang du byung / lha phu gangs rar phebs/gser 'bum phug tu re zhig dben pa mdzad/ thar 'dod mang po smin grol du gyur/ chos 'byung steng gi gnas sgo phye/ gyang gnyer gyis gdan drangs te dge ba la bkod/ yo cag mtsho sman sbrul gyis brgyan pas mchod/ rgya tshor spyan drangs te lha khang la phyag nas mdzad pas bar snang la phyag nas zla ba du mar chags/ thag ring po nas stag sna'i rdzong nang du phyag nas phyin/ 'o yug tu drung zhwa dmar ba sogs tshogs pa rgya mtsho la mdo sde las brgya ba sogs gnang / de'i tshe spyan snga tshes gnyis pa sne gdong gi khri thog mdzad pas spyan 'dren brgyud mar slebs/ za bu lung du gter lung rnams gzigs pa na gter dang gter bdag rnams ji lta bar gzigs/ rdo ril chung ngu'i steng du chen po brtsegs pa cig dang brag la 1073

slob dpon pad+ma'i sku rang byung sngon ma mthong ba bstan/ shangs kyi byang lam brgyud de gzhu gru bzhi dang mtshur phur phebs/ mtshur phur mdo sngags kyi bshad gra btsugs te ngo khro rab 'byam pa dbang phyug dpal bla mar bskos/ 'bri khung pas dbur stod du phebs par zhus te khru ba khar phebs/ chos rje rin po che sku mched kyis mjal nas mchod sprin cher mdzad/ bka' rgyud kyi chos skor mang du gnang bas thugs tshim/ khru ba kha dgon ma lag dkar leb rdzong bram sogs kyi bdag rkyen zhus te sgrub sde btsugs pa da dung du dar/ rong po dang mtha' bzhi sogs kyis rim pas spyan drangs te byang gi rgyud cog tse la'i bar du phebs/mdo khams pa'i spyan 'dren yang mang / der drung zhwa dmar ba dpon slob rnams sne gdong du nan gyis spyan 'dren par phebs/ ja 'dren 'bul nod rgya cher mdzad/ gdan 'dren pa sku ngo che ba ma ba zlog nas zhal gyis bzhes/ chibs kha rim gyis lha sa nas brgyud/ snye thang 'or du jo bo'i gsol lhung dang lung bstan sgrol ma sogs gzigs tshe jo bo dang byang sems du ma byon/ 'u shang rdor mnga' bdag khri ral gyi sngon gnas dran/ gzhung spre zhing du rje mar pa'i gdung khang rin po che mjal ba na rje mar mi dang rngog pa yab sras rnams dngos su gzigs/yar rgyab pa dpon chen rin chen bzang po yab yum gyis lha'i bkod pa lta bu'i mdun bsus dol du spyan drangs shing byams gling pa bsod nams rnam rgyal dang lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho sogs kyis mjal/ der sne gdong rtse nas ja 'dren thung ba slebs/ de nas sne gdong rtser bteg pa'i lam skyid bde phug tu spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po lugs gnyis kyi 'khor dang bcas pa 'khor los bsgyur ba lta bu'i 'byor pas mdun bsu dang thab 'dzin la phebs/ zhabs la spyi bos btugs pa'i dad pa gting phyin pa mdzad/ zla gcig lhag tsam du sne gdong rtser bzhugs/ mdo sde du ma'i lung chos drug gi khrid sogs kyis smin grol mdzad 1074

cing rtses dang du spyan drangs nyin 'ja' 'od dang me tog gis skye bo thams cad yid 'gyur tshogs chos su phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gnang bas thams cad mi phyed par dad/ spyan snga rin po che lugs gnyis kyi drung skor chen pos bskor ba stong phrag lhag pas zhabs skyel khra 'brug gi bar mdzad de der gnas mjal ba na sngon rgyal blon gyi sngon gnas du ma dran/ mchong rgyas stag rtser phebs/ dgon ri bo bde chen nas phyag nas mdzad pa stag rtse'i rdzong nang du phebs/ lhag bsam sde bas spyan drangs te 'bul zhabs kyis mchod/ shasbu'i gangs la re zhig dben pa mdzad/ bya ba khri dpon gyi ba g.ye gnyal du spyan drangs/ khri dpon pa dpon g.yog ya rtser spyan 'dren la slebs/ yar stod pa dang bya ba'i dums chen zhag gsum gyi nang du things/ gnyal lor byar gsum gyi gtsug khang yod do 'tshal gyi 'phyams sku dar seng gdugs rol cha sogs bsdus/ sde drug la sogs pa'i dge 'dun bsdus pa'i bsu ba'i bkod chen sa gzhi khebs pas sngun bsus te chos 4 rgyal lhun por phebs/ zla phyed re na 'bul chen lan re/ spyir thog mtha' bar gsum du tshad las 'das pa'i 'bul chen gsum byas pa'i dang po la chos 'khor lhun po'i dgon sdes thog drangs g.ye rong dang mon shal mo tshun bya ba'i mnga' zhabs na gtogs tshad kyi dgon sde gnyal sde drug byar chos sde lho ri smad lho brag mkhar chu lha khang sogs cho phran thams cad yi ger bkod de lha sde thams cad phul/ bar pa la khri dpon pa'i sras chos rgyal nor bu dang bkra shis rnam rgyal sku mched dbu skra phul nas mnga' zhabs na yod do cog gi skye 'gro thams cad phul/gsum pa la gzhis ka chos rgyal lhun pos gtsos nas shel mkhar/ sdong chen yang rtse/ shar gnas ka sogs khong rang dbang ba'i rdzong gzhis mnga' zhabs dang bcas pa phul/ 'di re re dang zla phyed kyi 'bul chen re re la'ang zang zing gi dngos spyad gzhan ni re re'ang khri rwa can gyis bsgrun par mi nus/ 'bul chen 1075

'di gsum sogs kyi 'bul yig bdag gis kyang rtse lha sgang du dngos su mthong /spyir khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas pa 'di ni rnam dpyod dang dad pa'i stobs che/khyad par drung du bcos min du mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob ste bya ba'i rgyal srid gar bstan du sgyur bar dgongs nas de'i smon lam dang bstod pa gsol 'debs kyang du ma mdzad/ sras che bar lung rgyal dbang chos rje'i sku skye la mtshan chos kyi graṭa pa dang go'i shi'i las ka gnang / sgyer gyi zhal ngo lugs gnyis kyi yon tan du mas phyug pa dbon po phyogs las ba la bstan pa 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' lung dang garma 'phrin las pa'i mtshan gnang ste chos 'khor lhun po'i gdan sar bskos shing sngags kyi gra tshang gnyis la dwags po rab 'byams pa mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa dang dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug mtshan nyid kyi gra gnyis la mkhas pa nam mkha' dpal bzang pa dang sde bdun rab 'byam pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan pa gnyis bskos/ zab mo yang dag ri dang rdza dmar sogs su'ang sgrub sde mdzad/dbyar bzhugs dbyar sar mdzad/ /rma gra tshang gi bshad gra thog mar btsugs te mi nyag rab 'byam pa mgon po dpal klog pa'i slob dpon du bskos/ rje btsun ma mnga' ris rgyal mos mjal te 'bul zhabs mdzad pa na byang stag lung gi nyen kor na yod pa'i sku skye 'di 'chi med grub pa ni yin nās par 'dug khyed rang bdog rkyen byas na legs/ mi byed na bstan pa la phan pa 'ong bas nged kyis byas pas chog ces bkas gnang bas bdag rkyen mdzad de thog mar drung du mjal nas gtsug phud phul/ se ba lung rje dwags po'i ngo mthong phug gzigs/rje dwags po'i 'khrungs gnas su yang phebs/ de dag tu bla ma lha rje rtag tu gzigs/ der rdo rje bdan du ma hā bo bhi la zhal gser snyan dar/ sangs rgyas la bstod pa/ smon lam/ rdo rje gdan gyi sgo yig tu sbyor rgyu dang bcas pa skad gnyis su bkod pa dzo gi 'chi med mgon po la bskur/ sngon rje dus mkhyen mon 1076

dom tshang na sgrub pa mdzad dus kyi sbyin bdag mon gyi rgyal po grwa thung gi rgyud pa mo na/ tsang mi/ ka tsa ra/ rgya gar ste re re la khri tsho re yod pa'i bdag po mon rgyal po don grub mjal du slebs/ 'bul zhabs dpag med byas/ sras po gcig phul te mon du dgon gnas 'debs par zhus/ gnas chen dom tshang rong gi sbyin bdag bgyid par byas te rdor 'dzin bskos pas gnas dar rgyas su gyur/ de ltar bya pa'i skor du lo gcig lhag pa bzhugs/ 'gro don mtha' yas/ slar g.ye rong brgyud/ spyan snga rin po ches spyan drangs te yar 'on gyi phyogs su bteg yar chab gtsang po'i chu sgrol nyin spyan snga rin po che dpon slob pha rir sngun bsu la phebs/ chu phan tshun du chibs rags phebs pa dus mtshungs su byung ba'i drung gi chibs rags gzigs ma thag spyan snga rin po che chibs las gzhol te dpon g.yog thams cad dad pa'i phyag grangs med du mdzad/ mchod yon lhan gcig pas zang ri khang dmar gyi gnas gzigs/ der ma gcig dang gcod yul bka' rgyud rnams bzhugs par gzigs/ thel du phebs te mdun bsu la rgyal po hu las phul ba'i 'phan chen sogs gshams/ spyan snga rin po che la thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa du ma dang brag cog pa rin chen bzang po dang lhun bde rab 'byams pa la sogs mkhan slob chos gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun thams cwad chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ der dpal phag gru pa rtag tu gzigs/ mchod yon lhan cig pas bsam yas su phebs te slog dpon pad+ma dang bodhi sa twa dang rgyal blon byang sems kyi gzigs snang mtha' yas shing 'di thams cad du'ang 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi ltas kyis skye bo kun yid phrogs/ mchod yon lhan cig pas mchims phur phebs te spyir rje rang byung pas sngon der dben par mdzad/ sgrub sde btsugs mkhas pa klong chen pa bskos pa las bla ma mkhas grub pa sogs sgrub sde'i rgyun mchims phu rnying mar grags pa 'di 1077

byung / 'on kyang de dag dus kyis rnyings te chos sgrub pa nyung ngur gyur par gzigs te sgrub sde gsar du mdzad/ mchims phu'i lung nang mchod gzhis su phul te mkhas shing grub pa dwags po gsung rab mang thos bla ca/ra bskos/ sgrub sde gtsang zhing thugs daca/ smar ba zhig byung / bka' srung rig 'dzin ma dang rgod po ta ras sgrub pa ba gzhan du 'gror mi ster ba dang / sgrub sde la gnod pa phra mo byas pa la'ang bka' chad cher btang bas bka' srung gi snyan grags cher byung / spyan snga rin po che mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pas zhabs spyi bor blangs te mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos spyan chab kyi rlabs g.yos pa'i gsol 'debs dang smon lam mdzad de phyir thegs/ 'phrang po seng ge sgang pas rdo rje brag rtsa'i dgon pa phul te bla ma la bskos ja gnang / gser la nas lha sar phebs/ chu shul lhun po rtse sa skyong don yod rdo rje'i phyag tu byung ba dang dus mtshungs pas phyag nas zhur byung ba lha sa nas phyag nas 'thor bas lhun po rtse'i rdzong nang phal che bar slebs te nas thum po byas nas ngo mtshar la phyogs kun tu bkye zer/spyir rgyal ba byams pas lung bstan te jo bo shākya 'di nag grong gi dbus su bzhugs pa 'dis bstan pa spyi nyams/ khyad par bod du nyams shing mchog sprul la mi 'os pa'i rgyan gyi rten 'brel gyis kyang bod 'ban btsun gyis gang ba yin/jo bo'i sku 'khor du dge 'dun gtsang sing ba'i sde zhig grub na bstan pa sos par 'gyur gsungs ba lan gsum du gsan pas de lta bu zhig thugs kyis dgongs kyang gzhis ka snel pa khong rang chags pa nas bzung drung na rim gsum gyi sbyin bdag yin yang gzhan dbang gis bka' ma sgrubs pas bar skor gyi phyi la dge 'dun bzhugs pa ni ma grub/ 'on kyang byams pa'i bka' ma bcag pa tsam mdzad par dgongs nas garma gra tshang gi bzhugs gnas su gam chos sde btab pa na skyes bu gsum las gang rung gi lam rgyud la skyes nges kyi dam pa 'ga' zung 1078

yang so so na yod par gdon mi za cho/da kyi de dag la ni su yang nyan par mi spyod/ snyigs dus kyi dge sbyong dang bram ze zang zing kho na la gdu zhing khyim la 'khren pa dag ni ches mang bas de dag gi yid bdud ris kyis mngon par dkrugs te rab byung gi rtags kyi phyi shun go mtshon ci rnyed bsdus pas spras te g.yul gshom par rtsom pa na dad ldan du mas 'di ltar gda' bas gzhan du gshegs pa'am srung ba'i lta gon nam sgar pa nyis stong du nye ba zhig 'dug pa la phyag mdzod kyi 'bul ba'i khrub dos gri dos kho na bshig na yang khed pa 'dra zhing g.yar na ban dmag phyed dang lnga brgya tsam zhig gis gar yang mi phyin pas bkas gnang bar zhus kyang 'o skol su la yang gnod pa mi byed/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rma mi 'byin/ khyod rang su yin yang nga'i 'khor yin pa rnams co ge sdod cig gsungs te ji mi snyam par bzhugs/ nang par glo bur du ser dmag lnga brgya tsam bshams/ rmog med pa rnams lhung bzed mgor gon/ rten khebs la mdung dar byas te 'ongs/ pa ra ba rdo rje dpal grub kyis kyang 'u lag gtos che ba khrid de phyag mdzod rnams 'thor na mi yong bas ngas smon grong du tshags byed 'u lag 'di rnams la khol zer nas bsam mno gzhan byas kyang sgar pa sus kyang bka' las ma 'das shing ri rab ltar g.yo 'gul ma byung bas sgar la gnod ma nus par chos sde mkhar las lcil bu re gnyis zin phal cher ma zin pa rnams bshig sreg byas/ sgar la gnod mi nus par dgongs kyang jo bo'i drung du gsol ba gdab par dal gyis phebs pa la dmag gis zhabs phyir bsnyegs/ mtshams med pa'i las lnga ji/'i byed pa po la dad blangs pa du ma byung / seng ldeng sgo nang du phebs pa dang ser dmag gis kyang khyams khra gang skad/ zhabs phyir nang so bzod pa brag pa rab byung byas ma thag pa cig yod pas sgo'i phyi rol du 'dug ste rlung gis sprin nag ltar gtor bas byed pa po de dag mi/ lugs gnyis kyi mtshan 1079
