nyid skye bo thams cad la bstan pa tsam las don ma 'grab/ 'di thos pa'i skye bo ༄lha mi thams cad kyang yid 'khrugs/ bya pa bskal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i mkhas pa des kyang gnas 'di lta bu la bya pa khri dpon sogs sbyin bdag dad ldan rnams kyis bka' chad mngon sum du 'bab par 'dug pas bka' gnang dgos par zhus/ drung zhwa dmar bas kyang gnas 'di lta bu btang stoms su 'jog pa mi 'ong bas 'di'i khag nga rang kho nas byed zer ba zhus/ bya pa khri dpon gyi zhu yig drag po'i 'phrin las kho na dus la bab tshul 'di ni bdag kho nas thal bar bgyid ces zhus/ kong po'i rgya bdag thams cad kyis kong dmag 'cha' bar zhus/ sa skyong don yod pa dang lcags mo 'od zer ba sogs kyis nged rang gi mnga' zhabs su chos lugs 'di gcig kyang mi mjog pas gnang dgos par zhus/ 'di thams cad la bdag gis zhu yig ngos ma kho na mthong /de thams cad la nged su la yang gang phan las gnod pa mi byed/ khyed gra yon bdag gis kyang chos bzhin bstan pa bzhin byas na nged kyi dgongs pa rdzogs/nged la dmigs nas gzhan la gnod pa byas na nged kyi zhabs tog ma yin gsungs nas dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig pa'i bka' nan gyis bsdams/ phar gnang ba'i bka' shog dngos ma mthong na yang de'i zhu lan dngos mthong ba na 'di ltar phebs pa ces 'dug pas don der snang zhing da dung yang dang yang du gsol ba la yang bka' nan de bas kyang cher gnang bas kha cig legs so phul zhing dad pa bla lhag par skyes/ rje zhwa dmar ba yang thugs chad pa'i zhu yig phul/ bya pa khri dpon ni khyed bstan pa'i bdag po rnams bstan pa mi srung na nged tsho 'dra nyan rang du zhugs kyang bla zer ba'i thugs chad mtha' yas par mdzad/ phyis bya pa khri dpon gyis 'di thugs la mnags pa kho nas yar gong snel gsum dang srid bshig ste gtsang srid mdzad nas skyi shod du khri dam/ gnyis 1080

gsum bteg pa'i tshe'ang drung rtse lha sgang na bzhugs/ de dag gis rje zhwa dmar ba la skyabs zhus kyang drung nyid du zhus shig par bka' bstsal/ myur ba'i pho nyas rtse lha sgang du btol te slar bka' shog nan can mdzad pas khri dpon pas 'dir yang yi chad du ma mdzad pa'i zhu yig snga phyi rnams dngos su mthong zhing phyi bltas rje zhwa dmar bas bskyabs pa ltar snang yang ngo bo rje nyid kyi bka' drin kho na ste byed pa po de dag gi lus srog longs spyod rten gnas dang bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa bstsal te/ 'dzam bu gling gi skyes mchog ni/ /nyes pa'i lan yang legs pas ldon/ /zhes pa'i rnam thar mngon sum du bstan te bdag ni rnam par thar pa 'di la mi phyed pa'i dad pa gzhal du med pa skyes so/ /de nas dbur stod kyi phyogs su phebs/ bdud ris kyi cho 'phrul rlung 'tshub nen po phyogs bzhi ga nas 'byung ba dang rlung 'tshub nas thog 'byung ba sogs byung ba ting nge 'dzin gyi zil gyis mnan te skad cig gis zhi/ 'bri khung pa'i lha sde mi sde thams cad kyis mchod/ khrom khri phrag lnga drug tshogs/ sgom pas kyang zhal mthong gsung thos kyis dad pa thob/ gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas nges shes khyad par can skyes/ bde chen khyung ngar du sgrub sde dang sngags rgyun btsugs/ khri khang pa yon mchod kyis mchod/ khre ba kha'i chos khri thang du sku mtshams mdzad pa na ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag can dang dpal lha mos 'phrin las sgrub par gzigs/ 'bri khung dbang rin po che dang dpon rin po che sku mched gsum sogs kyis rgyang ring po nas sngun bsus te 'bri khung thel du phebs/tshe'u kha'i thang la bzhugs/ dbang gi las ga'i snam sbyar gser ma/ gos ta hung gi sham thabs/ tsan+dana'i ka ba shubs bcas sogs 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ dbang rin po che nyid kyis lha khang chen mo bsos nas lha chen gsar du bzhengs pa /ma rab gnas mdzad/ 'di dag gi dus bka' rgyud kyi bstan pa nyam 1081

rmas/ khyad par 'bri khung na bstan dgongs zab chos dang bcas pa'i chos dang phyag dpe'ang mi bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas bstan pa gso dgos par dgongs/tshogs chos su bstan snying gi bshad pa dang / rin po che khu dbon la zab chos ci rigs dang phyag chen chos drug gi khrid/ khyad par dbang rin po che la phyag chen gyi thugs dam bka' rgyud kyi gral zin pa skyed par mdzad/ sgrub sde'i sa bon btab/ mkhan po'i bsko gzhag sogs bca' ba/ chos khrims kyang mdzad de 'bri khung pa'i bstan pa gzhi nas bsos/ der rje 'jig rten mgon po sogs rtag par gzigs/ stag zher ru bas kyang spyan drangs/ ser mo ba mi bcom par khas blangs/ sha pho gsang du phebs tshe mi nyag gi ja pa mang pos 'bul zhabs cher byas/ 'dam gzhung du bla ma rin po che'i— sku 'bum gyi rtser gser phru btsugs/ yod dgon gyi bca' ba chos khrims mdzad/ bra bo dgon pa bkra shis dar gling phul te phag mo'i sgrub mchod btsugs/ stag lung phod mdo hor khang pa yab sras kyis spyan drangs te mkhan slob kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis kyang mjal zhing 'bul zhabs cher byas/ de tshor thor nad pa bsdad shul du sgar phog cing thor nad mang du yod kyang skyon ci yang ma byung zhing nad yams kun chad/ kong po'i gdan 'dren snga phyir mang / khyad par drung nyid ma gtogs bsam rgyu med cing / kong lung pa kha lo bsgyur nus pa sa skyong don yod rdo rje dang grogs por 'thams pa'i yon bdag chen po 'bro la hu res/ chos rje rin po che khyed 'jag gi sar byon pa yin 'jag la be rgan gyi me yod/nas rgan gyi chang yod/ phag rgan gyi sha yod/ ma byon na khyi rgan sgug yun rings na bshang ba grang thag chad smra ba de yong ba yin zer ba phul/ der khrims dpon rnams kyis bltas nas 'bul ma nus par zhu yig bshig nas phul/ kong po de sngar ma bcos pa zhig yod pa yin da 'gyur 'dug mi 'gro gsungs/ dngos de 1082

ka phul bas bzhad cing zhal bzhes mdzad/ klung shod nas nyang kha phyogs su phebs/ brag dkar lha chu zhes bya ba ri rdo rje phag mo'i sku rang byung du gsal ba gsang ba chos 'a byung gi rnam pa'i nang du rtsa gsum gsal zhing bdud rtsi'i chu nyin re la dus gsum du 'bab pa/ dbu ma'i nang du gyen du phyin pa na lte ba sprul 'khor sogs 'khor lo so so la lha mang du bzhugs pa/ spyi bo tshangs bug snyan spyan gyi phug dang bcas pa'i gnas sgo phye/ der zhabs rjes zhus pa na yod de 'ong brag logs la stos dang gsung ba ltas pa na brag mi'i lag gis mi sleb tsam pa'i ngos 'jam po la zhabs rjes gsal zhing dod par mthong / 'on kyang da dung bdag rnams kyis mthong bar zhabs rjes dgos zhus pas/ 'o na 'di na phar la yi ge drug pa 'dug gsung zhing ma ṇi'i dbyangs gsung chung ngus mdzad bzhin pas phyag mdzub g.yas pas brag la ma reg tsam du 'bri ba ltar mdzad pa na bod kyi gzab ma'i yi ge drug ma 'bur du brkos pa ltar khyur gyis byung /gnas der sgrub sde mdzad/4 bla ma bskos te nags phu nas skyongs shig par bskos/der slob dashaṃn pad+ma lhag par du gzigs/ nags phur phebs/ der tshangs gsar bas phul ba'i chibs gā pa zhig shi bas ring bsrel dpag med byung /nags mdo'i gsal sgang du brag phug la phyag nas zhus pas brag la nas mang du thim zhing zug brag gsum du phebs/ zho khar 'phan chen gzigs tshe 'ja' dang me tog gi char mtha' yas/ cung zad nyams pa phyis gso bar mdzad/ mtsho chu dang mi nyag rtogs ldan gyis btab pa'i mdo chen dgon sogs zhabs kyis bcags/ brag gsum pa spyis bu khrul mang du phul te zho ba'i lha khang la brten nas chos sde rgya cher mdzad/ rkang por rim pas phebs pa'i brag phyi yan du kong stod smad kyi so so'i ja 'dren mtha' yas/ gsa' phur phebs te bka' rgyud kyi bla ca/ mtha' dag byon par gzigs/ se mo gnyan khrir go'i shri rin po che'i sprul 1083

sku ba dang drung bkra shis don grub pas gtsos pa'i kur srid kyi bla dpon rgya bdag thams cad kyis mdun bsu byas/ gyang tho skor gsum/ kong smad kur srid sogs thams cad 'dus te dga' ches pas so so nas 'phyams bro la sog sa pa'i gzigs 'bul/ 'bul zhabs rgya cher byas/ khyad par g.yung drung 'dzin du sngon gyi rgan mo blo bde'i bu brgyud yon bdag 'bro la hu res rta bzang brgya 'bul dang gzhan dag gis kyang rta bzang nyi shu sum bcu sogs 'bul ba ni mtha' yas/ lkog phreng du sgrub sde btsugs/ rtse lha sgang du phebs/ der chibs ོ pa khyung smug shi ba 'ja' gur gyis mi mthong ba tsam du btums/ me tog gi char bu yug ltar 'tshubs ring bsrel mang du byung / mdzod nag sogs gzigs shing mkhar las gsar du yang mdzad/ der rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi seng ge'i khri gnon pa/ 'phags pa'i yul thams cad kyi bstan pa'i bdag po 'dzam gling na zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen po dpal ldan yid kyi shing rta zhes bya ba'i rdo rje gdan pa chen po des rgya gar gyi rdo rje'i gdan dang ma ga bha la sogs par bstan pa spel bar phebs dgos pa'i spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig 'di lta bu phul te/ ya tra shu bha stomaspra ne sa ka la su ga ta ma ta byo ma masnyu lā lam kā ra/ —sha ra da skṛ ta hu hu tsi pra sa ka be+e ma la ka la dha wa li tā khri la ditshosnyulehūṃ/ zhes sogs phul ba ston gyi ka cog zhang gsum las mi dman pa zhus chen gyi lo tsā ba chen po zha lu lo tsā ba zhes grags pa/ bdag gi mkhan po don gyi slad du mtshan smos te chos skyong dpal bzang po dang de'i slob ma glo bo lo tsā ba dpal ldan grags pa dang bcas pa zhabs phyir bzhugs pa'i skabs su snang bas de bsgyur ba ni/ gang zhig dge ba'i sar gnas mtha' dag bde gshegs kyi/ /ring lugs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi ni rgyan gyur pa/ /ston ku'i zla ltar rab mdzes mtha' dag dri ma med/ /cha shas dkar pos ma lus phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /snyan grags 1084

'byor pa gsal ba'i ga bur gyis gang ba/ /rab 4/sal ma tshan bzang rin chen dpal ldan bla ma ni/ /lasba kurma sho tse'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ /byang chub chen po'i char gnas dpal ldan e rasnyu'i/ /chu bo'i drung gnas mkhan chen dpal ldan yid kyi ni/ /shing rtas sa la spyi bos btud de lan brgyar 'dud/ /dpal ldan khyod kyi spyod yul 'di ni rgyal ba yi/ /yon tan gyi ni gzhir gyur rgya chen mtshan mnga' ba/ /skye bdun dngos por shes pa'i yon tan thob pa yis/ /bdag cag la sogs byang chub chen po'i char gnas pa'i/ /'jig rten rnams ni dga' ba chen po skyes par gyur/ /dri med spyan gyis nges par gzigs shig thugs kyis kyang / /mtha' dag rnam par sems shig tshig kyang dbyangs kyis sgrogs/ /gang zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos las mtha' dag dri ma med/ /mtshan mnga' thub dbang yin slad de phyir khyod kyis ni/ /blta bar 'dod cing 'dod pa thams cad rab bskang bar/ /bzhed pa gang yin de ni rnam pa thams cad du/ /de nyid dpal yon yin te de nyid nor ldan no/ /de nyid tshogs dang yon tan ldan pa'ang de nyid do/ /gang zhig gzhan don byed par rang don rgyu gcig snying po mchog /de phyir dpal ldan gzhan phan ro gcig kun mkhyen gyis/ /yon tan rin chen rab tu gsal phyir brtson bya 'os/ /gzhan don byed pa med par byang chub yod min zhing / /byang chub don du gnyer ba med de gang gi phyir//bcom ldan sangs rgyas gzhan don nyid las rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub gyur par kun tu rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /rnam pa gzhan gyi tshul dang rgyu la gnas pa ngayis/ /byang chub min zhing nam yang kun mkhyen lta ci smos/ /nag pa zla ba'i bza' lhag pa la/ zhes byang chub shing gi lo ma mang po dang bcas pa dang /paṇ+ḍita chen po dgra gcan zin gzhon nu zhes bya ba sngon gyi rgyan drug la do bar grags pa des kyang zhu yig 'di dang mtshungs pa tshig don phun sum tshogs pa cig 1085

phul ba'i rgya dpe bod dpe gnyi ga mtshur phur phyag mdzod na bzhugs pa dngob su mthong na'ang da lta zhu yig cig shos kyi dpe ma rnyed/ ma gadha'i rgyal pos kyang spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig phul bar snang / 'di rnaca/sa dang gnas chen po brgyad kyi sa rdo sogs dang dpal gyi ri'i byin rlabs sogs dzo gi 'chi med mgon po soṭa kyis phul/ rten gyi yul mchod par bya ba nyid tu byed pa'i sa rdo sogs de dag las gnas chen brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sa rdo'i ril bu zhes ril bu skya sob che ba zhirge mdzad de deng sang yang rgyun yod/ dpal gyi ri'i grub chen rnams la sngon tshogs 'khor dang 'phrin shog gnang ba la ni dag pa'i snang ba nyid du de dag dang bgro ba mdzad par gor ma chag snyam mo/ /slar phrag yul du phebs te de dag gi lan gyi bka' shog dang rdo rje gdan du mchod pa siṅgha gling pa rnams dge ba la sbyor ba'i chab shog sogs gnang ste brdzangs/ phrag grum tshal du chos sde'i gzhi mdzad/der gzims khang la mtshan re zhing 'ja' dkar po zug spyir nyin mo skar ma mthong ba dang / mtshan mo 'ja' tshon 'byung ba dang / zhes mi shis pa'i rtags su 'chad pa yod kyang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad pa'i skabs su 'di 'dra ma nges te mig bcu gnyis pa sogs las byis pa skyes ma thag smra ba dang rgod pa dang ldang ba dang shing gi grib ma snga dro yod sar phyi dro'ang mi 'pho ba dang bur shing las bu ram rang bzhin gyis 'dzag pa sogs mi shis par bshad mod kyang ston pa sku bltams ma thag bzhad cing gsung chen pos 'di ni nga'i skye ba mtha' ma'o sogs gsung zhing phyogs rer gom pa bdun re 'bor ba dang dzaspu'i grib mas sku ma btang ba dang / 'tshang rgya ba na bur shing sogs las bcud rang 'dzag pa sogs ngo mtshar du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phrag mi'i 'khrug chen rnams zhi bar mdzad/ tsa gong gi gnas mdar sgrub sde mdzad/ ba yor mtshur phu rin po che gshegs pa'i don du phebs/ bkra shis ljongs su gzims khang mdzad/1086 —

zhing skyong gi sngags rgyun dang ba ༵ra yang zhing skyong gi rten gtor dang bskang rgyun/tsā ri'i gsar ma gnas lnga la ri srid kyi bka' gnang / phrag yul la phebs lam du shang stag bcus kyi sa dkar ma dang / rgya la rtse sdum gyi rtse bcad pa yin zer ba'i ri'i rtsa ba dang / sbang chu lung dang / me rag gi dgon pa dang / rgyal grong dgon pa sogs so so'i kha bdag gi lha mis phul te 'jigs skyob kyi dgon pa 'debs par zhus/ kha cig tu sgrub sde dang kha cig tu sbyin gtong gi khang pa tsam grub/ rta bang chab nag rgyal khang gi phur dben pa mdzad dus chu sgra las/ dag cing dri med sogs kyi mchod dbyangs rgyun du gsan/ 'phan chen mo gso ba'i dbu btsugs/ kong lung ral gsum la chos rgya dkar po/ gar srid sngags srid sogs lugs gnyis kyi bca' bas thams cad la phan bder mdzad/ der rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i dge slong shri la sā kur zhes pa zhig zhal lta ba kho na'i don du sleb sa/ dad pa cher thob/ paṇa chen gnyis dang rgyal po la chab shog gnang /'di dag la sngar ngag rgyun thos pa na rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po dgra gcan zin gzhon nu dang rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇa chen yid kyi shing rta zhes dang phyi ma 'di rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs par thos shing rnam thar par ma sogs na'ang rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan chen dgra gcan zin gzhon nu zhes snang mod kyang rdo rje gdan pa de ni yid kyi shing rta nyid du zhu yig gis grub bo/ /gling po che'i tshal du gong gi gser yig pa rnams nye bar blobs pa'i snga 'phros byung / bde yangs nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris phyin du dus 'khrug mi yong ba'i gser yig pa gnang ste re zhig bde/ dam can mgar nag gi gnas thog ma de brdung ba'i sgra thos shing zla ba re'i ring mgar ba gzhan gyis nye lam du bzo byed mi nus pa gri lha rtse rnon gyi mdun du phebs/ gri pas 'bul zhabs dang re kha dgon du dam can gyi rten gtor sngags rgyun btsugs/ rta bar phug gseb tu zla gnyis dben pa mdzad/ po bo'i — 1087

phyo gas su phebs/ bre mo chu mdor rnam rgyal gling gi dgon pa btab/ sngon zam gla chen po yod pa bcag ste dge zam du mdzad/ po kong gi 'khrug rtsod zhi/ po bo ya gong gi mar khu thang du dgon gnas btab/ rgya'i gser yig pa rnams nye bar slebs pas slar kong por phebs/ khyung tho la rtsa'i shing tshul ba dang skyo tshul ba bla ma grags rgyal gyis bar stod dgon sogs rang rang gi bdog pa sa rgya gnam rgya dang bcas pa phul te zhal bdag dang bskos ja gnang / gong ma snga ma gnam du gshegs pa'i smon lam zhu ba dang / da lta'i gong ma khri thog tu phebs pa'i bkra shis zhu bar gong gi gser yig pa ta'i go'i shri bkra shis bzang po rin chen kon ting go'i shri blo gros bzang po sogs slebs/ gong ma'i lung 'bul ba rgya ja phyed dang nyis brgya/ gos phyi nang brgya/ tsan+dan sdong po sum bcu rtsa grangs/dngul rkyan chen po gnyis sogs yo byad mtha' yas pa dang / yum chen mos gser 'phan drug rten khebs khyad par can mang po dang / don chos rje/ yang chos rje/ se ra chos rje sogs pho brang gi chos rje rnams dang / 4 tha'i rkyen wang sogs pho brang gi mi chen thams cad kyis so so nas 'bul zhabs mtha' yas par byung / bsngo ba smon lam gyi rgyas 'debs mdzad/ sngar po bo nas tshur glo bur du phebs pa'i dbang gis pha gir zhabs phyi ma zin pa'i thog kha nang so/ ka nam rdzong pa/ g.ya' dman pa sogs po bo gzhung dang po stod spyi'i mjal mi ma tha' yas slebs shing po rta bzang po sum bcu lhag pas gtsos pa'i 'bul zhabs byas/ gsal phur phebs/ brag phyi ba rnams kyis se te phreng phul te chos sde btab/ rgyal mtshan steng du gzims khang gi rmang bzhag gser yig pa go'i shri gnyis la 'dod chos gdams ngag gnang bas nges shes thob/ rtse lha sgang du— gser yig pa rnams la rten zhal bstan tshe ngo mtshar gyi ltas mang du byung / kar dpon bkra shis dpal 'byor ba la bskos ja gnang ste gdan sa karma'i si dhu 1088 —

la bskos/ spyir rgya nag gi las ka la mi dpon lha dpon gnyis las re re zhing mchog dman gyi rnam grangs mang yang de thams cad rgyal po nyid ma gtogs gzhan gyis bskos mi chog kyang rje de bzhin gshegs pa bod la phebs dus ta 'i ming rgyal pos rgya bod thag ring bas 'phral du zhu bas sleb mi thub/ chos rje rin po che nyid la mgon skyabs zhus pa'i rigs la lha dpon mi dpon gang gi'ang las ka nged la ma zhus par chos rje rin po che nyid kyis gnang ba zhu/ las ku'i rgyab gnon nged kyis byed zhus te de phyin go shri dang siju la sogs gnang ba yin zhing siju ni hor dus kyi las ga'i ming phyis 'jags pa yin/ gong du yang gong ma khri thog tu phebs pa la rgyal ba dang tshe spel ba'i shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i phreng ba dang / rgya yul gyi gar dgon/ ling gu si'i sde/ tas tu kur sde/ ri bo rtse lnga'i sde/ 'jam dbyangs sprul sde/ shing kun kur sde sogs la gus zhabs dgos tshul/ rgyal khams la dge bcu'i khrims mdzad dgos par bka' gnang ba sogs rgya cher bka' bstsal te gser yig pa rnams slar gong du brdzangs/ smon lam gyi cho ga yan lag nyi shu pa mdzad de sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi dang khyad par hor zla dang po'i cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du 'dzam gling tsam na zla ma mchis pa'i rten ngo mtshar can gzhal du med pa rnams las ci rigs par bshams/ rin po che a li mig shel spyad kha dog sna tshogs/ gser dmar smug ser gsum/ tha ma dngul spyad dang gu gu shan gyis bsdus pa'i mchod rdzas bod yul ba tshangs par bsnyems pa rnams kyis kyang sngon chad thos pa'i lam du yang ma gyur na mthong ba'i lam du lta ga la zhig pa rnams nyin re zhing gong nas gong du spel bas bshams pa'i spyan sngar drung nyid kyang srab stan nas gus phyag la sogs mdzad cing snga dro smon lam chen mo mdzad/ da lta smon lam chen mo'i nang du bzhugs pa'i bsngo ba rje nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 1089

yongs sbyong gi smon lam du yod pa 'di drung kho nas ljags thog nas gsungs/de'i ring sgar pa mi mang thams cad bsngo ba nyan zhing zhal lta/ phyi dro rnams sangs rgyas kyi skyes rabs du ma/ rgya bod kyi grub chen rnams byon tshul/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal/ rgya bod hor gsum gyi rgyal po/ lha lha min rtsod pa/ brgya byin dang rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa'i tshul gyi zlos gar gyi rtsed sna mdzad/ spyir rje 'di dus rtag tu zhabs rdo rje skyil krung phyag mnyam bzhag spyan lta stangs dang mi 'bral/ 'jig rten gyi gtam dri rmed gsum 'brel phan mi mdzad/ chos kyi 'bel gtam cung zad re ma gtogs gsung cher mi byon/ dus rtag tu ting nge 'dzin kho na las mi g.yo/ gzims sgar gar phebs su yang ca/jal mi thag ring ba mang dus zhag gsum re/ phal cher lnga'am bdun re la nyin re zhal mjal ja gral phyag lcag tsam ma gtogs phal cher thugs dam sku mtshams su bzhugs/ skyo seng ri gzigs sogs la mi phebs/ de'i dbang gis sgar pa rnams kyis kyang zhal mjal ba shin tu dka' zhing dkon pa'i 'du shes mtha' yas kyang cho 'phrul gyi ring snga dro bzhin sgar pa kun dang phyi dro khrom thams cad kyis mjal du yod pas dad can rnams ni zhal mjal kho na'i ched du snyeg skye bo tsam po ba mchog dman kun kyang sgar pa lo gsar zer nas ltad mo yang rab dang nying rab tu byed/phyis dbus gtsang du lha sa dang mkha' ru steng sogs su rgya ras zam so 'ba' zhig las byas pa'i gur chen gnam sngo leb khang pa ka ba brgya'i tshod yol skor skar phebs sgo zur gyi lcog gaspyi ra gser bya gser 'brug dang bcas pa phub par byes chas kyi mchod gshom gzab gshom mdzad/ gasbyo la'i dbu thog tu ta'i ming rgyal pos phul ba'i mu tig che ba the bong tsam nas chung ba sran ma tsam sdi bar gyi mu tig dkar dmar ser sngo sogs bsgrigs pa'i gdugs bcu gsum brtsegs kyi bdun pa yang pho 'dom phyed gnyis kyis 'khor ba tsam la sogs pa 1090

phub/ dbu thog dang sku rgyab tu mu tig gi bla re dang yol ba mu tig gi sku mnye dang bzhugs 'bol sogs bshams/ mu tig gi 'phan chen sogs mchod rdzas khyad par can rnams bshams pa na dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i bdag po sa skyong rdan yod rdo rje sogs kyang ha las te mis lha yul du slebs pa lta bur ngo mtshar ches pas dri ba'i spobs pa tsam yang ma byung / sman thang 'jam dbyangs pa sogs ci 'di rmi lam mam mig 'phrul yin nam yang na rnam sras kyi khang par sleb bam bsam pa byung zer skad/ rten mchod rgyas pa rgya nag gi brkos ma'i gnas bcu rgyas pa sogs mchog rnams mdzod nag na bzhugs pa yin pas sgar la bstos te 'di byes mdzod kyi rags bsdus bshams par zad pa la'ang de lta na gzhan lta ci smos/ sgar gyi phyag rdzas mtha' dag gi byung ba yin lugs sogs ni rje na rim nyid kyi so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis mkhyen gzigs kyi sgo nas bka' bstsal pa ma gtogs rten sgam gcig gi yang tshang pa su la yang ma 'tshal te gu'i gung pa rnams kyis kyang tshang bar mi mkhyen par yin te 'di ni bdag gis kyang rjes dpag ma yin par mngon sum gyis nges so/ /'on kyang sngon rje de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyi dus la bstos na ni cha tsam du snang ste mchod gshom chen mo mi the ba gasto la'i skor kho na la sngon rten sgam rgyab tshad ma sum bcu so gnyis yin 'dug kyang drung gong ma'i dus bcu drug tsam dang phyis ni bdun brgyad tsam du snang ngo / /cho ga yan lag nyi shu pa 'di ni thog mar gsa' phur lha babs kyi dus zla ba dgu pa'i bco lnga nas btsugs/ de phyin sa ga'i bco lnga dus chen gsum 'dzom dang / chu stod kyi tshes bzhi chos 'khor gyi dus chen rnams smon lam kho na mdzad/ cho 'phrul gyi zla phyed kyi ring smon lam dang zlos gar gnyis ga mdzad pa yin la/ de thams cad la 'ja'i gur me tog gi char/ kong por rgod mi 'ong yang rgod kyis skor ba byed pa sa gzhi la me tog skye ba char dri zhim po cung 1031

zad 'bab pa sogs re re zhing ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa byung snang ba so so bzhin bri bar ma spobs la/ spyir yang drung gar bzhugs su 'ja' dang me tog gi char rtag tu 'byung / gar phebs kyi nad yams chad/ skya rgyal/ lung stong chen po rnams su phebs kyang khrom khri phrag las mi nyung ba rtag tu 'du/ nyin mo mis skor ba bas kyang mtshan mo lha 'dres bskor ba skor lam byang phul che bar zhib mo'i blo can rnams gleng / khal mdzo gzims khyi gzims drel sogs shi ba thams cad la 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char dang ring bsrel 'byung / de sogs yi ger yang cung zad snang zhing sngon gyi sgar pa las dngos su thos pa ches mang ba yod kyang so sor brir ma lang / sgar dpon rnams kyang tshong mi byed/ yo byad mi sog nang brtag rgyud gsum mkhyen pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang rdor dbyings sogs dkyil 'khor che chung thams cad kyi gar dbyangs kyi bar chig rkya 'pher ba/ gcod dang chos drug gi thugs dam bzang ba kho na 'byung / bu tsha 'bring yan chad yig bcu/be+e ro tsa ni mgon po dang rta mgrin gyi sngags thung ste rab kyis dzung phyur bzhi/'bring gis gsum/ tha mas kyang gang rung dung phyur gcig ma thongs na mi grangs su mi 'jog gdan sa khag sogs bla ma rnam pa go'i shri rnam pa/ dpon chen/dpon chung / de 'og rnams khrims pa khrims g.yog gnyis rnams sgar pa gral ba dang / de 'og rnams bu tsha rab 'bring tha gsum/ de rnams shog du mar bgos nas zla ba gsum re tsam go'i shri ras khrims dpon byas nas khrims pa sum bcu tsam re mos kyis bsko/ yol sgo gdong gi pha tshad du zhogs pa nas 'tshogakhrims rar gos lhan pa can lham krad pa phog pa sogs mi gyon/ gzan rkyang sogs mi byed/ mi chen gyi gral gyi tshul ma gtogs sdod lugs gang byung darnga lag pa 'grams pa la bsten pa sogs mya ngan gyi 'dug stangs mi byed/ skad cha dri bshad gtam gleng pa thams cad la yul phyogs dpon rigs sogs kyi phyogs 1092

— char 'gro ba mi gleng ba sogs kyi khrica/sa kyi bca' ba phyag bris ma mthong / bang — chen mjal mi/ sogs zhu sna ci dgos mgron gnyer dpon gnyis kyis khrims grar gtug des gzims dpon chen mo dang gu'i gung ba la zhu/ rim par snyan spron/mgron po slebs pa thams cad la thog mar khrims res su yod rnams kyis gzhi len byed/ de nas rim pas chos rje nang so dang / gu'i gung pa sogs kyis dang len/ sgar ston la sha mi 'grim/ sgar nang du sha dngos su khyer mi chog rab kyis gtan du dang tha mas kyang nyin chang srung / bud med sgar du mi 'jogakhrims res brje khar 'di'i ring nged kyis khrims las 'das ri zhes brang dpon gyis mna' 'bul/ de'i dbang gis sgar pa shin tu mang rung phyi nang gang du'ang 'thab rtsod dang shed ngom sogs mi 'byung bas skye bo thams cad dad pa yin no//tshe rgyun khang / rta mgrin khang / rnam 'joms khang / dgongs 'dus khang /mgon po khang ste sku rim khang pa lnga/ las sna 'dzin pa'i brang kha chen po drug bcu lhag pa/ de re re la dpon che chung dngos lnga drug las mi nyung ba dang khrims pa bcu skor las mi nyung ba/ spyir khrims pa byes 'gro phal cher gzims g.yog khang du 'jog pas der khrims pa bdun bcu tsam la sogs pa drung 'khor dngos dang phogs yig gi skabs su thab gsos kyi dpon che chung zhes yi ger btab nas de'i skal ba blangs pas mgron thebs byed/ dbus gtsang thams cad du sgar gyi dpon chung la srab sum brtsegs dang pang khebs/ dpon chen la sum stan mnye 'bol dang pang cog byed pa ni bdag gis lo bcu gsum lon pa yan la 'dug chibs rags kyi dus kyang skya dar dang rol mo ba las sne che chung gi rgyab chab sogs chibs rags kyi snga 'gro ba rnams dang rta dkar po re la rten gan+dhe la bkal ba la gser thog phub pa chibs kyi mdun dang / chibs kyi rgyab nas gu'i gung pa sogs go'i the bla ma dpon chen sogs go rim nges pa can 10gyi3

'byon/ sku'i g.yas g.yon du gsil g.yab nyi zla kha sbyor 'khyer/ las 'dzin rnams g.yon gnon gtsug zhwa gu'i gung pa sogs go'i shri las ka can rnams las zhwa las gos/ bla ma sga shubs stan dmar thob pa rnams dang dpon chen rnams gos zlam gtsug zhwa sogs mi chen nges can kho na chibs rags la sgrig rta chas ngan pa dang gos chen hrul po sogs mi gyon/ de lta bu'i skya mi nyung mtha' sum brgya la byas pa 'byung / de lta bu'i chibs rags che ba bsgrigs so 'tshal la yang 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char 'byung ngo / /spyir drung sku nas phra zhing bla ma rnam gnyis kyis gsung chos 'bul dus dbyar bzhugs dgun bzhugs gar phog tu gzims spyil chung ngu rer drung sku mtshams kho na la phal cher bzhugs shing gsan bsam sgom pa mdzad/ mi chen gyi zhal ngo dbon po phyag phyir 'brengs pa rnams la go'i shri rin po ches dbang rgyud bshad lag len rnams gnang / bla ma rin po ches gcod dang phyag chen chos drug gi khrid mdzad/ dpon po rnams kyang rta sga drel stan re dang gos dros tsam ma gtogs yo byad mi 'tshag sgar 'degs pa na gzims gur gyi yol sgo chen mo'i gong thig la ras gzan btags nas brgyangs par sdod/ ja tsha bzhes sogs nang so nas gtong / nam thegs 'dzag rta 'dzag drel gang thob rta mang khang pa dang drel mang khang pa nas gtong /de la rang gi drel stan dang rta sga gtad nas phyag phyi byed/ tshul 'dis thos bsam sgom pa shin tu smar/ de dag la yol ba nang par grags/ phyis de lta bu mang ba na der ma shong bas khra gur chen mo zhig tu bzhugs pa rnams la khru gur nang par grags/ de gnyis kyi nang nas dge sbyor mtho ba rnams cog bu la brten te dben par bzhugs pa mang du byung ba la dbon po ri ba dang / de las kyang dben pa mdzad pa la yang ri par grags/ phyis yol ba nang pa rnams thogs cig yol skor gyi phyir ka gnyis ma re la bzhugs/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa dang zur 10zhu4

mang bya bral ba rgya ston bya bral ba sogs mang po ri khrod la thegs/ gzhan phal cher las 'dzin brang dpon bskos/ yang ri ba'i rgyun sgrub sde dge sbyor smar ba zhig byung ba dbu mdzad re bskos nas nyin bzhin gzims gur gyi phyir yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ sku mtshams dngos med dus zhag gsum re la dmigs pa re zhu/ de lta bu'i lugs gnyis kyi srol chen po yod de smon lam chen mo btsugs pa las 'phros nas ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa spyir glengs pa'o/ /'o thang dang bu chu skor du phebs/ kong lung ral gsum la chos rgya dkar po'i zhib cha mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du re zhig bzhugs/ sham po gnas kyi dgon gsar du lha khang bzhengs par rab gnas la phebs/ zing por yon bdag dbang phyug gis spyan drangs te 'bul chen dang skye bo la nag ston byas tshe char pa ro sbrang rtsi ltar mngar ba zhig bab/ nyi ma gsum 'gyur gyis ring / slar 'o shod du phebs/ rgyal gog bzang po spun tsha bo ste sha gtson khri mon du tshud pa sdug bsngal pa gsum 'don pa'i don la zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs te gnyi ga phan bde la bkod/ re shod no 'phrad du 'jigs skyob kyi dgon pa dang lhun grub dgon gsar du'ang dar rgyas kyi bka' gnang/ zing po 'bum pa sgang du phebs/ 'brug lo'i lo gsar dang smon lam mdzad dus phyag nas 'thor ba gong du 'gro ba'i gser yig pa rnams 'jam lam du zhugs nas zhag mal bsdad sar mang du 'thor bas phyag nas yin par shes te bsdus/ kong po'i nas rigs su 'dug nas phyis gong ma la yang phul zhing gzhan la bkye/ rtse lha sgang gi rnam thos tshal du bzhugs/ gus ldan gyi sbyin bdag chen po bya khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas dang sras go'i shri chos kyi grags pa sogs dpon g.yog bzhi brgya lhag pa sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha skyed tshal du chas pa lta bu'i 'byor pas zhal mjal ba dang spyan 'dren pa kho nar byon/ gser zho stong phrag lhag pa byu ru'i rgyal mo lag pa khru tshad ma/ shel rkyen/ gzims 1095ོ

gur nyi ma lha khang la sogs pa gsum/ rta drel nyi shu rtsa gsum/ dar ras ches mang ba dang bcas pa phul/ de'i tshe khri dpon pa dad pa'i spyan chab dbyar gyi chu bo ltar 'brub cing rang dbang med pa'i gdung shugs chen pos gser ga sogs sgor la sogs pa sku'i rgyan thams cad kyang phul nas dbu skra'i gtsug phud phyag tu phul te khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar gsol ba btab kyang 'khor rnams kyis nan gyis zhus shing rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs na lam gyi chod dang gzhan phan che bar bkas gnang / phebs par yang zhal gyis bzhes/ bsnyung gzhi drag po cig 'dug pa las nad cig yin pa 'dra bka' gnang bas gshegs pa dang mos gus drag tu mdzad pas bsnyung gzhi de phal cher sangs/ mdzod nag nas gos bzang po la rma bya'i mdongs bsgrigs pa'i yol ba sogs bkram/ gnas bcu rgya nag ma khri rgyab sogs bkod pa mtha' yas pa can sogs kyi rten mjal gnang bar 'dug khri dpon pa sku las 'bral bar mi phod bzhin du bka' lung gis phyir thegs/ phrag tu phebs te chos rgya'i zhib cha dang tshong rgya mdzad/ klo yul nas sngon rje rang byung rdo rjes seng ge la bcibs nas byon pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis btul ba klo gra dkar gyi rgyal po sogs mjal bar slebs/ ba men la sogs pa'i 'bul ba phul/ srog sdom sogs dge ba mang du khas blangs/ de'i dus tsā ri pang phug na sgrub pa ba mngon shes can zhig yod pa na re/ na ning sgar pa phebs zer yang spyan 'dren ma song / da lo dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhing skyong thams cad spyan 'dren la song bas phebs pa yod zer ba la ba yo ri dgon sogs kyis kyang gdan 'dren pa su yang med pas mi bden zer rung blo bur du ba yor phebs/ rmo lo thang ram gyis 'bul zhabs byas/ der yang klo mang po byung ste rang yul du dar ba'i rtsed snas mchod/ srog sdom dang ma ṇi mang du khas blangs/ tsā ri'i gnas skor ba la gnod pa mi byed pa dang rang 10gi6

yul du 'khrug pa mi byed par khas blangs/ bkra shis ljongs su phebs pa na sgo mo lar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba dang re ma lar sems nyid ngal so dang mkha' spyod /dkar mo gzigs pa nas bzung / nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i ri a ma ra dhū ti'i ngos su bde mchog sogs sngags kyi lha tshogs dpag med gzigs pa'i bar gzigs snang mtha' yas pa lam yig tu 'khod pa ltar dang chus brag tu mkha' 'gro ma'i zhabs rjes kyi gnas sgo phye/ glang gong bde chen steng du dgon pa thob gsungs te phyag nas 'thor/ tsā rir sgrub pa ba mang du bzhag ste skyen nas sgrub rgyags kyi rgyun sbyar/ skyen pa'i 'khrug rtsod rnams zhi bar mdzad de chos rgya dkar po la sbyar/ de nas sprul pa'i sku zhwa dmar bas dga' ldan ma mor gtsug lag khang gsar ma lha chen dang bcas pa bzhengs pa 'grub ste rab gnas la spyan drangs glang la nas ba yor brgyud/ thog mar phrag yul du rgya brag pa sogs kyi ma bde ba cung zad byung ba zhi bar mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mor phebs te rab gnas shin tu legs/ sprul pa'i sku zhwa dmar ba gtso bor gyur pa'i lha sde mi sde'i khrom khri phrag mang po la chos kyi dga' ston dang lugs gnyis kyi bka' drin rgya chen po mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du phebs te lo gsar smon lam mdzad/ lha mo rang byung rgyal mo'i bsnyen sgrub thog mar gyi ling tshal du btsugs/ / phyis glang khrod tshal du bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mdzad/ de dag gi tshe gshegs glu dang thog lhung ba'i sgra lta bu nyin mtshan du rtag par grag gtor len 'jigs su rung ba mngon sum du mthong / mi snying gi tshal pa cig khrug thun du dngos su sleb pa sogs rtags dang cho 'phrul bgrang gis mi lang ste rags pa rnam thar na gsal/khyad par nyang kha phyogs nas rlung 'tshub dmar po dang nag po dang sngon po dang dkar po sogs kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas 'khyil dang g.yon 'khyil du mar yod pa breng ma chad pa'i dkyil nas thog 'phangs te nyang kha'i shing sdong du ma bcag pa /097

dang 'ur sgra sa g.yo ba tsam byung tshe lha mo 'khor bcas mngon sum du gzigs pa la bskal mang ma sogs kyi bstod bskul mdzad/ rnam thos kyi rir bzhugs tshe po rngod snye gsum/ mdo stod smad/ dbus gtsang / bya ba rnams so so nas spyan 'dren mi che zhing mang bar slebs/ bla ma ka thog pa 'od zer rgyal mtshan la po bor nged rang gi chos khri'i rgyab tu sngar phyag lcag btsugs pa skyes pa'i shing sdong rtsa ba gcig la 'bras bu mi gcig pa gsum smin pa cig yod ces bka' bstsal ba khong gis ji ltar ba rnyed gsang phu bde mchog gi pho brang du phebs/ brag phyi ba'i nang rgya zhib tshags mdzad/ slar rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs pa na 'jang sa tham rgyal po rnam thos shes rab kyi zhu yig 'bul chen dang bcas te spyan 'dren par slebs/ po bos spyan drangs pa ltar klu nang du phebs/ der lho rong nang so zhang skyabs dpon g.yog rnams gdan 'dren la slebs te ldem rta mang po sogs 'bul zhabs cher byas/ bre mo chu mdor phebs/ po bo ma che chung rnams kyis chibs pa brgya la sogs pa'i 'bul nod mtha' yas/ zar be ba rnams kyis sa cha dbang ris phul zhing rnam rgyal gling du bla ma 'od zer rgyal mtshan bskos/ slar kong por phebs/ rgyal 'dzin pa'i yon bdag rgan mo blo bde'i bu rgyud sogs kyis 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ po bo ye gong dang mar khu thang du mkhar las zin nas khrom bsags/ dus bsgrigs nas phyag nas zhus pa rgyal 'dzin nas 'thor bas khrom thams cad kyis mthong bar si li li byung / lho rgya ston pa'i 'bul chen dang rngod pa'i 'bul chen dngul srang stong grangs dang mdzo sum brgya sogs slebs/ rgya ston pa'i bde steng dgon du rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsar bzhengs dang /rngod du shākya ba'i dgon dang gnyis su kong po nas phyag nas zhus pa dngos su slebs/ zar ber bzhugs yun thung bas zhabs phyi ma zin par po bo thog kha nang sos gtso mdzad khrung pa tshun gyi rta 'bul dang mdor na po bo'i bka' rgyud /098

kyi dgon pa thams cad kyi bdag rkyen zhus/ lo lo bzhin po bo'i kur srid kyi ser 'du dang chos khrims po kong gi gar srid gcig la gcig phan gyi bka' gnang / rgyal 'dzin du rgan mo blo bde'i bu brgyud bkra shis dang 'gro la hu re gnyis kyi khang par phyag nas phyin zhing 'gro la hu re'i ka ba la phyag nas phyed thug tsam pa mang du byung / der shar mon gyi rgyal po jo 'bag dpon g.yog mang po mjal bar slebs/ 'bul ba mtha' yas/ khong rang yang gtsug phud phul zhing bstan pa 'dzugs par zhus/ mtsho chen po'i nang na gru'i grong khyer 'bum phrag mang po gnas pa'i bdag po snur rje rgyal po la bka' shog gnang nas khyod kyi dung dkar mgo dgu pa de bskur zhes bka' gnang bas dad cing mngon par mkhyen par go ste de la sogs pa 'bul ba mang du bskur yang phyis lam gyi dbang gis zhu yig tsam phyag tu phyin skad par gsungs/ rgya la'i nags la seng ldeng sdong po lnga gtso 'khor gyi tshul du yod pa 'tshol ba'i bka' gnang bas rnyed de dbus ma de las gsung chos dus kyi gaṭi mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du spre lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ khyad par tshes brgyad la byams pa dang / bco lnga la ston pa 'khor bcas lhag par yang gzigs/ mdo khams kur zur sogs kyis ja sig chen brgya lhag sogs kyi 'bul ba rgya chen dang spyan 'dren slebs/ sngon gyi lung bstan du ma yod 'dug pa bzhin bkra shis lkog phreng nas slob dpon pad+mas sbas pa'i tshe chu tshe ril sogs 'don par gnang ste thon nas gter tshab kyang bzhag de'i tshe slob dpon pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bskor nas gdams pa dang lung bstan mang du gsungs/de ma thag de dag gi thugs dam sgrub pa la bzhugs pas tshe dpag med kyi longs sku'i zhing dang sku mtha' yas gzigs/ der bya pa chos mdzad bkra shis rnam rgyal ba dpon g.yog spyan 'dren par slebs/ dbus gtsang nas spyan 'dren yang mang /bya pa khrid dpon pa gnam du gshegs pa'i sngo ba gnang dgos pa dang dbus 1099

gtsang du yang phebs par spro bas zhal gyis bzhis pas spyan 'dren pa rnams yid tshim ste so sor byon/ spre lo zla ba dgu pa'i nyer gsum la rnam —thos kyi ri bo nas sgar bteg kong bston de mo sogs kyis skyel bar gzigs/ mthun snang du yang 'ja' sprin la gzhir bdag gi gzugs dang rta dang seng ge dang 'brug la zhon pa'i dbyibs mang du drung thegs pa'i phyogs su 'gro bar snang / kong po'i dad can thams cad kyis skyo ba'i rnam 'gyur cher byas/ pag rgan thams cad kyang skyo ba'i glu mang du 'then zhing myur du phebs par gsol ba 'debs/ drung skor rnams phrag yul du phebs te phyi nang gi zhal bskos mdzad/ grum tshal du dri med sangs rgyas bskos/ sgar pa byin zing po nas chu bsgral/ ba yo tsā ri brgyud/ glang la'i nang du bya pa'i ja 'dren sdun ma nang so chos mdzad pa byon/ skyen rgyal po dpal bzang dang lho sgo bas mchod cing sgo gong 'og gi 'khrug rtsod sdum pa'i bka' gnang ste phyis rje btsun skya ses 'phrin las kyi 'phro mdzad pas zhi/ bra ba brgyud rnams la zhal mthong gsung thos kyi 'brel pa bzhag dwags po sku rab pa sogs lam gyi sde che phra rnams kyis 'bul zhabs kyis mchod/ dwags lha sgam po'i ri la gzigs snang du ma byung zhing mchod sprin cher mdzad/ sbung mkhar nas byang mkhar por phebs/ der bya sgo gcig pa pad+ma rta mchog dbang rgyal sogs bsu bar byon/sa skyong don yod rdo rje'i spyan 'dren pa slebs/ byar sbung du phebs/ bya lo'i lo gsar mdzad/ khyad par mgon po'i gzigs snang mang / khrum sa brgyud/ rdo mon pa thang du ye shes kyi mgon po'i zhal 'bag sum+bha nag po gzigs pas mgon po dngos su gzigs/ gser phye 'bum pa dang grub thob chen po'i lung bstan lha khang sogs su mjal zhing slar phyag nas gnang / chos rgyal lhun por phebs te go'i shri sku mched kyis zla ba gsum bzhir 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pas mchod/gshegs bzhugs kyi don du bsngo bas rgyas btab/ bla ma dpa' bos kyang 'dir 1100

mardzal te dro bo lung du sgrub sde 'debs par bkas gnang ste mngags/ sgar pa stag la brgyud nas ya rtser phebs/ lha bsam bde ba ja 'dren la byon/ ra mor rten mdzo cig ge zhabs rjes byung / lhun po sgang du 'bul zhabs mtha' yās kyis mchod/ za hor gyi rgyal brgyud stag rtse bas spyan drangs/ srong btsan du sngon gnas du ma rjes su dran/ 'bul zhabs kyis mchod/ sman mkhar zhang mkhar gzhis ka lhun grub gling / 'gar rtsa/ dol lhun grub lha rtse rnams brgyud/ yar rgyab dpon chen pas 'bul zhabs rgya che/ dol mda'i ri rtser rje mar pa'i bzhuṭa khri yod pa bsos/ de dang zhal sprod mna' 'o la'i rtser drung nyid kyi bzhugs khri mdzad/ rgyal khams la phan bde'i smon lam mdzad pa na rje mar pa yab sras dang mtshur dbang gi rdo rjes bkra shis mdzad par gzigs/ gzhung bkra shis sgang du phebs/ 'di'i tshe sa skyong don yod rdo rjes gzhis ka snel pa'i sa rnams rtsod pas thob nas dngos kyi bdag po byed/ gzhan dbus gtsang spyi la phag mo gru pa'i rdzong ji'i tshul gyis lung brgyugs nas lo 'ga' zung song ba'i skabs yin pas khong dpon g.yog 'khor los bsgyur rgyal lta bu'i 'byor pas der ja 'dren la byon zhing mdun bsus/ skye bo khri grangs tshogs pas sa gzhi khebs tshe nam mkha' bar snang la ngo mtshar gyi ltas mtha' yas/ 'o rags su ja 'dren gyi 'bul chen dang gzhi lan gyi thog ma byas/ de nas mchod yon lhan cig pas gser ldan gyi chu bo la gru'i zhon pas brgal te lum shel grong nor bu dge 'phel bzang ging rnams su rim pas bteg der ser 'bras dge gsum gyis ja 'dren phul/ de nas chos 'khor chen po lha sar phebs nyin gling sto da smad kyi chos rje gnyis kyis gtso byas bod yul gyi bshad gra thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dang phyi mo gsang ne'u thog gi dge 'dun/ gung ru shes rab bzang sogs nā leṭi'i tshogs pa/ chos rje smon lam pa dang mkhas pa legs chos pa sogs kyis gtsos pa'i ser 'bras 1101

dgi gsum/ bde skyor zul gsum sogs shod chen skyi lung gi dgon che chung gi dge 'dun bzhugs so 'tshal rang rang gi bla ma rnams kyis dbu mdzad de khri phrag du longs pa'i ser sbreng lis bsus/ de'i tshe dag pa'i gzigs snang mtha' yas pa byung zhes bka' bstsal bar grags la/ phyi rol du yang nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char kha dog lnga ldan du bab/ skya ser gyi khrom thams cad dad pas yid 'gyur skad/ so so nas chos 'brel zhus shing chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ jo bo la gser gsol sogs mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/ bstan pa'i mdzad pa du ma lung ston par gzigs/ der khyi lo'i lo gsar smon lam mdzad/ shar kha nas gangs pa bla ma sogs dang / 'dan ma grub thob sogs mdo khams kyi gra rgyun rnams kyi ja sig chen stong phrag dang gser dngul sogs 'bul chen skye bo thams cad ha las pa phul/ dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub kyis kyang bka' bzhin dro bo lung du sgrub sde dang sras mkhar la zhig gso dang bdag rkyen mdzad nas slar 'bul zhabs dang bcas pas phyag tu phul yang khyed rang gis skyong dgos zhes bka' nan gnang / shar kong po'i rgyal khams chen po nas drung bkra shis don grub pas dbu mdzad kur khrid kyi bla dpon rgya bdag yon bdag rnams kyis 'bul chen du ma dang lha sar mchod pa'i rnga bo che mtha' 'dom nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa phul/ ha cang che bas rnga khri la 'phrul gyis bskyon tshe rnga shing steng nas gzhom zhing skye bo stong phrag du mas 'dren ma nus/ bzo pa rnams gtol dang bral ba'i tshe drung gi bka'as gnang ste kurma gra tshang gi dge 'dun phyed dang nyis brgya tsam gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba — ma'i gsol 'debs lan gsum byas nas 'phrul thag them pa tsam gyis bya 'phur ba ltar rnga khri'i steng du ling gis song / gzhom pa de yang tsheg sgra chen po dang bcas te rang byung du sos pa dang mnyam du brdungs pa las lhag pa'i rnga'i sgra 1102

chen po byung bas ngo mtshar gyi gnas su byas/ rim gyis mtshur phu dang byang rgyud du ma dang gzhu dang snye mor byon/ der de kho na nyid kyi gzigs pas/ ye ma hoX/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab tu bkra ba du ma'i ri mo 'di ni su yis bris so kyi/ zhes sogs kyi rdo rje'i mgur mdzad/ smyug lar mkhar las so ma byas nas phyag nas zhus pas ga dar gyis sgo thams cad bsdoms la zhog gsungs te de ltar byas/ nas dkar mo ka to ra gang phul/ de nas gzhu snye'i la kha nas lan 'ga' zung 'thor ba mdzad/ smyug lar sgo phye nas bltas dus steng shod thams cad du son las 'thug pa nas de nyid kyis skya chag ger gang / de rnams bsdus pas sngon las ches mang du byung ba nas khang du btab pas nas 'phel ba'i bka' drin gsab phyir dpon sa gser khang ma yum sras kyis /rma gra tshang la rtag tu phogs 'debs par zhus pa yin no/rong chen brgyud/ sngon rje mar pas lung bstan par grags pa'i gzhis ka rin spungs su phebs par nye ba na sa skyong don yod rdo rjes rnam sras kyi 'byor pa lta bu'i skya rags ches mang po dang / byams chen chos lung so so'i mkhan pos gtsos pa'i dge 'dun/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang la sogs pa'i 'bras yul rdzong dkar ba/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan la sogs gser mdog can pa/ kong ston dbang phyug grub pa sogs rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi tshogs pa sogs mdor na la stod man/ rong dur mig yan gyi dgon che chung gi dge 'dun thams cad rang rang gi bla mas gtso byas te sbyin bdag chen pos ser sbreng la 'du dgos par bkas bcad cing so so nas kyang nges par gnas 'di lta bu ni ches 'os so zhes sems pas dad pas 'dus te khri phrag gnyis gsum du longs nges zer ba'i ser sbreng gi bsu ba dang gos sku chen mo gsham pa sogs byas tshe lha rnams kyang 'gran pa ltar nam mkha' 'ja' tshon gyi bla bre dbyibs sna 1103

tshogs pas bres shing me tog gi char gyis bar snang yog pas mi'i mchod pa zi' gyis mnan tshe mkhas pa thams cad kyang mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhi ste dad pa'i spu long g.yos/ thams cad la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas ngoms par mdzad cing chos sde chen po de rnams so so nas dpon slob thams cad kyis chos 'brel du ma gsan zhing thams cad kyang dad gus thob/ khyad par phyi dus kyi mkhas pa rnams kyi nang na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal ba paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan ni ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pas thugs phrogs/ theg chen gyi yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gzigs pas gtsang la bzhugs ring phal cher zhabs phyi mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rnams kyang zla ba du mar zhabs phyir bsten te mdo mang la sogs pa'i lung dang bshad pa du ma gsan/ nyid kyis thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos du ma gsan te thugs dam gyi spangs rtogs du ma 'khrungs pas rtsa ba'i bla ma yang rab tu 'dzin/ dbus kyi sa bar du zhabs skyel mdzad de thegs gar zhabs spyi bor blangs te spyan chab mang du bsil zhing smon lam yun ring du mdzad/ phyis sgar chen theg pa'i 'og tu'ang sa skyong don yod pa la khyod kyi sgo drung na gser gyi pha bong chen po zhig byung 'dug pa khyod kyis len ma shes par 'dug ngas de nas dum bu cung zad cig lon pa de shin tu phan thogs par byung / zhes bkyon thabs su gsungs skad/ mkha' ru steng du phag lo'i lo gsar ma dzad/ byams chen gyi gdan sa pa sku skye sna tshogs rang grol ba dpon slob nyung ngur mdzad de gsung chos 'ba' zhig gsan/ rin spungs pa'i lung gtong ba'i sar phebs pa nas rgyal bu ngag dbang rnam rgyal sgar gyi mgo lung ba'i dpon du bskob/ pas zhabs phyi 'bral med mdzad cing gsung chos ca/nga du gsan/ spyir sa skyong don yod pa spyan 'dren gyi gtso bo yin/ rgyun du zang zing gi 'bul zhabs che yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni dad pas mnyes dgos pa las 1104

deng sang grags tshod kyi dad pa tsam ma gtogs chos las byung ba'i dad pa mi 'phrogs pa re zhig mi skye ba'i rigs su dgongs/ khong rang ra rnga sogs na mtshamasatsal bzhugs/ sgar chen shangs phyogs su gnyug mar bzhugs tshe snga sig chen stong grangs su nye ba sogs gnang ster rgya cher 'jog pa mdzad nas gyad snyen sger gsum dol pa la sogs pa'i byang gi 'brog chen rnams la ngos bsu ba'i bka' shog mdzad pas 'brog sde'i dos bsu gdan 'dren shangs su mi shong ba 'dra ba slebs/ sde pa'i phogs dang 'u lag la ma brten par byang mtsho mo dgu brgyud kyi gzhung nas mdo khams la thegs par dgongs tshe/ byams chen sku skye dang rgyal bu ngag dbang pa gnyis ci mdzad gtol bral gyis nyin mtshan du bshums shing gsol ba btab kyang dgongs pa ma 'grub pas gar thegs kyi zhabs phyir 'breng bar thag bcad/ sde ba nyid kyang ches tab tab pos rings stabs su nyin mtshan bshad nas byon yang shangs phur phyag phyi zin/ 'dan ma khrims dpon dang kurma 'phrin las pa sogs zhal 'dris su che ngo chen du sbran te bzhugs par gsol pa nan gyis btab pas ring zhig na zhal bzhes tsam grub nas rim pas rong chen dang byang thang chu bo ri snye thang sogs brgyud phag lo zla ba bdun pa'i stod la lha sar spyan drangs/ spyir rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs dam tsan+dan dkar po'i sgrol dkar khye'u lo brgyad kyi tshod tsam pa dang rje mar pa'i sku bya khur ma si thang zla zhal ma sogs sku gsung thugs rten khyad par ba kho nas gtsos pa'i 'bul chen/lha sa rnam gnyis/ tshal gung thang / byang chub gling ste gtsug lag khang chen po gsum gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul chen/ yer pa'i gnas chen gyi1sa gtsos pa'i 'bul chen sogs mtha' yas pa byas/ jo bo'i sku 'khor du dge 'dun gtsang hrug pa cig gnang bzhed kyang sde pa rang gi thugs bzhed kyis po ṭa la'i ri logs la chos sde 'debs par zhus pa btsan ches pa ra dgongs nas drung gis bkas ma 1/01

gnang / lha sa'i shar du thub chen chos 'khor gyi chos sde'i rmang bting / 'di la rten 'brel ha cang 'grig che ba ma byung bar rje 'phrin las pa gsung zhing bu khrul rnams kyang gtsang nas mda' stag shas che bar brten bstan pa'i rgyun 'bring tsam zhig byung / der chos rje mi nyag pa gshegs nas garma 'phrin las pa bskos/thub chen du nang so la 'dan ma khrims dpon/ mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon la dbu mdzad bde legs pa dang chos rje legs bshad pa/ sngags kyi slob dpon dkon rgyam pa dang drung blo gros pa bskos/ yer par dwags po rab 'byam pa mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa bskos/ kong po'i gra yon rnams kyis spyan drangs te sa skyong don yod pa 'khor bcas kyis lum pa'i tshugs khar zhabs skyel mdzad de thegs/ yar rgyab dpon chen pa mchog tu dad cing gus zhabs cher byas/ sne gdong rtser spyan drangs te lha gzigs ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dgung lo bcu drug pas mjal/ phyag phyi mi chen du ma dang bcas pas lnga ldan dang dwags po'i chos bzhi sbyar ba'i chos 'brel zhus pa na ches ngo mtshar ba zhig gnang ba la zla gcig tsam na mkhas pa'i dbang po 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang gis zin bris mdzad pa ches ngo mtshar can zhig bzhugs/ rim gyis dwags po'i gzhung nas brgyud/ kong po'i spyan 'dren dang yul so so'i 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pa rnams bzhes te phan bde'i sa bon bskrun/ rtse lha sgang du byi ba lo'i lo gsar smon lam mdzad/ go'i shri sprul sku khams su thegs par dgongs pa thog mar bkas ma gnang / phyis thams cad kyis nged dang khyad med par khur gsung ba'i bka' bkod gnang ste don gyis rgyal tshab tu bkos/ der lo gsum du mtshams dam po bar chad med pa zhig grub na sku tshe mthar phyin zhing bstan pa la phan zhes luXng bstan nas rnam thos kyi ri bo nyid du gzims khang bang sgrom zhig mdzad par thugs dam sku mtshams la bzhugs te sngon rgyal ba shākya'i tog nyid 1106

gdul bya rnams dam pa'i chos nyan par mi 'dun pa na dbyar zla ba gsum nang du yang dag 'jog la bzhugs te de bzhin gshegs pa 'jug sred rgyal po'i zhing du sangs rgyas 'gro bar ston pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dam pa'i chos bgro ba'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan par gor ma chag go /de ltar spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gangs can gyi rgyud 'dir rim par byon pa de rnams kyi nang na yang rje 'di kho na lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las rmad du byung ba ste/skal ldan gyi bu slob bgrang ba las 'das pa smin grol mdzad pa dang / tshad ma kun las btus bshad gzhir mdzad de de la sde bdun ma khan pos tshad ma rgyas pa rnam 'grel 'bring rnam nges bsdus pa rigs thigs gsum du ji ltar bkral ba dang / zur gyi dka' gnas gyes pa yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhis ji ltar bkral ba rnams rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i gseb tshangs su bshad cing / sde bdun lha shākya rgyan sogs rgya 'grel du ji ltar bkral ba thams cad mdor bsdus pas brjod de tshad ma'i legs bshad kyi chu bo kun 'dus rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bod gzhung gang la yang ma bltos par rang stobs kyis mdzad/bdag gi bla ma rje dwags ram pa'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten gsum sgron 'di la zhu ba po nga 'dra ba zhig yod na myur du 'grub pa yod de de med pas lan/ rigs gzhung rgya mtsho 'di la rtsom par yang ngas gsol ba btab/ rtsom yig pa yang nga rang gis byas/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa de gzhan dang rang mi 'dra/ tshad ma'i gzhung tsam yang sku 'khris na mi bzhugs/ phyag dpe ni mi gzigs/ dus rtag tu phyag mnyam bzhag spyan lta stangs thugs ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral/ gsung chos/ lugs gnyis kyi bka' bkod sogs gnang skyong zad mi shes pa dgos pa'i gsol cog gi 'khris su bdag gis smyug nag tung nge bzung nas bsdad/ gseng nam byung du thugs rtsom zhus pa na 'phro gang na yod gsung ba tsam las thogs pa 1107

med par spyan lta stangs kyi ngang nas sha ra ra ljags dpod mdzad/ deng sang gi tshad ma pa rnams dang sgros mi mthun pa shin tu che ba 'gar sems kyis ma bzod de zhus pa na ljags dpod 'phro bcad de ci yang mi gsung / zhag 'ga' yar du thugs rtsom de mi mdzad/ phyi nas bla ma'i gsung la yid 'ches dgos pa yin zhes bka' gnang / phyi nas de ltar ma zhus par gang gsung de ka bris pas de'i rtsod spang sogs ha las pa re gnang yod pa yin zhes dang / go la'i rtsis kyi skabs su cung zad go tshod zhus pa na de ltar min pa'i rgyu mtshan mtha' dag nges pa dang bcas te bka' bstsal nas phyag g.yas pa nam mkha' la cung zad brkyangs nas nged bgro gleng de ltar byed pa yin gsungs nas zhal 'dzum tsam mdzad byung /drung gi phyag brkyangs pa rdzogs par mthong ba sku 'khor ba la yang nga las med pa yin gsungs te gzur gnas kyi mkhas pas bltas na tshad ma'i bstan bcos 'di lta bu bod yul lta zhog 'phags yul du'ang ma byung ba snyam ste/ 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang / /rigs gzhung so so'i rnam 'grel mdzad pa mang / /mdo dang sde bdun 'grel par bcas rnams kun/ /tshig don gnyis car glegs bam gcig nyid du/ /ha cang mangs dang nyungs sogs skyon med cing //gzhung don 'khyog dang phyin ci log med par/ /ji bzhin bshad 'di rgyal ba sras bcas mthus/ /yin gyi gzhan du blo yi spyod yul min/ /zhes bka' bstsal pa kho na ltar yin la tshad ma mdo'i gzhung la zhes bya ba gsungs te zhes gzhan gzhung 'grel ba'i tshul dang / rnam 'grel gyi gzhung rnams la zhes bya ba smos te zhes rang gzhung 'grel ba'i tshul du mdzad pa na dpal chos kyi grags pa yang rje 'di nyid kyi sku'i ngakod par bstan zhing rje rang byung rdo rjes kyang zhal gyis 'ches so/ /rgyal ba byamyo sa pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel chung don gsal dang sbyar te 'grel pa 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me zhes bya ba mdzad cing 'di'i spyi don 1108

gyi skabs su mdo sde thams cad kyi dka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag gtan la phab cing chos 'khor rim pa gsum zhes thams cad la grags pa yang nyan thos kyi skabs su 'khor lo dang po nyid kyi bzlas pa gsum la 'jog pa dang / gzungs dbang gi mdo'i dgongs pas gang zag gcig gi dri ma rags bar phra gsum sbyong ba'i ched du rim par gsungs pa dang / dgongs pa nges 'grel gyi mdor gdul bya tha dad pa gsum du gsungs pa sogs rnam par 'jog cing / spyir mthar thug gi dgongs pa chos 'khor gcig char du bskor bar bzhed de bod yul gyi mkhas pa tshangs pa las ches tshangs pa'i bsnyems pa 'dzin zhing gzhan thams cad la ba lang ltar lta ba ji snyed cig byung ba de dag gi rmi lam du yang ma rmis na rna bar lta ga la grag pa'i legs bshad kyi 'byung khungs chen po mdzad la/ spyir bstan gyis don gyi gtso bo rnams legs par bshad cing rgyas 'grel gdams ngag gi bar tsam du grub pa zhig go /phar tshad 'di gnyi ga lta ba gzhan stong gtso cher bkral mod kyang sems tsam gyi lta ba la gzhan stong du ming btags pa bod kha gcig gi 'dod pa ltar bkral pa ni ma yin la/ spyir rje 'di sems kyi gshis stong nyid gtso bor ston pa zab mo lta rgyud/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gtso bor ston pa rgya chen spyod rgyud de sems kyi zab pa dang gsal ba ni gnyis su mi phyed pas na shing rta'i srol gnyis dgongs pa gcig du bzhed pa yin no/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba la gzhi gsum gyi cho ga gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod pa'i mngon rtogs la sogs pa bstan bcos khyad par ba mang du mdzad cing / dris lan khyad par can mang du bzhugs pa rnams kyis snyigs dus kyi gdul bya phyogs gar 'gro'i gtol med pa rnams la long ba la dmigs bu byin pa ltar gyur to/ /de ltar gzhan phan nam mkha' dang mnyam pas skye bo gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed phyir mi ldog par smin par mdzad nas dgung lo nga gnyis pa glang lo'i mjug tu song dus kong po'i mi mang 1109

rnams kyang zhal lta ba la ches dungs pa dang / kha cig gis zhal ma bzhugs par yang glengs/ sgar pa byin yang longs spyod srabs pas yid byung ste stag lo'i lo gsar la zhal mjal dgos par thams cad kyis nan zhus skyed/ khyed tsho ba la 'o ma nur gyis mi bzho bar ba bsad pa'i sha za ba 'dems pa yin nam zhes kyang bka' bstsal/ ha cang nan zhus ches pas zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis nas nang 'jal ci rigs pa dang bcu bzhi la lha sde mi sde'i khrom chen po 'bum phrag tu longs pa tshogs pa'i khrom chen por chos khri la phebs te kho bo'i sprul pa'i sku bsdus zin/ 'di longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin gsungs nas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad la mu tig gi dbu rgyan dang mu tig gi rgyan drug bzhes te thams cad la zhal mjal gnang / de'i tshe 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char yang sngon gyi thams cad las ches bkra zhing gsal/ yul so so nas 'bul zhabs ni sprin ltar du 'dus pas sgar ba thams cad ni longs spyod kyi rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'gyur bas zang zing gi re ba gang bar gyur/ spyir sku tshe 'di'i 'phrin las rdzogs par dgongs nas khams su drung si dhu pa la ngom gyi gnas 'di 'dra bar sprul sku 'byon zhes yab yum dang bcas te lung bstan pa'i chab shog gnang / drung skor ba phal cher yang longs spyod la yan pas mtshan dus zhabs phyir 'bod pa'i brda gnang yang ma slebs/ zhal chems phyag bris mi gsal tsam zhig gsol cog gi steng du bzhag ste tho rengs ston pa byang chub pa'i dus tshod la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang chos kyi dbyings nyid du bsdus te 'od gsal ba chen po'i dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad dang rnam dbyer med pa'i ngo bo nyid du zhugal so/ /de'i tshe sa g.yo ba 'ja' dang me tog gi char nyin re bzhin 'phel yang spyir drung gar bzhugs su ngo mtshar gyi ltas dus rgyun du 'byung bas skye bo dag the tshom du yang ma gyur/ bla ma chu dka' thub pa ri pa rnying pa nas gzhal ba'i gzims lcil zhig na bzhugs pa na re/ gnam sa'i ltas 'di dag yang ha cang mang drags/ rmi 1110

nyams kyi rtags kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra/ sngar zhabs skor thun du bcad nas ma dzad pa mthong gi yod pa'ang ma byung / zhi ba'i dbyings su zhugs sam zhes gsungs skad/ de nas sgar gzhi byes kyi gros dbang rnams bka' bgros te re zhig phyi rol du gsang bar byas nas sku rim gyi tshul gyis mchod sbyin dang gsol 'debs la brtson par mdzad/ de nas rim gyirnga/ rje btsun skya se rin po ches dad can gyis phul ba'i yo byad ri bo ltar spungs shing bod yul gyi mchog dman thams cad kyis rang rang gi dad 'byor dang sbyar ba'i mchod sprin rgya cher spros pa dang sa skyong don yod rdo rje'i 'byor pa'i rlabs chen po las/ rje 'phrin las zhabs dang 'dan ma khrims dpon pas phyag len du btab ste gtsang dbus khams kong gi mchod sbyin gyi gnas su 'os pa mtha' dag la mchod sbyin gyis tshim par mdzad/ pha rol du phyin pa'i rnam pa thams cad pas bsgos pa'i sku gdung rin po che 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi gzhir snang ba ni ba yu nas mtshur phu rin po ches zhugs la bzhen te sku gdung yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel sran rlon tsam pa kha dog sna tshogs pa mang po dang / khyad par sku'i sgal tshigs sku rtsib sogs ma nyams shing ma 'thor bar 'brel ba nya byus kyi kha dog lta bu la mgrin pa yan gyi sku tshigs zhal bcu gcig tu dod cing sku rtsib rnams re re'ang phyag mang po'i ri mo phyag mthil gyi spyan dang bcas te ches gsal ba spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong pa'i rnam pa rgyan thams cad ring bsrel las byas pa ches gsal bar byon pa rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus rtse lha sgang du gser gdung rin po che bsgrubs par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /'on kyang rje brgyad pa'i bka' las de lta bu ni sngon rgya bod gang du su la yang ma byon pa'i rten mchog tu snang zhing da dung de las ngo mtshar du ma 'byung rgyur snang bas phyi rol du zhal ltar yod na 'gro don che bar snang ste zhes bka' bstsal to/ /spyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi skad cig re res kyang gdul bya'i khams smin grol du mdzad pa 1111

ni ches mang gi stong gsum gyi rdul phra rab ni de lta ma yin la gzhan dag gis sku gsung thugs btang stoms su gnas pa tsam las gzhan don mdzad par mi snang ba de'i tshe'ang gdul bya gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed mchog gi dngos po la 'god par mdzad na chos bstan pa'i 'phrin las kyis lta ci smos/ chos kyi rnam grangs tshig bzhi pa gcig gis btul ba'i sems can gyi grangs kyang ji ltar dpog ste 'di dag ni bka' bsdu ba po rnams kyi yul kho na'o/ /des na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la tshad ni su zhig 'dzin/ 'on kyang deng sang tshu rol mthong ba pa kha cig gi mthong ba dang sbyar na bu slob kyi gtso bo ni rgyal tshab sprul ba'i sku bkra shis rnam rgyal/ spyan snga rin po che zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa sogs mchog gi sprul pa'i sku du ma dang / sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi gdan sa khag lnga'i khri zur/ phag mo gru'i spyan snga tshes gnyis pa/ 'bri khung dbang rin po che/ 'bri khung chos rje kun dga' rin chen sku mched gsum/ sgam po'i spyan snga sne'u thang pa sogs bka' rgyud kyi chen po rnams kyi gdung rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i zhal ngo gdan sa'i seng ge'i khri chen po gnon pa'i skyes chen rnams dang /'brong bu go'i shri pa/ bya go'i shri chos kyi grags pa/ lcags mo go'i shri pa 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ 'dan ma go'i shri bsod nams bkra shis/ lho rong go'i shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan yab sras/ gling du si ting 'dzin 'od zer la sogs las ka can gyi bla dpon chen po du ma dang / ngom tsha nang so dang chen shri du gang la sogs 'phrin las sgrub pa'i rgya bod kyi gser yig pa pho brang gi las ka can mang po dang / byams chen sku skye sna tshogs rang grol/ bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal/ sgom sde nang ya gnyis kyi gdan sa pa la sogs rgyal rigs chen po'i mkhas grub cha/nga po dang / rje btsun skya se rtogs ldan/ grub chen chu 'phur ba/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal/ zur mang bya bral/ rgya ston bya bral/ gsi dkar kun spangs pa/ bla ma grags rgyal ba sogs 1112

rtogs ldan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sgrub rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin ches mang po dang /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan/ mi nyag rab 'byam pa mgon po dpal/ ngo khro rab 'byam pa dbang phyug dpal/ dul mo ba bkra shis 'od zer/ smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa/ kurma 'phrin las pa chen po/ dwags po rab 'byam pa chos rgyal bstan pa/ dwags po rab 'byam pa gsung rab mang thos/sde bdun pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug shel khog pa stag ra'i kurma bka' bcu pa dang gtsang nga rab 'byam pa/ rta 'u nor bzang pa/ ra ti'i mkhas grub seng ge dpal/ byams sar ba dbus dge shes rab bzang / nyag rong na chang yo chos dpal dang ab se grags pa dang byams mgon pa sogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang /dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub/ mkhan chen shākya bzang po/ 'grus khang pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ khre ba kha pa don grub rnam rgyal/ ra sgreng bsam gtan gling pa/ cham dgon pa grags pa dpal ldan sogs sgrub rgyud kyi bstan 'dzin du ma dang / bya btang thar pa rgyal mtshan la sogs thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las tshad med du mdzad pa du ma dang / zho kha ma ṇi ba dang ma ṇi ba lhun grub rgya mtsho la sogs ma ṇi pa'i bskos ja bka' shog gnang nas mdo dbus su ma ṇi'i 'phrin las can du ma dang / chu dka' thub pa dang / grub thob 'tshem bu pa dang / rtoṭa ldan 'dan chung sogs sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba du ma dang / smyug la'i nang so 'grom pa/ khri dpon bkra shis dar rgyas la sogs pa khyim pa'i tshul can gyi rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yang mang bar byon te/ de rnams la sogs pa ni rje nyid kho nas smin grol du mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i slob ma sha stag yin la/ spyir chos 'brel mang nyung ci rigs gsan pa'i da da thob ni/ lhun bde rab 'byam pa/ brag cog pa/ shar smad pa/ mkhas pa'i dbang po/ 'bri khung mkhan chen zho ra ba/ stag lung 1113

ka drug pa sogs 'bri gdan stag lung rnams kyi mkhan slob chos gsum rim pa du ma/ chen po 'bras gling pa dang rtse nyag pa sogs chos gra chen po rtses dang gi chen po gzhung las rim pa du ma/ chos gra chen po gsang ne'u thog bde skyor zul gsum/ ser 'bras dge gsum/ byams chen chos lung la sogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi chos sde chen po thams cad kyi bla ma chos 'chad snga phyi rim pa du ma/ rdo reng kun spangs pa sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i skyes chen du ma/ dpal rgya drung dig pa sogs mdo khams gser mdog pa'i bla chen snga phyi/ pa bom zhwa dmar ba/rta sna bka' bcu pa sogs smar tshang ban brgyud la sogs pa'i skyes chen 'phrin las can du ma/ mkhas pa mi lnga la sogs pa mi nyag rab sgang gi bla chen rnams la sogs mkhas pa'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa dang / 'gos lo tsā ba chen po gzhon nu dpal/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho/ chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos rgyal sku mched/ rje zha lu lo tsā ba la sogs skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po du ma dang / shar rab 'byam pa/ shar kha ras chen/ gtsang smyon/ dbus smyon/'khrul zhig sangs bsam pa/ 'brug smyon kun dga' legs pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang po ste rgyas par ni rje brgyad pas bka' ba stsal ba'i bu chen gyi tho yig tu blta'o/ /mdor na yul dus de'i rgya gar rgya nag 'jang bod yul gyi skye bo mchog dman thams cad kyang dam chos kyi 'brel ba ma thogs pa dang zhal mthong gsung thos kyis ma smin pa ni 'ga' yang ma mchis so/ /de la go'i shri sprul pa'i sku ni snye bor 'khrungs/ rje chos grags rgya mtshos lung bstan zhing sku skye ba gong ma'i dpon po bkra shis sogs la ngos 'dzin gsal bar mdzad pas— spyan drangs te drung du gtsug phud phul/ mtshan bkra shis rnam rgyal dpal bzang por gsol/ drung gi bkas gdan sa khag lnga sogs mchog dman thams cad kyis drung dang khyad med par bskur/ rje bdun pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu gar 1114

bstan gyi bdag po mdzad de rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skur mtshan nas brjod/ rje na rim brgyad pa seng ge'i khrir spyan drangs/ dge bsnyen gyi bslab pa dang gsung chos du ma phu/la te mi ring ba na mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan te ngo mtsharazhu ltas du ma byung ngo / / zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa ni dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos shar nas shar gyi phyogs su skye ba 'dzin pas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pa ltar snga ma'i 'khrungs yul las shar phyogs mdo smad kre shod khang dmar du yab ldong dgon pa skyabs dang yum dbra bza' bsod nams sgrol ma'i /lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe yum gyis nam mkha' la zla ba gnyis shar ba'i shar ma de cung mi gsal la nub ma ches gsal ba dang lo legs kyi dbus su bsdad pa soṭa pa rmis shing mi ma yin dag gis kre khang dmar du kurma pa byon zhes bsgrags pa dang yul de'i skye bo mang pos kyang dge mtshan mang du mthong zhing lhums su ngal ba med par bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas nas dpal gdong chu mo bya lo 'brug zla'i tshes gsum gyi nyi ma shar ba dang lhan cig tu sku bltams kurma pa zhes gsung zhing zla ba bdun na rta ra gdan sa pa'i ngor ngos 'dzin du ma mdzad/khang dmar gyi dgon par spyan drangs tshe 'ja' dang 'od kyis bsu ba dang tshogs pa'i dbus su nyam nga ba med par tsog pus bzhugs pa dang kurma pa'i gsung 'bum dang a khrid kyi tshig mtshams phye ste bstan/ bde dgyes dang /rma rnam thar gyi zhing bkod sogs la 'di dang 'di zhes gsungs/ yi dam dang chos skyong mang po'i zhal gzigs/ mngon mkhyen mang du gsungs/ char gyis phongs pa dang lo thog srin bus gnod pa sogs la bden tshig tsam gyis zhi/ ngo mtshar ba'i rtsed mo'i tshul mdzad/ tshems brje ba'i mche ba byung ba na kha cig gis slong bar gzigs nas gnang snyam pa'i mod la dor te ma rnyed/ tshems ring bsrel sngon pos 1115

spras pa'ang byung / dgong lo bcu pa la shar phyogs su bteg ste gzhi bdag gis bsu bar snang zhing bcom ldan 'das zhal gzigs/ gso thog tu rten 'brel du ma gzigs/ lcags mo'i sar sngon rje mthong ba don ldan la ma dad pa byas pa zhig mngon par mkhyen te bka' bstsal bas bshags pa byas/ dmar gyi 'bring por chu bo cher brub pas lam bgrod dka' ba na gtor ma gnang ba'i mod la zhi/rnga ros kyis tshun byon/ ras su nags tshal mes tshig pa'i 'jigs pas nyen pa na mgon pos chu rgyun 'bebs par gzigs te rang sar zhi/ gnod byed mang po la chos skyong gis chad pa phab/ sha ba'i khyus bsu zhing skyel ba byung ba yul lha yin par grags/ 'khrungs yul dang nye bar phebs pa na 'brug glog dang ser ba drag po byung tshe zhing skyong byon nas spyan 'dren par gzigs/ de ma thag slob dpon chen po go'i shri pa dang sngon gyi nye gnas sogs rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i bka'as bskul bas spyan 'dren par byon/ go'i shri rin po che dang mjal te phan tshun mnyes shing chos du ma gsan/ gling bdag po dpon chen du si rnams kyis gus par btud/ rag thag sku 'bum du zhing skyong gzigs/ yul lhung du bo ga rgyal de'i gzhi bdag la chos gsungs/ 'dan klong thang du bka' rgyud kyi bla ma kun gzigs/ 'bri chur rlung chen byung ba rten 'brel mdzad pas zhi/ tshal mdor rlung 'tshub kyi nang nas mi sdug pa'i gzugs kyis bar chad byed par snang ba skyed rim gyis btul/ zur mang dgon du rta lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la rje /rma pa bdun pa dang thog mar mjal te gtsug phud phul/ mtshan chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang por gsol/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan dang tham ga gnang / mi ring bar mkhan po go'i shri rin po che/ las slob kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang pos mdzad de rab byung dang dge tshul mdzad/ mkhas slob las chos du ma gsan/ de nas kurma/ lha sde/ ri bo che/ ldong tshom phug sogs su 1116

byon/ gzigs snang mang zhing thog gi 'jigs pa zlog po bor nad yams cher byung ba la bka' shog gnang bas khyed cag 'khor bcas la gnod par mi 'gyur zer te thog tu bab/ shing dmar ro ldem sogs su yi dam chos skyong dang bka' rgyud bla ma gzigs/ brang byi'u yul bdag la bka' bsgos pas nad yams chad/kong po'i lha mis bsus te dgung lo bcu gnyis pa spre lo la kong por byon/ ma ra steng / stag rtse/ lung bstan mkhar/ dga' ldan ma mo rnams su byon te so sor zhal gzigs mang zhing sngon gnas dran tshul gsungs/ de rnams su chos skyong gi gzigs snang mang zhing ma ra steng du zhal bzhi pa gzigs pas phyi nas gtor ma gnang / dga' ldan ma mor sku mtshams zla drug mdzad pa na dkon brtsegs gsung chung ngus ljags klog mdzad pa'ang rgyang ring du thos pa dang de srid lha'i rnga sgra dang me tog gi char yang yang byung zhing rmi nyams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa gzigs/ mi las lung bstan te rje rang byung pas bzhugs pa'i ri khrod rdza rar byon te dben pa mdzad/ gyam steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang de mo thang du spyan ras gzigs gsang sngags sgrog pa gzigs/ dam can gyis bstod pa 'bul ba gsan zhing kong btsun de mos 'dud cing legs nyes lung du bstan/de mo thang gi bzhugs khri'i rtsa bar sngon ma mthong ba'i me tog gi sdong po yal mdab 'ja'i mdog can skyes pas ngo mtshar du gyur/ thim yul du slob dpon pad+ma gzigs/ stag rtser mgon po la phyogs bcu mgon pos bskor ba dang zhing skyong yang yang gzigs phyi rol du rlung 'tshub sa 'dar ba tsam snang / 'khor gyi log sgrub kyis thugs skyo nas rgya gar du 'byon pa yang dgongs/ tsā rir byon pa na ba yur lha mo rang byung rgyal mo gzigs/ gnas nang du byon pa na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gzigs/ byin legs su dben pa mdzad pa na mkha' 'gro ma brgyad kyi glu gsan/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas tshul ji lta bar gzigs te mgur 1117

mdzad/ gzigs snang nub pa gso ba dang gsar du zhal phye ba du ma mdzad/'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs pa na gzhan dag gis kyang 'ja' 'od tsam du snang / mtsho dkar du mtsho dbus na shel gyi mchod rten bzhugs par bshad pa'ang gzigs/ rin phug du mkha' 'gro ma seng gdong can gsum gyi dri ba'i lan mdzad/ ri bo a ma ra dhū ta'i phyogs bzhi nas chu dkar bzhi 'bab pa'i 'gram du byon pa na 'o ma kho na ltar bab pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ bkra shis ljongs su mkha' 'gro dang chos bgros/ gting zab phug par tshe chu zad med du 'phel/ nub phyogs dbang phug gi ri bo 'khor lo sdom par gzigs shing 'jigs byed kyi sku gzugs gsal bar bstan/ sngon phyogs de srin po'i grong du yod pa'i dus srin po'i rgyal po gdong brgyad par skyes te de rnams la chos bstan pa'i sngon byung dran zhing gsungs/ gsar ma gnas lngar zhal gzigs gsar du brgya lhag gsal bar mdzad/ paṇa zhwa phug dang byin legs su gzims chung chung ngur skye bo dpag med shong ba'i ngo mtshar byung / lam du brag la zhabs rjes byung / lding tsho brgyad par ches bsnyun pa na gzhan zhig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por bgrod par 'dod do zhes smras shing des bzhugs par gsol ba btab pa'i thugs nyams shar ba dang dus mtshungs par mkhas grub chen po gtsang chen pa'i gzigs snang la sprul sku rin po che 'di nyid phebs te snyigs ma'i sems can 'dul bar dka' bas kho bo zhing khams gzhan du 'gro khyed rang yang 'dong gsung ba na cis kyang bzhugs par gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes so gsung zhing ltas 'di ltar nas bzhugs par zhu yig kyang phul/ lhun grub steng gi ri khrod du bzhugs dus sngags bdag gis gus par btud cing bsngags pa brjod par gzhan dag gis kyang mthong / 4dbyangs can mas mnal lam du a ru ra dang po ti gtad cing lung bstan pa gzigs te snyan ngag gi mkhyen pa rang byung du byung / 'ja' tshon gling du dgyes rdor shin tu gsal ba yul gyis ma bsgribs 1118

par gzigs nas de'i sgo phye/ dga' ldan ma mor khri mthon po'i steng du 'dug nas skye bo dang ga med 'a 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa gang blo ma'i glegs bu phyag tu bzung nas don bshad de zhal du mid par gzigs pa na sad tshe bstod pa de thugs la snang zhing ting nge 'dzin du ma 'khrungs/ de phyin gsung rab kun lan re gzigs pas mkhyen/ slar slob dpon rin po che 'jam dpal bzang po las bka' rgyud rin po che rnams kyi bka' 'bum dang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ na ro'i chos drug sogs bka' rgyud rin po che'i zab khrid khyad par can rnams dang nag rgyal phag gsum gyi skor rdo rje phreng ba bde mchog lo nag dril gsum dus kyi 'khor lo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho gnyis med rnam rgyal sogs gsar rnying gi dkyil 'khor brgya phrag mang po'i dbang bskur rgyud 'grel dang man ngag snyan rgyud mtha' dag gsan zhing thugs dam gyi sgo du ma shar/ dkyil 'khor so so'i thig rnams gsan tshe cung go dka' ba na slob dpon a bhu kā ra paṇ+ḍi ta dkar gsal ngur mig can du byon nas mngon sum ltar khrid pa'i mnal sad pa na ji lta bar mkhyen/kun mkhyen chen po de la thugs mi phyed pa'i dad pa 'khrungs/ de'i tshe dngos nyams mnal lam du rgyud sde'i lha de dag thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob pa'i snang ba du ma gzigs/ sngon gnas mang du dran pas gzhan la yid 'ches bskyed cing khyad par du rtogs ldan chos bzang la de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog yan lag tu gyur pa'i rnam thar gsungs/ de'i tshe kun mkhyen chen pos yon tan dag gsongs cig par bka' gnang bas de phyi/ cher ma gsungs/ rgyal ba lo ras kyi sku'i skye ba gtsang chen chos kyi dbang phyug mkhas grub chen po des sngon cig char du dbu ri ba'i 'gro mgon mdzad pa na las tshan gyi chags sdang ches pas thugs skyo ba skyes te dbu ri pang mo rgod pa la gtad nas cig char shar ma'i gnas sgo 'byed du byon pa rten 'brel ma 'grig pas mtsho dkar khyung rdzong du lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad pas sgam po lha rjes slebs rom dang rin phug gi gnas phul bar 1119

gzigs nas rin phug du sgrab sde mdzad/ phyis yom la sogs pa mang du btab ste 'phrin las shin tu che sgong chos rje nyid zha lu ba'i dge bshes yin pa'i dbang gis bu lugs kyi kun rig dus 'khor sogs dang gling lugs kyi bde mchog dang khrid chen brgyad sogs dar zhing bstan pa la ches phan pa byung skabs ra lung rgyal dbang chos rje dgung lo nyi shu rtsa grangs pa cig spyan drangs nas dgon pa rnams 'bul zhing rgyal dbang chos rje rang yang gsung chos rnams gsan par bzhed pa la sgar la bud med mang du 'dug pa gzigs pas 'di mi mdzad par zhu zhes yang yang zhus kyang gsan du ma bzhed pas gtsang chen chos rje thugs ma rangs te gsung chos kyang ma phul/ nga'i dgon pa rnams khong la phul na ser khyim par 'gro ba 'dug gsungs nas ma phul/ phyis mi 'byon pa'i rten 'brel yang mdzad/rjes su sprul sku rin po che 'di spyan drangs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan la thugs gus pa mtha' yas pa skyes te sngon rje rol pa'i rdo rje la sgam po lha rjes gnas phul ba'i rten 'brel bzhin dbu ri ba'i dgon gnas thams cad phul/bka' brgyud 'di'i bstan pa sgrub tshugs kho nas 'dzin dgos pa yin pas rje nyid la sgrub pa la stos pa mi 'dug 'bras bu mthar phyin 'dug rung sgrub rgyud kyi mig stos dang sku tshe'i rten 'brel du re zhig sgrub pa gnang bar yang zhus/ de'i rkyen gyis sgam por sku mtshams la thegs/ bya rgod mang pos bsu ba ltar byung /dge 'dun rnams kyis bsus/ shing spang thang du phebs pa na bka' rgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlob par gzigs/ rje sgam po pa'i chos khri la bzhugs te dwags po'i chos bzhi gsungs pa na me tog gi char bab/ de dag tu sgrub pa zla ba dgur mdzad pa na dag snang dang ngo mtshar mang zhing tshe skrub mdzad tshe bum pa drug bcu rtsa gnyis rnyed pa'i ltas gzigs/ thugs dam ches 'phel zhing rten 'brel mang du gzigs/ phug mo che tragad yang yang du gzigs/ dge bshes chos grags kyi bdun tshigs byang bzhus mdzad pa na lhar skyes par gzigs /1120

kong por thegs par bzhed tshe dwags lha sgam pos bzhugs bar yang yang zhus shing mngon sum du'ang char chen pos thegs lam bskyil/ zur mkhar du rje dwags po'i 'phel gdung la mjal tshe de ma thag tu 'phel/ rica/ gyis dga' ldan ma mo dang gsa' phu sogs su phebs/ rje lo tsā ba zhal gzigs nas bstod pa yang mdzad/ de'i tshe dbus gtsang du snyan grags 'phel bas 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang mkhas pa nam mkha' blo gros pa sogs dge bshes chen po du mas ched du mjal du byon zhing gus pas chos du ma gsan/ dbus phyogs su phebs par gsol ba yang btab/ zhing skyong gis gnang ba phul te sgrub thabs rgyas pa'ang mdzad/ dga' ldan ma mo/ /rma phog rtsa/ stag rtse sogs su yi dam chos skyong gi zhal gzigs mang zhing bstod pa mdzad/ de nas snye bo/ rngod/ po bo rnams brgyud mdo khams kyi lho rong nas lho lung chen bco brgyad/ 'darna ma/ gling /be ri la sogs pa'i bar du rma chu'i rgyud kyi skye bo so sos spyan drangs shing so sor ngo mtshar gyi gzigs snang dang than pa sel ba 'ja' dang me tog la sogs pa'i ltas dang mi ma yin so sos bkur sti byed pa sogs ni bgrang gis mi lang /dgung lo nyer gnyis pa rta lo la dar dang rdo sogs nas brgyud kre rong lcags gsum sogs shar kha'i yul du byon/ thams cad mkhyen pa chos grags rgya mtsho phyogs der phebs pa'i drung du byon te rje'i drung du bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas sogs dang bla ma rnam gnyis las gsung chos rgya cher gsan zhing dpon slob lhan cig par re zhig bzhugs/ slar gling tshang ri bo che/ garma sogs dang po bo kong po brgyud/ dgung lo nyer bzhi pa spre lo la dga' ldan ma mo nas bteg ste dwags po dang 'ol kha brgyud/ gdan sa thel dang tshong 'dus brag kha la sogs par phebs/ sngon kong por mjal ba'i rje yid bzang rtse nga dang rje nam pa gnyis lha gzigs rlangal kyi ti shrir gyur pas gtso bor zhabs tog gi gus zhen mdzad 1121

cing spyan snga rin po ches bkur sti cher mdzad/ dpyid 'bring gi tshes bzhi'i snga dro rje yid bzang rtse bas mkhan po dang dge 'dun sgang gi tshogs pa'i 'dren pa chos kyi rje rab 'byor seng ges las slob/ chos rje nam pas gsang ston mdzad de lnga'i tshogs kyi dbus su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ mkhan po las dus kyi 'khor lo sgyu gsang / bde dgyes/ kha/ gdan/ gshed skor sogs kyi skor mtha' dag dang byams chos spyod phyogs sogs snga phyir gsan pa mtha' yas/ slob dpon gnyis las kyang chos mang du gsan zhing las gral la bzhugs pa'i slob dpon gzhon dbang la yang chos mang du gsan te phyis yid bzang rtse ba phyi mar grags/mkhas grub chen po lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho las ni mar lugs dang paṇa chen lugs sogs dang gsar rnying gi gsan pa mtha' yas/ rje lo chen gyi bkas bskul ba dang khyad par gyi yon tan las yar rgyab nas sbyin bdag chen mo rdo rje bde ma sras mched dang bcas pas dad gus mtha' yas pas bskur zhing gtan du ba'i sbyin bdag bzhed pa kun sgrub tu gyur nas phyis gnas nang gi byams pa'i sku dang dga' ldan ma mo'i rten gtso thub chen sogs kyang de nyid du bzheng ba mdzad/byams gling smon lam gyi gral dbur yang lan mang du phebs/ lha sa dang mtshur phur phebs/ mchod sprin du mas mchod cing dbus gtsang gi chos sde che ba thams cad la zang zing gi mchod sbyin du ma mdzad/ lha grags pa mtha' yas kyis spyan drangs te g.yam bzang la sogs par 'gro don mdzad/ bya bkra shis dar rgyas la sems bskyed kyi sdom pa gnang / sa khyi'i zla ba gsum pa la gzhis ka gri gu nas brgyud de gra dol nas lha sar mchod pa mdzad cing gnas nang du slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan las chos mang du gsan/ mtshur/ gnam gzhung / 'dam/gnam mtsho phyug mo'i bkra shis do bo che'i bar du byon te ban sgar dbon po sogs chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ ra sgreng du mchod sbyin mdzad/ stag lung du 1122

spyan drangs te chos dang zang zing gi sbyin gtong mdzad/ 'phan yul dang ba lam shar nas 'on du brgyud mngon dga' chos rdzong du rje yid bzang rtse pa la chos mang du gsan zhing rje yid bzang rtse pas kyang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa sogs tshur mang du gsan/ tshong 'dus su spyan snga rin po che la chos mang du gnang zhing bsam yas srin po ri rnams su mchod pa mdzad/ dol lhun grub lha rtser rje lo chen la rngog chos rnams gsan tshe nam mkha' la lha'i rnga grag pa dang mtsho chen po zhig lhag med tu gsol ba'i ltas gzigs/ rje lo chen gyis kyang phag mo zhal bzhi ma la sogs mang du gsan/ rje mar pa'i sgrub gnas gzigs par bzhed pas lho brag la phebs te sa mo phag lo shar ba na sras dro bo lung du phebs te mchod bstod mdzad/ mkhar chu'i bar gyi yul gru rnams su byon te thams cad kyis dad mos 'bul ba dang chos dang zang zing gi 'gro don mtha' yas/ lha lung du sgrub sde mdzad par brtsams kyang yum yul gyi lhas sa gzhi phul ba gzigs pas bkra shis dge 'phel gyi sgrub gnas mdzad/ der lo gcig tu sku mtshams mdzad tshe rang gi phyag g.yas pa lhung ba'i mnal ltas byung tshe mtshur phur gtsug lag khang cung zad zhig pa dang lha chen gyi phyag la chud zos byung ba gsan te gso ba'i yo byad mang du gnang / dro bo lung zangs phug du sgrub pa ba sum bcu'i 'du ba'i sgo sbyar lcags byi'i zla ba gsum pa nas mon bum thang la thegs/ba run chos 'khor gyi bar du byon te zla gcig gi khongs su btsun gsar sum brgya lhag pa byung ba rnams gos kyi sbyin pas rab byung gi rtags su bsgrubs te hor zla drug pa'i bco lnga nas lhun grub chos sde'i gtsug lag khang mdzad/ slar bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs te sgrub pa po bzhi bcu'i sgrub rgyags sbyar zhing bca' ba legs par mdzad/ slar yar rgyab 'on sogs su phebs te bla ma rnams dang chos phar gsan tshur gsan gyi bgro ba mdzad cing rje 'gos la phur pa'i dbang gsan 1123
