tshe mnal lam du slob dpon pad+ma gzigs/ spyan snga rin po che dang sde sdod 'dzin pa du ma la so so'i 'dod chos gnang / de'i tshe sprin nag gi nang nas mi nag phur thogs thon te thugs gar bsnun pa'i mnal ltas gzigs pa na ro stoms gnad tu bsnun/ bad mkhris kyi bsnyun byung yang de ma thag zhi/ yab yum gyi don du mi 'khrugs pa dang tshe dpag med kyi sku yar stod du bzheng ba la bar chad srung ba'i phyag nas mdzad pas lugs blug pa na nas 'bru ma tshig par lugs gseb na gnas pa byung / chu byang kha nas spyan snga rin po che sne gdong gi go sar phebs pas spyan drangs te chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ rin spungs nang so mtsho skyes pa dang snel pa du dben sha la sogs la so so'i 'dod chos gnang / hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gcig la khri ston gyi bshis brjod mdzad/ yar stod tu rten chen grub pa'i rab gnas mdzad/ bya pas spyan drangs pa'i ngor bral nas g.ye dang sho po brgyud de zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig la chos rgyal lhun por phebs te cher dad pas mchod/ gser phye 'bum pa dang khyad par grub chen kurma pa'i lung bstan lha khang la mchod pa cher mdzad/ zangs po che la sogs par byon te lde drug gis mchod/ byar chos sder bla ma 'phags chen sogs la gsung chos du ma gnang /tsā rir phebs te yul stod du chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa cher mdzad/ yul smad gsil ba tshal du phag mo'i dbang skyed rdzogs kyis 'dus pa rnams tshim par mdzad/ de dag gi tshe sku rgyun du cung zad snyun pa la sman dpyad kyis ma phan yang sa phyogs de skyes bu mtshon cha thogs pas gang zhing gad rgyangs drag du sgrog pa'i mtshon chas bsnyung ba'i gnas rnams dum bur btubs pa'i snang ba gzigs ma thag sku 'phar g.yo drag tu byung bas dwangs/ slar chos rgyal lhun por phebs pa na rje yid bzang rtse pa dgung lo go gsum du phebs pa sku nas smin rung thugs 'khrul pa med par thugs rtsom sogs mi 'chag pa dang sku zor yang shing bde ba 1124

yod kyang sku grib kyi rnam pas cung zad bsnyun pa gsan te sku rim du ma mdzad kyang zhi bar gshegs pa'i mtshan ma mkhyen te de bzhin gyi zhu yig phul te mi ring bar mya ngan las 'das/ rdza dmar bas spyan drangs shing dgon ma lag phul te yom la sogs pa dang chabs gcig par bdag rkyen mdzad/ rte'u rar spyan drangs/rje nyid kyi gus ldan gyi slob ma chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyis rten ngo mtshar can du ma phul/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes drug la chos 'khor lhun po'i mchod rten gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rje 'gos kyi dgongs rdzogs gsol 'debs du ma mdzad pa na dag snang mang du gzigs/ slar rgya rab nas g.ye brgyud de gor chos rdzong du phebs pa na rje lo chen gyis brtan bzhugs 'bul mi gnang ba slebs/rtses dang du bla yel chen mor rje 'gos kyi gshegs rdzongs su bzhi stong gi dge 'dun la 'gyed chen mdzad cing chos kyis kyang tshim par mdzad/ yang dgon du sku gdung la mchod pa mdzad cing rin po che'i za ma tog tu bzhug su gsol/chu stag hor zla dang po'i tshes gsum la 'phyong rgyas stag rtser spyan drangs te ri bo bde chen la phyag nas mdzad cing zhabs tog cher mdzad/ shin tu dad de sbyin bdag gi rtsa bar gyur/ slar yar rgyab tu rje lo chen dang chos bgros nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa garma pa mdo khams nas dbus su phebs pa la mjal du theṭa pa na yar rgyab nas 'bul zhabs rgya chen sbyar te phebs/ slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pas phyag 'tshal sgang nas gsu ba mdzad/ zla ba dang po'i nyer drug gi nyin mtshur phu'i bkra shis gsar mar dpon slob mjal/ hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la gzhi len gyi dga' ston 'bul zhabs cher mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa las mdo du ma/ 'i lung gsan pa dang 'gro don yang du ma mdzad/ stag lung bas spyan drangs te skyi 'phan brgyud/ ka drug pa sogs dge 'dun gyis bsus te mchod khang chen mo'i mthil du mjal/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gnyis kyi snga dro 1125

nas kun mkhyen ngag dbang grag pa'i drung du 'bri gdan stag gsum gyi chos mang du gsan/ chos rje sku mched sogs la zab chos nang don dang mkha' spyod bka' 'bum sogs gnang zhing tshogs chos su dwags po'i chos bzhi gnang / zang zing gi 'bul nod ni phan tshun gnyis gar rlabs che/ rim pas skyi shod dang skyi smad sogs nas gzhung spre zhing du gdung khang rin po che sogs mchod/ dol bsam gtan gling du rje lo chen las sbyor drug nyams khrid tu mdzad pas stong gzugs rgya cher gzigs shing zab gnad du ma gzigs/ 'dul ba'i phyogs rnams rgyas par gsan/ rje don ldan zhabs kyi dril bu lus dkyil chen mo'i dbang dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa tshur gsan/ dpon slob lhan cig pas brag kha yang dgon sogs su thegs te rje 'gos kyi mchod rten la rab gnas mdzad/ byams gling smon lam la phebs chos mang du gsungs nas 'brog gi lam brgyud de lha grags pa mthe' yas kyis mchod/ lho brag shar gyi smra bo cog po'i gnas gzigs/tsan gro nas lam mdzad/ cha lung du zhag nyi shur dben pa mdzad/ ban par byon te kher gad kyis btab pa'i drug ral dang khyung tshang zhing chen rnams yon bdag so sos phul te bdag rkyen mdzad/ seng ge rdzong du ya 'brog khri dpon lhun grub rgyal mtshan pas mchod/ bkra shis dge 'phel du bzhugs tshe mtshur phur slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mdzad/ de ma thag gong ma kun dga' legs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi gral dbus spyan drangs te ya 'brog nas yar stod brgyud de byon/ hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga phyi mar rtse'i tshoms su tshogs chen pa dang thel rtses dang gi stod rags lnga brgya tsam gyi dbus su gdung mchod kyi bsngo ba gnang / zla ba brgyad pa phyi ma'i tshes bcu gsum la rtses dang gi bla yel chen mor lnga stong gi tshogs pa'i gral dbu mdzad/dpon sa la bka' chos du ma gnang / byar mdar rje lo chen dang mjal/ zhing slar 1126

yar stod ci rigs su 'gro don mdzad de 'brog dang sman bzang dang spro dang / lha lung du phebs tshe mnal ltas ngan pa du ma byung / bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs pa na rje lo chen gshegs pa'i pho nya slebs te hor zla dgu pa'i bcu bdun la bteg nas nyer gcig la lhun grub lha rtser phebs/ sku gdung la mchod pa mdzad pa'i nub cig rje 'gos dang rje lo chen gnyis sku drung na bzhugs par snang ba las gnyis ka sku lus me'i phung po lta bu'i 'od phung du gyur nam mkha' la je mthor gshegs pa na thugs dad pas de'i rjes su bsnyegs pa ci zhig na lho nub gyi nam mkhar mda' 'phangs pa ltar bzhur cing nyid de nas slar log par gzigs te 'di ni dus 'khor las bshad pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub pa'i mtshan mar rje 'di dag bzhed do/ /slar sku gdung sbyong ba dang dge bdun sgang pa dang rtses dang sogs su mang skol dang 'gyed rgya cher mdzad/ yar rgyab nas dgongs rdzogs kyi thang ston chen mo mdzad pa'i gral gtsor bzhugs/ rje lo chen gyi bstod pa dang rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho yang mdzad/ de dag gi bar du chag lo gsum pa sogs la brtag gnyis kur lugs sogs gnang / bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la gong dkar du spyan drangs te rdo rje gdan du mchod pa mdzad/ chos kyi rje mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug kun dga' rnam rgyal la dbang bskur rjes gnang du ma gnang / lhun grub lha rtser rje'i sku 'dra rab gnas sogs mdzad de slar yar 'brog nas sto brag du phebs te sras dro bo lung du mchod pa mdzad/ bum thang pas nan gyis spyan drangs te bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la lhun grub chos sder phebs te gtsug lag khang gsar bcos rgyas par mdzad/ gzhi ba'i 'dus pa dang khyad par phyag phyir chos 'dod mkhas btsun dang rigs rus kyis mtho ba ches mang bas gar bzhugs su dbang lung rnam bshad khrid sogs kyi 'gro don ni rgyun mi chad cing nyin re zhing mdo sngags ci rigs pa'i thugs rtsom yang mi 'chag par — 1127

mdzad pa ni rgyan gyi rnam thar yin 4ra tha 'khob ta bstan pa'i ming tsam dpeXpa / / ni ri ji byung ba bdud rigs kyis ma bzod pas yon bdag nang 'khrug byung / nad yams kyis sku 'khor pa rnams gtses tshe stongs su dgongs pas lhag par thugs stobs skyes dkon mchog la gsol ba btab cing sku 'khor rnams kyang dbugs phyung ste dar 'dam dang sman las dus gsum sangs rgyas nye ba'i sras brgyad/ khro bo gnyis dang bcas pa legs par bzhengs shing mchod rdzas rgya cher mdzad/ pa gro sogs nub mon rnams dang ku ru lung sogs shar gyi mon du ma dang dung ri rgya mtsho sogs nas spyan 'dren slebs kyang zhal gyis ma bzhes/ 'on kyang mjal mi mtha' yas pas de dag gi 'bul ba bzhes/ btsun gzugs tsam las bslab sdom gyi ming yang med pa dpag med 'dus pa yang so so nas bslab sdom dgos pa'i go ba tsam skyes nas gsol ba 'debs pa na mon btsun mtha' yas la bslab sdom gnang / bla ma ye shes rgya mtsho dpon slob kong por spyan 'dren la slebs/glang mthil dang dung la sogs pa'i yul du dgun nyi ldog tshe phebs shing shing thams cad lo mdab rgyas/ skyu ru ra la sogs pa smin/ ge sar gsum pa sogs me tog rgyas pas bod kyi dbyar sos las mdzes par gzigs te thugs ngal sos pa ltar gyur/ bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas re phal dang / brag steng / dung li sogs su byon/ bcu bdun la chos sder phebs/ 'brug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i yar ngo la rab gnas dang dga' ston mdzad/ skabs 'di shed du bdud kyis rgyud bskul ba'i skye bo du mas chibs rags kyi thog tu brgyugs nas sku la rdeg par sems pa na sangs rgyas mnyan pa chibs 'ju mar yod pas na bza' ber zlam yar dbu la bslog pas kha dog ma gcig pas cung zad 'khrul te lus/ gam po gnas nang gi bde tsha mkhan po'i dbon po cig gis rta las bab nas bsrungs pas re zhig thub ste chibs rags rnams thal/ kho rang bsad pa 1128 ra —

phyis mon yul du mir skyes te bag chags gsal bar byung ba ni da lta bla ma bde tsha zhes 'gro don mdzad pa 'di yin no/ /zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug la bod la chibs kha bsgyur te sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang du phebs/ de'i tshe sku mkhar la zhabs tog shin tu ngan par gziṭa pas skyes mchog gzims chung du skyes mchog 'khor bcas dang sngags sku rnams sman thang ba zhi ba 'od 'brir 'jug pa'i bka' gnang ba grub 'dug pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad cing mchod rdzas phul/ 'di'i dus rje dpa' bo bya btang mdzad pas de phyogs la phebs pa'i thog mar sras gzims chung gi rab gnas mdzad pa dang mjal nas chos 'brel gsan par snang / slar bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs te sbyin bdag rnams la sgrub sde gtad gnyer mdzad/ rnam thar na sgrub sde 'di la shin tu do gal can mdzad 'dug pas rang cag bstan pa 'dzin pa'i ming gis 'tsho ba rnams kyis kyang 'di la lhag par 'bad dgos par snang ngo / /dang spro nas sman thang dang 'brog brang mda' sogs brgyud de dol rgyang gling nas sbyin bdag chen pos bsus te bkra shis rnam rgyal du dpon sa rdo rje bde ma yum sras la bka' chos gnang / bla ma'i sgrub sde bsam gtan gling du gdams pa zab mo gnang / byams gling du sa skyong dge ba'i dbang po la bla ma'i rnam thar sogs gsungs shing chos kyi 'khor lo du ma bskor/ lhun grub gling du rgyal bu yum sras la dbang bskur du ma mdzad/ drug pa'i bcu gnyis la spyan snga gong ma chen mos sbun bsu mdzad de sne gdong rtser phebs/ dbang chos du ma gnang zhing tshogs chen pa la lnga ldan gyi chos bstsal/ dgu pa'i tshes gcig la bteg ste yar stod shar nub tu 'gro don mdzad nas slar sne gdong du bzhugs te gsung chos stol ba na rje garma pa'i bkas bskul te bcu pa'i tshes drug la phyags bteg yar gong / 'brog rong chen rin spungs brgyud/ so so'i sbyin bdag chen po rnams 1129

kyis bskur sti byas te gtsang po'i byang lam brgyud/ 'u yug phu dkar du rje thams cad mkhyen pa garma pa dang mjal/ gser 'gyed dang 'bul chen mdzad/mdo sde las brgya pa sogs thams cad la phan pa'i phyir tshogs chos su stsol bar gsol ba btab nas gsan/ gar dbon sku mched sogs sgar chen gyi 'dus pa rnams la dbang khrid lung bshad pa du ma mdzad/ dbus phyogs dang sto rgyud kyi che gu la 'phrin las bskul ba'i grogs gyis zhes bka' bstsal rgyas par phebs te shing sbrul zla ba gsum pa'i nyer bdun la bteg gos sngon gyi gtsug lag khang mjal/ snubs mdar chos lung gi mkhan chen rat+na ba 'dus pa dang bcas pas mjal tshe bka' rgyud kyi bzhed pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi chos 'brel gnang bas cher dad/ rin spungs pa'i sa skyong rdo rje tshe brtan la sogs pas sngar ltar bskur sti dang rim gro rgya cher byas te rim pas byon/ bar chad kyi mtshan ltas cung zad byung ba ya 'brog gi mtsho 'gram rgyan dang nye ba'i dben gnas shig tu zhag bdun sku mtshams mdzad pas bar chad sol ba'i ltas gzigs/ rngog lo dang mar do'i 'khrungs sa gzigs pa la mos gus mdzad/ zla ba bzhi pa'i yar ngo nas yar rgyab kyi sbyin bdag chen po'i bsod nams kyi zhing du chos kyi 'phrin las cher mdzad nas slar sne gdong rtser phebs te bka' chos du ma gnang / yar stod dang lho brgyud nas spyan drangs te ya rtser phan tshun gyi bzlums mdzad/ g.yam bzang spyan snga'i rgyur sku gzhon pa rab tu phyung / stag rtse/ dgon thang / mkhar thog brgyud de rtser phebs/ bka' chos gnang zhing dpon blon gyi lhad bsal/ta si'i sku 'dra dang nyang po gru'i lcags zam la phyag nas 'thor/ 7 yar rgyab tu byon te dge 'dun sgang pa sogs la chos 'khor bskor/ kun spangs pa chen po dus der rab tu phyung / dpal mkha' spyod pas mnal lam du byams pa'i sku 'di khyod kyis ma 'ongs pa na 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes gsan pa bzhin byams 1130

pa'i sku bzheng ba'i zhal bskos mdzad/ der gong ma mnyel bas spyan drangs te 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang sogs gnang bas bsnyun pa las grol/ slar yar rgyab tu dpon chen kun dga' rin chen rgyal po la phyag chen gyi nyams khrid gnang / rje /rma pa'i bka' shog phebs te bdun pa'i tshes bzhi la bteg ste gsang la nas byon/ gsang phur sgrol ma rtsod rgyal ma la rgyab yol phul/ lha sar mchod pa du ma mdzad cing gzhis ka sne'u pas mchod/ 'dir/ de tshe bco lnga'i dus kyi rmi lam du/ /rin chen in+d+ra nī la 'od 'bar ba/ /dbyibs legs zung du 'brel ba rnyed pa ni/ /phyi ma'i dus kyi lung bstan yin par zung / /zhes pa 'di la sngar kha cig sku skye gnyis byon pa la ngos 'dzin par snang yang sku skye gnyis yin na in+d+ra nī la de yang phan tshun du gnas pa lta bu dgos kyi zung du 'brel ba mi riṭa so/ /de nas stag lung du spyan drangs te phan tshun mnyes par gyur/ zla ba de'i gnam gang gi dus 'dam stong ri steng du rje rnarma pa mjal/ 'di tshe mtshur phu go shri sku mched la pa ra nas 'tshe ba cung zad byas pa zhi bar gyis shig bka' pheb ste stod lungs su thegs te de dag zhi bar mdzad/ slar bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi la lha sar rje kurma pa dang dpon slob mjal/ go'i shri rin po che'i lung lag rtags shis brjod gnang ste gu'i gung par mnga' gsol yang 'phrin las rgya ches pas sku skye ba 'di'i ring zhabs phyir bzhugs pa ni ma shar/ spyir go'i sri rin po che dpal 'byor don grub kyi zhal chems su sprul sku zhwa dmar ba 'di la bdag gi shul 'di gnang ba zhu/ de ma shar na khong rang gi sku skye snga ma gnyis kyi mdzad pa'i 'phro yin pas kong po'i gzhi pa 'di gnang ba zhu/ )gang na'ang dpon slob gnyis po ya ma bral ba cig cis kyang zhu/ zhes nan gyis zhus par snang yang de ma thag gi gu'i gung pa 'brong bu go'i shri la gnang ba dang / kong po'i gzhi pa gdan sa bar pa la gtod pa gnang / re zhig zhabs phyir nges par bzhugs — 1131

dgos pa kho na yang ma shar/ rje 'gos kyis kyang nan gyis spyan drangs pas dbus phyogs su phebs pa shar/ de'i dbang gis mdo sngags mtha' dag gi gsan bsam thugs dam nyams bzhes kho na gtso bor mdzad chog pa byung zhing de'i ngang nas gzhan phan yang dpag med grub par 'dug lha sa nas bzung yab sras lhan cig pas gzhung gra dol rnams brgyud/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu la bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos spyan drangs te spyan snga gong ma tshes gnyis rin po ches rje kurma pa dang dang por mjal/ lug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i bar du yab sras gnyi gas chos 'khor bskor zhing 'bul gnang gi rlabs mtha' yas/ slar yab sras lhan cig pas yar stod shar nub tu phebs tshe bsam bde skyed tshal du gar dbon rnam gnyis sogs la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang sogs gnang / ya tse thang gi bar du zhabs phyir bzhugs te yab sras lhan cig pas sde phan tshun gyi 'jam thabs mdzad/ sto rgyud dbang pos zhabs 'degs kyi mtshams sbyor mdzad de sgar chen de phyogs su thegs/ rje nyid zla ba lnga pa'i nang du yar stod shar nub dang yar rgyab tu phebs/ byams pa'i sku grub pa zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis la rab gnas thog ma dang yon rdzongs gnang / slar skyi shod la spyon drangs te gnas nang gi mchod khang gsar mar rten bzhugs grub pa na de'i mar ngo'i bcu bzhi la rab gnas dngos gzhi dga' ston dang bcas pa mdzad/ bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la lha sar phebs pa nas bzung rim gyis byon te 'phrang po'i rdo rje brag rtsar yab sras mjal/ slar yar rgyab tu lha chen rgyab mtho so gnyis pa zangs gser las sgrub par bka' gnang ste glo bo bkra shis mgon gyis spus bsgyur las zangs gser mang du phu' ba sogs las bsgrubs/ kong por spyan drangs pa'i ngor chibs pa bsgyur te gong ma sku 'khor gyis 'ol kha bkra shis thang gi bar du zhabs skyel mdzad/ glong la nas bye nyil brgyud de dwags po yom dgon par re zhig bzhuṭa/1132

rgyum pa yab sras kyis bkur stis myo/chod/ sku rab gdan sa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa khri thog tu 'don pa'i shis brjod mdzad/ kong stod dung dkar brag gi ri bor chos sde mdzad/ spyir mchims lha'ang nag phyogs pa yin zer yang dung dkar brag gi sa 'di mchims lhas mnal lam du phul zhes thos/ rin phug gi gnas la sogs pa rnams la dar rgyas mdzad/ yul gru so sor bkur stis mchod de dga' ldan ma mo'i gdan sa chen por phebs/ sa spre zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gnyis la ras bud sgang gi bzhir sa chog mdzad de ka chen dgu bcu rtsa bzhi'i khyon gyi gtsug lag khang chen po dri gtsang khang khyams skor khang rung ba'i khang pa phan tshun sgo khang dang bcas pa legs par mdzad de rig byed pa rnams kyang yar rgyab nas zhabs tog bgyis te zhal ba'i bar dpyis phyin par grub cing de dag gi dus dge las dang zhal mjal gsung thos kyi 'du ba phyogs thams cad nas mtha' yas kyange de dag gang la'ang nad gdon dang gru ko sogs la nyes pa gtan ma byung bas thams cad ya mtshan du 'dzin/ skabs cig bdud ris kyis yid g.yos pa'i dus 'khrug ldang bar brtsams pa na dkon mchog la bstod pa dang chos skyong gi 'phrin las bskul zhi ba'i sbyin sreg mang du mdzad pas zhi bar gyur/ hor zla bcu pa nas phrag yul sogs chab nag dang gsang sogs chab dkar dang bya lo shar ba nas phu gseb klu nang rta ba skor sogs yul gru so sor phebs te sngar srol gyi me tog bzhes/ stag rtse thugs rje sgang du sgrub gra mdzad/ lung bstan mkhar du shel las grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi nang rgyal ba'i sku 'od zer 'phro bas gang bar gzigs pa na dge las bar chad med par 'grub pa'i ltas su gzigs/de'i tshe rje kurma pa nyang kha nas phebs pa la kong po'i gzhi byes lhan cig pas rta ba stod du bsu ba dang gzhi len mdzad/ dga' ldan ma rmar phebs shing dgung skag gsum pa'i bar chad sel slad bkra shis ljongs dang byin legs su phebs te 1133

zhal gzigs nub pa rnams gsal bar mdzad cing sngon med du ma zhal phye/ slar dga' ldan ma mor phebs pa na gnas kyi rnam bzhag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhal lung yang mdzad/ de'i tshe rje zha lu lo tsā ba zhabs phyir bzhugs pas sngon bod du ma 'gyur ba mdzod 'grel gnam lcags thog gzer bsgyur ba'i bka' gnang ste leṭa par bsgyur/ khyi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu tshun gyi gtsug lag khang grub nas rnying mar bka' brgyud kyi bla ma'i bris sku mdzad/ dbus nas lha chen spyan 'dren pa'i slad du chibs kha bsgyur te thakhri la nas bod lung byar dang chos rgyal lhun por phebs/ lho rgyud dbang po mched dang mkhas pa chen po bskal bzang chos kyi rgya mtsho dang sku skye chos rgyal nor bu sogs la dbang rjes gnang dang bka' rgyud rnam thar sogs gnang / yar stod du sbyin bdag chen po rnams la gra lnga'i dbang bskur sogs mdzad/ sne gdong du mchod yon mjal/ yar rgyab tu phebs te yum chen rdo rje bde ma zhing gzhan du byon pa'i dge rtsa chen po'i bsngo ba mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs pugi gi dge slong dzñā na maṅga las bskul te ma hā bodhi la bstod pa legs sbyar gyi skad du mdzad/ zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la spyan snga gong mas bsam yas kyi shan so nas bsus te mchod yon lhan cig pas gdan sa thel du phebs te rten gsum phyag rdzas thams cad gzi gas lam du zhib mor phul te don gyis gdan sa'i rtsis phul zhing phyis go sa gnang dgos par yang zhus/ 'jang pho brang du khu dbon gdan 'dzom tshe gdung rgyud la mtshan dang dge bsnyen gnang /rtser mchod yon phebs te bsnyen sgrub kyi nyams khrid mdzad/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa gnang tshe mtshan ltas cung zad rtsub pa gzigs/ de nas 'phyong rgyas su 'degs pa na dgon thang gi bar zhabs skyel mtha' ma mdzad/ lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu la bkra shis brtsegs pa'i khang bzang gi rab gnas mdzad nas yar rgyab tu phebs/ da mtshig gsum bkod kyi sku'i rab gnas mdzad/ de tshe gong ma blo bur du mnyel 1134

pas spyan drangs pa rings par thegs kyang sku thim pas mjal ba ni ma grub/ sku rim gyi tshul gyis thugs dam la 'dogs pa mdzad/ gdung mchod dang dgongs rdzogs chen mo'i gral dbu mdzad/ dus der dka' gnas shin tu che yang thugs rjes bde legs su gyur/ kun spangs chen pos phyi nang gi khur bzhes te lha chen legs par grub pa dga' ldan ma mor spyan drangs/ 'di rnams kyi tshe dus skabs ngan pas shin tu dka' na'ang mdzad pa la bar chad med pas dkon mchog la thugs 'ches pas mdzad pa brgya pa mdzad/ chu byi gsar nas bla ma ye shes rgya mtshos dga' ldan ma mor rten gyi khri rgyab byas/ gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la rje 'gos kyi gdung hūṃgs kyis sbyangs tshe rtses dang stod rags la gser 'gyed mdzad/kong por phebs bzhed kyang yar lungs su dmag gi 'du 'tshog byung ba la bka' bstsal gnang dgos pas 'gyangs/ gri gur phebs te bya bskal bzang pa'i bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ sa skyong don yod rdo rje'i dpung gis yar gong rnams bsdigs pa la mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa mdzad/ dpal bsnams rgyal dbang pa la chos du ma gnang / chu glang zla ba gnyis pa la yar rgyab nas ston pha'i gos sku la sogs pa'i 'bul chen mdzad/ sde srid phag mo gru pa'i gros dbang rnams kyis 'gro mgon rin po che'i gdan sar phebs te gdung rgyud kyi lugs gnyis ga'i mgon skyabs gnang dgos par zhus/ dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos ma 'ongs lung bstan du rje btsun badz+ra rā dzā'i dgongs pa sgrub par dga' bas de'i dgongs pa sgrub pa'i phyir chu bo lo ha ti'i klung 'gram du 'byung ngo zhes pa'i dus su son par yang mkhyen nas gdan sa chen po'i khri gnon par zhal gyis bzhes te phyis khri thog tu phebs nas sde srid phag mo gru pa'i lugs gnyis kyi dbu 'don mdzad/ sngar zhal ngo shin tu phra ba'i skabs su gdung rgyud kyi rten 'brel mdzad/phyis bltams pa nas sku nar ma son gyi bar du lugs gnyis ka nas brtse bas 1135

bskyangs pas tshes gnyis rin po che tshun gyi lha gzigs kyi zhal ngo rnams kyis rje 'di'i 'jig rten gyi bka' drin kho na'ang cis kyang khyer ba med do/ /slar sa skyong don yod rdo rjes spyan drangs te chu shul lhun po rtser phebs te bzhed pa tshim par mdzad/ stag lung rin po che der spyan drangs pa dang dgyes par mjal/ mtshur gnas nang du phebs te ngo khro rab 'byam pa la sogs la grub snying gi skor gnang /mtshur phur rten chen 'dzam gling rgyan la sogs pa mjal zhing mchod/ drug pa'i tshes gcig nas bzung ste gnam rtsed ldeng 'dam snying drung lha phu la sogs par gzhan don mdzad/ yor dgon du kun mkhyen chen po'i mchod rten la mchod pa mdzad/ hor zla bdun par stag lung rin po che las chos du ma gsan zhing chos rje sku mched bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i las slob mdzad cing chos du ma gnang / de'i tshe thog bab kyang gang la'ang ma gnod/ chos dang zang zing gis phan tshun mnyes/slar 'bam rom/ glang ling— la/ g.yug sna rtse sogs byang ris du mar gzhan don mdzad/ skyi chu'i chu mgo smṛ ti chu brgyud nas bya zhu la brgal/ nyang long brag gsum sogs nyang kha brgyud thams cad du bkur stis mchod/ dzo gdan dgon par bla ma bskos/ stag lo gsar nas gun tshang du bzhugs pa na dpal phag mo gru pa dngos su byon te thugs gar thim pa'i mod la thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs/ gsa' phur zho kha'i 'phen chen gzigs/ rnam thos kyi ri bor rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du mjal/ rten gsum khyad nor rnams zhib par gzigs mo gnang / dga' ldan ma mor phebs te lha chen gyi gzungs bzhugs legs par mdzad/ de'i ring nye ba'i sras brgyad kyi ldem sku shin du legs pa rnams bzhengs/ ri mo shing rtsi rnams mdzad/ de skabs su byar dwags kyi bar du phebs par gsol ba btab ste bya skur gyi khon zhi bar mdzad/ kun spangs chen pos thugs rtsol mdzad de gtsug lag khang spen bad kyi bar grub/ phrag grum 1136

tshal du rnam sras kyis dar dpyangs phyag du gtad pa bzung bas rnam sras steng phyogs su gshegs pas zhing khams mtha' yas pa zhig du slebs pa na 'di dga' ldan yin gsung ba'i mod la lha gnas 'og mas gong ma mi mthong bar gsungs pas 'di ji lta bu snyam pa na byams pa'i pho brang gi khang brtsegs sprin ltar mtho ba 'od zer 'bar ba tsam las ma gzigs pas sang yos lo la kong smad dang spo bor byon/ dgon gnas la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mtha' yas/ phu lung dgon dang nye bar mnal lam du 'bri khung thel ji lta bar gzigs/ chu nyi ma'i dpal mkha' spyod pa gshegs pa'i sar mchod rten mdzad de dge ba'i rgyun sbyar/ slar kong por phebs/ rnam thos tshal du kurma 'phrin las pa sogs la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang sogs gnang / gtsug lag khang phyi nang legs par grub cing dga' ldan ma mor phebs nas zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas 'chi bdag 'joms pa la brten nas rab gnas bcu bzhi la lta gon dang bco lnga la dngos gzhi mdzad cing sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa rgyun chags dang las kyi 'khor lo 'di'i dge ba rgya cher bsngo ba'i smon lam mdzad/ slar dga' ston chen mo'i phyag nas 'thor ba'i gral dbur rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ kur srid kyi bla dpon mi sna rnams dang skye bo stong phrag mang po lhags shing bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin bkra shis gnang / skya ser khri phrag tu longs pa la 'gyed ston rgya cher mdzad/ zla ba gcig tsam du dgyes ston rgyun ma chad cing 'dus pa kun la 'thab rtsod sogs gtan med pa'i ya mtshan byung / zla ba bcu gnyis pa la rtse lha sgang du phebs te 'brug lo gsar ba'i lo gsar chen po'i gzigs mo mdzad/ bka' lung mtha' dag sgrub pa ma nus pa la tshig gi sbyang ba 'bul ba dang thel gyi go sa 'di byed dgos pa 'char ba nas yang yang mjal ba'ang dka' bar 'dug pas phyag 'bul gyi myo/tha' ma yin 1137

pa'i tshul zhus te slar dga' ldan ma mor phebs/ bka' bsgo gnang bar 'os pa rnams mdzad de dung dkar brag dang dwags po dang 'ol kha brgyud de gdan sa thel du phebs/ gzims mal gser sku'i rab gnas mdzad/ bla yel chen mor 'dus pa rgya mtsho la sku 'khyos gnang thog dpon sa gdung rgyud kyis 'bul chen mdzad de de nyin nas gdan sar phebs/ sngon kun du rgyu'i spyod pas 'jug go zhes pa'ang gdan sar car bzhugs mi 'char bar sgar pa'i tshul gyis phyogs du mar 'byon pa la dgongs par snang / lugs gnyis kyi mi chen thams cad kyis gdan sar phebs pa la legs so'i 'bul ba rim par phul/ chu bar gyi ri thebs rdzangs/ yar rgyab tu phebs te dpal 'byor rab brtan gyi shis brjod mdzad/ yar stod tu sa skyong mi 'gyur dbang po'i sde gshegs pa'i gral dbur spyan drangs/ sa skyong rnam rgyal 'od kyis gus par mchod cing chos kyi bka' drin bstsal/ chos lung tshogs pa dpon slob rnams la gsung chos ci rigs pa gnang /sku rten gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rtses dang gi 'dus pa dang tshogs sde gsum sogs la mang skol dang gser 'gyed mdzad/ dpon chen kun dga' rin chen dbang gi rgyal po rab tu phyung ste e waṃ thams cad mkhyen par grags/ de'i tshe stag lung rin po che mya ngan las 'das pas chos rje sku mched sogs kyis spyan drangs te 'on dang 'phan yul nas brgyud de byon/ lam na gnas pa'i bla dpon —dang nā lan+d+ra dang ri bo dge ldan sogs kyi chos sde'i dpon slob thams cad kyis 'dud cing ci 'byor gyis mchod pa dang chos kyi bka' drin zhus/ stag lung thang du phebs te sku gdung rin po che la mchod pa mdzad cing dgyes rdor gyi sgo nas gdung mchod mdzad/ skya ser gyi 'dus pa mtha' yas pa la mchod sbyin chen po mdzad pa'i gral gyi thog mar bzhugs te mchod bsngo gnang / phyag nas kyang dgongs rdzogs kyi ched du 'bul 'gyed rlabs chen mdzad/ dngul gdung gi rgyur 1/38

yo byad rlabs chen gnang zhing lugs gnyis kyis chos rje sku mched kyi dbu 'don gnang / der sgom sde nang chen pa sogs dang / bra ti phur tsha sogs mdo smad kyi mjal mi ches mang por slebs te chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/slar lha sar jo bo rin po che la mchod pa mdzad/ sa skyong ngag dbang rnam rgyal rgyal bur bzhugs pas sne 'ur mchod cing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang gnang /gsang ne'u thog tu chos rje rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rnams la chos dang zang zing gi bsdu ba mdzad/ brag khar dpon las spyan drangs shing slar gdan sa chen por chos dang zang zing gi sku 'khyos gnang ste sku mtshams dang thun bar du dus 'khor gyi mngon dkyil dang rnam bshad mdzad/ khang gsar chen mor tshogs pa rnams la mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po'i bshad pa mdzad/ rten gsum rnams la na bza' la sogs pas rgya cher mchod/ me sbrul gyi lo gsar la dpon sas mjal zhing lo de la yar stod smad yar rgyab sogs su 'gro don du ma mdzad cing gdan sa'i 'jag lcil du zangs gser las grub pa'i dbu gdugs/ ston pa'i tshems la dngul gyi za ma tog mkhan po bobhis tā'i zhal ko sogs zhal ko rnams la rin po che dang tsardon gyi bzhugs khang rnams yar rgyab tu bsgrubs te phul/gdan sa nyid du 'gro don du ma dang tsā rir ri thebs brdzangs/ dbu gdugs 'jag spyil gyi sgo la shong thabs ma byung ba na gsol 'debs mdzad pas bde blag tu tshud/ e waX thams cad mkhyen pa'i gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbu mdzad/ sa rta la gnas nang du gser 'bum la zangs gser gyi char khebs phul zhing stag rtser sa skyong rdo rje tshe brtan zhing 'phos pa'i gral dbu dang nang rten 'od dpag med kyi sku 'drar rab gnas mdzad/ rje zha lu lo tsā ba la ming gi mngon brjod sna tshoṭa gsal ba bsgyur bar bka'as gnang ste bsgyur/ yar stod smad du 'gro don mdzad cing ti se dang chu bar du ri thebs gnang zhing mnga' ris skor gsum so 1139

sor bka' shog gnang nga gyi zhabs tog thams cad kyis snga ma las 21sa ba/nas chan ches bla lhag pa byas/ yar rgyab la sogs pa thams cad tu so so'i 'dod pa bzhin chibs kha yang yang du bsgyur te gzhan phan mdzad/ de'i tshe bya gtsang gi dpung chen skyi shod du lhags te gzhis ka snel pa 'jig par nye ba na sne'u pa nyid kyis nan gyis zhus/ stag lung pa dang bol kha bas ngo chen zhus te dgu pa'i tshes brgyad la gdan sa nas bteg ste bkra shis sgang gi na khar phebs/ thugs rje'i rlabs che ba dang rgyal po rnams kyang sngon gyi lugs bzang po ma nyams pa'i skabs yin pas bka' la tshad mar bzung ste ser 'bras kyi sde la gnod pa med cing mchod gzhis kyang so sor gnas/ snel pa'i sa skyong ngag dbang lhun po sku mched la'ang sku skal gyi sa phye ste gzhis ka sne'u rang gi yong sgo'i khung ji lta ba gnang nas gegs skyon med par mdzad/ khyad par du lha sa rnam gnyis la 'tshe ba cung zad kyang med/ tshal gung thang dbus gling la sogs pa gzigs chos 'khor bsam yas sogs nas brgyud de dpon sa khri thog du bskos shing shis brjod mdzad/chos mang du gnang / dpon blon rnams kyis gdan sa yun sring dgos pa'i zhu ba phul/ lho rgyud dbang po de'i tshe gshegs pa la zhal ngo rnams thugs mi ngal ba'i chab shog gnang / yang dben du sku mtshams cha/dzad pa na mtshan ltas rtsub par byung ba phyis gdan sar rtsub 'gyur 'byung ba'i ltas su gzigs/ slar yar rgyab tu dpon sa sku gshegs pa'i gral dbu mdzad cing bde mchog gi sgo nas ngan song sbyangs/ nye gnas chen mo 'das pa'i dge ba rgya chen mdzad/ rje zla 'od gzhon nu'i gdan sa ba sgam po chos rje bsod nams rgya mtsho bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po mdzad/ sa skyong chen po don yod rdo rjes spyan drangs te gtsang la chibs kha bsgyur/ dpal 'byor rab brtan du thu btsun bsod nams 'byung gnas dpal bzang po rab tu phyung / bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos gzhis ka rin spungs 1140

su spyan drangs/ sa skyong khu dbon la rdzogs chen rdo rje zam pa sogs dang chag lo gsum pa dang byams chen mkhan po sogs la rang byung bka' 'bum dang khrid sogs du ma gnang / ba dor rje btsun mar pa yab sras— kyi rten la bkur sti mdzad/ mar pa'i chos khri la bzhugs te brtag gnyis rgyud gsum du bsdus te gsungs/ shangs 'brong khang gi bar du phebs/ sa skyong chen po sogs la sbyor drug gi khrid mdzad/ phyogs de'i skya ser mchog dman kun gyis gus pas bkur zhing tshogs chos gnang / der bla ma chos 'phags ltas bzang po dang bcas nas 'das pa la dge ba rgya cher mdzad/ slar gtsang po brgal te gser mdog can du paṇa chen rin po ches gzhi lan mdzad/ bsam grub rtser bsu ba'i bkod pas phebs cing dpon blon la dus 'khor rgyud phyi dang sangs rgyas dbyangs kyi sbyor drug la sogs pa gsungs/ bkra shis lhun po'i dge 'dun la tshogs chos dang khyad par de'i 'dren pa paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud sogs dang rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi 'dren pa kong ston dbang phyug grub pa la o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung bshad sogs bstsal/ snar thang gnas rnying dga'ab gdong sogs kyi chos dpon thams cad kyis gus pas btud/ zha lu gdan sa pa rig 'dzin rgyal po sogs khyu lu sde dgon gyis gus par bskur/ sku cung zad bsnyun pa sgrol dkar la gsol ba btab pa dang sku rim gyis dwangs/ dpal bsnams skor du spyan drangs te mchod/ lam na gnas pa'i skye bo mchog dman rnams kyis so so'i 'byor pa bzhin mchod de slar rin spungs su phebs/ byams chos lung gi dpon slob thams cad la gsung chos rgya cher gnang / bde ldan rdzong gi dben gnas gsar pa la rab gnas mdzad/ rtse shar nub la stod sto byang rnams so sos ja 'dren phul/ sa skyong chen pos gzhis ga thems cad du 'bu' zhabs rgya che zhing khyad par rin spungs su mthong thos kyi skye bo ha las 1141

pa'i 'bul chen byas/ slar dbus la chibs kha bsgyur/ yar sring du ya 'brog dpon gyis 'bul zhabs cher mdzad/ byang thang nas chu shul lhun po rtser byon/gdan sa'i khur ring du gnang dgos par nan gyis zhus pa la zhal gyis bzhes/skyi stod smad du phebs/ lha sar mchod pa dang po ta la'i khang gsar gyi rab gnas mdzad/ gsang phu gung thang dga' skyor zul gsum 'bras ser la sogs bshad gra rnams kyi chos smra ba rnams dang sgo yab la sogs sgrub gra'i bla ma thams cad kyis mjal zhing so so'i 'dod chos zhus/ mon dang kong po'i 'bul skyel rnams lhags/ 'bri khung gi gdan sa pa rje 'jig rten mgon po dngos 'byon par lung bstan pa'i rje kun dga' rin chen ched du mjal ba'i phyir lha sar phebs pa dang khyams khra chen mor mjal/ dbang rgyud man ngag mtha' yas pas thugs tshim par mdzad/ sa skyong chen pos 'bri gdan gyi rin po che rnam gnyis la mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas/ slar 'on phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur/ smon mkhar du mchod yon mjal/ gdan sar phebs te sku 'khyos gnang / gnas nang dang dga' ldan ma mor gdan sa gsar du bskos/ rtser phebs te chos du ma gnang /lam du yar rgyab nas mchod cing sa skyong chen pos byang thang nas mdun bsus te jo mo kha rag gi 'dabs stag rtse rdzong du zla ba dgu pa'i stong la phebs/ kha rag gi gnas gzigs/ sa skyong mchod yon la dus 'khor gyi dbang gong ma mdzad/ zla ba de'i nyer gsum nas lo mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam par mdzad/thun bar du chos drug lung sbyor chen mo mdzad/ lcags bya gsar nas mā ya'i sgrub thabs son mdzad/ mnal ltas la spos kyi glang po che gangs ri lta bu la chibs nas 'byon pa dang / 'brug ring zhing che ba du ba 'khyil ba lta bu sngo nag la chibs te nub nas nub byang du song ba na de'i mgo bo sprin gyi dbus su zhugs shing 'brug sgra drag po yun ring du grag pa'i ltas gzigs pa bde chen ya ngas pa 1142

can gyi chos sde'i ltas su dgongs/ dbyar g.yul rgyal gyi rdzong du bzhugs gnas spos te sku mtshams thun bar du gdan bzhi'i dkyil chog dang 'dus pa'i skyed rim rnam bshad sogs mang du mdzad/ jo mo kha rag gis bar chad sel ba dang — 'phrin las sgrub par gzigs/ rgyal ba'i mchod rten rin po che'i rang bzhin 'od 'bar ba mnal lam du gzigs pas rten 'brel du rnam rgyal mchod rten mdzad/sku mtshams nang ma grol nas sbyin bdag chen po mchod yon sogs la dus 'khor gyi dbang rdzogs sogs dang byang chub sems sdom gnang / dgu pa'i nyer drug la bteg ste chu bo ri nas lhun po rtser mchod yon lhan cig pas phebs/ mi dbang chen po la phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi dbang sogs dang byams chen gdan sa pa la chos drug sogs gnang / mdo khams rgya ston pa sogs mang du 'dus pa la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa mdzad/ sa skyong chen pos khyad nor mang du phul/ srin po rir bde mchog rang byung la mchod cing smon lam mdzad/ byang kha'i gzhung brgyud sbrags mdar yar rgyab nas thu btsun sku mched kyis bsnyen bkur/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug la thel du phebs/ sku 'khyos kyi mchod sbyin mdzad/thar mar 'od dpag med kyi sku rgyab mtho bco brgyad pa zangs gser las bzheng du bcug de'i tshe nag po chen pos 'dud ba'i mnal ltas shar/ chu khyi zla ba dang po'i nag po'i tshes bcu la thel gyi mkhan slob sogs du ma la bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gnang zhing sgrub mchod kyi rgyun mdzad/ rten chen thel du spyan drangs te gzungs bzhugs grub nas bzhi pa'i yar tshes la rab gnas mdzad/ dga' ston yon rdzongs sogs thel phyi sngar srol bzhin gnang / chu bar du ri thebs brdzangs/ rtse dang 'phyong rgyas su phebs te skyed mos tshal du sku mtshams mdzad/ti ser ri thebs gnang / dpal ri'i lha babs mchod rten grub pa la rab gnas mdzad/ lhan po sgang du phebs te lha rigs chen pos mchod/ g.yam bzang 1143

spyan snga sogs kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po mdzad/ slar srong btsan du phebs te sbyin bdag chen po rnams la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rdzogs par mdzad/ 'phags sde la mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang mdzad de chos skyong du 'dzin par gyur/ slar sne gdong dang brag khar mchod yon mjal zhing rdor dbyings kyi dbang sogs gnang / slar thel du phebs nas chos dbang du ma gnang / dpon sas rgyal bzang gi bar skyel thung mdzad de skyi shod la thegs/'phan yul rgyal gyi phu nas sa skyong chen pos stod lung bde chen lha 'bangs su phul ba der phebs/ zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin sa skyong chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i skye bo mtha' yas pas bsus te ar byang chub ye shes kyi chos gzhi gnam rtseng lding du phebs/ rje kurma pa gzhur gdan chags pa dang dus mtshungs pas mjal bar mdzad cing sbyin bdag chen pos mtshams sbyar yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sku chags dang gdul bya rnams skal ba dman pas zhal mjal ma grub/dpon slob gnyis dgongs pa dbyer mi phyed kyang cung zad mi mdzes pa'i skye bo'i ya kha bag tsam byung / zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gnyis nas sa skyong chen po la 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang brgya rtsa gnang zhing de'i tshes drug la tshal pa bka' 'gyur shin tu dag pa gsung rab zhus dag gi ma'i thes su bzhengs pa de sogs dngos spyad du ma dang / 'thus btsun nyis brgya de'i phogs thes kyi mchod gzhis rnams phul te gsar pa rnams dge bsnyen du bcug bcu pa'i tshes lnga la bteg ste snying drung sogs brgyud nas stag lung thang du phebs/ chos rje sku mched la rdor dbyings kyi dbang sogs chos bka' du ma gnang zhing tshogs pa thams cad chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ 'bri khung du spyan drangs te lam du 'gro don mdzad bzhin pas ja ldang phug tu chos kyi rje thog kha ba dpon slob kyis sdun bsus te mtshe'u kha'i gzims khang chen por phebs/ mkhar thog dpon blon gyis 'bul 1144

zhabs mdzad/ chos rje khu dbon la 'bul nod tshogs su mang skol 'gyed chas gnang / bcu gcig pa'i tshes bzhi la thel du phebs te mchod pa dang skyob pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs bla ma rnams la dbang chos du ma gnang / chos rje rin po che khu dbon la tshe dbang brgya rtsa dang dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs kyis bzhed pa bkang / chu phag gi lo gsar nas dang po'i nyer brgyad la bteg chos rjes reb tsha khar skyel thung mdzad/ byang gi sa ci rigs par byon te nyi khri la sogs par gzhan don mdzad/ 'dam gzhung rnams su phebs yor dgon du sku 'bum la mchod pa mdzad/ dam can pas gsu ba dang rgyan dgos tshul ston par gzigs/ rtseng ldeng du byon te mthun rkyen rnams sa skyong chen pos rtag par sbyar ste dgon sa brtags pa na lha brgyad kyi gangs kyi ra ba'i dbus ri bo 'brang rgyas zhes bya ba gnyan chen thang lha'i shar phyogs bde chen gyi ri bo nyid 'thad par gzigs te gsum pa'i bcu gsum nas sa slong ba'i cho ga nyin gsum mdzad pa'i gsum pa'i tho rengs mnal ltas dge ba gzigs nas de'i nyer bzhi gza' skar bzang ba la dus 'khor thugs dkyil dang 'brel bar sto 'phye brtag pa sogs sa chog bkra shis dang bcas pa mdzad/ dgung lo nga gcig pa chu mo phag lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po la gtsug lag khang bla brang dang bcas pa ka ba bdun bcu don drug gi sa yul bla yol chen mo skor lam gra khang brgya dang go bdun rnams kyi rmang bting / nyer gsum la dkon mchog mchod pa rgya chen dang lha sa bsam yas sogs la'ang mchod pa 'bul mi gnang ste gegs med du 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad/ sa skyong chen pos bsgos te gtsang dbus khams 'brog gi las mi mtha' yas pas brtsigs/ zla ba dgu pa yan gyi gtsug lag khang 'og thog skor khang nyis thog khang phran rnams phal cher grub/ dgu pa'i nyer gsum la 'du khang zhal sro'i 'bul 1145

zhabs rngams sa skyong rin chen rgyal mchog gis bsgrubs/ rtse 'bri gdan stag lung sogs thams cad nas legs ja phul/ de dag gi skabs su khrid lung du ma gnang zhing gsar bu rnams rab tu phyung ste dbang chos du ma gnang zhing lag len du ma btsugs/ gnas nang dang chu shul srid pa mkhar dang slar yang gnas nang rnams su bzhugs shing 'gro don mdzad/ shing byi gsar nas bslab btus sogs gsungs/ glo bo chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gangs can dang ti se gcig gam tha dad dris pa'i lan mkhas pa'i rna rgyan mdzad/ skyor lung lum pa la sogs dang bsam yas nas chu bo bsgral te rtser mchod yon mjal/ slar gdan sar phebs te chos kyi 'phrin las dang phyogs kyi 'bul skyel ba rnams la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pa mdzad/ yang dgon pho brang gi rten gsar bzhengs rnams la shis brjod mdzad de byams pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho drug pa bzheng bar bka' gnang ste phyis grub pa na rab tu gnas pa mdzad de mon chos sde'i rten gtsor gnang /ti ser ri thebs brdzangs/ bdun pa'i tshes drug la sne gdong rtser dpon sa la 'ja' sa zhu ba dang sprul sku chos dpal ye shes kyi 'phrin las kyi rgyun gyi rta 'bul dang bcas 'dzam gling bdag po hung ji'i drung du gnang / spyir g.yung pa'i dpon drung tshe dbang gis rgyal rtse ba'i steng du dmag bteg pa rgyang ror bub ste btson du shor ba thog mar lho stod pa dgos dgos rgya la'i phyag tu phog pa rgyal rtser btad pa'i nad lan gyis rin spungs pa dpon blon lho stod pa la thugs ma bde bar yod pa las skabs 'dir dpung rnams dkar mo gling khar tshogs te lho stod la 'degs par thag chod pa na sngar gyi sbyin bdag yin pa'i rgyun gyi thugs brtse bas dgongs pa mdzad de dpon g.yog gi zhu 'jags gnang bas gzhis ka nas kyang gsan/ sa sna tsam phul bas chog pa byung ste lho stod pa'i srid brtan pa rje 'di'i bka' drin yin/ rin spungs nas rgyal mkhar ba chos mdzad grags pa 1146

rin chen gyi lag nas spe chung len par mi sna mngags pa phyi dro slebs rgyu'i snga dro mgon skyabs kyi mi sna gnang ba sdun la slebs pas dbang lag byas te spe chung khong rang la 'jags su bcug pas na spe chung ba gnas pa'ang rje 'di'i bka' drin yin no/ /de ltar 'phyong rgyas su bzhugs te 'phrin las chen po du ma mdzad/rtse brag kha thar ma sogs rgyud gdan sar phebs/ de thams cad du rgya ston dbon nam mkha' pa sogs mang po la chos gdams ngag gnang zhing rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mang du bsgrubs/ rtser phebs te dbon sa legs 'tsho rgyal mo btsun mo'i thog mar phebs pa la shis brjod mdzad/ sman khang pa rab tu phyung /yang rgyab tu shing glang gsar nas gzhis ka so so'i zhabs tog dang dbang chos gnang ba sogs du ma mdzad/ sne 'ur phabs/ 'bras spungs gdan sa mkhas btsun pa sogs la dbang chos gnang / gnyis pa'i bcu gcig la sa skyong chen po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon thams cad po ṭa lar phebs/ sgo yab gdan sa pa rin chen brag pa snyug la chos rje rnams la chos du ma gsungs/ slar snang rtse gnas nang smon mkhar brgyud de yangs pa can du phebs/ gtsug lag khang soṭa spen bad kyi bar du grub 'dug pa'i ri mo shing rtsi sogs kyi mgo brtsams/ phyoṭa gyi 'dus pa rnams la gsung chos ci rigs gnang / nad yams cung zad byung ba dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa dang gzhi bdag gi thugs dam bskul bas zhi/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod du ma btsugs/ phyogs thams cad du chos sde'i snyan grags cher byung ba sngon 'brug mgo sprin gseb na sgra sgrog pa'i rten 'brel du snang / sngon dpal mkha' spyod dbang pos 'di dang mi ring ba'i phug tusgrub pa mdzad pas mkha' spyod pho brang du grags shing de nas ma 'ongs pa 'dir kho bo'i gnas 'byung zhes lung bstan phar snang / 'di rnams nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtogs brjod ut+pala'i do shal snga phyir dgung lo nga bzhi'i bar gyi rnam thar 1147

tshigs bcad du mdzad pa las cung zad re bsdus pa yin la/ de nas yangs pa can du rten chen gtso 'khor rnams bzheng ba dang / zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa na rim gyi gser sku sku tshad ma/ mgon khang du gar lugs dang the she pa'i chos skyong gi sku/ steng 'og thams cad du ri mo'i bkod pa khyad par can sman thang pa sman bla don grub yab sras dang mkhyen brtse bas bris/ gtsug lag khang phyi nang thams cad lhan cig tu grub pas grub mgyogs pa dang dngos gtsang ba dang bla gab che ba 'di lta bu sngon ma byung zhes bdag chung ngu'i dus sgrog cing snang / mdun gyi ne thang la gos sku'i tshad kyi ras bkram pa'i steng du sman thang 'jam dbyangs pas gos chen gyi lham gyon/ lag tu sol pir yu ba can bzung bas thub chen gyi sku bris te tshon yig btab nas de ji lta bar gos chen kha dog so so dras nas bsgrigs pa'i gos sku shin tu che ba bsgrubs te rab gnas la sogs pa'i dus su ngo mtshar gyi ltas du ma byung skad/ gos sku chen po 'di lta bu la thig 'debs pa sogs med par hol bris lan gcig las spo lan sogs ma dgos pas gzo bo mkhas pa'i phul du sgrog cing gtso bor rje'i thugs rje yin pa snyam mo/ zhing skyong mi la brlams te dga' ldan gtsang khang gi ka ba nang ma rul yod pas brjeb la phebs dgos par zhus te rta lo la phab ste ka ba'i rmang 'byim gseb tu nub pa'i dbang gis ches rul 'dug pa bcad de 'phrul gyis gso ba mdzad/ de'i tshe mthu stobs chen po'i dpung g.ye bla 'bring du lhags pas thams cad kyis mgon skyabs zhus te zla gcig zhag bcu nas thegs te dmag zhi ba dang sde dpon mang zhig mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas dbugs phyung / dgung lo drug bcu pa sprel lo la bdag gis rab byung gi bka' drin nod pa min/'di tshe rgya nag gi pho nya rnams 'khor te lung ling ji 'bul nod rgya cher byung / sa skyong don yod rdo rje gnam du gshegs/ dus mtha'i cho gas rjes su 1148

bzung / skyi g.yor gyi lam bar rnams su 'gro don mdzad nas gdan sa thel du phebs te 'phrin las chen po du ma mdzad/ slar yang yangs /rwa/ can du byams khang chen mo khyams rung khang dang bcas pa ka ba brgya lhag gi sa ma dzad de byams pa'i sku bzheng par bzhed kyang mnal ltas su sangs rgyas shākya'i dbang po chos 'chad can gzigs pas de lta bu'i gser sku shin tu che ba 'khor dang bcas pa mdzad/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gser las bzheng ba dang thugs dam bstan 'gyur bzheng par mdzad/ mtshan ldan thod pa sprug chung gi mkha' 'gro ma de'i sku skye ba lnga pa rje btsun ma snyan grags bzang mo rab byung dang dge tshul mar bsgrubs shing gsung chos du ma gsan nas rtsa ba'i slob mar gyur/ mkhas pa chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'chi med dpal bzang pos gsung chos mang du gsan/ thugs dad pa thob cing phyag chen rnam bshad kyi thugs rtsom zhus/ 'bri khung dbon phu lung ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad de dge tshul bsgrubs nas gsungs chos ci rigs par gnang nas 'grus khang pa dang dpon slob gnyis kyis 'bri khung gi gdan sar nan gyis bsko ba mdzad/ gdung rgyud sku gzhon pa rab tu phyung ste thel gyi go sar bskos/ rje kurma pa brgyad pa kong por phebs pa la gdan 'dren yang yang du gnang zhing khyad par dpon po chos skyong ba gnang ste khong gis kyang phebs pa'i zhal bzhes ma byung gi bar du ci la thug kyang mi 'gro zhes yun bsrings nas bsdad/ rje kurma pa nyid phebs par spro na'ang sgar pa rnams kyis mi phebs par zhus/ sbrel lo rtse bzhugs dus rje rang gi phyag bris nged rang mjal spro bar yod rung sgar pa rnams kyi dbang ma 'dus pas ma slebs gsung ba pheb pa2 pas chab shog spyi bor gzhag ste nga'i bla ma de'i drung na mi gzhan med na nga la bka' shog nang gtsang ba 'di lta bu phebs shing yod pa yin gsung zhing dbu phyag gis 'phur zhing da ni kho bo bsdad pa la dgos pa mi 'dug /149

shesungs nas de ma thag rtse nas phyag bteg/ dpon sas dgon thang du zhabs skyel mdzad pa na gdan sa thel gyi go sa 'di nga la shin tu gnod par byung gsung zhing lam rnams su'ang myur bas phebs te lha sa jo bo la rin po che'i bzhugs khri phul te yangs pa can du phebs/ rje kurma pa'i drung du kong po stod du mngags kong gi mtshams tsam du mjal bar smon zhes dang dbon po chos skyong ba la'ang log shog gi bka' lung phebs te dgung lo don gnyis pa sprel lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer lnga la dgongs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das shing sku gdung rin po che ni dngul gyi mchod rten rmad du byung ba bsgrubs par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /mdor na rje 'di ni gsan pa rgya che zhing rnam par dag sgrub thabs rnam bshad dkyil chog dri lan la sogs pa'i bstan bcos ches mang ba mdzad pa thams cad kyang tshig don bzang rgyas bsdus 'tshams dpyis phyin gzu bor gnas pas gzhan las phul du byung ba sha stag tu snang la/ de'i dus kyi dbus gtsang dwags kong mnga' ris phyin gyi 'jigs pas mnar ba thams cad kyi mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa'i zhu sa/ bla dpon thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gcig pu par bzhugs la slob ma'ang gtso bo rnam thar gyi zhar la smos shing yangs pa can gyi 'dren ba'i gtso bo ni snar thang mkhan chen shes rab dpal ldan pa dang phyis slob dpon dge 'dun bzang gis mdzad cing slob ma'i gtso bo ni stag lung chos kyi rje rnam rgyal grags pa la sogs pa yin la spyir gsung chos rgya che chung ci rigs zhus pa'i slob mar ma gyur pa ni bod kyi bla dpon tsam la med do/ /rje dus mkhyen gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi gdan sa lnga las khyad par du gsung gi gdan sa gdan sa bar grags pa kharma'i sidhu bkra shis dpal 'byor ni sgar du chos don gnyer 'dus pa thams cad la'ang dbang chos kyis tshim par mdzad/khyad par drung nyid kyi lung bstan la brten/ rje brgyad pa'i sprul sku ngos 'dzin dang zhabs tog pa'i thog 1150

ma mdzad pas gar bstan la phyag rjes che'o/ /spyir yang de'i du rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhag 'ga' zung na zhal mjal re las mi yong zhing gsung chos zhu dka' ba nas rje nyid kyis skal ldan gyi rgyud byin gyis rlob pa tsam mdzad/ chos kyi thob rgya 'dod pa rnams go'i shri sprul sku dang drung si dhu sku mched 'brong bu go'i shri rnams la zhu/ khrid dang rab byung bsnyen rdzogs rnams rdze btsun skya ses mdzad pas rje 'phrin las pa sogs kyi gsan yig na yang lung rnams 'di dag las brgyud pa shas che'o/ /byams chen chos rje sna tshogs rang grol ni rin spungs pa'i zhal ngo'i sku skye gsal bar byung / rje bdun pa nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mchog tu bsnyen/ gsang sngags kyi gdams pa mthar thug par gnang ba'i bu chen gyi mchog tu grags/ byams chen chos sde'i gdan sa mdzad/ thugs dam gyi spangs rtogs mchog tu gyur/ lha sa'i gser thog brnyings pa gsar du brjes nas 'bul ba dang rnying pa de zhig gso mdzad nas thub chen chos 'khor gyi gtsang khang la 'gebs par dgongs kyang bod spyi'i bsod nams dman pas sde bzar gyis ma grub/ de'i chu rnams las gser dngul gyi bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs te rgyud debum rje brgyad pa'i drung du phul/ gzhan rnams gar sde rnams dang gtsang gi dgon che ba rnams la gnang / phyis sku khams cung zad bsnyun pa'i nyin cig shar pha gi nas sprin dkar po cig tshur byung ngam stos gsungs/ snga dro tsam na sprin dkar po mtha' 'ja' tshon gyis bskor ba zhig ri'i rtse nas rgyang byung ste tshur je mgyogs byung / gzims khang gi steng tsam du sleb byung zhus pas nga'i stan mthongs ga'i thad der theg gsungs te sprin de la gzigs shing phyag thal mo sbyar te rje thams cad mkhyen pa kho bo bsu ba la phebs byung / nga ni phyag phyi byas te dag pa mkha' spyod du 'gro gsungs te de nyid du sku mdangs yal gyis song /kurma gra tshang gi gra sgres rab 'byam pa bsod nams rab 'byor rje 'di la gdams 1151

pa zhus te nyams rtogs bzang bar skyes/ 'u yug gi ri khrod cig na sgrub pa la yod pas gsal snang la sku 'das par shes te mtshams thon nas gag tshangs su phyin pa na sku gdung bzhu ba dang thug ste mos gus kyi gsol 'debs drag po byas pas thugs tsheg sgra dang bcas te sreg rdzas 'bul ba'i sgo chung la 'phar te khong gi pang du byung ba la rten ring bsrel ngo mtshar can byung zhes khong nyid las dngos su thos so/ bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal ni gtso bor rje bdun pa'i dngos slob yin la/ spyir rje btsun skya se/ rje 'phrin las pa/ dus zhabs pa rnams bsten zhing mkhas pa chen por gyur/ nor spyad rgya mtsho sogs 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / nang don gyi 'brel pa pod chen bzhi la sogs pa bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ chos 'khor lhun po bskal dus kyis nyams kyang slar pad+ma bkod pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad do/ /rje btsun skya se rtogs ldan ni/ 'khrungs yul byang stag lung ba'i skor gyi skya se ru ba yin/ sngon khyim nang bzhugs dus skya se a mgon zhes ming thos pa tsam gyis mgron po dang ri dwags thams cad 'dar nus pa'i thub tshod dang ar jag gi dpon mdzad/ phyis dgung lo drug bcur nye ba na mgron tshan shig 'joms par brtsams/ de dag gis brgol ba la ral gri bsnun pa rgod ma sbrum ma zhig la phog ste sto ba ral nas rte'u lhung ba la ma des lces ldag par gzigs pas skyo ste kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ de phyin rdor dkar stan gcig them sbangs na bza' chos gos gsum pa'i sbyangs yon mdzad cing thugs dam gyi thil gcod yul la mdzad de gnyan khrod kho na 'grims pas snang srid kyi lha 'dres 'phrin las thams cad bsgrubs/ rje chos grags rgya mtsho las phyag chen chos drug gi thugs dam brnyes/sa skyong don yod rdo rje la sogs dbus gtsang gi mi chen thams cad kyis rtsa ba'i 1152

bla mar bkur/ rtogs ldan 'gal ltag pa zhes rnam dpyod che ba des tshigs bcad kyi skur pa mang du btab kyang phyis zhal mjal ba na/ mi la ras pa ser po zhes ches dad cing snga ma la bshags pa dang bstod pa yang dag pa phul/ sku tshe bya bral gyi brtul zhugs la bskyal/ rje gong ma'i 'phrin las kyi 'phro kong po'i chos rgya dkar po thams cad dpyis phyin par mdzad de phan bde la bkod/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa la mig lta bur gyur te/ sku tshe mthar phyin pa dgung lo dgu bcu la nye bar bzhugs te phyis brag gsum zho khar mya ngan las 'das nas gdung 'bum yang der bzhugs so/ /de la slob ma'i tshogs shin tu mang yang snga bur byon pa'i rtogs ldan kre chen dang kre chung gnyis ni thugs dam shin tu bzang ba byon yang snga mo nas gshegs pas gzhan don dngos su ma bstan/phyi tshar gyi kre chen nam mkha' 'od zer ba ni phyis bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub sde'i bla ma mdzad/ kre chung chos kyi rgya mtsho ni rdor dkar sogs rje btsun skya se'i rnam thar bzhin mdzad/ phag mo nas rin po che sgom pa yab sras rnams dang gzhis ka rin spungs pa sogs kyis gus par bkur/ sgom chen gyi bu slob ni ches mang zhing slob ma'i gtso bo yang rje btsun dam pa zhes mtshan 'don pa'i glo bo chos rje kun dga' sgrol mchog yin zhing 'dis kyang byang stag lung gi chos rje sku mched dang gzhan yang dbus gtsang gi bla ma dang chos sde che gu'i gdan sa pa mdzad do/ /chos rje kre che chung gnyi ga 'khrungs sa kre bo ma yin yang mtshur phur kre bo'i las tshan la bzhugs pas de ltar grags so/ khams su 'khrungs pa bla ma ru pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho ni bcud len gyi sman cung zad ma gtogs zan la sogs pa mi zas rags pa mi gsol/ sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/ sgam po spyan snga bkra shis sgang pa khu dbon rnams kyi bla ma mdzad/ g.ye dwags kyi phyogs la 'phrin las skyong / de'i slob ma'i gtso bo ni byar po rtogs ldan pa ste gcod kyi 1153

thugs dam mthar phyin rtogs pa shin tu mtho/ mngon shes mnga' bar grags/sne gdong rtse dang gdan sa thel nas rlangs lha gzigs kyi zhal ngos spyan ma 'drongs/ 'on kyang blo gtad kyi gnas su byas nas srung mdud zhu sa byed/ de'i slob ma'ang 'phrin las nus pa bla ma smon lam rgya mtsho la sogs pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang nags phu chos 'phel ba sku mched la sogs rje btsun skya se'i bu slob ches mang ngo / /grub chen chu 'phur ba ni sngon rje phag mo gru pa'i slob ma grub thob nyang ras se bo zhes grags pa grub chen kurma paski'i sku'i bkod par zhal gyis bzhes pa de rdzu 'phrul gyis gsang phu ba btul nas rgya gar du mu stegs 'dul du 'byon par dgongs pa na gsang phur rten 'brel log pas slar mdo khams la byon/ drel dkar mo zhig yod pa rma chen pom ra'i 'dabs su shi ba pom ra'i bar chad du mkhyen nas gangs gzigs sa'i phug par bzhugs/ gangs kyi tshal pa cig blangs pa la gangs ri de'i dbyibs byas/ chang zom zhig yod pa nas btsags shing gsol/ chab byung ngo cog gangs de la gsil bas de ji ltar zhu ba bzhin pom ra'i gangs nag zang gis zhu nas de'i shul deng sang yang yod zer/ der pom ras bzod gsol byas/ srog snying phul te bshags par drel brgya dang brgyad 'bul bar byas pa na da res nga la mi dgos/ ma 'ongs ga dgos dus su phul zhig gsungs te gdams ngag du ma dang ma 'ongs lung bstan mang po mdzad de de nyid du gter du sbas/ phyis grub chen par 'khrungs pas sngon gnas gsal bar dran te gter phyung / rma pom ra'i skor du byon pas dre'u dkar mo cig gis sna drangs te dre'u 'bul ba kho na brgya dang bdun du longs/ de nas drel dkar mo cig byung bas da 'dis don grub gsungs nas 'byon pa'i 'phro bcad/ 'di kum po rdo rje dpal brtsegs dang de'i ri yin zhes kyang phyis thos/ spyir rang byung gi thugs dam shar ba yin yang rtsa ba'i bla ma 1154

rje bdun pa la 'dzin/ khams kyi chu chen po cig la nam mkha' la 'phur bar mthong ste chu 'phur bar grags/ rje tsong kha pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing btsun sgrub rgyud la mchog tu mos pas 'bri gdan stag lung pa 'ba' ra ba sog bka' rgyud kyi bla ma du ma la chos phal cher gsan pa yin yang phyis ri khrod shin tu dben pa cig na bka' rgyud kyi sgrub pa po lnga bcur nye ba mtshams 'ba' zhig la gnas pa yod par gsan nas mjal du byon/ dri ba mdzad pas chos kyi go ba cung zad kyang med pa'i lug rdzi ri la bsdad pa lta bu zhig 'dug pas thugs byung ste da ni 'di rigs thams cad 'di 'dra ba yin yod par 'dug dgongs yang shar/ bstan pa la ma bzod pa'i thugs kyang shar bas dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar la sogs pa yang mdzad/ 'bri khung nyer gnyis rin po ches bstan dgongs kyi bshad gra 'dzugs pa'i bla ma rje tsong kha pa bskos/ dbon po sku mched dang a mdo ba dang mnga' ris pa'i gra rgyun thams cad gnang nas ri bo dga' ldan btab/ 'bri khung ba'i gra rgyun thams cad der 'dus/ bstan dgongs sogs thog mar 'chad pa'i tshul dang phyis dgag par yang mdzad/'phrin las shin tu rgyas pas mtshur phu nags phu garma 'bri khung thel gdan sa thel sgam po sogs bka' rgyud kyi gdan sa phal cher chos rgyun 'gyur/ bka' rgyud kyi chos rabs chad par nye ba na grub thob 'dis zang zing gi mchod sbyin/ chos kyi sgrub tshugs dang brtul zhugs sogs rnam pa du mas de thams cad du sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba yin pas bstan pa la bya ba zla ma mchis pa mdzad do/ /spyir sa 'bri'i rtsod gzhi yang 'bri khung dbon rin po che bsod nams grags pa gshegs pa'i dus ti ser 'gro ba'i ri pa tshan gcig sa skyar phyin/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ rin po che 'og min du gshegs sam gshegs ltas ci byung gsungs pas ri pa cig na re/ 'og min ci yin steng min du gshegs mod/ ring bsrel gyi char bab/11du5

phyag rgya chen po'i gser sku khru gang byon zer bas chos rje ba cang mi gsung /sang nyin chos grar ngas khyed 'tshol khas drag gi drin med de kha sang gi kha 'chal de 'dra kha nas mi 'ong tsam 'di nga'i drin yin gsung ba thel pas thos pas thuṭa la ma 'thad/ dpon rdo rje dpal gtsang gi dpon byed dus de'i zhe nad du rje sa paṇa gyi chos gra la rta brgyugs/ zangs mo che la rta chu blud/ spyil bu bshig nas rgya srang bcos/ de lta bu la sa skya pa rnams thugs la ma ran/ phyis 'phags pa rin po che thugs shin tu bzang bas thams cad la phan bde 'ba' zhig dgongs pas byed thabs ma byung yang sku gshegs su bcug ste de 'phral nas sa 'bri'i rtsod chen byung bar deb dmar na bris snang ba 'di gnyis kyi gleng gzhi'i thog ma dbyibs 'dra bar snang zhing 'di tsam gyi g.yos thub pa ni gzhan la mi 'byung bas/ sngon dge sbyong sbed kyis dge slong bsad pa la bdud sdig can gyis legs so byin pas mngon pa'i nga rgyal skyes pa dang / 'phags skyes pos ser skya bskor tshe sdig can gyis shākya rgan por sprul te tshul shing blangs par bshad pa lta bu/'dir yang rje sa paṇa gyi drung gi ri pa de dang rje tsong kha pas gzigs pa'i sgom chen de ni nges par bstan pa la sel 'di lta bu skyed pa las na bdud sdig can dngos so zhes kho bo 'ba' zhig sems la/ spyir mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang mi gcig blun por mthong ba'i rtags kyis mi thams cad blun por sgrub pa 'di lta bu ni cis kyang mi mdzad par zhu ste tshad ma'i rtags kyi rnam gzhag la thugs bsam thong zhig grub chen pas phyung ba'i gter yig rnams na yang rje bdun pa man gyi lung bstan ches gsal ba du ma yod par snang / gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal ba ni rje bdun pa las chos gdams ngag thams cad gsan te mkhas grub chen por bzhugs/ rab sgang gi mkhas pa mi lnga'i nang nas byams gsar ba chen po'i sngon gnas gsal bar dran te yid ches pa'i nges pa du ma bskyed/ rab sgang gi 1156

sde rnams sde 'khrug tu gyur nas chos 'khor yun ring du chag sde rnams kyang nyams pa'i dus rje 'dis 'khrug rtsod thams cad bsdums/ dge 'dun gyi bca' ba gzhi nas mdzad/ chos 'khor gyi sngar srol bsos ste rab sgang du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gzhi bzheng du btang / khyad par byams gsar la bstan pa'i bya ba cher mdzad/ rab sgang gi dge bshes thams cad dam pa'i chos kyis btul/ spyir mdo smad kyi skye bo thams cad dad pa la bkod cing shin tu ho'i rgyal po dang dar rtse mdo'i mi chen sogs rgya'i blon chen mang po dang rgyal bu du mas mchod/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis kyang / sngon tshe gtsang ma'i zas kyi rim gro pa/ paṇa chen dbang phyug rgya mtsho de yang khyod/ ces sogs kyi sngon gnas du ma lung bstan yang mdzad/ mdo khams kyi bla ma cig la 'phrin las che/ sku tshe mtha' phyin par 'gro don mdzad cing dbon po sku mched la sogs pas 'phrin las kyi rgyan skyong ngo / /zur mang bya bral ba ni zur mang gi gdan sa las kun spangs bya btang gi brtul zhugs mdzad de sgrub pa mthar phyin gzhan phan shin tu che'o/ /rgya ston bya bral ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ni rgya ston chos rje'i sku skyer rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis bka' bstsal/ rgya ston pa'i gdan sa las kun spangs mdzad de grub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyi thog ma'i zhabs 'degs pa'i gtso bo mdzad de zhabs tog shin tu che'o/ /gsi dkar kun spangs pa ni gdan sa 'og ma'i skor du dbang khrid kyi 'gro don che'o/ /bla ma grags rgyal ba ni rong po'i sar 'khrungs/ bkra shis ljongs kyi rdor 'dzin mdzad/sgar chen bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du rtag par gzigs/ yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa la drung gong ma'i slob ma'i nang na chos rje ngo khro dang 'di gnyis mang zhes rje bdun pa gsung skad/ sngags kyi nus pa mtha' yas/ sog steng dang tshil dgon pa btab ste 'phrin las che'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan ni spyir kong ston zhig gi sras su skyi shod du 'khrungs/ gsang phur gsan sbyong mdzad /1du7

—de dgung lo bcu gsum bcu bzhi nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge bshes tshad ldan du gyur te chen po mdzad/ dus der gsang ne'u thog tsam dang bod yul tsam na mkhas par gzur gnas rnams gleng zhing bstan bcos brtsams pa 'bras bu'i rtags las kyang shes/ g.yas ru gser mdog can gyi chos gra chen po btab ste 'phrin las mtha' yas/ phyis rje bdun pa dang mjal te gdams ngag gsan/ thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs te rje 'di rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin la/bka' rgyud rin po che 'di ni gang las phyag chen gyi rtogs pa skyes pa de kho na rtsa ba'i dpon slob tu 'jog pa ste dpal phag mo gru pa chos gsan pa gzhan du mang yang sems kyi sgro 'dogs rje dwags pos bcad pas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa lta bu de'i phyir rtsa ba'i slob mar bgrangs so/ /mi nyag rab 'byams pa mgon po dpal ni mi nyag gi sar 'khrungs/ chung ngu na rje bdun pa'i zhabs la bsnyen pa na dbus gtsang du song la 'bras yul rdzong dkar du slob gnyer gyis la shog gsungs pa bzhin byon/ kun mkhyen byams chen rab 'byam pa la bsten te mkhas par sbyangs/ phyis rje'i bka'as garma gra tshang btsugs pa sngon ma bar chad kyis cung zad 'thor na'ang btsun chung bdun tsam zhig lus pa kho na la nyid kyis dbu mdzad chos khrims bla ma gsum ga'i go mdzad de dka' ba mdzad pas ring po ma lon par blo gsal gyi dge 'dun mang du 'phel/ skyed tshal gyi chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa dang dpon slob thugs shin tu bcugs pas mkhan chen g.yag pa'i chos gra na skyed tshal 'dzugs dus kyi gaṇ+ḍi yin pa cig bca' yig chung ba/ ya 'brog bka' bcu pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa dang bcas gra tshang tshugs pa'i legs jar gnang / skyed tshal ba smyug la sogs su chos bar la 'byon dus tshogs dang rig lung sre ba'i srol byung / mdor na chos rje mi nyag pa de thugs rgyud bzang / slob ma thams cad la thugs thag pa nas brtse bas cung zad slob gnyer smar ba rnams la'ang gsol ras dang gnang sbyin mdzad/ dpon sa gser 11du8

khang ma sogs sbyin bdag dad 'byor can mang pos zla re zhing yang na bza' cha tshang mang dwa 'bul yang sku la gang 'byar tsam ma gtogs jar bsgyur nas dge 'dun gyi mang ja 'ba' zhig mdzad cing gra pa gos med pa la gnang / tren bza' phyi ma yang gos chen gsar rnying bzang ngan gang yin yang de ga nyi char thams cad la gsol ba ma gtogs bzang ngan gyi 'dems kha dang spo len mi mdzad/ gra pa bcu bco lnga tsam nyin re bzhin bskor nas ja gung tshigs ma chag pa re mos kyis gnang / slob gnyer smar ba rnams srod chos kyang zhus chog thor chos la rtag tu phebs/ chos 'don sku rim la yang gral dbu la rtag tu phebs shing spyan btsums nas thugs dam kho na mdzad/ kha char lhags pa nyin mtshan ci byung yang g.yo ba med par bshad nyan kho na mdzad/ sku tshe'i mjug la phar tshad la sogs pa 'di rnams la yig 'jog byas na legs par shes pa 'dug ste sgros mi gcig pa'i chags sdang gi rgyur 'gro bar 'dug pas mi byed gsungs/ bstan pa la bsam pa'i 'chad nyan pa yin na spyod pa de lta bu zhig dgos rgyur snang ngo / /gra pa rnams kyang shin tu gus zhen che bas mtha' bsnyun pa dang sku 'das pa'i dus lhung bzed zla gam gzan lhag po sogs yod do cog mang ja dang sku rjes su btang ste gzan gnyis pa yod pa su yang ma byung ba skad/ rgyal ba'i dbang po lha sar phebs dus ljags la rgya 'dzer gyi bsnyun byung nas gshegs par nye ba'i tshe yang nga'i gra pa rnams snying rje bas nga'i rtsar thong yang ya5 gsungs na'ang sku nyams thag pas ma btang / mthar gra pa rnams snying rje kho bo ni dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs te gshegs/ me tog gi char kha ba ltar bab skad/ dge bshes dka' bcu pa bstan dar zhes gsang phu'i tshogs pas kyang tshad ma la 'gran par mi nus pa'i ston bzang de la sogs pa mkhas pa dang khye thul sku skye sogs gzhan don nus pa mang du byon no/ /ngo khro rab 'byams pa dbang phyug dpal ni rgyal ba'i dbang po sku gzhon dus ngo khro'i yul du phebs pa na zhabs la gtugs/1159

dbus gtsang la song la gser mdog can du slob gnyer gyis la shog gsung bas byon te paṇa chen shā mchog pa bsten te gsung rab mtha' dag bde blag tu khong du chud/ ber nag can la sogs chos skyong dang yi dam rnams rgyun nga ra gzigs/rtag tu 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs/ mtshur phu'i chos 'chad mdzad de nang don gyi 'grel pa sogs bstan bcos kyang du mar mdzad/ slob ma'ang / gzhag bla ma kun dga' dpal dang / g.yam bzang spyan snga bla ma gru bzhi pa dang / bla ma tshe dbang rgya mtsho/ rje blo gros dbang phyug sogs du ma byon no/ /rje smyug la paṇa chen ni dpon sa gser khang ma'i sras smyug la ba'i zhal ngor sa stag la sku bltams/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la tshul bzhin du zhugs te mkhas pa dang btsun pa'i mthar phyin/ mkhan chen rat+na ba/ lo pa spyan snga bsod nams legs mchog la sogs pa bsten te bka' gdams kyi srol dngos 'dzin/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi sku'i skye bar thams cad la grags/ rje dbus smyon pa rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad skabs smyug lar mi gcod mdzad dbu thod rag rug tu chag rdo phung chen pos mi mthong bar mnan yang har gyis bzhengs te rlung ro gcig bsal bas sku lus skyon med du gyur te mgur len zhing mgyogs par byon pa la thugs dad cher 'khrungs te chos mang du gsan zhing rigs drug 'khor lo'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / zhes pa'i bstod pa dang rnam thar yang mdzad/ mtshan ldan zhig mo dang bsod nams legs mchog pa sogs skyes chen mang du bsten te bka' rgyud gdams pa kho na la thugs gzhol zhing rje chos grags rgya mtsho bla ma'i mchog tu 'dzin/ thugs dam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin/ gsung chos zhu mi mang nyung ci yong kyang chos ja 'debs re ma chag par gnang ba dang /chos zhu thams cad la 'tsho ba gnang ba sogs sngon gyi dam bca' yi—na gsung bzhin phyag len du 'debs/ bka' bdams glegs bam lo re la lan re gnang 1160

ba'i dam bca' mdzad/ de dus me tog char nges par 'bab zer zhing bdag cag gis zhus dus thig le bcu drug gi dbang gnang dgongs me tog gi char thog gnyis brtsegs la ma thogs par gzims chung gser khang gi zhal ba thams cad khra chem du song ba bab 'dug zer/ mdor na yul dus de'i bod gangs can gyi dge bshes sgom chen rnal 'byor pa bla ma che chung thams cad kyi 'tshog sa dang dam chos zhu sa gcig pu bar snang ngo / /bka' bdams glegs bam gnang dus jo bo'i sku tha dad pa re la mchod pa sna lnga re bsham/ jo bo'i bstod pa dang / nang gi yan lag bdun pa re 'don/ de bzhin du chos gang gnang de dang mthun pa'i rten bsham pa sogs phyag bzhes ngo mtshar ba snang ngo / /rgyal srid kyi gnang dgos shin tu rgya che na'ang de rnams gzims dpon don grub pa sogs byed 'jug pa ma gtogs sku drung du chos zhu dang bla ma dge bshes ma gtogs pa'i khyim pa la gral yang mi mdzad cing che bzhag chung bor nas chos kyi 'phrin las 'ga' zhig mdzad par mthong la/ khyim pa zham ring du 'khod pa gzims dpon sor 'brang ba sogs kyang gtan khrims lnga pa dang tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen la gnas pa gos dkar po can rgyan spangs pa chos kho na la gzhol ba du ma snang / dgung lo nga brgyad la sku'i bkod pa bsdus te dga' ldan du gshegs/ 'di'i dus stong ra chos rje'i mnal lam du nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin gyi gseb na khang brtsegs khyad par can snang ba nas sa steng gi bar la gser gyi skas gsum btsugs nas dbus ma la spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar 'byon pa yin zer nas lha rnams mchod pa byed cing snang ba na rje smyug la ba dbus ma de la gshegs nas khang bzang gi nang du 'byon par gzigs te rmi lam ngan pas sku rim gnang dgos/ zhes gsol bar snang / shesgo ba spyan snga la sogs slob ma gzhan don nus pa ni bgrang gis mi lang zhing gzims dpon don grub pa ni bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad de phyis 116 1

kun spangs kyi ngang nas thugs dam mthar phyin no/ /rje garma 'phrin las pa phyogs las rnam rgyal ni/ dgyer gyi gdung rigs rgyal chen sku rab pa'i zhal ngo 'brug mda' dge sbyong ba'i sras su me byi la 'khrungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus la thog zur mkhar du bzhugs te sku zhang a bo chos rje la sman dpyad gsan nas mkhas par gyur/ sde bzar gyi dbang gis gnyal phyogal su phebs te bstan pa la rab tu byung nas gsan bsam mang du mdzad/ zur mkhar chos rje'i gcen po dwags po paṇa chen don grub rgyal mtshan pa dang lhan du 'bras yul rdzong dkar du byon/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa rnams bsten te sde sgod mtha' dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ rje sangs bsam pa las phyag chen dang chos drug gi thuṭa dam khyad par can 'khrungs/rje btsun rdo rje gdan pa la sogs skyes chen mang du bsten/ chos rgyal lhun por rje chos grags rgya mtsho dang mjal te chos drug gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa 'dzin par khas long zhig gsungs te de ltar zhal gyis bzhes/ rje kurma 'phrin las par mtshan gnang ste chos 'khor lhun po'i khri thog tu bskos/ rdza dmar la sogs par dben pa yang mdzad/ phyis kurma gra tshang gi 'dren pa mdzad de legs bshad gling gi chos sde gsar du btab/ rje na rim brgyad pa'i las kyi slob dpon mdzad cing phar tshad 'dul mngon dbu ma sogs gzhung lugs mtha' dag phul/ byang chub gling du rgyud pa gra tshang btsugs/ garma rabs brgyad kyi gser sku dang kurma bka' 'bum rnams bzheng pa mdzad/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mdzad pa po ti bcu phrag lhag tsam bzhugs/ sngon dgung lo sum bcu tsam gyi dus grub rgyal tshe sgrub kyi thugs dam sku mtshams mdzad pa'i tshe mnal lam du tshe dpag med kyi bris sku de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mang du byung ba la sgra zhig gis 'od zer bdun bcu don gnyis yod zer ba dang / yang 'od zer spro thebs bdun bcu 1/62

don gnyis byas pa yin zer ba yang byung / yang ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo yin zer ba bud med yar rgan dar gyi gos gyon pa zhig gis bum pa cig lag tu bzung nas de'i kha rgyan gyi ku sha mdun du sprugs byung ba'i gseb nas tshe dpag med kyi sku nas tsam mang du byung ste 'di grongs shig zer/ bgrangs pas bdun bcu don gnyis byung / des na tshe tshad bdun bcu don gnyis yin/ spyir bshad du mi stub pa yin na'ang da rgan por song ba dang khyed la bshad pa yin gsungs/tshe dpag med kyi thugs dam thang sku 'di la thugs rtsis shin tu che/ rje mi bskyod zhabs la tshe dbang brgya rtsa phul ba'i rjes chog gi tshe'ang de'i dbu rgyan la nas 'bru lnga tsam dang bum pa la gsum tsam sogs me tog mang du zug pa thog mar rje'i drung gis gzigs shing de nas thams cad kyis mthong zhes dpon slob dzu ma gsung / thang sku khru tshad tsam pa ri mo legs po min tsam grub rgyal ma bzhengs sku zhig yod/ dgung lo re bzhi pa tsam gyi dus sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad khab kyis btsabs pa lta bu'i mnyel gzhi dang phyi nang gi ltas rnams kyang 'gyur ba'i tshe sgrol dkar la thugs dam mdzad pas sku khams dwangs/ phal cher zhal gzigs par gdon mi za yang mnal lam la btang ba'i skas mgo zhig gi zhal pa'i logs la sgrol dkar gyi sku mthong gsung ba tsam dang sā tsha 'debs mkhan zhig snang pa'i sku spar nas byung ba de des lag gis phyar ba'i 'od kyis rgya nag gi bar khyab pa la sogs pa byung gsung zhing 'di nas re zhig mya ngan las mi 'da' par zhal gyis bzhes/ rje 'di kong por rje brgyad pa la gsung chos 'bul zhing bzhugs/ bdag dro bo lung na mtshams dam par yod dus rmi lam du bdag dbu rtse dmar po'i mdun na 'dug pa la nam mkha' la ngang pa'i khyu chen po zhig sto nas byang du 'phur song ba'i gseb na cung che ba zhig 'dug ba de je dmar song nas rje 'phrin las pa sku chos bzhes pa seng ge dmar po ral dmar can 1163

zhig la chibs par snang ste bdag gi mdun der seng ge las babs te tshur byon/pha tshad na rje gdan 'dren pa yin zer ba rta sga can khrid pa kha cig snang / bdag gis byin rlabs zhus pa na/ phyag gnyis dbu dang bcas pa bdag gi mgor bzhag ste bu khyod gsol pa gang 'debs pa de dam par ster ro ba/sung ba na rje nyid lo brgya bzhugs par zhus pas zhal gyis bzhes te spyan 'dren pa de dag la song zhig pa'i brda mdzad pas de dag ga shed du song / phyis smyug lor phebs 'phral ltas 'dis brtan bzhugs 'bul mi zhig btang bas smyug la'i ka drug rtser sku mtshams tshe sgrub la bzhugs ma'i bzhugs stan gshom pa dang dus mtshungs pas dam tshig gtsang gsungs nas mnyes/ brtan bzhugs kyi bzhugs stan 'dug go cog thing gsungs nas bting pas brgyad bcu gya bzhi byung zer te phyis gya bzhi la mya ngan las 'das/ rje na rim brgyad pa/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnam gnyis/kurma pa'i gdan sa gong 'og gi rin po che sgam po'i spyan snga sgar pa sku mched/bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal la sogal pa skyes chen mtha' yas pa dang /kun mkhyen rong po'i sku skye gsal bar dran zhing mkhas pa zla med pa mtshur phu'i chos rje nyi ma bkra shis/ pad+ma bkod kyi 'dren pa mdo sngags gnyis la mkhas pa'i slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtsho/ gdan sa zla gcig dang phyis sa tham rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad pa ngo khro mkhyen rab rnam rgyal/ gdan sa pa chos rje shes rab rnam rgyal/ sa tham rgya' po'i bla ma byang chub bshes gnyen la sogs pa rje nyid kyi rtsa slob kyi rab 'byams smra ba brgya phrag tu longs pa dang / 'dra bla ma chos kyi 'od zer la sogs bka' bcu smra ba'i 'phrin las can ches mang po dang / rje nyid kyi dbon po gzims khang 'og ma'i gdan sa pa snga phyi dang / rin chen brag pa'i bla ma na rim/ shangs nas sku rab chos rje/ cham dgon pa dang glang lung pa la sogs ya 'brog gi bla ma phal cher/ do bo ri pa snga phyi rnams/ gre che chung 1164

bo gas sgrub gra'i bla ma ches mang po yang rje 'di la chos mang du gsan pa kho na 'o/ /rje smyug la paḍā chen dang phar slob tshur slob mdzad la chu shul mkhan chen pa dang / gzims dpon kun spangs pa la sogs lugs gnyis kyi yon tan dang ldan pa ches mang ngo / /spyir nā lan+da'i gzims khang 'og mar kun mkhyen bkras rnam pa'i gdan sa'ang mdzad cing 'phrang po ba'i chos rje gser mdog pa dang brag thog chos rje sogs sa skya pa'i dge bshes mang po la lam 'bras ngor rdzong gi lugs tha dad dang glegs bam ma/ dkar ma/ gnyags ma/ smar ma/ pod nag ma/dpe mdzod ma la sogs lam 'bras kyi po ti nyi shu lhag pa'i lung khrid/ rgyu lam gyi dbang sogs gnang zhing sa kur gnyis ga'i bstan pa la bya ba mdzad do/ rje dwags po rab 'byams pa mkhas grub chos rgyal bstan pa ni sgam po'i mdun nyag nyi klung du sa sbrul la sku bltams/ sku chung ngu nas yom dgon du gtsang chen chos rje'i drung du rab byung mdzad/ mtshan chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/chos gdams ngag mang du gsan/ sne'u thang du mtshan nyid gsan/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lori rgyud 'grel bu lugs kyi phyag len la sogs pa ches mkhas par sbyangs shing slar 'bras yul skyed tshal du kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi spyan sngar sde snod mtha' dag la sbyangs/ mdor na rje nyid kyis/ phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor ba'i rtsis la mkhas/ /sku gzugs mchod rten sogs kyi dbyibs dang tshad/ /gzo rig phul du phyin pa gzhan yod min/ /rang gzhan grub pa'i mtha' la tshad ma ste/ /brda sprod pa la sgra yi rig pa shes/ /nang don zab mo'i gnas lugs lta ba'i tshe/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel man ngag bcas/ /ji bzhin shes nas gzhan la ston nus mod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar mkhas pa'i phul du phyin te 'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran zla dang bral/ rtses dang du gra skor la byon dus chu byang ba'i dge bshes pod chen brgyad bcu yod pa zhig dang 'bum rab 'byam pa rin chen 1165

chos dbang ste rnam gsum lhan cig tu byung ba rje 'dis po ti nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bshad pa mdzad pas ches bshad pa bzang zhing dpyis phyin pa dang khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo la phul du phyin pa des rgyu skar gyi nang na zla ba ltar ches lhag par gyur te thams cad kyis ngo mtshar du byas/ dbon sa tshes gnyis rin po ches khyad par du bstod bsngags mdzad cing chos 'chad du bzhugs dgos par nan gyis gsungs kyang bdag gir ma mdzad/ bdag gis kyang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum ga la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa'i nang na rje 'di lta bu gzhan ma mthong / rgyal ba'i dbang po'i zhabs la bsten par mdzad de zab chos mtha' dag bsan zhing thugs dam gyi rtogs pa phul du phyin zhing 'khrul zhig chen por bzhugs/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i sras su dgongs te zhwa ljang gi cod pan dang rje mthong ba don ldan gyi phyag dril sogs gnang / rje 'phrin las pas yar pa'i bla ma gnang bar gsol ba btab pas yer pa'i gdan sar gnang /nang don gyi 'grel pa shin tu ngo mtshar che ba mdzad de rje na rim brgyad pa'ang nang don gyi 'grel pa 'di kho na legs par 'dug gsung / chos gsung ba rnams kyang bka' rgyud rin po che'i dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa kho na gzhan dang phye ste gsal bar ston/ bdag lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus mjal zhing bka' drin shin tu che/ bdag gis thub chen du spyan drangs te chos kyi gsol ba btab nas dbus kyi kur sde rnams kyi bla ma dge bshes phal cher 'dus pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / tshad ma rigs gzhung rgya mtsho'i lung rje 'di ma gtogs pa gzhan la mi bzhugs pas de'i bshad lung sogs gnang / spyir bka' rgyud rin po che dang khyad par rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs ba kho na lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres par 'chad/ dgung lo don drug pa shing spre la kho bo yi dbu zhwa ljang col po'i tshul du zung zhig zhes sku skye ba phyi ma 'byon par zhal 1166

gyis bzhes te mya ngan lam 'das shing sgar chen mi mang gi bla mar bskos pa'i dbang gis sgar gyi dpon che chung thams cad kyi bla mar gyur cing cham dgon pa dang slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtshos grub chen pakhri'i bka' 'bum dang 'dul ba lung zhus te rje 'phrin las pa la phul lo/ /chos rje gsung rab mang thos pa ni dwags po sku rab dgon gsar du rab byung mdzad/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi spyan sngar sde snod la sbyangs te mkhas par gyur/ rje bdun pa rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten te thugs dam gyi spangs rtogs rdzogs/ ser 'bras dge gsum gyi chos rje smon lam dpal dang legs chos pa sogs dang sgros gleng mdzad pas shin tu rgyal ba skad/ stag lung rin po che ngag dbang grags pa la 'bri khung dgongs gcig zhus pas khyed sa skya pa la nga 'bri khung pa'i chos mi 'chad gsungs/ nan gyis zhus pas 'o na dgongs gcig gi grub mtha' 'dzin pa dang lo re la lan re 'chad par khas len dgos gsungs te de'i dam bca' mdzad nas legs par gnang / rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa dang dgongs gcig gcig par mdzad nas lam rim byang chub ljon shing zhes bya ba mdzad/ dgongs gcig rtag tu gsung zhing bka' bstan bcos thams cad kyi po ti brtsigs nas 'di'i nang nas gang 'dems zer na dgongs gcig kho na 'dems zhes thugs rtsis che bar mdzad/ bdag gi bla ma mkhas grub sangs blo ba'i yang chos gsan pa'i bla ma bka' drin che shos shig yin/ bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub sde'i 'dren pa mdzad de 'phrin las che bar byung ngo / /rje btsun bkra shis 'od zer ni mdo khams lcags dul gser gsum las dul mo'i sar 'khrungs/ thog mar dbus gtsang du byon te ri bo dga' ldan pa'i grar sde sdod dang gsang sngags la sbyangs pas shin tu mkhas par gyur/ yul du 'byon par bzhed nas lam du rje bdun pa dang mjal bas zhal gzigs pa tsam 1167
