gyis byin rlabs zhugs/ dad pa rang dbang med pa byung ste yul du 'byon pa'i spros pa bcad nas gdams pa zhus te rtse gcig tu nyams len mdzad pas rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu shar/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan rdzogs te gtso bor ri khrod kho na mdzad/ phyis 'phrin las kyang shin tu che zhing rje brgyad ba'i drung du gdams ngag khyad par ba thams cad phul/ rje btsun bkra shis rnam gnyis zhes sangs rgyas mnyan pa dang bka' drin mtshungs pa tsam du 'dzin par mdzad cing rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku grags pa dpal 'byor la sogs skyes chen du ma dang mdo khams kyi lha sde mi sde'i chen po thams cad kyis bla ma gcig pu par 'dzin zhing bka' rgyud rin po che'i dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa kho na ston par mdzad do/ / sde bdun rab 'byam pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan ni gtsang rting khebs pa'i zhal ngo yin/ gser mdog can du sbyang pa mdzad cing gtso bor tshad ma sde bdun la mkhas pas mtshan der thogs/ paṇa chen gyi thugs rtsom gi par sgrub pa rnams kyi do dam mdzad pas zhabs tog shin tu che/ rje bdun pa'i drung du paṇa chen gyis 'bul mo che mdzad pa'i skabs sde bdun rab 'byam pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi dge bshes bcu gcig ces 'bul yig tu btab nas phul/ garma gra tshang gi 'chad nyan slob dpon mdzad cing slob ma mang du byon/ phyis g.yam bzang gi mkhan po dang bshad gra'i chos ston pa po mdzad de lung rigs 'dzin pa mang du byung ngo / /dus zhabs pa shākya dbang phyug ni ru dgon gsar dang zha lur sbyangs pa mdzad/ sde snod dang khyad par sngags yo ga dang dus 'khor bu lugs la mkhas pas mtshan dus 'khor zhabs par chags/ rje bdun pa las gdams ngag gsan zhing dad thob kyi slob mar gyur/ dwags por gsang sngags gling btab/ rje smyug /168

la paṇa chen gyis kurma gser phreng la g.yung gi rnam thar nyid mdzad chen mo bcugarje de bzhin bshegs pa'i rnam thar mi nyag blo rin pas mdzan pa sogs dang sog dbon pa'i rnam thar brgya rtsa ma chung ngu dang / rje mthong ba don ldan gyi rnam thar hor ston sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa sogs dang / ban sgar ba dang go'i shri ba'i rnam thar gzhan ma rnyed nas rje nyid kyis bstod pa re mdzad de de rnams glegs bam gcig tu mdzad nas lo re zhing nges par lung du mdzad/ rje bdun pa'i rnam thar khyed bsten yun ring thugs rgyus che rnam thar rtsom pa'i 'os khyed la 'dug pas mdzad dgos zhes gsung chos phar gsan tshur gsan mdzad pa'i skabs su bskul bar mdzad nas rje dus zhabs pas brtsams pa'i rnam thar ches legs pa zhig yod cing rje paṇa chen gyis bdag la lung yang bstsal mod kyang ma phyi shin tu dkon par snang ngo / /chos rje do bo ri pa ni ya 'brog mngon dgar rab byung mdzad/ bka' bcu pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu grags/ kham gra tshang gi zur chos pa mdzad/ rje bdun pa la thugs dam gyi rtogs pa brnyes te sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad cing g.yung do bo ri dang byi'u chu mig tu sgrub sde mdzad/ skyid shod dga' ldan pa'i dpon sa chos rjes rtsa ba'i bla mar bskur zhing phyag chen gyi thugs dam bskyed/ chos rje kun spangs pa dang bka' bcu pa dbang phyug dpal sogs sgom khrid kyi 'gro don tshul bzhin du nus pa du ma byung ngo / /rje dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub ni dbus yar lungs kyi stod rgyus sman gyi gnyal ston gzhis gar 'khrungs/ gdung mi nyag yab gong ma kun dga' leṭa pa'i gsol dpon grags rgyal ba yum rdor thog pa'i gdung rigs rgyal mo 'dzom/sku mched gsum las 'bring po rje 'di nyid yin la/ 'khrungs ma thag nas sngon gnas du ma dran/ yum gyi pang du blangs te nas rngod pa na 'bru de thams 1169

cad 'gro ba rigs drug gi bkod par gzigs/ sku skye ba snga ma'i gnas lo ro brag dmar yin pas zhal bye 'phral du nga brag dmar la 'gro gsungs pas yab yum rnams btsan gnod par dogs pa skyes/ chung dus phyag mdzub kyis brus pas rdo rje gzhon nu'i lugs sku chung ngu zhig red/ de nas brtsams te snang ba thams cad 'od lnga'i thig le dang thig phran gyi nang du zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyis gang ba rtag par gzigs/ yum gyi rgol du byung bas bros te se phung la 'chang bas se ba la phyag rjes gsal bar byung / yab kyi sne gdong du gong ma kun dga'alegs pa la phul te gsol ja bar bcug 'khor ba la snying po med par rtag tu mkhyen pas chos bros yang yang mdzad kyang yab yum gyis bkag ste ma thon/ phyis dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i tshe dgun dus cig nyung ja thugs spro mdzad pa'i gral gyi dbus su lcags thab btsugs pa la gsol ja bkol mkhan mdzad pa na rdo khog tu ja mar rgyab pas me dmar lhab kyis 'bar bas thugs dam gyi ngang du lhan song ste skyogs tshags phyag g.yas g.yon gyis bzung bzhin par spyan lta stangs su ha re lus/ ja gnam du song ste thal 'tshub kyis nang gang bas yab kyis shag tu khrid nas bka' bkyon mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis gser ga ma gtogs pa'i sku rgyan rnams bang khebs su dril nas yab kyis rnyed sar sbas/ gser ga bsnams te zangs ri tes po brag dmar na lhun bde rab 'byams pa bzhugs par bros/ mdang gu ru chos dbang dang mjal ba rmis/ khyed la de lta bu'i 'gro don can 'ong zhes mtshan chos dbang lhun grub tu gsol zhing dge tshul du bsgrubs/ spyan snga lugs kyi phyag chen chos drug gi khrid bskyangs pa tsam nas cig char ba'i tshul du rtogs pa shar/ nyin mtshan gyi skyu ma gcig tu 'dres/ lo phyed gnyis tsam nas gsang spyod la 'byon par bzhed de rim gyis byon pa na lha sar phebs ku'i tshe lung pa dang grong sogs kyi rnam pa ci yang med par thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin du song 1170

bablo dbus na thub nga/ gtso 'khor lnga kho na bzhugs par gzigs te thugs nyams 'ur nas thal byung du jo bo'i drung du byon sku la 'jus te gsol 'debs dang smon lam mang po shugs 'byung du gsungs/ de nas brtsams te gnas byin rlabs can du phebs pa na phal cher thugs nyams 'ur ba mang / de nas skyid shod dang byang phyogs sogs kyi gnas rnams su gsang spyod dang bar bar du lcang gling pa gzhon nu blo gros/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ dpal 'chi med grub pa/rje btsun kun dga' bzang mo/ ra lung rgyal dbang chos rje sogs bla ma mang po la chos gsan/ lcang gling chos rje rgyal dbang chos rje lhun bde ba rje 'di gsum la khyed gsum gyis nga'i sku re gyis gsungs pa na gzhan gnyis kyis gser sku re mdzad cing rje 'dis rin po che klu'i 'brim pa las brkos pa'i sku 'dra sor lnga tsam zhig bzhengs pas shin tu mnyes te kho bo 'di 'dra rang zhig yod snyam gsungs nas dbu zhal du 'jibs pa'i byin rlabs can zhig da lta bzhugs/dbon po khyod la 'phrin las chen po 'byung ba 'dug pas slob gnyer zhig gyis gsungs nas 'bras spungs su byon yang las tshan gyi 'khrug pas thugs skyo ste dben pa mdzad par zhus/ mtshur phur gcod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje la gtum mo'i man ngag gsan te ras bud kyi tho rengs ras chu grang la sbangs te gsol nas ja yun re tsam la skam zhing rlangs pa chen po 'byung ba de lta bu gzhan rnams las gsum bzhis mang bar mdzad pas ngo mtshar skyes phyis ras bud mdzad pa na yang rlon ras kyi phyag srol 'di mdzad cing rlung khrid mdzad pa na'ang slob ma rlung 'dzin bcug nas sna sgor bya spu bzhag rlung bsus la dbyug pa bsnun te bya spu ldeg mi ldeg lta ba la sogs pa'i phyag srol yod pa'ang bla ma 'di las byung ngo //kong por 'byon par dgongs pa na stong shong gi zam kha tshur mar mgon po phyag drug pa zhal gzigs te skye ba thams cad du chos skyong zhing 'phrin las sgrub par 1171

zhal gyis bzhes/ zam kha phar mar rdo rje phan mo byon te bu khyod zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu la rtswa chung zangs kyi mtsho brag tu ma slebs na 'di phyi'i rten 'brel 'phyug go gsung bas de nyid nas 'ol kha brgyud/ lam thams cad du 'jigs nyen che yang skyon mi 'byung ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad pa thog tu bab ste mgron pa kun gus/ zangs mtshor phebs nyin 'ja' 'od kha dog sna lnga pa nam mkha' dang sa gzhi la bsu ba'i tshul du byung / mkha' 'gro dang zhing skyong gi bsu bar gzigs/ der rtogs pa mthar phyin rlung srog thur 'dres pa'i grub chen kun bsam pa yang der phebs pas gnyi ga phan tshun du dag pa'i snang ba cher thob/ri chos la sogal pa'i chos du ma gsan/ de'i tshe rje dpa' bo 'di thugs dam gyi gtso bo mkha' 'gro snying thig la mdzad pa'i dbang gis spyir thugs nyams 'ur zhing khyad par du mkha' 'gro mang po thugs rgyud la zhugs pa'i tshul gyis sngon ma grags pa'i rgyud mang po sha ra ra gsung ba dang chos nyan rnams kyi dam tshig nyams chag sel ba dang ma 'ongs pa lung ston pa dang mtsho'i steng la sa gzhi la bya ba ltar 'byon pa dang mtsho nang nas zhing skyong gi chibs rjes dang re ma ti'i sku soṭa bstan zhing slar mtshor bskyal/ phyag rjes zhabs rjes mang du byung ba rnams mtshor bskyur zhing sbas pa sogs dpag med byung bas thams cad ha las te kha cig— gis smyo bar thag bcad/ phal cher gyis dpa' bo zhig yin pa 'dra zhes mtshan dpa' bor chags/ chos rje kun bsam pas dngos nyams rmi lam gyi brtag pa mang du mdzad pas rje 'di dang mjal phyin chad thugs dam la skyed cher byung bas thugs 'ches te bla ma lta bur bskur/ rnam thar bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs ma yang mdzad/ 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar ha las pas sku tshe thung du doṭa zhes/ mkha' 'igro/ri bro ra zangs kyi mtsho brag tu/ /zhing skyong mkha' 'gro yi dam du ma gzigs/ /bden 'dzin zhig pas phyag rjes zhabs rjes bzhag /sprul 117 2

pa'i dpa' bo khyod la gso'/ ba 'debs/ /gsol ba 'debs so zhi nga 'der brtan par bzhugs/ /zhes sogal kyi brtan bzhugs mdzad/ phan tshun mnal lam bzung nas gzigs res mang du mdzad/ gtsang phyogs su gsang spyod la byon te skabs la lar mi gcod dras/ po yang mdzad/ gtsang bsam grub rtser de dag gi skye bos gus par byas pa na gtsang po'i bye gling rtswa shing gis khebs pa zhig na nyin re zhing 'ja' tshon gyi gur dang me tog gi char 'bab cing mtshan bzhin mkha' 'gro dpag med 'du bar gzigs te dris pa na sprang rgan bza' mi zhig 'dug zer te byon pas rtswa lcil nas nye gnas ma bgres mo zhig tshur byung / bla ma la mjal bar zhus pas su la yang mi mjal ba yin zer/ nan gyis zhus pas des bla ma la zhus te drung du byon pa na bgres po gzi brjid can zhig 'dug pa la phyag byas pas khyod la dge sbyor ci 'dra yod gsungs/ nyin ma yengs tsam mtshan ma 'khrul tsam yod zhus pas/ a re sdug lam dang po rang du 'dug gsungs/ bla ma 'dis su la yang gtam cher mi gsung / nyin mtshan med par ngh+ru hūṃ/ zhes dang skabs su sngon po ser po dmar po ljang khu zhes gsung ba zhig 'dug khyod skal ldan du 'dug gsungs nas khong rang gis sangs rgyas stong la dngos su gsan pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i khrid gsungs/ las rgyu 'bras la 'dzem pa gal che/nga yang sngon brtul zhugs che/ mi gcod dang gnyan sa la brtul zhugs mang du byas/ khyad par dom tshang rong du gza' bdud gnas pa'i shug sdong zhig gi rtsar gcod byas pa tshar lhongs gang yang ma byung bas drag gcod byas shug sdong la me brgyab pas gza' bdud kyis thog phab nas 'di bzhin byung ba yin gsungs nas dbu gtsug bstan byung bas dbu thod dbu klad dang bcar+sha pa the bong shong lhag par bug pa har gyis 'dug pa la bdud rtsi byung tshad der bcug nas 'jogathog mde rkan gnyer gyi khrod na nyug ge 'dug 'di la na tsha zug gzer che bar 1173

byung nas rdo rje rnam 'joms la 'don par zhus pas des ma thon/ dpal rta mgrin gyis lan gsum bton pas ma thon/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la zhus pas dbu'i gtsug tor phar yol tshur yol mdzad nas a ra ra nga mgo na sems can gyi las 'di mthu che bar 'dug gsungs/ rje btsun sgrol ma la zhus pas 'di bsal na phyi mar dmyal bar lan gcig skye dgos par 'dug da lta'i 'di dang du blangs na phyi mar nyams su myong mi dgos par 'dug gsungs bas 'o na da lta las bdag gir bgyid par zhus pa yin gsungs/ bskal pa dpag med kyi sngon du da lta'i chos rje rkarma pa dang nga gnyis byang chub tu sems mnyam du bskyed pa yin na'ang khong tshogs gnyis rgya che bas gzhan don rgya chen grub/ kho bo de tsam ma byung ste tshe rabs phyi ma nas gzhan don rgya chen po 'byung gsungs/ la phyi la sogs par byon/ la phyi dang ling ba brag la sogs par rje btsun la byung ba'i cha mthun gyi tshar stongs byung / chu mig dngul 'bum gyi rtsar skyes pa zhig dang bu mo zhig rta 'ol ba bzhon nas byung ba la thugs 'ur te da lta gang dran pa zhig phul —gsungs pas bud med des shel phreng zhig phul byung / thugs 'ur nas chu de la ma thogs par byon pas de gnyis cher dad/ ko ro la thog tu jag pa mi bdun dang mjal ba la mgur gsungs pa sogs rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar dang cha mthun pa kho na byung / slar dbus dang lo ro'i sar byon 'jol snang gi yul gzigs pa'i sa nas thugs nyams 'ur te phebs/ skya snga'i gnas ma gin khang pa khru bo gsum sgyed po btsugs pa ltar yod pa la da gcig las mi 'dug gsung ba la dbon po shākra rgyal ba na re nag tshang khru bo'i rtse phab mchod khang khru bo 'gyel ba yin zer/ 'jol snang gi nang du byon tshe gdung 'bum las bdud rtsi'i chu bab/ 3jol snang gi rgyab 'ong gseb tu phebs nas 'di na mchod rten chung ngu yod pa dran nam gsungs/ yul mi rgan po rnams kyis yod pa dran yang sa 1174

ngamigs ma dran zer bas zhing gi dbus shig tu 'di na yod pa yin rkos dang gsungs/ brkos pas mchod rten gyi rmang dang sā tsha mang du byung bas yul mis der mchod rten byas te skye dran 'bum bar grags/ sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang sprul sku gzhon nu lhun grub kyi sngon gnas mang du gsungs pas sngon gyi gra slob kun yid 'ches skyes te sprul sku rtsod med du grags/ de yang chos rgyal rin chen gling ba'i rnam thar ri bo ba nam mkha' 'od kyis mdzad par lung mang du drangs te chos sku 'od dpag med kyi sprul sku thugs rje chen pos 'dzam gling 'dul ba las rgya gar du rgyal po chen po zhig gi mchod gnas nang pa'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta dang phyi rol rgyang 'phen pa'i ston pa ral pa can gnyi ga'ang 'khor lnga brgya re dang bcas pa yod de rtag tu rtsod pa las phyi rol pa rgyal bar nye ba'i tshe dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas de'i btsun mo'i lhums su thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer zhig zhugs pa las ring po ma lon par khye'u skyes ma thag kha nas sgra tshad kyi gtam smra ba zhig byung / 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs te ngag gi dbang phyug thob/ de lo bdun lon pa na mu stegs kyis da lta nas tshar gcod dgos zer nas rgyal po dang bcas pa'i rtsod pa'i grar khye'u de bos pa na/ khye'us sgra rigs pa'i hūṃ 'dren bya ba shar gyis bton pa la mu stegs kyis skyon bzung ste rtsod pas mu stegs rab tu pham par byas te shes rab zla med pas mtshan shes rab 'byung gnas su thogs/ mu stegs rnams nang par zhugs te 'khor du gyur yang slob dpon med pa'i yon tan la yid mi 'ches zer bas slar dpal chos kyi grags pa dang seng ge bzang po la sogs paṇa grub mtha' yas pa bsten/ slob dpon chen po pad ma 'byung gnas las rdo rje theg pa'i lam mtha' dag gsan te mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ sku tshe ches ring du bzhugs te phyis na ro pa sgo srung phyi ma mdzad pa na 'dis nā leṇ+ḍa nub sgo srung ba mdzad/1175

mdo sngags kyi 'khor gnyis su yod/ mthar so sa gling gi dur khrod du bzhugs tshe nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul dur khrod chen po'i dbus keng rus kyi pho brang chen po nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer byung ste sku la phog pas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i ngo bor gyur te rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs gar thim pas gnyis su mi phyed pa lhan cig skyes pa gcig gi ngo bor gyur/ ci zhig na thugs ka nas yi ge hrīXdamar po'i rnam pas rgyal po chen po zhig gi btsun mo'i lhums su zhugs te zla ba bcus sa bcu bgrod pa'i tshul gyis ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid las rnam pa mi mo mi las 'das pa'i lus can du sku bltams/rab tu 'byung bar gsol te bstan pa la dge slong ma'i dngos por gyur/ mtshan bde skyong bzang mor grags/ gser gling pa dang chos bshes dang jo bo rje dang na ro pa rnams las gdams pa nod/ dge slong ma'i rnam pas nyin mo sde snod kyi chos ston/ mtshan mo grub pa'i gnas thams cad du chogs kyi gtso mo mdzad de rdo rje theg pa ston pas 'gro ba 'dul ba na mu stegs kyi ston pa ka ra zhes bya ba'i zag bcas kyi mngon shes kyis shes te dur khrod 'di'i dbus na sangs rgyas pa'i dge slong ma zhig gis mu stegs kyi bstan pa gzhig par 'dug khyed lang tsho la bab pa gsum song la tshangs spyod dang phrol zhig zer te de dag 'ongs pa na dge slong ma phyag g.yas na gseg shang thogs g.yon na lhung bzed thogs te gar byed pa zhig mthong / des gseg shang btab pas khong rnams kyi pho dbang tshal bar gas pa nas khrug dang byang sems 'dres ba'i rgyun bab pa lhung bzed tu blug nas gsol bas gzi mdangs rgyas te khong rnarmas bros pa phyis bud me da du gyur pas ston pa de khros nas nga rang 'gro zer te zag bcas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis bsnyems pas phyin pa na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dngos su gyur nas khyab 'jug gi steng na gar byed pa mthong bas 'gro ma nus te dug sbrul chen po zhig tu 1176

bskyur te phyin pa na snyan g.yas kyi steng nas phag zhal nag po zhig phyung bas sbrul khyur mid de gsang gnas nas bton pas rdzu 'phrul nyams te sbrul las ldog ma nus/ mu stegs kyi 'khor thams cad nang par btsud/ bstan pa rgyas par mdzad nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas skad cig gis drangs te he ru ma'i thugs gar gnyis su med par bde ba chen por bzhugs te ci zhig na hūX yig gi rnam pas 'phros te rgyal po chen po zhig gi sras bdun gyi thu bor bltams/ rgyal tshab mdzad pa na bdog gu sbyin par btang zhing khyad par glang po che stong gi stobs can glang po che sa 'gul bya ba bram ze slong mo ba la byin pas yab mched 'bangs thams cad kyis bkyon te gnas nas phyung lam du bu smad thams cad byin/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro mas spyan drangs te dur khrod chen po rkang gling gi dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad byon te dbang bskur/ spangs rtogs thams cad yongs su rjogs te rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad/rnal 'byor rol pa'i ye shes zhes bya bar grags/ mthar rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na 'jam dpal bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ste nyid kyi thugs kur phog pas skad cig gis 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur te 'od kyis drangs nas 'jam dpal gyi thugs gar thim ste gnyis su med do/ /ci zhig na thugs ka nas 'od zer mang po 'phros/ gcig r+ghaṃ ga lar song bas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku rang byung bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa zhig byung / gcig bal yul du song bas thugs rje chen po'i sku ma he'i zhos mchod pa zhig byon/ gcig bod yul g.ye chung du thugs rje chen po'i sku sku stod gsal ba zhig byung / gcig bod du song ba la gzigs pas bod ser sprin 'thibs pa lta bur nag mun ne 'dug pa la g.yas kyi ral gri de lan gnyis brgyab pas sto phyogs de dkar wal gyis byung / g.yon gyi ut+pa la de 1177

mtha' zhig du btsugs pas ut+pal bcu gcig tsam la gser dngul sogs kyi rdo rje tha dad pas mtshan pa re byung / 'di la ral gri lan gnyis ni dpal ldan sangs rgyas rong pa dang chos rgyal rin chen gling pa yin la ut+pal bcu gcig po rnam thar las ni chos rgyal rin chen gling pa'i bu chen du bshad kyang sku skye ba phyi ma rnams su mi 'gal lam zhes sems so/ /de nas hrīXyig dkar po'i rnam par spros shing 'gro ba'i don byas nas bod kyi g.yu ru'i rgyud lo ro'i nang du skye ba bzhes nas bla ma zhig gis khyod sngon gyi paṇ+ḍita shes rab 'byung gnas de 'dra zhes mtshan de ltar btags/ steng pa lo tsā ba dang 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon po dang stag lung thang pa la sogs pa yongs 'dzin du ma bsten/ sde sgod dang rgyud sde mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i mthar thug ste sangs rgyas rong ston chen por grags/ 'gro ba'i don cher mdzad/ rgya gar la 'byor par dgongs pa la steng lo'i gsung nas chos bod na yod pa 'di ka yin skye ba phyi ma la don sgom pa la rib cig 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ yul tha dad pa bzhir sku'i bkod pa bzhis 'jol snang sogs gtsug lag khang bzhi dus gcig la btab/ dgung lo drurge bcu rtsa bzhir po ta la nas thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba sku la phog pas 'jam dpal gyi sku'i rnam par gyur pa 'od kyis spyan drangs te thugs rje chen po'i thugs kur thim/ snang ba dag pa mang pos nam mkha' la byon te mi snang bar yal nas chos gos sogs lhung bar mthong / nam zhig na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od zer gyis bskul te hrīXyig dkar po'i rnam par 'phros te lo ro tshe sgro'i nang du yum gyi lhums su zhugs/ mtshan mo zhig sku bltams pa na 'od nyi ma shar ba lta bu byung / mes pos rang gi chos gdams dag thams cad gsungs/ sku chung ngu'i dus mnal lam du 'phags pa klu sgrub byon te chos thams cad rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin no zhes phyag mdzub sbrel/ pha 1178

dam pa byon nas chos thams cad rig pa dri ma med pa yin no zhes nam mkha' la phya ga g.yug gi byon/ slob dpon pad ma byon te chos thams cad gzod nas ye rdzogs lhun grub yin no zhes nam mkha' la mdzub mo btsugs/ jo bo rje byon nas chos thams cad lam gyi rim pa yin no zhes skas la 'dzegs te bzhud/ de la sogs pa sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ chos byed dam khyim byed/ sngags pa byed dam rab byung byed dris pas/ 'khor ba dug gi khyim thab nga mi byed/ /gtan gyi mdun ma dam chos byed pa yin/ /mi chos ma spongs lha chos ma grub pa/ /skye bo chas kyi sngags pa nga mi byed/ /gzhon nu rab byung bslab gsum nor ldan pa/ /bstan pa'i srog shing bshes gnyen byed pa yin/ /sogs gsungs/ chung ngu'i dus nga rong ston pa yin gsungs pas nga ro 'don pa yin zer bar go nas brdegs skad/ lo lnga drug gi dus grog phug cig tu thugs dam la bzhugs pas mas btsal bas ma rnyed/ log byon pa na mas 'thabs pas/nga ni rtogs ldan bla ma'i bu/ /ma la ma skyes rang byung yin/ /mtsho skyes me tog pad+ma'i bcud/ /da lta shi yang skye mi dgos/ /zhes gsungs pas ma la ma skyes na su la skyes zer nas cher 'bar bas bros byon pa na me tog kha dog lnga ka rnyed pa bsnams byon pa mes pos gzigs te dgun sgang chen la 'di 'dra rnyed pa sprul pa'i sku dngos zer nas phyag spyi bor blangs/ chung dus byis pa thams cad bsdus nas gangs srubs kyi tshogs 'khor dang dzāpā sogs mdzad/ chos bshad dbang bskur rtsed mo kho na mdzad pas byis pa'i pha ma rnams kyis khyod kyis nged kyi byis pa rnams mgo bskor bas las ka ma byung / da de ltar byas na brdung zhes sdigs mo byas pas se ba'i mda' gzhu dang 'ur rdo bsnams nas rgan thayos cad la phod btsugs/ byis pa thams cad brdungs/ them pa mi gtsang ba dang srang kha tsher mas bkang bas thams cad kyis babs byas pas rtsub spyod de bzhag dgung lo 1173

bcu gnyib/ man la ma phur la sogs pa'i yab chos thams cad mkhyen/ bla ma rin chen bya bral las rab tu byung ste gnyal skye rir byon nas mdo sngags du ma la thuṭa sbyong mdzad/ brtag gnyis zla ba gsum la mkhas par mkhyen pas thugs rab kyi mchog tu grags/ bla ma gser sgo ba dang bla ma klu phug pa sogs mkhas grub mang du bsten/ rmi lam du lung bstan gyi rigs mang du byung / grogs kyi dbang gis glo bur du lha sar byon pas jo bo bcu gcig zhal gyi gser srung bcol nas bzhugs tshe gtsang la stod ding ri nas yin/ byang sems kun dga' bya ba yin zer ba zhig gis kha byang 'di khyod la mkho bar 'dug zer nas ko ro brag gi gter gyi kha byang phul/ gzigs pas thon nges snyam pa'i spro byung / mkha' 'gros btad rgya bkrol ba'i rtags kyang byung nas zab mo lnga ldan la sogs pa'i gter phyung / gter phyung gi bla ma sgrub pa mdzad pas bla ma sprul sku'i zhal gziṭa/rgya gar gyi ri bo po ta la dang su ka ra tir 'byon dgos pa'i lung bstan 'dug pas rgya gar du byon/ ka ma ta'i rgyal phran zhig gis mchod gnas su bskur te gus par byas/ ka ma rū pa bya ba shing gi rir byon te mu stegs srog gi mchod sbyin byed pa rnams la brtul zhugs mdzad/ dbang phyug gi liṅga dar la dril ba zhig gis thams cad la byin rlabs byed cing 'dug pa phrogs te 'phangs/ dmag thabs kyis bskor yang rlung rtar zhon nas byon pas ma zin/ slar shing thog mkhregs po zhig 'ur rdor bcug nas 'phangs pas thams cad byer nas bros/ chu chen po nyin zhag 'ga' yar 'gro dgos pa la shing rtsa thag gis sbrel ba la gru'i dod byed cing 'dug pa ltar byas pas chu dbus su dum bur 'thor ba na chos dang 'gal na shi khrig ces bden stobs brjod pas chos khug gi thag pas shing bsdus nas byung ba la bsten pas bde bar thar/ nyin lam mang por mi med kyi nags stong gcan gzan gdug pa can gyis gang / shing thams cad dug sbru(sda gyis 1180

'khrigs/ mi ma yin gyi sgra la mtshams pa med pa'i lam bgrod kyang gang la yang nyam mi nga bar btang stoms 'ba' zhig gis bgrod/ ri bo po ta la mtha' chus 'khor ba'i dbus na bye ma'i thang chen po de'i dbus na bye ma'i ri chen po la a ru ra la sogs pa'i shing sna tshogs skyes pa'i rtse na rdo'i lha khang gru bzhi chung ngu zhig na thugs rje chen pa'i rdo sku rang byung khye'u lo brgyad pa tsam dus bzang la sku las bdud rtsi sman gyi zil pa 'dzag pa yin zer ba zhig 'dug der zhag bdun song pa na tu ru ga'i dmag lhags te dkon gnyer de yang rdo sku khur te bros/ sku la rgya tshad kyi bsnyun drag po yang byung / dmag gis kyang slebs te chos khug de rtsa gseb cig la skyur ba ma rnyed 'dug gzhan gser yod zer nas na bza' thams cad dum bur bgos te khyer/ brdeg 'tshog sna tshogs pa byas kyang rmi lam tsam gyi snang ba las ma byung / zhag mang po gsol zas ni med pas nyam thag na'ang zla gnyis tsam na bsnyun yang dwangs sku khams bde bas go le byon pas chu mig gi rtsar slebs te rde'u dang rtsa ba dang 'bras bu dang lo ma cung zad bsten pas sku stobs rgyas/ thugs dam shin tu 'phel te slar zla gcig tsam bzhugs/ de nas lam bgrod dka' ba du ma bgrod de sngon slob dpon pad mas tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i gnas su gar ti zhes bya ba nags tshal bgrod dka' ba'i dbus na 'dzeng dkar dang shel 'dres pa'i pha wang shin tu che ba gur phub ba lta bu'i nang na sgrub phug ngo mtshar can dkyil 'khor mang po rang byung du yod pa der byon pa na paṇ+ḍita dkar po 'khor bu mo gzhon nu yod pa zhig byung ste dbang bzhi brda'i tshul gyis bskur/ 'dir lo gsum sdod zer ba'i brda bstan te song / der lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad pas bla ma yi dam gyi gzigs snang mtha' yas shing bla ma longs sku grub/ de nas lam bgrod dka' zhing 'jigs su rung ba rnams bgrod cing btsal bas pha wang rus sbal nag po zhes bya ba klu bdud 'jigs su rung 1181

ba'i gnas mi ma yin mngon sum du 'gyu ba de rnyed nas bde chen skor gsum gyi gter phyung / gter sgrub mdzad pas bla ma chos kyi sku grub cing dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs/ slar bod du 'byon par dgongs te sngon sbyin bdag byed pa'i rgyal po des bkur sti cher byas/ dzo gi mngon shes can bzang po zhig gis sku mthong ma thag phyag dang bskor ba byas gsol ba 'debs shing 'dug pa de la gter shog rgya yig kho na bris pa'i shog dril thogs shig yod pa rgya gar ba zhig la ster bar gsungs 'dug pa de yin par shes nas byin/ rgyal po des nan gyis bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gsan par bod du byon/ skal ldan gyi slob ma mang du 'dus/ bod yul thams cad du snyan pas khyab/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rgyal po dbang du 'dus pa/ grub thob kyis lam rgya tshugs pa sogs bzang rtags gsungs pa la rje rang byung rdo rjes hor rgyal po dbang du 'dus pa/ grub thob cig gis dwags kong la lam rgya tshugs pas tshang bar mkhyen/ sgom mas bla ma'i gdan sa 'dzin pa la sogs ngan rtags gsungs pa'ang tshang bas chos sgo 'byed pa'i dus la bab par gzigs nas dom tshang shel gyi brag phug tu bde chen skor gsum gyi chos sgo phye bas ngo mtshar mtha' yas byung / spyir skal ldan mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad de chos sku 'od dpag med dang slob dpon pad+ma tha mi dad pa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes dang gnyis su med par zhugs so/ /spyir sku dngos bde ba can du byang sems kyi tshul gyis bzhugs shing sprul pa'i ming can sku'i bkod pa sku gsung thuṭa yon tan phrin las kyi bkod pa lngar 'byung bar gsungs pa'i gcig gis ko ro brag 'dzin par gsungs pa dang / sngon rin chen gling pa sku gzhon dus 'jol snang du byon pas dkon gnyer gyis sgo bkag pas thugs skyo ste/ rang gi gnas la rang gis spyod par mi dbang na/ phyi ma rang gi gnas su skye bar shog ces gro ga la bris te sgo'i ya them gyi bar du bcug de'i rten 'brel gyis 'jol snang du sku skye ba phyi 1182

ma sprul sku gzhon nu lhun grub sngon gyi dbon rgyud du 'khrungs pa ste/ slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros te ltas ngo mtshar du ma dang bcas te 'khrungs/ sku shin tu chung ngu nas mngon mkhyen mgur gsung ba la thogs pa med cing sngon gyi yi ge phyung / phyag zhabs kyi rjes mang / slob dpon pad+ma'i chos gter du ma rnyed/'phrin las ha cang mi che bar gzhon nu la gshegs shing / de'i sku'i skye ba phyi ma sprul sku rgyal mtshan dpal bzang zhes pa'ang sngon gnas ches gsal bas thams cad kyis the tshom chod cing sgrub pa gtso bor mdzad/ spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gzhal bar dka' ba byon yang dgung lo nyer gcig la sku'i bkod pa bsdus par snang la de rnams kyi sngon gnas du ma dran nas gsungs par snang ste de rnams ni sku skye snga ma las 'phros pa'o/ /yul phyogs der bzhugs pa dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i tshe bsnyun shin tu lci ba zhig byung nas/ nad la sman pa mi 'gugs shing /gdon la rim gro mi byed par/ sogs kyi mgur gsungs/ sman dpyad sogs ma mdzad par ro stoms kho nas gzhi med du grol/ blos btang gi slob ma 'ga' zung dang bcas te yul phyogs du mar byon/ spyir rje 'di sngon bya bral gyi brtul zhugs mdzad dus sku'i cha byad ni nges med du mdzad/ res lung stong grog mdo la rtse sogs su'ang zhag mang po bzhugs/ su dang yang gtam mi mdzad/ res 'ga' bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs la bstod pa kho na mdzad cing spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas 'byon pa nyin mtshan sbrel mar mdzad/ res skyo shas dang nges 'byung gi mgur kho na gsung zhing spyan chab 'byung zhing yul gru ma thos pa mang po'i mi chen la sogs pa shi nas ngan song du song ba sogs kyi tshul gsung zhing bar do'i sems can la chos bshad kyi mgur kho na gsung / res rdo rje thag ba'i rgyud kyi tshig sngon ma grags pa dpag med zhal thon mdzad/ res rtoṭa pa'i mgur dpag med bzhengs te slob ma rnams kyang de dag la mos pa byed 1183

pa ma gtogs chos tsam mi gsung / res sus ci phul yang gcan gzan gyi mdun du rtswa bzhag pa ltar 'dor/ res cung zad re la'ang phangs pa ltar mdzad/ res su phrad la ma 'ongs pa lung du ston pa rnams cung thod kyang mi slu de ltar ma nges pa'i spyod pa mdzad/ mngon mkhyen yang thugs nyams 'ur na ma gtogs mi gsung ba'i dam bca' mdzad/ spyir gzhan rgyud hal hol shes pa 'di 'dra kho bo la lo gsum nas yod/ khams kyi rten 'brel las 'byung ba yin pas 'di 'dra la blor mi chud pa mi dgos gsungs/ de ltar dgung lo sum bcu la nye ba'i bar du gsang spyod tshogs spyod chung 'bring dang rig spyod spros bcas spros med dang shin tu spros med de/ spyod pa de thams cad lhan cig tu mdzad/ de phyin phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang tshogs spyod chen po lhan cig tu mdzad de snod ldan gyi slob ma rnams la smin grol gyi lam tshul bzhin du stsol/ skye bo thams cad la'ang mthong thos dran reg gi gzhan don mdzad/ dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma dang khol po dar thod can gyis spyan 'dren par gzigs nas dro bo lung gi phyogs byon/ de'i dus yul de dag na nad yams yod pa la lha mo'i 'khor zhig mi la babs nas 'dir o rgyan gyi sprul pa zhig 'byon/ de nas nad yams chad 'gro zer te chos rje phebs ma thag chad/ zur phug dang khyad par zangs phug tu sku mtshams dam po yun ring pa mdzad pa'i tshe res mtshan ril gyis chos skyong gi bstod pa dang bskul mdzad pa na thams cad kyang zil gyis ldang mi nus pa tsam byung skad/ mon bum thang gzigs par bzhed nas chu khyer gyi bar byon pa na rten 'brel cung ma 'grig gsungs nas phyir phebs/ thugs 'ur nas lam mis thare dka' ba rnams la'ang chibs rgyug mdzad nas sras mkhar du byon/ bu mo chung ngu zhig lam na 'dug pa la lag pas gang zin zhig da lta phul gsungs pas des spen ma zhig bcad nas phul byung bas spen bad cig byed dgos par 'dug ga sungs te rje mar 1184

pa'i sku mkhar rje btsun mi las brtsigs pa sras mkhar dgu thog gi rtser sngar rje mar pa'i dus kyi spen bad ches brnyigs te spen ma'i rnyigs ma ja phag 'dra ba dam dum tsam lus pa de slar legs par bsos shing mchog khang gong 'og tu mchod pa du ma mdzad/ rgyal mkhar ba'i nang so kun bzang pa shin tu dad cing zhabs tog byas/ sras dro bo lung gi gnas chen 'di 'bul bas bzhugs dgos zhus pa na kho bo sa bdag gir mi byed pa yi na gsungs nas ma bzhes/ skyol bya ba'i ri khrod du lhun grub brag ler ming btags gzims spyil mdzad nas bzhugasu/gsung chos smar bar gnang / 'di phyin gra pa mang du yod pa rnams kyang chos lung tshogs pa dang tshogs dge 'dun sgang dang phyis sgar chen du rje btsun skya se'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs zhu bar gtong ste thog ma drung nas shākya bas dbu mdzad pa sogs re re la nyi shu dang bco lnga sogs yod de thams cad bslab tshugs shin tu gtsang / bde mchog lo hi pa dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil dar zhing bsnyen sgrub la 'god/ o rgyan bsnyen sgrub dang chos drug sras mkhar ma soṭa la smar khrid mdzad de skor du lo du ma bzhugs/ slar lho shar rta shul du sku grib kyis bsnyung thim rim yang phal cher rdzogs te gshegs par mkhyen nas rnal 'byor pa grong yul du 'chi ba phangs bas ri logs ya gir skyol gsungs pa na lha bzhi dgon par gdan drangs tshe gzhi bdag tsha lung brag btsan spun bzhis chibs pa'i rmig pa nas 'degs par du mas mthong / der phebs 'phral nas sku khams kyang dwangs pas phyis der ring du bzhugs shing slob ma mang du byung / yugs se tshang bya ba'i gnas su bzhugs/ gra ba mang zhig phug che ba zhig tu mun khang la bzhugs/ gzhan rnams phug so sor mun khang byas/ thams cad kyi bug sgor zhag gnyis gsum la dmigs pa skyel du 'byon/ 'di'i tshe rje chos grags rgya mtsho gnya'/ chos rgyal lhun por phyi ma phebs pa'i skabs yin/ snyan grags kyis bskul 1185

ba'i sto shar nub kyi skye bo mtha' dag kyang mjal du song / de'i tshe mun khang ba rnams mjal bar 'gro 'dod kyi rtog pa drag po byung zhing rgan pa rnams kyis 'byon par zhus pa na/ kho bo rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang 'od gsal gyi ngang du — 'bral ba med pas dngos su mjal ma mjal la ltos pa med/ mjal sgo'ang sngon gyi smon lam zhig gis thugs rjes ni 'dzin par yod/ da res phyin na khyed rang tsho'i dge sbyor ni g.yeng bas 'khyer bar 'dug 'on kyang khyed rnams kyi 'dod pa dang sbyar nas 'gro gsungs te byon/ sgar gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs nyams 'ur/ 'bul chen mdzad pa'i dus su 'bul ba'i dngos po re re la tshigs bcad lhug gi bsngags pa dpag med mdzad smon lam re dang sbrags nas phul/ sku gzi brjed che gsung zla med thugs mos gus dang byin rlabs kyi shug gzhan dang mi 'dra bas khrom thams cad snang ba 'gyur te 'ur ding du song / rje dwags po rab 'byam pa dang thugs 'dre bar byung bas zhu sna sogs mdzad/ khrom chen po la rje thams cad mkhyen pas gsung chos gnang pa na rje dpa' bos rje 'phrin las pa la maṇ+ḍal zhig phul na zhus pas mangs pas mi 'grig gsungs/ sa gzhi spos byugs la mi 'grig rgyu ci yod/ 'grig mi 'grig la phan yon khyad ci yod snyam byung gsungs te bzhengs nas maṇ+ḍal phul bas thams cad dad pas 'ur/ sngon khrom rnams shab shub byed pa la de nyin thams cad zhi gnas thob ba ltar nyan/ mjal nyin nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa shin tu mnyes par mdzad cing ja gral grol khar bla ma dpa' bo cung zad then gsungs nas zhal 'dzum mdzad de khyed kyis nged kyi bka' zhig sgrub dgos gsungs/ de ltar yang yang du gsungs/ gsung chos kyang ci rigs gnang zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ phyis ci zhig na lho dro bo lung 'dir kurma pa'i bstan pa zhig yong ba'i rten 'brel yod na'ang sngar 'grig pa zhig ma byung ba/ da khyed de phyogs la 'phrin las che ba yod 'dug pas 1186

der nged kyi sgrub sde gcig cis kyang 'debs dgos gsungs pas ngaro/ gis ci nus shig 'debs/ de nas phyag nyid du 'bul bas bla ma zhig gcang ba zhu zhes zhus te dro bo lung du byon pas nang so kun bzang ba shin tu mnyes te rje mar pa rang gi thugs rje yin/ sngon phul bas ma bzhes/ da cis kyang go bcad ces thog mar sku mkhar rin po che phul/ sngar mkhar zhol gyi bar chad nas srin zam phra mo la mi rtsal pas thar tsa ma las med nas de rnams legs par bcos/ sku mkhar gyi rtser zhal ba brdung ba na mtshan mo mi ma yin gyis brdung ba ches mang bar byung / mchod yon gnyi gas dro bo lung du sgrub sde'i sa yul gzigs pas nyin mang por thugs thag ma ma chod/ nyin zhig lha mo'i sku 'bag rgya gar ma'i drung du gtor ma zhig mdzad/ thugs 'ur te sku 'bag nas lcag gis brabs te sdug rgan ma khyod kyis bstan pa srung bar khas blangs nas khyod kyi gnas 'di na bstan pa de ci 'dug chos byed mkhan su 'dug gsungs nas cher bkyon/ de'i sang nam nangs ma thag lha mo'i dkon nyer nag tshang gdan sa ba sku drung du 'ongs te gzims khang gsar pa zhig mdzad na mi sde la 'u lag gzan po yong ba 'dug pas nga rang gi dbu rgyan 'di 'bul pa yin/ mi mang la gson dge'i tshab byed zer nas phul te der dbu rgyan bde rgin rtser ming btags te gzims khang mdzad/khong rang dbang ba'i mar pa mkha' ru yang phul/ don la lha mos phul bar byed pa yin/ de'i skor du sgrub sde'i lcil po mang du thebs/ 'on kyang rje dpa' bo 'di lcil po bla gab can byas pa la chos mi 'ong / bung tshang 'dra ba chung rug ge ba re dgos pa yin gsungs pas de ltar yod par snang / sngon mon mo sgrub chen mas rgyags gcig skyong dgos gsung ba sgrubs pas chos zhu thams cad rgyags gcig byed/ tsha dro'i dus thug pa nag tshang nas 'gyed cing rgyags so sor skyel/mtshams pa thams cad kyang nang du thab mi 'dzin/ mtshams pa la bug sgor byon 1187

nas chos gsungs/ skyab 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya phag mo'i sgom bzlas bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas yan lag bdun pa byed/ ku sa liṭi tshogs sog deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing sogs kyis so thar len pa/ spyod 'jug lugs kyi sems bskyed kyis byang sdom/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang bde mchog gi nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par srung gis sngags sdom len pa/ gsol 'debs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi len pa/ phyag chen la mnyam par 'jog pa/ rjes bsngo ba smon lam ste de rnams khrigs su mdzad nas thab ka ba ma gtogs thams cad kyis snga dro phyi dro srod tho rengs te thun bzhir ma chag pa byed/ de yang chig shur tsam ma yin par brel ba med dus snga dro sogs so so 'khyongs pa dang / shin tu brel na yang ja 'debs gnyis kyi yun tsam nges par byed/ 'debs bzhud kyi snga dro thams cad chas zin pa na dge 'dun thams cad bzhengs te ma na ma'i gsol 'debs rgyas pa re mdzad pas thun gyi tshab byed/ dge 'dun thams cad thar thor du mi 'gro bar ma reg tsam la snga ma dang rjes ma ma gtogs thams cad ngag bcad nas dge sbyor las ma yengs par 'gro ba sogs sngon gyi bka' rgyud gong ma'i chos srol shin tu bzang ba bzhin mdzad do/ /dbu rgyan phul nas bla g.ye zin pa na rin chen brag pa'i chos rje bsodi nams rgyal mtshan pa dpon slob kyis der chos khri brtsigs pas rten 'brel la mnyes/ sgrub sde grub nas sras dro lung sgrub sde sogs kyi bkod pa'i thang sku bris 'bul chen dang bcas rje thams cad mkhyen pa gartseng la thegs pa'i yar ris kyi lha sar phebs pa dang mjal/ de rol kyang 'bul ba re la tshigs bcad kyi bsngags pa dang smon lam mdzad cing dad pa'i gdung shugs dang gsol 'debs drag po mdzad pa na khrom thams cad snang ba 'ur/ de yang nyid dang por nyan thos kyi dge tshul yin yang bar du sngags spyod kyi sku cha lugs ma nges pas byis pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang 1188

seng ge lta bu'i spyod pa sogs sna tshotshogs mdzad la phyis rje lhun bde ba las bsnyen rdzogs rnam dag mdzad pa kho na bzhed kyang lhun bde ba sku gshegs pas sku gdung gi drung du dbu skra phul/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan por 'os pa yang ma gzigs nas/ sngon gyi sgrub rten sgrub pa mo de zhabs phyir yod pa'i skabs yin par snang /de'i rgyu mtshan las/ skya se rtogs ldan pa'i gsung nas bla ma dpa' bo de gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob nus pa cig 'dug lar khong rag yang dge ma rag la mnyes drags nas gsung skad/ mkhan chen bde legs pa'i gsung na re/ khrom de'i khrod na mi ngu ba su yang mi 'dug nga las mgo mkhregs pa'i mi med/ tshe 'di la mchi ma gzhan 'ong ma myong ste de'i nyin mchi ma rang dbang med par shor/ bla ma 'di'i phyag phyi la 'gro dgos snyam/ khong dpon slob kyi sgar du phyin pa na btsun ma skra lo can zhig mthong / 'di phyag rgya mar 'dug zer bas mtshan nyid pa'i dbu mdzad yin pas kha zer gyi dogs nas chos ma zhus zhes dngos su gsung ba thos/ sras mkhar dang sgrub sde sogs phul ba na slar khyed rang gis ma bzung na sgar pa'i mi btang bas mi zin gsungs nas slar chos rje nyid la bskos ja gnang /bla ma'i bka' mi gcog pa'i dam bca' mdzad pas zhal gyis bzhes/ sa skyong don yod rdo rje dpon blon gyis kyang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa gnas chen du mchod pa'i yo byad mang du phul/ phebs lam yar 'brog nas ra lug dang gnag phyugs mang du phul ba las sras kyi dkar thog gi rgyun 'di btsugs/ sras mkhar rgyal mtshan zer ba'i gro shul ba gra pa stoms chung zhig gis gzan zhig btsongs pa'i rin gyis sku mkhar la sa dkar gsol bas de phyin srol du chags/ sngar rje zhwa dmar bas mdzad pa'i sgrub sde zangs phug 'dzin mi bla ma dpal ldan bzang po sngon gyi slob ma yin pas chags sdang mi 'byung ba'i phyir thun mong du bsko bar bzhed kyang khong gis mjal du ma 'ongs pas ma grub/ chos rje kun bas ma 1189

pa gshegs pas spyan 'dren drag tu byung ba la nan gyis bzhugs par zhus/ lha mo'i sku 'bag la spyan chab kyi rjes byung / gtor ma'ang phul ma thag brul/thegs par brtsams ma thag kha ba chen po mis mi thar ba bab/ thams cad rmi lam yang rtsub pas bzhugs par zhus pa na/ ltas bzang po nged rang la'ang med kyang bla ma'i dam tshig yin pas 'gro gsungs te dbon po mnga' bdag chos rgyal ba gdan sar bskos/ lam la dka' ba chen po mdzad nas thegs/ sku rjes kyi bya ba mdzad/ dol rdzas por sku tshe'i rten 'brel du sku mtshams shig mdzad pa'ang rkyen gyis grol dgos pa byung / 'brog bde steng du chos rje 4ri khrod ras chen he ru ga'i cha byad can dpon slob mang du byon te 'bul ba cher mdzad/'byon dus khyed༄ rnams kyis ngu ba sogs ma byed/ bkra shis pa'i mgur then/thor tshugs chings la song gsungs kyang thugs 'bral bar ma phod pas thams cad kyis ral pa bshams shing bshums pas da ni rten 'brel mi 'grig par 'dug khyod rang lo gsum gyi bad du gtsang ma gtogs shar phyogs la kha gtad nas ma yong /yong na tshe'i bar chad 'byung gsungs/ de nas da ni rje thams cad mkhyen pa mjal dgos par 'dug gsungs nas sgar chen gtsang nas skyi shod du phebs tshe sku cung zad bsnyun bzhin mjal du byon/ sgar du phebs shar gra pa kun bsags nas/ 'o sgar chen 'di 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang yin/ sgar pa la ci yang yod de dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' na dur khrod yod pa lta bu yin gang la'ang log lta ma byed/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo spyan ras gzigs dngos yin gsol ba thob/ sde pa sgar pa 'di'ang 'khor lo sdom pa'i sprul pa yin/ bsod nams can la sgrur yod pa yin khyed rang rnams 'di gnyis kyis sdug tu mi 'jug gsungs/ byang thang du phyag phyi zin du re ya nga ma zin/ skyi shod rnams su mjal te 'bul nod mang du mdzad/ sang sgar pa thegs ga'i 1190

—rgyab ja'i tshe yur ba'i 'gram na btsugs shing gi phreng ba yod pa'i shing brung dang mi reng ba rtsi rje thams cad mkhyen pa bzhugs/ drung 'khor rnams ci bder 'khod pa na ci zhig na rje dpa' bo bzhengs nas sku mdun nas phyag 'ga' zhig mdzad cung zad bzhugs/ — yang sku'i g.yas phyogs dang g.yon phyogs nas kyang de bzhin mdzad/ ci zhig na rje dwags ram pa'i drung du byon nas/ mdun zhal dang g.yas ༄ zhal g.yon zhal nas gsol ba btab dbang bzhi blangs zin/ da rgyab zhal nas gsol ba btab chog gam zhus gsungs te de skad zhus pas rje thams cad mkhyen pa zhal 'dzum mdzad de nged rang la khong gis ga dong pa bzhi yod par mthong ba e yin par 'dug de ka byas chog gsungs te ljon shing dang sku'i bar 'dom gang tsaca yod nga de'i bar nas gsol 'debs yun ring du mdzad ces rje dwags ram pa gsungs/ de'i nyin snye thang gi mkhar nag thang du sgar phebs te bzhugs/ sgar nas ma tshad du khong dpon slob kyi gzims gur mdzad/ de yang dgung lo zhe dgu pa phag lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig du snang / sku mdun du ja la spyan 'dre na byung / dpon slob rags pa bco lnga tsam zhig byon/ gsol cog gi g.yas zur na mar bzhugs/ spyir rje dpa' bo 'di bla ma'i drung du bzhugs pa na spyan spyan chab phyag thal sbyar dang mi 'bral/ mos gus che ba'i mthar thug pa'i lo rgyus mang du yod/ spyir su la yang dam pa'i chos kyi tshig tsam ma gtogs phal ba'i gtam mi gsung / gar bzhugs kyang sku lus gnad/ spyan rdo rje'i lta stangs/bar rlung gi sbyor ba dang mi 'bral skad/ mchog dman thams cad la gong du bkur zhing bkur sti mdzad/ gsung 'jam zhing zhe sar bcas pas brjod/ de ltar zhi zhing dul yang sus kyang zil gyis mi non/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa kha bye bas rdo rje'i mgur la thogs pa med/ thugs 'ur ba'i dus lkog gyur gyi gnas dang ma 'ongs pa lung du bstan pa rnams bslu ba med/ char 1191

'bebs gcod sogs la spyan lta stangs kyi sbyor bas gang 'dod 'grub/ snying rje chen po tshad med pa mnga'/ yon tan gyi gting mtha' mi dpogs pa yin no zhes pa ni 'phros pa'o/ / de nas ja gral de thon pa dang rje dpa' bo har bzhengs te phyag gsum mdzad nas kho bo nad dam po cig gis zin bdog pas gang bde byas chog pa gnang dgos ces lan gsum zhus pa la rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang de ga chog gsungs/ 'di mya ngan las 'das chog par zhus par snang bas sngon tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus ston pa'i drung du bdag mya ngan las 'das par bgyid do zhes lan gsum zhus pa na/ mya ngan las 'da' bar smra'am 'di ni 'dus byas kyi chos nyid yin na ngas smrar ci yod/ ces gsungs pa lta bur snang ngo / /de ma thag tu bzhengs te gral gyi sked smad tsam na rje rnga ngas blo ba 'di dge 'dun gyi byang 'dren mdzad pa dbu mdzad sangs blo zhes mtshan 'don pa cig bzhugs pa'i phyag nas 'then te thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku myo/dun du khrid de 'di la da lta dro bo lung gi gdan sa bsko pa zhu zhes zhus te de gar phyag nas gnang sbyin gnang/ 'di yang dro bo lung du mnga' bdag chos rgyal ba de'i nyin gshegs par 'dug pas mkhyen pa yin par snang / de ma thag na bza' gos zlam sku phyam dmar ser gnyis sku chos me long ma/ sku gzan/ sku rags sku sham gyi bar du phul/ sku pang du dbu bcug nas smon lam mang du myo4dzad/ nga bla— ma'i drung nas phyir gcer bur mi 'gro gsungs nas sku 'gag sku rags tsam bzhes pas sgar gyi drung skor dang gra pas bskor te yol ba bar la bsko ra ba mdzad/ zhal gyi thad drang po nas thal mo sbyar te zhal la spyan 'bru tshugs su gzigs nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa khyed kyis nga la spyan yun ring po cig gzigs shig zer ba lan gsum du gsol ba na rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang zhal 'dzum dang dbu dgug pa lan gsum du 1192

mdzad/ da ni nga'i bsam pa thams cad rdzogs bya ba thams cad zin gsungs nas phyi 'gros kyis yol ba'i phyir byon/ phyir phebs ma thag gsung chen pos sgar pa rnams la'ang dkor zan khyed tsho dkor thams cad zos thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa mi sgrub pa gsungs nas cher bkyon/ gra pa rnams la yang mi khyed tsho'i bsod nams de ring gis zad do gsungs/ gzims gur du phebs 'phral rjes sangs blo ba la ngas bla ma thams cad kyi dgongs pa dang bstun pas chos rgyud phyogs med du byas pa yin/ khyed kyi ma 'ongs pa'i dgos pa cig yod pas chos rgyud zhwa stabs dang bcas pa 'di kurma pa kho nar 'dril ba zhig gyis gsungs/de phyin gsung gzhan ni mi 'byon/ skabs su khyed rang tsho sdod ngas chos bshad kyi gsung ba lan re tsam gsungs/ sang tshes gnyis la sgar chen lha sar thegs/dpon slob rnams de kur bzhugs/ tshes bzhi'i tho rengs thugs 'od gsal du zhugs/ rje sangs blo bas gtso mdzad pa rnams kyis yol ba'i phyi nas gdung mchod mdzad/ de dus gzims gur la 'ja' 'khor mar zug me tog gi char rtag tu bab pas snye thang pa rnams kyis rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzims gur gyi shul yin par bzung phyis sgar pa de'i bla ma zhig gshegs par 'dug zer nas thams cad bskor ba la 'dus/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin gung la thugs dam grol bar bstan zhing rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du bsngo zhus la phyin pa na thog mar zhal ngo nag tsam mdzad/ de nas chos rje mang thos pa la gzigs nas nged sgom chen pa 'chi na nyams dang bcas nas 'chi ba yin/ zhes zhal 'dzum mdzad/ sgar gyi bla ma rnams las khyed rang tsho su mos pa gtong gsung bas rje dwags ram pa zhus te gdung sbyong du gdan drangs/ sa skyong don yod rdo rjes kyang mchod pa'i sprin spros/ snye thang gi dgon pa gang mos su spyan drongs zhes gsung bas nor bu brag gi zhol du gdan drangs/ hor zla bdun par song bas ser ba yod 1193

nges thes mi sdes gdung mi bzhu bar sde pa la zhus kyang de 'dra mi dgos/ yul byin gyis b.li ba par 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ gdung bzhu ga'i tshe thog mar rlung chen po byung ste sa'i nyal nyil thams cad phyags/ de rjes 'brug sgra drag po dang bcas pa'i char zhig byung bas snye stod thang de'i kyong thams cad chus gang bas yon chab bsgrigs pa 'dra ba zhig byung / de nas char chad de nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pas khebs/ me tog gi char kha ba ltar bab tshe rje dwags ram pa bzhengs nas g.yul khang gi steng der byon te me tog gi char 'dzin pa la phar rgyug tshur rgyug mdzad zer/ spyir rdzogs ldan gyi dus zas gos kyi char dang rin po che'i char 'bab pa dang sangs rgyas 'byon pa'i lam brgyan pa sogs la'ang thog mar rlung gis nyal nyil 'phyag de nas char gyis rdul gnon/de nas me tog gam zas sogs 'bab pa ste go rim ni 'di kho nar snang ngo / /phyis rje dwags ram pa'i zhal nas/ khyed kyi skye ba snga ma de'i gdung bsreg pa la ngas phyin/ gsol dkar mi nyag gan kur chen po de spub pa'i yu ba nas bzung ste skor gyin me tog gi char 'di tsam byung ngo a/ ngas me tog gi chad de las che ba mthong ma myong / chos 'brel zhig ma zhus snyam nas 'gyod po byung /da khyed nga'i rtsar byon byung bas 'gyod mi dgos par 'dug gsung ba bdag gis dngos su thos/ dbu klad ril po spos shel ltar dwangs pa dang ring bsrel ngo mtshar ba mang du byung bar snang zhing phyis dbu ltag gi gdung zur gsum pa cig gi zur cung ser tsam 'dug pa las phyis mdun loṭa thams cad ser por gyur/ de'i dbus nas dkar zhing 'od 'tsher ba zhig la thugs rje chen po kharla r+pā ṇa phyag gnyis pa'i sku ches po/sal ba zla phyed re zhing je gsal du 'gro ba zhig bdag gi lag na yod pa phyis chos rje rang gi sku 'dra zhig tu bzhugs su gsol zhing ring bsrel dkar ser sran rlon tsam pa rgya mdud kyi dbyibs yod pa shin tu lci ba 1194

bdar na gru bzhi sogs bzo ji ltar byas kyang btub pa la sang nyin snga ma'i rgya mdud dbyibs snga ma ji ltar ba de gar log 'gro ba zhig kyang bdag gis mthong ste rje brgyad pa'i bka' las de rije bsrel yang dag pa yin no zhes bka' bstsal to/ /gdung tsha la ring bsrel byung ba mang zer/ gdung khang gi so phag gdung thal rnams bzhus de kur mchod rten byas nas bzhugs shing bdag chung ngu'i dus kyang ring bsrel rnyed kyi yod zer zhing bskor mchod byed par snang /tshes bzhi'i mchod pa 'dzin sa rnams na me tog gi char sogs 'byung ba yin zer ba yul ci rigs na du ma snang ngo / /rje de'i bu slob kyang mgo thon tsam gyi sgom chen ni ches mang la/ rje ri khrod ras chen ni rje nyid kyi gcung po yin/ rje nyid kyis dge bsnyen gnang /mtshan 'jam dbyangs lhun grub/ gtsang smyon pa dang shar kha ras chen dang las 'brel 'dug pas der song gsungs te de dag gi gdams ngag rdzogs shing ri khrod ras chen du mtshan btags/ he ru ga'i chas mdzad/ slob ma'i tshogs mang zhing 'phrin las shin tu che/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ni rje dpa' bo kho na la 'dzin te rje gshegs rjes slob ma kha cig gis gdan sar spyan drangs pas/ sngon gyi lung bstan mnyel nas dro bo lung du gdan sar phebs kyang bsnyun dam pos ring bar btab ste bskos ja zhur btang ba'ang ma slebs par sku tshe'i bar chad du gyur/ phyis sku skye gsal bar byon te da lta 'gro don mdzad/ de'i slob ma zur pa stod zur gyi sngags ston sgrub chen barmed bkras pa dang / de'i slob ma ko brag pa shes rab rgya mtsho yin no/ /sku tshe'i stod kyi slob ma dpon po rdo rje rnam rgyal ni zangs mtsho sogs su bzhugs dus kyi slob ma yin/ phyis gra dar lung du bzhugs ste sman sbyin dang bsnyung gnas la sogs pas 'gro don mdzad phrin las shin tu che/ bla ma khrom steng pa sku mched kyang rtsa ba'i slob ma yin/ phyis 'phyong rgyas stag rtse'i khrom steng nyid du bzhugs 'phrin las legs po byung bar thos/ dge slong bde chen 1195

dar zhes bya ba thugs dam shin tu bzang ba zhig kho bo rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro gsungs te byon/ bla ca/ dpon yig pa ni grar 'khrungs/ byams gling pa'i dge bshes yin/ rje la bsten te gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs/ rtogs pa shin tu mtho/ bka' 'bum gyi bsdu ba po yang mdzad/ mtshan lhun grub rgya mtsho yin/ mngon shes mnga'/ bar do'i rnam shes gzigs/ ring srel mang du byon no/ /sgrub chen shākya dh+wa dza ni byar chos sde'i dge bshes rje nyid kyi zhabs la btugs nas spangs rtogs mthar phyin/ rje gshegs rjes gdan sa'i dod mdzad de zhabs tog che/ bdag lo dgu pa'i bar du chos dang zang zing gis skyong bar mdzad/ de nas lo bco brgyad tsam gyi bar la 'khrungs sa'i lo ro'i smad sa le gangs mdab kho nar rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad cing sgo bsdus kyi lung nag sngon ma ṇi bgrangs na gzhi bdag la phog yong zer ba'i mar thugs dam mdzad pas zhang spang dkar thul te lcang lo can gyi dgon pa mdzad/ de nas yul der chos pa dar ba yin/ rje sangs blo ba ni 'brog ba ri smad du 'khrungs/ rje dpa' bo mjal zhing chos gsan pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam rnal ma 'khrungs 'bri khung ras chen pa sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ rig gnas dang mdo sngags kyi mkhyen pa che zhing gsan spyo mtha' yas/ dro bo lung gi gdan sar bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel ma 'grig na'ang brag lung brag rtsa'i dgon btab ste dbang lung khrid gsum gyi 'phrin las shin tu che zhing bdag la'ang chos dang zang zing gi bka' drin che/ sgrub chen rgya gshongs pa bsod nams grags pa yang rje 'di la gdams pa du ma gsan/ dol phu rgyag gshong du sku tshe sgrub pa la bskyal mngon shes mnga' bar grags so/ /bla ma smon lam bzang po ni gzhung du 'khrungs/ gsang phur mtshan nyid la sbyangs pas shin tu mkhas/ tshal min du dus 'khor la sbyangs shing rje dpa' bo las bsnyen sgrub sogs gdams pa mtha' dag gsan te sras kyi thu bor gyur/ rjes lung bstan te dol chos 'khor sgang btab nas 'phrin las che'o/ /sgrub chen chos dpal ba ni 1196

dol du 'khrungs/ 'phrin las rgya cher ma byung yang tshe ring bar yong ba'i rten 'brel yod gsung ba ltar byung / dgung lo gya gcig pa'i tshe bzhugs sa nas mdun du 'dom do tsam na mthongs ka yod pa'i skas la phyag g.yog cig 'idzegs yong ba la thog phog ste skas sol dum thor re ba las ma lus/ mi de lus sdum tsam zhig lus/ lcags phreng zhig yod pa gong bu gcig tu zhu yang khong rang la lus cung zad 'phar ba tsam las ma byung skad/ sgrub chen blo she ba ni rmi lam sgyu lus la mnga' brnyes/ dol rgyang gi phu bya mda' kho nar sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te dbus tsam gyi sgom chen la bzang bar byed do/ /gtsang du g.yung pa rtogs ldan pa zhes phung po ri bo cher sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa dang /'brog mgon bu lung pa'i bla ma dad pa can de'i khang par phyag nas nam mkha' la mang du chags pa las ba thag phra mo zhig la nas bdun brtsegs su chags pa bdag gis kyang mthong / pha'i bu sngags 'chang lhun grub mgo legs zhes thugs rtsis che ba'i gnas brtan sngags 'chang yang gnyal gyi phu zhig tu 'grongs kur bsnyung zug gis phyag zhabs g.yugs pa'i rdo thams cad la rjes byung zer/ dol bde shongs su sgrub pas dus 'da' ba'i sgrub chen bsod nams brtan pa zhes bya ba'i mkhas grub des kyang gdams ngag gsan nas rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin no/ /dge slong thabs ldan don ldan zhes bya ba skad kyis khrom thams cad 'du thub pa phyis rgyal po rnams kyi mgur mkhan du gyur yang 'chi khar rkyen snang thal byung du bcad de bar do dang po zin zhing ngo mtshar gyi ltas byung bar snang ngo / /gra nas ce te chos mdzad ma zer ba'i grub chen ma rje 'di'i rtsa ba'i slob ma zhig kyang lo drug bcu tsam na gra bsam 'grub chos rdzong gi pha ra'i dbon dgon na mtshams la yod pa las thog babs te me thab sbug bcings su bsdad pa'i pus mgo gnyis dang dpral pa'i bar la thog med song / gdan gos dang thog gi shing —mang du tshig 1197

4 kyang mi rnams kyis bltas tshe lus gnad kyang ma zhig la ma tshor bar 'dug cing zhag 'ga' cung rig pa mi gsal tsam byung yang nye bar sor chud zer te bdag lo bcu pa'i dus dngos su mthong ngo / /gzhan yang yul gru so sor mngon mtho'i 'gro don cung zad 'pher ba'i bla ma dang sgom chen ri 'pher tsam ni tshad med do/ /yar rgyab kun spangs pa dang glag tshang gdan sa pa sogs chos 'brel thogs pa ni ches mang la/ bla ma ru pa'ang dbu rgyan du mjal bas chos du ma zhus/ lan gcig khyod rang nga'i khri thog 'dir nyol/ 'phrin las kyi rten 'brel 'ong gsungs te de nas 'phrin las byung zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma dang mtshungs par 'dzin zhes thos so/ /'brog phyi rdza la bzhugs dus btsan ru'i pha jo sngags pa cig mjal bas dad pa thob cing chos zhus/ chos byed par gsol ba btab pas khyod rang zhal der 'khrul zhig pa dang las 'brel 'dug gsungs nas lung ba—stan pa ni phyis zhal de ba kun dga' bsod nams te rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin par snang ngo / /gru shul du bram ze snyan rgyud btsugs pa na chos zhu'i skyes pa gsum chos byed par zhus pa la rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du las 'brel 'dug pas song zhig ces bka' bstsal te khong gsum phyin pas rje thams cad mkhyen pas sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan chos rgyal mtshan dge 'dun rgyal mtshan zhes gnang ste bya bral gyi brtul zhugs byas pas mi la ras pa gsum zhes sgar pa rnams kyis 'don pa 'di'i dang po la rkyen des bla ma mi la zhes grags te khra kurma chos rdzong btab/gzhan gnyis sgrub pa ma thar phyin pa re byung ngo / /gzhan yang bla ma 'bri ra ba/glang khungs pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ gnyal o rgyan gling pa sogs gyis rang gnas su spyon drangs te gdams pa mang du zhus la/ bla ma cham dgon pa grags pa dpal ldan dang / rkyang chen bla ma lha dbang ba sogs phyag phyir lo re gnyis bzhugs pa ni ches mang ngo / /de ltar rje dpa' bo 'di ni ma mjal ba'i dus nas rje 1198

thams cad ma khyen pa rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'dzin pa dang / phyis dpal dro bo lung gi gdan sa chen por kur bstan gyi rten 'brel 'grig pa'i r+shabs tog che zhing dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pas ches bgrang 'os par mthong ngo / /mkhan chen shākya bzang po ni mdo khams kurma'i nye lam gsal stong sgom shi'i bzhugs gnas dang nye bar 'khrungs/ dbus su byon te mtshur phur gsang sngags kyi phyag len ca/khas par sbyangs/ chos rje ngo khro las gdams ngag thams cad nod/ phyis sgar gyi yang ri la bzhugs shing gdams pa legal par gsan/ dwags lha sgam po'i bstan pa nyam rmas dus spyan snga sne'u thang pas rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du bdag rkyen zhus te dar rgyas gsol ba btab pas rje thams cad mkhyen pas sgam po'i mkhan por bskos dar rgyas kyi rten 'brel mdzad/ 'dis phyag mkhar du sgrub sde mdzad/ slob ma mang du 'dus/ lugs gnyi ga nas sgam po dar rgyas su mdzad pas sgam po'i gnas la sngon rje 'jig rten mgon po yab sras dang phyis rje 'di bka' drin che zhing spyan snga bkra shis sgang pa sku mched dang spyan snga sgar pa sku mched du bcas pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ kong po ra yang chos rgya ci rigs pa dang skyeb sde gong 'og gnyis mdzad de kur bstan la gcig tu mdzad pa che'o//bla ma cham dgon pa grags pa dpal ldan ni 'brog sba do shug par 'khrungs/ bla ma mang po bsten/ khyad par drung pa si dhu pa'i phyag dpe bri ba'i zhar la zab chos rnams gsan zhing rje 'phrin las pa la'ang phul/ phyis che sa 'gro ba'i mgon po'i ti shri mdzad de chu bo rir sgrub gra mdzad do/ 'grus khang pa bsod nams rgya mtsho ni mdo khams 'grus khang pa'i zhal ngo yin/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa las gsung chos rnams gsan/ rje kun dga' rin chen gyi slob ma mdzad nas mdo khams su bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad cing phyis dbus su byon te dbon zur bzhugs pa'i bla ma mdzad do/ khre ba kha pa don grub rnam rgyal ni rje nyid kyi rtsa ba'i slob 1199

ma yin la 'bri khung skor du 'phrin las che'o/ / bsam gtan gling pa ni kun mkhyen 'jam dpal bzang po dang rje bdun pa'i rtsa slob yin la ra sgreng gi lung lag zhig tu sgrub pa mthar phyin du mdzad pa'i sgo nas 'phrin las che'o/ /gzhan yang ngar pa rtogs ldan la sogs pa'i gzhan phan can mtha' yas par byon no/ /smyug la ba'i dpon sa gser khang mas kyang sku gshegs gar zhal gzigs par grags shing nang so 'brom pas kyang chu bo ri'i nam mkha' la rje kurma pa ras rkyang zhwa nag can byon te me tog gi char bab pa'i zhal gzigs thang sku snang ngo / /de las sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren par gyur pa ni sangs rgyas mnyan pa grub thob ste mdo khams 'bri chu'i rgyud 'dan lung par 'dan khri dpon gyi gdung rgyud du shing glang la 'khrungs/ gdung gnyan yum de ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma o rgyan gyi yul dngos su gzigs pa zhig yin/ btsas ma thag nes gsung smra ba la thogs pa med cing thugs dran pas dgung lo gcig nas zin/ skye 'chis thugs dngangs te dgung lo lnga nas dbu skra rang gis bcad de rang btsun mdzad/ kurma pa'i mtshan gsan pa tsam gyis ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa'i mos gus khyad par can 'khrungs te nyin zas mi gsol/ mtshan mi gzim par rje kho na thugs la brnags pas sku'i nyam yang rid pa na yab yum gyis dgung lo drug pa cig la mjal du brdzangs/ mjal ma thag pha bu phrad ba ltar gyur/ mtshan bkra shis dpal 'byor du gsol/ dgung lo brgyad pa la bla ma rnam gnyis las rab tu byung / dgung lo dgu nas bcu drug gi bar 'dan chos sder mkhas pa sangs rgyas dpal ba'i drung byams chos spyod phyogal rigs tshogs 'dul ba gsang 'dus sogs mdo sngags kyi sbyangs pa cher mdzad/ da ni tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya ba zhig gi sgrub pa snying por byed de yang bdag rkyen rtsa ba'i bla ma la rag las par dgongs rje thams cad mkhyen pa dgung lo 1200

bcu dgu pa bum 'bor gyi sa zla lam gnyis tsam na bzhugs pa'i sar gcig pu bros nas nyin ca/tshan ma brtsis par byon pas zhag bco brgyad na mjal/ dpon slob rnam pa gaju/ma lo bdun du ma bral bar bsten te khyad par can gyi gdams pa mtha' dag gsan zhing de thams cad thob lor ma btang bar dbang gis rgyud smin nges pa skyed rim dang rtsa thig rlung gsum gyis rnam smin gyi lus dag pa 'od gsal dang phyag chen gyis snang srid sku gsum du la zlos par mdzad/ nges 'byung dang mos gus byang chub kyi sems gsum la rtsal sbyangs/ dka' spyad kyis sku lus gud cing nyi lhags kyis gdungs pas mtshan gnyan dbon sngo skyog du grags/dgung lo nyer gsum na da ni dge sbyor chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor klungs su chud par byed pa la dben pa cig bsten dgos par 'dug snyam du dgongs te zhus pa na rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas 'o de ka gyis dang por mdo khams kyi gnas gnyan po rnams dang de nas dbus kyi lho byang gang rigs nis mgo bzung la gnas gnyan po rnams su sgrub pa gyis/ kho bo'ang rim bzhin dbus gtsang du 'ong gsungs pas/ dang por gam po gnas nang du lo gsum/ sbom phug na lo gnyis/ de nas dbus su byon te mtshur phur lo gnyis/ thang lha na lo gcig ste me ma bus g.yos pa'i zas ma gsol bar rlung dang rig pa'i bcud len kho nar lo brgyad mdzad/ spyir yang thos bsam gyi dus su'ang longs spyod shin tu che yang gang yod grogs po stoms chung la gnang nas ngan ngon las longs mi spyod/tshogs khang dang tshogs stan tsam ma gtogs pa dge 'dun gyi dkor dang sgos mgron cung zad kyang dang du mi bzhes/ sgar du bzhugs ring yang ja ro dang gtor lhag sogs kyis 'tsho ba ma gtogs dbon gyi skal ba sogs dang du mi bzhes/ de thams cad du bla ma ma gtogs thams cad la gsung bcad de su'i yang ngo mi srung / de nas chu shing gi grogs po la rje dam pas gser bya bral ba 1201

dge 'dun rgyal mtshan rdzong ba mdzad de khong gis grogs byas/ bal bu rtag ngus dbang lag sogs kyi bcud len kho nas 'tsho ba gnam mtsho'i phyi nang du lo lnga/ mon dom tshang dro bo lung zangs phugs shasbu 7gangs rnams su lo re re bzhugs shing ston dus kyi zla ba gnyis gsum la bsod stoms cung zad dang /de'i ring mdo dbus su rnal 'byor pa gnyan por byed pa dang sprul pa'i gang zag tu grags pa dang bzang por grags pa du ma mjal bsnyen rdzogs dang chos du ma gsan/ dgung lo bzhi bcu pa la nub phyogs o rgyan du 'byon par bzhed nas grogs kyi nyams brtag pa'i phyir kho bo ni sham+bha lar 'gro 'dod khyod ci snyam gsungs pas gser bya bral ba na re/ a pa rtsed mo min na rung/ man lung gu ru dang o rgyan pas ma bgrod pa'i gnas bgrod ci nus/ khyed la de tsam gyi blo gdeng yod na rab o rgyan 'bring du ruṣ+ka'i yul gyi nags tshal rta rngog can/ tha ma dzā lan+dha ra tsam du ci stogs gyis zer te gnyis ka o rgyan du 'byon par byas pa la grogs po la kun rdzob byang sems dus min du lhongs pa'i gegs shig nad drag po byung ba la lha sa'i 'dze sprang zhig gi shig nad kyang blangs pas khong sku gshegs/der thugs dgongs la yang bla ma sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i rdo rje phag mo dang o rgyan ga na yod/ grogs de yang 'di 'dras gshegs pa yin srid/ da ni skyid sdug rje garma pa rang mkhyen snyam nas rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ khyod rang bsam mno thong /bsam pa gang shar ba de la ngas gnang ba byed/ rmi lam du'ang kho bo ma brjed par gyis 'od gsal zung la gsol ba thob gsungs/ de ltar byas pas mnal lam na mi dkar po cig na re/ khyod rtsa ba'i ma la lan gcig bltas te chos kyi 'brel ba gcig mi 'dogs sam zer ba byung yum mjal 'dod drag po 'khrungs/de skad zhus pas mnyes pa'i bka' bstsal gnang nas byon lam bar su ri brag tu phebs dus gzigs snang la yum dus las 'das te ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sngaṭa 1202

skyes kyi ngo bo zhig tu gyur par gzigs te bdag sa spyod nas mkha' spyod du gnas spar ba'i phyir bde mchog gi dbang bskur stsol ba rnal 'byor pa chen po mkhyen zhes gsung ba gzigs pas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur mdzad/ rdo rje'i mgur yang gsungs/ da ni rdza go bo phug gam sle du brag gnam skas can lta bu zhig tu rus phung skya khrol le btang dgos snyam du dgongs/ 'cham la kha'i skyo du brag la bzhugs pa na/ yab yul du a gro dang 'dan ma gnyis 'khrugs te rje bla ma'i sku mched mi chos kyi yon tan can zhig bsad/ spun zla bya bral ba zhig dbus nas pha yul du yong gi yod zer ba thos nas gshed ma btang ba na gangs khrod kyi pha wang gi skyibs na sho mang dang zwa shing gi stan la sku skam la rid pa ras hrul gyi gzan gsol ba zhig mthong bas zhe sdang rtsa ba nas shi dad pa rang dbang med par skyes te snu yod thams cad phul/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis rab tu brtan pa'i nus pas yab tshan dang dgra bo gnyi gas rang re gnyis kyi 'khrug pa mtha' med 'di la rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i slob ma bya bral bkra shis dpal 'byor lta bu dgra gnyen ris med du grol ba de spyan 'drongs na 'khrug pa rtsod med du zhi nus pas de spyan 'dren zer nas gnyi gas spyan drangs pa na lan tsam yang ma gnang bar khru spong brag tu gshegs pa na/ rje garma pas khyod kyis dge 'dun gyi sde gtsug lag khang bcas pa cig gyis/ nged dbus su chos 'khor chen mo la 'gro rgyu yin pas de dus 'bul ba yang bskur/ de rnams la lhongs sna tshogs 'byung yang de thams cad lam du lhongs te byang chub kyi sems kyi grogs su 'gyur zhes pa'i bka' shog phebs pa na bdag yon tan gyi rtsal gang yang ma rdzogs pa la 'di ltar phebs pa snod brtag pa yin dgongs nas slar bskor byang zhus/ sgrub pa mdzad par gsol ba btab rung snga ma ltar bka' nan phebs pa na da bla ma'i bka' kho na mchog gi dngos grub yin dgongs nas dang 1203

du bzhes/ a gro dang 'dan yul du phebs/ gnyi ga nas spyan drangs te sa mtshams o rgyan ri khrod du dgung lo zhe gsum la dgon pa btab sha khon thams cad sbyangs/ sku mched bkrong ba'i a gro'i lag dmar rnams la chos dang zang zing gnang sbyin rgya cher mdzad pas dad cing gus/ de lo nas khrid skyong bar mdzad de skal ldan gyi sbong ba pa du ma 'dus/ chos sde rgye cher btab/ rtogs ldan a 'gag la sogs pa sprul yul bgrod thub pa'i slob ma du ma thon/ de'i tshe yul de'i sde dgon sngar yod mang po 'phrin las ma bzod cing khyim la 'khren pas go mtshon gyi sbyor bas 'ongs pa na gnod par ma nus kyang re zhig rtsod pa zhi bar ma gyur zhing de dag gi bsam sbyor zhi ba ma yin pa rgya cher 'phel ba na sa g.yos chen pos de dag gi snod bcud k+tang phal cher zhig pas drag po'i 'phrin las kyi snyan pa yang cher byung / nyide khang pa gzhi brtsegs kyi thog na bzhugs pa'i khang pa zhig ste nyid gyang mthon po cig gi rtser phebs pa na 'phur bar grags te de phyin gnyan pa grub thob tu mtshan gsol/ dgon pa klungs su spos te byang chub gling btab/ dud chen stong gi yong sgo sbyar te dge ma'adun 'du ba'i sgo ches bzang bar sbyar/ de'i tshe rje thams cad mkhyen pas khyod kun spangs kyi brtul zhugs kyi mdo stod thams cad du slong mo'i spyod pa gyis shig gsung ba phebs pas de thams cad du byon te kur sde chen po rnams su rnying gso gsar 'dzugs rab byung bsnyen rdzogs khrid skyong mtha' yas pa dang rab sgang sogs su chos 'khor chen po rnams gyi gral dbu mdzad de chos rgyud so so ba thams cad kyi mkhas ba dang grub par grags pa thams cad kyis spyi bor bkur/ yul gru thams cad du khon thams cad sbyangs te zhi bar 'dums/ dge bskul gyi tshogs ni nyin gcig gi 'phrin las kyang mtha' yas/ nam mkha' mdzod lta bu'i longs spyod 'du ba thams cad rab rnams rje'i drung du 'bul/ 'bring gis dge rgyun rnams 1204

mdzad/ tha mas 'phral dgos dang gra slob skyong / rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dru nga du khri rwa can gyi 'bul ba dang 'bum rwa can gyi 'bul ba lan bzhi lnga dang stong rwa can gyi 'bul ba grangs med pa dang / rje na dim brgyad pa'i drub du'ang khri 'bul lan mang po dang stong 'bul 'grang gis mi lang bar mdzad/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu'ang dge 'dun khri phrag tu longs pa'i chos 'khor chen po lan gsum dang spyir gdan sa rnams su 'bul 'gyed mtha' yas pa mdzad/ phyis gser mi bo che'i khur du longs pa thub chen chos 'khor gyi gser thog gi rgyur dmigs pa mdzad/ mdor na rje na rim brgyad pas rnam thar du bdag gi rje bla ma 'di lta bu nang du chos brgyad kyi 'khri ba grol/kun rdzob rnam smin gyi rtsa thams cad kyi mdud pa zhig 'gro 'ong gi rlung thams cad kyi 'gyu ba chad/ khams dkar dmar 'bar zhu'i spros pa bral/ rga shes kyi rlung dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dhū tir 'dus/ gnyid 'od gsal gyi klungs su tshud/stoms 'jug gi sgrib pa 'pho bral du mdzad/ snang ba lha skur shar/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde bas thugs tshim/ rdzu 'phrul gyis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams 'dul zhing byin gyis rlob/— zung 'jug gi sku rnal 'byor chen po la gsal snang thebs/ ces gsungs pa nyid de mchog gi grub thob chen por bzhugs/ rje /rma pa brgyad pa'i yongs su 'dzin pa mdzad de dbang khrid lung man ngag bzhuṭa so 'tshal lo bzhi lnga'i bar du phul/ dgung lo drug bcu re lnga la bab pa'i tshe da ni shi yang bsam pa rdzogs pa yin gsungs te gdan sa bar par sku mya ngan las 'das/ zhag bdun pa na rje brgyad pa'i mnal lam du ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i glu las/ sngon gyi tshe na rgyal ba bde ba'i glu/ /snyigs ma'i dus na dran pa ye shes rnyed/ da lta byang phyogs rnam par bkod pa na/ /drug 'bum bdun khri'i — dge slong mdun bdar te/ /'dan ma grub chen tshul ni de ltar ro/ /zhes soṭa 1205

gsan/ paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ to gzhan don du sku'i bkod pa bzung bar snang la/ gtso bor rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rigs kyi bdag po yin zhing gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol du mdzad par gdon mi za la spyir ni kho bo la rtogs ldan gyi slob ma 'byung rgyu rnams rje brgyad pa'i slob mar rten 'brel bsgrigs par bka' bstsal to/ / —dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lha sngags dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi/ /'byung gnas gcig po rigs kun bdag /mi bskyod zhabs der spyi bos 'dud/ /de la bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma rigs kyi bdag po mtshan brjod par dka' ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin gcig pa'i ga zuṭa kyi skur bstan pa rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang rgyal ba byams pas da lta 'dzam gling na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa nyams mas lnga brgya tha ma la thug pas skye bo thams cad ngan song du gzhol bar gyur gyi de thams cad la khyod kyi las nyon de dag kho na las brtsams te gang 'du'/ du ston zhig ces bskul ba na yid bzhin kyi snying po'i pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum pa la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te khams sna tshogs pa 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la stoms par zhugs pa na 'dzam gling gi sems can thams cad kyi khams dang dbang po dang mos pa thams cad ji lta bar mkhyen/ 'dul dka' sla de thams cad la'ang thugs mnyam pa nyid du gyur zhing de thams cad gdul ba'i nus pa mnga' bar gzigs nas sangs rgyas de thams cad la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i sprin rgya cher spros te 'od zer mtha' yas pas sems can thams cad smin par mdzad de/ bcom ldan dpa' bo khyod ni sngon sangs rgyas/ /dga' ldan bzhugs nas 'dzam gling gshegs 'tshal ltas / /bdag la ma rungs/ 'dul ba'i lung mnos te/ /byang chub spyod pa'i ca/gon mdzad 1206

ngo mtshar to/ /zhes sogs smon lam dang dam bca' chen po mdzad pa na byams pa'i dbu gtsug gi mchod rten gnyis pa cig spros te dbu thog tu rigs bdag tu byas te khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni mnyan pa sgab thob bo zhes gsung zhing 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor pa'i rnam pas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs te rdo rje'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'gro ba'i don ji ltar mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams ni skal ba mchog gi spyod yul te rnam thar bdag tshul bcu gnyis pa las ji skad gsungs pa nyid de de skad bka' bstsal ba yang rgya mtsho las chu thigs tsam bstsal bar zad de tre bsam gyis khyab pa'i gnas ma yin no/ /thun mong gi gdu' bya'i snang ba dang bstun na/ོ rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhal chems shog dril bzhag par/ bdag ni skye ba med la skye tshul ston/ /gnas pa med la gnas tshul ston/ /'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston/ /skye ba med kyang slar yang skye tshul ston/ /zhes dang /bdag ni gdod nas g.yo med 'gro 'ong med/ /skye dang gnas dang 'chi sogs rab spangs kyang / /rtag tu phyogs bcur g.yo zhing 'gro 'ong dang / /skye gnas 'chi sogs rnam pa sna tshogs ston/ /thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu ste/ /de bzhin dus rnams kun tu shes par gyis/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad dang /sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'khrungs yul yab yum sogs gsal ba'i shog dril du ma rgyal tshab sprul sku la gtod gsung ba dang sidhu pa la gtod gsung ba'i zhal yig can so sor yod pa mdzad nas gsol cog gi steng du bzhag yod par snang / de la gang du sku bltams pa'i gnas ni mdo stod kyi sa dpal garma'i gdan sa chen po ngang nye ba ngom chu rgyud/ de las g.yas lung ka ra ti phug de'i bye brags taX gyi grong du skye bochu/ phal ba ltar snang ba'i yab yum las ltam par mdzad do/ /de yang rje nyid kyi bka' las kho bo la phyi nang gsang ba'i pha ma yod de longs spyod rdzoṭa 1207

sku'i zhing du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo trīX yig gi rnam pas gsang ba'i yab chos rje 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor lo sdom par bzhengs pa'i zhal nas zhugs te gsang ba'i yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma a sgron gyi lhums su zhuṭa shing 'di gnyis sa bcu pa'i byang sems yin la rnam pa g.yo sgyu'i mdzad pa ltar snang bas kho bo'ang mi gzhi ngan pa ltar snang ba yin/ de nas longs sku rgyu'i he ru ga'i rnam pas bltams te sngar sa hor gyis bod chol kha gsum bzung dus kyi dmag dpon che mo dgu pa'i rgyud las skyes pa gser bya bral byams pa bshes gnyen gyi zhal nas zhugs shing 'khrungs sa'i chu mig dang shug phung gi bdag mo klu mo da ra gsal sgron gyi lhums su bab ste de'i rten 'brel gyis ngag cung zad mi bde ba dang spun zla rnams shes ba mi gsal ba yin/ nang gi pha ma 'di dag ni sngags kyi sbyor lam pa yul nyer bzhi thams cad du dngos su tshogs 'khor la dbang ba 'in/ de ltar gsang ba dang nang gi lhums su rdo rje theg pa'i nang gi dbang bskur thams cad yongs su rdzogs te dag pa snang ba'i sprul sku'i rnam pas nang gi yum gyi lhums nas bltams te phyi'i yab a byams dang yum ldong mkha' spyod pa'i dbon mo ldong bza' bla ma sgron gyi lhums su zhugs pa yin/ phyi'i yab yum 'di gnyis kyang sngags kyi tshogs lam chen po pa rmi lam du yul nyer bzhi rnams bgrod pa yin no zhes bka' bstsal to/ / — de yang rab byung me yos kyi lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i srod la 'od kyi gong bu 'od zer 'phro ba zhig khang thog tu babs nas skar khung nas sil sgra dang bcas pas nang du song nas nang thams cad nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal ba zhig byung tshe lhums su zhugs te ji ltar yum gso sbyong spyod pa'i lhums su byang chub sems dpa' zhugs pa ltar zad kyi dkar dmar gyi sa bon la stos pa ni ma yin par snang ngo / /de'i nub yum gyi mnal lam du thang chen po me tog gis 1208

gang pa'i dbus na gur chen po shin tu legs pa sku gsung thugs rten ngo ca/tshar bas gang ba dung gi mchod rten kha ba ltar 'bab pa cig tu son nas rus nga/ ri rgyan drug dang bcas te gar byed cing 'dug pa'i rgyab ri 'ja' gur dang myo/ bun g.yu'i mdog gis gtibs pa khye'u bu mo ltar mi ngoms pa nor bu'i rgyan can mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pas phyi nas bskor ba dang glu gar gyis mchod pa mthong zhing de'i tshe mchod gral nas gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig blangs/bud med ral pa kham shar re ba zhig gis dung chen po cig 'bud cing 'dug pa'i dung blangs nas bus pas skad cher byung tshe khri thog na bla ma zhig bzhugs 'dug pa na re/ dung skade de rgya dbus thams cad du thos nas thal zer/ phyi rol thams cad khrom gyis gang 'dug pa la yab kyis ma ṇi lag bskor chen po cig thogs nas thams cad la ma ṇi bskul zhing 'dug bla ma des dung gi mchod rten gyis rma do 'dzin byas pa'i phreng ba zhig yum rang la gtad nas 'dis ma ṇi bgrongs zer te 'dren bdo ba la mnal sad tshe lus bde nyams dang bcas pa'i sngar las lji tsam zhig tu song 'dug de phyin rmi lam du khang ltag nas chu bcus pas gzar bu'i nang du spyan ras gzigs yin zer ba'i byis pa chung ngu zhig byung nas desaṃ rin po che'i khri chen po la bzhugs nas skye bo mtha' yas pa la thugs rje chen po'i sgom lung gsung zhing thams cad yig drug 'don ga dang / khang thog na gser khri zhig 'dug pa la rang gi pang na byis pa cig 'dug —pa de song nas de la 'dug ste 'gro ba mtha'atho yas pas phyag bskor byed pa rmis shing bud med gzhan zhig la'ang dus mtshungs par rmi lam de snang / nub phyogs nas 'od dar yug brkyangs pa lta bu la 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dra ba 'brel ba khang bzang lta bu'i nang na seng ge chen po g.yu ral can gyi steng du 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa'i nang na bla ma'i sku 'od zer 'phro ba dbu zhwa ring po gyon pa 'od kyi g.yas 1209

g.yon da btsan pa rnga brdang mi da ma dang mtha' thams cad lha mi mchod rnga4 byed ༄ ༄ ༄ ༄pas gang ba/ 'og gi sa gzhi khrom chen pos gang ba de thams cad kyis da nga nyid la mchod pa dang smon lam meng po cha/dzad nas nub phyogs su byon par mthong ste 'di ni slob dpon pad+mas byin gyis brlabs par snang ngo / /yang nyi zla skar gsu ma 'dzom pa la bla ma rnal 'apyor pa'i cha byad rta dkar po can 'khor rad 'dra brgya stong gis bskor badzo/ khang mkhris su khal mang po pho ga ste rten sgam nas rten dpag med bton pa dang mnyam du yum la bu zhig snang ba de rten sgam du bcug nas ngas 'di da bar ma rnyed zer/ de ma thag tu de rta dkar po gser sga gser chas can la bskyon te dar 'phyar dung 'bud rol cha mang po dang nam mkha' spos dud kyis 'khrigs pas nub phyogs su song bar snang ste 'di ni phyis rgyal ldob sprul skus spyan 'dren pa mthong bar snang / yang rang gi zhing dkyil na gur chen po'i mtha' cog pus bskor ba/ gur de sku gsung thugs rten gyis gang ba'i dbus na khri zhig 'dug pa la sdong gi bu zhig 'dug pa de song ba btsun pa mdzes po cig tu gyur nas 'dug cing de'i bdag po bla ma bgres nyams yod pa cig gis byed par rmis te phyis sangs rgyas mnyan pas zhabs tog mdzad pa gzigs par 'dug dngos su yang lhums su zhugs phyin khang pa'i phyi nang thams cad du brgyad stong pa la sogs pa'i gsung rab 'don pa'i 'ur sgra dang ma ṇi'i 'ur sgra khrom chen po tshogs pa lta bu grag cing res nyan na mi thos res ma nyan na'ang thos pa rgyun du byung / yul mi 'gas yum gyi kha4 pa'i phyi nang thams cad me 'bar bar mthong /yum sku yang zhing bde/ zas ma zos kyang bkres pa'i snang ba med/ nyi ma gcig la nas dgon zho drug gi mal gyi yur ma zin zhing lus ngal ba tsam yang ma byung /sa bon bre do btab par nas khal bzhi thon/ yang lan zhig yum ram ‘ 'thu bar song nas cung zad bsdad yod tsa na khog pa nas skad phra mo zhig gis/ tog 1210 —

tob/ ma byed 'gro ser ba 'ong le yod/ zer ba zhig byung / yum rang sga a je shi ba de'i skad yin par yang dogs/ zla bo la khyod kyis ci smras dris pas ngas cang ma smras skad phra chung zhig ni grag zer bas log phyin pa na khyim du slebs ma thag ser drag thu mo zhig byung / khong nas yig drug gsung ba du mas thos/ yab yum 'thab mo byung nas yab kyis yum la gla nga'i yu ba brgyab pas khong pa'i nang nas nged ma bu la 'di tsam byed pa'i las ma byas zhes gsung byon pa nang mi thams cad kyis thos pas yab kyi khro ba'ang zhi/ 'di dag las na byang chub sems dpa' don thams cad grub pa lhums na tsardon sbrul snying gi khang brtsegs na bzhuṭa pa ltar phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa pad+ma las brdzus te skyes pa lta bur lhums na bzhugs par snang ngo / /yum 'o ma bshig cing yod tshe a khu a thar gyis khyod la 'dre'i phrug gu yod dam zer nas gri brgyab pa sto ba la tshud kyang ci yang ma nyes 'o ma rkyal pa ral/ yab kyi rmi lam na gser sku chen po cig gi bdag bcol ba dang / gser sku bzheng bar 'dod pa na khyod kyis bzheng mi dgos nga rang rang byon du yong ba yin zhes thub dbang gi gser sku ngo mtshar can byung ba dang / slob dpon pad+mas khrom chen po la chos bshad nas dung phreng mig yod med 'dres pa sil bu ras khug chen po gang btang ste 'di khrom la khye/'brel tshad ngas 'dren pa yin 'jig rten na nga bas lhag pa med gsung ba rmis/nyin zhig rtsal ma brtsas te 'ongs pa na dngos su drel khal dang mi mang po byung ba nas dre'u dkar po gcig la rten sgam bkal rgyan drug bcings pa'i mi zhig gis rten khug zhig nas zhwa zhig phyung ste lag tu gtad byung ma thag de rnams yal song /yang rmi lam na khro bo ral gri 'dzin pa dang bud med rus rgyan can dpag med kyi nang nas sngon mo rgod kyi thul pa gsol ba bcu gsum gyis khyod kyis lag tu khams gsum gsal ba'i nor bu thob pa yod de'i ja 'dren yin zer ba rmis/ 1211
