gcen mo klu sgron gyis yum gyi steng du 'ja' gur mthong nas bstan pas gzhan gyis kyang mthong de la sogs pa rang gzhan gyi dngos nyams rmi lam gyi mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba ni mtha' yas/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal ma mthong ste phung khams skye mched thams cad sprul pa sprul ba dang 'dra bar byung gsungs/ de ltar lhums su zla ba brgyad lhag par bzhugs te skog gyur gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad de zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bzhi'i snga dro yum la gnod pa med par bltams pa'i rol pa bstan tshe dri bzang gi ngadu chen po byung / dril phyi byas nas cung zad song ba na spyan hrig hrig mdzad nas /rma pa'o zhes lan gnyis go tsam gsungs/ de'i tshe khang thog tu 'ja'i ka ba zug me tog gi char bab cing yum la zhag mang gor dri bzang gi ngad bro bar gyur/ de'i tshe dkar po'i lha thams cad kyis snyan pa bsgrags bas skye bo'i tshogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'dus shing ngom du kurma pa'i sku skye 'khrungs zhes snyan pas phyogs thams cad du khyab bo//de'i tshe kurma sisbru pa rgyal sras bkra shis dpal 'byor phyogs der phebs pa la zla ba de'i tshes bcu gsum la yab a byams kyis mjal du byon nas nged tshang la byis pa ngo mtshar che ba zhig yod zhus pas phyag sgam nas shog dril zhig phyu da ste gzigs nas khyed yab yum la ci ming khang pa'i ltag 'og tu shug phung dang chu mig sgo shar du bstan pa rnams e yod gsungs/ de rnams yod tshul zhus pas khyod kyi ming de mi mthun 'dug yab la byams pa/ yum bla ma mtsho zer ba 'duga'on kyang a byams dang ble ma sgron zhes phyogs mthun tsam yin pa 'dra/ sku tshe'i rten 'brel du 'brug lo zla ba gsum pa'i bar gsongs la nya ra dam po gyis gsungs nas/ rten bsdus ril bu bdun/ ras kyi bag le kha gang / ja dang mar/ gu gul dkar nag 'dres pa phul gang tsam bskur nas/ 'di garma si dhu pas khyed la na bza' dang ja 'dren yin zhus/ spos 'dis bdug pa gyis/1212

rten bsdus ril bu 'di rnams drongs dang sprul sku yin na ci yang mi yong / min na nang par nas rtags cig ston pa yizha/ de'i tshe mang na tshis/ bzhi nyung na gsum gsung ba yin/ de byung na khyod 'dir shog gsungs/ ya ba kyis de rnams byas pas na bza' ja 'dren yang bag 'phyis tsam/ e ma ho nga la the tshom ma byed dang / /nga ni /rma pa zhes bya/ /gsungs/ gzhan 'ga' yar gsung ba ma zin/ja skol zhing yod tshe sprul sku bltams nas zhag bcu gsum lon pa de bzhengs nas gar mdzad ngom stod kyi ldong lha rgod kyi bu mo dpon g.yog gnyis kyis mjal nyin 'ja' dang me tog gi char byung / thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma dngos dang mjal ba'i dad pa skyes/ dad rten zhu ba la na bza' bag le'i dum bu cung zad cig byin pa la khong gnyis rtsod pas khyed gnyis de 'dra ma byed gsung zhing yig drug 'ga' zhig gsungs/ shel khyam dpon nya skyabs kyis nga'i phas drung gong ma sku chung ngus na bza' zhig phul/ da res ngas kyang sku drung du na bza' zhig 'bul zhes phul ba na phyag du bzhes te 'bul ba legs gsungs/ sku 'khrungs nas zla gcig na ri bo che'i sgom chen gser phur bas mjal te khrom mang po yod sar ja zhus tshogs 'khor byas/ phyag tu khong gis ḍa dril phul bas dgyes pas 'khrol zhing thams cad la phyag dbang mdzad/ khyed kurma pa yin na rtse lha sgang du nga la chos gnang ba de gang yin zhus pas phyag rgya chen po dang na ro chos drug yin gsungs/ drung sidhu bas sprul sku brtag par yon bdag mtsho skyes btang tshe yig drug lan mang po gsungs/ dbu dum pa gser jis mja' te sku la dri bzang po rgyun du bro ba la ngasnams te gtsug tor dang mdzod spu ma gtogs mtshan thams cad rdzogs par 'dug zer nas ri bo cher snyan pa bsgrags so/ /de rnams ngom sa sgang bya ba drung na rim gyi bu chen zhig gi dgon da lta chos rgyud dge ldan pa byed pa der thos nas ja 'dren phul dge 'dun pa kun gyis mjal tshe yig drug 1213

dang ā li kā li gsung chen pos gsungs pas thams cad dad/ ldong khyi sprang mas mjal tshe sgyu ma'i rang bzhin nga ni skye 'gag gnas dang bral/ /zhes gsungs pas dad pa thob ste mi sde rnams mjal bar bskul zhing de thams cad la mnyes pas phyag dbang mdzad/ dbon sbrang rgyal bya bas mjal bas khyod sdig can yin gsungs nas bzhad/ des kyang bshags pa byas/ pa bod pa'i bla ma zhig gis ngas rtse lha sgang du gser srang gang phul nas byin rlabs zhus pa yin pas de ring phyag dbang zhabs dbang gnang dgos zhus pas mnyes pa ra mdzad cing yang yang byin rlabs mdzad/ bla ma zhabs rjen pas mjal te gsung zhig 'byon dgos zhus pas/ rdor skyil dang phyag bsnol stabs mdzad de spyan nam mkhar gzigs nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pas khong dad pa cher thob/ sku 'khrungs nas zla ba gnyis na nu ma g.yas ba'i gong du ring bsrel dkar po yungs gar lta bu gsum 'dzoms su shar ba kun gyis mthong bar zla ba tsam snang / phyis grib can zhig gis mthong bas yal/ zla ngo gsum pa la tshems se'u yungs kur tsam gnyis byung ba na yab a byams kyis reg ste 'di nged spun za ba'i 'dre so e yin zer bas de nub rang yal ljags cung dig par snang /spyir gson po ring bsrel 'dzag pa dang / /zhes moshise par 'chad mkhan snang yang 'di la khungs ma mthong zhing dbu skra dang sen mo'ang sku bal gyi ring bsrel yin pas de lta na gson po'i skra sen yang mi shis pa dang gzungs sngags ni gzungs kyi ring bsrel yin pes gson pos gzungs bshad pa'ang mi shis par thal bas 'di ni rang gzor gor ma chag go a thar gyis kurma pa yin na 'dis mi gnod zer nas sman chen zhun mar dang sbyar te drangs pas de phyin sku lus la 'bur zhib mang po byung / lan cig yum bal 'khel ba'i 'phang nas bzung ste 'khel ma bcug pas mi kha rgyang grags 'di bas nyen pa ma byung zer nas thal cag 1214 —

brgyab pas a ma rang kha rog srod ma ṇi thon/ nga la bdag po cig yong ba yod/ ra.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūX gsungs/ de nas yun ma thogs par ri bo che ba dang lho rong pa'i gdan 'dren slebs/ so so'i dar kha zhu yig phyag gis bzhes shing mnyes par mdzad/ spyan drangs te ri bo cher me tog bkra mchod kyi mchod bstod kyi tshe phebs pas bsu ba lta bur byung / de dus zla ngo bdun bzhes la chos rje steng pas rgun 'brum sder gang gi steng du bur rdog gsum bzhag pa byung bas shin tu dgyes nas bur rdog gsum sku gsum/ rgun 'brum sder gang du ma ro gcig ces gsungs nas phal cher bzhes/ khrom thams cad la phyag dbang mdzad cing yig drug gsungs/ sngon yab la khyod kyi bu garma pa yin na cir thal yang nga byin rlabs mi zhu zhes kha dan byas pa cig la phyag dbang ma mdzad pas kho rang yang dad/ ri bo che pa'i zhal ngo mi dpon ri mtshams dge sgom thams cad kyis so so nas ja 'dren phul/ so so nas drung gong ma'i bka' shog byin rlabs rten sogs so so ngos 'dzin zhus pa rnams la tha dad du yid 'ches/ chos kyi rje 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'di /rma pa'i sprul sku rtsod med du ladug pas khyed rang zhabs tog pa'i 'os yin pas zhabs tog gyis zhes lho rong pa yum sras la bka' gnang / chibs pa sogs rdzong 'bul dang bcas te lho rong rdzong gsar du phebs so/ /'di'i tshe rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku khrom sbrul lce steng na bzhugs tshe nang zhig bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis ngam kha skad snyan po cig tshor/mdang la pa cig slebs byung bas thams cad mkhyen pa ngom na sku 'khrungs pa'i nges pa can 'dug zhus pa dang gzims gur la nyi ma shar ba dang gsol ja dang po gsol dkar du zhus pa gsum dus mnyam pa'i rten 'brel byung / kho bo'ang lus sems bde rten 'brel shin tu bzang gsungs/ 'di'i dus bla ma a mdo ba rgod rlabs can zhig gis khong rang gi bu zhig byung ba la'ang pha ma la rmi ltas 1215

bzang ba dang ltas bzang po byung ba la brten nas bu la bslab sbyang yang du ma byas nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul skur grags te brag gsum na bzhugs/ sgar pa phal cher yang zas chang gis mgu bar bgyis nas phyogs su lhung bar byas/bla ma rin po che skya se gdan drangs te sku skyer ngos 'dzin mdzad na'ang zla ba rnga5nyis tsam na bla ma nyid sku gshegs/ rgyal tshab rin po che sngon gyi lung bstan so gas nas sprul pa'i sku nyid la 'chug med kyi thugs nges shes yod rung re zhig spyo/ ra pa mi mang gi kha ngo cung zad gzigs dgos pa nas 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi spyod pas brag gsum du phebs nas a mdo ba'i sras dang mjal ba mdzad/mjal dar sna mo gsum btang ba gsum ga tshur bslog byung ba'i rten 'brel la'ang ma mnyes/ 'brug grag 'phro la skad chag pa'i mnal ltas kyang sprul sku 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ 'on kyang thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas drung bkra shis don grub pa dang bka' bsgros te rtse lha sgang du spyan drangs nas sku mtshams la bzhugs su gsol/ mnal lam brtags pa na'ang nub ngos kyi sa thams cad nag cing mi sdug pa dang shar ngos kyi yul thams cad dkar zhing nyams dga' bar gzigs/snye bo sa phug na bzhugs dus kyang seng ge nga ro 'byin mi nus pa cig 'dug pa shar nas 'brug chen po cig grag pa'i mod la de khyir gyur pa'i mnal ltas las 4 shar gyi sprul sku 'di rtsode med yin pa 'dra zhes rong bo bla ma gcod pa la snga mo nas chogasungs par snang / bdag lo dgu pa cig thub chen chos 'khor na slebs pari tshe khrims dpon chen po 'dan ma go'i shris gral 'phros la'ang sgra' ska 'di'i ༄ ༄yab de yab rgod cig e yod/ nged kyi brag gsum sprul sku 'di la ni yab rgod cig yod pa yin/ yab rgod byung phyin sprul sku slob pa la tshig gnyis kyis chog skad/ dran nam zer na dran gyis/ ma dran nam zer na ma dran gyib// ngo shes sam zer na shes gyis/ mi shes sam zer na mi shes gyis/ 'dis chog pa 1216 ༄

yin par 'dug ces gsung ba sogs dpyod ldan thams cad ni som nyi tsam yang mi byed par snang ngo / /mchog gi 4sprul pa'i sku ni lho rong rdzong gsar du gdan drangs te nam ma/ba' mdzod kyi lha khang la sogs par phebs/ sngon gyi dbu zhwa dang las zhwa gzhan ma'i sgam bsgrigs pa dang / sku 'dra dngos dang gzhan ma na bzas btums te bsgrigs pa dang drung gong ma'i tshems dang rgya ston pa'i tshems thams cad mkhyen pa'i na bza' dum bu dang / bla ma gzhan gyi na bza' dum bu bshibs te khyed rang gi dbu zhwa sogs gang yin ngos zung zhes zhus pa thams cad la drung gong ma'i rnams kho na ngos bzung / spyir mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'di lta bu la brtag pa 'di rigs ni rta mchog rin po che la gom pa bsgyur shes mi shes brtag pa lta bu yin mod na'ang 'di rnams phyi tshas 'dra 'dra bzos nas byed par snang bas tshur mthong gi yid 'ches kyi gnas cung zad ni snang ngo / /rgya ston bya bral bas kyang zhu yig mdzad/ dbu lo 'dra 'dra gnyis ngos 'dzin zhus pa na drung gong ma'i dbu lo la 'di nga'i skra yin 'di bla ma gzhan zhig gi skrar 'dug gsungs pas nges shes thob/ drung gong ma'i lcam mo dbon mo dga' bas mjal bas a ja gsungs nas mkhyen/ drung gong ma'i ring bsrel dang ring bsrel gzhan ngos 'dzin zhus/ byu ru'i thugs dam phyag tse skor yod pa ngos 'dzin yang mdzad/srung ba'i logs la drung gong ma'i yum gyi me long zhig yod pa la 'di su'i red zhus pas a ma gsungs nas phyag gis 'jus/ khyed chos grags rgya mtsho yin na mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gar mdzod zhus pas shing gnyis rdo rje dril bu'i tshul du bsnams nas gar gyi tshul dang rnas 'bru 'thor nas bkra shis shog gsungs/— dgung lo bzhi pa la drung pa grags pa bkra shis pas phyag phyi mdzad de ri bo cher byon pa'i lam du ki nog bla ma bsod nams rin chen gyis g.yu zhig phul te khyed /rma pa yin na nga la gsung zhig byon zhus pas/ nga lan re pad+ma 'byung gnas 1217

yin/ /lan re sa ra ha pa yin/ /lan re byams pa mgon po yin/ /gsungs/byams pa ji ltar bzhugs zhus pas bzang po'i stabs mdzad/ ri bo che 'phyams dpon pas gdan drangs pa na ber nag can gyi 'phyams yun ring por mdzad/rten mchod 'di rnams la drung gong mas phyag nas mdzad pa e 'dug zhus pas ber nag can gyi thang sku 'di ngas khyod la mtshur phur byin pa de yin gsungs pas khong dad de mchi ma byung / ri bo cher bla ma sku do bas khyed kyis chos rje 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag phul gsungs pas nga /rma pa yin pas phyag mi 'tshal/khyod rang nga la tshol gsungs/ chos rje'i drung du bzhugs stan bshams pa la yang zhal phyir bsgyur nas bzhugs/ bu chung khyod nga la phyag tshol byin rlabs zhus gsungs nas phyag brkyangs pas dbu dgyed mdzad de phyag mi 'tshal byin rlabs mi zhu gsungs/ cung za5 na phyag brkyangs nas khyod la ngas byin rlabs byed pa yin gsungs pas dpon slob kun ngo mtshar du gyur/ chos rjes drung gong ma'i na bza' gos chen zhig dang chu 'phur ba'i na bza' gos chen zhig bshibs te khyed rang gi gang yin gsungs pas na bza' de ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gtsug zhwa zhwa ser sgom zhwa rta rmig ma zhig rnams drung du bzhag ste zhwa gang gsol zhus pas gtsug zho de bzhes nas gzhan gnyis phyir dor/ sta shod du bu chung khyod ri bo cher ja 'thung du 'gro 'am kong por zan zar 'gro gsungs pas kong por zan zar 'gro gsungs pas chos rje'i gsungs nas/ thugs zhan la tha 'khob gdul bya che bar dgongs par 'dug 'di kurma pa min rdzo ba ang gsungs/ de nas ri bo che pa/rgya ston pa/ lho rong pa ste sde pa khag gsum gyis bka' bsgros mdzad/ sgar du mi sna mngags/ drung gong ma'i dbu che zhal slob che ba rnams bzhugs ring sprul sku 'di khri thog tu phebs pa 'thad ces zhu ba bskur/ dgung lo lnga pa la 'o lung du dbon mo dga' ba can du bzhugs pa na/ nga'i sprul pa gcig mtshur phu na 1218

yo da / gcig yul gzhan zhig gsung ba ma go skad/ yang dbon mo nga/ga' bas a mdo bu kham pa yin pa 'dra zhus pas/ kurma pa nga yin a mdo bu zur mang sku skye'i skye ba yin/ kho nga'i gra pa yin gsungs/ 'o na rtse lha sgang na'idas pa de yin nam rtsar bshis na 'das pa de yin zhus pas/ rtsar bshis na 'das le de yin gsungs te gsung 'di las brag gsum sku skye phyis zur mang gi sku skye chung tshang du gyur nas tsher lung gi bla ma mdzad pa yin no/ /khams su gru shan mi yong na'ang me tog ra ba la gru 'dra le 'di ci yin gsungs/ gru gar gzigs zhus pas dang po mthong ba yin gsungs/ skabs su/ nga ni sa ra ha pa ste/ /nga ni gam pa yin no/ /zhes yang yang gsungs/ yul pa'i rje mo zhig bsngo ba zhu ba la mos na ning nga la skur pa btab pas bsngo ba mi byed gsungs/ dbon mos dris pa na na ning dam pa yin na gog po mi byed las che/ 'di pa gog 'dug byas/gzhan ma zhus zer/ drung pa sprul sku'i sgar pa kong po nas brag gsum du khyogs 'dug zer ba thos pa na/ ma khyogs kong por yod gsung bas phyis de bzhin du 'dug yang ḍa dril bsnams te mgon po'i 'phyams dang slob dpon pad+ma'i 'phyams dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gar yin gsung ba yang yang mdzad/ ang / yum lha mo skyid ces gsung ba na dbon mos de su lags zhus pas khyod kyi ma yin gsungs nas zhabs gyol stangs mdzad/ nga la a ma gnyis yod pa yin gsungs/drung gong ma'i dbon po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis sku rtsed zhus pa na tsha sdo de 'dra ma byed ces sus kyang ma zhus par gsungs/ yul mi gzigs ma myong ba zhig la a 'bum gsungs nas gsol ras gnang ste mtshur phur nga'i gra pa zhig shi ba'i skye ba yin gsungab// sgar pa rnams kyis spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar ba'i drung du brag gsum sprul sku la ja 'dren gnang dgos zhes zhus pa na yang sprul sku ni khams bzhugs pa de yin par rtsod med mdzad/ sgar pa'i ngo 'dzin tsam du 1219

ja zhus kyi rnam pa tsam zhig las ma gnang / rgya ston bya bral bas 'o lung du malhag gi sprul sku'i drung du gzims gur dang chibs sogs kyi 'bul chen mdzad/rten so so'i na bza' brjes pa'ang mkhyen nas bka' bstsal/ zla gcig tsam zhabs phyir bzhugs te mi rnams ci bsam mi shes/ nga ni drung gong ma'i mdzad pa dang drung 'di'i mdzad pa la khyad par mi 'dug bsam gsungs/ rngod shākya ba'i gra pa gsum gyis drung gong ma'i zhal mthong ba nged gsum su lags zhus pa na dbus ma de'o zhes mkhyen par mdzad/ nyin zhig mchod shoms kyi steng gi nam mkhar ring du gzigs te slob dpon pad+ma mkha' 'gro gnyis dang bcas pa snang gsungs/ gzhan yang zhal gzigs mang du gsungs mod kyang a mdo sprul sku la'ang de dus rnam thar mang du bris par snang ba mthong ba nas cher ma bkod par snang / yang yum la kurma na si bhu pa 'das yod gsungs/ zhag bco lnga na drung pa gshegs zer nas sgar du 'grim pa 'gro mi rnams lam der byung / rdzong na bgyeṭa dus 'jang 'drul ba du ma dang sri /ra nang so'i gra pa mang du byung ba rnams mjal ma thag thams cad mkhyen pa dngos kyi gus 'dun gyis mchi ma 'byin zhing 'bul ba du ma byas/ bu khrul zhig la sman ja zhal gang gnang zhing dbu mdzad de la phreng ba dang sman gnang nas rdzong ba yin gsungs/ sgar nas nga 'bod mi yong gsung ba la ring por ma thogs par spre lo hor zla bcu pa la sgar nas bla ma yang ri ba dang de bzhin gshegs dbon gdan 'dren la byung / drung pas sprul sku rtsod med yin na 'di long zhig pa'i bden stobs dmod bor mdzad pa'i dar thums dang de'i zlar dar thums gcig ste ngo mi shes pa gnyis bskur te phul ba na dngos de dang po nyid tu the tshom med par bzhes/pho nya ba gnyis the tshom med pa'i dad pa skyes/ spre lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la rdzong gsar nas bteg ste 'o ma lung du sku 'dra la phyag nas mdzad/ rgya ston bya bral bas 'brang 1220

ra dgon du 'bul zhabs mdzad/ ru shod chos 'khor steng du a khu a khra sogs la khyed thams cad zhwa phud la sdod gsungs/ dgun 'di mgo grang 'dug zhus pas zhwa gyon na gtum mo bsgoms pa la dgos pa ci yod gsungs/ byuso legs nyes/ mgron sleb mi sleb sogs kyi mngon mkhyen ches mang zhing khyad par gting dpag dka' ba'i rnam par thar pa mthong ste a khu a khra bya ba'i dpyod ldan de cher dad/ tshang rag sum mdor sgang pa'i mgron gnyer ba byang chub 'od zer ja 'dren la slebs/ srung ba gnyis ngos 'dzin zhu ba la drung gong mas gnang ba de ngos bzung / chibs gong du mnal yur ba sangs —nas bla ma yang ri ba gzhi bdag thamasadze cad rta pa go khrab dar mdung can rkang thang dang bcas pa ja 'dren dang bsu ba snang gsungs/ de nas sgar du sprul pa'i sku dang zhabs phyir lho rong go'i shri pa dpon g.yog ri bo che pa'i mi sna dang bcas pa 'byon pa'i snga 'phar btang ba slebs khar nam zla dgun yin yang khu byug lan gsum du grag pa dang 'brug skad lan gsum du byung / rgyal tshab sprul sku la sogs pas gnyi ga gsan/gzhan kha cig gis khu byug gi skad thos/ la las 'brug tshor/ sgar dpon rnams kyis lho rong pa yum sras la ja 'dren phyag mjal byed/ sprul sku gnyis nges pa ma 'drongs kyi bar phyag mi 'bul mjal dar mi gtong zhes khrims byas pa lho rong ba la bskor ba na khyed rang sgar pa ci mdzad yin gsungs/ de nas spyi mdar mjal ba na dpon che chung thams cad dbang med du snang ba 'gyur te khrims rang dral nas phyag dang mjal dar phul/ thams cad mchi ma dang bcas te thugs rjes gzigs shig zer nas 'ur ding du song / sprul pa'i skus kyang nang so chos rin pa sogs la ngos 'dzin mdzad/ bya lo hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig la sgar du phebs/de dgong rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus spyan drangs te gzims gur du byon/ khyod kyis nga ngo e shes/ nga su yin pa 'dug gur dang bkod pa sngar dang e 'dra do/ 1221

gur 'di'i bdag po su yin zhus pas/ khyod ngas ngo shes/ snye bo go'i shri yin/khyed kyis kyang dbu skra ring po bzhag 'dug tho co ma byed/ gur dang bkod pa sngar dang 'dra do/ /gur gyi bdag po khyed yin gsungs/ drung gong ma'i drung 'khor zhig la ngos 'dzin dang dgyes dgyes mdzad/ tshes gsum gyi nyin drung gong ma'i sku phyam gser ma sku 'dra thang sku gser sku dbu zhwa nyin mo bde legs rnams ngos bzung / na bza' gser ma bsnabs shing 'khrab pa mdzad/ da dung ngas mi rdzogs 'dug gsungs/ tshes lnga'i nyin rgyal tshab rin po che'i las zhwa drung gong mas gnang ba gser gyi dbu zhwa seng dmar pos g.yogs pa dang las zhwa gzhan zhig gi sgam drung du bsgrigs pas 'di ngas khyed la byin pa de yin yang yang gsungs/ der thams cad mkhyen pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng du zhabs bzhag nas 'byon par brtsams pa dpon slob thams cad kyis bkag tshes bcu bdun gyi nyin dbon po bkra shis bzang gis thang sku dril ba gnyis phyag tu gtad pa na 'di mkha' 'gro ma zhig red gsungs nas phyir gnang ba sgrol mar 'dug 'di nga'i sku yin gsung ba drung gong ma'i bris skur 'dug lha rje 'jam dbyangs la khyod kyi khug ma na nga'i dngos po zhig yod gsungs te chibs 'dzam gling nor bu'i mchin pa ring bsrel can phyag tu bsnams/ nyin gcig a khu a khru dang mgron gnyer byang 'od gnyis la gros byed rgyu yod gsungs/ khyed sgar pa dpon slob sus kyang gros mi shes 'dug ngas ngos 'dzin/ de tsam byas na'ang lta mi dang go mi su yang mi 'dug a mdo ba'i bu dang bdag li'i bu gnyis la ngos 'dzin gyis zer zhing bsdad pas gros thag e chod/ drung pa snye bo go'i shri la'ang 'di mdzad mi 'dug lha dang zhes yang yang gsungs/ 'o gros tsug byed zhus pas gros thag sems la chod gsungs/ der rgya ston bya bral pa dpon slob brgya lhag kyang byon/khong gi gra pa zhig la thugs khro ba'i tshul gyis khyod la byin rlabs mi dgos/ khyod 1222

kyis nga la byas le yong gsungs nas byin rlabs ma gnang / rje'i rgyu dris pas spo bo chu mdo bas zar be gzims khang bshig pa'i dus nga yang dmag la yod pas de dgongs pa red/ da ni nga yang thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa yod zer/ de nas shar nub kyi sprul sku gnyi ga spyan drangs/ skye bo'i tshogs stong phrag du ma tshogs te sprul sku gnyis la lugs gnyis kyi dri ba/ ngos 'dzin bskul ba/ sun 'byin dma' 'bebs/ sdigs mo sogs sna tshogs pa byed pa na/ rje 'di ni ri rab ltar g.yo ba med/ snying rje chen po yang 'khrungs/ ngos 'dzin sogs kyang btang stoms su mdzad de mi g.yo bar bzhugs/ 'on kyang skabs su bab pa'i lugs gnyis kyi bka' bstsal ba rnams ni sus kyang ldog tu med/ a mdo sprul sku bas ni dgung lo bdun par son yang yab yum dang zas skom gyi ming tsam mkhyen/res 'ga' ngos 'dzin lha rten mchod cha gang zin zin gang 'dus 'dus bsnams nas 'byon/ res bshum zhing tab tab bor yang gyur/ khong gi srung 'khor ba gcod pa dang sngags par rlom pa 'gas kyang sngags kyi sbyor ba dang phaṭa shar byed pa sogs mi 'tshams pa du ma byas kyang ri rab la rlung ltar g.yo bar ma nus/'on kyang rje 'dis snyigs dus kyi 'dus ba blun po'i rang bzhin mkhyen pas ngos 'dzin ma mdzad/ khong gis lag gis gang zin thu bar shong tshad khyer ba na khong rang ge 'khor g.yog dang phyogs 'dzin gyi sgar pa rnams kyis rta brgyugs bsangs gsol du ma byas/ sgar pa rnams a mdo bas zang zing gis bsdus zin pas rgyal tshab rin po che'ang mdzad dka' ba na sprul sku rtsod med du 'dug na'ang da res la nged la dbang ma byung bas khyed rang sde pa khag gsum gyis shar gyi sprul sku gdan drongs gsungs pa na/ lung pa de rnams lho rong pa dang rgya ston pa'i mnga' zhabs yin pas sprul sku yin nges nas kyang khri thog tu mi 'don na nub phyogs pa 'khor bcas med par byed zer nas dmag gsog la zhugs/ des skar pa rnams 1223

rkyang skrag ste go'i sri rin po che'i drung du nga nyid kyis gang dgongs pa de yin zhus/ drung pa nyid la'ang shar gyi sprul sku phebs nas khyod nga la tshad mar mi 'dzin na gzhan byed rgyu ci yod gsungs nas bka' bkyon pa dang bud med dkar mo zhig gis dung chen po zhig khyer nas ngas 'di thams cad du bsgrags kyang khyod kyis tshags byed ma nyan zer nas khros pa dang / bud med dmar mo zhig khros nas khyod rdzun ma kho na'i kha la nyan/ da grib kyis bskyed pa'i nad drag po 'byung zer ba gzigs pas sgar pa thams cad kyang gnyid sad pa ltar gyur te hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor la seng ge'i khri chen por phebs te bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba mdzad/ sgar pa thams cad thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes te sngar nged rang tsho de 'drar 'khrul ba ci byung ngam zhes gleng / de'i tshe go'i shri rin po ches kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rje chos grags rgya mtsho 'od zer 'phro ba bzhugs 'dug gsungs nas phyag mdzad cing gzhan rnams — kyang phyag tshol gsungs/ 'dzam gling bdag po gong ma cing de'i 'bul ba'i thog ma yang na bza' gsol spyad sogs mtha' yas pa dang / ja sngar ma thon pa'i ngar ngad can zi phol dang thos bol dang a tra pa tra zer ba sogs mtha' yās pa bzhugs khri la phebs pa'i thog mar phul zhing 'di'i tshe 'brug cher grags zhing me tog gi 4mar dang 'ja' 'od byung / bya sngon ma mthong pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig byung nas re zhig bsdad/ khri thog tu phebs nas spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pas ja zhus 'bul zhabs rgya cher phul te mchog gi sprul pa'i skur nges shes bskyed par mdzad/ bya lo zla ba gsum pa'i nang du dbus gtsang du gtam snyan slebs te gar sde thams cad du dar 'phyar dang dga' spro cher byed pa bdag lo bcu pa zhig gis mthong / 'di phyin nas bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi zhal gzigs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gsung 'byon/ lkog gyur lung ston pa sogs ni da lta yi ger snang ba 1224

yang brjod kyis mi lang / khyad par brag gsum sku skye'i zhen pa 'dzin pa'i sgar pa rnams kyis lkog tu skur zhus byas pa thams cad so so la dngos su bka' bstsal bas dad par mdzad/ a mdo ba la thugs rjes 'dzin par dgongam rung ma nyan par phyir song ba bsod nams nyams pas mthong chos la mi dge ba rnam par smin/ go'i shri rin po ches stag lo nas yos lo'i bar gar byon zhus pa sa stag lo la nga shi nas dga' ldan dang bde ba can du bsdad pas skyid po byung / mi rnams la yi chad pas skye ba mi len bsam na'ang byams mgon dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis yang yang bskul te skye ba blangs nas da lo bar lho rong du bsdad kyang khyed sgor pas gsur ma nyan gsungs/ de ltar gzhon nu rol rtsed kyi rnam thar cung zad tsam dge slorwa༄nga chub bzang po zhes bya ba drung gong ma'i dpon chen a khu a khra zhes grags pa des bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar las bsdus pa yin la 'di phyin gyi mdzad pa sa bon tsam nyid la nyid kyis bstod pa dang sbyar te brjod par bya'o/ / de yang zla med ston pa'i bstan pa gang yin pa/ /'phyug med dngos nyid legs par btsal byas nas/ /yang dag tshul la bsnyen pa'i rtul zhugs can//bstan la nges par rdzogs der gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngos la zhugs shing rdzogs pa'i rnam par thar pa ste/ de yang thun mong gi bstan pa'i dbang du byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phyug med ni 'dul ba yin la de yang so thar ris bdun las dge rkyel ni bstan pa la zhugs pa tsam dang dge slong gi sdom pa ni bstan pa la rdzogs pa ste brtan mkhas kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa ni gnas brtan ston pa lta bu nyid yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'khor ba me 'bar ba'i klong lta bu las sems can thams cad gdon par bya ba'i theg chen gyi nges par 'byung bas kun nas bslangs te thog mar dgung lo bdun 122 5

pa'i tshe nyid na rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku bkra shis rnam rgyal dpal bzang bo las theg pa chen po'i dge bsnyen yongs rdzogs yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong dang bcas pa nod par mdzad cing bar ma dge ba'i ngo bor rten galho la'i drung du gtsug phud phul zhing rab byung gi rtags bzhes pa dang chos skyabs grags pa dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gsol ba dang sangs rgyas mnyan pa las dge tshul gyi dngos po sgrub par mdzad cing phyis dgung lo nyer gcig pa na phag lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer gsum la dge 'dun sgang pa'i 'dren pa sras dgra can zin bzang po'i sku'i bkod ba brtan pa'i yan lag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu phrag lnga lhag pa lon zhing / mkhas pa'i yan lag sde sgod gsum la 'dzin mkhas gsal rig gi lnga tshan bzhi rdzogs shing rdo rje'i theg pa las mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa dpal chos grub seng ge'i zhabs kyis mkhan po dang / garma pa'i 'phrin las pa chen po phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas las byed pa'i slob dpon/ sgam po'i dge 'dun mang po'i mkhan po dpal shākya bzang pos gsangs ste ston pa/ grib tshod pa bla ma dpon yig pa bkra shīs bzang po la sogs pa bdun gyi tshogs las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang dag par nod cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i mdzad pa mtha' dag la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang tha mi dad par gyur to/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i dbang du byas na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phyug med dngos ni theg pa chen po yin la gang theg pa chen por 'jog byed ni byang chub kyi sems rin po che kho nar zad la de yang smon pa'i sems 'dun pa la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis yang dag par zhugs pa dang 'jug pa'i sems gter lta bu la sogs pha rol du phyin pa thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis legs par rdzogs pa'am/ yang na kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rgya chen pos gzhan don gzugs kyi sku'i bar yang dag pa ra zhugs pa dang don dam byang chub kyis sems 'khor /226

gsum yongs su dag pas rang don chos nyid kyi skur yang dag par rdzogs pa ste dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag nyid las byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i chu bo mtha' yas pa thams cad nod cing rgyal ba'i sras chen po thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyi 'jug ngogs gcig pu par gyur to/ /rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa'i dbang du byas na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phyug med dngos ni rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa nyid yin la 'di nyid la rdo rje'i slob dpon dam pa de rnams nyid las smin byed dbang gis bsnyen pa dang grol byed kyi lam las rdzogs pa'am/ yang na sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin dbang snga ma gsum gyi lam gyis sku rdo rje mngon byang lnga'i bdag nyid mchog gi sprul ba'i sku dang gsung rdo rje bden don bcu gnyis kyis bdag nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku dang thugs rdo rje dga' ba bcu drug gi bdag nyid chos kyi sku'i ngo bor yang dag par bsnyen pa dang / ye shes rdo rje dbang bzhi pa'i lam phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis lhan cig skyes pa'i skur yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs kyi bdag por mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa nyid mngon du mdzad pa'o/ /bcas dang rang bzhin kha na ma tho'i chos/ /ltar snang dam pa'i chos su bcos pa rnams/ /sbun ltar phyi rol gyur pa nyid gzigs nas/ /don bzang legs bshad 'doms der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ni sdom pa gsum gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs yongs su spang sa pa'i rnam par thar pa ste/ de yang so thar gyi skabs su rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ni gang spyad na mtho ris dang thar pa la sgrib pa de yin la bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba ni zla 'jog gi spang ba sogs rgyud nas 'dod pa che ba'am g.yeng ba'i rgyur cung zad 'gyur ba rnams so/ /byang sdom gyi rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ni rang nyid ngan song du skye ba la 'jigs pas mi nag 1227

mdung thung can lta bu mi dgrol ba sogs yin la de'i bcas pa ni gzhan sems srung bar bcas pa lta bu ste 'das na brgyud nas gzhan don la cung zad gnod pa'o/ /sngags sdom gyi rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba ni gang spyad na rtsa lhung du 'gyur ba rnams te phung sogs la lha min par dogs pa'i the tshom dang / chos nyid du dmigs pa sogs kyang yin la/ bcas pa ni tshogs gral du las kyi rdo rje bslab pa rgan pas byin pa len pa na ye shes kyis rgan pa ma gtogs pas sngon du phyag byed dgos par bstan pa lta bu ste 'das na rdo rje spun la ma gus pa sogs kyi nyes pa'i cha tsam 'dren pa'o/ /mdor na las kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu la mkhas pas theg pa so so'i las kyi rnam par gzhag pa thams cad la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa brnyes shing rgyu 'bras mngon sum du gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan pas blang dor gyi mtshams rgyal bas ji ltar du bstan pa rnams las cung zad kyang mi 'da' ba ste/ de yang deng sang bod yul na bstan pa rnying ches pas grub mtha' dang chos lugs tha dad pa khas 'che ba mang mod kyi bstan pa dngos su chud nus pa ni shin tu nyung ste/ nyan thos par 'jog pa la 'khor ba'i btson ra las thar ba'i myang 'das 'thob 'dod kyi bsam pa dgos kyang deng dus tshe 'di'i grags snyan rnyed bkur kho na bsgrub byar byed par mthong bas nyan thos par mi chud/theg chen pa la gzhan phan gyi bsam pa 'ba' zhig dgos kyang deng sang dgra phyoṭa la gnod 'khyol na grub rtags su rtsi bar snang bas theg chen par mi 'gyur/sngags sdom gyi tshe chos thams cad yi dam gyi lhar dag dgos kyang snang tshad dgrar langs kyi sngags pa la de'i re ba ci/ des na bod yul pa rnams spang blang gi mig ldongs te sdom pa gsum gyi lag len srung mtshams thams cad 'khrugs te bcas rang gi kha na ma tho pa spang byar bstan pa rnams lag tu len pa sogs chos ltar bcos pa kho na zing zing por gyur pa na de thams cad sbun pa ltar spangs te blang 1228

dor yang dag par ston pa'o/ /'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma thams cad pa/ /yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes las 'byung sems nas/ /zlog med mos pa gong 'phel phul byung ba/ /dad pa'i pha rol son der gsol ba 'debs/ /rtes pa ni chos kyi rtsa ba dad pa'i mchog mnga' ba'i rnam par thar pa ste/ de yang thar pa'i rtsa ba ni dad pa kho na yin la de la so so skye bo rnams ni thos byung gi shes rab tsam gyis dad par zad la/ byang sems 'phags pa rnams kyang skyes pa'i rabs rgya mtsho rnams su goms pa tsam gyis 'jug par zad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis ni phan yon yang dag par mngon sum du gzigs pas na gus pa rab kyi mthar son pa yang dag par mnga' ba ste gsang ba ring bsrel gyi mchod rten gzigs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyang bshums mo mdzad cing bla gos mchod rten la gsol ba lta bu'i phyir/ de bas na dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag bsten par mdzad pa'i tshe yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo+o bo nyid dang / thar pa'i 'jug ngogs snang bar byed pa dang bdud kyi phyogs nub par byed cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sgo ston pa'i 'byang gnas gcig pu par mkhyen pas ༄bkur sti dang sri zhu dang rim gro dang phu dud mchog gis bsten par mdzad la tha na ku re tsam du'ang bka' mi ldog pas mnyes pa thams cad kyis mnyes par mdzad cing ji ltar rgya mtsho la chu bo rnams bzhin du rig pa'i gnas lnga sde sgod gsum rgyud sde bzhi bka' bstan bcos thams cad kyi chu bo 'jug pa'i chu gter gcig pu par gyur to/ /thog mar go'i sri rin po che las chos gsan pa'i dus de dag tu'ang sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi gzigs snang dang / drung gong ma'i rnam thar du ma gsung zhing bzhugs gnas bad sgrom gyi bkod pa gsung ba dang / drung dpal 'ibyor don grub la bla ma gcod pa rab tu byung tshul sogs sngon gnas gsung ba dang / go'i shri rin po ches sngon rong po par 1229

—thang du drung gong ma'i bcu bzhi mchod pa mdzad tshe phyag mchod kyi chu dri ro babam̐ng por gyur pa sogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul gsungs/ drung pa'i sku srung gi nang na drung na rim gyi gdung ring bsrel thams cad bzhugs spro so sor ngos bzung zhing phyag sgam nas phyag dpe zhig la 'di ci lags zhus pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag dpe po ti dkar thung ma yin gsungs shing zhal phye nas glegs shing gi gam pak+ki'i sku 'di chos grags rgya mtshos bris le red gsungs/ gzhan yang gzigs snang gi tshogs mtha' yas shing nges don gyi chos skad ngo mtshar ba mang po gsungs/ yul phyogs de dag gi mi ma yin thams cad kyis gus par btud/bde ba can la sogs pa'i bkod pa gsungs shing sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ser por 'dug gsungs/ yang zur mang rin po che blo gros rgya mtsho ba dang sku skye rgyal bzang pa drung na bzhugs pa la/ da lta yi ge la bris gsungs nas/ sangs rgyas 'od srung yang nga yin/ mar me mdzad kyang nga yin/ ber nag can yang nga yin gsungs/ drung bkra shis don grub pas gsa' phu bla ma dpon yig bkra shis bzang po dang gsol ja ba nam mkha' sogs btang ba slebs༄/ dpon yig pas zham ring 'bral med du mdzad/ bya lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu nas rdzong gsar nas mdo khams shar phyogs su bteg rngu chu brgal/ 'di thams cad du gzigs snang mang / ri bo che pas zhabs tog cher mdzad/ chos rje 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bstan pa dbyar gyi chu bo ltar rgyas pa'i rten 'brel byung rigasungs/ lha khang rnams mjal zhing bar khang du sku 'dra che ba zhig la rab gnas ma legs par 'dug pa bgegs skrod dang rab gnas bskyar ma mdzad pas phyag nas zug 'bum gsum chos khri khar skye bo khri tsho la chos gsungs shing kha mchu rnams zhi bar mdzad/ phyogs glang chos grags chos bgro ba gzigs/ nyid kyi 'khrungs sa gzigs gsungs nas der tshogs gtor mdzad pa na mdun ri'i 1230

smyo ri ///sgo //rdospro mtho cho thorngasang //15rtsar ba da na pad+mas/ nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sta/ khyod na rgyal ba ma ga dbyangs so/ /dbyer med rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ /gsung ba gsan/ sa sgang pa yon mchod kyis bsu ba'i tshe ra khyu zhig phyag phyir bkag ma thub par 'brangs pa sngon gyi mi ma yin 'dul 'phro glags ltar byung pa la dam can bran du bkol nas tshar bcad pa yin gsungs/ sa sgang gi gdan sar bstan pa rgyal mtshan bskos/ de dag tu mgon po phyag drug pa dang ber nag can yang yang gzigs/re sne dgon du dpal ldan bkra shis bskos/ kur dbon bkra shis grags pa ja 'dren la byung ba la khyod kyi mig g.yas pa la ci byung gsungs/ kurma pa dang ri bo che ba 'thab tshe shor ba yin zhus pas/ khyed kha gnyis su rgyal yang bstan pa la bya ba mi byed de ka yin gsungs/ rta dbon a rag dang rong po shākya'i bar do'i rnam shes gzigs/ rje don ldan zhabs sku bltams gnas ngom shel khyam du nam mkha' rmel mtshan bskos/ garmar bsu ba chen pos spyan drangs shing dag pa'i gzigs snang ches mang ngo/ /rim gyis li thang du phebs te 'bul nod mtha' yas shing gzhi bdag mkha' 'gro ma des mdun ri'i rtser spyan drangs/ de'i dad pa'i rten du zhabs rjes kyang byung / dus der go'i shri rin po che zhing 'di'i mdzad pa rdzogs pas mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya cher gnang /thub chen gyi gser tho ga rgyur ja brgya mdzo lnga bcu/ gser zho stong phrag gcig zangs dos bcu bzhi sogs dbus su brdzangs/ 'dob spang phug tu bla ma nang so bskos shing sgrub sde gsar du mdzad/ dung khyeng mgo dang 'gom sgang du phebs/ mda' lang du rab stong tshar sgang gi gzhi bdag gzhag ra lha rtses srog snying phul/ nyag rong gru khar khong mchod yon rnams kyis gru kha phan tshun gyi gzhis ma lag phul/ mkhas pa 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i sgrub gnas dzālan+dha rar zhig gso'i zhal bkod gnang / rab spang gi grub thob rnam gsum dang mkhas pa mi 1231

lnga'i dgo na chen bka' bzhi/ stong mgo rin chen gling / byams gsar/ ra/ti dga' ldan gling rnams su phebs/ so so'i mkhon slob dge 'dun thams cad kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa dang / khri 'buladu ma byas shing gus pa thob/ zhingazhe mi chen gyis spyan drangs te dar rtse mdor phebs/ pho brang shin du ho/ 'gag jus/li jus/ 'go thum sogs kyi skye bo bgrang ba las 'das pa la chos 'bre'adzimadzad/slar ra tir phebs/ rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal bla mar bskos/ de yang dus der rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i rdo rje slob dpon rigs kyi bdag por 'os pa ni spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa yin yang mdo khams su phebs ma thub pa dang drung gong ma dpon slob mjal phrad phyi ma ma 'grig pa'i rten 'brel gyis zhal mjal ba zhig ma shar/ drung gong ma nyid kyis zhal chems su dngos slob kyi nang nas bla ma'i 'os 'thu mdzad pa na'ang sangs rgyas mnyan pa la bsngags pa che ba dang spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pas kyang drung 'di'i bla mar mnyan pa grub thob pa 'os zhes gsungs la/ go'i shri rin po che las brgyud pa'i dbang man ngag du ma gsan yang ring por mi thogs par mya ngan las 'das/ sngon gyi bu slob thams ༄cad kyis mjal ba na yang rje btsun bkra shis rnam gnyis la thugs dad par gyur te dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsnyen pa'i rten 'brel kyang mdzad/ rje btsun de dag la'ang bla ma dang yi dam chos skyong gis lung bstan te byi ba lo zla ba bcu gcig pa nas — rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i drung du dang por so thar gyi sdom pa nos te de'i bslab bya ston pa'i gzhung che chung rnams dang / shing rta'i srol gnyis las byang chub tu sems bskyed de de'i bslab bya ston pa'i spyod phyogs kyi gzhung 'grel man ngag rnams dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams su dbang bskur bas smin par mdzad nas rtsa bshad phyi ma dang phyi ma'i phyi ma la sogs pa'i rgyud chen po 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pa rnams dang / deng sang rgya bod du grags pa'i 1232

man /ga gi gtso bo sbyor drug lam 'bras zhi byed/ gcod yul/ shangs chos/jo/ sdol/ blo sbyong la sogs pa'i man ngag mtha' dag dang / khyad par mnyam med dwags po bka' rgyud kyi byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa mar me gcig las gnyis pa mched pa ltar thugs la 'phos pas byin rlabs kyi bka' babs rdzogs par gyur la/ 'di dag gi tshe/ rab ko bar/ ra 'og la/ tsher lung mda'/kre yul dom tsha nang sogs nas jo nang pa'i chos grwa chen po dzam thang gi bar du phebs/ khong rnams kyis 'bul zhabs ni mtha' yas/ 'ji ga lha mo dar thog tu bzhugs thog 'dzam gling bdag po cing de rgyal pos chos kyi rje de bzhin gshegs pa ta'i ming rgyal pos spyan drangs pa'i ga'u le bzhin rje mi bskyod rdo rje pho brang du spyan 'dren pa'i lung phebs nas rgya bod kyi gse༄ra yig pa dom tsha ho tsi dang / pho brang gi mi chen tha'i kyen li'u yun 'khor bcas mngags/ pho brang nas bteg nas zhag bcu song ba nas du gang rdo rje bzang po la sogs pa'i gser yig pa rnams drung du mngags pa slebs/ de ma thag mgron gnyer grags blo dang bcas pa lhan du brdzangs/ bla ma rgyal ba rigs lnga gcig bsdus pa'i/ /rnam 'phrul rigs gsum mgon po /rma pas/ /bkra shis byas nas hu tsi rgyal sras pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan bsam don 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam bkur/ 'dra yul dang rong po me ba'i mtshams tsher lung mdar dgon pa 'debs pa'i cha rkyen dang bka' bkod mdzad de 'dra bla ma chos kyi 'od zer bskos/ dom tsha si li thang du phebs/ ci nang du 'phags pa klu sgyeb gzigs nas bstod pa mdzad/ lcags mo thong rje nang du phebs/ 'grus khang chos rje bsod nams rgya mtsho la 'das ma 'ongs kyi lung bstan bka' shog gnang / gling drung pa ting 'od pa khu dbon gyis spyan drangs/ zil mdar phebs/ khri rwa can gyi 'bul ba dang dbon gyis thog drangs pa'i gra pa yang brgya lhag phul/ der 13tritri

lcags mo kun ting go'i shri 'od zer rgyal mtshan pa la 'das ma 'ongs kyi lung bstan chab shog tu gnang / gling drung pa la lung bstan du ma dang gad1sa pa gnang / tsher phur drung pa grub thob pa la dus 'khor 'grel chen gsano pa na dus kyi 'khor lo dang rje mi la gzigs pa rje grub thob pa la thim par gzigs nas bstod par mdzad/ 'grus khang chos rje dang sbom 'bor ba rnams kyis nan gyis spyan drangs tshe hor sog rgyug par 'dug pas mi 'gro gsungs kyang dpon rnams dbang che bas thegs tshe/ drung pa grub thob la khyed zhabs mi bde bas bros mi thar gsungs nas bzhugs su gsol/ la kha zhig nas gzigs pa tsam la ru sde rnams sog pos btab nas phyir mgyogs par phebs/ 'di res sog pos gnod 'tshe shin tu che/ gnyan byang chub dgon/ stag rong tsha/ stag gzig a leb nang / skyo mda' brgyud de rkarmar phebs/ rdo rje gdan du thub dbang lnga sde dang bcas pa gzigs/ sgo nga la thog brgyud nas sgom sde snye thang du phebs/rdza chu kha ra ba thang du phebs/ tha'i kyen chen pos brdzangs pa'i mi dpon las ka can gsum/ bod kyi tsha thog thu gon sogs rgya 'grul lnga brgya lhag slebs/ gong gi 'bul yig tha'i kyen chen po'i zhu yig pho brang du 'byon dgos tshul dang bcas pa slebs/ slar garmar phebs/ rje dus mkhyen gyi sku 'dra'i drung du bzhugs pa mdzad dus rje dus mkhyen gyis da lan rgya nag tu ma 'gro gsung ba gzigs/drung bsod nams rnam rgyal kurma'i si dhur bskos/ si dhu bkra shis dpal 'byor ba'i sku skye chos kyi 'od zer la sga shubs stan dmar gnang / de ltar lo ngo hril po phyed gsum tsam du nyin mtshan bar med du dbang lung bshad pa nyams khrid rnams gsan/ de'i don thugal nyams su bzhes/ phyag dpe gzigs rtog gi sgo nas dogs pa'ang 'phral du gcod par mdzad cing ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen rtogs phul du byung / bdag gis 'bul ba'i tshul tsam las mi dgos par 'dug 1234

gathungs nas grub thob chen po nyid rang yang gus pa phul du phyin pa 'khrungs/ da ni kho bo'i bsam pa mthar phyin/ tshe yang 'di tsam ran pa yin gsungs nas mya ngan 'as 'da' bar bstan te de'i tshe/ /chos dbyings rab 'byam phyag rgya che brnyes shing / /ma rig nas bzung rga shi 'gags gyur kyang / /gnyis snang skye bo'i rtag 'dzin gzhom slad du/ /gzugs sku'i snang brnyan sdud par cha/dzad pa la/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi 'bod do kye ma kye/ /zhes gsungs pas lha chen gyi dpung pa g.yas par grub thob chen po dngos su byon/ zab rgyas kyi gsung byon nas yal bar gzigs/ de phyin nas rje btsun bkra shis 'od zer bsten par mdzad de bde dgyes gsang 'jigs mā gdan sogs kyi rgyud sde chen po mtha' dag gi phyag len bshad pa man ngag thams cad dang brgyud pa'i man ngag thams cad dang khyad par drung gong ma las gsan pa'i zab chos mtha' dag bum pa gcig nas gcig tu byo ba ltar gsan par mdzad/ thun mong gi snang ba ni sangs rgyas mnyan pa sku gshegs rjes ri bo che tsha ba sgang brgyud nas la bar dgon du phebs/ byams chen la phyag nas mdzad pas nas bre gsum 'thor ba phyis bsdus pas bre bdun byung skad/ sum pa gru mgo zla dgon sogs nas gon gyo' sa rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sgrub gnas 'du long dgon du phebs/ slar dmar khams mod 'gram brgyud/ slob dpon pad+ma'i sgrub gnas rdo rje gro lod du gzigs snang du ma gtan la phab cing zhabs rjes byung / gser 'bum sgang dang 'bri chu gru kha brgyud/ ba thang shas su phebs/ be+e ro tsa na'i gnas sgo phye/ gnas sgor gam po rdo rje dpal brtsegs kyis btud de dar dkar po cig phul zhing zhi ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par zhus/ rje dus mkhyen dbra re dge chos brtson dang bcas pa'i zhal gzigs/ le thang du phebs te rgya 'grul khing kras gsum gyis ja 'dren 'bul nod phul/ dom tsa hu ci slebs te gong gi 'ja' sa dang 'bul ba phul/ nyag 1235

(( rong gru khar zhabs rjes byung / chor lung mdo/ shel khog jo gi dgon/ /zhil ra ma sgang sogs su phebs/ der dbus nas 'dan ma khrims dpon pas7'bri gdan gyi dbang gnyis kyi zhu yig dang / spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgye yig 'bul ba dang spyan 'dren la slebs/ khong la snga phyir bka' lung ji ltar phebs pa rnams gsungs pa na sngon gyi gsung ji lta bar byung nas dad pa lhag par skyes/de ma thag lcags mo go'i shis bris kyang mjal/ 'ga' thag tu phebs dus rab sgang gi gzhi bdag rnams kyis bsu bar gziṭa/ 'brug lo zla ba bzhi pa la ra ti dga' ldan gling du phebs nas gser yig pa rnams kyis mjal bar snang ste 'di rnams kyi dus rje dul mo ba las gsan bsam sgom pa khor mor mdzad pa snang ngo/ /phyis rnam thos kyi ri bor bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i tshe mkhan po las tshe dpag med grub rgyal lha mang gi tshe dbang dang rnam sras mdung dmar can chos skyong du phul zhing gzhan stong gi bshad chen du ma mdzad nas lta ba 'dzin dgos par zhus pa las phyis phar phyin jo zi'i lugs su 'grel bar mdzad/ 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud phul te bstan pa la bya ba mdzad par zhus/ zab lam yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor snying por dril ba yang gsan/ bsnyen rdzogs 'bul tshe sna ma sbyar gser ma la rje 'phrin las pas gser ma la byin rlabs mi chags zhus pa mkhan po se gol mdzad cing 'di khong la gser du snang ba yin par 'dug gam garma pa la gser dang bong ba la khyad par ci yod gsungs skad/ bsnyen rdzogs phul nub/ ngas rje'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs phul zin nas kong po da la'i ri rtser nga rang blo bde bar bsdad pa rmis/ tshe dbang phul nub/ ngas sā tsha btab pas sā tsha rnams las 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba byung ste bstan pa la bya ba chen po mdzad par 'dug gsung / mkhan chen rin po che'i phyag phyi pa rnams kyis bstod pa brtan bzhugs shig zhus pa na rnam thar gyi tshul las mi ring bar sham+bha lar thegs 1236

pa'i༈lung bstan dang bcas pa zhig gnang / sngon bsnyen rdzogs 'bul du phebs mar rje zha lu lo tsā ba la thugs dam brtag pa zhus pas bsnyen rdzogs bar chad med par 'bul thub cing yar phebs nas nged rang mjal tsam yong gasnyang ba nas bsnyen rdzogs 'bul thub ma thag nas yar thugs rings pa mdzad/ bka' drin gtang rag gi mchod sbyin rgya cher spros pas nyang kha brgyud nas thegs/ long po'i nags khrod cig tu gdan bzhes mdzad pa na gsol ja bas me ma bsad par bzhag pa mched nas nags tshal cher sreg cing rlung chen pos ded de chibs rags las brgal ba tsam du byung ba na rgyal chen gtor ma de deng sang ma byung ba yin par 'dug da lta shoms gsungs nas chibs las gzhol te gtor ma bsngos nas me'i steng du 'phen pa gnang ma thag chus bsad pa ltar zhi zhes thos/ rgyal chen gling du phebs nas rje lo chen dang mjal zhing dgyes par gyur te mi ring ba na cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul mdzad/ sham+bha lar chos 'dzugs pa 'phyis yong ba 'dugaseng ge slebs byung gding ba gtod gsungs nas mya ngan las 'das/ rje lo chen la mi zhu bar byas kyang khyed tshos gsangs pas mi thub/ da ni kho bo'ang 'gro gsungs te de ma thag gshegs par thos/ rje 'phrin las zhabs las thog mar mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal nyin re thun gsum gyis gsan par mdzad pa na thun mang du spar bar zhus pas de ltar na gsan lo las mi yong ngam gsung ba na slar tshig don rnams ji lta ba bskyar bas thun brgyad dgu tsam mdzad de zla ba gnyis tsam gyis dpyis phyin par mkhyen nas/ slar byams chos gzhan bzhi/tshad ma kun las btus pa rnam 'grel nges/ rigs thig gyes pa'i bstan bcos bzhi/ mngon ba gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ dbu ma rtsa she 'jug brtag — gnyis rtsis kun bsdus pa sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams dang / bod yul gyi rngog lo dang phya gtsang gi yig chaḍa sa paṇa gyi sdom rig la sogs mdor na 1237

— /gzhung chen nyer lnga'i tshig don thams cad bde blag gis khong du chud par mdzasko/de dag gi bar rnams su dbang rjes gnang man ngag khrid gsan pa ni mtha' mes/de ltar gsan pa'i yun lo ngo gsum zla ba dngos bcu bzhi la gsan bsam bar ma chad pa lo gcig kho nar snang rung de srid gsol ja'ang cung zad las mi bzhes par nyin mtshan bar med par tshig don bsam pa dka' gnas la dogs dpyad rgal brtag sogs kyi chos so so'i gting dpogs par mdzad de/ slob dpon rin po ches kyang 'di lta bu'i thugs kyi brtson pa dang mkhyen pa zhes bsngags par mdzad/ /rma lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis las ka tsan sogs brda sprod yan lag dang bcas pa sbyong ba'i tshul bstan/ mdor na/ legs bshad byis pa dag las kyang / /mkhas pa rnams kyis yongs su len/ /zhes pa ltar gang zag 'di lta bu zhig chos 'di lta bu zhig la 'dris so zhes grags pa thams cad la'ang de las brtsams pa'i dgyes pa dang mthong bkur mdzad/ de'i dri ba dpyis phyin par mdzad/ spyir mkhas pa'i yon tan ji lta bu zhig gis kyang thugs ka mi khengs/chung ngu las mi shes pa rnams la'ang brnyas pa mi mdzad/ bod tsam na 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa dag dhang du 'ongs pa na yang zil gyis non te dri lan zhu mi nus shing cung zad zhus pa rnams la'ang phyis 'gyod pa'i gnas su 'gro 'on kyang nged rang shes rab chung thos pa dman pas ci yang mi shes gsung ba 'ba' zhig 'byon zhing de yang khengs skyung tsam min pa thugs thag pa nas de ltar dgongs par snang / phyis su dbus gtsang la phebs pa sogs kyi skabs su'ang dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad ldan gzigs na sa dge 'bri stag jo zhal gsar rnying su'i khrod na 'dug rung bshes gnyen du bsten zhing bkur sti mdzad pa kho nar dgongs 'dug kyang de lta bu'i yul su yang ma byung bas slar rje btsun bkra shis rnam gnyis dang sangs rgyas mnyan pa la thugs dad pa mi phyed par 'phel ba'i rkyen du 1238

song ste rje bla ma'i spyan sngar bsnyen pa'i rabs de lta bu byuX ba'i sde la sogs pa mdzad/ spyir gzhung chen rnams la rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs las bka' bgror yod par snang zhing sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zab gnad rnams le brgyud pa'i man ngag las byung ba dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i gasdi/nga las byung ba zhes tha dad du ston par mdzad pas na dge ba'i bshes gnyen longs sprul la dngos su bsnyen zhing byang sems thams cad dang choja/ bgro na'ang deng dus la stos pa'i legs bshad sna cung zad re gsan pa la'ang dgyes tshor dang rjes su yi rang ba du ma mdzad/ rje shākra mchog pa'i slob ma paṇa chen rdor rgyal ba dang bya 'jam pa'i dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo la mkhas zhes de dus grags pa nas so sor bka' shog gis bskul ba gnang / chos kyi 'bel gtam gnang bar bzhed cing dpyad par bzod na yongs 'dzin du bsten par dgongs kyang paṇa chen pa'ang nges par bla ma 'chol na 'byon bya ba sogs deng sang gi skye bo dag gi srol rnyed bkur gyi ched du gtsigs dbab pa'i zhu ba phul/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku me ri'i gseb thams cad lañtsa'i yi ge phyir bstan 'phro ba gzigs pas rten 'brel mi 'grig par dgongs nas bka' nan ma gnang phyis 'bri khung du phebs tshe khang gsar chen mor gzhi len gyi bzhugs gral gyi gral 'phros gzhi len pa'i gtso bor khong bzhugs pa la bdag la bka' phebs te sdom gsum rab dbyer/ nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad la/ /'dul ba mi 'dra bco brgyad yod/ / ོzer ba de lta na grub mtha'ang bco brgyad yod yong bas mi 'dra ba ci lta bu yod gsung ba'i bka' lung bsgyur ba na gsung che zhing gdangs dang bcas pas mngon pa dang dbu tshad la grags pa'i bye mdo'i thar thor mang du zhu ba mdzad kyang /da sde ba bco brgyad kyi grub mtha'i khyad par dris gsungs/ de dag la lan byis pa ༄mgu byed sa stong 'gog pa tsam mang du phul yang da 'o na grub mtha' bco 1239

— brgyad po zhu rgyu med zer ba e yin dris gsung zhing rjes su gsung 'dar ba dang bcas pa chung ngu'i sgo nas don gyisu de ltar yin tshul zhal bzhes mdzad song /yang bye smra rang rig khas mi len bar 'dug mdo sde pa khas len par 'dugasems tsam pa rang rig don dam du 'dod par 'dug dbu ma pa rang rig 'gog par 'dug sngags nas rang rig na 'tshang rgya bar bshad 'dug rang rig de rnams kyi khyad par ci yin dris phebs pa na/ snga ma las gsung chung zhing 'dar bas tshad ma ba'i gzung rnam 'dzin rnam sogs kyi 'brel mi che ba mang du zhus/ mthar 'o na rang rig de rnams kyi khyad par mi shes zer ba yin nam dris gsungs te mthar gsung chung ngus de ltar zhal bzhes mdzad song zhing gral grol ba na/ spyir nged rang gsung rab thams cad la 'dris po yod pa'i lugs yin/khyad par kha sing nas phebs par tshor ba nas nyin mtshan med par dpe cha bltas/brjed pa bsos/ khyad par 'di 'dra la dri ba 'ong ngam bsam tshad bltas pa yin te nged rang gi bltas pa tsho la tshig gcig kyang dri ba mdzad ma byung / ci yin nam gsung skad de/ mngon par mkhyen pa yin nam dgongs par 'dugade nas 'dul ba la mkhan po med par sdom pa skye'am bya ba sogs kyi dri ba phra mo yod pa'i shog dril gcig gzhan phar tshad mngon pa dbu ma sngags spyi khyad par du dus 'khor te so so'i spyi bshad tho re ba yod pa'i shog dril bdun la de thams cad kyi lta ba gzhan stong du gnas par bris pa'i shog dril rnams phul/de la 'dul ba'i skabs dka' gnad mi 'dug pas nged kyi 'dul ṭīka stos/ spyir 'di thams cad lta ba gzhan stong du gnas pa mi rigs zhes pa'i lan zhig gnang /de la lan sgrub byed 'dra phul byung ba rnams la/ yang lan shin tu ngo mtshar pa zhig gnang ba la chos bzhin gyi lan gzhan med par 'di 'dra gnang na garma pa la mi tsho ma dad pa skye 'ong zer ba tsam las ma byung / 'on kyang mkhas pa'i mthong 1240 ོ

bdag rkyen dbu 'don du bgro ba mdzad/ bya yul nas 'jam dbyangs chos rjes phyag dpe dkon zhing dngos gtsang ba po ti nyis brgyar nye ba phul te bdag gi yon tan gang shes ni 'di tsho la bltas pas byung ba yin zhes zhus/ phyi5 shangs chos 'khor nas dus 'khor rab 'byams pa bya ba zhig bkas bskul te drung du 'ongs pa ni sngon dus 'khor la gra skor dang cho ga sogs mkhyen pa zhig yin yod 'dug pa slar dbang rgyud 'grel gyi bshad lung skyed rdzogs thams cad kyis rjes su bzung ste dad pa thob ces thos/ mdor na gtsang dbus thams cad du phebs pa la'ang lcang ra rab 'byams pa de chu/khas po 'dug gsung ba dang / 'bras yul 'jam gsar ba de yon tan rang mi che par 'dug ste btsun pa rang yin nges shig 'dug gsung ba dang / yon tan gang sa nas rje 'chi med pa rang rlabs che bar 'dug khong gi de la'ang zad rgyu zhig ni 'dug gsungs shing dbus gtsang phyogs na rgyud tshod ni 'bri khung mgon rgyal kho na mtho bar 'dug gsung ba rnams bdag gis mngon sum du thos/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa'i sprul pa'i sku dkon mchog yan lag dang rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku grags pa dpal 'byor ba gnyis la ni bla ma dngos kyi 'du shes las gzhan pa slob ma'i 'du shes mi mdzad/mdor na chos thams cad dge ba'i gshes gnyen du rtag —bar gzigs par snang ngo /tshe 'di'i grags 'byor snying pos dben pa'i tshul/ / tshig tsam min par snying nas rab rtogs te/ /zhen log sred pa bral ba'i rnam thar can/ 5 /dgos med dran pa brtan der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ni 'jig rten blos btang gi rnam par thar pa ste/ sngon sgar pa mang pos sprul sku nub phyogs pa la bkur sti byed cing sto rong skor du 'phral gyi zhabs tog ngan pas 1241

'tsho bar mdzad pa na'ang nyid thugs shin tu dgyes te khong rang sgar pa la sku skye gzhan na yod par snang bas kho bo la sku skye'i ming mi dgos par 'dug de'i tshegayeng ba med par chos tshul bzhin du byas chog pa cig yong dgongs nas shin tu mnyes par byung skad/ tha'i kyen chen pos mjal pa'i snga lo 'jang yul du spyan drangs/ sa tham rgyal pos spyi bor bkur zhing 'bul zhabs mtha' yas/ rgyal po nyid kyis skor du bzhugs pa'i gtan gyi mchod gnas mdzad par zhus kyang ma gnang / 'on kyang dgon pa gsar 'debs mang po mdzad/ rab 'byams pa brtan blo sogs bla mar bskos te 'phrin las kyi rgyun chen po 'di byung / de yang rje chos grags rgya mtshos kho bos skye ba phyi ma la kurma pa gcig byas na ni bstan pa'i don chen po mi 'grub par 'dug pas kurma pa gnyis byed pa yin gsungs pa ltar/gong ma cing de rgyal po ni sku'i bkod pa gcig ste rje brgyad pa sku bltams pa dang gong ma seng ge'i khri la byon pa dus mtshungs par snang ngo / /gong ma de yang zhwa nag bzhes shing kho bo ni garma pa'o zhes gsung la/ phyis dom tsha nang so rta 'bul la song ba na yang thugs mnyes pas las ka spar zhing spyan 'dren par bsgos/ nyi ma nub phyogs na 'od —dpag med kyi sprul sku nged kyi don du byon pa de spyan 'dren zhes khrims ra chen po rnams su lung phog rgyal po'i bkas dung tha'i kyen zhes pa'i blon po chen po gcig gi 'og ma/ gzhan blon po thams cad kyi mchog tha'i kyen li'u yun zhes bya ba la blon po tha'e kyen chung ba bzhi/ de re re'i 'og na dmag dpon bcu re/ de re re la dmag mi stong grangs gnyis gsum re/ bla mchod du las ka can gyi bla ma bzhi/ de re re la 'khor rgya ban brgya re/ 'bul ba la mchod chas gsol spyad sogs rin po che rab sna tshogs/ tha ma gser dngul las byas pa/ na bza' bzhugs stan khyad par can la sogs pa /sgam cha brgya phrag du ma dang / ja gos dar dang tsan+dan la sogs pa bgrang gis —mi lang 1242

ba 'u lag dang bcas pa khri phrag bdun lhag pa gdan 'dren du brdzangs/ 'dug pa'i tshe 'u lag rnams rang rang gi gos rta rgyab ltar byas pa bsgrigs par sdod nga/ lcags ri lta bu nyis rim tsam dang de'i nang du zam so nag yo'i yol ba rgya chen po gru bzhi bskor ba skar phibs ltar yod par dmag mi phyi ma rnams sdod pa soṭa dmag mi phyi bar nang gsum dang / de'i nang na gos lcags nag gi yol ba gru bzhi'i nang du las 'dzin dmag dpon blon po sogs rim pa du ma sdod pa dang /mdzod sogs la gur thog lnga brtsegs dang gsum brtsegs sogs kyi steng mar sha btub pa sogs byang thub pa thams cad kyi dbus su gos lcags nag gi yol ba rim pa du mas bskor ba'i dbus na khong rang gi gur chen tog dang bcas pa'i gung nas mchod sgam sogs 'bul chas kyi lung dang sgam rnams rim par bsgrigs pa'i dbus su gser gyi khri yangs po stan bzang po can la khong rang gan rkyal du nyal te khye'u lnga bcu tsam gyis rol mo'i rigs dang glu gar rgyun du byed pa/ khong rang gi gsol kha ba bcu lhag res rin po che'i phor bu chung chung du mar skom gyi rigs du ma khar ldugs pa rgyun ma chad pa lta bur byed pa/ khong rang gi mtha' dang gur phyi mthar dmag mi stong grangs tsam rtag tu bskor nas re mos kyis srung ba/ mdun ma tshad du blon po rnams langs nas bya ba chen po'i kha bskos byed pa/nyin re zhing phyir tshong gi rgya gral chen po re sgrig pa la nyin so sor ras skud kyi dog pa kha dog so so/ zam so kha dog so so/ stong skud so so/spyo dar gos yug so so sogs thams cad zong gcig pa ma gtogs khyer mi chog pa de nyin so so la brje/ khrims 'gal byung na khrims tha dad pa 'phral du byed/ 'degs pa na sdun du 'u lag dang khal mang dmag mang rnams btang nas me phag rgyag pa'i mi nyis brgya cam me rdzas kyi skye'u ga sha byas pa lag g.yas g.yon du lcags kyi me dong bzung ba rna ltag la spos reng spari ba bcug pa rnams rings par rgyug bzhin 1243

pas dong bur rdzas blug shing gis kha bcad/ me spar te sa la btsugs ma thag 'phar/ rjes ma des de blangs shing de ltar byed pa sogs me phag gi 'ur sgra dang tsheg sgra kho nas sa g.yo ba ltar byed/ de nas rta pa rnams dang rnga mong la zhon pa dang drag pa rnams khyogs dang mdo li la drangs pa dang khyad par tha'e kyen chen po nyid ni si ta'u nag po 'ba' zhig gi thag pa brgya phrag mang po la skye bo'i tshoṭa kyis gyam la bteg cing dar gyi gur gdugs༄ dang bcas par bza' btung dang glu gar gyis mchod/ rol mo'i sgra mtha' yas pas lung pa 'gengs/ lag cha'i ris mtha' yas pa bzung ba'i dmag res pa stong phrag du mas mtha' srung zhing 'gro ba de lta bu'i bkod pa rgya gtam bod du mi shong ba snang zhes de dus kyi sgar pa las dngos su thos/ gar slebs su khong rang gi bkod pa'i si thang re 'bri zhing yod par snang ba de'i bkod pa khong rang gi gzims gur tsam bris pa'i chung ngu re la'ang ha las par snang / spyir tha'e kyen zer ba rgya nag gi btsun mo srung ba'i phyir skyes pa mang po 'bras bu phyung ba las gang sos pa rnams btsun mo'i g.yog tu 'jog pa nyug rum ba'i ming yin la/ spyan 'dren gyi blon po 'di bon gyi blon po bstan pa la ma dad pa cig rmed par snang bas phebs ma gsan na dmag thabs kyis spyan 'dren bsam pa yod par snang / de dus rgya yi blon po khri dmag bdun lhag par song bas bod la mi gzan pa'i phyir rab sgang du phebs/ rgyal po'i lung phab pa la sgar nas ja 'dren ring thung rnams ga'u le bzhin btang / blon pos kyang zhu yig rim par phul ba la phebs pa'i zhal bzhes ma byung bas ci 'thad bod dang 'brel che ba rnams la dris pas phyag mdzod pa dbon po bkra shis bzang mgu dgos par go nas zang zing gis brid cing gong du phebs dus gu'i gung pa'i las ka yong bar byas/ cis kyang phebs ma byung na 'bul ba rnams gta' mar bzung la zhal bzhes ma byung gi bar mi 'bul zer ba'i mngag byin/ thog ma 1244 —

drung du blon po chen pos mjalga te khong rang gi mjal dar kho na mtha' yas pa phul/ phyi nyin gong ma'i lung 'bul yig rnams phul/ gong ma'i lung la sngon gyi ga'u le bzhin bzhed pa dang zhabs bsu dang bcas te bzhes/ de nas nyin re bzhin blon po so so'i 'bul ba/ btsun mo dang rgyal bu/ rgyal bu gzhan/ bla mchod so so rnams kyi zhu yig 'bul ba rnams rim par phul pa da lta mchod shoms chen mo la yod pa'i dngul kong dngul gyi dra ba can du ma dang dngul gyi spos phor dang pad sder gser dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal phal che ba 'di rnams yin/ de'i tshe thog mar mjal ma thag nam mkha' la nyi zla phrad song ba la nyi zla gcig sa la lhung byung bas 'gro ba'i rten 'brel ma 'grig gsung ba dang / thugs rje chen pos kyang gong ma'i sku tshe brtul zin bsam 'gro zhes gsung ba gzigs te 'byon par bkas ma gnang / rgya ston pa/ zur mang ba/ gling du si/ lcags mo go'i sri/ 'dan ma khrims dpon sogs bka' bgros te da res ni phebs par ma dgongs 'dug pas lo dus ci rigs tsam la phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ 'bul ba rnams bzhes/gnang ster rnams mdzad/ gong ma la bka' shog gnang nas blon po tha'i chung gnyis gdan 'dren la bsdad/ gzhan rnams zlog na khong tsho la'ang chad pa mi 'ong /mchod yon thams cad la'ang 'di legs zhes bka' gros mdzad/ rje nyid kyis da res kho bo 'gro ba'i rten 'brel ma 'grig khyed la'ang chad pa mi 'byung bar bya zhes bka' bstsal yang blon po gsang ba'i mngag thob pa'i gdeng yod pa dang /'phral du spyan drangs pa'i ngo so 'dod pa dang / bsod nams kyi shugs bri ba soṭa kyis nyan par ma spyod de shin tu khros/ 'bul chen rnams khyer nas bod khams gling dgu dmag gis 'joms zer nas sgar tshugs gnyis du phyir log phyag mdzod pa'ang de'i skyel thung du 'gro zhes bteg ste song / go'i shri rnam pa'ang nged tshos rgya nag la phyag phyi mi stogs gsungs nas ya tshad du bteg ste byon/1 245

blon po dang phyag mdzod pa gros bgros te rje'i drung btsan thabs su spyan 'dren gtong bar brtsams pa na go'i shri rnam pas gsang thabs su yar spyan drangs/gong ma'i 'bul ba rnams phyag tu ma phyin/ blon po mar phyin pa lam bar thams cad du yo byad thams cad sus thob la song / dmag mi 'u lag thams cad kyang byer/ nyi zla sa la lhung ba gzigs pa'i dus de nyid du gong ma gnam du gshegs/bon la dad pa'i rgyal po zhig bskos pas bstan pa la gnod pa cher byas/ tha'e kyen yang dung tha'e rkyen gyis zhus pas srog la ma nyes tsam byung nas sdum ra gnyer ba cig tu phab/ rgya yul du'ang nad mtshon me chu'i 'jigs pas 'jig la thug pa byung bas blon pos gong ma'i 'bul ba rnams ma phul/ rkarma pa ma mnyes par byas pas lan zer nas grub thob pagis hor yul du rdzu 'phrul bstan pa las snyan graṭa mi chung ba byung / phyag mdzod pa'ang sku chas kyis gang thub de tshor bzhugs nas phyis rgyal tshab sprul sku sgar du spyan drangs te kong por lhag ma rtsis phul/ 'di'i dus phyir mi mdzes pa che zhing skye bo rnams sna tshogs pa sgrog pa byung yang sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje sems can la 'jug pa'i yul ma byung ba dang / blon po des kyang rgyal po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba ma bsgrubs par lam thams cad la gang 'gor gyis dgra 'dul gnyen skyong byed cing bsdad pas bka' chad byung ba dang / gong ma'i 'bul ba rnams gang du bsngos pa'i sar ma phul bar sdig grogs kyi ngag bsgrubs pas dkon mchog gi bka' chad dang / skyes bu dam pa la zhe sdang ba'i rnam smin ni mtha' yas pas yul khyad par can la ma gus pa'i bsam sbyor gyis de ma thag mthong chos yun ring po la ma bstos par bsod nams skad cig gis zad de —bran ltar gyur pa dang / longs spyod kyi rlabs deng sang bod pa'i chen po mtha' dag gi 'byor pa bsdus pas kyang mi do ba de lta bu yang chu bur zhig pa tsam las ma byung ste 'dis ni skye bu dam pa'i bka' bstsal ji lta bar ma bsgrubs 1246

pa dang sdig grogs kyi ngag la ༵na pa dang yul khyad par can la ma gus na 'di 'dra 'byung ngo zhes mngon sum du bstan par snang zhing / longs spyod dang 'byor pa la snying po med par bstan par snang ngo / / de bas na rje 'di ni longs spyod dang bde 'byor thams cad la ji snyam du mi gzigs pa ste kong por phebs nas kyang gzhis byes thams cad kyis drung gong ma'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun chos rgya dkar po gnang ba sogs zhus pa na'ang drung gong ma rnams lugs gnyis kyis 'phrin las skyong / phyag phyi pa'ang lugs gnyis kyi yon tan can mang / dus bzang ba yin/ deng sang 'o skol rnams dus ngan par skyes/ mi dus thams cad sngar las 'gyur/ 'o skol la bya ba chen po nus pa'i mi yang med/ slob ma chos 'dod rnams kyang chud 'dza' bas 'o skol gyis de lta bu sgrub par mi nus zhes gsungs nas ma gnang / hor thar pa 'bum gyis nan gyis gdan 'dren zhus te byang 'dam gzhung du chos sde chen po gcig 'debs/hor stod smad bar gsum byang gi ru sde sbra thag 'dzin no cog dang bcas pa la bu khrul byas te hor rang gi gzhis ka dang 'brel ba ban+dhe khri tsho 'du ba sgar pa'i 7yang bzhugs gnas kyi gtso bo yong ba zhig byed ces nan gyis zhus pa dang du ma bzhes/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i re ba'ang yul gru de dag du bzhugs te mchod yon lhan cig pas lugs gnyis kyi bya ba thams cad byed pa cig bzhed pa'ang gnang bar ma mdzad/ zhal nas kyang kho bo mtshan nyid kyi bshad gra rang 'dod na'ang rab sgang du phyin na klog pa ba'i jo gdan gtsang ma lnga stong tsam zhig 'dug pa 'di garma pa gcig por 'dril ba 'dug ste snying po med pas ma byas pa yin gsungs shing sgar chen gyi sgrigs rim yang kho bo lo nyer dgu pa zing po 'bum pa sgang du thog mar mjal dus kyang brang kha chen po sum bcu lhag yod pa thams cad rim pas bsdu ba gnang ste dbus gtsang la phebs dus brang chen dngos 1247

phyag mdzod/ gsol ja khang / chos rje nang so tsam la 'dus pa mdzad/ gyel tshab sprul ba'i sku thab sgo bzhi sogs sgar ma bu dbyibs mtshungs pa'ang rje'i bkas thams cad spong dag mdzad de dpon slob lnga drug la 'du ba mdzad/ mdo smad la sogs pa'i yul chen 'byor pa can rnams su spyan 'dren mtha' yas kyang thegs par mi mdzad par dbus gtsang gilazhung mi thams cad dad 'byor chung /tha na rtswa shing tsam yang dkon pa 'di dag tu spyan 'dren dang bzhugs gsol ched du med kyang sdig zas nyung ba dang thugs g.yeng chung ba la dgongs nas bzhugs par mdzad/ sku 'khor phyir 'gro ba thams cad la'ang ci dgos kyi rdzong ba thams cad mdzad/ 'on kyang yul srol gyis ma grub pa'i re gnyis bu lon snyeg pa lta bu'i phal rtags ston pa yong yang cir yang mi dgongs/ rje 'di la bsten nas sngon mu to ba las gyur pa rnams kyis kyang sde dpon chen po'i 'byor pa la longs spyod cing da dung 'khang ba lhur byed pa rnams la'ang thugs stoms pa kho na las cung zad kyang mi g.yo/ slob ma dam pa rnams ni 'dod pa chung ba chog shes pa ras kyi chos gos gsum pa sogs kyi sbyangs yon can mang du mi smra ba bdag gzhan rje ba'i byang chub kyi sems thugs dang 'dres pa/ tshe 'di'i rtog pa dang chos min gyi rtog pa rmi lam na yang mi rgyu ba/ snang grags dad pa'i 'khor lor shar ba rje nyid dang 'du 'bral med pa'i dag pa'i snang ba can/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang yi dam la sogs pa'i gzigs snang 'byams klas pa/ gnyid 'od gsal du chud cing rmi lam sgyu lus su dag pu'i skyes chen kho na bzhugs/ dam pa kha cig phrin las kyi grogs su chen po'i bya ba mdzad pa rnam sa kyang gser dang bong bar mtshungs pa kho na mang / des na gzhan rnams bsgrub bya'i snying por byed pa'i tshe 'di'i longs spyod gnas 'khor thams cad ni gru bo che 'jig kha'i nor rdzas lta bur mkhyen/ bstod grags thams cad ni bdud kyi las kho nar dgongs/ nges par snang ba 1248

'de ni rmi lam tsam kho nar mkhyen pas tshe 'di pa'i mthun 'jug thams cad las ring du grol ba yin no/ /byams pa'i blo can snying rje'i gdung shugs dang / /'bral ba medo par nges 'byung rnam par dag /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas las rtag skyo zhing / /mi rtag nges par sems der gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa ni gzhan don rlabs po che'i rnam par thar pa ste/ de yang bskal pa mtha' yas par byams pa la goms pas sku mdzes shing ltar ngoms pa mthong na mi mthun pa med pas sems can su zhig gis sku'i dkyil 'khor mthong na'ang khro ba'i kun dkris zhi ste bram zes zla ba tshes pa mthong ba ltar dad pas mngon par dga' bar 'gyur la gang mthong thos dran reg thams cad don ldan 'gyur ba'i smon lam chen po btab pa de'i phyir zhal mthong gis smin grol khyad par can thob pa'i gdul bya bgrang gis mi lang ba 'di ni 'phrin las kyi sgo chen po gcig go /bsam gyis khyab pa ma yin pa'i thugs rje chen po sems can gyi khams thams cad la rtag par goms pa'i gzhan dbang du gyur pas gang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyi tshes mnar ba rnams lta ci 'tshal/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang dbang phyug chen po dang nyan rang dang sa bcu pa'i rgyal sras kyi bar la yang brtse ba mtha' yas pa rab tu 'phel zhing sems can gyi khams na gcig kyang dor ba ma srid mi srid srid par mi 'gyur ba 'di ni thugs rje chen pos gzhan don mdzad pa'i sgo'o/ /de la skyes bu gtso bo rnams kyi ngag ni ngag gi skyon re bzhi la sogs pa spangs pa bden pa dang snyan pa dang phan pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma yin pa ni spyir yin la/khyad par du brjod du med pa'i yon tan gyis phyug pa'i rje btsun 'di ni shes bya'i gnas de dang de la zla med pa'i grags pa thob pa kha cig la ni spyod yul tsam du 1249

yang ma gyur pa'i gnas mtha' dag shes bya de nyid las glengs te rgyas par bkas bstsal ba na rang gi shes pa dang blo gros ni gyi na tsam du shes pas khengs pa mtha' dag lhag mar byas te yang dag pa'i lam la snod drang por 'gyur pa dang / kha cig la shes bya de la ches rmongs pa'i rnam par bka' bstsal ba na de nyid rang gi khengs pa'i nyes pa yin par mthong ste drang po'i gnas 'thob pa dag mthong ngo / /bka' rgyud rin po che dang khyad par sgrub rgyud kurma kaX tshang la ches zhen pa byas yus kyis sems gang ba kha cig la zhen pa'i yul de dag la smad pa dang 'dor byar bstan pa na kha cig de tsam gyi pha rus tsam gyis zhen pa ni dad pa yang dag pa min pa'i gnad go ste rgyud drang por 'gyur ba dang / kha cig ni des khros 'khrugs shing ci bya gtol med par gyur pas ngag gi ma gus pa brjod pa la zhugs shing 'di lta bu ci snyam du sems shing rgyu rtogs pa kho na las sems lung ma bstan du gnas mi nus la/ rgyu des kha cig ni dgra gcan zin dang lhas byin la thugs stoms pa lta bur shes nas dad pa 'thob/ kha cig ni gang la'ang zhen pa mi rung bar 'dug snyam nas rgyud drang por 'gyur/ tha shal kha cig kyang sems cung zad khu 'phrig tu gyur pas ci zhig na rje 'di'i yon tan dang rang gi nyes pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dag snang ngo / /tshong dang so nams dang 'dod pa la mngon par zhen pa rnams la de nyid las brtsams te de dag gi spyod yul ma yin pa'i gtam bstan pas 'dul ba dang / kha cig ni rang gi las kyi mtha' des yid 'byung ba dang / kha cig ni de nyid las brtsams te chos kyi rnam grangs kyi rang bzhin khong du chud pa dag snang ngo / /nga rgyal gyi rang bzhin can kha cig la gang gis dregs pa des bstod par mdzad pa na bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen no zhes zhum zhing khengs pa 'dor ba dang / kha cig la de rang gi sngon tshul gsang ba pa dag bka' bstsal bas 'dul ba dang / kha cig la ma 'ongs pa ji ltar 'byung ba 1250

lung bstan pas 'dug ba dang / kha cig la ni smad cing 'tshang 'bru bar mdzad pa na rang gi nyes pa mthong ste rgyud drang por 'gyur ba dang / kha cig de ltar bka' bstsal pa na yul des ji bzhin ma go la der 'khod pa gzhan dag zhig gzhi de las lta ba drang por 'gyur ba dang dad pa ches 'thob pa sogs mdor na rnam pa thams cad pa'i gsung bka' bstsal pa de thams cad la bdag gis thos pa la'ang des 'dul ba zhig med pa ni 'ga' yang ma mthong ngo / /des na bdag byis pa tshur mthong gi yul du'ang de lta na gzhan lta ci smos te 'di ni gsung thos pa don ldan du 'gyur bas gdul bya 'dul ba'i sgo'o/ /mdor na sgo gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag thog ma med pa nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi phan bde'i rgyu gcig pur mdzad cing de kho na ltar bsngos pa las ji ltar rdza mkhan shugs chen pos sngon yun ring du bskor ba'i 'khor lo de ni phyis 'bad rtsol med na yang ngang gis 'khor bltar sku gsung thugs la 'bad rtsol gyi rnam pa mi mnga' ba nyid kyis gzhan don 'ba' zhig par lhun gyis grub pa ste gang zhig gang du nges par byung ba ma dmigs kyang sems can thams cad byang chub tu nges par 'byin pa rgyun ma chad pa 'di ni bla na ma mchis pa'i nges 'byung gi sgrub pa rnam par dag pa ste ci mdzad don 'gyur gyi gzhan don gyi sgo chen po'o/ /'di ltar nges 'byung rnam par dag pa'i sgra gcig gis ni sems can thams cad byang chub mchog tu gzhug par 'dod pa'i snying stobs ni theg pa chen po'i nges 'byung dag pa ste gdul bya rnams byang chub kyi sems de lta bu la 'god pa dang skyes bu 'bring gi rigs can rnams la 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin dang de'i rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa bstan pas srid pa rgyu dang bcas pa las thar ba'i thabs skyes bu 'bring gi lam la 'god pa dang / tshu rol mthong ba pa thams cad la'ang 'dus byas mi rtag pa dang zag bcas sdug bsngal du gnas pa 'khor ba'i rang mtshang bstan pas las 'bras kyi 1251

mthong ba skyes bu chung ngu'i lam la 'god pa ste 'di dag ni brjod pa sgra'i chos kyi 'khor los gdul bya 'dul pa'i sgo'o/ /mdor na dam pa'i chos nub pa'ang chos don du mi 'gyur ba'i gdul bya tshogs pa na de dag la chos spangs pa'i nyes pa mi skyed par bya ba'i phyir thabs mkhas kyi mdzad par bshad pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las su mi 'gyur ba'i chos ni 'ga' yang med par gsungs pa yin no/ /nyon mongs ngan blor skad cig mi gtong zhing / /gal te shar yang gnyen po'i chu lon can/ /dge ba'i ngang tshul bzang po mi gtong ba'i/ /bshes gnyen phan mdzad gang der gsol ba 'debs/ /ces pa ni brtson pa chu bo ltar rgyun mi chad pa'i rnam thar te/ gang dug gsum gyi kun slong gis 'du byas pa'i las rnams ni gcig tu gnag pa mi dge ba 'ba' zhig yin la/ tshe 'di'i bsam sbyor gyis zin pa rnams dge pa'i rnam par 'dug na'ang chos ltar snang bar zad la/ rang don gyi zhi ba 'dod pas brtson pa'ang nyi tshe ba'i myang 'das kyi rgyur zad pas bsam pa log pa dang dman pa de thams cad ni nyon mongs ngan blo zhes pa'i sgra gcig gis bsdus te de lta bu'i sems skad cig kyang thugs la mi skyed cing gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'tshang rgya kur bdud sdig can gyi pho nya sprul pa las 'dod pa dang khro ba dang rnam 'tshe'i rtog pa gsum skyes pa ltar byung srid kyang skad cig de nyid du rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen pos sun phyung thag sring ba'i gnyen pos thag bsrings/ spong ba'i gnyen pos gzhi med du spangs te rten gnyen po chu lon lta bus nyes pa'i chu bo gang dag nam du yang 'bab pa med par byas te thog ma dang bar dang mtha' mar dge sdom pa gsum gyi ngang tshul bzang po mi nyams shing gong du 'phel ba'i sgo nas 'gro ba ma 'dris pa thams cad kyi bshes/ rgyu med par gnyen gshin pa/ tsan+dan 4dang ste 'ur 1254

mtshungs pas thams cad kyi mdza' bo gcig pu bar gyur te su zhig ji ltar byed kyang de'i lan phan pa 'ba' zhig gis sgrub par mdzad cing tha na sgo gsum lung ma bstan du bzhugs pa'i skabs kyang med par chos spyod kyi dge ba bcu 'ba' zhig gis nyin mtshan khor mor 'da' bar mdzad pa'o/ /gzu bor gsung rab don la mnyam bzhag nas/ drang nges so sor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyis/ /cal sgrog rjes su rgyug par mi byed par/ /nges don dam pa 'chad der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ni chos kyi sgo thams cad gzhan dring la mi 'jog par chub pa'i rnam par thar pa ste/ de yang rgya mtsho chen po nas ded dpon dag gis gru bo che bshams pa don mthun dang bcas pa dag gis rgya mtsho'i khol bu cung zad cung zad du bgrod nas rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i nor bu len zhing des yul dus der rang gzhan la phan pa sgrub par zad kyi rgya mtsho ma lus pa bgrod cing nor bu thams cad rtogs —par byas pa ni 'ga' yang med pa ltar ston pa'i gsung rab kyi rgya mtsho gzhal du med pa las grub pa'i mtha' so so smra pa'i slob dpon slob dpon dag gi chos kyi rnam grangs dag las rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa dang blor bshin pa'i don don tsam rnyed par zad kyi chos kyi rgya mtsho thams cad kyi tshig don khong du 'thungs pa ni 'ga' yang yong par ma gzigs pas na bdag slob dpon 'di dang 'di kho na'i rjes su 'jug go zhes mtha' gcig tu zhen par mi mdzad de rang phyogs la bshin pa dang gzhan phyogs la 'khu ba'i zug rngu med par thams cad la gzu bor gnas pa'i blo gros zab cing gting dpag dka' bas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis sam mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad kyi tshig don dang / chos kyi rnam grangs de 'byung ba'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang dam chos pad+ma dkar 1263

po la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gnas rnams la mnyam par bzhag ste phar phyin theg par rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo dang dgongs ldem dgongs kyi don rnam par gzhag pa dang sngags bla na med pa rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud du rgyan bdun dang mtha' drug tshul bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo nas gtan la phab ste gdul bya'i skal ba bzhin ston par mdzad kyi gcig tu mngon par zhen pa kho nas ni ma yin te gdul bya kha cig la drang don du 'gyur ba de kho na kha cig la nges don du 'gyur ba sogs dang / skabs 'gar drang don du bstan pa de skabs 'gar nges don du 'gyur ba sogs srid pa'i phyir dang rnam pa gcig tu na chos thams cad brjod du med pa brjod pa'i phyir drang ba'i don kho na dang / rnam pa gcig tu na sangs rgyas kyi gsung nam yang mi bslu zhing gdul bya der bstos kyi nges don yin pa'i phyir thams ced nges don du bzhag kyang mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'grel par byed pa la 'phags pa'i yul du shing rta'i srol chen po gnyis ji lta ba bzhin du bdag nyid chen po 'di ni gsung rab mtha' dag la rang dbang du 'grel pa'i mthu thob pa yin la bod yul 'di na ni snga ma snga ma'i cal sgrog gi rjes su thams cad rgyug cing grags pa'i rjes tsam du 'breng bar zad kyi rang gi blo gros kyi mthus dpyod par nus pa ni 'ga' yang dka' bar mthong la/ dpyod par rlom pa rnams kyang bya rog so rtog lta bu'i zhib cha thar 'dod la bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo ster ba zhig dang sngon sus kyang mi rnyed pa'i lta ba yin zhes skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas— shig ston par snang la bdag nyid chen po 'di ni de lta bu ma yin te sde snod rgyud sde mtha' dag la sngon gyi chen po dag gis dpyad par ma nus pa'i dka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag mig phye ba ltar 'grel pa dang / lta ba'i tshul gsal bar mdzad pa rnams ni bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang bdag nyid chen po klu'i zhabs yab sras kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba ste rgya 1ཿ54

bod kyi grub pa chen po thams cad mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig pa nyid las khyad par du rje 'di'i gsung rnams dpyis phyin mtha' chod dpyod ldan gyi som nyi drungs nas 'byin dmigs gtade kyi mtshan ma gzhig nus pas ches khyad par du 'phags pa nyid do/ / chen por grags la brtse zhing brjod byed blo/ /smon lam dag pa rnams kyis mtshams sbyar nas/ /dge la sbyor ba'i blo gros spyod pa'i rten/ /yongs su bsngo bar mdzad der gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ni srid zhi gtan sgrol gyi 'phrin las mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa ste/ chen por grags pa zhes bya ba'i sgra ni chen po ma yin yang zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go de gang zhe na 'khor los bsgyur ba dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa ste 'jig rten pa rnams kyis skyabs gnas su mngon par lta ba de dag go de dag kyang snying po dang ldan pa ma yin te 'khor ba'i bde 'bras res 'ga' ba tsam de re zhig myong ba dang 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin rnam par ltung ba las ma 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang sa bcu pa'i bar yang btsan sar phyin pa ma yin te mgron po lam du lus pa lta bu bsam pa'i mtha' ma rdzogs pa nyid kyi phyir/ de thams cad la lhag par brtse pa'i thugs rje'i rlabs dmigs pa ma mchis pa mngon par g.yo bas ches brjod cing phan 'dogs par 'dod pa'i blo gros yangs shing tshad las 'das pa gong nas gong du bskyed de gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i mdzad pa dang smon lam gyi khyad par rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas 'dul bya dang 'dul byed kyi 'brel pa'i mtshams sbyar nas rgyu dge ba dang 'bras bu byang chub la sbyor ba'i 'phrin las mdzad cing rgyu des gdul bya mchog dman thams cad kyi rgyud la theg pa mchog gi blo gros khyad par 1255

can rdzogs pa'i byang chub skyed pa'i rten du bde dge ji snyed pa rnam pa thams cad pa dang dus thams cad par tshul thams cad pas yongs su bsngo bar cha/dzad cing des na nam mkha' ji srid pa dang sems can ji srid pa de srid du 'phrin las kyi rgya mtsho nam yang nub pa ma mchis shing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las dang rnam par dbye ba med pa'o/ /de ltar yon tan brjod las dge gang thob/ /yon tan de ldan yon tan brjod po'i ngag /byang zhing chub pas lus sems don ldan pa/ /garma pa yi dgongs pa rdzogs byed shog /ces pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bsngo bas mtha' bsdu ba ste/ de ltar rang nyid la ji ltar ldan pa'i chos sgro btags pa dang skur pa btab pa med par brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di brtsams pa dang / gzhan dag gis 'di'i don shes pa dang dad pa dang sgrub pa dang kha ton du byed pa sogs las dngos dang brgyud pa'i dge ba gang zhig thob pa gang bsngo bar bya ba'i rgyu'o/ /yon tan de dang ldan pa'i yon tan brjod pa po ni rje nyid de bsngo ba po'o/ /ci rang gi yon tan brjod pas dge ba thob ba ma zhe na los 'thob ste dper na rgya cher rol pa'i mdo ston pa nyid kyi mdzad pa nyid kyis bka' bstsal pe las gdul bya ji snyed cig smin grol du byas pa'i dge ba lta bu'o/ /gang du bsngo na gnas skabs su ni rje nyid kyi gsung ngag byang zhing sgra gsal dag tu chub pa ste gsung ngag cung zad ma byang ba sel phyir bsngo bar mdzad la/ mthar thug tu ni lus don ldan gzugs kyi sku dang sems don ldan chos kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te sems can thams cad de ltar 'god pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las gcig pa'i dngos po rgyal ba don yod grub pa dang tha mi dad pa kurma pa'i bzhed pa rdzogs phyir bsngos pa'o/ /1256
