bstod pa 'di ni chos rnam thar gyi tshul du bstan pa shedams ngag 'doms pa 'i — — — ched du yang yin te tshigs bcad dang pos bstan par ming btags pa tsam gyis tshim par mi bya bar bstan pa dngos yang dag pa 'tshol la zhugs rdzogs gyis shig pa dang / chos dang chos ma yin pa legs par shes la bcas rang gi kha na ma tho ba spongs shig pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad ldan srog gi zungs su bsten zhig pa dang / cis kyang dgos med dran pas chog shes par gyis shig pa dang / theg chen gyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems sbyongs shig pa dang / rang rgyud kyi gnas skabs kho na la rtogs la rang rgyud thul zhig pa dang / cal sgrog gis tshim par mi bya bar gzur gnas kyi shes rab kyis rtogs shig pa dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub las gzhan pa smon bya'i yul du mi rung bas de thob nas srid zhi gtan sgrol kho na don gnyer du gyis shig pa dang / dge ba thams cad byang chub dam par bsngos shi—ga pa rnams gdams ngag tu bya ba ste tshigs bcad res bstan to//de ltar rnam thar gyi gtso bo rnams bstan nas thun mong gi skye bo dag la mdzad pa'i go rim ji ltar snang ba ni/ de lta bu'i yon tan gyis mnga' 'byor ba'i bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid rab sgang nas nub phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur te kre rong lcags gsum gyi sar phebs/ kre bo'i sar ri rtse zhig tu cung zad bzhuṭa nas 'dir dgon pa thob cig pa'i bka' gnang nas btab pa lhun po rtser grags te sku skye ba phyi ma'i bzhugs gnas la dgongs par 'dug slar kurma phyogs su phebs pa'i 'or chen gyi la rtsar rgyal po dpal shes khyed da res rgya yul du ma byon pa legs/ rgya'i lha 'dre rnams khyed spyan 'dren du byung bas nged bod kyi gzhi bdag rnams dang rab sgang du 'khrug pa byung nas bod rgyal ba yin/ khyed kyi 'phrin las nged thams cad kyis sgrub par byas zer/ kurma ri bo che re dkar sog gsum sogs nas lho rong rgyud/ khyung tho la brgal te phu long dgon ye gong 1ཿ57

klo lam dkar nag rong klu nang sogs lam so sor 'gro don mdzad/ slob dpon pad+ma sogs zhal gzigs du ma byung / dgung lo bcu bdun pa chu lug hor zla gnyis pa la mkhan chen shākya bzang po/ bla ma grags rgyal ba/ bla ma chu dka' thub pa sogs kong stod smad kyi gar srid thams cad kyis ja 'dren gyi rim pa dang bcas te de mo la nang nas rgyal 'dzin ta ba stod la sogs par phebs/'bul zhabs kyis mchod/ gyang tho sprul sku sogs gyang tho gar srid kyis bsus shing gnam thos tshal du gnam dkar gling gsum gyis 'bul zhabs rgya mtshos mchod/ drung bkra shis don grub pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi smon lam mdzad/ /kurma bu chu sogs kyi mchod sprin bzhes te hor zla lnga pa'i yar tshes nas rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs te byes mdzod kyi gzigs rtogs mdzad cing sku gsung thugs rten dang nor sna khyad par can rnams gzigs shing kha yig med pa rnams la 'di'i dus 'di ltar byung gi lo rgyus rgyas pa re gsungs/ chos rje mkhan chen pa la bka' gnang ste gam phu steng gi 'khrugs pa dums/ de'i tshe dpal sha wa ra smug nag ras kyi smad dkris dang rus rgyan can thor tshugs dar dmar gyis bcings pa'i sna g.yas g.yon du 'phyang ba thugs gar gri thod 'dzin pa snyan g.yas ut+pal dkar pos brgyan zhing sku smad g.yas zur du rma bya'i sgro chun dpyangs pa steng du gzugs gzhan mi mngon la gser gyi gdub bu mang po dang sor gdub 'khrol pa tsam snang ba'i mkha' 'gro mas rma bya'i gdugs bzung pa/ ṭā ki ma gser gyi dril phreng 'khrol ba gnyis kyis zhabs nas 'degs pa zhig bdag la rtogs pa drir byung gsungs te de'i lan gnang ba ni/ sa dang po'i rtogs pa gang yin na/ /snang stong zung 'jug chos kyi sku/ /bden med sprin dar na bun bzhin/ /e maho/sa lnga pa'i rtogs pa gang yin na/ /gsal stong zung 'jug chos kyi sku/ /gnyis med rnam dag 'od gsal ba/ /sa brgyad pa'i rtogs pa gang yin na/ /bde 1258

stong zung 'jug chos kyi sku/ /spros bral 'gyur med mkha' rdo rje/ /sa bcu pa'i rtogs pa gang yin na/ /rig stong dbyer med chos kyi sku/ /sgrib gnyis rang grol e ma ho/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rang gis rang la stos dang gzhan na med do/ /da ltar gyi shes pa 'di ye shes yin gcig las med do/ /gcig de sems can yang yin sangs rgyas kyang yin/ da lta'i shes pa'i rang gdangs 'dir/ /ngal ba chen po ma byed cig /'di las gzhan du med ces gsungs/ gyi ling tshal du gser gling bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis nyid kyi rnam thar zhus pa la/ bdag ni chung ba'i dus nas kyang / /'dod yon rmi lam sgyu 'drar rig /bdag ni nges 'byung kun blangs nas/ /so thar gser gyi bum pa ni/ /nyes skyang dri mas gos pa med/ /sems bskyed pad+ma dkar po la/ /rang don ba mos ma gos so/ /rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta la/ /tha mal rnam rtog rdul gyi 'tshub/ /skad cig tsam yang mi snang ngo / /sogs gsungs/ bla ma ru pa dar kre chung bas mjal te 'bul chen byas/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i ja zhus zhu yig bla ma gdan sa pa dang dbon po chos skyong gis phul/ /'di'i dus spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'ang sngar dpon slob mthun sbyor ltar snang ba'i 'gal rkyen rnams kyi gnas tshul yang mkhyen pas zhal mjal bar ches bzhed cing slar yang dbon po chos skyong ba gnang nas sngar nged rang gi las dbang gis phyis mjal ma thub pa la semab/ 'gyod par yod/ da nga rang gis gdan 'dren gyi dngos gzhi byed cis kyang phebs pa zhig zhu/ phebs lam yang yar klungs phyogs 'di la gnang na nged thel gyi go sa 'dis thel pa'i las tshan sgrig dgos zer nas dang po'i 'dra ba zhig las mi 'ong bas nyang kha phyogs 'di la phebs par zhu/ brag gsum du nga rang rgan po gdan 'dren la yong / mjal lugs kyang dbu'i byin rlabs tsam gnang ba 'dug na nga bod yul gyi ban+dhe'i rgan mgor 'dug pas mi 'gal/ ched du zhu 1259

rgyu ni min/ gzhan nged rang sgar pa'i srol dkar yol gyi shubs thag mdzub mo la gyon/ gding ba khyer nas yong ba yin pas gnang dka' gtan mi dgos/'bri stag gi chos rje zhal bzhugs 'di thams cad nged rang gi slob ma kho na yin pas 'di dag kyang dka' ba med par zhal slob tu chud pa zhig 'ong / 'di ltar min na 'di tshos kyang mjal phrad kyi dka' gnas ci zhu mi shes/ phebs rjes nga rang gi dgon gnas mchod gzhis yon bdag slob ma thams cad drung nyid la 'bul gsung ba'i zhu yig do gal can phul na'ang sgar dpon rnams kyi bka' gros la de lta na chos gsan pa 'char zhing de mi legs pa'i bka' gros byung ste sku dbang ma 'dus pa'i bka' shog nang ma gnang ba nas spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'ang sku tshe'i 'phen pa gtong bar mdzad de mi ring bar mya ngan las 'das par snang / tang rtsar bzhugs dus khams nas phyag mdzod pa bkra shis bzang slebs/ rje 'di ni nyes byed la lhag par brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa ma gtogs bka' bkyon mthar 'ded ye mi gnang bas bka' ma bkyon par mjal kha gnang / seng gong tshal dang chang dong sgar du bzhugs tshe rta dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan 'das pa'i sngas su phebs te 'pho ba gnang / nga ni skye rga na 'chi 'di/ /mthong ba tsam gyis snying rlung 'phyo/ khrom dung phyur bsags pa'i nang shig na/ /rgan po stong yang rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sogs kyi mgur mdzad/ /tab chab nag gling bzhi tshal dang rgyal gong lhum brag sogs su dbus gtsang pa'i mjal mi dang dge 'dun nyis stong tsam la mdo sde dran nye sogs gnang / der gzims dpon chen mo 'dan ma go'i shrī 'da' khar spyan drangs phyag rdzas rnams rtsis phul/ mtshams sbyor bzang po'i bka' gnang lhar skye bar lung bstan/der bye'u shin tu mdzes pa zhig byung ba la/ mdzes sdug gi bye'u smra mkhas ma/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas gus par nyan zhing mchi ma phyung nas song / drung na ne 1260

tso smra shes thugs brtse ba zhig yod pa'i skye ba zhus pas sngon sangs rgyas me tog bla ma'i bstan pa'i lhag ma la rgyal po'i btsun mor gyur ba'i tshe dgra bcom pa pad+ma'i ze ba bsod stoms la byon pa na bran mo legs 'dzin mas skur pa btab ba la des chos gsungs pas dad/ phyis ngan 'gro du ma brgyud nas ne tso 'di yin par tshigs su bcad de gsungs/ de nas lkog phreng gzims khang du phebs/gnas bzang bas thugs spro zhing mgur du ma gsungs/ khyad par 'di khyed tshos yid la zung la gdangs shes par slobs gsungs nas gnang ba/ sems zhi zhing gnas pa spros dang bral/ /gsal dwangs kyi shes pa bde bar shar/ /rtog dpyod rlung gi dbyung rdub chad/ /bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi//khyed sgom chen yod na chags kyis dogs/ /rnam rtog phra ba dur dur po/ /dran pas zin pas bde bar shar/ /gnyis 'dzin shes pa'i rtsi bgrang mkhan/ /bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi/ khyod sgom chen yod na dred kyis dogs/ /blos byas stong pa cang med po/ /phar bltas stong pa yin no lo/ /tshur bltas sems nyid rig rig po/ /gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rbad kham can/ /bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi/ khyod sgom chen yod na dred kyis dogs//'di ka tha mal shes pa las/ /yod med mtha' bral rdul ma gos/ /spyod lam rnam bzhir khyer kyang stub/ /bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi/ khyod sgom chen yod na 'chal gyis dogs/ /nyams rtsub skyes bla ma bral ba'i sa/ rang chig tsho mi thub nges 'byung can/ /rkyen ngan gyis dge sbyor 'thor ba sla/ khyod sgom chen yod na de ru 'bungs/ /tshe 'di yi che thabs don du gnyer/ /gzhan stobs chen rnams la smon pa 'debs/ /chos brgyad rgyal 'gong dmag dpung sdud/ /bag chags ngan pas nang len byed/ /bdag 'dzin bskul bas dge sbyor 'thor/ khyod sgom chen yod na chags zhen spongs/ /grogs rtag mi thub sgyu261

pas mtha' nas bskor/ /g.yeng ba'i gra pa bsod nams sgo/ /pho rus kyi nga rgyal chos kha 'dzin/ /dam tshig la ser chung 'gro yis dogs/ khyod sgom chen yod na blo kha zlog /gal chen yon bdag ngo srung gi gzhi/ /bstod smad gyi gra sa chaṭa sdang gnas/ /chos ma nus tshogs pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus/ /skye mched gzugs legs mtha' nas bskor/ /rgyud gnyen pos ma slebs khrel mi thub/ /tshangs spyod la bar chod yong gis dogs/ khyod sgom chen yod na gcig tu dril/ /lto gos kyi 'dun ma rbad kyis chod/ /sprang 'tsho'i bza' ba'i bang mdzod bsten/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis po/ /zad med kyi phugs sri'i blo gtad mdzod//gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa rtsad nas zhi/ /dus de tshe tha mal gdod ma'i gshis//rkyen 'pho 'gyur med pa kun tu bzang / /don dang po'i sangs rgyas mi phyed pa//sems bde chen stong nyid rdo rje'i dbyings/ /lus ngag gi bya ba bde gshegs mtshan/ /bzang ngan gyi rtog pa de ru chad/ /blo a 'thas kyi zo zhabs thang du rul/ /bzang legs legs 'dra ba'i 'dun ma gtor/ /zhes sogs gsungs/slar gsang dang bde yangs su phebs te 'bul nod bzhes/ do zhong bas babs bshegs phul/ slar kong phreng gzims khang du sku mtshams kyi khong nas chos rje mkhan chen pa la zab chos du ma gnang / gter bum gyi ri ltad la phebs pa na zhabs rjes gsum tsam byung / rgyal 'dzin du phebs te ban sgar nang so sogs kyis mjal/ dbang chos du ma gnang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i pho brang du byon pa'i gzigs snang dang jo bo smṛ ti'i gdung 'bul bar gzigs/ de na rgya bod kyi grub chen thams cad bkod pa 'di lta bus logs bris su 'dug gsungs nas bod kyi 'gos 'brog mar 'brom sogs kyi ri mo'i bkod pa rgyab yig tshigs bcad dang bcas pa mdzad/ yang byang sham+bha lar byon pas shar sgo'i drung na 'dzam gling gi mi rigs sum brgya drug bcu 'dus pa'i tshong 'dus la zhal lta ba'i thang 1262

sku 'di lta bu 'dug gsungs nas thub pa gangs chen mtsho'i thang sku rgyab yig gi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa mdzad/ der gzigs snang gi rim pa mtha' yas pa las nyin gcig gi gzigs snang bris gsungs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum bzhugs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' sprin dkar pos g.yogs pa/ de'i mdun du bkra shis rtags brgyad/'phan rol mo dbu rgyan dar dpyangs me tog gi phreng ba seng ge'i khri bdud rtsi'i bum pa ka pā la sna tshogs rdo rjes kha bcad pa nor bu rnga yab sil snyan phye ma phur ma dri chab lha bshos stag pags kyi steng du tshogs kyi rdzas bzhag pa mda' gzhu 'khor lo rdo rje'i sor gdub/ de'i g.yas su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sprul sku thig le kha dog sna tshogs pa'i nang du bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas mchod pa/ de'i 'og tu dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa dang blum po sgo brgyad dang chos 'byung bsnol ma dang chos 'byung rkyang pas gang ba de'i mthar 'od dmar pos bskor ba'o/ /de'i 'og tu thig le'i nang du mgo bos gang ba dang mig gis gang pa dang lag pas gang ba sogs thig le'i nang na 'char ba'o/ /de'i 'og tu rtags bcu dang mun pa dang nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mthar sprin yod pa dang nyi ma zla ba'i 'od ril phog pa dang thog ser dang char zim bu 'bab pa dang / skyes pa dang bud med mang po 'gro ba dang / rdo rje dang dril bu dang bum pa'i kha nas 'ja' tshon 'byung ba dang bum pa'i nang nas me lce 'byung ba dang lcags kyi pha wang rta rngas btags te nam mkhar 'dogs pa dang /mtsho dang pad+ma dang chu rgyun 'bab pa dang nags ri dang sman ljongs dang me tog gi tshal rlung gis bskyod pa dang dpag bsam gyi shing las sbrang rtsi'i rgyun 'byung ba mi mang pos 'thung ba dang / gangs ri zhu ba dang ri dwags rngon pas brngos pa dang / shā bud kyis sa rdo sol ba dang sa gzhi steng nas phyir log pa dang ri rab 1263

nyil ba dang sbrul mdud grol pa dang skra shad 'dzings pa dang / bde mchog dkar po yab rkyang gi zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'byung ba dang 'od lnga'i 'khor lor re mig phub ltar 'khor ba dang / khyab 'jug dang lto 'phye dang spos reng gi dud pas nyi ma yar 'dren pa dang phyogs bcu nas rlung bcu 'ongs te nam mkhar thim nas de'i rjes la gser gyi mchod rten byang chub shing gis brgyan pa rdo rje lu gu rgyud du mas 'brel ba gzhan yang bar skabs rnams su rten khebs chol sgrigs kyi rnam pa lta bu pad+ma dang dngul chu btul ma rnams so/ /rtsa dkar sog sbubs lta bu'i nang nas rlung 'ongs nas mgo thams cad 'ja' tshon lnga las grub pa mthar 'od ljang gu la thim pa/ gzhan yang kha ṭaX ga dang ḍa ma ru sna tshogs pa dang / bya sprel/ ri bong / sha ba/ rna ba/ dgo ba/ rgya rtsod/ khrung khrung ngang pa/ ngur pa/ rta/ dre'u/ mdzo/ glang chen/ thi pa/ khra/ khu byug bya rgod/dom/ dred/ 'phar spyang / stag gzig seng ge byi la/ chu bya/ nya sbal/ sdig pa/ sbrul/ chu srin/ bra ba/ rma bya/ ne tso/ shang shang / nor bu'i gling /nam mkha' nas sprin las zas gos kyi char 'bab pa rnams so/ /de'i thang sku gcig kyang mdzad/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ nag po pa/ rgyal rnga lan bdun pa/slob dpon dpa' bo rnams las chos so so gsan/ zhang rin po che gzigs shing de'i sku'i bkod pa khyung du mdzad nas klu 'dul ba dang lha dbang phyug gi sras mor mdzad de dbang phyug la chos ston pa dang / chos gsung ba dang mya ngan las 'da' ba ston pa dang 'khor los bskyur rgyal gyi btsun mor mdzad de shi ba'i rkyen gyis rgyal po chos la sbyor ba dang / ri rab bshig pa dang / sgra gcan la bsnyin gnas 'bogs pa sogs lha ma yin 'dul ba la sogs pa'i tshul gsungs/kho bo sa steng 'di na byung ba'i tshe/ /rgya nag kha che yu gur li dang ni/ /za hor gser gling rnams na ngo mtshar ba'i/ /cho 'phrul du mas skye rgu dad par 1264

byas/ khyad par mi dbang rgya nag rgyal po yis/ /bsod nams spel slad zang zing dngos po'i tshogs/ /bdag la mchod phyir rgya nag mi dpon ni/ /brgya phrag mang pos mchod phyir sti stang byas/ /'on kyang rgya nag yul du 'gro dgos zhes//nan skyed chen po byas kyang kho bo yis/ /brtags shing dpyad tshe sa bdag rgyal po ni/ /tshe yi 'phen pa gtong bar blos rig nas/ /phyogs der 'gro ba'i brtson pa bshol gyur pas/ /mi dbang pho nya rab khros rang gnas song / /de la chos skyong tshogs rnams bka' phab ste/ /rgyal po'i pho brang me dang chu yi char/ /du mas nyam thag byas shīng mi rung ba'i/ /ltas ngan du mas shar phyogs 'dzam gling pa'i/ /skye bo kun la grags pa'i bya ba byas/ khyad par 'jang nag dpung tshoṭa zhi bar byas/ /hor gyi yul du tshig ma'i char pa phab/ /sog po'i rgyal po ra ḍū ṣa pa la'i/ /'dze nad 'phrin gyis bsal bas drin lan phul/ /yu gur yul du dug sbrul chen po la/ /yi ge bskur bas rgya mtsho'i nang du bros/ kha che'i yul nyer dge 'dun 'bum sde yis/ /mkhan por dgos zhes de la 'di skad spring/ /skye ba phyi mar sgrub par dam bcas so/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i rnam thar gsungs shing / yu gur gyi yul du dug sbrul chen pos nyam thag pa na yu gur rgyal pos bdag gi yul 'dir dug sbrul gyis gtses pas khyed /rma pa la thabs yod dam zhes rgya nag rgyal po brgyud de phul ba na/ gdug pa can khyod sems can la gnod pa med pa bde ba dang ldan pa zhig ci nas kyang sems can chen po khyod mkhyen no/ /li thang nas bris pa dge legs 'phel/ zhes gnang bas dug sbrul bros par snang ngo / /rgyal 'dzin gyi 'khrug pa bsdums te rgya bdag bskos/ a mdo sku skye tsher lung gi bla mar rdzong ba bskos ja gnang / sku'i sprul pa rgya nag dang sham+bha la dang kha che dang o rgyan la sogs par yod tshul dang bod nyid na'ang du ma yod par bka' bstsal/ rje mi tra dzo gi de sngon 'dan yul du mjal dus 1265

lo nyi shu tsam gyi na tshod cig 'dug phyis li thang du mjal dus dgung lo drug bcu tsam pa sku rid zhing sngo ba dbu skra dkar ba zhig 'dug lha sa nas 'ongs gsung zhing bod kyi dgon gnas rnams na chos lugs bzang ngan 'di 'dra 'dug gsung zhing sngon kho bo sau raṣ+ṭa'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas/ da ma dha ra'i ri la sdod du 'gro/ da dung lus 'di la lo stong tsam sdod/ de nas 'tshang rgya ba yin gsung zhing gdams ngag dang dam rdzas du ma gnang / sku lus shel ltar mi sgrib pa dang bya rgod la bsad gso dang sdigs mdzub kyis gangs ri g.yo nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan te khyed bod kyi grub thob sla bar 'dug gsungs/ yang shar khar lan gcig mjal gsungs/ slar rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs te shing mo bya lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes brgyad la yang dgon bsam 'phel dbang po'i tog gi gzims khang dang sgrub sde'i gzhi bting / khyad par chos rje mkhan chen pa'i gzims spyil mdzad pa'i tho rengs thugs rje chen pos lung ston pa shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rab tu byed pa'i 'od 'khor dang bcas pas gnas 'di byin gyis rlob pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes bar chad srung bar gzigs shing / don ldan mi yi dege spyod 'di/ /don du bsgrubs na mi rabs gsum/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas dag tu 'gyur/ /sgrub po'ang lo gsum tshe ring 'gyur/ /zhes pa gsan/ paṇa chen shākya mchog dang kun mkhyen rong po sogs rtag par mi 'bral ba'i tshul gsungs/ dgung lo nyer gcig gi gnyan cha sel ba'i sku mtshams mdzad/ drung mkhan po la sku gsum gyi sgrub thabs gnang ste yi ge sogs ma len par mtshams gyis gsungs nas rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi sgrub pa la bzhugs/ mtshan lam du be+eḍūr+ya'i ri'i dru nga na bdud rtsi'i klung gaṅgā ltar 'bab pa nye bar byon pa na lcags sreg gi ri bo dang ro nye dmar po'i zhun chur gyur pa la zam pa snang ba'ang seng ge khros pa gnyis kyis srung ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas su gzigs pa na 1266

byang chub kyi sems drag tu 'khrungs pa'i tshe nam mkha' las/ skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo las/ /thar 'dod blo 'khrul rgyal ba yang / /gshegs shul brgya zam 'di bzhin no/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa gcan gzan te/ /phyi ltas yul la bde snang yang / /zhen na sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras so/ /zhes grag ste 'di ni zhen na bdud rtsi dang ro nyer mtshungs pa'i chos kyi gtam chen por go'o/ /yang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub yin zer ba'i glegs bam mang po snang ba la gzigs pa na gser gyi brgyad stong pa 'ba' zhig snang ba'i yig 'bru las/ shes rab zab mo rgyal ba'i yum/ /brjod par mi nus gsang sngags lam/ /rgas pa gso dang 'chi ba 'joms/ /rims nad sel byed rgyal ba'i yum/ /zhes pa gsan/ yang dzā lad+dhā ra'i gnas rin po che sna tshogs pa'i ri bo'i phug dang mtshor bcas pa'i yul ljongs dang mi ring bar me ri dur khrod kyi dbus na li khri'i rang bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang mtha' yas pa gzigs te byon pa na pad+ma kha bye ba'i sbubs las lha mo zhig gis phyag spyi bor bzhag ste/ e ma/ me tog dmar po dpyid kyis mi skyed dam/ /dngul chu sbyor ba'i ril bu mi za 'am/ /rgas dka' 'chi med ral gri rno ngar la/ /ril ba spyi tshags chu yis mi bkru 'am/ /zhes zer ba la khyod su zhig ces dris pas/ /khyod ni khyod yin khyod las gzhan ma yin/ /dgon pa 'di ni rang lus rdo rje'i gdan/ /gnad du snun na byang chub shing drung yin/ /zhes sogs brjod de bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ljags thog tu bzhag pa na ting nge 'dzin mang po'i sgo bye ste gzigs par byon pa na rten gyi rnam pa de thams cad rang yal te 'khor lo'i gtso bo nyid kyis dbang rdzogs par bskur te zhing khams de yang mig 'phrul ltar gyur to/ /yang gtsug lag khang gi bkod pa dpe las 'das pa cig gi shar khyams mdo sde mdzangs blun las gsungs pa'i skyes rabs rnams bris pa'i mdun na 1267

gzhon nu lo bcu drug gi na tshod zur phud lnga pa me tog gis brgyan pa zhig sher phyin gyi glegs bam sgrog cing snang ba na 'di ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal te 'di la gnad kyi gsang dag dri'o zhes dgongs te dri ba du ma mdzad pa'i lan ni/ dgun bum pa chus bkang na 'khyags nas 'chag pa ltar so skye rnams rlung 'gaṭa nas 'chi la rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rlung phyi nang gnyi ga 'pho med du khegs pas mkha' spyod 'grub pa ni chu nang du bzhag pa'i dngos po mtshon gyis mi chod pa lta bu yin pa dang / phyi rol gyi dwangs ma'i dwangs ma dngul chu sogs kyi rdzas kyis nang gi dwangs ma'i dwangs ma mthu brtas nas mi 'jig pa'i phyir dngul chus lus 'chi med 'grub pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i lhas tshe sring ba ni ma 'ongs pa mir skye rgyu'i tshe da lta chos nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis blangs te byin pa yin pa dang /sngags lam gyi rten du rung ba'i lus la rtsa lha dang phyag mtshan rlung yig gzugs thig le sa bon dang nā dar gnas pas de dag la yi ge yod la sgra mi snyan pa dang rtswa mi shing mi rnams ni de lta bu med pas sngags lam gyi snod du rung ba'i yi ge mtshan nyid pa med pa yin no zhes dang / sgra mi snyan pa la'ang rlung yig gzugs kyi rnam pa tsam yod kyang phyi rol tu dpyad pa ma zhugs so zhes dang / bla med kyi rnal 'byor pa'i lus la gnas pa'i srin bu'i tshogs skal med rnams phyir bud pas shig nad 'byung ba dang / skal ldan rnams rnal 'byor pa de dang dbyer med par gyur nas 'tshang rgya zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa lus la spro bar 'gyur ba yin zhes dang / rmu thag zhes pa sgro btags pa yin la nga las nu ltar rgyal po bsod nams can de dag mi lus nyid kyis lhar song ba yin zhes dang /bskal ba dang po'i mi rnams rten brten pa phra bas lus yal la de phyin rags pas yal ma nus pa'o zhes dang / bud med nyon mongs mang bas nad kyang mang ba ltar bcas pa yang mang bar mdzad la bud med kyi rten la mchog lnga mi 'byung ngo 1268

zhes dang / sngags las bud med mchog tu bshad pa ni phar phyin theg par thabs byang sems dang mi ldan pa'i shes rab gol sar gsungs la sngags su shes rab nyid ye shes su gsungs pa'i dbang gis yin zhes dang / rdo rje theg par phung soṭa nyid lhar bshad pa dang / me lha sogs kyang gtso bo las tha mi dad pa dang me dang me lha'ang tha mi dad du yod pa sogs ni rdo rje'i theg par snod bcud gdod ma nas rgyal ba rgya mtsho kho na nyid du bstan pa yin no zhes dang / las dbang gis lus la rin po che'i khams yod pa nya byus dang mu tig lta bu yod pas mi ro gser du sgrub nus pa dang sdig pa dngul chur sgrub nus pa yin la rang rgyal gyis 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing du sku gdung rdor byin gyis brlabs pa'o zhes dang / dud 'gro las mir gyur pa dang mi dang dud 'gro 'dus pas mir skye ba sogs ni so so'i las dbang ngo zhes dang / gser gyis dbul ba sel ba lta bu spyir sgro btags yin yang kun rdzob tu gnas tshul la'ang cung zad zhugs te gser dug bral zos na tshe ring ba'i phyir dang / phyir rin chen sna bdun dang ldan dus mi rnams kyang dge ba bcu spyod par 'gyur la rin po che so so'i phan yon mang ba dang / nag po'i klus rin po che dug can sprin du bcug pa'i char gyis mi ngas dang mu ge sogs skyed pas nor bu ni skyon yon gyi nus pa che'o zhes dang / snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad ni steng 'og ma bgrangs pa'o sogs dang /'go nad ni thang shing gcig 'bus zordo na thams cad la 'go ba bzhin dang /gdon gyis brlams pa ni chu la grib ma shar ba lta bu ste ye shes dbab pa dang 'dra'o zhes dang / sman gyis tshe sring ba'i thabs yod dam de gang du skye ming ji ltar btags ces dris pas/ yod de de ni gang du'ang yod la gang du'ang ma skyes so sman gyi ming ni 'chi mi 'chi'i sgro skur dang bral ba do ha zhes pa ste chos dang chos min mnyes pa'i khu ba gnyis su mi bya bar gcig tu byas la btung ngo 1269

zhes pa na de ni do ha'i phyag chen sgom rim du snang ngo / /de lta mod kyi 'phags pa 'jam dpal la sti stang ma byas so snyam nas bzhengs ma thag 'jam dpal khyams kyi ri mo la thim ste sgo khang gi steng nas legs so legs so zhes grag go /der 'jam dpal las sems kyi nges gsang ma thos zhes dgongs tshe ri mo de'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu sems nyid ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da lta ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis ngag tu brjod mi btub brjod kyang don mi ston te de ni blo phyogs re'i yul du lung rigs dang dpe dang 'thad pa du ma bkod pa bde bde ltar snang bas sems kyi gsang rnyed par mi 'gyur ro zhes pa gsan/ der dri gtsang khang 'dir sgo 'byed pa byung na bdun rnam dag bya'o snyam pa na āXzhes pa'i sgra chen po cig gis mnal las bzhengs par snang ngo / /yang 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying pos lus mi mngon par mdzad de/ kye grogs dag rig sngags tshe 'di pas/ /sgrub par bya yis des ci bya/ /tshe yang sgrub pa don ldan na/ /legs kyang 'jig rten smod pa'i gzhi/ /zhes sogs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis dge slong rab gsal gzhon nu la bskul ba'i tshul gyi byang chub chen por bskul ba gsan/ sangs rgyas 'ong srung gi dus kyi pad+ma 'byung gnas yin zer ba dge slong rgan po zhig las skye ba dang rga shi med par 'dod na ma rig pa drungs nas 'byin par byos shig zhes pa gsan zhing / khyed da lta gang du bzhugs/ 'od srung gi dus kyi pad+ma 'byung gnas lags na yul gang du pad+ma las 'khrungs zhus pas/ nam mkha' 'di da lta gang na gnas/ 'od srung gi dus kyi nam mkha' de gang las byung zer te mi snang bar gyur/ 'o na sangs rgyas stong re re la pad+ma 'byung gnas kyang stong 'byung bar 'dug snyam pa na de de bzhin no zhes pa'i sgra grag yang shri parla ta zhes pa rgya gar lho phyogs kyi tsā ri trar skyes pa yin zer ba'i shing thog lo 'dab can zhig phyag na 'dug de rlung gis bskyod pa'i sgra las 1270

da ni ring po mi thogs par tshe thung ba'i rkyen thams cad las grol lo brtson 'grus skyed cig ces zer/ rgya gar sto phyogs su yang tsā ri tra zhig yod par 'dug snyam tshe shri brla ta lho phyogs su yod pa pha dam pa'i grub thob pho mo'i rnam thar las gsal zer ba gsan/ shri parla ta ni dpal gyi ri bo zhes par 'gyur la 'dzam gling na dpal gyi ri bcu gnyis yod par bshad pa'i lho dpal gyi ri nyid la de skabs kyi tsā ri'i sgrar bshad par go'o/ /yang yul lam+bha ku'i zhing skyong gis slob ma rnams la re zhig gsang sngags ma ston blo sbyong gis khrid sngags kyi sgod ldan ma 'ongs pa na 'byung zer ba gsan/ de ltar rtags snang rnams kyi don bsdus nas/ /grub rtags dang po bde ldan ma dang mjal/ /gnyis par 'jam dpal la sogs byang chub sems/ /drug las man ngag gnad kyi sgro 'dogs chod/ /gsum par da lta'i gnas tshul tshe ring yang / /don mi 'gyur zhes nam mkha'i snying po nas/ /rgyal sras brgyad kyis legs par rjes su gdams/ /bzhi pa srog thur rengs par gyur pa dang / /lnga pa lus gnas pad+ma'i rigs rnams kyis/ /rgyal ba mnyes pa'i shes rab mig yul snang / /drug pa lce la ngag sgrib dag pa'i rtags/ /bdun pa pad 'byung la sogs mtshan ma ni/ /bcu yis sngon las zlog du mi stub kyi/ /de min tshe sgrub 'di dag 'bad byas pas/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi rkyen las grol zhes thos/ /ces gsungs nas sku mtshams grol/rgyal tshab go'i shri'i sprul sku phebs pa la dge bsnyen dang grags pa dpal 'byor gyi mtshan gnang / sku skye rnam gnyis/ gar dben rdo rje gzhon nu sogs la zab chos du ma gnang / der nyan thos dgra bcom pa rab gnag ces bya ba gzigs pa la byang chub tu sems bskyed par tshigs bcad kyis bskul nas byang chub chen por dbugs byung / bla ma cham dgon pas mjal zhing gzims gur chen mo sogs phul/ sne gdong rtse nas yar rgyab dpon chen pas sngon gzims gur la 1t+ta71

dmigs te /rma lha khang bya ba'i gur chen rgyu dang bkod pas 'phags pa bsgrubs pa de la sogs pa'i 'bug chen du ma /'bul bar bla ma yang ri pa mngags/mnal lam du o rgyan du byon nas 'khor lo'i 'du ba mdzad tshul gsungs/yang bde mchog dkar po chos 'byung gi dbus su rnam par 'gying ba'i thugs gar thig le nag po mi sdod par g.yon du 'khyug pa'i sgra las sa kā ra hi ya zhes byung zhing mche ba bzhi la bdud rtsi'i bum pas brgyan pa yum dang bral ba zhig tu bdag nyid gzigs/ de'i mod la phyogs bzhi nas ḍa ma ru'i sgra las a haṃ e waX oṃ hūX zhes sogs rdo rje'i glu'i sgra dang u dum wa ra'i me tog kyang rnam par 'thor/ snying gar rtsa ris la byang chub kyi rtse mo zhes pa'i yi ge 'od zer sngo dwangs kyi rnam par 'char tshe ngar 'dzin /dag ste gtad so med pa'i snang ba du ma 'phel bar gzigs/ yang dag chos kun 'byung ba'i sgor gyur pa/ /rnam thar brgyad ldan rnam pa du ma'i gzugs/ /mchog gyur bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi yum/ /zhes sogs nas/ lus kyi phung po nam mkhar thim par byos/ /zhes pa ḍā ki ma'i rdo rje'i glu gsan/ lus nam mkha' la ji ltar sbed snyam pa na/ khyod kyang nam mkhar thim 'dod sems pa na/ /lus ngag yid gsum sbrul mdud bzhin du glod//rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings su rten dang phrol/ /zhes gsan pa'i mod la 'od kyi thig le sngon po sgo nga tsam zhig gi nang du srid zhi thams cad sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis ltar snang ste de'i nang nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer ches 'phags pa du mas/ kye nam mkha' 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gdung gi khang pa yin pas mos pa nan tan du yid la gyis shig /ces thos pa na thams cad 'ja' ltar yal bar gzigs/ yang/ dud 'gro bye ba'i nang nas smra shes shing //don go bsam pa ldan pa'i mi nas kyang / /sogs dang / khengs pa ma rabs rnams kyi mthun snang du/ /'jig rten tshul dang mthun pa ma grub kyang / /rnam 1272

dpyod ldan pa'i so so skye bo ni/ /go sa che chung gang du 'khod rnams dang / /'phags pa rnams kyis rjes su yi rang mdzad/ /blun rmongs rnams la ji ltar snang yang rung / /rang gi 'tsho ba tsam zhig don gnyer ba'i/ /bhu su ku 'a gnas skabs gsum po las/ /yid byed med pa de dag thams cad kyi/ /blo dang mthun par ma gyur bzang po'i rtags/ /yin phyir ak+ṣa badz+ra ji ltar yang / /bde ldan dga' ba'i dbang po yin par nges/ /zhes sogs nyid kyi rnam thar cung zad gsungs/ rje nyid la mtha' dmag zlog par lung bstan zhes rnying ma ba phal cher gyis gleng ba nas nam zhig na slob dpon chen po pad+ma dngos la de ltar lung bstan pa lags sam zhes zhus pas/ cing de rgyal po de khyod rang dang rgyud gcig cing des hor sog 'jang thams cad la lung 'gro bas des lung bstan pa yin na'ang rten 'brel 'chugs/ bod du mtha' dmag 'gegs pa la bstan pa rnam dag dgos te 'ga' zhig la lta ba rnam dag yod kyang spyod pas dben/ kha cig la spyod pa dga' rab yod kyang lta sgom log par shor/ mdor na tshe 'di pa kho na ma gtogs phyi ma bsam pa med/ de'i dbang gis nag phyogs pa rnams kha rgyal te nad mug mtshon gyis gzings pa yin/ khyod kyis jo bo rjes byas pa 'dra ba zhig byung na mtha' dmag mi 'byung ste snyigs dus la mi 'grub/ phugs nas bod 'dir rgya gar nag hor sog gis 'chags 'jig che bar 'byung na'ang gnas skabs su bde ba tsam thub kyang srid/ lo zla re tsam zlog pa'i rten 'brel lha sa bsam yas la sogs par 'di ltar gyis zhes gsung ba gsan/ thun mong gi mthun snang dang bstun pa'i sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i skye rabs kyang cung zad gsungs/shel tham lta bu lag na yod na las ka yod par 'gro'am zhus pas/ spyir rgya gar gyi chos rgyal kha cig dang bod kyi chos rgyal rnams kyi dus spangs rtogs kyi yon tan la dpags nas bsnyen bkur ba'i khrigs so so yod/ de nyams nas las ka 1273

zer ba 'di dar ba yin/ 'di la sa skya pa gong ma rnams dang 'o skol gyi gong ma tshos rgya hor gyi las ka blangs pa la 'ga' zhig rnyed bkur gyi ched yin bsam pa byed kyang de lta ma yin te bod la dmag mi 'byung zhing rgyal khrims rgyug pa'i ched dang zang zing gi gdul bya gtso bor tshogs pas gzhan don du blangs pa yin la spyir lugs gnyis kyi las ka las 'o skol gyi 'di rab byung gi ston pa shākya thub pa'i go sar rgyal pos bkur nas 'dzam gling pa thams cad kyi bla mar bskos pa yin/ gzhan shel tham sogs lag na yod pa tsam gyis las ka yod par mi 'gro gsungs/ 'di shin tu thugs mang ste spyir rgya hor gyi las ka mi brgyud la 'jaṭa pa ni rgyal po la she mong cher bldabs pa re re tsam las mi yong / so so la las ka yod pa rnams kyang lo gsum ma dang lnga ma dang bdun ma dang lo skor re tsam na sdud mkhan mngags te sdud/ yang las ka gzhan du rje ba sogs 'byung / mi brgyud la yod pa rnams kyang pha 'das pa na bus len dgos pa sogs kho na ma gtogs las ga'i go mi chod la/ drung de bzhin gshegs pa la ta'i ming rgyal pos dus gtan gyi tham ka phul bas slar bzhes mi dgos pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i rgyu mtshan gang yang ma go bar mtshal rnyed tshad kyis thel dmar dang tham ka byed par snang ba nas rje nyid thugs 'tsher ba ltar mdzad cing drung na rim gyis rgya hor dang 'brel ba'i 'phrin las thel dmar sogs mdzad pa'i rgyun rgyal po'i re ba rdzogs byed tsam yin rung mthong myong chung ngu mang pos ched du che che 'jigs 'jigs byas pa zhig yin pas ngas kyang byas chog snyam pa mang pos deng sang ngo tsha ba tsam 'dug 'o skol da rang thel nag byas rung chog pa 'dra zhes phyis kyang yang yang du gsung ngo / /'di yan gyi lo rgyus rnams bla ma dpon yig gis bsgriṭa pa dang chos rje mkhan chen pas mdzad pa las cung zad re bsdus pa yin no/ /'di dag gi dus phrag grum tshal gyi chos sde sngar drung gong mas gnang na'ang dar 1274

rgyas su ma gyur pas slar gso bar mdzad de der rje nyid kyi bzhugs khri la 'jam dpal bzhugs par gzigs pas 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i mdangs ldan gyi gtsug lag ṇa/nga du mtshan btags/ do khro rab 'byam pa mkhyen rab rnam rgyal garma grwa tshang gi 'chad nyan pa las phyir byon pa bka'as bsgos te dge 'dun gyi sde mdzad/ther chen nyi shur nye ba la sogs pa dad ldan gyi yo byad ni ri spungs pa lta bu gnang bas re zhig dar rgyas su gyur/ 'on kyang rab 'byams pa gcen pos nan gyis rang yul du spyan drangs pa bsgrub bya'i don por zhen pa dang zhal ta pa zung gis 'du ba'i sgo gnas min du god pa las bar du cung zad nyams pa na mkhas shing gzu bor gnas pa'i skyes chen byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa rgyal ba'i sras kun dga' bkra shis kyis rje'i bka' bsgrubs te btsun chung bdun kho na la 'chad nyan pa dang dbu mdzad chos khrims gsum ga'i go mdzad de legs par brkyangs pas 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i mdangs ldan gyi bshad gra chen po 'di tshugs pa yin la sngon gnang ba rnams zhal ta pa dag gis gnas mino du god kyang slar dgos rgu'i 'byor pas 'du ba'i sgo sbyar bar mdzad do/ /gar bstan la gcig tu mdzad pa che ba chos kyi rje shākya bzang pos rnam thos kyi ri bor sgrub sde dar rgyas su mdzad la phyis phrag yul du sgrub sde rgyas par mdzad de bstan pa la phan par gyur to/ /de la rje nyid dgung lo nyer gcig nas nyer gsum gyi bar rje 'phrin las pa las gsan bsam gyi tshul rgya cher mdzad la/ de ltar dpon slob gnyi ga nas gsan bsam gyi bzhed pa rdzogs pa na rje 'phrin las pa'i dgung lo don bzhi pa glang lo'i mjug tu zhabs skyel gyi dod por brag phyi'i bar du gzims sgar gteg ste mchod pa'i sprin tshogs gzhal du med pas mchod de dbus phyogs su thegs shing slar legs bshad gling du mkhas pa shes rab rnam rgyal gdan sar bskos te yol theg chen rtser bzhugs nas dgyes 1275

rdor brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa rtsom pa mdo rtsa mtsho mchan gyi mchan gzhung sre ba/rgyud pa gra tshang 'dzugs pa/ kurma rabs brgyad kyi sku dang bka' 'bum bzheng ba sogs mdzad do/ /rje'i drung nyid ni sgar chen gyi sngar srol sgrigs ma chen po rnams la yang dus kyi dbang gis dgos pa mi 'dug par dgongs pa dang / spyir sgar gyi srol sngar shin tu bzang na'ang drung gong ma sku mtshams gnang ba nas bzung rgyal tshab rin po che'i sgar sogs la rim pas mig srol 'ad de lugs gnyis ka nas mig rgyu la lta ba lta bu zhig tu gyur pas thugs 'byung bar yang gyur/ sngon drung gong mas kho bos tshe 'di la phar tshad kyi rtsom pa tsam ma gtogs bshad nyan ma grub pas phyi mar bshad nyan byed ces bka' bstsal bar snang ba'i dam bcas pa yang sgrub par bzhed pas thugs cung zad 'byung ba'i tshul gyis khyod rang sgar pa rnams so sor song / kho bo dben pa byed pa yin zhes sku mtshams par mdzad cing gsol gzims la sogs pa'i las tshan rnams kyang dang du ma bzhes par phyag phyi'i sgom chen zhig gis gsol ba dang gsol ja zhu ba byas/ der sgar pa thams cad kyis ngo gang che sbran nas zhus pas bka' gang gnang gi sgrigs byed par dam phul te 'thor mi dgos pa tsam byung / gling dpal ldan gyi dbon po gling dbon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gzims dpon chen mo dang phyag mdzod lhan cig par bskos te bshad sgrub kyi gra 'dzugs dgos pa'i bka' gnang /'di dus sngon gyi yang ri ba'i rgyun sum bcu lhag re yod pa chos kyi sgrigs rnam pa 'bring tsam zhig yod pa'ang re gnyis tshig brtseg byung ba'i rkyen la brten gra bshig nas so sor btang / slar rtses dang bka' bcu pa gzhon nu blo mchogadabu mdzad sangs rgyas seng ge dge 'dun dpal bzang / dgi 'dun phun tshogs te thub chen pa'i gra pa shangs pa gsum ste dge slong bzhi la khyed tsho lhan cig par sdod la smon lam rnams gsung mi 'chad thon/ smon lam pa byas kyang chog yang 1276

ri ba byas kyang chog pa yin bka' phebs te khong rnams kyis bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ gzhan yang dbu ma brag dkar ba'i gra rigs dang byang stag lung gi ri phran pa dang gling pa sogs shas che ba'i skal ldan mang du 'dus pa rnams ༅ nga lhan cig der 'jog pa mdzad pas da lta'i yang ri'i rgyun 'di chags pa yin la bdag gis mjal dus kyang dge 'dun sum bcu lhag tsam pa tshe 'di'i rnam rtog rmi lam na yang mi rgyu ba chos gos rnam gsum hrul po la brten pa yul snang gi dbang du 'chor mi srid pa/ gsol 'debs kyi sgra thos pa tsam kyis snang ba ban bun du byed nus pa/ sger gyi shog skal sogs mi len par 'tsho ba bsod stoms la brten pa kho na snang / phrag tu yos lo'i lo gsar gyi bar lo gsar smon lam yang sngar srol bzhin mdzad/ lo gsar 'di'ang sngon rje gong ma'i dus gzhan phan du 'gro ba yod par sna nga yang deng sang kong po 'dir ltad mo la mi mang thams cad thag ring nas 'du/ de la skyes pa bud med thams cad so so nas sde tshan gyi bsdu stabs byed/ srog chags mang po gsod/ mi dge ba mang po 'phel ba zhig 'dug gsungs nas de phyin smon lam ma gtogs lo gsar gyi rtsed sna ma mdzad/ de'i res klo mang pos ba men sogs phul zhing rtsed sna mang po byas/ sku grib la brten pa'i sku khams cher bsnyel ba zhig byung ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po gzigs par snang zhing bka' lung gnang ma thub pa nas sasto ra la phyag bris gnang nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gyis gsungs pa na rje mkhan chen pas phag mo'i sreg blugs brgya rtsa mdzad pas dwangs par snang / de nas gsum 'grig nas zing por phebs/ 'dir bsam yas nas bla ma khra tshang pa sku mched kyis 'bul chen mtha' yas pas mchod/ de yang rlangs lha gzigs kyi bla'i sku rim pa gung thing khra gsum las khra tshang ba sngon sngags pa nus pa can sha stag gi rgyud pa khra tshang ba chen mor grags pa de ni gsang sngags gsar rnying gi mkhyen pa dang nus pa che/1277

rje chos grags rgya mtsho las thugs dam gyi rtsal rdzogs pas rtsa ba'i slob mar gyur/ bsam yas kyi lcog shar lhor rje'i sku bzhengs pa la bsam yas pa rnam sa snga ma ci rigs zer yang rab gnas zin pa nas char chen bab/ zhag 'ga' nas bsam yas phu la ja pa tshan chen thon pa'i thog ma byung ba nas ja mod/ lo bdun du lo legs pa nas phyis mos par snang ngo / /bdag gi lus longs spyod thams cad rje gong ma'i phyogs su bsngos pa yin gsungs nas ngam shod kyi yar 'on gnyis yar du dus de'i bla gcig mar song bas 'bul nod mang du 'byung ba thams cad la phal pas bltas na ser sna che bar mngon pa tsam gyi zhib tshags mdzad/ kha btags rnying pa dkar po/ nag khra/ sngo khru sogs zhe gcig so so'i dos dos byas pa dang / gos dar chen sogs so so'i kha 'khyar dos su byas pa dang / so so'i yug longs dos su byas pa sogs gos dar kho na'ang ha las thub pa dang / rten mchod khyad can gan dril sogs yo byad mdzod du ma gang ba dang / khyad par nas bed bkyed sogs mdzad pa'i nas khal khri phrag gnyis gsum du longs pa'i zhib gsog mdzad de sgar pa la lo sbrel gyi zhabs tog mdzad par dgongs kyang phebs ma thub/ sku na byon pas mjal ma thub pa nas zhal ngo thams cad la nga'i 'di gzhan sus kyang mi 'ju bas rje'i phyag tu thongs pa gyis zhes zhal chems nan can mdzad/ bsam yas rgyal po la bka' bsgo mdzad nas gshegs/ zhal ngo sku mched rnams kyis kyang nas rnams bka' bkod zhus nas gos snam du dril ba dang / phyag dpe 'di ltar bzhing ba gyis sogs kyi dgongs pa bsgrubs shing yo byad thams cad bzhed pa bzhin phyag tu thengs pa yin no/ /de yang rje'i dgung lo nyer drug pa 'brug lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin bdag lo nyer dgu pa zhig gis zing po 'bum pa sgang du sku'i dkyil 'khor thog mar mjal ba yin la bdag nyid kyi lus longs spyod bde dge dang 1278

bcas pa phul bar rlom mo/ /zhag lnga na sku'i bdud rtsi ga bur du gyur pa byung ba'i rten 'brel las mnga' ris rab 'byams pa phyogs glang legs pa/ khams pa rab 'byams pa seng ge bzang po/ /gu ge rab 'byams pa sde bdun pa/dbu mdzad sangs rgyas seng ge dang bdag cag lnga la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub par bkas bsgos te bsgrubs shing mnyes par gyur/'brug lo de'i zla ba bcu pa tsam nas mkhas pa rin chen legs pa/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa grangs tsam 'dus pa dang por gyur pa la bshad gra'i rgyun mdzad/ 'di'i dus mgo dom gling gsum gyi dpon rnams sgar du 'ongs pa la po bo chu mdo bas gnod pa byas pa'i rkyen gyis po kong gi kur srid rnams kyis dmag chen bsags te po bor drangs sems can gyi las zlog par mi nus pa zhig yod par snang bas rje nyid kyis dgag pa dang sgrub pa gang gi yang bka' ma gnang / dpon rnams sku mdun du gros la 'tshog pa'i tshe yang rje nyid thugs rtsom chos kyi dri rmed ma gtogs gros kyi tshig gcig tsam yang mi gsan zhing mi gnang ba dngul chu sa la bzhag pa lta bur snang / 'di dus bdag zhabs phyir re bcar yod pa'i skabs yin/ phyis pu bor byus 'bring tsam byung bar snang skabs de mo la kha bas bya len mtshang skyel tshang ma byas zer nas 'joms par thag chod skabs rje nyid kyis rgya bdag gzhir yod rnams dang khyad par dpon khro rgyal dpal la dgon pa de bshig 'dug na khyod dang nga mi 'cham zhes bka' nan gyis gnang bas ma zhig pa yin la 'di'i tshe rang phyogs par khas 'che pa phal cher gyis skur ba btab/ drung pa rtse lha sgang pas kyang thugs 'khang mdzad/ yang ri'i drung kun bzang pa'i gsung gis 'o /rma pas grub rtags de ring bstan no rkang rjes lag rjes gang dga' gyis/ /rma pa'i grub rtags gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba 'di 'dra zhig dgos zer nas mnyes 1279

skad/ 'di la bstod pa brjod mkhan bsam shes 'ga' zung las ma byung yang khong rang chu mdo ba rnams kyis kyang de go nas do zhag lo dus su rta bzang ba 'ga' dang bcas pa'i babs bshags 'bul bar slob dpon drag pa gcig gnyis dang mi sna rnams tshal gung du sgar bzhugs dus slebs/ 'bul ba'i gtam la yang dmag ma thub nas babs bshags byed pa min/ na ning de mo la kha rje'i drung rang gis bskyabs pa yin par 'dug pas spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa yin bsams nas dad pa skyes pas bshags pa 'bul du 'ongs pa yin zer ba'i gtam btang / slob dpon drag pa des ga ra drag po'i sgrab thabs kyi dpe zhig gi lang ring ring rang ring zhus pas/ khyod dga' ldan pa cig nga /rma pa cig la rnying ma pa'i chos zhu ba e yin gsung ba'i sku rtsed kyang mdzad pa yin/ 'di las ches sngon tsam du mon rgyal po gā thung gi brgyud pa jo 'bag gi sras gces ming sprang po dar zer ba de blon po khri dpon bzhi dang bcas pas mjal du slebs te khong rang gi skra yang phul/ go'i shri'i las ka gnang / 'bul ba ni mtha' yas par byas shing blon po sin ti gas kyang khyad par du mchod/ yar rgyab dpon chen pa'ang las dbang gis gtsang phyogs su byon pa zhabs phyir mjal te rab byung dang dge slong du bsgrubs/ mu tig gi mchod rten sogs phul zhing chos dang zang zing gis rjes su bzung / 'bri khung chos rje kun dga' rin chen gyis spyan 'dren gyi zhu yig phul/stag lung chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa'i zhu yig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mar dpal stag lung gi gtsug lag khang chen po na gnas pa'i shākya'i dge slong rnam rgyal grags pa dpal bzang pos gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag sngon du 'gro bas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la gtsugs te 'di skad ces zhu ba zhes pa'i zhu yig dngos lan du mar phul ba mthong / mdo smad nas bzhag bla ma kun 1280

dga' dpal gyis rgya spyad khyad par can mang pos sna drangs pa'i 'bul chen dpon po gzhon pas phul zhing spyir snga phyir 'bul chen mang / zhu ngag du'ang ngas gces phrug mi drag gi bu kho na bsdus nas sgar du lo lo bzhin sum bcu bzhi bcu las mi nyung ba brdzangs pa rnams sgar du mjal sa'ang ma rnyed par ser 'bras dge gsum sogs su song ba kho na byung 'dug pas 'phral chas bzang ngan dang dngos kyi 'bul ba yod med la ma gzigs par rjes su 'dzin dgos zhes kyang phul/ ka thog gi chos rje sangs rgyas lta bur lta ba du ma dang / 'dzam thang nas sa bzang ma ti'i sku skye chos rje de dang / smar khams gser mdog pa'i bla chen rnams kyis 'bul nod du ma byas shing / 'jang dmag las skyob pa rje nyid ma gtogs pa re sa mi 'dug pas phebs dgos pa'i zhu yig phul ba ni snga phyir mang / gdan sa phag mo gru nas dpon sa spyan snga rin po ches zhu yig kha btags gos chen las bzang ba dngul gzan chung ngu tsam la thugs rje chen po'i sku dang bde legs kyi tshigs bcad yod pa sogs 'bul zhabs mang du mdzad/'di dag gi dus bstan pa'i 'byung gnas dbus gtsang yin par dgongs nas chibs kha bsgyur ba 'ba' zhig dgongs/ 'on kyang garma pa gdan 'dren med par 'byon pa ngo tsha zer nas kong po 'phral 'tsho'i longs spyod bde dpon rnams kyang yul so so'i khur bsdur yod pa la zhen pas sgar dpon rnams ni 'byon par mi spro/ dbus gtsang na bdag por rlom pa dbang dang longs spyod kyis 'byor pa rnams ni dad pa'i nor dang bral dge ba'i grogs pos ma zin rnam dpyod kyi snang ba med pas phebs kyis dogs pa tsam las med/ rnam dpyod che zhing dad pa dang ldan pa skom pa chu 'dod pa lta bu du ma dang / bstan pa cher snyigs pas skyo zhing rje lta bu phebs na sor chud dam snyam pa re gnyis yod kyang ba tshwa'i rgya mtshor yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu thigs bzhin du song / 'on kyang smyos pa'i bu 1281

la ma lhag par brtse ba 'phel ba bzhin du de tsam gyis rje nyid dbus gtsang kho na la phebs par gcig tu dgongs pa'i dus yin/ 'di dag gi tshe so ga zam khang nas skye ba'i rten 'brel byed pa yin gsungs nas 'brong bu go'i shri pa'i bang chen yod sar kong po nas phyag nas gnang ba sog zam kha'i thang khyab par mang du slebs te de nyid myu gur skyes shing smin pa las sngar nas mi smin pa las de phyin lo thog legs par smin pa da lta'ang yod/ rje kun dga' rin chen sku gshegs pa'i dngul gdung la phyag nas zhus pa rtse lha sgang nas gnang ba 'bri khung thel du mngon sum du slebs pas mi dbang mgon po rgyal mtshan yid 'ches pa'i dad pa thob/ rgyu des zhabs tog rgyun du dka' na'ang spyan 'dren gyi sna tsam byed par zhus pa dang hor gyi dpon thar pa 'bum gyis nan gyis spyan drangs pa lhan cig pas 'degs par dgongs/ lug lo zla ba gsum pa tsam nas mdzod nag cung zad gzigs rtog mdzad de gong ma ta'i ming rgyal pos phul ba'i gser gyi thub dbang dang gnas bcu'i gtso bo mchod yon gyi gsi thang chen mo gnyis dang na bza' bzhugs stan khyad par can du ma zhal mjal gnang zhing slar phyag rdzas du ma 'jud par mdzad/ zla ba drug pa nas sdong po gru sor sgar gral gnang ba na/ spyir brang kha chen po phal cher bsdu ba gnang zin na'ang zhabs drung spyan snga sprul sku dang mtshur phu ba sku 'bring ba bzhugs pa dang / rgyal tshab go'i shi dpon slob bzhi brgya tsam dang mnyan pa sprul sku dpon slob nyis brgya lhag pa sogs bzhugs pa'i skabs yin pas sgar gral la gur nag chen mo brgyad bcu lhag par longs shing gur phran mtha' yas/ yang ri'ang brgyad bcu lhag tsam la gshog chen gcig gi skal ba yang len pa'i bka' gnang / yang ri las zur du dben par bzhugs pa yang lnga bcu lhag dang gra tshang ba yang brgyar nye ba tsam dang spyir sgar pa nyis stong du nye ba tsam rim pas bu chu brag phyi rnams su phebs shing der 1282

spre lo gsar ba nas sgar 'degs pa dang smon lam lhan cig tu mdzang bzhin pas brag gsum du dbyar bzhugs mdzad hor dang rong po chen po sogs kyi ja 'dren dang bskyar bskul slebs/ ston 'bri khung phyogs su phebs nga/ la sngar srol bzhin 'bam thang nas chos rje dpon slob kyis bsu ba mdzad/ 'on kyang mjal lugs drung gong ma dpon slob kyi skabs min pa'i dgos tshul sde pa dang rang gis nan zhus gang phul ba de ga la mdzad/ mtshe'u kha'i thang la sgar chen bzhugs te zla ba bzhi lnga'i bar du tshogs pa la spyi chos dang ras bung pa la ras chos/ chos rje rin po che la dbang khrid du ma dang dgongs gcig gi bshad chen gnang zhing tshoms dang po la bdag gis gsung zin bris byas shing tshoms phyi ma drug la gsung bsdus pa re bdag la sngon du gnang ste mtshams sbyor zin ris ltar gyis shig gsungs te de ltar bgyis/ phyis 'di las lan gsum tsam du je rgyas su gnang ba bka' 'bum gras kyi po ti bzhi bzhugs/ mi dbang mgon rgyal ba'i gcen po nang so slob dpon pas bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ gzhan mkhan po khru ba kha sku skye ba dang chen po stag phu pa la sogs 'bri khung lha sde mi sde'i bla ma rnams dang /byang stag lung nas ja 'dren du btang ba'i dge rgan a rgyal la sogs pa dang /byang 'bab rom pa'i bla ma ka bzhi drug kong pa spyan snga sku mched/ dbu ma sku skye la sogs pa sog pa mkhar ru ba dang sgom sde la thug pa'i bar gyi skya ser mchog dman thams cad kyis 'dud cing mchod/ khyad par hor gyi dpon thar pa 'bum gyis mjal nas rab gnas su phebs dgos par zhus/ der bya lo'i smon lam chen mo yang mdzad de zla ba gnyis pa nas klung shod du phebs/ bkra shis thang du dbyar bzhugs mdzad/ der legs bshad gling nas dge 'dun dpon slob rnams ca/jal bar phebs/ de dus gdan sa pa chos rje shes rab rnam rgyal yin la sgam po spyan snga sku rab chos mdzad phyag mdzod mdzad pa dang lha mthong — 1283

chos mdzad pa sogs gra tshang na bzhugs pa'i skabs yin/ khra ba kha'i sgrub sde rtser gzims khang gi lte bar rje'i drung bzhugs/ de'i phyi'i gzims chung so sor 'bri khung rin po che dang sprul sku rnam pa gnyis rnams so sor bzhugs te zla ba phyed gnyis su sku mtshams dang dbang khrid du ma gnang / 'dir dge ldan rtse shar byang gi chos rje gdan sa pa dang kun spangs pa rje bsod grags pa dang 'bras spungs nas rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhu yig gus 'dud ches che ba dang zhal mjal bar bzhed pa dang phebs par zhu ba sogs byung / gra tshang 'brug lo'i mjug la btsugs pa'i sbrul lo zla ba drug pa nas bdag la bka' gnang ste gnas brtan gyi rnam pa byas/ 'di nas thugs dam brtags pa na mnga' ris rab 'byams pa phyogs glang legs pa la babs nas bskos ja gnang slar ra sgreng stag lung sogs kyi gnas gzigs/ skal ldan gyi don mdzad bzhin par stod lung mtshur phur phebs/ mi ring bar dbon po gling dpon sngar bsnyung nas lo gnyis su nye ba song ba de gshegs/ bla ma rin po che kre chung gis 'bul nod rlabs che ba mdzad/ khyi lo gsar nas smyug lar spyan drangs te gdan sa pa shes rab rnam rgyal la sogs kurma gra tshang gi dge 'dun dang / zha lu smon lam pa la soṭa gsang phu kho pe'i dge 'dun dang / chos rje lha dbang blo sogs skyed tshal 'og ma'i dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i bsu bas spyan drangs/ na kha phug tu sgar phab/dbyar de sems can gyi las dbang gis gtsang dbus kyi zlos pa cher byung yang rjes su chings kyi bka' bkod gnang bas 'jags/ sne gdong rtse nas kyang spyir kurma pa'i go sar phebs pa tsam la 'bul ba'i yig skur dang / de nas rgya nag gi bla ma mdzad pa'i dang / slar phag gru pa rang gi bla ma zhus pa ste yig skur gyi rim pa gsum yod pa las 'di nang gi che shos de yin zhes gong 'og tu mtho re lhag pa dang / zhabs kyi pad+ma la dngos po thams cad kyis 'dud cing 1284

zhu ba zhes sogs kyi yig bzos dang bcas pa'i 'bul ba rgya spyad gtso che ba bzang zhing rlabs che ba'i 'bul bar dbu ru'i dmag dpon che bgres bying pa cha/ chen dang drung yig myu gu ba sogs mngags shing gzhis ka gong dkar nas dang 'phyong rgyas pa rgyal chen gling pa sogs so so nas ja 'dren phul zhing bying pa ma chen gyis gtsug phud phul yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen zhus thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pas rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu par 'dzin no/ /slar drung gong ma'i dpon chen dpon po brtson 'grus pa sogs gnang ste chab shog gnang byin ga'u le bzhin mdzad/ hor dang rong po'i gseb tu phebs par zhus kyang dgun bzhugs mtshur phu'i skungs su gnang bzhed pa nas 'dam gzhung du ma thegs par gnam gyi sa ci rigs par phebs te so sos mjal/dgun skungs su dben pa mdzad cing gsung chos 'phel bar gnang / sog zam pa sku mched kyis 'bul nod mdzad cing rab byung bsnyen rdzogs gnang / gzhis ka rin spungs pas gtsang du phebs par zhus te phag lo zla ba lnga pa'i yar ngo la mtshur phu nas bteg ste dbu ri nas gzhu la phebs/ der 'jam pa'i dbyangs 'chi med dpal bzang pos mjal zhing gus 'dud mdzad/ snye mo rin chen rtse pa'i dpon sa gser khang mas mchod/ rim pas sa dkar gru so brgal te rong chen gyi nang brgyud/ zhag gcig gi sa nas dpon drung g.yung pa khams pa ba dpon rags bsdus thams cad kyis bskor bas gdan 'dren dang nyin bskor gyi sa nas gtsang g.yas ru dang ru lag gi bdag po sa skyong ngag dbang rnam rgyal sras sku mched dang dpon drung g.yung pa ma chen dang bcas pa dpon rnam pa che rigs thams cad kyis bskor ba'i chibs rags lnga brgyar longs pas bsus/ byams chen chos lung / chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma la sogs 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi tshogs pa/ chos rje lcang ra rab 'byams pa dang 'bum ram pa dge 'dun nyi 1235

mas gtsos pa gser mdog can pa'i dge 'dun sogs rab tu byung ba stong phrag mang po'i ser sbreng / gos sku chen mo bshams pa la sogs bkod pa mtha' yas pas spyan drangs te mkha' ru steng du sgar phab/ 'di nas yang ri'i bla ma la grub chen kun dga' bzang po bskos/ 'di'i dus la stod lho khri skor nang bshig ste rgyal srid nyams pa'i mgon skyabs mdzad de bdag po yab sras kyi sku skal la pha drug stong skor gyi sa 'jags pa/ zhal ngo mi gte la bzhugs dgos pa'ang sgar du chos mdzad byas nas bzhugs pas chog pa byung / thob rgyal ba rab tu phyung ste kurma don dam yang dag 'phags su mtshan btags/ klog pa'i grar sbyangs pa mdzad ring por ma thogs par mkhas par gyur te karma 'dul gra gling gi bshad sde btsugs nas dar rgyas su gyur/ nyug rgyal khang dang bsam grub rtse'i bar du mchod yon lhan cig pas phebs te nyin bzhin mjal ba dang gsung chos gsan/rje btsun rat+na bha dra zhes deng sang dpyod ldan gyi dge pa'i bshes gnyen gcig pu par grags pa 'di dang slob dpon nag po spyod pa pa'i sprul skur grags pa rje btsun kun dga' sgrol mchog pas kyang 'di skabs su mjal te chos gsan/spyir sde pa rang gi bzhed pa la rin spungs skor du lo gcig shangs 'brong khang dang bsam grub rtse sogs su lo gcig seng ge rtse pa'i dpon ris rnams dang lho skor du lo sbrel tsam mchod yon lhan cig pas thegs bzhugs mdzad par bzhed kyang rje'i drung dben pa la thugs gzhol ba nas bzhed pa bzhin ma grub/ 'on kyang zha lu ngor khro phu sogs su gnas gzigs gnang / bshad gra 'di 'a thugs gtad ches pa yod pa nas dgongs pa dang sbyar te 'thus btsun du ma phul 'dug pa sbyin bdag gi cha nas rjes su yi rang yang sgod kyi cha nas skal ba can mang po ni ma byung ba 'dug 'bul nod ni rlabs cher mdzad de ru mtshams kyi phu jo mo gangs dkar ma'i gnas su phebs/ sngar gling dben gshegs pa nas dbon po 1286

rdo rje 'bum gyis phyag mdzod lo gcib/ tsam mdzad nas rtsis phul/ gtsang la phebs ka nas rgyal tshab sprul pa'i skus gu'i gung pa'i las ka yin bzhin pa nyid las phyag mdzod kyi rtsis bzhes kyang 'khrul zhig chen por rtag tu bzhugs las tshur mthong gi byis pa rnams kyi spyod yul du ma 'tshams pas slar rtsis phul/ rje'i drung yang thugs rtag tu dben pa la dgyes pa nyid las lhag par yang snyigs dus kyi tshul la thugs 'byung bar gyur te spros pa chung ngu kho na la thugs gzhol/ phyag phyir bshad sgrub kyi snod ldan bya btang 'ga' zung las mi bsten par dgongs kyang sku rab chos mdzad pa phyag mdzod pa dang gzims dpon chen mor bzhugs pas thabs mkhas kyis sgar pa bskyangs pas rten gnas gzhan ma mchis pa rnams la brten sa yod pa byung / sde pa sgar pa'i sras mo rnal 'byor ma zhig la byung ba snye mo rin chen rtser btang bas dpon sa gser khang mar grags pa des sngon gzhur mjal/ phyis bsam grub rtser mjal yang gzims yol gyi nang du bud med phyin mi chog pa dang phyag dbang rjen pa mi nag la mi yong ba'i dbang gis thugs ma gang / phyis 'bri khung zur bzhugs pa phebs pa na mchod yon dbyer med par gyur pa nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa jo mo gangs 'dab dang 'brong bu dgon rnying dang spel rom sogs ci rigs par bzhugs pa'i tshe gzhu snye'i mi sus kyang mjal du ma 'gro snar pa la gnas tshang ma gtong tshong ma byed bsod stoms ma ster gsung ba la sogs pa'i khrims byas pas sgar pa'i 'grim 'grul mi thar ba byung /de ltar nye skor ba rnams kyis 'bad pas bkag mod kyang gtsang dbus lho byang thams cad kyi skye bo ni lung par mi shong ba snyam pa rgyun du 'dus/ ya 'brog khri dpon gyis kyang mjal du byon te 'brog phyogs su phebs par zhus/ 'di'i tshe tshogs chos chen mo gnang ba'i gral du da nged rang ring po mi thogs par snye mo lung pa'i 'jigs skyob dang phun tshogs rab brtan gyi khang pa'i 'jigs skyob la 1287

'gro dgos/ 'dzam gling rab 'byam sa pa ngang snye mo'i mi rnams pha yi/ na ya ra 'jigs skyob zhu bar sleb yong / de byung tsa na nged rang mi gtong dbos pa yong / gtsang pa la zhen che bas shaṅkar ba gtong / lab mkhas pangag dge bshes sangs rgyas dpal grub gtong / rdzig rjeg yin pas mgon po bla ma gtong / de tsam na phun tshogs rab brtan rtsis len dgos pa yin/ zhes nyin gsum tsam bstud mar gsungs skad/ 'di'i tshe dpon sa mchod yon dgung la reg nga/'i dus su snang / de nas zla ba phyed gnyis tsam na dpon las gtsang pa las ngo ldog pa'i tshul gyis thon pa la dmag mdzad pas mtshan mo stong 'ur byung / des skrag ches te gzhu snye bor te mchod yon lhan cig pas bros/ shul pa thams cad skrag ches de 'dus chen gra tshang gi chos rje 'dzam gling pa dang gzhan snye mo'i dpon rib/sa rgan sna thams cad 'jigs skyob zhur rje'i drung du 'ongs/ sngar bka' ji ltar gnang ba bzhin khong rnams gnang ste phun tshogs rab brtan gyi gzhis ka bzung /phyag mdzod sogs sngar nyams zin ma gtogs ma nyams par mdzad de dpon sa khong rang byon nam gtsang pa byon nam su byon la rtsis sprod par dgongs kyang /beng rang ni thal mar dbus la bros/ zhag nyi shu tsam nas gtsang dmag slebarngag ba 'i mi sna'i lag du 'phrod pa ma dzad/ snye mo lung pa dmag gi 'jigs pa las skyabar / pas phan bde'i 'phrin las mdzad/ spyir spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa nyid drung spyan drangs te gang yod 'bul bar bzhed kyang sgar pas thegs su ma ster/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'ang thugs chad pa'i tshul gyis dwags kong gi mtshams sam kong po stod tsam du mjal bar smon zhes pa'i zhu yig phul te sku gshegs/ skyen rgyal po mtshan ldan thun mong ma yin pa'i sbyin bdag yin pas mjal du 'gro kha'i tshe khyod rang yar ma 'ong nged kong ngo/da 'ong bas nged rang phrad 'ong gsung ba'i bka' shog phebs/ de nas zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa sprul pa'i sku 1288

dkon mchog yan lag/ rgyal po mtshan ldan gyi sras su bya lo hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la sku bltams/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa bkra shis ljongs su phebs thog rgyal po mtshan ldan mjal du byung ba la khyod kyi bu tha chung de nga la phul gsungs nas khyi lo zla ba dgu pa'i bco lnga la ba yur mjal te dpal mkha' spyod pa'i sprul skur ngos 'dzin mdzad de gtsug phud gzhan gyis 'breg pa na ma gsan te rje'i phyag gis bcad/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag gi ngo bo yin pas mtshan yang der btags/ slar dgung lo phyed dang gsum pa na phrag yul du mjal ba nas phyag phyi bcar mar mdzad/ zhwa dmar gyi cod pan bcings/ 'di'i tshe yangs pa can du yang sprul sku zhig bdag rkyen mdzad/ drung nas bkra shis dar rgyas kong por phebs dus sprul sku rin po che la thog mar thugs yid 'ches pa'ang mdzad/ mthar sprul sku 'di nged rang tsho la gnang dgos/ 'di kho na min pas khri thog tu bskos gsung na'ang sko/ gang yid 'ches pa skos gsung na'ang sko/ zhes nan gyis zhus/ sgar pa rnams kyis kyang zhwa dmar ba'i sprul sku yin na nged rang gis bdag rkyen gnang bas gnang go chod pa cig mi yong bas phar gnang ba 'thad zer ba nan gyis zhus kyang drung gong ma dpon slob gnyis kyang lhan du bzhugs mun thung bas lan pa yin/ khyed rang tsho sku skye gang la 'tshol rung 'di gzhan don nus pa cig nga rang gis bzo ba yin gsungs nas ma gnang / rgyu des sgar gyi sprul sku la yid 'ches ma byung / nged rang gi 'di ka yin par 'dug ces sne gdeng dang 'phyong rgyas su zhus te thag bcad/ spyir sprul sku'i bdag rkyen gnang ba'ang don la yin min la ma bstos par yangs pa can gyi sa gzhis la dgongs nas bdag rkyen mdzad snyam pa cig spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i slob ma rnams kyis yid la bzung nas nged rang tshos kyang bcos pas yong snyam pa shar/ ngo bo bla ma la dad pa med pa dang / spyan snga thams cad 1289

mkhyen pa nyid kyang slob ma rnams la thugs chad pa cig byung ba 'dra bas sngami/na ring zhig tu gus 'dud so gas mi byed kyi steng du mjal du phyin pa la chad pa byed pa la sogs byung / klung shod khra ba khar bzhugs dus rtseng ldeng mi dpon pa sogs yangs pa can pa'i ja zhus 'bul du slebs/ de rnams la sku rtsed kyi tshul du khyed rang tsho'i sprul skur grags pa 'dis lo bco brgyad nas bzung lo tshigs 'di dang 'di lon pa na rtags 'di dang 'di lta bu 'ong zhes lung bstan pa rnams kyi lo tshigs dang po la phyag mdzod pa dang nang zhig byung ba sogs mdzad pa mi legs par snang ba du ma byung ba nas phyag mdzod nas kyang mnal sad pa ltar gyur te sprul sku la sprul skur ngo shes pa tsam zhig byung phyis rje nyid kyi thugs rje dang chos skyong gi 'phrin las las sngon mchod gzhis rnams khyed rang tsho'i lag tu 'ong zhes lung bstan pa ltar byung ba 'di yin no/ /'di'i tshe hor dang phyag mdzod pas gdan drangs pa'i dbang gis yangs pa can du phebs te sprul pa'i sku dngos khrir phebs pa'i shis brjod mdzad/ slar gzhu snyer phebs/ rje mkhar gyi chos sder spyan drangs shing mgon skyabs zhus/ ya 'brog khri dpon gyis spyan drangs te sna dkar rtse'i khri khang du phebs shing gus pas mchod/ dro bo lung gdan sa pa ri khrod ras chen gyi sprul sku kurma bzang po dang rgyal mkhar ba mi dbang grags pa dpal 'byor mchod yon gyis spyan drangs pa'i rkyen dang lho phyogs kyi gdul bya'i skal ba'i mthu dang sgrub gnas chen po gzigs par yang bzhed pa nas stag lung gling thud rnams nas smon mda'i la nas lho stod du phebs/ yul gru de dag gi sa skyong ngag dbang mi bskyod rnam rgyal sku mched sku phra mor bzhugs pas men thang gnas dang lha lung la sogs par spyan drangs 'bul zhabs kyis mchod/ gu ru lha khang du phebs te jo bo la mchod pa mdzad/ der chibs rgan po cig shi ba yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel gyi tshogs su gyur te de dag gi mchod pa'i rten du 1290

gyur/ grung la dang chos la nas brgyud gangs can du bka' rgyud kyi chu bo thams cad kyi 'byung sanas gdan sa chen po sras mkhar sprul pa'i pho brang dang dpal dro bo lung du phyag phebs/ sku mkhar la gser thog cig byed gsungs nas bka' gnang ba'i rten 'brel dang thugs rje'i mthu las 'di nas lo bcu pa la gser thog grub / spe chung ba/ kho thing lha khang ba sogs shar ban pa tshun gyi drag zhan skya ser thams cad kyis mjal zhing spyir sgar gyi 'bul ba la bstos na rgya mtsho'i mdun na chu thigs yin mod kyang yul gru de dag gi skye bo'i mthong ba la bstos pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ slar grung la nas brgyud sman thang du phebs/der khra pa'i dpon sa don grub pas nan gyis spyan drangs te phebs/ zhong kha'i dgon pa la brten nas /rma bstan dpal gyi chos sde 'debs par zhus phyag nas gnang / bu khrul nyis brgya lhag pa phul/ khong rang sku chas bsgyur dpon chen gnang / slob dpon du rab 'byams pa bzang po rgyal mtshan gnang na'ang phyis srib rdzong gi ri la btsan rdzong gi chos sde btab pas cung dgongs par yang ma 'byor/ ya 'brog pa dang dpon g.yog gi 'jam chags gnang ba'ang sde pa chos rjes thabs kyis 'jig par mdzad pas chos sde ni chags ma thub song ba snga ma dgongs pa gang gtad de byed dgos pa'i don du snang / dpon sa tshe dbang dar rgyas pas zhabs phyir chos byed par zhus pa na re zhig khyod kyis khur khur na khyod rang tsho'i rang yul du log chog pa tsam yong / de nas chos gyis gsung ba de kho na bzhin du byung bar 'dug glang lo 'di'i dgun ha bo gangs bzang gi 'dabo kha ro'i gnas su bzhugs/ khri dpon pa zhabs dbang zhu bzhed kyang ma nus pa'i tshe de mkhyen nas zhabs cung zad brkyangs pas ches dad pa thob/ rgyal rtse bdag po yab sras gshegs pa'i don du 'bul zhabs rgya cher byas/ gzims dpon kun legs kyis rab byung zhus/ stag lo gsar ba'i zla ba gnyis pa tsam nas 1291

smyug la pas spyan drangs te dpakha/ sder sbyin bdag dad 'byor can gyis zla phyengo lhag pa mchod/ sde pa srang mgo ba 'a/ sogs sde srid phag mo gru pa'i blon chen rnam sa kyis gus zhabs kyis co/chod de chu bzang gi 'u nga nang tsha rags phur sgar phab ste ston zla tha chung gi bar du bzhugs shing bstan pa'i sbyin bdag smyug la bas rgyun gyi zhabs tog dang gong dkar nas sde srid 'gro ba'i mgon pos 'bul zhabs rgya cher mdzad/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku la bsnyen rdzogs gnang nab/ kong po'i gdan sa rnams su/ thegs pa'i zhabs skyel sgar tshugs gcig gi bar du mdzad/ gtso bo lha bug pa can pa yar stod shar gyi bdag po dang 'phral du de'i blon po gri gu'i rdzong dpon dpal chen pas spyan drangs te byang thang gi la nas 'brog gi gzhung brgyud de thog mar gri gu dang rim pas yar stod du phebs/khrom sa thang byang chub sdings la sogs par gzhan phan mdzad cing shaspu'i gangs la dben pa mdzad par dgongs te gzims spyil yang mdzad/ dpon sa gdung brgyud kyi dbu skra bsil zhing dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/ lha rdzong dpon pa des lhun po sgang zhol du klu khang zhig mdzad nas 'dir garma pa'i chos sde zhig 'ong zhes dga' tshal chos kyi pho brang zhes rdo la brkordorga pa mdzad 'dug pa ltar der gtsug lag /bang mdzad de bshad gra bzhugaru/ su gsol/ slar gri gu yol dkar du bzhugs pa nas lho rgyud gnyal lor byar gsum gyi bdag po bya pa khri dpon sku mched kyis spyan drangs te shel ca/khar rdzong chen brgyud/ dbyar sar sgar phab ste dgun bzhugs mdzad cing khri dpon pa rang dbu skra bsil zhing sna gcig gcod pa'i dge bsnyen du bsgrubs/ bya pa sprul sku 'di dus gtsang na bzhugs pa bya pa sku mched rang gis nan gyis spyan drangs te rje'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs zhu bar bzhed kyang dbu che du mas gshol te dgung lo bcu bdun pa la dpal 'khor bde chen gyi chos rje las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad du bcug pa sogs las mjal ba ma 1292

shar/ bya pa rang gis brag gong dpal ri la chos sde 'debs par zhus/ pad+mo bkod spo bar zhus kyang gzhis pa rnams spor ma gsan/ dpal ri rdo rje'i gdan du ming btags te phyag nas gnang / de'i rgyur dmigs pa'i gnang sbyin yang mdzad par 'dug rgyal chen sku rab pas spyan drangs te 'bul zhabs mdzad/'di yan zur ri'i mtshan tsam yod kyang sde gcig tu bsgrigs pa ni med la so sor ci rigs bzhugs pa cig yod pa las 'di nas sde gcig du bsgrigs/ dbu mdzad chos khrims bskos/ drung don rin pa bla mar gnang ba yin/ dwags stod rdzong kha'i logs la chos sde mdzad par zhus kyang btsan cha yod pa bkas ma gnang bar mda'i thang la bshad grub gling gi gtsug lag khang chen po chos sde dang bcas pa mdzad/ shel grong rab 'byams pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs bla ma la bskos/ slar byar skyid sbug sogs su gzhan don mdzad/ sbrul lo la mon pa'i gdan 'dren dang bstun te dom tshang rong gi gnas gzigs/ mon gyi rgyal po dang jo bo'i rigs rgya gar la thug pa tshun gyis mjal du 'ongs te 'bul nod kyis mchod/ 'di skabs dpon po chos mdzad sku che rigs gtso che ba bsdus pa la sngags gra tshang 'di 'dzugs pa mdzad/ rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku yang skabs 'dir sku thim/ sne gdong rtse nas zul phu'i gtsug lag khang phul te phebs par zhus nas dbyar smad der phebs te skal ldan du ma'i don mdzad/ der rta lo la nang so phyag mdzod pa kurma don dam yang dag skyong sku gshegs pa na nged gnyis tshe'i tshad mtshungs pa yin gsung ba dang / yang zur gyi dge 'dun bsod stoms la 'byon pa rnams la nga'i bka' 'bum rnams da grub pa yin pas lung thob pa dka'/ pod dbang zhus gsungs te bka' 'bum rnams brtsigs pa'i pod dbang mdzad/ mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i bka' lung mang du gnang / des dge 'dun rnams kyang thugs slong slong por gyur te sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung sogs 1293

bstan 'dzin chen po thams cad la brtan bzhugs 'bul bar bskul/ thams cad kyis brtan bzhugs phul bas re zhig zhabs brtan/ spyir lha sar jo bo'i zhal gzigs par bzhed kyang 'bras ser gyi dge 'dun rnams kyis khyim la 'khren par mdzad do ces grags pa nas phebs ma bde/ rje'i drung lha sar phebs nas jo bo'i drung du smon lam mdzad na bod la mtha' dmag dang nad mtshon mu ge mi 'byung rgyal khams bde ba 'ong zhes thams cad mgrin gcig du gleng na'ang de lta bu dka' bar byung / zul phu'i ri rtser ri gzigs la phebaca/ pa na zhabs rjes du ma dang chibs rjes kyang brag la gsal bar byung / 'di skabs gung thang gi gtsug lag khang yang mes gshegs/ slar lug lo la smyug la tsha rags nas brgyud mtshur phur phebs te gzhal yas khang dang gser thog la sogs pa'i zhig gso rgya cher mdzad/ thub chen dang mchims phu'i bla mar mkhas grub dpal khang pa ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mtshur phu'i chos 'chad du rngog tshang 'og ma'i zhal ngo mkhas grub bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ legs bshad gling du mkhas mchog bsod nams bzang po rnams bskos/ 'di'i tshe stag lung gi gtsug lag khang mes gshegs pa la zhag 'ga' zung gi gong nas zur tsam lung bstan zhing phyis gso ba'i yo byad kyang gnang / 'bri khung zur pa khong rang ji skad gsung ba'i mjal tshul gyis thugs tshim par mdzad/ 'di dus grub chen kun bzang pa ltas ngo mtshar can dang bcas gshegs nas rgyal ba g.yung rin chen mgon yang ri'i 'dren par bskos/ 'di'i dus nyi ma gza' 'dzin dang phyis zla ba gza' 'dzin zhig byung ba'i 'bras bu la bsnyad nas gtsang du dpon blon 'jig pa dang lho 'brog gi 'byung tshul sogs ma 'ongs lung bstan du ma mdzad par 'dug 'di'i tshe gzhis ka ba'i dmag gi 'ur gyis nyang stod phyogs pa skrag par gyur te dpal bsnams pa sa skyong rgyal dbang rdo rjes zhu yig pa'i gtso bo mdzad/ rgyal mkhar rtse nas nan 1294

gyis zhus te rab tu 'jigs skyob la phebs dgos pa dang yang na rgyal rtse dpal bsnams kham pa'i mchod gzhis pa byas nas drang por bsdad chog pa dgos par nan gyis zhus/ 'on kyang de lta bu gzhis ka ba'i thugs la ldan mi yong / 'on kyang nged kyis phan gang thogs lab gsungs nas dpon drung la da res dmag byas na khyed rang la mi legs gsung ba nan gyis phebs kyang / rgyal mkhar rtse la bskor 'dug zer ba'i tshe mi gnang ba zhu/ sku ngo 'bul zer ba las ma byung /phyis bka' lung gang gnang gi thog du bab/ 'di nas rim pas dpon blon yang zhig de skabs su sgar phebs kyang skye 'gro'i las la bcos su ma byung / gnas chen za phu lung gzigs par yang bzhed/ spre lo spre zla'i tshes bcu dang yang dus mtshungs pa na ti si'i rdzong chen bcu gsum las gzhis ka brag dkar ba'i zhal ngo shangs lha phu bas spyan drangs te gnas rnams gzigs shing ring du 'gro don mdzad/ der drung pa si dhu sprul sku'i 'bul chen gos chen gyi bla res brgya/ gos dar gyi yol ba brgya/ rten khebs brgya/ ja brgya la sogs pa'i brgya tshan mang por longs pa'i 'bul ba slebs/ sku rab nas nan gyis spyan drangs pa'i ngo la lcags mo bya'i lo la chibs kha bsgyur/ thel bsam yas kyi gnas skor gnang bzhed pa na sne gdong nas phebs mi chog pa'i rgyu mtshan gsungs mi btsun tsam phul bas khong rang la mi legs pa 'byung bar lung bstan te nged la khong gi bka' bkyon phog pa yin gsungs nas khong gi lung rgyug pa'i sar na bza' yang bzang po ma bzhes/ lha khong gi gzhung dkyil skyes su phebs nas gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gra tshang 'dzugs pa mdzad de phyis rin spungs pas thub bstan gser mdog mchod gzhis dang bcas pa phul bar bzhugs te mkhas pa tsha ba rab 'byams pa bla mar bskos/ sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa kong po nas phebs te sgar nas lugs gnyis kyi bsu ba'i bkod pa chen pos spyan drangs/ bzhugar/ khri khyad med du 12 9rta

bshams pa la bzhugs/ phyis gdan sa'i rten 'brel la dgongs par 'dug spyan snga gong ma'i phyag rdzas khyad nor du ma yang phul/ bya skur gyi zhal ngo rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya chen gyis mchod/ 'di nas brtsams te rten gadzhai la nas bzung phyag rdzas khyad par can thams cad nyin re zhing rnam pa gzigs mo'i tshul gyis phyag gis sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag tu gtod pa gnang zhing don gyis rtsis sprod thams cad gnang bar 'dug yab sras lhan cig pas yar stod du phebs te 'bul zhabs mtha' yas pas mchod/ 'di'i dus kong por kur srid kyi bla ma zhig gis ster byin re bas dgon pa bya pa sku skye la 'bul zer ba byas/ de la sgrub sde mdzad pa na rang dbang mi 'dus par go nas nged rang gi sa srung dgos zhes kur srid sbran/ kur srid kyi khyu snyeg dgos byas pa la lan ma btang bar dus gzings byed rtsis byas pa go nas kur srid kyis dmag byas pa la brten nas lo ro bkra shis mthong smon pa rnams kyis btsun ma'i bar la dmag phral ba'i brgya lhag cig gis sgar gyi mdzo g.yag rnams la jag rkun byas kyang khong tshos bsad pa'i lhag gang phul tsam bzhes/ lan dang bka' bkyon ci yang ma mdzad/ slar bshad sgrub gling du phebs te smon lam chen mo dang chos mang gar 'phyams sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mdzad/ gzhis ka so so dang yul gru so so'i 'bul chen phul/slar gtsang khang 'du khang rgya bskyed pa'i bka' gnang nas sgo gsang sngags gling na bzhugs skabs yar lung du dwags dmag lhags pa'i mdzad dka' byung tshe thel nas dpon sa spyan snga'i drung gis bar mtshams su phebs dgos par nan gyis spyan 'dren zhus pas dpon slob nyung bsdus mdzad nas 'ol kha nas thel du phebs shing bka' chos du ma gnang / gnas gzigs zhib par gnang / tshong 'dus brag khar bzhugs tshe dpon sa gong ma rang phyag 'bul la phebs nas mgon skyabs 1296

zhus/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul sku bdag rkyen gnang ba 'dis cha kho na la dgongs snyam pa de dus dbus gtsang pa rnams la yod pa nas 'di phul na mnyes yong bsams nas bde chen mchod gzhis kyi deb rnams phul tshe yangs pa can phyag mdzod pa sku gzhon pa pha tshad na yod pa la 'phangs te nga la mi dgos khyod rang gyis gsung ba dang phyis mchod gzhis yong bar lung bstan pa bzhin glang lo nas phyag du byung / lugs gnyis kyi yon tan gyis phyug pa 'phyong rgyas nas sa'i dbang phyug hor bsod nams dar rgyas dang smyug la nas gzims dpon kun spangs pa gnyis kyis rgyus yod dang phyag phyi mdzad de gdung rgyud pa dpon g.yog dwags po nas yar phebs thub pa sogs dang re zhig gi chings gnang bas thams cad cung zad bde/ zhar la bsam yas la sogs pa'i gnas gzigs mdzad/ byang chub chen po la ding phon shin tu che ba zhig na bzar phul/ lam mkhan pa mi la brlams pa la sermes bskyed gnang / byams pa gling du spyan drangs te yar rgyab pas gus par mchod/ sngags rnying ma la skur pa btab pa'i rtsom byang rje'i drung gi mtshan la g.yar ba zhig gzhan zhig gis byas pa byung ste rnying ma pa mtha3 dag ma mos pa nas de'i lan dang rtsom tshul la dogs pa dpyad pa drang po'i sa bon zhes bya ba mdzad/ slar sne gdong rtser spyan drangs bka' chos gnang ba na dpon sa nyid bzhugs dus gdung rgyud khri thog tu 'os pa zhig rgyal tshab kyi tshul du phyag phyir thugs brel gcod du bcug khri thog du rtsod med yong ba mdzad na rgyal khams thams cad la phan zhes bka' gnang ba la'ang de lta mi 'char bar zhus/ lab chings kyang gnyis thad nas ches dka' ba'i tshe thugs sun pa'i tshul gyis sa mtshams 'di las sus brgal ba'i sde gzar byas pa la chos skyo nga gis chad pa thong zhes gsung ba gadzad de bshad sgrub gling sogs la'ang phebs ma gsan par tsā ri mtsho dkar la thegs/ gri gu bas sna mor bslus byas pa dang bya skur gyirngashe yar 1297

gzhung la bcug pa gnyi ga'ang nyes pas sa mtshams las brgal ba'i bka' chad yin par gleng zhing 'dug rten chen gyi sku rgyu zangs rtse khal sum brgya tsam longs pa na bdag la bka' shog phebs te bshad sgrub gling gi gtsug lag khang 'di sbyin bdag gi sdig sbyong dge spel du dmigs kyang gtso bor nged rang la khur bab pa zhig byung ba khyod kyis 'di'i do dam byed dgos gsung ba phebs rung dge 'dun sde skyong dgos pa dang mi mang ba nas ma nus pa la tshig gi sbyang ba zhus/ 'o na rgyu byin rlabs de mdo rgyud nas bshad pa'i tshad ldan zhig gyis gsung ba dang / sku'i dper 'jim sku zhig dgos 'dug pa'ang tshad ldan gyis gsung ba phebs pas ram stod gyi gtsug lag khang rnying pa zhig tu mdo lugs dang dgyes rdor la brten nas zhag gsum du byin rlabs tshad ldan bgyis/ rig byed pa rnams la'ang skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa skye mched byin rlob sogs tshad ldan byas/ rgyu byin rlabs kyi shis brjod grub pa'i tshe grub thob paskis mtshur phu'i lha chen grub pa'i skabs kyi shis brjod dang mgur sogs kyi lung zhu mi byung bas rten 'brel legs par yang go/'on kyang bzo bo'ang mang du thong la nan tan byas na 'phul mang po mi dgos pas lo gcig gi nang du grub nges pas brtson 'grus skyed zer ba smras na'ang dbyings che ba'i nam mkhar ldings nas yun ring lus/ 'on kyang gong lar phebs dus zhal ras dang dbu skra'i bung ba phreng 'og ma gtsug gi nor bu rnams bsgrigs pa la bka' lung bzhin bdag gis rab gnas kyi cho ga bgyis shing phyag nas gnang /bar du sde gzar sna tshogs pa byung na'ang sku rgyu'i zangs leb bzhugs pa'i khang pas skyel ma thub pa byung ste zags god med pa las phyis rgyal sras kun dga' rin chen bshad sgrub gling gi bla mar bskos pas dpyis phyin par mdzad de 'di nas lo brgyad pa bya lo la rab gnas legs par bgyis/ sde gzar de lta bu'i skabs su'ang rten chen bar chad med par grub pa dang bzo bo rnams la'ang bar chad med1298

pa ni dgongs pa gtad pa'i byin rlabs kho nar 'dug pas dkon mchog la yid 'ches na des chog par go mtsho dkar na bzhugs dus stag lung chos rje sku mched gsum cung zad thugs 'dzol ba ltar snang ba na sku 'bring bas sgar du phebs pa yin pas mgon skyabs gnang dgos zhus pa la'ang spyir mjal spro na'ang thugs ma mthun pa la sgos dbon so sor 'tshol ba mdzad na gtan mi yong bas thugs mthun pa kho na dgos zhes bka' gnang bas sel chen por ma song ba mdzad/stag lo gsar ba nas bdag gis kyang thams cad rmi ltas sogs rtsub par gleng ba dang dgung skeg 'di nye bar 'dug pas stag yos gnyis po la sa gcig tu gdan chags pa'i sku mtshams dang sku rim gnang ba zhig zhur btang ba la nged rang yang de ltar bsams rung bsam chung rnams nyan par mi spyod 'dug pas bsams pa las ma bsams dbang che ba zhig byung gis dogs zhes pa phebs/ spyir rje btsun 'di lta bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin gcig pa kho na gdul bya la gang 'dul gyi skur snang bar zad pas skad cig ma gcig gi gzigs pa dang rnam par thar pa'ang blos bsam par mi nus na rnam par thar pa thams cad lta ci smos/ 'on kyang tshur mthong rnams rjes su bzung ched dag nga/'i gzigs pa bka' bstsal ba kho na yang spyir bgrang gis mi lang yang bye brag du cung zad brjod na/ stong gsum shong ba'i glang chen spyi bo la/ /mi ro zhu ba'i mar khus gtams pa'i nang / /rang lus sdong bur 'bar ba'i rtse mo na/ /rma bya'i sgong nga kha nas skye bzhin gar/ /zhes sogs ye shes kyi dhū ti la rnam shes kyi dbu ma dag pa'i rtags dang / re zhig rang lus yan lag bzhi po ni/ ljon shing chen po bzhir gyur lag gnyis kyi/ /rtsa ba nam mkha'i gzhi la sra zhing 'thas/ /rkang pa sa la sra zhing lhag par 'thas/ /lus kyi nang kun rab tu stong pa la/ /gangs ri'i dum bu gnyis shig rgod cing 'phro/ /zhes sogs rnam smin gyi lus dag pa 1299

dang / lus zungs bdun dang sbas pa'i rtsa lnga dang yan las/ gi rlung lnga da nga yan lag bzhi dang rtsa phran thams cad dang rtsa gsum so so'i rlung bcas la bsreg pa thebs pa'i rtags dang / rtsa 'khor rnams dang don lnga dang snod drug dang lus kyi 'byung ba chen po rnams bsregs nas ye shes kyi skur gyur pa ste mdor na rdo rje theg pa gtum mo'i rnal 'byor gyi yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag zhal sum bcu rtsa bdun ma'i sku la dbu ma dgra gcan gyi gzugs lte bar dus me dang bcas pa'i dug sbrul gyi mgo phag zhal dbus ma spyan gsum pa'i spyi bor thon pa'i lce rtse gsum gre/yo ba'i dbus ma'i rtser dpal he ru ka bzhugs pa'i 'od kyis rnal 'byor ma drangs pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i spyi bor rdo rje 'chang dkar po bzhugs pa'i hūX sgras 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i paṭa pa sbrul shun ltar 'phar te rdo rje sems dpa'i sku la gsol bas sngon por gyur zhing yum gyi dbu thod mar me gnyis chad ltar 'phar te rdo rje 'chang gi mgrin par thim pa'i mod la sdom pa yab yum stong chen du yal ba dang / sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar be+e ḍūr+ya'i bum pa nor bu'i tog can gyi nang du rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi nang du dpal ldan bla ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi /3khor 'das gang gis myong yang rnam shes gtan bral du byed pa de rten brten pa dag pa'i me phung gis rnam pa thams cad pa'i rten 'byung du 'kho/0/ bas bum pa nas phyir lud 'khor 'das thams cad du bo bas lcags la grub pa'i dngul gyis thebs pa ltar gyur pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rdo rje lcags kyu'i rnam pas dbral ma nus pa dang / dngos po dang dngos med rtag mi rtag sogs kyi spros par ma khom pa las rdo rje pha lam gyi me thab gru gsum sum bshibs kyi nang du rnal 'byor ma lang long du 'du ba'i me phung rtse mo gcig pa'i rtser bla ma he ru ka phyag na glog gi zhags pa 'dzin pas chos thams cad la 'debs pa na bla ma'i sku kha ba ltar bab pa me dang 'dres pa dang / ye 1300
