shes lnga'i nam mkha' dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i dbus su bdag gzhan thams cad he ru ka zhal phyag grangs med du gsal ba'i dbu thog dang phyag na he ru ka bzhugs pa las zla ba char ltar bab pa rang gi ba spur thim/ nyi ma grangs med shar ba sku'i 'od zer sngo nag gi gseb tu na bun ltar yal/ dgra gcan nam mkha' nas 'khor ba zhal du mid de thugs gar yal ba dang / me phung gi gseb tu rang nyid ye shes mgon po mi'u thung gel pa'i rnam par bzhugs pas nam mkha' las stong gsum tsam re bcad nas nam mkhar sna tshogs rdo rje dang nyi ma'i steng du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten brtsigs pa'i bum par bla ma ye shes kyi mgon por bzhugs pa rang gi zhal nas dbugs spros pa bdud rtsi'i char du gyur pa las nam mkha' la dpag bsam gyi ljon pa yal ga dang me tog dang 'bras bu g.yur za ba las dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'khriṭa pa 'byung bas mchod pa/ mchod rten de yang skad cig gis rang gi thugs gar zhugs pa dang / dur khrod brgyad so so'i dbus su keng rus mig las nyi ma'i 'od 'byin pa/ khong nas rgyu sto 'dzag pa/ skra dmar ser brdzes pa/ dug sbrul brgyad kyis brgyan pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa lus dpag tshad tsam pa des dur khrod kyi mi ro rnams srung ba na nam mkhar bla ma rdo rje khra gdong ma phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'og ma gnyis kha ṭāX dang cang ti can mkha' lding la zhon pa 'khor du he ru ka yab yum thams cad bya rgod dang khu'i rnam pa can gyis bskor ba sprin ltar gtibs pa nam mkhar lam byung bas gzigs pa tsam gyis ro rnams rang sar yal keng rus rnams byin pa shing ltar rengs pa'i mod la bla ma'i zhal nang du bka' rgyud kyi bla ma rnams lam byon pa dang / rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i nang du khyi gdong ma dmar mo dang glang chen gyi gdong can dkar po 'jig rten las brgal ba'i spyod pa can dang / bla ma natīka thub tu byon 1301

pa'i thugs /ra sems dpa' gnyis kyis rnga yab g.yob pa dang / ye shes mgon po ber nag can gyi tshogs 'og nas me ltar du 'bar/ steng nas bka/'a rgyud kyi bla ma sprin ltar du gtibs/ bar nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro chu ltar 'khol ba thams cad kyi spyi bor bla ma brjod med kyi 'od gsal du dag pa la sogs pa ye shes kyi gzigs snang mtha' yas pa dang / gzhan yang / rmi lam gyi mthong ba mos sgrub kyi snying po las 'byung ba ltar dang / khyad par gu ru mtshan brgyad zhang gi sku brgyad garma pa rabs brgyad rnams dbyer med du gzigs pas de'i sgrub pa bka' rgya ma bstsal ba sogs gzhal du med de de dag ni zab chos so so las gsal lo/ khyad par du rje mnyan pa chen po'i sku 'dra dngul blugs pa las khru tshad tsam sku shin tu legs pa brad bdar byas zin ltar byon zhing khri rgyab rin po che'i phra du mas spras pa mdzad de bla ma sgrub pa'i sgo nas rab gnas gsol 'debasagyis cig par gnang ba stsol ba gzigs nas klung shod bkra shis thang du rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku dge slong kun bzang ba/ drung pa g.yung / 'jam bu dge slong sogs phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin nges bsam pa bcu phrag tsam gyis bla ma sgrub pa'i gsol 'debs kyi rgyun mdzad/ rje nyid kyang srod thun la phebs pa'i sgrub pa zhag bdun tsam mdzad pa na/ rje nyid kyis lho phyogs kyi zhing snying po dag par rje bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan du sangs rgyas te byang sems kyi 'dus pa ther 'bum dang dkrigs chen la chos ston par gzigs te sku'i bkod pa zhing gi rdul snyed kyis mchod pa tha dad pa mdzad pa dang / bla ma he ru gar bzhengs pas mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye/ shes bstsal ba sogs ngo mtshar mtha/ na yas pa brnyes par snang la/ sgrub pa po so so'i nyams snang mngon sum gyi dag pa'i mthong ba tha dad pa yang gzhal du med de bdag gis nyin re zhing so so'i gsung bzhin bris te phul/ spyir yang rje nyid kyi thu na 1302

mong ma yin pa'i chos drug chen mo sogs kyang zur gyi dge 'dun phal cher la gnang ba na chos gnyan pas gsum re la dmigs pa tha dad du gnang ba rnams bdag gis skyor mkhan khrid gnyer gyi tshul byas/ so so 'i nya mas myong rnams bris te skabs su 'bul pa'i shog dril snga phyi 'di rnam mthong na sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar 'di rigs 'dug pa rnams rtsed mo lta bur 'dug snyam pa skye ba ha las thub pa sha stag yod kyang snod min la gsang sgrogs su song dogs pa dang /so so nas yon tan sbed pa 'ba' zhig tu 'dug pa dang / rje'i drung nyid yon tan gsang ba na gtso bor mdzad pa dang khong rnams kyi thugs dam la gnod doṭa bdag gis rten gyi gzungs bzhugs kyi rigs kho na la bzhugs su bcug nas gragal su ma bcug pa yin/ gzhan yang mched grogs so so'i gsung las thos pa ngo mtshar tshad med pa du ma yod kyang gzhan dag gi blor mi chud pas ma bris/spyir ji lta ji snyed gzigs shing mkhyen la rdo rje'i spyan lnga dang mngon par shes pa drug mthar phyin pa ni theg chen mi slob pa'i 'phags chen rnams kyi thun mong yin mod kyang da lta sangs rgyas kyi rnam pas 'dul ba'i gdul bya ma tshogs pa dang /khyad par snyigs dus 'dir skye ba mang po dran no phyag rjes zhabs rjes byung ngo nam mkha' la 'phur ro bya ba la sogs pa zer ba'i zhig po dang sprul skur grags pa yul gru re na'ang mang por snang la de dag gi tshul la rjes su dpag pas dpyad pa na tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur dang zang zing ngan ngon tsam 'di sgrub pa 'ba' zhig tu snang bas de dag gi cho 'phrul ltar snang ba de dag kyang byung ba'am ma byung ba'am ci zhig snyam pa dang / byung du zin rung spyan mngon shes ltar snang tsam ni bdud kyis kyang skyed pa du ma yod pas de dag gi rgyu ci snyam du som nyi 'phel bar mthong la de'i phyir rje 'di ni spyan mngon shes dang ldan par zhal gyis gtan mi bzhes la/garma pa'i mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa zhes pa tsam las dngos su zhal gyis 1303

mi bzhes pa ni deng sang sngon gyi bzang po che ge mo zhig dang de nas bzang po ga ge mo zhig tu skyes pa dran no zhes brjod bzhin pas da lta bzang po ma yin pa'i spyod pas 'tsho ba rnams kyi dregs pa gzhig pa'i ched dang / dus gsum po'ang so skyes kun nas btags pa tsam las ngo bo nyid kyis ma yin pa dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul sku gdul bya la mtha' yas par snang ba rnams kyang dwangs pa'i chu snod thams cad du zla gzugs 'char ba ltar bshad pas snod gcig chag pa'i dbang gis zla gzugs de mi snang ba na yang gang du'ang song ba min zhing chu snod gsar du byung ba zhig du zla gzugs gsar du snang ba na yang gang las shi 'phos te 'ongs pa ma yin pa lta bur gsungs la/ skye ba snga phyi la sogs pa la bden par mngon par zhen pa 'di ni byis pa'i chos yin gyi 'phags pa rnams kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar bden rdzun gyis stong par mkhyen pa'i phyir mngon par zhen pas gcig tu bka' mi stsol ba yin no/ /de lta mod kyi thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas shugs 'byung du bstsal ba ni/ sngon nā gadhū na'i zhabs la gtugs/ /lam nye rgyu'i spyod pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /dpal byams pa'i rnal 'byor rgyal ba'i sku/ /mtshan mnga' bdag me trir yongs su grags//yum bcom ldan 'das ma grub pa'i dpal/ /rje dbang po'i blo gros 'jigs pa med/ /sprul yul bhu ma tha la bskyangs/ /dpal pad+ma badz+ra zhes su grags/ /steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang na/ /rje rgyal ba'i myu gu sprin gyi stobs/ /zhing dag par bsgyur pa'i sems dpa' bzhugs/ /mtshan blo gros rin checa zhes su grags/ /nub kun bzang rol pa'i zhing khams na/ /mchog sbyin pa'i sa bdag tsan+dan sde/ /dus dge bcu rdzogs pa'i ya mtshan yod/ /mtshan pad+ma rnam rol zhes su grags/ /yul byang phyogs yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'dir/ /rje 4 bdag rgyal po'i bla yi blon/ /dbang che bar grags pa'i ngan lam rigs/ /ming rgyal ba 1304

mchog dbyangs zhes su grags/ /bod chen po'i yul ljongs nyams dga' bar/ /blo legs par sbyangs pa'i grags pa can/ /rje dgongs pa rab gsal zhabs la gtugs/ /grum ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes su grags/ /rje phya pa'i snyad pa ma bzod nas/ /yul mdo smad phyogs nas dbus su btol/ /paṇa chen gyi bla ma mang bsten pa'i/ /ming dbu se ru grags pa ma lags sam/ /yum rdo rje bde mas byin gyis brlabs/ /dpal dbyangs can lha mo mgrin par zhugs/ /sngon rgyal rnga brdungs pa'i bag chags gsal/ /don zab mo'i gnad la nges shes skyes//pha grub mchog rnams kyi zhabs la gtugs/ /yul bzung don dag pa'i rten 'brel las/ /nang rnam par shes pa'i 'gyu ba 'gags/ /yul kun rdzob bden pa'i 'khrul tshul rtogs/ /don dam pa'i bden pa rang ngo 'phrod/ /mthong spang gi dri ma rab spangs pa/ /log zhugs kyi mdud pa grol nas song / /yang srid kyi 'ching ba bral ba las/ /sprul bsgyur gyi skye 'chi ci yang ston/ /srong btsan gyi 'phrin las sgrub pa la/ /dgos don gyi zhwa nag gyon pa nas/ /rje /rma pa yi mtshan bzung ste/ /mtha' rgya mtsho'i bar du da dung bgrod/ /dus rtsod par ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /thabs zang zing gi 'du long la brten nas/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa grub pa'i zhing / /yul nyer bzhi'i gnas su bsdus byas te/ /gsang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sprul ba nas/ /bdag byin rlob kyi cho ga stobs bskyed de//lus sems kyi 'khrul 'khor rdo rje bzhigs/ /sku bzhi yi rgyal sa de ru gnon/ /dpal bum pa bzang bo grub pa'i lus/ /mchog thun mong gi zong gu der mchis pas/ /las can gyi skyes bu 'ga' yod na/ /dus deng sang dad pa'i bag chags zhog /ces pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i mgur khyad par can du ma bzhugs/ mdor na sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi gsang ba rnams ni gsang ba'i bdag po rnam sa 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul du zad mod kyang rgya mtsho las chu thigs tsam gyi cha 1305

shas bdag nyid kyis thos pa'ang du ma yod mod kyi gzhan dag gis blor mi chud pa'i phyir btang stoms su bzhag go/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyang zhal gyis ni nged rang mngon shes med pas ces kho na gsung gi zhal gyis mi bzhes kyang gdul bya la ma 'ongs pa dang lkog gyur pa sku rtsed kyi tshul gyis lung du bstan pa rnams ni ches mi bslu ba ste/ sprul sku sman thang 'jam dbyangs pa la khyod tho rangs ma chag par byed pa'i tshe sgrub de ci yin gsungs pas nang du slebs nas rje'i drung 'di la mngon shes de 'dug go nga'i de gzhan su la'ang rgyus med/ mngon shes 'di zhed po yin 'di ma yags zer skad pa dang /bdag zhabs phyir slebs nas zla ba gnyis gsum na rtsis kun bsdus pa'i ri mo thob cig gsungs nas gzigs pa'i tshul mdzad/ res rkyang bgod sbrags bgod kyi ri mo chung ngu re la'ang dka' ba ltar ston/ res sngon su la yang ma grags na bdag gis lta ci smos pa'i gnas mtha' dag rgya cher bka' bstsal/ rje 'phrin las pa'i ṭīka des don mi lhongs par 'dug pas de la mchan bu gyis gsungs te gsol ba'i dus ma gtogs zhabs phyir bsdad de gsung bsgrubs/ rje nyid ni 'dul ṭīka gi thugs rtsom kho na bar ma chad par gnang / ja gral/ 'bul bzhes/ bang chen sleb rdzong / bskos ja bsko bzhag gsung chos gnang dgos/ bka' bkod/ bka' shog skad cha dri rmed/ sku gsung thugs rten gyi zhal bkod/ phyag dpe zhus dag phyag dpe la dmar dang ser sogs kyi 'byed/dge tshul slong gi las gral/ sgar pa'i tshes bcu dgu gtor la sogs pa'i chog gral sogs kyis dus rtag par zing zing por yod rung thugs skad cig yang mi g.yeng / thugs brel de rnams kyang so sor mdzad/ thugs rtsom yang mi chad/bdag gis kyang sku mkhris su ri mo dang mchan bu 'debs pa bgyis shing gzigs lam du phab/ bzhugs gral chen po sogs yod pa zhu mi 'os pa'i skabs la 1306

lar 'di la bshad lugs kyi na yams gang dgongs par bde'am 'di ltar na mchan bu 'di ltar du 'debs dgos par 'dug don gzhan du na mchan bu 'di ltar du 'debs dgos par 'dug snyam nas yid gnyis su gyur pa'i tshi tshur spyan cher gzigs nas res skabs 'di la 'di ltar du gyis gsungs pa dang /res 'di la ji ltar yin gsungs nas dri ba'i tshul dang res 'di la ji ltar byas gsung ba sogs dngos su stsol/ res gzhan la gsung ba'i tshul gyis la la 'di skad zer gyi yod par 'dug 'di 'di ltar yin gsung ba dang / res zhal phar phyogs su gzigs nas gnas 'di lal la 'di skad zer zhing yod par 'dug ste de la skyon 'di 'ong sogs gsungs pa'i tshe mi de dag ni ci gsung ma 'tshal bas rig rig por 'gyur la bdag rang gis dgongs pa go nu4 pa sogs ni bgrang gi mi lang ste bdag gis 'brug lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la zhabs phyir slebs nas spre lo'i ston brag gsum du phebs pa'i bar la bdag rang gi zhu don khyad par ba ci yod pa de ga gsol ba dung btab pa tsam gyis thabs sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas the tshom chod pa'i lan stsol ba kho na byung / 'di tshun de tsam du gsal ba ma byung ba rang gi dad pa dman pa yin nam rgyu mtshan ma 'tshal/ 'on kyang de lta bu dngos su zhus pa na kha gsag tu 'gro ba dang zhal skyengs pa lta bu'i cung mi mnyes pa gnang gi 'dug pas ma zhus/ rab 'byams pa dpal 'bar ba dpon slob drung na bzhugs pa na 'bri khung nas khyod da lta rang myur bar chos rje lcags thang ba'i drung du song gsung ba de ltar byon pas lcags thang ba gshegs kha dang mjal te rje rkarma pa'i chos kyi 'khyos ma blang gsungs nas gdams ngag gsan pas thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs nas gshegs par 'dug/ kong por sku grib mgur cham dang sku'i tshad gzhi la bsten pa'i yang yang sku bsnyel pa'i tshe bdag mnal srung ba sogs la phal cher yod pa mnal srung ches dka' ba na rang 1307

gi snang ba ma dag par zad mod/ /gzugs khams pa la'ang gnyid med na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ga la yod snyam pa'i mos gus dung ba re byung nas gsol 'debs dran tsam byung ma thag sku khams shin tu dwangs par snang zhing dri rmed du ma mdzad/ yang mi zhig byung ba na sku khams nyog par ston zhing / bla sman pa rnams kyang phyag rtsa 'bul ba ma gtogs rgyun du sku mkhris su bsdad mi chog pa dang / sku 'khor ba rnams kyis gsol spyod phan gnod sogs kyi blang dor mi mkhyen pas mgur cham bsnyel ba'i tshe mar khu zhu ba sogs snang yang de lta bu'i skyon yon gang la'ang bstos pa med par bsnyun las grol 'gro bar snang / bdag la de lta bu'i bka' phebs te bstod pa dang brtan bzhugs dang rtogs 'bul gyi tshul gyi mgur ma sogs ci rigs re phul ba'i mod la sku dwangs pa lan ches mang por byung / bu chu'i jo bo la bdag gis me long zhig la mu tig gi tshom bu bkod de phul nas gsol ba mang du btab/ drung du slebs nas zhag 'ga' na rmi lam du rje'i phyag yon pa na gser gyi pad+ma rin po che mtha' yas pas spras pa cig snyan g.yon du yod pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin par mdzad de 'di khyod kyis nga la phul ba'i maṇ+ḍal de yin lan gsum du gsungs pa rmis pas jo bo'i sku de yang kong lung pa garma pa'i rgyal khams yin pas rje nyid kyi sku'i bkod pa gzugs brnyan gyi tshul gyis rtag tu 'gro don mdzad par go'o/ /phyag rjes zhabs rjes sogs gzhan snang la mang du byung bar snang yang spyir rkang rjes lag rjes kyi rigs dud 'gro la yang mang du 'byung bas rtags khyad par can du ma nges shing lar yang 'di rigs phal cher gzhan gyis sgro btags byas pa mang bar 'dug gsung zhing 'on kyang sku phra dus gsi dkar dpon chung yol sgo ba byed pa'i tshe sku rtsed kyi rnam pas rdo chung zhig phyag gis bcangs pa khong gis dad rten du zhus pa de ched du min par yang mi gsung / phyis khong sbrul lo la glang khrod tshal du byung tshe khyed 1308

kyi dad rten de khyer shog gsungs nas gzigs shing bdag gis kyang mjal/ phyis khong 'das pa na de khyer shog gsungs nas phyag tu bzhes ste bdag la gnang ba da lta dad pa'i rten du mchis/ rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul yang rgya nag tu dom tsha nang so rta 'bul la slebs dus 'di gam pa'i gser yig pa brdzus mar 'dug zer nas chad pa byed par brtsams pa na drung nyid zhwa nag bzhes pa nam mkha' la mngon sum du byon pa gser khang nang ma'i pho brang nang gi rgyal blon kun gyis gzigs pa dang bya tshe ring gnyis kyis pho brang la bskor ba dang gar byed pa byung bas dom tsha la mthong bkur cher byas pa dang / gdan 'dren gyi blon po rnams kyis sgar du nye ba tsam nas sprin gyi gseb tu drung gi sku zhwa nag can snang ba dmag mi dang bcas pas mthong ba dang sa tham steng du phebs dus rgyal po'i glang po che dang stag gis gus par btud pa dang / nyag chu'i dar la byon pa na nyag rong pa mang pos nam mkha' la gshegs par mthong ba sogs dang nad gdon gyis nyen pa dang 'chi ka ma sogs kyi mdun du sku mngon sum du byon pa'i lo rgyus ni ches mang ngo / /'chad pa'i 'phrin las ni mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen mtha' dag las re re'ang 'grel tshul mi gcig pa mang po'i sgo nas 'chad par mdzad la bka' bdams kyi lam rim khyad par can dang de lta bu'i blo chos su 'gro ba dang chos lam du 'gro byed kyi thabs gtso bor ston pas rje 'di'i gsung la tshad mar 'dzin no cog nam 'chi nges med dang cis kyang dgos med snying du zug cing 'gro kun pha mar shes pa bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo goms pa sha stag 'byung ngo / khyad par du rdo rje theg pa thun mong ma yin pa'i khrid rim zhag gsum la dmigs pa re sogs kyis dus rtag par chu bo ltar stsol bas rgyud smin zhing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir sdod ldan gyi slob ma'i tshogs snang srid dag par shar ba dag snang thun gcig gi 'char sgo yang bgrang las 'das pa/ rje nyid dang 'bral med kyi gdeng thob pa 1309

tshe 'di'i bya ba la byis pa'i rtsed mo tsam du'ang mi lta ba de lta bu skyes chen gyi slob ma bgrang bar mi nus pa byon no/ /rtsom pa'i 'phrin las ni sku chung ngu nas bstan bcos dang rdo rje'i mgur ngo mtshar can ches mang la/ khyad par dgung lo nyer gnyis la 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i tshig 'grel/ nyer gsum la phar phyin gyi ṭīka chen/nyer bzhi la sgra ka la pa'i ṭīka chen/ nyer drug la mdo rtsa'i rgya cher 'grel/nyer bdun la mdzod kyi ṭīka chen phyis dbu ma'i ṭīka chen sogs pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ches mang po dang / ma hā mā ya'i 'grel pa sogs rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud kyi rnam bshad mngo dkyil sgrub thabs ches mang po dang / gsang ba snying po sogs rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po bstan pa dang / khrid kyi rim pa ches mang po bstsal pa 'di thams cad gzhan gyis byas pa lta bu'i btags zin 'thag pa ma yin pa/ ji ltar mkhas pas kyang brtags na gting je zab tu 'gro ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'chad tshul dang ldan pa kho na yin la snyan ngag tsam la'ang rje 'dis mdzad pa'i bya dka'i rgyan dbus su nga bzhi la mkhas pa bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba lugs 'byung lugs zlog gang nas kyang bgrangs chog pa 'di lta bu bod yul gyi nga brgyad ma brtsams pa snang ba rnams kyis 'di'i phyogs su yang phyin pa ma yin no/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las kyang / spyir rje 'di chos spyod kyi bya ba bcu las gang yang rung ba dang mi ldan pa'i btang stoms su ni skad cig kyang bzhugs par ma mthong la sku la bcar ba rnams kyang lung ma bstan du mi 'jog par dge ba la bkol bar mdzad cing khyad par rje nyid kyi sku ring la dge 'dun gyi sde 'phel ba ni/ 'jang rgyal pos khang gsar mgo'i chos sde/ 'dob spang phug tu chos sde/ la bla ma yon tan dbang phyug bskos pa'i dgon gnas kyi chos sde/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa bsod nams rnam rgyal la brten te ru yon gyi chos sde/ kha ba dkar por 'jam dpal rgya mtshos btsugs pa'i 1310

chos sde/ lcags mo nang sos lhun po rtser dgon gnas/ gling drung pas bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi sde/ 'bri rgyud du stong le'i sde/ lho 'o ma lung du slar yang chos sde/ 'dra tsher lung mdar chos sde/ nyag chu rgyud dang rab sgang sogs su bzhag bla khu dbon gyis chos sde da ma/ mgo log dbon pos mgo log ta shar sde/ring ring mdor na ta'u shel khog spom 'bor che chung / mdo stod smad rnams su kur sde che chung gsar 'phel mang po/ khyad par 'jang gi sha 'bu/ ngo khro/ la sgang /mdzal chu rgyud/ 'ba' thang / rgyal thang sogs nas lo lo bzhin gra pa lnga brgya'i rgyun rdzong ba/ po stod dkar po sgang du chos sde/ khyad par bshad gra gsar btsugs la/ kong por phrag su rū gdong gi chos sde/ yar stod du kurma dga' tshal gzhung lugs gling / dwags por garma bshad sgrub gling / khams su ra ti dga' ldan gling du mkhas pa rin chen legs pas gsar du bshad gra/ stong mgor rab 'byams pa brtson 'grus kyis bshad gra/ gtsang du gsung rab rgyal mtsho/ thob rgyal bas rkarma 'dul gra gling / gsang sngags gra tshang / sgrub sde la/sgar du yang zur gyi sde gnyis/ chos rje mkhan chen pas do dam mdzad de rtse lha sgang gi sgrub sde/ phrag yul du sgrub sde/ nags phur sgrub sde gsar du bsnan ba/po bo g.ya' sman du bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis la bka' gnang ba'i sgrub gra lha gzigs 'gro ba'i mgon po btsun mo dang bcas pas zhus te mchod yul du chu ba ri'i sgrub sde/ sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgar du yang ri/ dpal dro bo lung du kurma rig 'dzin grub mchog sde/ byang dbu mar slar yang sgrub sde rgyas pa rnams rags pa ste 'di phal che ba'i re re la'ang dge 'dun pa brgya las mi nyung zhing mang pa rnams sum brgya dang de las lhag pa ste zhib par ni bri yis ma lang ngo /'di thams cad kyi rgyu dang yo byad mang du phyag nyid nas gnang ba kho na shas che la/ spyir gar phebs kyi gtsug lag khang la mchod pa/ dge 'dun la gnang ) 1311

sbyin sogs ni mtha' yas/ sgar nyid du rje dus mkhyen gyi tshes gsum ma chod pa nas brtsams te drung na rim rnams kyi dus mchod thams cad dang yum gyi dus mchod tshes bcu gnyis sogs thams cad la cho ga so so gnang zhing gtso che ba rnams la dkyil chen sum bcur nye ba'i chog mang mdzad pa sogs rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las bgrang gis gar lang la nyin re kho na la'ang rab byung drug bcu lhag pa dang bsnyen rdzogs dkyi' 'khor drug bdun tsam sgrub pa 'byung la de lta bu rgyun ma chad pa yong bas lo gcig gi rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyang mtha' yas shing bdag kho nas las slob bgyis te bsgrubs pa'ang bgrang gis mi lang ngo / /rten bzheng sogs ni snye bo dang rngod kyi chos sde gnyis su thub dbang gi gser sku rgyab mtho nyi shu pa re/ rtse lha sgang du rkarma pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho nyer lnga pa/po 'bor sa gser gtsug lag khang ka ba brgya'i khyon gyi sa rgyan gnam rgyan/ su ru gdong du ston pa'i gser sku rgyab mtho sum bcu pa/ sgam por rje dus mkhyen gyi gser sku mtho bcu gsum pa/ tsan+dan dang bse ru dang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zung 'jug rgyud rim mtho tshad ma khri rgyab dang bcas pa zangs gser gyi gnas brtan bcu drug rkang gang ma dang rje gong ma'i thugs kyi bzhugs khang dngul gdung mda' tshad phyed dang gnyis ma/ rgyal tshab sprul sku snga phyi gnyis kyi dbu thod bzhugs khang dngul gdung mda' tshad ma gnyis/ thugs dam thang sku shin tu ngo mtshar can mang po rje 'phrin las pa'i dngul gdung dga' tshal du sbyin bdag chen mo yum sras la zhal bskos gnang ba'i thub dbang gi gser sku thog tshad lhag pa dang / drung na rim gyi gser sku sku tshad/ rje mar pa'i sku mkhar rin po che la gser thog bshad sgrub gling gi lha chen rgyab mtho bzhi bcu pa la sogs pa 'di thams cad kyi rgyu'i gtso bo rnams phyag nyid nas gnang ba kho na shas che zhing rje'i thugs rje las grub pa kho na yin no/ /tshad ma rigs gzhung 1312 4

rgya mtsho'i spar sgar nyid du bsgrubs shing rje btsun ngal gso/ yar stod du sgrub par bkas gnang zhing bdag la bkas phebs pas nang don rang 'grel ba ra du bsgrubs so/ /mdor na rje 'di ni drung na rim thams cad kyi 'phrin las gcig tu bsdoms pa lta bu ste rdza ngom phyogs su kur bstan 'byung bar lung bstan pa de rje nyid /3khrungs pa dang / gtsang phyogs su bstan pa 'byung bar lung bstan pa ni gtsang du kur lugs kyi chos sde thog mar 'phel ba 'di dag dang sto phyogs su bstan pa 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i thog ma chos sde 'di ste gtsug lag khang dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa 'phel ba ni drung na rim gzhan gnyis gsum bsdoms pa las kyang rje 'di mang la/ bka' 'bum ni rje pak+ki la'ang da lta po ti bcu drug las mi bzhugs la rje 'di'i bka' 'bum po ti sum bcu lhag pa bzhugs shing gdul bya la rje 'di'i gsung rnams kho na nye bar mkho ba dang / khyad par tshe blos btang zhing sbyangs yon can mos gus mthar phyin pa'i slob ma'i tshogs 'di tsam du rgyas pa yin la yul gru thams cad du'ang rje 'di las spang blang gi dam bca' 'di ltar nod do zhes sdig spong dge sgrub la gnas pa ni lam bar re na'ang gzhal du med par mthong la de ltar 'phrin las kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rje 'di'i 'phrin las kyi gtso bo ni sngon drung gong ma dpon slob thugs 'gal ltar snang bas kur bstan mtha' dag phyogs kun tu zing zing por spyod pa zhig snang la/ phyis rje 'di spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pas spyan drangs pa phebs pa ma shar yang don du phebs nas mjal ba dang 'dra bar thugs yid gcig tu gyur pa nas sprul pa'i sku dwags kong gi mtshams su 'byung bar lung bstan phul zhing sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'dren pa zhus/ rgyu de las sprul pa'i sku'i dbu 'don zhabs 'degs mdzad/ sdom pa gsum ldan du bsgrubs/ 'ung 1 313

rtogs kyi mdzod gtad/ bstar pa'i bdag por bskos/ phyis nas spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i gra slob thams cad kyis kyang dpyod ldan kha cig ni yid 'ches nas 'dud/ sprul sku yin min la ma bstos pa dag kyang zang zing gi rgyu la dmi/gas nas 'dud/ zhe sdang ba'i zug rngus sems tshig pa'i sol ba dag kyang 'dud par ston pa'i bya ba las gzhan pa'i 'tsho thabs ma rnyed/ phal cher ni grags pas 'dud pas rtsod med du gyur te kurma kum tshang gi bstan pa'i nang sel bablums nas kur bstan gyi rgya mtsho ris med pa gcig tu gyur pa 'di ni 'phrin las kyi dam pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun dam pa yon tan gyi rgya mtsho gzhal du med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas de ni dbang po dman pa rnams rtag par 'dzin pa las ldog phyir mi rtag pa'i chos sgo brdas ston pa dang / skal mchog rnams la skyed rim rdzogs rim du bsdu ba dang / gzugs sku chos kyi skur bsdu ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston pa'i phyir yongs su mya ngan las 'das par yang bstan te/ spyir sngon tshe sgrub gnang ba'i ltas las kyang / kyi grogs dag rig sngags tshe 'di pas/ sgrub par bya yis des ci bya/ /tshe yang sgrub pa don ldan na/ /legs mod 'jig rten dmod pa'i gzhi/ /zhes sku tshe ha cang ring ba kho na gdul bya mi mang bar bstan par snang ba dang / bdag la chos 'brel gyi thog mar bshad pa gnang ba bla ma khru tshang ba sku mched la sngon gnang ba'i rdo rje'i mgur de las kyang / sngon tshe bde chen myong ba'i lā li pa/ /da lta rdo rje'i rgyud sbyangs dga' ba'i dpal/ /phyi nas byams pa'i drung du bder brtsen pa/ /rang gzhan don gnyis grub bo dbyangs can ma/ /skye ba kun yang gzugs brnyan ltad mo tsam/ /'chi 'pho'i tshul yang tshegs med bde bar grub/ /bar srid yongs su spangs pa'i skal ba can/ /zhes sogs gzugs sku sdud pa la ha cang mi ring ba'i gsung gnang ba dang / /gsung mgur rnams dang gong ma gsum bstod 1314

rje mnyan pa'i bstod pa sogs shog dril phyag bris rnams bdag gis phab ste phyag dper sgrig pa cig yod pa'i tshe lug lo rtse lha sgang du bzhugs dus/ yul kre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i nang / /chu sgra bcas dam chos nyan pa'i sa/ /rang byon thugs rje chen po'i drung / /sa de dang ha cang mi ring bar/ /phyis skye ba len pa'i mtshan ma mthong / /zhes sku skye ba phyi ma'i lung bstan 'di gnang byung ba sku tshe'i rten 'brel du bsam/ 'di re zhig mi 'bebs pa dang mi sgrag pa cig zhus rung da lta phob gsungs nas dge slong bkras rgyam dge slong bzang dpal pod 'bor dge bshes dge slong 'jam bu sogs gsung sgrog pa rnams kyis sku mdun du gsung sgrog pa'i skabs kyi bka' rgyud mgur tsho sgrog pa'i rje nyid kyi gsung mgur sgrog dus khyad med du sgrog 'jug pa gnang song ba la yang cung zad yid ma bde/brag gsum du rang gzhan gyi sngon phyi'i gnas du ma stsol ba'i skabs shig rje nyid kyi sku tshe dang 'phrin las zhus pa la 'phrin las kyi rgyun chen po 'byung sku tshe ni gdul bya la bstos/ zhes phebs pa dang rta lo la zul phur gdul bya rdzogs pa'i bka' bstsal gnang tshe dge 'dun sde rnams kyis bdag la'ang bka' shog do gal can mdzad byung ba nas gsol ba snying nas btab pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul mi btang /dge 'dun rnams kyis nga'i zhu grogs mdzad nas gsol ba nan gyis 'debs pa rje dus mkhyen gyi sku tshe'i tshad du bzhugs pa'i zhal bzhes ma byung bar 'debs dgos par zhus/ de ltar zhu yig phul yang dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang tshogs la brtan bzhugs lam pa 'don pa ma gtogs de lta bu gsol ba 'debs pa zhig ma byung bar 'dug la bdag la 'phrod lan kyi bka' shog kyang ma phebs na zhal bzhes lta ga la zhig phyis khyi lo gtsang dang smyug la nas dwags po la phebs pa'i lam ya 'brog la phebs pa'i tshe bdag gser thog gi zangs brdung gi sgang gi skabs yin pa sngon du zangs leb gcig pad 'dab kyi sku 'dra thugs rje chen po 1nya15

kharma pā ṇa gcig dang gtso 'khor gsum pa gcig rnams la gser gsol te gzigs 'bul zhu bar khyer/ 'brog sga 'drar phebs thog mjal/ zhag lngar zhabs phyi byas pa'i phyi de nyid brtan bzhugs rgyas pa cig 'bul snyam pa'i tshe da brtan bzhugs rnam pa tsam gyis chog deng sang bstan pa brnyings pa dang yongs 'dzin med pa dang sems can la mgon skyabs gzhan med pas bzhugs dgos zer ba'i mchi ma 'don pa'i tshan byas shan 'dra bas ma byed gsung ba nan cher bstsal bas ha cang zhu ma spobs/ /de'i dgongs mo bdag la rdo rje rgya gram gyi stan zhig bting ba la sdod gsungs nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i gdan mchog tu/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che/ /ye shes rdo rje 'pho med par/ /gtsug lag phreng ba 'tsho bzhes shog /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad slo ka gsum pa'i phyag bris cig gnang nas ngas chos rje la brtan bzhugs byed pa yin/ khyed gra pa rnams kyis 'di thon gsungs nas gnang / da res cang go ba ma byung yang phyis bsams dus thog mar zhal bzhes ma phebs pa nas 'di'i bar thams cad bzhugs par ma dgongs pa brtan bzhugs ma bzhes pa kho na yin par 'dug snyam pa shar/ 'on kyang brtan bzhugs rnams kyis lo brgyad kyi bar gsol ba thebs pa yin no/ /glang lo la yar lungs nas mtsho dkar la phebs lam dwags po sgor bdag gis zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mjal zhing de tshe'ang bdag 'khor bcas thams cad la bka' 'bum brtsigs pa'i pod dbang gnang zhing yo ga'i skor sogs zhal phye nas dbu nas cung zad tsam gsung ba dang ci 'dra 'dug stos gsungs nas lag tu gtod pa mdzad byung zhing yang zur rnams da lta khyod la chos dgos zer yong yang khyod kyis da lta khong tsho la bshad pa khebs mi che/ khyod rang gis 'chad pa'i dus 'ong gsung ba'ang dgongs pa can gyi gsung du snang / de nas thal mar mtsho dkar la thegs/ /bdag dwags po sku rab skor na gnas pa'i stag lo gsar pa 1316

nas sku khams cung zad bsnyun par bstan/ sman pa rnams kyang bsnyun gyi ngos 'dzin la ma 'cham pas bdag la bka' shog nan gyis phebs te spyir mtsho dkar gyi gangs la dang spang la kha bas chod de 'dab chags ma gtogs pas mithar pa'i dus yin na'ang lam bcos shing phyin pas bde blag tu zhabs kyi pad+mar bgrod/ shin tu dgyes par mdzad cing 'tsho byed rnams kyis kyang de ring las phyag rtsa bde ba ma byung zer zhing 'dug bsnyun ci yin la sman pa rnams ma mthun pa'i gsol sman ci rigs 'bul ba zhig 'dug pa gsol sman mangs par go nas cung zad 'phro bcad de zhabs tog byas pas gsol dang sngar mi bsnyun pa'i dus cung zad re las mi bzhes kyang sngar la bstos na cung yangs su song zhing sku shed kyang skyes/ zhabs bzhengs mi thub pa'i rnam par 'dug pa'ang nyin skyed byung ste zla gcig tsam nas 'byon pa byung zhing gnas kyi brlan bsher de sku la mi 'phrod par go nas rim pas spyan drangs/ 'on kyang bzhugs par ye ma dgongs pa 'dra la sku mdangs kyang shin tu ngan pa sogs snang ba/ yang ri ba'i dge slong bar shar zhig gi rmi nyams su rje thams cad mkhyen pa bde ba can du thegs pa yin zer nas sku 'od zer dpag med dang bcas pa zhwa nag bzhes pa cig nub phyogs su byon nas thal/ re zhig na rje'i sprul pa yin zer ba phyis spyan drangs pa'i sku rid pa de kho na 'dra ba mdo li la spyan drangs pa cig byung gsung gi 'dug pa ltar yang yin srid par snang / 'di'i dus gsol ba btab kyang dwangs pa'i rnam pa ye mi ston par snang zhing drung lo tsā ba kun chos pa dang g.ye pa snying po bya ba'i skyes bu dam pa gnyis gshegs ma thag pa'i gdung rus mchod rten gyis shig gsungs pa na rten 'brel 'gegs byed kyi gsum pa btsal bas ma rnyed/ sngon ma bsnyung ba'i skabs nas phyag mdzod pa sku mched la nga shi na khyod rang tsho nor la chags nas ma sdod/ sprul sku dkon mchog yan lag sogs khur che ba yin/ zhes 1317

yang yang phebs snang ba dang / chung rgyud kun dga' la khyod rkarma pa'i sku skye yin zer ba'i khams phrug ral pa phrug ge ba zhig gi mdun du 'be phor 'di khyer nas ja dkru zhing sdod la che/ khyod kyis phyin pas phan mi thogs/ khyod gtan nas ma 'gro zhes yang yang gsungs snang ba dang mtsho dkar du phebs nas ci zhig na drung gong ma rnams kyis dbus gtsang gi chos sde thams cad la sku 'gyed sogs kyi gnang sbyin gnang ba yin te/ nged rang gis de ma grub/ da sku rim chen po cig phyogs ris med par byed pa yin gsung ba zhig sku skye dang sde pa gong ma la lobs/gzhan la ma lab ces gsungs zhes dge slob bsam gtan gyis zer/ phyis sku rim zhus pa na nged rang sku rim chen po cig byed dgos par 'dug pas sku rim yin zer nas yo byad thar thor du gtong ba de ma byed gsungs shing rim pas gong la dang rnam rgyal du phebs/ 'di'i dus gzhis ka rin spungs pa'i bdag po rin chen dbang rgyal gshegs pa'i bsngo zhus rin spungs kyi khyad nor thams cad phul/ 'tsho byed mkhas par grags pa mang du yod pa'ang kha cig sku dwangs par gleng / spyir so so'i snang bar zad pas 'dzin lugs sna tshogs snang ba de rnams kyi don du ji ltar phul pa'i sman dpyad rnams so so 'gal ba ltar snang ba kho na 'dug na'ang so sor bzhes/ bzhengs bzhugs ni bsnyun med ltar gyur/ 'on kyang rnam rgyal gyi skar phibs chen mor zla gnyis la nye ba'i bar du nam nangs sa sros su phyag sgam thams cad gzigs shing drung na rim gyi phyag rdzas yin nges sngar yod dang bdag gi lag tu byung ba ni zhes tshan gcig der ma zad sku skye ba phyi ma'i phyag rdzas su 'jog rgyu'i spyad dngos kham che ba zhes tshan gcig spyad 'jog thun mong gi tshan gcig mchod sbyin du bya ba'i yo byad ces tshan gcig ste deb zhib mor mdzad/ 'di skabs kyi phyag rdzas khyad par can thams cad kha 'byed pa sogs phyag gis ma gnang na gzhan la rgyus med pa mang zhing spyir yang so sor 1318

phyag gis bzher+sha/ pa snod du 'don 'jug sogs nad med kyi dar ma rnams kyang thang chad cing lub/ rmya bar 'gyur na'ang / rje nyid sku ngal ba skad cig kyang med/gzhan nad kyi ngoge btab pa rnaca/sa la cung zad la 'khrugs dogs pa dgos kyang cis kyang sku mi ngal ba 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad par snang zhing phyag rdzas rnams deb tu mdzad/ spyan lam du phab phyag rtags kyis mnan pa 'di ni phyis bzhugs kyi las 'dzin rnams la bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis par byung /5 gong la nas lcags mo go'i shri la gnang byin rgyas par mdzad de cis kyang 'byon dgos gsungs nas rdzong ba mdzad pa ni phyi ma'i mdzad pa la dgongs par 'dug spyir sangs rgyas kyi sku rang blo'i spyod yul gyi gnas ma yin mod kyang bdag rang gi blos gzhal ba'i sku la sman pa'i thabs ji snyed pa bod lung chos zam mdo'i bar du zhabs phyi car mar bgyis/ 'on kyang sku khams dwangs skyed cher yod pa dang tsā ri mi chen pa rnams kyis 'bod nan che bas yul smad du chos 'chad par zhag bcu pa cig phyin nas slar gong la mjal tshe de srid sman pa rnams kyis bcos so so du ma phul nas sku khams log par bstan 'dug cing 'di phyin sman pa lnga drug yod pa re res zhag bdun re tsam la gsol ba bkag ste smyung bar gsol ba dang /sman sna tshogs phul ba re mos byed cing snang bas mi legs par zhus rung gsan pa'i rnam pa ma gnang / rig shes kyis ma 'ongs pa'i tshul go yang thabs ma rnyed pas nyin re zhing sku rim du tshogs 'khor re phul gsung ba bzhin dgyes rdor bde mchog dus 'khor nag rgyal phag gsum sogs so so'i skyed rim phra mo re dang rje nyid lha thams cad kyi ngo bor shes pas mchod bstod bzlas pa tshogs gtor 'bul ba tsam re bgyis shing bzlas bum gyi chu rgyun gyis sku khrus gsol ba re yang zhus/ da lta rje 'di'i zhal lta gsung nyan tshogs 'khor zhu sku khrus gsol du yod pa 'di re dga'/ da ni ring po ma thogs par gzhan zhig 'ong ba lta snyam ste 11319 7

lung pa stong chad ste ba re byung / phyag mdzod pa bgres pas lha rje rnams na re sku khams dwangs yod zer yang nga ni blo shin tu ma bde/ sprul sku rin po che'ang kong por bzhugs/ khyed kyis phyag phyir 'gro dgos gsungs na'ang sman pa rnams kyang nyan par ma spyod pa dang / bdag la bstos pa'i mi mang ba dang / sku mya ngan las 'da' ba lta bas ma spro bas rnam rgyal nas phyag 'bul bsgrubs/ zhabs dbang zhus/ gsol ba btab pa na drung na rim gyi sku chas 'di rnams ma zags pa khyod shes so/ /zhes bka' bstsal/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs la dbu zhwa zhig phyag gis g.yogs nas khyod kyis gra tshang gi bla ma dang sras dro bo lung gi gdan sa yong ba gyis shig gsungs/ 'di nas zhag lnga drug na rim pas bshad sgrub gling du phebs shing khrom la rgyang mjal yang gnang / de nas sgo gsang sngags gling du phebs pa nas sku bsnyun tshabs che ba'i rnam pa byung bar 'dug rim pas yar stod ra mo'i bar du mdo li la spyan drangs pa na lam du mi nye lam du gzigs pa kun la'ang khyod da lta ci byed da ci byed bsam gsung ba sogs kyi dri ba kho na mdzad skad de mi tshe stong zad du song ba thugs kyis ma bzod par 'dug nyer gnyis la ra mor phebs pa na sku cung zad bsnyun che ba nas de nyid du sgar phab/stag lo zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer gsum gyi zhogs deng sang bairba pa dang te lo pa gnyis kyi kho bo bteg byung gsungs te bsnyun yang med cing sman pa rnams kyang phyag rtsa bde bas bag phebs pa'i tshe snga dro'i cha la nam mkha' dag pa la mja' 'od kyis gang ba dang bcas chos kyi dbyings su zhugs te de ma thag yar stod kyi lam kha'i grong zhig tu dam can pa rta pa dpon g.yog gnyis su byas pa mngon sum du tsha phogs byas ja bkol te phyir rta la zhon nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa kurma pa de sku gshegs pa 'dra/ khyod kyis da lta stos shog de gshegs na bod la mtha' dmag 'ong zer te de ma thag yal skad/ sku gdu rin po che mtshur phur sngon du 1320 ོ

spyan drangs/ slar sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa kong po nas rim par phebs/mtshur phur sgar ma bu rnams 'grig tshe gsang btol/ sngar nas mtshur phu rtse lha sgang 'bri gdan rin spungs sogs su bka' gros bskor ba na thams cad thugs mthun pas sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa khri thog tu spyan drangs/ 'di ni rje rang gis sngon nas bzhugs khri khyad med mdzad phyag rdzas rtsis sprod sogs gnang grub 'dug pa dang bshad sgrub gling du sgar pa rnams la nged re zhig 'gol pa zhig byed pa yin pas khyed rang sgar pa'i skyabs gnas sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa la zhus zhes bka' bstsal ba sogs snga phyir gnang ba nas rgyal tshab tu bskos zin par 'dug pa'i dgongs pa nged phyag mdzod pa dang bcas pas bsgrubs pa yin/ slar sku gdung rin po che tsan+dan dkar dmar sdong po mang po dang a ga ru dmar po dang nag po sdong po 'ba' zhig gi zhugs la bzhen zhing a ga ru phal pa'i tshogs ni phyogs kun tu bdug pa'i sprin dkrigs/ de yang nyi shar nas zhugs la bzhen te nyin gung gis sreg rdzas rdzogs zhus thag chod par byas nas rjes chog grub pa na slar spur khang gi byang shar nas me phra zhing gsal ba zhig 'bar te je cher song bas shar lho nub dang byang dang dbus thams cad khyab pa cher 'bar zhing du ba med pa shin tu cher 'bar nas slar byang shar gyi mtshams su mar me tsam yun ring du gnas te slar nyi nub tsam la zhi bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe kha cig zhugs thal drags 'ong bas 'o mas gzhil zer yang zhugs rang 'bar 'di la nged rang tshos mi shes pas ma reg byas nas bzhag ltas 'di las sprul sku byang shar gyi mtshams su 'byon nam zhes bdag cag gleng ba tsam byung / mnga' ris skor gsum phyin la stod gtsang dbus sto byang thams cad kyi ban+dhe brgya longs yan gyi sde ban bon sa dge dwags rnying sogs ris med la mang ja 'gyed chen bsngo rten dang bcas pa dang / gtso bor 'bri gdan gnyis su sngar nas gnang ba'i rgyun 'dug pa 1321

ltar dang / yul gru de rnams kyi kur sde badzhai lnga yod pa yan chad la gnang cha'i skal ba dang byin rlabal kyi rten/ yul dus de'i ris med kyi bla ma che ba thams cad la bcu gsum bco lnga'i tshan dang de 'og la bdun tshan la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa thams cad kyang rgyu dngos rnam par dag pa tha ma mchod sbyin du bya ba zhes dang / spyod 'jog thun mong du bya rgyur bkod pa rnams dang / gdung 'bul gyi yo byad mtha' yas pa rnams kyi steng nas gnang / sngon rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs kyi khru ma mtshur phu na 'dug pa dang / drung chos grags rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs kyi khra ma rtse lha sgang na 'dug pa sogs kyi dbang du byas na brgya phrag gi 'gyur las kyang ches rmad du byung ba gnang ste sngon ris med la rim gro chen po byed gsung ba'i dgongs pa bsgrubs pa yin/ 'di rnams kyi tshe sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs phyi bdag gis bgyis/ phyag mdzod pa rgyal chen sku rab pa'i zhal ngo kumi mdo rgyud rgya mtsho dang garma mchod sbyin rgya mtsho mched gnyis kyis mdzad/ 'phral gyi do dam 'byed 'grol rnams yangs pa can nas phyag mdzod pa dang smyug la nas nang so lnga 'dzom pas mdzad pa yin/ sngon nas kho bo'i dngul 'bum byed gsungs nas dngul mi rgyab du ma 'dug pa la gzhi byas slar dad can gyis phul ba sogs las rje nyid kyi thugs las skyes shing ci gsung gi bka' sgrub pa chos mdzad kurma srid bral gyis do dam lag gi bla byas te dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten mtho sum bcu pa logs la rje'i rnam thar 'phul du yod pa/ mtha' nas kyi mu tig star kha rlon pa tsam zhig dang gzhan mu tig khyad par can mang po dang g.yu chen yul gru ri bar grags pa mar me ltar snang ba ches mang po dang / gzhan yang pad+ma rā ga la sogs pa yin par grags pa'i deng sang gi rin po che sngon po dang sngo skya dang sngo dmar dang ngamar skya dang dmar chen dang dmar spug dang dmar ser dang ser skya la sogs pa sna tshogs pas phrar byas te 1322

rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phung po lta bur snang ba gser ljang brdungs kyi rgyan gyi khyad par mtha' yas pa can bod yul tsam lta zhog 'phags pa'i yul na'ang 'di lta bu ma mchis sam snyam la gzo bo bal po rnams na re nged bal yul na rgyu'i gser dngul 'di thams cad kyis mu tig che ba 'di la mi do zer skad/ de lta bu'i rin po che'i mchod rten ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa grub par chos kyi sku'i sgod du gyur pa'i sku gdung gi ring bsrel rin thang med pa rnams gtso bor bzhugs 'khor gzhan yang na bza' bzhugs stan la sogs pa skus nye bar spyad pa'i yo byad rten gyi yul mchod par bya ba nyid du byed pa rnams dang sku gsung thugs rten ngo mtshar can gzhan mtha' yas pa dag dang tha na gdung bzhu ba'i so phag gi bar du bzhugs te tha na gzungs bzhugs kyi mchod pa'i dri bzang kho na'ang gser srang nyi shu tsam gyi rin thang song bar snang na gzhan lta ci smos te de lta bu'i ngo mtshar gyi rten sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i pho brang chen por bsgrubs te gsar ma'i mchod khang thog dpangs btod pa dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa sogs mdzad par rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang rje de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngul gdung gnyis kyi bar du bzhugs shing sbrul lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas rab gnas chog gra mang po btsugs te sta gon mdzad/ nyer gsum gyi dus mchod kyi nyin dngos gzhi mdzad cing byin rlabs cher byung la rab gnas btsugs pa nas rlung zhi zhing shin tu dro zhes gleng la nyer bzhi'i nyin dge 'dun stong phrag tsam gyis ser sbreng dang dar khru chen mo skyong ba phyogs bzhi nas bkra shis dang dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ slar sku tshab kyi sku 'dra rin po che legs par bzhengs pas gtso mdzad de sngar gyi drung na rim gyi sku brnyan rnying pa rnams dang bcas tsan+dan dkar dmar gyi bzhugs khri la bla ma lha khang du bzhugs su gsol te rje'i dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad do/ /yangs pa can nas phyag mdzod pa 1323

mchod gzhis chos bzhin gyis 'bad med du phyag tu byung ba rje'i thugs rje kho nar mkhyen pas bka' drin bsab pa'i phyir rje mtsho dkar du bzhugs dus spyan 'dren btang yang zhal ma mjal bas sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pas dbus pa'i sgar chen la zhabs tog gi khur bzhes/ rten bzheng gi gzo bo'i phogs mgon chen slebs pa thams cad kyi gzhi len mdzad/ sngon yab sras lha khong na mjal dus mdzod nag gi khyad nor mang po 'bul gyi 'dug zer pa gsan pas rkarma pa la des mi 'thogs/ nged rang la de las med pa snyam pa shar ba na khyod rang de 'dra mi dgos ba'i 'di thams cad khong gis bdag rkyen byed rgyu yin zhes pa'i bka' shog gnang ba dang / 'phyong rgyas su yab sras lhan du mjal dus rgyugs yig rje ba gnang 'dug pa la sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa dpon slob sum bcu gsung ba na/ sngar spyan snga rin po che de lta bu zhig yod pa la deng sang sum bcu snyan pa'i tshe khong rang la gzigs nas khyod rang la phogs 'debs rgyu yod na sprang pos thogs mi 'ong zhes gsung ba rnams kyang 'di yin bar snang / des na sku'i rten du bshad sgrub gling gi rten chen/ gsung gi rten bka' 'bum gser ma chos mdzad ma rnam grol gyis sbyin bdag mdzad nas bzhengs pa dang / thugs kyi rten mchod rten khyad par can 'di yin la yul gru so so'i gra yon dad 'byor can rnams kyis rang ring gi skal ba'i gdung bzhugs pa'i rten bgyis pa ni mtha' yas so/ /༈ de yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di la klu sgrub thogs med kyi zab mo lta rba dang rgya chen spyod pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rnam par phye bas shing rta'i srol gnyis zhes bka' drin zla ma mchis pa dang / 'dul bstan la mi rung ba'i gezhi bcu byung ba'i tshe dgra bcom pa grags pas bsdu ba gnyis pa'i sgo nas bsal ba dang / bod yul du jo bo rjes bod rnams las 'bras dang byang chub kyi sems la bkod pa dang / dam pa rgya gar gyis gsung rab thams cad man ngag tu dril 1324

nas bstan pa dang / rje mi la dang rgod tshang pas zhen log dang mos gus mthar phyin pas sems can dpag med de dag la bkod pa dang / rngog lo tsā ba chen pos sde snod kyi bshad pa'i 'phrin las mtha' yas pa sogs de rnams nyi zla ltar grags shing ngo mtshar phul du byung ba yin mod na'ang de rnams sngon bstano pa tshul bzhin gnas la gdul sla ba'i gdul bya tshogs pa'i dus yin pas deng sang la bltos na de tsam du dka' ba'i gnas ma yin la/ deng sang bstan pa thams cad gzugs brnyan las kyang ches gzugs brnyan du gyur cing theg pa chen po'i tshig tsam dar ches pas theg chen gyi don nub pa ltar gyur te mdo sngags thams cad la rtog ge'i rtag chad kyi lta ba sna tshogs pas bslad nas tshig tsam la rtog ge'i gsang tshig gi 'khyog 'gros sna tshogs pas smra pa'i mu stegs mgo reg gi tshogs kyis bod yul zing zing por gang pa'i dus 'di lta bur yang mdo sngags thams cad kyi zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa nyams len mngon rtogs thams cad la phyin ci log gi log rtog thams cad bsal nas yang dag pa'i don snang bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ches mang po mdzad pas mdo sngags kyi shing rta'i srol 'byed gcig bu pa yin la/ mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu lta zhog deng sang mi dge ba bcu yang 'dul bar sgrog cing 'dul ba nyan bshad par rlom pa rnams kyang dus tshigs la sogs pa'i bgro gleng gi gnas sna 'ga' yar zhig bzung ba la 'dul ba shes zer gyi sdom pa ma thob pa 'thob byed kyi cho ga thob pa mi nyams par srung tshul nyams na phyir bcos rnams ji bzhin khong du chud pa su yang mi snang ba'i dus 'dir 'dul ba'i legs bshad kun las btus pa blang dor mig phye ba ltar ston pa 'di lta bu mdzad cing sngon paṇa chen shākya shri'i gsung nas bod kyis 'dul ba'i kun spyod ji bzhin mi yong ba 'dug mi la ras pa des rtags dang cho ga byas na 'dul ba ji lta ba yong bar 'dug gsung bar grags pa ltar slob ma'i nang na'ang blos btang 1325

dang zhen log rje btsun mi la lta bu la 'dul ba'i kun spyod ji bzhin sgrub pa rgya' ba g.yung la sogs pa du ma bzhugs pas 'dul ba la bstan pa'i me ro gso bar mdzad pa dang / deng sang khyim pa rnams lta zhog rab byung klog pa po phal cher rnams ni la dor dang ltag chod dang tshig skyon gyi rtsod pa lhur byed kyi las 'bras la snying rje'i yul du lta la/ sgom pa por rlom pa rnams kyang blang dor med pa yin zer nas spang bya len zhing blang bya 'dor ba dang / mi dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad rgyab rten gsang sngags skad du sgrog par byed pas grub mtha' la zhugs ma zhugs thams cad las 'bras la cir yang mi rtsi ba'i dus 'dir las kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam par gzhag pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji lta ba bzhin ston pas las 'bras kyi blang dor la gdul bya rnams 'god la/ spyir thugs rje'i rlabs bsam pa'i yul ma yin pas gzhan dag gis las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag lo zlar bshad pa las rje 'dis 'bul bzhes kyi khrom bar ma gcig la srog sdom rkun sdom la sogs pa'i sdig spong / ma ṇi dung phyur la sogs pa'i dge ba khas len pa ches mang zhing snang ba'i 'gyur tshabs che la/ khrom la zhal mthong gi 'gro don mdzad pa'i tshe yang zhal mthong ba tsam gyis thams cad rang dbang med par gsol 'debs sdig bshags smon lam sogs kyis 'ur dir du 'gro ba mchi ma dbang med du 'byin zhing gsol ba 'debs pa ste/ dpyod ldan dag gi gsung las kyang zhal mthong ba'i mod la dad pa mi skye ba'i mi su yang mi yong ba 'dug gzhan pa dge ba la ngo tshar lta ba zhig yod pa'ang rje'i zhal mthong ba'i mod la phyag 'tshal ma ṇi 'dren zhing 'dug gsung ba ltar yin la slob ma rnams la chos kyi snying po byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig ston te spyod 'jug lugs dang byang sa'i lubs dang don dam sems bskyed sogs kyi chogs 'bogs pa dang rje nyid kyi sems bskyed kyi khrid thun mong ma yin pa du ma'i sgo nas bskyed par mdzad pas dgos pa khyad par ba 1326

mthong na bdag gzhan rje ba la thogs pa med pa'i rgyal ba'i sras mang du bskrun par mdzad cing gdul bya'i shun pa bdag lta bu la'ang las 'bras dang byang chub kyi sems kyi go ba res 'ga' ba tsam zhig byung ba yin no/ /mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don man ngag tu dril nas ston pa la rje nyid dam pa rgya gar gyi mtshan du ston pa'i dus las kyang ches rmad du byung ste de ni ḍā ki ma sum bcu rtsa lnga dang grub thob pho mo lnga bcu rtsa lnga la sogs pa'i gsung zlos par zad la rje nyid ni gzhan dring la bltos pa med cing bsams gzhigs pa'i blos ma yin par gdul bya'i skal ba bzhin chos kyi rnam grangs gcig kho na'ang 'chad tshul tha dad pa mang por snang ba zad med du ston zhing zab mo'i gnad stsol ba rnams kyang smra bsam gyi ra ba las brgal zhing nyams myong khyad par can mngon sum du skyed pa kho na'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyes la mos gus ni rje 'di lta bu gzhan mi srid pa tsam yin te rje mi la yang rje btsun mar pa dang ches dman mchog gi tshul du gnas pa la gsung phal cher bsgrubs shing bka' bkyon la log lta ma skyes pa dang bla ma rigs bdag tu gzigs pa tsam gyis mos gus kyi mchog brnyes par 'jog la rje rgod tshang pa'ang chos rje ras pa'i slob ma'i nang gi gzhon shos su yod la gsol 'debs nus pa dang phyis bla ma sgrub pa gnang nas rgod po nga'i chos gcig po zhes bla ma sgrub pa la nan tan du mdzad pas bla ma sangs rgyas su gzigs pas mos gus mchog tu thob par 'jog pa yin la/ bla ma mchog mthon po'i sar gnas shi—nga rang dma' mor gnas pa na gus pa skye sla yang rje 'di ni de lta ma yin te rje btsun bkra shis rnam gnyis/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan slob gnyis te mtshungs med skyes mchog rnam bzhi zhes bka' stsol ba 'di dag kyang rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i slob ma sha stag yin pas drung nyid la rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 'du sheja/ kyis myo/chog tu 'dzin pa kho na yin yang de rnams la bla ma sgrub pa la ma bstos par thog ma nas 1327

sangs rgyas nyid kyi mos pa 'khrungs pa dang / bdag ni garma pa ste ches mchol/ go snyam pa'i nga rgyal ma nal lam na yang 'khrungs pa med par gus 'dud thams cad pa mdzad pa 'di ni gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'i nang na rang bas ches dman pa'i gnod pa bzod pa bzod pa'i dam par bshad pa ltar skye bo rnams kyi lta ngor rje nyid las dman par snang ba la gus pa 'di lta bu mdzad pa ni ches ngo mtshar to/ /de lta mod kyi rigs rus dang gdan sa dang stobs kyis mngon par ca/tho bas de'i nga rgyal 'chang ba ha cang gzigs rgya mi che ba du ma zhig rje'i drung du 'di skad zhu ste/ kho bo khyod la phyag 'tshal chos zhu ba yin pas phyag lan dgos zhes dang / bzheng ba dang bzhugs stan mnyam pa dgos zer ba dag 'ong ba na rje nyid mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi phyag lan mi mdzad pa ma yin na'ang sngon kau sham+bha'i rgyal po gtum po rab snang gis 'phags pa ba ra dhā dza'i drung du phyin pa na ldang ba ma mdzad pang khros te phyir song / de ma thag nga ldang ba dang bsu ba mi byed na de bsad do snyam nas 'ongs pa na 'phags pas mngon par shes te ldang ba byas pa tsam gyis sngar rgyal po'i lus la rang bzhin gyis 'od yod pa de med par song gom pa drug bsus pas rgyal po'i lus kyis khyab pa'i 'dom gang gis khol bur zhom ste thur du 'u ru ru 'gro pa na skrag ste bskyab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas 'phags bas rgyal po chen po nga la sems kyang dga' bar gyis shig dang sa slar 'byor zhing 'od 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs ma thag dga' bar byas pa'i mod la sa slar 'byor 'od kyang byung ste dad nas rgyal pos gzhi 'di las bdag la nyes par 'gyur ba mi 'byung grang zhus pa na 'phags pas ngas gom pa bdun bsus na rgyal srid las nyams par 'gyur mod kyi 'on kyang gom pa drug las ma bsus pas khyod kyi rgyal srid zla ba drug nyams par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bstan te de bzhin du gyur pa lta bu'i nyes dmi gas yod pa la dgongs nas khyed 1328

rang nga la phyag byed mi dgos phan tshun phyag med par mjal chog gsung gi phyag lan mi mdzad pa ni pha rol po nyid skyob pa'i don du mi mdzad pa yin la/ stan mthon po dgos zhes brtseg pa sogs la khong rang rnams kyi bsam pa bzhin mdzad kyi/ thob mi thob la sogs pa'i gleng mo mi mdzad/ dpa la sbas kyis sngar mu stegs pa rnams bos phyis ston pa spyan drangs pa na mu stegs pa rnams kyi gral mjug tu bzhugs la 'on kyang rim gyis gral mgor song ba lta bu rje nyid la'ang de ltar byed pa yod rung bzhugs pa la gdon mi za'o/ /spyir nga khyed la chos zhu ba yin pas phyag lan dgos zhes bya ba dang sngar khyed kyis nga la chos zhu dgos zer ba sogs bod na zing zing por yod cing sngon phreng kha ber chung gis 'brom ston pa la khyod chos gra nas 'ongs pa'i dge bsnyen zhig snang ste nga yang phreng kha ber chung bya ba'i mi chen po yin pas khyod kyis phyag wa 'khyug pa 'dra ba zhig tshol byas pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'di lta bu ni da dung byang ngos 'di mang ba yin la/ zang zing gi ched du blun po kha bsod cung zad yod pa 'dus pa'i mgo phar bskor tshur bskor yin na der zad mod/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan ldan la 'di ltar byas na phyis rten 'brel 'phyugs pas byin rlabs mi 'jug pa yin no/ /spyir yang 'jig rten na phrad tshad phyag byed pa'ang ga la yin te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyal la dad ldan rnams kyis phyag byed pa rtogs phyir rgyal po gsal rgyal sogs kyis phyag byas tshul bshad pa dang / bram ze rnams phal cher phyag mi byed pas bram ze'i khye'u ma sdug gis de bzhin gshegs pa la sngon du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur pa'i gtam sna tshogs pa byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go zhes 'chad pa yin la/ bla ma brtag pa la'ang sngon phyag mi byed par brtags nas dad pa thob pa na 'dud pa ste spyir bla ma brtag dgos ni thams cad zer yang bod du ni tshul bzhin brtags pa rje rang byung pa la g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis brtags pa 1329

tsam las cher ma thos la spyir bod pa rnams ni thos lo'i skad cha la bsten pa dang /rig sngags kyis rmongs pa thebs pa dang / dbang sdud kyi sngags kyis cha/go 'khor ba sogs las dang por skyon yon tan ltar sgrog pas dad pa skad du bsten/ phyis dbang chos kyi go chod mi chod ci yin rung de zhus zin nas skyon rnam/sa brjod rnga/ra snang zhing da lta'i bod yul ba rnams kyi bla ma brtag pa ni thabs bzang ba kha mkhas pa dgra thul gnyen skyong la phan pa zhig gam bya ba btang rdzu dang mkhas rdzus 'tsho zhing dam pa'i gzigs ngor brim par bya ba ma yin pa zhig brtag par snang ngo / /rigs rus kyang spyir de ga ma nyams pa kho na'ang dkon par snang la/ ma nyams pa yin du chug yang shākya'i rigs skyon med kho na la lhas byin dang legs skar yang byung ba dang / bod chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud skyon med la glang dar lta bu byung pa yod la/ breg mkhan las rab tu byung ba nye ba 'khor lta bu yang yod pas rigs kyis mi chog pas dam pa dgyes pa'i spyod pa la gnas pa dgos la/ gdan sa'ang sngon gyi skyes bu dam pa de'i spangs rtogs kyi tshad du 'khyol na yin gyi skye bo tha mal pa zhig gis byang chub kyi shing drung du bsdad rung sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur ba dang snya nam grod phug du bsdad pa tsam gyis mi la'i go sar mi 'gro ba shes par byos shig kha cig garma pa lta bus gnas min gyi mjal phrad de 'dra mdzad na che ba 'chor zer yang 'jig rten gyi grags ma grags la bstos pa ma mdzad pa nyid kyis chos kyi che ba ni phul byung du thon pa yin la 'jig rten gyi'ang dpyod ldan dag gis ni de ltar thos pa na rje'i mdzad pa la dad pa lhag par skye zhing skye bo gzhan pa dag rnga ma byang ba zhig yod par 'dug snyam du skye ba yin la da lta rgyal khrims med pas skye bo dag lugs bzhin du mi spyod pas deng sang gi skye bo'i bya ba rnams byis pa'i spyod par zad pas gtan tshigs su mi che ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi mugs bzhin gyi srol du'ang ba/ la 'gyur te sngon ma rnam sa kyis gus 'dud byas pa'i 1330

srol khong dag gis mi 'dzin pa bzhin no/ /spyir rje 'di ni gzhan dag gi rnyed bkur la gnod kyis dogs pas yon tan thams cad sbed cing khyad par 'gran zlar bsnyems pa dag yod pa'i sar mi/ mngon pa'i tshul gyis dman sa kho na 'dzin/gzhan mtho bar 'gyur ba'i thabs kho na mdzad kyi rang chen por gzigs pa'i 'gying ba ni gtan mi srid do/ /spyir 'jig rten gyi khe grags dang rnam g.yeng la zhen pa nyes pa'i 'byung khungs su ston phyir/ tshe 'di'i grags 'byor snying pos dben po'i tshul/ /zhes sogs gsungs kyi rje 'di ni gangs ri'i sul ches dben pa dag du bzhugs kyang yul dus de dag gi 'byor pa'i mchog mtha' dag rgya mtsho la chu bo bzhin du 'du mod kyi cir yang gzigs pa mi mnga' ba nor bu rin po ches skye 'gro'i dbul ba sel yang cir yang mi rtog pa lta bu yin la/ bod yul gyi bla dpon chen po dag gis mi rabs nas mi rabs bla rabs nas bla rabs bcu phrag mang po dag gis nan tan gyis btsal 'bad pas bsags ma god par bsrungs pa rnams kyi yo byad mtha' dag bsdus pas kyang rje 'di'i drung du nyin gcig gi 'bul chen 'bring po cig la yang do bar dka' ba dang / gang du phebs par dkar po'i lha mthu bo che thams cad 'du zhing mchod/ rgyal khams mtha' dag gi mjal mi sprin bzhin du 'du bas ci dgos lhun grub tu 'byung /lo legs shing skya rgyal/ nad yams dang dus 'khrug nyung ba sogs mthong chos bder gnas kyi bka' drin mtha' yas/ slob ma'ang sangs rgyas thams cad rje nyid kyi rnam 'phrul du shes pa'i mos gus can dang cis kyang dgos med kyi zhen log gting tshugs pa dngul chu sa la pho pa ltar 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang mi 'dre ba'i bya btang gi skyes bu mang du bzhugs so/ /de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar de rnams kyang gdul byayi/ bsgrub bar bya ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rnam thar gyi tshul du ston pa kho na ste nyid bstod du don dgus gsungs pa 1331

dang / legs spyad mar legs spyad so gsum du gsungs pa dang / nyer bdun ma dang rnam thar la slob pa'i khrid du gsungs pa ltar bslab cing bsgrub par bya'o/ /rje des smin grol du mdzad pa'i skyes chen gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab kyang rags pa rje nyid kyi sbyang bar bya ba'i rabs kyi bstan bcos su bka' bstsal ba ltar yin la/ gtso bo zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog yan lag rje nyid kyi rgyal tshab bstan pa'i bdag por bzhugs shing 'gran gyi zla med pa'o/ /rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku grags pa dpal 'byor/ si dhu sprul pa'i sku chos kyi 'od zer mnyan pa sprul sku/ dbu ma sku skye/ ri khrod sku skye sogs skyes bu dam pa bsams bzhin du srid pa 'dzin pa du ma dang / 'bri khung gi gdan rim bco lnga pa rin po che rin chen rnam par rgyal ba/ gdan sa gong 'og bar gsum gyi zhal ngo / sgam po'i spyan snga sku gzhon pa/ ni ring rin po che sogs bka' rgyud kyi gdan sa 'dzin pa du ma dang / gzhung brgya smra ba byang sems nyi ma bkra shis/ slob dpon bstan pa rgya mtsho/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ mkhas mchog shes rab rnam rgyal/ rgyal sras kun dga' bkra shis/ rab 'byams pa byang chub bshes gnyen/ mkhas mchog phyogs glang legs pa/ mkhas btsun chen po rnam rgyal grags pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas dpal grub/ mkhas mchog bsod nams bzang po/ mkhas pa rin chen legs pa sogs bstan pa la bya ba mdzad pa'i mkhas pa chen po rnams dang mkhan chen dbon ram ba/ gzhag blang dbon pa sku mched sogs bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad ba du ma dang / drung kun bzang ba sogs tshe 'di'i rnam rtog chad cing 'od gsal nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'gro ba sogs de kho na nyid kyi yon tan mnga' ba ches mang po dang / rab 'byams pa dpal 'bar ba ni gdams ngag gis smin grol du mdzad pa'i bu slob dam pa yin la gzhan yang bsten yun ring thung ci 1332

rigs pa la rtsa ba'i bla ma rje nyid la 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa dang sgom chen ches mang la/ 'jam dbyangs 'chi med dpal bzang po sogs bod yul gyi che gnyan mkhas btsun bzang gsum dam chos kyi 'brel pa gsan pa ni bgrang bar mi spyod de mdor na rgya nag pho brang yan bal po dang rgya gar tshun du 'phrin las kyis khyab bo/ /che gnyan thams cad kyis zhabs la gtugs pa la yang rje 'di thugs dregs pa gtan mi mnga' bas so so'i chen po 'di dang 'di dag mjal lo zhes rje nyid kyi spyad pa'i rabs las gsungs pa ltar dgongs kyi nga la chos zhus pas na nga'i slob ma'o zhes mi dgongs so/ /mchog gi sprul sku nyin byed shar ba lta bu na rim dgu pa 'di dang rje nyid kyi zhal slob sprul sku thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa du ma'i yang rnam thar ngo mtshar ba mang du yod mod kyi sku tshe'i rten 'brel du dmigs nas re zhig ma bris so/ sgrub rgyud kurma kaX tshang gi dpal ldan bla maḥ dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa sa bon tsam du cung zad brjod pa 'di ni rje /mi bskyod zhabs snying gi dbus su 'dzin pa dpal gtsug lag phreng bas spyir chos byung chen mo'i kha bskang bar bya ba dang / mkhas grub dpal sdings pa kistu shā ra zhes bya ba des sngon 'di lta bu dgos zhes 'di nas lo bcu gnyis kyi sngon du nan tan gyis bskul ba la khas blangs pa kha 'og tu lus 'grus par bya ba'i ched du yang dmigs nas bya lo zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga la kong yul sngags spyod kyi zhing gnod mdzes mkhar gyi yul gyi lte ba dga' ldan ma mo'i gtsug lag khang chen mor legs par grub bo/ /dge bas 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang rnarma pa'i/ /gdul byar gyur te rdzogs byang gi /go 'phang dam pa thob gyur cig /yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs las le'u tshan brgyad pa'o/ /bstan pa'i snying po sgrub rgyud kum tshang gi /dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar ngo 1333

mtshar gtam/ /mdzad bzang chos sbyin mi zad spel pa'i phyir/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can stobs kyis yangs par skyong / /sa skyong g.yul rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ /sku rab rnam rgyal khang bzang chen por bsgrubs/ /dge ba 'di dang dge kun gcig bsdoms te/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bsngo/ /shu snyi// //rma ga laX / / 1334
yan lag gsum pa bod kyibaskabs/chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston gyi yan lag gsum pa bod kyi skabs las dgu pa 'bri khung bka' rgyud kyi rnam thar snying po bzhugs so/ /

le'u dgu pa 'bri gung bka' rgyud kyi rnam thar/khyad par du 'bri gung bka' rgyud ni bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i rnam thar cung zad mi 'dra bar bzhed de/ rdo rje 'chang / in+d+ra bo dhi/ klu'i rnal 'byor ma/bi su /lpa/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ma tam gi ste pha rgyud kyi bka' babs so/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ tsār+ya pa ste mā ya'i 'o/ phyag rdor/ ḍim+bi ba/ khri na badz+ra/ la ba ba ste rgyud sde mtha' dag gi'o/ /phyag rdor/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'am pad+ma badz+ra/ skal ba bzang mo ste dgyes rdor dang gtum mo'i 'o/ /in+d+ra bo bhi ni sangs rgyas kyis gsang 'dus kyis btul te o rgyan gyi yul stongs nas mtshor gyur/ phyag rdor gyis klu la rgyud gtad pas mir gyur pa mtsho 'gram du yul bcas te gtso mo klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo ste thams cad grub pa thob nas mtsho de yang skams pa'i shul du rang byung gi lha khang du dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs pa la phyag rdor gyis rgyud rnams gtad/ de'i tshe lho phyoṭa o de be+e sha'i rgyal po bi su /lnga rab tu byung nas paṇ+ḍi tar gyur pas/ ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /ces pa'i lung las nyon mongs lam byed yod par rig nas smon lam btab pas mkha' 'gros lung bstan te he ru ka rang byung gi lha khang du byon pas klu'i rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs te dngos grub brnyes/ sa ra ha chen po rgyal po de bsten nas bran mo zhig la la phug 'tshed du bcug pas lo bcu gnyis ting 'dzin la song / bzhengs nas tshod ma ga re gsungs pas/ sems kyi 'khri ba ma chod na/ /lus ni dben pas ci la phan/ /bcu gnyis lo ru mnyam bzhag kyang / /tshod ma'i 'khri ba ma chod mtshar/ /zer 1337

bas mda' mkhan mo bsten te grub pa brnyes/ mkha' spyod chen por gshegs te dpal gyi ri la bzhugs/ klu sgrub ni be ta'i yul pa/ rigs bram ze/ bram ze brgya la chos ston drangs pas bu rnyed par lhas lung bstan pa ltar rnyed/ mtshan mkhan gyis skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dang ldan yang tshe zhag bdun dang / bram ze dang dge slong brgya re la gdugs chod drangs pas zla ba bdun lo bdun thub par bstan/ de nas 'khyam du btang bas nā lan+dar bram ze dgra gcan zin gyis rab tu phyung / 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang skur/ gzungs lo bdun bton pas 'chi bdag bcom ste mkhas pa chen po dge slong dpal ldan du grags/ mkhan pos gsang 'dus kyi dbang man ngag gnang ste zhal ta par bskos nas dpal gyi ri la gshegs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chang tshong mar mdzad pa cig gi khyim na rkya ba gser du gzigs nas chang tshong la gser 'gyur gyi gdams pa zhus/ lo bcu gnyis mu ge byung ba na gser 'gyur gyis dge 'dun bskyangs/ phyis dge 'dun gyis log 'tsho la bkod 'dug pa'i chad par gnas nas phyung ste mchod rten bye ba gyis zhes bsgos/ der dge slong bde byed bya bas rigs pa'i rgyan zhes pa'i gzhung 'bum phrag bcu gnyis pa byas te paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad sun 'byin pa'i tshe slob dpon gyis rigs tshogs brtsams nas yod med du lta ba tshar bcad/chos grar klu 'jog po'i bu gnyis khye'ur byas te 'ongs pa la tsan+dan goni ṣā bslangs pas klus spyan drangs/ yum rgyas pa dang yi ge nyung ngu spyan drangs klus 'phrin las byas te mchod rten bye ba'ang phal cher grub pas nā gāsbyo nar grags/dril bu lta bu'i brag gser du bsgyur bzhed pa sgrol mas bkag ste dpal gyi ri la sgrub pa gyis shig par lung bstan/ sgra mi snyan du byon/ byis pa rgyal por gyur pa'i khab tu lo gsum bzhugs/ btsun mo slob dpon la chags pas slob dpon 'dra ba'i bu byung ba āyi de was shog 'dam gyi ma he bcos pas skur pa sangs/1338

dpal gyi rir bdud rtsi bum pa gang gi phyag rten byas pas rgya mtsho bdud rtsir bsgyur pas thugs rgyal chag lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa mdzad/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dgongs 'grel gtam tshogs rigs tshogs bstod tshogs mdzad/ dpal gyi rir rgyal po bde spyod kyi bus dbu bslangs pa ku shas bcad de byin/ tshigs bcad gsum grag sku lus rdo bar byin gyis brlabs pa da lta yod zer/ ku ku ri pa ni/ spyod pa la rgyu ba'i tshe lam du khyi gu mo zhig la snying rje skyes te bsos/ yul ka la sa hu'i nye sar rang byung gi phug tu lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs/ thun mong gi dngos grub rnams thob tshe lhas sum bcu rtsa gsum du spyan drangs pa la ma bzhugs par khyi gu la brtse bas phyir byon/ khyi gu des sa drus pas chu mig byung / de rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur te lha'i bde ba la ma chags pas mchog gi dngos grub byin no/ /tsār+yā pa ni be+e ga la'i bye brag u ru bai sha'i grong du rje rigs su 'khrungs/ dza lad+dhā ra pa dang kusku ri pa bsten/ bar dor dngos grub thob bo/ḍim+bi pa ni ma gabha'i rgyal rigs yin/ nag po spyod pa las gdams pa gsan/glu mkhan gyi bu mo bsten/ rgyal sar spyan 'dren pa la rigs lad pas mes dag par gyis gsungs nas zhag bdun bsregs pas he ru ka dngos su gyur/ lo bdun brgya mi yul du bzhugs so/ /bi na sa ni gi ri'i rgyal po'i sras gcig pur gyur/ tasbu ra'i sgra las sems rtse gcig pa thob/ skyo ba na slob dpon rta mchog gis tasbu ra'i sgra la brten nas ngo sprad de spyod pa des rtogs pa bskyangs nas yul khams de grol bar byas so/ /la ba ba ni o rgyan dang nye ba sasti re zhes pa grong 'bum tsho gsum gyi rgyal por gyur pa la slob dpon bi na sas byin gyis brlabs te nga/ ba dang kham zan gyis 'tsho zhing dur khrod mun pa mi bzad par phyi pa'i mkha'i 'gro ma rgyal po'i btsun mor yod pa rnams btul te mgo la lham bkon sna bcu brgyus pa'i chad pa dbab/ 'khor bdun brgya dang bcas pa mkha' 1339

spyod du gshegs so/ /yan lag med pa'i rdo rje ni yul gaspyi grong khyer 'bum tsho gya bzhi'i bdag po in+d+ra bo dhi'i sras las rab tu byung paṇ+ḍitar gyur nas chos gsungs pas bud med mi sdug pa cig res ngu res rgod cing khyod kyis tshig shes pas rgod/ don mi shes pas ngu zer zhing o rgyan na nga'i ming po phag tshang pa zhes rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor pas shes zer te grong 'dabs na phag rdzi rgan rgon gnyis bu mo mdzes ma dang gsum 'dug pa la gtugs pas rgan pos rmos byed/ bu mos rol nang nas bsgrugs pa'i 'bu tshod za zhing 'dug khong gis ma zos pas rgan pos khyod rigs kyis dregs shing yon tan gyis bsnyems pas snod du mi rung gsungs/ gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs te bu mo dang lhan cig dpal gyi rir sgrub pa mdzad/ dngos grub brnyes te mu ge'i dus 'bru'i char phab/ yul du byon pas rigs nyams zer nas me la bsregs pas zil pa phrom me 'dug nas yul de btul bas pad+ma badz+ra'i mtsho skyes rdo rjer graṭa so/ /de'i slob ma skal bzang mo ni su ma ti dpal gyi blo gros ma la smi ka ra don gcig ste in+d+ra bo bhi'i lcam snyung 'dze byung ba spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes bsos/ mtsho skyes kyis rjes su bzung bas grub pa thob/ laṅka pu ri'i rgyal po'i sgo drung du smyon ma'i spyod pa mdzad/ thams cad mthong snang tha dad pa'i tshe rgyal po'i phyags bdar ba zhig la chos bstan/ phag mo dbu bcad mar mdzad/ phyaṭa bdar ba de dang kha sbyar nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /te lo pa ni yul za hor/ bram ze gsal ba'i 'od yin/ so ma pu rir rab tu byung / lcags 'og tu lo bcu gnyipa sgrub pa mdzad/ thun mong thob/ nya'i rnam shes spar/ klu sgrub 'tshol du phyin pas 'jigs byed gzhad pa'i dur khrod du ma taṅgi dang mjal te slob dpon dri za'i yul du gshegs/ khyod rjes su 'dzin pa la nga btang ba yin zhes de kho na nyid bstan te za hor gyi grong khyer ha ri ke la ni sprul pa'i rgyal po 1340

khru/t+ma kes byin gyis brlabs pas sgrub thag nye ba yin/ der smad tshong ma dha ri ca/'i khol po gyis la rtogs pa skyongs zhes gsungs yul khams de ba grol bar mdzad/ lho phyogs kyi rgyal po tsan+d+ra dī ba na la gus pa'i don du nus pa bstan te ngas ni zhing khams brgyar yang phyin/ /sogs gsungs te yul de drangs/ /za hor gyi yul lan gsum stongs par mdzad do/ /na ro pa kha che'i bram ze/dka' ba bcu gnyis kyis rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag ste bar dor mchog thob pa'o/ / mar mi dgas gsum phag gru pa rnams rnam thar spyi dang 'dra/ phag gru pa la thugs sras bzhi/ mthar thug bzhi/ mchog brgyad/ nye gnas brgyad/dge bshes dang sgom chen 'gro don can mang du byon/ bstan pa'i bdag po lta bur gyur pa 'bri khung skyu ra rin po che ni/ mdo khams 'bri klung dam pa chos phyug gi yul tsar stod g.yon lung gi grong tsu ngur 'dru rgyal skyu ra'i gdung 'dzin par mdzad do/ /de yang sngon rgyal po glang dar gyi dus tsam na skyu ra'i sngags 'chang chen po cig la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo sna nam bza' chos kyi dbang phyug blangs pa la nga la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bu bzhi 'ong zer zhing sha gzug gcig drangs pas phag nas gri gug dang thod pa phyung ste sha'i sum cha gcig thod par gtor ma byas/ cha gcig rang gis zos/ cha gcig khol mo la byin skad/ gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur zhing ri rab khang khyim la thogs med du rgyu zhing dus min du 'gro 'ong byed/ mthar sku lus 'dis bka' srung kun gyi gtso mor gyur te rgyud 'dzin rnams kyis mtshan nas bos pa tsam gyis dgra kha phung du 'gro ba de'i sras nam mkha' dbang phyug gi rgyud pa a mes dbang rgyal bya ba nus pa can de'i sras bzhi pa mdo sngags la mkhas pa 'jigs byed kyi rna' / 'byor pa rdo rje/ yum btsun ma zhes bya ba bud med bu dang bral ba la bu 1341

yid la ma byed dang sdug bsngal mi skye'i zhes ston pa cig gi sras su chu mo phag lo la 'khrungs/ lhums su 'jug gnas ltam pa'i skabs kun tu rdo rje mchu'i po ti dkar po 'od kyi rnam par yum gyis gzigs/ sku gces nga/sa bon po la gtad de des mtshan dpal ba thar rang phyis rang gis btsun pa skyabs su mtshan spos/ dgung lo drug nas klog mkhas par mkhyen te za yon gyis mi nges kyis nyen pa'i skye bo mang po bskyabs shing da lta'ang 'bri khung thel pa'i klog zhes klog chod che zhing skyon chung ba/ sa sgra ra sgra sogs thon pa 'phul rten sogs la'ang mchu sbyor tha dad thon pa yod do/ /slob dpon lnga drug tsam yod/ chos mang du gsan/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/ mnal lam du'ang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po byang / mdo rgyud las gsungs pa'i las tshogs rnams grub/ chos mkhas pa dang nad sel ba dang mthu che ba sogs nus pa che ba'i grags pa thob/'on kyang dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pas thugs phrogs te dam can rdor legs kyis phrin las bsgrubs te byon/ chas pa'i nyin khams nas dbus kyi bar 'ja'as 'brel/ bla ma de'i drung na gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya yod kyang thugs kyi sras nga rang yin snyam du ngam ngam pa byung / mnal lam du rje phag gru pa spyan ras gziṭa su mjal/ sbal lo tsā ba la dba'as rdo rje rgyal po sku khams bzang ngam byas pas khong khros te rdo phyar byung / cig na re kho phag mo grur 'gro bar 'dug zer bas 'o na song zhig bla ma rin po che sku khams bzang ngo zer/ khong ni ma ga dhar lo bcu gnyis bsdad pa cig phag mo grur gzim sa lcil la skor ba bdun byas pas thugs dam 'khrungs pa yin par snang / de nas dgung lo nyer lnga pa me phag gi mjug la phag mo grur mjal/ ja dang dar zab dang rta dang kun phul bas kho bo rkang bzhi'i 'bul ba mi len pa yin zhes rta ma bzhes/ ja de la phyag bcug mnams nas bzang po cig 'dug thon par skol/ 'di 'di bos gsungs te dbu 1342

che brgyad bcu tsam tshogs pa la drangs/ rje nyid kyis yang yang bzhes pas sku gzi mdangs dang ldan par gyur/ bla ma 'di lta bu rnyed pa da re tshogs bsags snyam pa na/ khyod da nga rang la re che bar 'dug ste ngas khyed rnams kyi don du dka' ba dpag med spyad pa yin gsungs/ sngar rtogs ldan thod pa bor chog yin yang srid mi len/ 'on kyang da dung kho bo'i slob ma ma tshang gsungs shing nga'i rgyud pa 'di dge bsnyen sa bcu pa cig gis 'dzin gsung ba la chos rje nyid phebasaphyin chad da ni nga'i 'khor tshang gsungs shing rtogs ldan skye ba'i 'khor lo bskor bya ba sogs gsungs pas snga ma kha cig ma mos skad/ lan gcig rje bzhengs nas lus gnad bcos/ mdun du yi ge gsum gsung chen po zhig mdzad nas khyod la sgom chen bzang po zhig 'ong / sgom chen tsam la bzang ba zhig 'ong / de la kho bo dga' ba lags mod gsungs/ dag snang la ltem rkyang byung bas sar phyag gi zhe dam mdzad pas sor chud/ mos gus la ltem rkyang byung ba zhus pas de phyin chad ltem rkyang ma byung / sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du chos lnga po 'di dang ma bral ba gyis/ rtogs pa 'dis chog snyam na da dung mang du gor yod pa yin gsungs/chos bsgugs kyi sar yang yan lag bdun pa kho na phul/ phyag rten sna re med par mjal ma myong / byang chub sems sdom gnang nas khyod kyi ming ni byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal lo gsungs/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ji ltar 'char zhus pas de khyod rang gis shes nas 'ong lan gsum gsungs/ gsheṭa shar bla ma'i thugs ka nas gser gyi rdo rje byung ste rje 'di'i thugs gar thim pa der yod kun gyis mthong / lcil po'i rdo yan chad sku 'bum gyi phyogs su gtad/phyis g.ye chung du bla ma yal gyis zhabs tog byas te sgrub pa mdzad pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad shar/ rlung dbu mar tshud/ chos zab mo 'di rnams bla mas sngon nas gsungs 'dug pa snyam nas mos gus khyad par can skyes/ sgrol ma 1343

zhal gzigs/ slar yang lo gnyis sgrub pa mdzad pa na snyung 'dze drag po thog babs su byung bas rkyen byas te snying rje blo rdeg tu 'khrungs pa na klu chen po de yang sku lus las bud par gzigs pas snyung gzhi skad cig gis grol/ rtogs pa mthar phyin te sangs rgyas thams cad dang dgongs pa mnyam pa nyid du gyur/ 'on kyang gzhan gyi ngor zhag phyed dang bzhi yi nang par la/ mi kho bo'i las ngan rang sar dag /zhes gsungs/ sngon bla ma rin po ches kyang khyod rab tu byung gsung ba la/ rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba brgyad khal dang 'dra ba'i steng du bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba spong ba gong tsha lta bu mi theg dgongs nas ma blangs/phyis g.ye chung du bcas rang ngo bo gcig pa dang / bkag pa ye bkag gnang ba ye gnang dang chos kyi rgyal pos 'gro ba spyi la bcas pa dang nyams pa las ma blangs pa nyes pa lci ba sogs kyi gnad dgongs pas rab tu mi 'byung ka med du 'dug par mkhyen nas dgung lo so lnga pa me mo bya lo la zhang gis mkhan po dang rtsi lung pas slob dpon smyal ba 'dul 'dzin gyis gsangs ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs smyal 'dug la 'dul ba gsan/ nga dpal chen bairlu ba dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhig dge slong du phebs pa 'di nga pho rgod yin gsungs/bla ma sdum sku lus gum pa dmigs pas zhag gsum la bsal/ mkhan po la bsnyung 'dze thog babs su byung ba zhag bco lngas bsal/ gzhan yang byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis nad zhi ba dang / nus pa phul du byung bas skye bo dag blor ma chud de rgyu rkyen sna tshogs pa gleng pa na rje phag gru pa'i slob ma tsā ri ba bya ba grub thob tu grags pa cig na re ngas lta zer skad/ khong gis mjal bas dad pa thob ste de grub thob rtsod med du 'dug nged gnyis bla ma mi gcig par 'dug nga'i bla ma dge bshes khams pa yin par 'dug khong gi bla ma sangs rgyas yin par 'dugazer skad ste mdo las kyang sangs rgyas la dag sa pa rnams kyis bsam gyis mi 1344

khyab pa chos kyi dbyings thams cad par mthong ba dang theg chen gyi 'phags pas rtag pa'i skur mthong ba dang so skyes mya ngan las 'da' bar mthong ba rnams mos pa'i khyad par yin la rang nyid rgyud tshod mthor song nas mos gus gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin no/ /der gdan sar phebs pas stong nyid snying rje'i rnal 'byor gyis 'dze 'ur 'ded mdzad pa'i bla ma gral dbu la bzhugs zhes gtam btang bas 'dze 'ur 'ded par mtshan grags/ gdan sar lo ngo gsum bzhugs pa la khong rnams rtsing spyod byed pas mi bzhugs par dgongs/ rje gong mas za 'og gi 'bol rnying pa 'di khong rang tsho la gtod la khyod rang byang pha gir song gsung ba gzigs te gzhi ba tsho la gdan sa 'phrod yod do gsungs nas byon/ 'bri khung gi gzhi bdag bar lhas bon po'i gzugs kyis bsus/ sha ba dang bya rgod la sgom btab/ lam du gsung phur rtsegs dbang phyug seng ge dang gtsang pa 'jam dpal seng ge sogs la gdams pa gsungs/ mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyis bsus nas dgung lo so brgyad pa lcags pho byi ba la 'bri khung du byon/ skal ldan gyi slob ma mang du 'dus shing byang du byon pas gnyan chen thang lhas gsu ba byas/nyi ma gtod la mnan/ mkhan po kol ti bas sems skyed gsal ma btab pa dang gso sbyong la cho ga dka' ba na phyis mi mdzad par dgongs pas tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gso sbyong dang rab byung gnang bar gsol ba btab/ ngam shod tu byon/ thugs rjes 'khrug pa yun ring du zhi/ dwags por byon te mu ge cher yod pa phebs ma thag nas zhi ste bka' drin tshad med par gyur/ dgung lo drug bcu'i dus rten 'brel mdzad pas sku tshe'i bar chad zhi/ dmu chu'i bsnyun 'phrul 'khor gyis dwangs/ phyis ngam shod pa'i rabs chad cig gis yo byad dang gsung rab gdan sar phul ba la brten lung pa'i mi thams cad kyis gdan sa bshig par thag chod tshe slob ma'i bde legs bla ma la rten 'brel sgrig dgos par dgongs/1345

gsung rab des gtso byas phag gru'i gsung rab kun sgam por phul bas rtsod pa'ang rang zhi/ phyis phag gru dar ba'i rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig pas rje nyid kyi 'phrin las 'di che zhing bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par byas pa la de tsam zhig grub gsung zhing 'di ni na ro pa'i dka' ba bcu gnyis las lhag zhes gsungs la gzhan kun gyis skur pa btab/ phyis bla ma'i gdan sa ngas brgya 'gyur du btang ngo gsungs nas rje spyan snga bskos pa phyin phag mo gru'i gdan sa bka' rgyud rnams byon no/ /'bri khung nyid du phyon pa ni/ mkhan chen gu ra ba yul se'u gangs dkar mo/ yab sum pa rdo rje dpal/ grog mkhar gtsang ston las rab tu byung /mtshan tshul rdor/ dpal chen thag ma ba las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'dul ba la mkhas/ zhe drug la 'bri khung pa mjal/ byin rlabs zhugs/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sprul bar lung bstan/ dgung lo re bzhi nas lo gsum gdan sa mdzad do/ /dbon rin po che bsod nams grags pa ni mdo khams snying 'jam 'om bu lung du yab 'jig rten mgon po'i khu bo dkon mchog rin chen gyi sras a nye a graṭa la sras gsum gyi che ba yin/ 'bring po dpon rgyud pa rdo rje seng ge chung ba gcung rin po che rdo rje grags pa/ bcu gcig pa la dpal chen shri phug pa mngaṭa te 'bri khung du byon nas mtshan gnang / stag phur snubs ston yon tan grags la dgyes rdor gsan/ 'bri khung nyid du 'dul ba sogs sbyangs/ lo bcu gsum dang drug dang bzhi'i dam bca' rim par mdzad nas sgrub pa mdzad/ so lnga la khrir byon/ so dgu la sgo mang bzhengs/ zhe dgu la 'das/rje spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas ni mdo khams lce lung rag ni yab lha gzigs yon sgom/ 'jig rten mgon po las rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/lo nyer gcig gzims g.yog mdzad/ bzhi bcu pa la phag mo grur bskos te lo 1346

nyi shur bzhugs/ dbon rin po che sku thim gcung sgrub pa ma grol bas 'bri khung du lo nyer gcig gdan sa mdzad/ gya gcig shing yos la thegs/gcung rdo rje grags pa ni lo drug pa la 'jig rten mgon po mjal bas 'di te lo ba yin nged rang thams cad las lhag pa 'ong zhes lung bstan/ bdun pa la 'jig rten mgon po thegs/ nyer lnga la dbon thegs tshe kho bo sgrub pa mthar ma thon pas gdan sar smra ba'i seng ge spyan snga ba bskos gsungs/ mchog ma thob bar them pa las 'da' re zhes dbu mna' dor smra ba bcad de lo bcu gsum bzhugs/ garma pag shi hor gyis tsan+dan gyi mer zhag phyed dang bzhir bsregs pas gshegs par bzhed pa na te lo ba seng ge la bcibs nas byon 'od kyis 'jig rten snang bar mdzad nas yig 'bru gsum du bsdus pa gam pa la bstims te zad par me'i ting 'dzin sgoms me'i gnyen por me thong zhig gsungs pas bdud las rgyal/ kho bo 'bri khung na gcung rdo rje grags pa yin sngon te lo bar grags/ stong gsum kun na kho bo'i sprul pa mtha' yas gsungs/ de'i tshe garma pas/ rang byung ye shes thams cad mkhyen/ /seng ge sgra yis byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas kun 'dus 'bri khung pa/ /'gro ba'i mgon po rdo rje graṭa/ /khong seng ge dkar mo'i steng du bcibs/ /mi kho bo'i mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//gsung lhang lhang bdag la 'di skad gsungs/ /'gro ba'i mgon po garma pa/ /sbyangs pa mthar phyin thugs rje can/ /lam byang chub sems la nan tan mdzod/ /khyod stong nyid nam mkha'i rdo rje yin/ /gsungs shing slar yang mkha' la gsheṭa//mi kho bo 'byung bzhi'i bdud las rgyal/ /zhes gsungs/ phyis cog sna nas thel rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs su gzigs te phyag mdzad skad/ zhe drug la khrir phebs/ gtsug lag khang ka ba brgya dang brgyad bcu'i sa lha chen du ma gser thog gser 'phru dang bcas pa mdzad/ dge 'dun khri phrag bcu gsum gyis me 1347
