gyi bdag /ka mib ni dmag gi bdag /mdzes ma 'od ldan tshal gyi bdag /zhes bdag po bzhi'i ya gyal yin/ dbang phyug zhag bdun gyis grub ste nag po thub rgyal du btags nas mngal skyes kyis mi thub pa/ kha nas me phyung ste rgol ba sreg pa/ mthar dbang phyug nyid zhugs nas rtsod pa rnams byin/ dbang phyug gi grogs po tshangs pas ne tso paṇ+ḍi ta ces rtsod lan thams cad ne tsos 'debs pa dang / khyab 'jug gis pra ṇa paṇ+ḍi ta ces thod le skor bskyur bas rtsod lan bris yong ba dang / dbyangs can mas sring mo paṇ+ḍi ta ces sring mor byas te rtsod lan 'debs pa rnams byin/ nub phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa med pa tsam byas/slar ma yis sgrol ma la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dris nas nang pa'i bstan pa da dung yod dam zer bas yul dbus su btang na thul 'ong bsams nas nang pa'i bstan pa dngos shrī nā lan+d+ra la sogs yul dbus na yod pa yin mod zer bas yul dbus su 'ongs/ yul der slebs nas shi na ga la dra ga na yod byas pas bud med cig na re bram ze sgra ma byang ba shrī nā lan+d+ra bya ba yin zer bas bud med kyis kyang sgra shes par 'dug snyam/ yang byis pa cig rtsa ba rko ba la ci rko byas pas rtsa ba rko zer/ ci'i rtsa ba byas pas rtse mo'i rtsa ba zer/ rtse mo gang gi dris pas rtsa ba'i rtse mo zer/ byis pas kyang rgal lan shes par 'dug pas da res ldog gam snyam yang bsnyems pas mu stegs kyi rgyal po sogs mu stegs pa thams cad bsdus te nā lan+d+rar phyin/ de na gtsug lag khang chen drug bcu/ khang phran brgya rtsa brgyad/paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya/ gnas brtan chen po bcu drug sogs yod kyang rta dbyangs su shes pas 'di mngal skyes kyis mi thub zer te rtsod po ma byung / gtsug lag khang gi phyi nas bskor te mi gsar pa mi gtong / nyin re la dus gsum du rnga bo che brdungs nas dbang phyug dang ston pa drug dang rta dbyangs rgyal bar gyur cig zhes sgra chen po sgrog kho dge 'dan gyi gral da 'ongs nas mgo zlam dang po gang nas ri ra ra —1446

skyernga / zhes dbyug pa rdeg dge 'dun gyis dkon ma chog la gco/la ba btab pas gnas brtan gyi rmi lam du ye shes mgon po na re/ mu stegs kyis nga'i gzugs kyi spyi bor phur pa btab/ ngan rdzas sna tshogs pa byugs yod pas phur pa thon ngan rdzas khrus la slar khung bu gsos/ gtor ma rgya chen po thong / de nas sprul pa bya rog cig yong ba la yi ge thogs/ lho phyogs dpal gyi ri nas klu sgrub spyan drang gis zer/ de bzhin byas pas bya rog chen po cig byung ba la sngon rgyal po legs mthong chen po gling bzhir 'gro ba ma he stong phrag mang pos shing rta 'dren pa'i tshe khyu mchog de rwas lus 'phrug cing sdod tshe gzhan gyis mi 'drongs pas ma he rnams kyis khyu mchog la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig bkur bar dka' ba'i khur gyis lus dub nas/ /bdag cag rnams ni khyod la gsol 'debs na/ khyod ni rma med bzhin du rol pa 'ba' zhig gis ni rwa yis 'phrug byed de/ /gcig go lta'am yun ring gnas kyang khyod kyi khur yin phrag la long / /zhes pa bris te bya rog gi mgul du btags ste btang / bya rog gis dpal gyi rir gtor steṭa steng du skad sna tshogs bton pas yi ge bkrol te bklags pas dgongs te 'byon bar brtsams pa na ār+yā de was de'i gnyen po nga yin snyam ste slob dpon 'o brgyal bdag gis 'gro bar zhu byas pas brtag pa'i phyir slob dpon gyis nang pa dang ār+ya de was phyi pa'i cha bzung brtsad pas kyang slob ma rgyal/ slob dpon gyis phyi pa dang slob mas nang pa bzung ste brtsad pas kyang slob ma rgyal/ slob dpon phyi rol pa'i gzhung la 'dris drags ༄pas mu stegs dngos su 'khrul te mu stegs ngan pa de khyer zhes lham bu chung 'phangs/ dran pas zin nas khyod kyis mu stegs kyi 'du shes byung ba yin pas gshegs pa mi dgos/ lam gyi mu stegs rnams thul mig la ma chags par gyis shig gsungs/ lam du nags kyi lha mo na re slob dpon gyi spyan legs zhes rjes su 'brengs pa na 'o na khyod khyer zhes spyan ya gcig /447

byin/ nā lan+d+rar byon tshe shing tshong bar brdzus te yo byad shing khur gyi gseb tu bcug nas byon pas thar/ nang gi khron pa tsam ma gtogs chu thams cad bkag pas dge 'dun 'tshog tshe chu gser gyi zho la bteg pa'i na ra do do gtod pa la gzhan rnams zhal 'khru ba tsam las mi yong yang slob dpon gyis phyag dang gdong bkrus nas chu slar gtad/ lo tshigs dris pas lo lnga brgya lon gsungs/ klu sgrub yin nam byas pas min zer ār+yā de wa yin nam byas pas yin zer bas thams cad dgyes te rol mo bsgrags/ garnyi'i sgra las kyang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gyis mchod pa/ /ma la yar skyes tsan+dan rgyu las byung / /rin chen gaspyi tog tog 'di brdungs pas/ /mu stegs 'chal pa rnams kyi glad pa 'gems/ /ces grag pas mu stegs rnams yid ma bde/ kho chu sbyin byed pa na slob dpon gyis kyang chu gtor/ ci byed zer ba la slar dris pas pha mes shi ba la ster zer/ nga yang kaX ru na slob dpon gyi ldum ra skam pa la gtor byas pas/ ke rur skam pa la 'di nas gtor bas ci phan zer/ pha mes sngon shi ba la da lta chu byin pas ci phan byas pas brdugs/ mgo rlum ga las 'ongs pa mgo blum ske las 'ongs dang / ske can mgo blum ga las 'ongs la lam nas 'ongs dang / lam ga las 'ongs la de lam la dris shig gis brdugs/ them pa la zhon nas da phyi nang gang du 'gro dang bye'u bar bar bcug nas shi'am gson zer ba la de khyod kyi rkyen la rag las kyis brdags/ kho khrus byed pa na slob dpon gyis kyang bum pa zhig nang mi gtsang rin ༄bas bkang nas phyi bkrus pas nang mi gtsang bas bkang nas phyi bkrus te ci byed zer ba la khyod kyang des ci byed kyis brdugs/ dpang po phyi pa nang pa gnyi ga 'dzin pa gsum gsum ste dgu bzhag nas rtsod/ gang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la pham pa thams cad 'jug par byas/ gang ma nyan pa rgyal pos lce gcod par byas/slob dpon gyis kho'i mgo thog tu lham skrad btags/ byi la gcig ne tso'i gzuṭa 1418

gsod pa la goms su bcug snum gyis zhal ba byugs/ skyes pa gcer bu dbang po las su rung ba zhig rnams brdogs/ kho na re mig gcig pa 'di ci 'dra zer ba la slob dpon gyis/ /brgya byin mig stong ldan yang de nyid mthong ba mid/ /drag po mig gsum ldan yang de nyid mthong ba med/ /ār+ya de wa mig gcig po ni gang yin des/ /chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin de nyid gsal bar mthong / /zhes gsungs pas lan ma byung / 'di'i lan thob ces ne tso btang byung ba byi las bsad/ khyed sangs rgyas pa mi 'tshe ba chos su smra'am/ smra byas pas/ 'o na ne tso bsad pa rang gis pham/ sring mo gaṅga'i lha mo dang dpal gyi ri na dge slong bzhis sdig pa sbyang gi yod/ khyed sangs rgyas pa las byed pa po la smin par 'dod pa ma yin nam/ yin/ 'o na de rnams kyis sdig pa sbyangs kyang khong rang gi byang mod/ 'o na byi las ni tso bsad pa byi la la 'byung mod/ pra ṇa paṇ+ḍi ta skyar byung ba snum byugs pas yi4 ge ma byung / sring mo byung ba skyes pa gcer bu thon pas ngo tsha nas4 yal/ lham skrad btags pas dbang phyug 'jug ma nus/ phyis khos lham skrad bor bas zhugs te brtsad pas mthar shin tu phra bas dpal mos kyang ma go ste tshar bcad/ khos mig gsum nas me phyung bas slob dpon gyis zhabs la spyan bcu gnyis sprul nas mnan pas kho 'gyel te brgyal/ sangs pa dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du 'bros so snyam nas dbang phyug gi mthus nam mkha' la bros/slob dpon gyis kyang ded de de yan la rlung spu gri'i reg pa can bya ba thams cad dum bur byed pa yod pas ma 'khro yid ma 'ches na skra'i la ba chod la skyur gsungs nas khos de bzhin byas bas phye mar song ste bab byung / da dung cung zad song ba na ral gri phyor gsungs pas lcags kyi phye mar song / 'dis snying rjes khyad par du 'phags par 'dug snyam nas dad pa thob par kha cig 'chad/de nas bzung ste khrid pas kho rang ni nang par ma zhugs pas rgyal pos lce bcad 1449

de lha khang zhig tu btson du bcug gzhan thams cad nang par zhugs/ khos lcib pa'i phyir glegs thag bkrol pas shog gu zhig lhung ba mi g.yo ba'i yi ge bcu pa'i sgrub thabs mthong bas sngags thung 'di 'dra la phan yon 'di 'dra gar 'ong snyam tshe lder tsho zhig gis khyod da dung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yid ma 'ches sam zhes thal lcag bsnun pas brgyal/ sangs tsam na mdun na shog bu 'ga' zung 'dug pa bklags pas pha khol lung bstan gyi mdo bya ba kho rang gis smon lam log pa dang phyis bstan pa'i gsal byed chen por 'gyur ba'i lung bstan 'dug ste the tshom skyes nas nges par sangs rgyas pa bden na bdag gi lce sngar bzhin sos pa dang mu stegs bden na mi sos par gyur zhig ces smod bor bas de nyid du lce sngon bzhin sos pas dad pa rang dbang med par skyes te sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo//gsum la rtag tu bdag phyag 'tshal/ /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen bzhi sku gsum grub/ /rnam rtog mi mnga' thams cad sa le mkhyen/ /chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes skur ldan/ /sangs rgyas dpag bsam 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang / /chos la skye 'gag med cing spros pas dben/ /de la dmigs na yon tan kun 'grub pa/ /legs rgyu dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gnyen pos rim par bsal nas sangs rgyas sar zhugs pa/ /sems can don mdzad sangs rgyas zhing sbyong ba'i/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sogs dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa shugs 'byung du brtsams/ nalan+d+ra nyid du mkhan po dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal dang slob dpon nor bzang las bsnyen par rdzogs zhes grags pa ltar na dze ta ri snga ma zhig byung bar snang la/dkon mchog 'bangs su mtshan btags dpal gyi rir klu sgrub yab sras la mdo 1450

sngags rgams cad gsan/ lan gcig pus 'khyud bcings te chos nyan pas 'phaṭa pas de lta bu mi rung gsungs pa na nga 'dra ba'i nga rgyal la chos nyan yang mi shes pa snyam ste shin tu ngo tsha zhing nga yang 'di 'dra na gzhan lta ci smos snyam nas bla ma lnga bcu pa brtsams par grags/ bstan pa la gnod pa byas pa'i bshags par bstan bcos mang du rtsoms shig gsungs pas sangs rgyas la skur pa btab pa'i gnyen por bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa dang skyes rabs/ chos kyi bshags par chos kyi sku la bstod pa/ dge 'dun kyi bshags par bla ma lnga bcu pa dang rtsa lhung gi sdom/ rgyu 'bras spangs pa'i bshags par sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa chen po/yan lag brgyad pa la 'jug pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po/ yan lag brgyad pa bsdus pa rnams mdzad/ khyad par snying po bsdus pa rtsom tshe/ sa gsum dge legs 'byung ba yi/ /dge ba'i ltas ni sna tshogs byung / /zhes klu yul du 'od sna tshogs kyi sprin chags pa/ de las bdud rtsi'i char 'bab pa/ shing 'bras dus min du smin pa ste gsum/ lha yul du rgyal mtshan g.yo ba/ de las 'od 'phro ba/ me tog gi char 'bab pa gsum/ mi yul du sa g.yo ba/ ut+pala'i char 'bab pa/ dug gi me tog rnyings pa/ gser gdugs rang bzhin gyis 'khor ba/ dung rnams rang sgra 'byin pa/ shing gi bcad mtshams nas 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi 'byung ba/ rdza rnga las sngags sgra 'byung ba/ dkon mchog rten rnams mdangs dang ldan pa/ nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis shis pa brjod pa dang bcu gnyis ste bco brgyad byung / ste ga lar tsan+d+ra go mi bye ma las bzhengs pa'i sgrol ma'i drung du bzhugs tshe tsu ta rkang gcig pa'i yul gyi mi gnyis bar du 'phrul 'khor bcug ste mgyogs par 'gro bas khyer te yul der slebs/ shing srin bus zos pa'i rjes yi ger yod pa la rdor gcod dang sdud pa tshang bar 'dug pa la mchod/ der gzhan don mi nus pas sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas 1451

mnal sad tshe yul dbus su byon/ ngo mkhyen pa thams cad 'das pas nags su bzhugs pa'i tshe stag mo la sku lus btang bas skyes rabs 'phror lus/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs blo gros bkra ba/ a sho ka ces kyang bya zhing /dpal chen dge ba ni khyim na bzhugs pa'i mtshan du 'dod pa dang yab kyi mtshan du 'dod pa gnyis snang yang zla zer las/ bdag gi mes por gyur pa ni/ /dpal chen dge ba zhes bya ba/ /de ni da lta'ang sa gsum na/ /grags pa dri medasgrog par byed/ /ces pa ltar na dngos kyi mtshan du rigs la/ mu stegs kyi dus ral pa can/ skra'i la ba can/ nang par gyur nas chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs/mar me mdzad/ dpa' bo/ 'bum ṭīka mkhan po/ daXṣ+ṭa sa na/ bkod ma 'dzin pa/ bde mchog mi g.yo ba/ sgrol ma ste slob dpon lha gsum pa zhes soṭa mang du grags so/ /slob dpon ār+ya de was de lta bu'i ston pa chen po btul te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba mdzad/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa dang lag pa'i tshad/gtan tshigs grub pa/ ye shes snying po kun las btus pa/ spyod bsdus sgron me/bdag byin rlabs/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong / gdan bzhi yab bka' yum bka'i sgrub thabs/ shing gcig dka' 'grel sogs mdzad la/ 'phags pa min la 'phags pa'i ming / zhes pa'ang ming 'dogs dus 'phags pa ma yin pa la dgongs kyi phyis grub thob chen po bzhi la spyir rta skad can gyi gnyen por li tsā khri dri med grags pa dang rgyal sras lag na pad+mas smon lam btab par grags pas klu sgrub yab sras ni de dag gi ngo bor khums so/ /'phags pa li khar shing 'phel na gtong ba mdzad dus rgan rgon gnyis la gser mang du gnang bas rgan pos nye gnas byas chos nyan pa tshe 'phos nas klu'i byang chub tu 'khrungs pa yin te mkhas grub zla med par gyur nas tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes te dpal gyi ri la da lta'ang bzhugs la gsang 'dus dkyil chog dang rim lnga'i 'grel pa sorges mdzad/ bla 1452

ma dag ma he'i rwa sgom du bcug pa de yin gsung yang de ni slob dpon shaṇi pa bya ba yin par paṇa chen nags rin gyis gsungs te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub bal por shing kun la bya ba mdzad dus slob ma zhig shes rab shin tu chung bas dmiṭa pa ci bstan yang ma zin pas thugs skyo ste 'o na mgo la ma he'i ra skyes par sgoms ang gsungs pas de zin nas bsgoms pas slob dpon byon tshe rwa brag phug la 'thogs par mthong bas ldang ma shes pa na dmigs pa brtan par dgongs te mnyes nas rwa mgo la thim par sgoms shig gsungs te da migs pa nyung ngu zheg bstan/ slob dpon gyis bcud len gyi chu grub nas ril bu byas te bkye ba na gzhan rnams rtsis chen byed cing 'dug des dpral pa la reg tsam byas te 'phangs so/ /slob dpon gyis de'i rgyu dris pas nga slob dpon gyi gdams ngag las grub pa thob pa yin/ de 'dra ci dgos bya yis chu dang snod lta gon mdzod zer bas slob dpon gyis rdza mang po chus bkang pas khos lhung bzed du dri chu btswags pa thigs pa re blug pas grub pa'i dngul chur gyur te slob dpon gyis klu sgrub phug par gter du sbas/ phyis dzo gi zhig gis rdo rje gdan nas kha byang rnyed de bal po zhig la gnas tshang byas/ klu bsgrubs te phug pa 'di na nor mang po yod zer 'don no zhes gnas po khrid de phug par phyin pas phugs na chu gting zab pa cig 'dug pa la sbrul gyi zam pa byung ste phyin pas snod chus gang ba mang du 'dug pa nas chu lhung bzed gang khyer phyis de'i thigs pa gcig zangs la lhung ba gser du gyur pa shes te gnas pos chu sbas te khyim la me spar te gser 'gyur byas dge ba rgya chen po bsgrubs la 'di paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i lo brgya'i sngon tsam yin par gsungs/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis spyod bsdus sgron me'i 'grel pa mdzad pas 'phags pa lha'i slob ma yin pa snyam/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa 'od gzhan rnams 'phags pa'i dngos slob tu 'chad/ bka' bzhi rgyud pa'i lo 1453

rgyus las klu sgrub mya ngan las 'das nas lo lnga brgya nas 'khrungs pa dang 'phags pa lha'i slob mar 'chad/ tshig gsa'/ du/ klu sgrub dgra gcan zin ni bzang po'i zhal snga dang bcas lhas kyang gsungs rjes su/ /'brengs pas de yi tshul lugs dus ni yun ring zhig tu gsal bar bstan pa mdzad/ /de yi slob ma bstan bcos de la rnam par 'byed pas rnam nges blo ldan pa/ /rnams kyis mu stegs ma lus pham byas thub mchog bstan pa yun ring bshad/ ces de'i slob ma rnams kyis ces pa las bdag gi bla ma zhes pa lta bu mi snang ngo / /slob dpon zla ba grags pa ni lho phyogs so ma nar 'khrungs/ skye ba lnga brgyar paṇ+ḍi tar gyur/ 'jam dpal gyis rjes su bzung bas zla med pa'i mkhas par gyur/ bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel pa dang gtso bor nyi zla ltar grags pa gsal ba rnam gnyis zhes pa rtsa she'i 'grel pa tshig gsal dang gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal mdzad/ nā lan+d+rar bzhugs te de na paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya po thams cad sems tsam pa yin/ slob dpon gcig po dbu ma thal 'gyur ba yin/ lan gcig khyams stod na mar byon pas rdo'i ka ba la dbu thug pas khong rnams na re/khyod chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa yin zer ba ka ba dang mgo rang bzhin med par bya mod zer bas ka ba ga re gsungs nas phyag g.yugs pas nyi zhur la bya ba bzhin du song / yang char drag chen pos dge 'dun gyi ma he mo rnams naṭa la 'thor te 'o ma drang du ma byung ba na khong rnams na re/ khyod snang sems 'di thams cad yang dag ma yin pa la yin par snang ba yin zer ba ri mo'i ba yang de lta bu yin pas 'o ma 'jos shig zer bas yang ri mo'i ba las 'o ma bzhos te dge 'dun la drangs/ cho 'phrul 'di dag gis paṇ+ḍi ta mang po dbu ma bar btul bar gdon mi za'o zhes kho bo sems so/ /slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi ni paṇ+ḍi ta tsan+d+ra bya ba zhig mu stegs chad lta ba zhig 1454

dang rtag tu rtsod pas paṇ+ḍi tas tshe snga phyi yod pa'i sgrub byed dang / khos med pa'i sgrub byed bkod kyang mnyam po las ma byung bas ngas skye ba phyi ma dngos su bstan gyi/ de yang zla ba phyi ma la nga shi nas ba ren+d+ra'i grong du paṇ+ḍi ta chos khol bya ba'i bur skye nga yin pa'i rtags su smin mtshams su rme ba zla ba lta bu yod pas ming yang zla bar 'bod pa zhig 'ong lo bdun na rtsod pa bya'o zhes byas te de ltar byung ba'i skyes ma thag du yum 'o ma brgyal lam byas pas mas kha rog sdod byas pas ma'i ngag nyan pas ci yang ma smras/ mtshan zla bar btags/ phyis dge 'dun gyi phyag mi len gral mgor mi bzhugs pa'i phyir go mi'i dge bsnyen du bzhugs pas tsan+d+ra go mir grags so/ /mu stegs des sgra'i bstan bcos chen po bkrugs pa zhig pha la bskur nas 'di'i 'grel ma shes na phyi par 'jug dgos so zer/ de ma go nas paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan la 'dri ba dang phyi rol pa la rngan pa gtad nas dris kyang ma shes/ dpe cha bzhag dka' gnas bzung nas 'drir song ba bus 'phrigs te dpe cha bltas nas gong 'og tu tho btab ste bzhag pha log nas dpe cha bltas pa tsam gyis shes te 'dir su byung dris pas su yang ma byung bu glen pa ngas lta zhing 'dug zer/ phas dris pas ma la mdzub mo'i brda byas/ mas smros shig mi smra ba ci yin byas pas ma'i ngag nyan pa yin zer/ zla ba phyi ma'i nya la rtsod pa'i tshe bu chung gis nga pang par zhog la rtsod du chug zer bas 'di dang rtsod cig byas pas bus ba chung ngu 'dis nga'i rtsod zla mi yong zer ba la khye 'us/ mar me chung yang mun pa sel/ /lcags kyu chung yang glang po 'dul/ /byis pa chung yang mu stegs 'dul/ /sngon 'di ltar dam bcas pa ma yin nam/ zhes gsungs pa tsam gyis spobs pa lan med du gyur te mu stegs thams cad nang par bcug ba rerji' rgyal pos kyang bkur te bu mo byin/ phyis bran mos jo mo tā re zhes bos pa na yi dam dang mtshan gcig pas mi rung bar shes te bzod par gsol ba na rgyal 1455

pos 'o na gaṅgā la skyur zhig zer nas bskyur/ slob dpon gyis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas gaṅgātī nang du gling chags par bzhugs te tsan+d+ra gling zhes par grags/ nya pas bsgral te rgyal po'ang dad de bla mar bkur/ phyis nā lan+d+rar slob dpon zla grags chos gsung ba'i sar gdugs gcig bsnams nas byon pas slob dpon gyi gsung nas pha gi nga la rtsod pa byed pa zhig yin par 'dug chos ci shes dris shog gsungs te dris pas/ sgra pā ṇi dang bstod pa brgya lnga bcu pa 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gsum shes zer bas mkhas pa chen por rig nas nā lan+d+ra pa thams cad kyis phyir byon zhig zer nas slar dpag tshad nas bsus te de'i tshe rab tu byung ba mang pos gsu ba nga dge bsnyen gyis blang bar mi rigs pas gsu ba dkon mchog la 'bul snyam pas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku zhig shing rta la bzhugs slob dpon nyid kyis rnga yab g.yob cing bstod pa mdzad pas sku gzugs des dbu yon por byas nas gsan pa byung bas 'jam dbyangs mjing yon gyi bstod pa zhes 'dzam gling gi bstod chen bzhi'i gcig tu grags/ slob dpon zla grags dang rtsod tshe de ring gi lan sang btab pas 'di la 'dri sa zhig yod par 'dug snyam nas zla grags kyis gsan du byon pas khrarla pā ṇa'i lha khang na thugs rje chen po'i sku des mchog sbyin bshig nas mdzub mo ker zhing 'chad pa gsan/ sa bcu'i byang sems la'ang nye ring 'di 'dra sna'adug bsams nas 'phags pa nye ring ma mdzad zhus pas gsung 'phro chad/ mdzub mo ke re lus pa la gsol ba btab pas thugs rje chen po mdzub ker gyi bstod pa zhes bstod chen gcig tu grags/ tho rengs mnal lam du byon te dge slong zhig dang nged gsum sems lhan cig tu bskyed cing khos nga bsgrubs pa yin/ khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha ni 'jam dpal lo gsungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyis theg chen gyi bstan bcos mang du rtsoms shig gsungs pas zla ba sgron ma'i 'grel pa dang sku gsum la 'jug pa sogs mang du 1456

mdzang/ slob ma rgyal rigs kyi dge slong zhig babs nas sdig pa spyod pa 'dul phyir slob spring / sgra tsan+d+ra pa yan lag dang bcas pa mdzad nas btul/ slob dpon zla ba grags pas sgra mdo kun tu bzang po ces pa tshigs bcad legasu pa zhig mdzad pa gzigs te rang gi bstan bcos la ngo tsha nas khron par bskyur bas khron pa la rtag tu zloja' zug chu 'thungs tshad nad zhi zhing shes rab 'phel bas tsan+d+ra khron par grags/ spyan ras gzigs kyis khyod kyis lhag bsam gyis byas pa gzhan la phan pas khron pa nas phyung la gzhan la ston cig zhes gsungs par deng sang grags la/ rgya gar na grags tshod la tsan+d+ra pa ma dar kun tu bzang po dar bas go mis bdag gi de dar bar zhus pas kun tu bzang po dar 'phro chad de tsan+d+ra pa dar/ der slob dpon zla grags thugs chad nas bstan bcos khron par laphangs pas tsan+d+ra khron pa byung / phyis steng du mchod rten brtsigs par grags yod snang la slob dpon gnyi ga zla ba'i mtshan du ni mtshungs par snang ngo / /yang bram ze dbul po zhig gis slob dpon la nor bslongs pas slob dpon la sbyin rgyu med kyang snying rje chen po skyes te zhal ba'i logs la sgrol ma'i sku cig de nyid tu bris/ de'i 'og tu sgrol ma dpal chen mo la bstod pa bya ba zhig bris pas bstod pa phyed tsam zin dus bris sku'i zhabs kyi 'dub bu'i nor bu zhig 'od che cher gyur nas bstod pa zin pa na nor bu dngos su brul byung ba byin pas dbul pa bsal te bris sku de byin rlabs can du byed skad/ bstod chen gcig ni de bzhin —gshegs pa la lha las phul byung du bstod pa yin la 'di mtho btsun grub rjes mdzad par grags shing khyad par 'phags bstod kyi 'grel pa shes rab go chas mdzad par spun gnyis kyis ti ser dbang phyug gis dgra bcom༄ mchod pa mthong zhing rjes su bstan pa rnams bshad nas de ltar rtogs par gyur te slar rang gi yul du song ste de dag gis gsung rab kyi chos kha na ma tho ba med pa yin par 1457

shes pas rig byed kyi tshig rnams rtswa ltar du dor te rab tu byung nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la khyad par du 'phags par bstod pa dang lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pa gnyis byas so zhes pa tsam las med kyang lha las phul byung gi stod 'grel des mdzad par mtho btsun grub rjes ni khyad par du 'phags pa'i bstod pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod la/ bde byed bdag pos ni lha las phul du byung ba'i bstod pas bstod pa yin no zhes bshad do/ /'grel pa 'di gnyi ga na spun gnyis kho na las spun gsum gyi 'phros mi snang yang che ba gnyis dang po phyi pa la mos pa de 'chad ma 'dod par snang bas spun gsum yod pa rdo rje gdan gyi lo rgyus nyid dag par rdo rje gdan gyi dkar chag las bshad pa dang rdo rje gdan gyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i lo rgyus yid ches kyi tshad ma las shes so/ /bstod chen gcig ni sgrol ma'i bstod pa me tog phreng 'dzin te kha che khri bstan gyi rgyam po rol pa'i rdo rjes rmi lam du lhas bstan pa ltar mchod gtor byas pas mtsho bskams sar gtsug lag khang stobs kyi mthu can brtsigs/ der dge 'dun sum stong gis nyin re dus gsum du mchod pa'i mchod rten gyi gdugs kyi steng na khye'u skyes ma thag pa gzugs bzang ba dar las bkris pa zhig ngu zhing 'dug pas dge 'dun gyis mchod rten gyi rtse nas rnyed pa 'di bkur bar 'os pa zhig 'byung ngo zhes ma ma la gsor bcug slob sbyang byas pas mkhas pa chen por gyur te slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen zhes grags/ des sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rtog pa 'bum pa las sgrub thabs phyung ste bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ yo byad thams cad chags med du gtong bas slob dpon thams cad gtong bar grags/ yo byad zed slong ba mangs pas yul dbus su byon/ lam du bram ze long ba bu dang bu mos khrid pa zhig byung 'di gnyis khyim byed pa la ci yang med pas kha cher slob dpon thams cad sbyin pa la slong du 'gro zer/ 1468

de nga yin zhes mna' bor bas bram ze brgyal/ slob dpon snying rje chen po skyes te lus btsongs nas sbyin par bsams/ rgyal po tshangab/ pas byin gyis rim gror mi brgya dang brgyad sreg pa'i gcig ma longs pa la btsongs te rin du gser ljid mnyam bram ze la byin pas dbul ba bsal/ slob dpon dong du bcug pas da grangs tshang bas myur du sreg 'ong zer nas dong gi mi thams cad nyams thag par ngu ba la snying rje cher skyes nas slob dpon gyis me tog phreng 'dzin gyis sgrol ma la bstod pas sgrol ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i char byung bas dong pad+ma'i rjing bur gyur/ btson rnams gzi 'od dang bcas pas pad+ma'i steng du yer byung bas rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes te btson rnams btang / slob dpon dmag gis bskor ste 'byon mi 'jug par srung ba na sdig spyod kyi 'dun sar thugs skyo ste rang yul du phyin par jo mo la gsol ba btab ste jo mo'i dar dpyangs la 'jus nas mig phye bas kha cher rgyal po gzhan zhig khri steng na 'dug ste khyod rgyal po 'di'i bur skyes ma thag shing grib la bsnyal yod pa 'khor yengs pa la bya rgod kyis khyer te shi nas za bar bsams te mchod rten gyi rtser bzhag pa las khyod rang gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin rang yul du phyin par byas pa yin gsungs/ slob dpon gyis gtsug lag khang gnyis ga'i bdag po dang rgyal po gnyis ga'i mchod gnas mdzad/ phyis kyang sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'di'i sgo nas zhal gzigs mang ste paṇa chen shāspyi'i sku srog bskyabs/ gser srang lnga brgya'i bu lon ma khor bar g.yog byed dgos pa gcig gis slob dpon gyi rnam thar gyis bskor ba'i sgrol ma'i bris sku bzhengs te g.yog byed bzhin bsgrubs pas rmi lam du lung bstan te mu tig gis gang ba'i bum pa rnyed pas bu lon sbyangs shing longs spyod chen por gyur pa la sogs dngos6grub brnyes pa mang du byung ngo / /'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras la gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa zhes bya zhing rgyud 'dzin la sangs rgyas bskyabs dang zla 1459

ba grags pa sogs thal 'gyur ba 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma ḍā/ dang /legs ldan byed sogs rang rgyud pa dang khyad par mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa ye shes snying po dpal sbas zhi ba 'tsho pad+ma'i ngang tshul seng ge bzang po sogs rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu mar 'phags pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'chad do/ /thogs med sku mched byon tshul ni nang pa'i gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra 'gems zhes pa phyi rol pa la gnod par go nas dmag drangs te gsung rab bsregs/ yang cung zad 'phel ba na yul dbus kyi rgyal pos stag gzig gi rgyal po la ras kyi gos srubs med pa zhig bskur ba'i snying gar rkang rjes kyi ri mo lta bu zhig byung bas ngan sngags byas so zhes dmag drangs te snubs/ yang dar ba'i tshe phyi pa'i sprang po gnyis nang pa'i lha khang zhig tu bkur 'ongs pa dkon gnyer gyis khrus chu gtor bas khros te sa'i dong brus par gcig gis nyi ma bsgrubs pas lo bcu gnyis na grub ste cig shos kyis khur te gtsug lag khang du slebs nas mig bltas tshad la me 'bar bas lha khang mang po bsregs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis chos skyong mang du rbad kyang rtags ma byung / phyis rnam sras rta sngon can gyis bsad byung bas chos skyong gi mchog tu bkur skad/ de ltar chos mngon pa la dgra lan gsum dar bas nub cing ston pa 'das nas lo dgu brgya lon pa na bram ze'i dge slong ma gsal ba'i tshul khrims kyis bsams pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba chos mngon pa dgra lan gsum gyica/ nub/ rang yang bud med du song bas dar bar mi nus/ gzhan yang mi snang bas lus la bu skyed de dar bar bya'o snyam nas rgyal rigs dang 'dus pas thogs che/da dang bram ze dang 'dus pas dbyig gnyen byung ste skyes ma thag lce la gi wang gis a bri ba sogs blo rno ba'i cho ga byas te cher skyes pa na blo sbyong gyis la bstan pa dar bar gyib/ shig ces bsgos te gcen gyis ri bo bya rkang du byams pa bsgrubs te lo gsum na rgan pos shing bal gyi lwa bas lcagis kyi sdong 1460

po las khab byed pa dang / drug na chu thigs kyis brag zad pa dang / dgu na bya sgros brag zad pa mthong ste slar yang bsgrubs/ rtags ma byung bas lo bcu gnyis na thon pa na khyi mo dro smad 'bus khyer nas ldang mi nus pa ro stod gzhan la zug pa mthong bas kye ma sem sa can rnams rang 'di ltar sdug bsngal yang gzhan la zhe sdang ba bsams nas snying rje bzod med du skyes te grong khyer nas spu gri g.yar 4brla las sha bcad pa la 'bu mi 'chi ba'i phyir lces blangs te bzhag par 'dod nas mig btsum ste lce brkyangs pas sa la thug mig phye pas khyi med par rje btsun 'od sgor re byon nas 'dug de tsam du zhal mi ston pa thugs rje chung zhus pas nga khyod rang dang ma bral bar yod de sgrib pas ma mthong ba yin/ da lta snying rje chen po skyes pas sgrib pa dag ste mthong ba yin/ yid mi 'ches na gzhan la ston gsungs te rje btsun phrag par bzhugs nas nga'i phrag na ci 'dug ces tshong 'dus su bstan pas gzhan sus kyang ma mthong / rgan mo zhig na re khyi ro zhig 'dug pa zer skad/ der theg chen dar bar zhu 'tshal zhus pas skad cig gis dga' ldago du khrid de lha'i dro skad gcig mi'i lo lnga bcur theg chen gyi sde snod gsan par grags la sa sde'i gna' mchan las zla ba drug gsan zer yang spyir so so'i snang ba tha dad kyis 'jog pa ma 4gtogs dus bden pa med pa dang / dus byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir tshad bzung bar mi bya'o/ /de rnams kyi don bsdus pa'i bstan bcos rtsom par zhus pas byams chos lnga brtsams par seng bzang bzhed la/ gnad kyi zla zer ba sogs bka' bsdus ma thag brtsams par 'dod la/byams chos lnga/ sdom rnam gnyis/ sa sde lnga/ rab byed sde brgyad de byams pa dang 'brel ba'i chos sde nyi shu po thams cad kyang byams pas mdzad par bod snga rabs pa du ma /redod do/ slob dpon slar mi yul du byon te byams chos lnga yi ger bkod pa mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa de nyid rnam nges/ rgyud bla'i 'grel 1461

pa mdo dgongs 'grel gyi 'grel pa/ sa sde lnga/ sdom rnam gnyis sogs mdzad/rgya chen spyod pa'i shing rta'i srol thog mar phye/ lo brgya dang lnga bcur bzhugs te 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ / de'i gcung po slob dpon ba su mi tra dbyig gi bshes gnyen ni sngon rang rgyal mang pos chos mngon pa dar bar smon lam btab cing lung sman gyi gzhi las lhag mthong dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas mal gyi mchog tu lung bstan pa kha che'i yul du byon slob dpon 'dus bzang bsten/ mngon pa sde bdun dang bye brag tu bshad pa sogs gsan pas tshegs med par mkhyen/ rgya gar du byon pas lam du sho gam pa'i gnod sbyin gyi lha rten lan gsum 'phrogs pas zlog kyang chos blo la yod pa dbral du ma btub pas btang / gcen gyis theg chen bstan pa gsan nas/ kye ma thogs med nags su lo/ /bcu gnyis bar du ting 'dzin bsgrubs//ting 'dzin ma grub glang chen gyi/ /rgyab khal longs ba'i grub mtha' brtsams/ /zhes theg chen gyi chos dang gang zag la bstings pa gcen gyis gsan te slob ma gnyis mdo sde sa bcu pa dang blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa gnyis kha thon byed du btang nas srod la bton pas theg chen 'di rgyu bzang la 'bras bu kha g.yel ba 'dra gsungs/ tho rengs bton pas rgyu 'bras gnyis ka shin skyo bzang bar 'dug pa la skur pa btab pa lces lan pas lce gcod gsung ba na gcen gyi drung du gshegs par zhus ste byon/ 'bel gtam mdzad pa na gcung spobs pa myur zhing gcen shin tu bul ba'i lan bzang po byung nas rgyu zhus pas/ khyod skye ba lnga brgyar paṇ+ḍi tar skyes pas spobs pa myur ba yin/ nga la de lta bu med pas rje btsun la zhus shing lan 'debs pa yin gsungs/ rje btsun gyi zhal bstan par zhus pas so skye yin zhing dang por theg chen la skur ba btab pas tshe 'dir mjal ba'i skal ba med theg chen gyi mdo 'brel mang du rtsoms/ skye ba phyi ma la 1462

mjal gsungs/ der nga yi phu bo klu dang 'dra/ /nga ni char 'dod bya dang 'dra/ /klu yi rgyal pos char phab kyang / /bya yi gre bar song ba med/ /gsung zhing theg chen gyi bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa tshig gsal las 'phags pa thogs med sa gsum pa 'od byed pa brnyes kyang dbyig gnyen 'dul ba'i don du sems tsam bstan no zhes pa ltar dang por sems tsam bstan pa'i sgo nas chos nyid la bkri bar mdzad la/ slob dpon gyis kyang sems tsam gyi lta ba la drin du gzo ba'i phyir yum don sems tsam du bkral lo/ gzhan yang sa bcu pa/ blo gros mi zad pa/ ga ya ga ri'i mdo/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs sogs kyi 'grel pa dang / mdo sde rgyan dang chos nyid rnam 'byed kyi 'grel pa sogs mdzad do/ /spyir 'bum sde go dgu thugs la mnga' zhing zangs su 'bru mar gyis sku dbyings nas zhag bdun du zhal thon mdzad do/ /de nas bye brag tu smra ba rim pas kha drang ba'i phyir mdo sde pa'i lta bar gnas shing kha che ba'i lugs la zur za ba mngon ba'i mdzod brtsams nas skyes dang bcas nas kha che 'dus bzang la bskur bas mnyes te 'grel pa mdo dang mthun pa yang mdzad/ 'di'i lo grag zer gsum rnams deng rang gi grub mtha' la zur za'o byas pas khong rtsom pa la mkhas pas tshig gi rgyan yin gsungs/ yang de gsal bar bya phyir mdzod kyi rang 'grel brtsams te bskur bas mkhyen te lan gyi phung po brtsams/ rtsa ba sun 'byin gyi 'grel pa 'di lung rigs kyis tshar bcad la kho rang gsub tu gzhug dgos gsungs nas 'byon par brtsams/ dbyig gnyen gyis kyang de slob dpon yin pas rtsod du mi rung ngo snyam ste rang byung gi mchod rten lta'o zhes bal yul du byon pas bal por ban gzugs chang bum thogs pa gcig gzigs pas rnam rgyal zlog nas bton pas 'das te sku gdung gi mchod rten yod/ kha che 'dus bzang ni 'khor mang po'i dur smrig gi 'o da gis nam mkha' dmar por song bar byon te 1463

yul dbus su 'das/slob dpon dbyig gnyen de la slob ma rang las mkhas pa bzhir grags pa'i mngon pa rang las mkhas pa slob dpon blo brtan ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen bha ga bi har na 'bum sde go dgu zhal thon mdzad tshe phug ron zhig rgyun du nyan pa shi nas mtha' 'khob gra ma bya bar bye'u skyes ma thag nga'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen gang na bzhugs zer bas cher skyes nag yul dbus su bskyal/ slob dpon gyis yi ge'i phyi mo nas bzung rig gnas thams cad bslabs/ chung dus sgrol ma'i sku zhig la sran ma'i phud phul bas zad zad du phul yang brul bas byis pas ngus pa na sku des ma ngu ngas byin gyis brlab bo gsungs/ de nas mkhyen rab zla med par gyur/ rten de la yang sran ma'i sgrol ma zhes grags shing da lta bod na yod pa'i dkon brtsegs le'u zhe dgu po 'di slob dpon gyi thugs la ji snyed bzhugs pa yin par grags shing 'grel pa'ang mdzad skad/ mkhas pa'i phul du phyin te slob dpon yon tan 'od kyi sbyin bdag rgyal po shrī hashis dpal tshos kyi grags pa la da lta su mkhas dris pas/ mkhas par rgyal pos byas pa yi/ /btsun pa yon tan 'od kyang ste/ /bstan bcos kun gyi pod gcig la/ /slob dpon blo gros brtan pa nyid/ /gsungs skad/ des tshad ma kun btus kyi 'grel pa dang mdzod 'grel gnam lcags thog gzer rab byed sde brgyad kyi 'grel pa sogs mdzad/ de'i slob ma gang ba spel yin la de'i slob ma dzi na mi tra dang dā na shrī la sogs yin par grags so/ /phar phyin rang las mkhas pa 'phags pa rnam grol sde ni gtsug lag khang rgya chen po du ma'i bdag po 'phags pa ku ru ku sle'i sde ba'i bdag po slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bangaca/ kyi dbon po yin/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob/sangs rgyas las dngos su yum gsan te yum don dbu mar bkral ba nyi khri snang 1464

ba mdzad/ de'i slob ma dad pa'i sa tshogs lam la gnas pa btsun pa gro'/ sdes nyi khri rnam /'grel mdzad/ de nas mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ yang dag rnam snang mdzad/ de'i slob ma slob dpon seng ge bzang po ni rgyal rigs las rab tu byung rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas/ chos bshes kyis lto bcu bdun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byas shing byams pas rmi lam du rjes su bzung bar 'chad pa dang shes 'byung gis byams pa las mngon rtogs rgyan gsan par bshad pa ltar byams pa bsgrubs pas dge slong gur gum gyi mdog 'dra ba zhig gis bskul ste khrarla pā khor byon/ zhag gsum du bsnyung ba mdzad pa'i tho rengs sprin gseb nas rje btsun zhal gser ca/dog spyi gtsug mchod rten gyis spras pa chos 'chad can zhig gis 'grel pa rnams kyi 'thad pa bsdus la khyod kyis rtsoms shig gsung ba gsan/ rgyal po dharma pā las sbyin bdag byas to tshab gsum pa'i gtsug lag khang du yum don rgyas par 'grel pa nyi khri le brgyad ma dang brgyad stong 'grel chen/ 'bring du 'grel pa 'grel pa don galal/ bsdus par 'grel pa sdud 'grel rtogs sla ba dang shes phyin sgom pa sogs mdzad/ slob dpon gyi dngos slob las 'grel pa don gsal la chos kyi bshes gnyen gyis 'grel pa tshig gsal mdzad de 'ge/la byed snga ma bzhi'i mthu las 'grel nga/ra bshad pas chos bshes kyi 'jam pa'i bshad pa zer/ nub kyi sgo glegs pa shes 'byung blo gros kyi bsdus don las snga ma bzhi las lhag par 'chad par bkral bas shes 'byung gi rtsub bshad zer/ gser gling pas 'grel par sngon yang byung bdag gis kyang 'grel zhes pa ltar bkral pas gser gling pa'i btang stoms kyi bshad par graṭa shing sangs rgyas ye shes kyis kyang sdud 'grel mdzad do/ /'grel byed snga ma rnams kyis yum bar ma nyi khri dang mngon rtogs rgyan sbyar ba las slob dpon gyis/ /la la las don gzhan las tshig /gzhan las rnam grangs ming gis te/ / 1465

zhes pa ltar brgyad stong pa sogab/ las don/ nyi khri las tshig 'bum las mi/nga gi rnam grangs bsdus pas yum thams cad kyi rgyan du bkral pa dang / dbu mar gnas pa dang rje btsun gyis gnang ba byen pa ste gsum gyis mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa'i nang na don gsal 'di rmad du byung ba yin no/ / 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa yon tan 'od ni rgya cher 'grel las/ 'phaṭa pa gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bram ze'i slob dpon btsun pa yon tan 'od bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa bde bar gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba bdud rtsi'i nying khus shes rab kyi dbang po rgyas pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' dam pa nan tan snying por sgrub pa zhes bshad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa des 'dul ba'i mdo rtsa ba dang de'i rang 'grel/ las brgya rtsa gcig pa dang / byang sa'i tshul khrims le'u'i 'grel pa sogs mdzad/ phyis bsod nams grags pa dang zhi ba'i 'od kyi slob ma shākya 'od kyis sum brgya pa rtsa 'grel mdzad/ bod gzhan rnams yon shāka gnyis mchog gnyis dang gzhan drug rgyan drug tu 'dod kyang shes byed med la/ klu sgrub thogs med gnyis mchog dang gzhan drug rgyan drug tu rje chos grags rgya mtsho bzhed pa nyid legs la/ klu sgrub thogs med ni lung bstan mang zhing shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pas mchog tu grub cing mgon po mngon byung gi rgyud kyi lung bstan/ paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa chos kyi grags pa zhes grags pa 'di dang skyes bu drug bstan pa la phan pa tshangasi par spyod pa la gnas pa rnams kyis grub bo/ /zhes pa 'dis rgyan drug thon no/ /des na ār+ya de wa dang dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos grags yon shāka gnyis te drug klu sgrub thogs med de mchog gnyis so/ / tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs kyi glang po ni rigs bram ze gnas ma 1466

bu'i sde pa las rab tu byung / mkhas par gyur te mkhan po la spong ba bsam gtan gyi man ngag zhus pas phung po las de nyid dang gzhan ma yin pa'i bdag sgoms shig gsungs/ de ma rnyed nas mar me spar gcer bur mig bgrad de bdag btsal pas mkhan pos khyod rang gi grub mtha' sun 'byin par 'dug pas song zhig gsungs pas mkhan po de nyid du sun 'byin nus kyang 'os ma yin no snyam nas byung ste slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi drung du theg pa gsum ga la sbyangs/khyad par rnam rig dang tshad ma la mkhas par gyur te mdzod kyi 'grel pa dang yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa'i 'grel pa dang / rigs pa'i sgo dang dmigs pa brtag pa sogs tshad ma'i bstan bcos thor bu pa brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad/ de thams cad gcig tu bsdu bar bzhed de brag phug gi brag ngos la rdo thal gyis/tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ /ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshad ma sgrub phyir rang gi gzhung kun las/ /btus ste sna tshogs 'thor rnams 'dir gcig bya/ /zhes bris pa tsam gyis sa g.yos sgra chen po gragamu stegs kyi ston pa thams cad byin pa shing ltar rengs te mu stegs nag po thub rgyal bya ba'i mngon shes kyis shes nas slob dpon bsod stoms la byon pa'i shul du lan gnyis phyis/ gsurmi pa la 'di dbyi ba ku re yin na dgos pa yod pas ma 'phyed cig phrag dog gis yin na blo la yod pa dbyi mi nus so/ /nodza ba'i blos dbyi na lus snang bar gyis shig dang / brtsod par bya'o zhes bris pas bsdad 'dug pa dang brtsod pas lan gsum du slob dpon rgyal yang bstan pa la 'jug du ma btub/ mthar kha nas me byung ste slob dpon gyi yo byad bsregs pas mu stegs 'di gcig pu'ang ma thul na sems can thams cad ga la zhig rdo thal sa la bab ma thag sems bskyed btang ngo snyam nas 'phangs pas rje btsun 'jam dpal nam mkha' la byon te bu ma byed ma byed theg pa dman dang phrad pa las ni 1467

blo gros ngan skye ste/ khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di la mu stegs tshogs kyis gnod mi nus/ khyod kyis ma thob kyi bar du dge ba'i bshes su nga 'gyur zhing / /phyi ma'i dus su bstan bcos kun gyi mig gcig tu ni 'di 'gyur ro/ ṇazhes rjes su gnang bar grags la/ chos mchog las dben par rang don yid byed kyi blo skyes pa na 'jam dpal byon pa dang kha che dzñā na shrīs khyod kyis sangs rgyas ma thob bar du zhes 'chad do/ /de ltar tshad ma kun las btus rang 'grel dang bcas pa brtsams te mu stegs thams cad tshar bcad do/ /de'i slob ma'i gtso bo paṇ+ḍi ta dbang phyug sdes kun las btus la 'grel pa mdzad do/ / dpal chos kyi grags pa ni lho phyogs rgyal dbang gtsug gi nor bur mu stegs kyi bram zer 'khrungs/ slob par bya ba mtha' dag mkhas par lobs te bram ze'i brtul zhugs len 'dod nas zhang po mu stegs kyi ston pa ma len la yo byad bslangs pas ma byin te bskrad pas mu stegs thams cad tshar gcad par bya'o snyam nas rig pa'i gnas thams cad la sbyangs/ dbang phyug sde la kun las btus tshar gsum du nyan pas dang po la dbang phyug sdes ji ltar go ba ltar go gnyis pa la phyogs glang gis ji ltar degongs pa ltar go ste dbang phyug sde'i 'dod pa nor bar rtogs/ gsum pa la 'bras bu rgyu'i khyad par gyi rjes su byed pa lhag par rtogs te slob dpon la brjod pas shin du mnyes te nga'i nor ba rnams phyoṭa sngar gyis la 'grel pa rtsoms shig gsungs te bran du rdzu ba sogs thabs sna tshoṭa kyis grangs can dang rig byed kyi mtha' gsang bar smra ba la sogs pa mu stegs thams cad kyi gsang tshig blangs te thams cad shes pa na brtsod pas ston pa chen po rnams tshar bcad/ la la yul gzhan du bros/ gzhan thams cad nang par bcug ste/ gal ste chos kyi grags pa yi/ /smra ba'i nyi ma nub pa na/ /chos rnaca/sa gnyid log yang na shi/ /chos ma yin rnams da gdod longs/ /ces 1568

gsungs skad/ grub thob brgyad bcu'i nang du'ang / mu stegs rigs la sgra tshad mkhaso/ /phyir rgol tshar bcad mkha'u la gshegs/ /dharma gīrti ces bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes/ bstod do/ /de la rgyal po me tog rgyas pas 4da lta su mkhas dris pas/ shes rab can ni phyogs kyi glang po ste/ /tsan+da go mi brjod pa rnam par dag /snyan ngag dpa' bo las byung sdeb sbyor mkhas/ /me tog kun du rgyas pa longs spyod ldan/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nga min su//zhes gsungs pas dharma gīrti yin nam zer/ de skad du yang grags gsungs pas sbyin bdag byas te rgyas par 'grel ba rnam 'grel/ 'bring rnam nges/ bsdus pa rigs thigs te gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum/ rtags bye brag tu ston pa gtan tshigs thigs pa/ mu stegs kyis btags pa'i 'brel ba 'gog pa 'brel ba brtag pa/ snang ba sems yin kyang gzhan rgyud 'thad pa rgyud gzhan grub pa/ rtsod tshul ston pa rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste gyes pa yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi ste tshad ma sde bdun mdzad/ rtsom pa'i go rim grub pa'i le'u/mngon sum le'u/ — rang don le'u/ gzhan don le'u ste brjod bya'i go rim de ltar yin kyang tshad ma slob pa na dang por rtags kyi rnam gzhag gal che bar dgongs shing rtogs dka' bar gzigs nas rang don le'u la 'grel pa mdzad pas phyis slob ma rnams kyis rang don le'u thog mar byas so/ /paṇ+ḍi ta lha dbang blo la le'u gzhan gsum gyi 'grel pa rtsom par bskos pa lan gsum pa brtsams pa'i dang po gnyis la ma mnyes/ gsum pa tshig zur gyi nus pa dang 'phros pa'i don rnams ma byung 'dug rung dngos bstan tsam byung 'dug 'on kyang nga'i riṭa pa 'di gzhan gyis ji lta ba mi shes par 'dug ces/ rgya mtsho la ni chu bo bzhin du rang gi lus la thim zhing nub pa nyid du 'gyur/ zhes pa bcug cing bstan bcos rnams phal cher gyis ma shes/ la las phrag dog byas te nyes so zhes bstan 1469

bcos khyi mjug la btags pas khyi kun du rgyu ba bzhin du bstan bcos dar bar 'gyur gsungs nas mnyes/ 'on kyang skye bo phal cher sogs kyi blo ka mgor bcug go zhes grags la/ rigs gzhung rgya mtshor 'di rtsom par dam bcar bzhed do/ /shākya blos 'grel pa gnyi ga bsdoms pa la 'grel pa mdzad/ rnam 'grel grub pa'i le'u ma gtogs pa la shes 'byung sbas pas 'grel pa tshad ma'i rgyan mdzad/rgyal bas byin gyis rgyan gyi 'grel pa dang / rang ngon le'u la dzam ris 'grel pa mdzad/ mngon sum le'u dang gzhan don le'u la nyi ma sbas pas 'grel pa mdzad/rnam 'grel la 'grel pa rjes 'breng ma bram ze bde byed dga' bas mdzad/ rnam nges la chos 'byung byin dang dge srung gi slob ma chos mchog gis 'grel pa dang /ye shes dpal bzang gis 'grel pa dang / dul lhas 'grel pa slob phan mdzad/rigs thigs la'ang chos mchog dang rgyal ba'i lhas 'grel pa mdzad cing yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi ga la dul lhas rgya cher 'grel re mdzad/ bod du ni thog mar bsdus pa/ de nas 'bring / de nas rgyas pa dar te phyi rabs su bstan bcos kun gyi mig gcig por gyur to/ /4 slob dpon zhi ba'i lha ni yul 'khor bzang por rgyal po dge ba'i go cha'i sras su bltams/ chung ngu nas 'jam dpal rnon po grub ste 'jam dpal gyis bskul te nā lan+dar rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung / 'phags pa las dngos su gsan nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa mdzad pas gzhan rnams kyis 'du shes gsum par btags/ gnas nas 'byin pa'i phyir mdo 'don par bskos pas khru bcu gnyis pa'i khri la bzhugs nas sngon ma grags pa thon zhig zer ba ltar spyod 'jug gsungs nas sher le'i/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /zhes pa'i tshe je mthor gyur nas sku mi snang bar gsung grag pas rdzogs par bton/ der paṇ+ḍi ta gzungs thobe pa rnams kyis bsdus pas kha che ba rnams kyis slo ka bdun 1470

brgya dang yul dbus pa rnams kyes stong du byung la/ kha 'phangs pa'i kun btus gnyis kyang ma shes pas slob dpon lho phyogs mchog rten dpal yon can na bzhuṭa par thos te spyan drangs pas ma byon/ spyod 'jug blo ka stong de tshad rmer gyis/bstan bcos gnyis breng khang gi gdung gseb na yod gsung zhing dge slong e la dha ri las byung yang zer/ yang shar phyogs su g.yul ngo chen po cig tu zhugs te skad cig gis dum par mdzad/ dgon pa'i brag phug chen por mu stegs pa lnga brgya gnas pa dang / yang gcig na sprang po stong gnas pa la zhag bdun du yul ngan byung / zam pa kun chus khyer/ slong ma nus par stogs nas 'chi ba la phyoṭa pa 'bras chan lhung bzed re bslangs te byin pas tshim par byas shing chos la bkod/ sdig spyod kyi rgyal po gcig gi blon po mdzad de sdig pa las ldog cing shing gi ral gri'i 'od kyis btul/ mu stegs shaX gar de was nam mkha' la dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis bris pa rlung gis gtor te mu stegs thams cad btul/ bud med myos byed ma zhes pas chang btsongs nas skye bo rnams myos par byed cing khyo mu stegs pa rdzu 'phrul thob pa des myos pa rnams gsod pa na nyi ma gta' mar bcug pas btul/ de ltar bstan bcos rtsom zhing mkha' la gshegs/ byang sems bslab pa mthar phyin pa/ shārta de wa zhes pa des byang sems kyi bslab pa rgyas par ston pa bslab pa kun las btus/ bsdus nas ston pa mdo kun btus/ tshig nyung la don rgyas pa spyod 'jug rnams mdzad cing /bslab btus kyi mngon par rtogs pa gser gling pas mdzad cing mdo kun btus kyi don sdu jo bos mdzad do/ /spyod 'jug la 'grel pa brgya rtsa yod par grags kyang shes 'byung gi 'grel chen sogs bod du brgyad tsam 'gyur ro/ /de la soṭa pa skyes bu dam pa bgrang las 'das pas rgya gar shar/ nub/ dbus/ sto/byang rnams su bstan pa bzung la/ bod dang rgya nag la jo gas par yang de dag 1471

gi rgyud 'dzin las bstan pa byung ba yin no/ /nang rig pa las rgyu mtshan nyid theg pa'i skabs so/ /rdo rje theg pa ji ltar dar tshul la/ nyan thos sed+dhā pa la sogs pa'i ngor ni sngar lung ma bstan lan cig byung / /zhes sogs theg chen bkar sgrub pa'i don bdun nyid kyis gsang sngags bkar sgrub la/ spyir bstan 'gyur na 'dul —ba'i skor po ti nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ mngon pa 'og ma la po ti bcu gnyis dang /gong ma la sa sde ma the ba'i drug byams chos la po ti bcu lhag tsam rnams 'gyur/nyan thos kyi 'dul bar yang/ phan par byed pa'i gsang sngags bzung bar bya'o zhes dug gzhil ba dang sbrul zlog ba'i sngags tsam yang bzung bar gsungs na tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba dang nyon mongs ye shes su byed pa'i gsang sngags cis mi bzung la/ sngags rnams kyi sngags kyi mthu ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo shes yang yang gsungs pas zur gyis bstan pa yin la shes phyin las/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di ni rig sngags chen mo'o sogs kyis ming dang / sor phreng la phan pa'i mdor mi nyis stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba bsad pa de rnams la bstan pa la gnas pa ni 'ga' yang bsad pa med do sogs kyis dgrol ba lam byed dang / bud med 'gyur ba'i mdos sbyor ba lam byed de don zur gyis bstan pa yin no/ /de yang bya rgyud kyi gzungs phal cher ni rang rang gi gleng gzhi'i skabs bzhin ston pas thun mong gi gdul bya la gsungs pa mang la kha gcig gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa'i snang ba yin pa'ang yod do/ /bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen rnams las gsang ba spyi rgyud ni/ gleng gzhi med kyang mjug tu phyag na rdo rje dbang phyug chen pos bstan pa zhes bshad pas phyag rdor gyis gsungs pa yin la/ thog mar/ de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i rgyud/ /ces sogs yod pas rgyud chen po cig gi dum bu zur du bkol bar snang la/ legs grub la sogs pa yang phyag 1472

rdor gyis gsungs pa'o/ /mdor na lha rje bo lta bu las dngos grub len pa bya ba'i rgyud rgyud sngo co nga phrag bzhi ste/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las bya ba'i rgyud stong 'ug bzhi'o zhes so/ /spyod rgyud la rnam snang mngon byang ni/ byang sems don grub longs skur 'tshang rgya ba'i dus kyi chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa las cung zad tsam ste byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyis seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te zhes sogs gsungs la/ phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi rgyud ni kun tu bzang po phyag rdor du ji ltar dbang bskur tshul ston pa'o/ /mdor na lha grogs po lta bu las dngos grub len pa spyod pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgyad do/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' khyab par 'dug ste byang chub sems dpa' don grub la bskul te zla ba rdo rje'i ngo bor byang chub tu sems bskyed nas rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas rdo rje dbyings su mtshan btags te sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kun tu bzang por mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs las rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa la phyag na rdo rjer mngon par dbang bskur te rten brten pa sprul bshad kyi sgo nas sems can gyi khams mtha' dag btul/ slar yang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa drag pos 'dul bar bya ba rnams 'jigs su rung ba'i sku dang sngags dang phyag rgyas btul te dbang phyug sangs rgyas thal ba'i dbang por gnas 'phangs/ slar thugs kyi cha gcig lus la zhugs pa ma hā kā la zhes bstan pa srung bar bskos pa'o/ /gzhan dregs byed thams cad dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te khyab 'jug ni rdo rje sgyu ma dang tshangs pa ni rdo rje thub pa sogs su mtshan btags/ dbang —phyug gis yon du u ma dang brgya byin gyis thig le mchog ma phul ba slar rnam snang la phul te rdo rje sgeg mo dang rdo rje gar mar dbang bskur zhing de nyid bsdus pa dang dpal mchog dang rtse mo sogs rnam 'byor gyi rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis 1473

bstan la ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas ring po ma lon par rgya gar shar phyogs su phyag rdor gyi dngos slob rgyal po rab gsal zla ba byung ste rdo rje dbyings su mngon par dbang bskur zhing / de la dgra gcan zin dang klu sgrub yab sras nas mi yul du dar bar mdzad par gyur la/ de nyid 'dus pa la shākya bshes gnyen gyis 'grel pa ko sā la'i rgyan mdzad/ kun snying gis de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bco brgyad pa dang dpal mchog gi 'grel pa stong phrag nyer bzhi pa dang dkyil chog rdo rje 'byung ba mdzad/ grol ba'i mdzod kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi 'grel pa mdzad/ kun snying gnyis dang ka ma la dhe nus ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel pa mdzad cing sgrub thabs mdzad po mang du byung bas dar zhing rgyas la/ bod du yang bstan pa snga dar la sangs rgyas gsang ba sangs rgyas zhi ba sogs dang phyi dar la lo chen rin bzang gis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de yo ga stod lugs dang / bu dong gi snur nyi ma sogs nas bzung ste snur lugs dang / rtsa skya pa rnams nas bzung ste rtsa lugs ces dar bar gyur la/ phyis bu rin po ches yo ga'i rgyud lag len gyi bstan pa rmang nas bsos kyang deng sang ni cho ga kha cig tsam snang ngo / /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi ming ni stong phrag bcu gnyis te — rgyas par grangs med do zhes gsungs la/ pha rgyud kyi lugs la rnal 'byor chen po tsam mam/ ma rgyud kyi lugs kyis pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis dang / dus 'khor gyi lugs la gnyis med rgyud bsnan ste gsum du yang 'byed la/ de la pha rgyud kyi gshed skor rnams ni bdud btul ba'i dus kyi gdul bya so so'i snang ba yin la/gshed dmar nag dang 'jigs byed rnams bod du ni jo bo dang rwa lo sogs kyis dar bar mdzad do/ /spyir rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings su rdo rje 'chang chen po nam du yang mi phyed par rtag par bzhugs shing rdo rje'i rgyud chen po rnams nam yang mi nub par bstan zhing ston la ston pa rgyun mi chad pa nyid las/ lha'i gnas 1474

dang mi'i yul la sogs pa gdul bya skal ldan gar yod du sprul pa 'i sku dang chos kyi snang ba 'char bas smin grol du byed pa ni chos nyid yin la de las bsang ba 'dus pa ni sngon ston pa bzhugs dus mnyan yod nas dpag tshad sum brgya na o rgyan gyi yul yod de de na rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti gnas pa na dgra bcom pa rnams nam mkha' la 'gro ba mthong ste dris pas sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos su shes nas dad de shar phyogs su phyag dang mchod pa byas pas ston pa 'khor bcas mngon sum du mthong ste gdugs tshod la spyan drangs te srid pa las bsgral du gsol zhus pas rab tu byung zhig gsungs/ 'dod yon ma spangs par grol bar mdzad du gsol zhus pas rten brten pa dang bcas pa'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dngos su dbang bskur zhing rgyud bstan/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis nyams su blangs pas mchog gi dngos grub thob ste yul khams de phal pa'i skye bos stongs par gyur to/ /'di ni ye shes thig le las lung bstan pa'i in+d+ra bhū ti yin la slob dpon pad+ma'i yab dod de'ang yin pa snyam zhing in+d+ra bhū ti gsum las chen po ces bya'o/ /de nas o rgyan gyi yul de mtsho chen po cig tu gyur te phyag rdor gyis klu rnams la rgyud gtad pas mtsho 'gram du sprul pa'i lus kyis grong bcas shing mthar mir gyur te de'i tshe ḍim+bi he ru gas chang tshong ma bai na sa btul zhing des sras lu ba ba bskyed pas rgyal po in+d+ra bha ti btul bar bka' bzhi rgyud pa la grags pa 'di ni in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa ces bya ba bde mchog gi 'grel pa mdzad pa po ka ma pa la'am lwa ba ba zhes pa yang rgyal po'i bla ma 'di'o/ /de nas ci zhig na drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin zhes bya bas rgyal po'i sras mo lha mo rol pa chen mo grub pa la bkod/ de nas rim bzhin rgyal po dpa' bo rdo rje/ mdun na 'don dam tshig rdo rje/ zhing pa pad+ma'i rdo rje/ chang tshong ma lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje/ tha ga pa dga' ba'i rdo rje/ bram ze mo rdo rje/ 'breg mkhan grub pa'i rdo rje/ dpal 1475

ldan kun 'gro'i mgon po/ rnal 'byor pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ lcam la dhi chen mo/des rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti rjes su bzung rgyal po de a wa dhu ti ba mdzad pas lwa ba par grags par lhan cig skyes grub rtsa 'grel las bshad pa ni in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba ste gsum pa'o/ khyad par du dri ma med par grags pas thestan pa'i mdor gsungs pa li tsā we dri ma med par grags pa de nyid gnas gtsang gi lha'i rnam pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa byang chub sems dpa' blo gros zin chen du bstan te des sa ra ha dang klu sgrub rjes su bzung nas de las dar ba ni gsang 'dus 'phags skor zhes bya'o/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje'am dpal sna tshogs gzugs zhes bya bas kyang gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa nye bar len pa la sogs pa mdzad cing bi shā mo tras kyang de'i rjes su 'brengs te mdzad do/ /'di ni sgeg pa'i rdo rje snga ma ste bod du bstan pa byung ba'i sngon du byon pa dam tshig gsal bkra mdzad po yin la/ phyi ma ni dze ta ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba 'jam dpal las dngos su chos mtha' dag gsan pa des lo brgya lon pa na tshe tshad lo bcu las med pas nga'i chos nams sgod ldan la byin zhig gsungs pa na 'dzam gling la lan gsum gzigs pas ma ga dhan ma he'i rdzi bo lo brgyad bcu lon pa cig sdod ldan du gzigs nas las 'di zhog las chos sgor zhugs shig gsungs pas/ yi ge yang mi shes 'tsho ba'ang med/ rgas pas tshe phyi ma la rjes su 'dzin par zhu zer ba la/ 'jam dpal dkar po'i sgrub thabs gnang ste zhag bdun bsgrubs pas 'jam dpal zhal gzigs/ chos thams cad rang byung du shes pa'i paṇ+ḍi tar gyur te blo gros can nam paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti zhes grags/ 'khrungs sa'i ming gis nor bu gling pa dang / gsang mtshan sgeg pa'i rdo rjer grags/ da rgas pas bshad pa mi khom sgrub pa byed zhus pas khyod rang gi tshe lhag lo bcu yod pa dang / nga'i tshe lhag lo brgyad yod pa 1476

khyod la byica gyis lo bco brgyad 'gro don gyis/ de nas rje btsun 'a gsol ba thob dang tshe nyi zla dang mnyam yang srid gsungs te slob dpon mkha' spyod du byon par 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i lo rgyus las bshad pa'i dze ta ri 'di ni na ro pa paṇ+ḍi ta mdzad nas byang sgo srung ba'i dus kyi sgo srung cig yin la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i bu ma slob kha che paṇa chen yin no/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes ni slob dpon seng ge bzang po las mkhas par sbyangs/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje las rnal 'byor rgyud man dang rnal 'byor ma gu ne+e ru las bla med mang du gsan/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gdol ba'i bu mor bstan pas rjes su bzung ste dzam+bha la grub/ dzā lad+dhā rar slob dpon byis pa chung ba'i zhabs la ma rgyud du ma mnyan/ yu'/ kaX ko na zhes nam mkha' la nags tshal 'khrigs pa na slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob losrung ba'i zhabs zhes pa thabs rgyud la mkhas pa bram ze tsa dra ra la sogs slob ma rdzu 'phrul can mang pos bskor ba — thams cad kyi 'tsho ba nor rgyun mas nyin re zhing sbyor ba/ de la lo dgur bsten te skyed rim gyis skye ba gcig gis thogs par grub cing zla ba bco brgyad du spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad/ de kho na nyid rtogs par bya ba'i ched du rdo rje gdan gyi rgyab ku pa dza'i nags gcan gzan gdug pas gang bar bzhugs te 'gro ba rnams bdag 'dra bar gzigs te zla ba drub tu lha gnad la bor ba na slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byon te de yang khang chung du ba can zhig gi phyi na btsun rgan 'ban po sham thabs bye ba chos gos la thod byas nas zhing rmo zhing rol du 'bu mang po dmar nyog gis 'chi ba/ chung ma rgan mo mi sdug pa cig dang khyi mo nag mo mtshan ma dkar ba dang bcas pa gzigs te the tshom skyes pa na btsun rgan des dge slong 'di la dro drongs shig zer nas nang du khrid de chu mig zhig 'dug pa nas chu dang nya mang po bcus te btsos nas snod du byung ba la khyi mo des 'o ma /477

skyugs nas blug ste byin pa ma zos pa na btsun rgan de byung nas da 'o na khrus la byin zer te slar 'bras btsos te byin/ zos zin pa na nam mkha' la 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sprul nas nga dang 'di gang la mos gsungs ba na dkyil 'khor la mos par zhus pas slob dpon dang 'khor gnyis kyang nang du song ba na gzhan mi gnang bar khang pa cig lam byung ba'i nang du phyin pas 'jam dpal rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pas dbang bskur zhing rjes su zhal lung gsungs pas de kho na nyid rtogs shing zas ma zos pa dang sprul pa la bdam pas tshe 'dir zung 'jug gi sku mi 'grub ste bar dor mchog 'grub pas bstan bcos mang du rtsoms shig gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /der slob dpon gyis sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po la sogs pa lung gis zin pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad/ slob dpon tshogs su chos gsung ba na slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ban hrul du byon pa la phyag ma mdzad/ dben bar phyag mdzad pas da ci ci'i phyir mi byed gsungs/ ma mthong ngo zhus pas mthong bzhin du ma mthong zhes smra na mig lhung bar gyur cig ces gsungs pas spyan 'bras gnyis sa la lhung / slar spyan 'bras bcug ste nyin mtshan gnyi gar mthong ba lha'i mig byin/ slob ma'i mchog bco brgyad byung zhing mar me mdzad bzang po la sogs pa bzhi tshe de nyid la grub cing sman pa'i zhabs kyis zhal lung gi 'grel pa sogs mdzad/ tha ga nas mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / shārti pa'i 'grel pa snyim pa'i me tog yang ye shes zhabs lugs yin la rjes 'breng gis mdzad pa ni shin tu mang ngo / /slob dpon rkun snying gis gsang 'dus kyi 'grel chen po ti drug tu longs pa mdzad/ 'phaṭa skor dang ye shes zhabs lugs gnyi ga lo chen dang smri te dang gtso bor mar pa chos kyi blo gros dang 'gos khug pa lha btsas las brgyud de bod yul du ches dar bar gyur to/ / 1478

bde mchog gi phyogs la rang bzhin gyi gnas su long4sku rgyu'i he ru gas chos ston pa rgyun mi chad pa nyid las sprul sku 'bras bu'i he ru gar bzhengs tshul ni/ rtsod ldan gyi thog ma'i tshe lha chen po dbang phyug zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sku bzhis ri rab kyi rtse dang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed sogs su btsun mo bzhi dang rtag tu rol bas gnas shing / de'i tshe bar snang nas lha dang dri za bzhi/ sa steng nas gnod sbyin dang srin po bzhi/ sa 'og nas klu dang lha min bzhi ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'khor du byung ba la pukhri ra ma la ya sogs yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi bgos nas byin/ brgyad tshan re zhing mkha' spyod/ sa spyod/ sa 'og spyod pa'i gnas su grags/ rdo'i liṅga mgo'i dbyibs can sogs re re byin te de la mchod cing phra men ma mgo brnyan can bzhi dang mi'am ci mo phyed mdog can bzhi ste brgyad la dur khrod brgyad byin te 'dod pa'i khams stongs pa tsam du za bar byed la de ni gdul bya'i he ru /'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid ri rab kyi rtser 'khor lo sdom par bzhengs pas dbang phyug dang u ma brdzis te dbang phyug sa 'og tu sangs rgyas la mi skyod pa sogs rigs lngas gzhal yas khang dang / kun bzang nas bzang skyong gi bar sems dpa' nyer bzhi dang rdo rje pho nya mo dang tsun+da sogs nas gtsug tor ma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed ma'i bar lha mo nyer bzhi po rnams thod dum dang rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo dang 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang go ri sogs khro bo yab yum brgyad kyis sgo ma bzhis khru men ma bzhi 'dul phyir yab gdong brnyan du sbas shing mtshams ma bzhis yab phyed mdog du spas te gdul bya'i ming dang cha lugs ji lta bar bsgyur ba'i 'khor dang mchod pha'i lha mo bcu gnyis dang go cha'i lha dang skye mched kyi lha rnams so sos sprul te phul nas gdul bya rnams thim longs spyod bdag po gsum gyis 'tshang rgya bar byed pa na gdul byed kyi he ru ga'o/ /de ltar gnas yo byad 1479

gyon cha srog sngags sogs thams cad ye shes kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs ste rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag gsum pa dang mngorno ba'i brjod pa 'bum pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'bum pa dang nyung ngu'i rgyud dang 'bum phrab/ sum bcu so drug gi tshad can mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang / de dang tshad mnyam pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho sdom pa rgya mtsho dbye ba rgya mtsho de nyid rgya mtsho ste rgya mtsho drug la sogs pa gsungs shing bka' bsdu ba po rnams kyis bsdus te phal cher mkha' 'gro'i phyag na bzhugs pa yin la/ rgyud bsdus pa rnams shākya'i rgyal pos sngon byung bskyar ba'i tshul du gsungs pa'o/ /slar phyag na rdo rje dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros sa ra ha dang klu sgrub la gsungs shing rtsa rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa/ skyed rim ston pa mngon brjod bla ma/ skyed rdzogs gsal bar byed pa sdom 'byung / thun mong gi bshad rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'go phyogs mthun he ru ka mngon byung dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang rnal 'byor mthun sbyor dang a ra li la sogs pa spyan drangs nas dar zhing gtso bor lo nag dril gsum gyis rgyas par mdzad de te lo na ro chos 'di'i bdag por gyur la/ de dag gi rnam thar ni bka' bzhi rgyud par 'chad do/ /bod tu'ang lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po dang jo bo rje dang pham ting ba dang / mar do chos dbang dang / lo chung grags 'byor shes rab rnams kyis dar rgyas su mdzad la pu rangs lo chung ni mkha' spyod dngos su grub bo/ /spyir rtsa rgyud kyi stod 'grel phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa dang / lu ba pa'i dka' 'grel dang / lha sbas dang rgyal ba bzang po dang ta thā ga ta ragī ta dang /in+d+ra bo dhi dang / rgyal dka' zla ba'i 'grel pa sogs dang / skal ldan grags pa'i dpa' bo yid 'ong sogs dang / sdom 'byung gi dka' 'grel rat+na raṇi tas mdzad pa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa bha wa r+bha dras mdzad pa dang /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel pa gru gzings stong phrag brgyad pa pad+ma badz+ras mdzad 1480

pa sogs spyir bde mchog gi rgyad rgya gzhang po ti bca tsam bzhags so/ /dgyes ra riX ra rab rdor ni 'brardo bu'i he ru ka mi skyod dgyes pa rdo rjer bzhengs pas rgyud bstan pa ste/ phyag ni bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ sogs dang / de la bdag med mas zhus pa/ /zhes so/ /chos ni rgyas pa 'bum bdun/ 'bring 'bum lnga/ btsūs pa brtag gnyis te rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma phyag thig phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po ye shes thig le bshad rgyud snying po'i rgyud/ grub pa nges bstan 'bras bu'i rgyud de kho na nyid kyi sgron me rnams las rtsa rgyud rgyas pa 'bum bdun dang 'bring 'bum lnga'i brtag pa phyi ma rnams dang grub pa nges bstan bod du ma 'gyur la/ gzhan rnams dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo gur dang bcas pa phebs so/ /brtag gnyis 'di ming mthun du 'dod pa/ rtsa rgyud bsdus par 'dod pa/ phyung ba'i rgyud du 'dod pa ste gsum las rdo rje snying 'grel du rtsa rgyud bsdus par bshad pa la rin chen rgyan 'drar de bka' nas phyung rgyud du 'chad mod kyang 'bum lnga'i brtag pa dang po gnyis brtag pa sum bcu po'i mdor bstan nam don bsdur gnas pas/ rdo rje snying po mngon byang chub/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po ste/ /sgyu ma'i brtag pa gnyis pa yin/ /zhes pa ltar brtag pa dang po gnyi ga phyung ba yin la/ ye shes thig ler rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis ma bshad pa'ang 'bum lnga bshad pas zlos pa spong ba'i phyir yin la/ gong du brtag pa bcu gnyis par/ /rgyas par gsungs pa mdo ru bsdu/ /zhes dang / ci gsungs sbyin sreg byas nas ni/ /zhes pa ni bar 'bum bdun du bstan pa bzhin zhes pa ste rtsa rgyud bsdus pa yin pas rdo rje snying 'grel dang mi 'gal zhing le'u dang po gnyis phyung ba yin pas na ro yab sras kyi bzhed pa grub bo zhes kho bo sems so//rdo rje snying 'grel dang / spyad dka' zla ba'i 'grel pa su mu de dang / shīrta pa'i mu tig phreng ba sogs rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa bcu gsum tsam dang / in+d+ra bo dhi'i 1481

gur gyi dka' 'egrel sogs dgyes rdor gyi rgyud 'brel rgya gzhung po ti bcu gnyis tsam bzhugs la bod du'ang sa rngog gnyis sogs sgo du ma nas dar ro/ /'de la 'gos 'brog gis he badz+ra zhes pa'i he bod si gsal byed he sngon du byin pa yin par bsams nas kye rdo rje zhes bsgyur ba ltar thams cad la grags mod kyang /de ltar na mtshan dngos rdo rje kho nar 'gyur la/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /zhes pa nus pa gtan med 'gyur bas dgyes pa'am rol ba'i he la dang badz+ra'i ya yig phyis nas dgyes pa'i rdo rje'am rol pa'i rdo rjer 'don pa rje mar pa dang rje rang byung ba'i bzhed pa nyid nges par dgos so/ /gzhan yang gdan bzhi dang ma hā mā ya sogs sprul bshad du gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas thod pa ni yum gyi ba gar mya ngan las 'das par bstan nas dbu thod kyi nang nas rgyud kyi glegs bam byung bar snang ba ste/ mdor na rgyud sde mtha' dag ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams dang / klu sgrub yab sras kyis mi yul du snang bar mdzad la/rgyud kha cig klu sgrub kyis skugs par brdzus te o rgyan nas blangs par yang rngog pa kha cig 'chad do/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la red mda' pas skur pa btab pa'i dogs pa cung zad bsal bar bya ste rgyud kyi thog mar e waX med pa ma grub ste/ don gyi e waṃ yod pa'i phyir/ /e waX la sgra don gnyis su 'byed pa'ang rgyud 'di kho na'i khyad chos so/ /rgyud 'di mi shes na e waX gzugs sgrub dang sgra sgrub sogs e waṃ nyid shes mi nus pas khyed cag e waX gyi ming la mos pa byed par zad do/ /'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyang spyir rgyud kyi dum bu yin yang don gyi me+e waṃ yod de/ a tha shri man badz+ra dha ra/ zhes a shes rab dang tha thabs yin pa'i phyir/ bsdus rgyud la snga phyi bshad pa mi mthun pa ni skabs so sor doṭa pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis blangs pa'i khungs med pa ma grub ste tsi lu pas pad dkar gyi sprul pa las blangs pa dang dus zhabs pas blangs pa sogs 1 482

gsungs pa'i phyir/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i tha snyad gsungs te bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ he ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /zhes rgyud ston pa po'i so so'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su gsungs pa'i phyir/ don grub ste rgyal po in+d+ra bo bhi'i mnyam sbyor 'grel pa sogal su grub chen mang pos dus 'khor khungs su mdzad cing / jo bos/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen las/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ sham+bha la'i yul yod de 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las sham+bha la zhes gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud don ji lta ba 'byed pa dang skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa la sngags kyi grub thob dgos par sus kyang go ste des na/ rgyud don ji bzhin shes la mngon shes ni/ /lnga bas lhag pa drug po nges par dgos/ /ces kho bo smra'o/ skyes bu nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs dris pa lung ma bstan gyi dri ba'o zer ba lan lung du ma bstan pa zhes pa mthong gi lung ma bstan gyi dri ba zhes pa ma mthong la 'jig rten mtha' ldan sogs dang mtshungs na lan mi gsung bar rigs pas rang gi 'gal ba khas blangs pa yin no/ /rgyang 'phen pa ni 'byung ba'i mthu las sems med par sems can skye bar 'dod kyi 'byung ba'i skye gnas can gtan mi 'dod na drod bsher skyes drod bsher gyi rkyen gyis skye ba tsam zhig khyed rang yang khas mi len nam/ dud 'gro skye gnas bzhi dang zhes pa'i 'grel par/ brdzus te skyes pa ni ljon shing la sogs pa ste sa'i skye gnas so zhes bshad pa 'di la brdzus skyes yin na dud 'gro yin pas khyab par go ba ni sngon ma byung ba'i blo gros cig go /'jig rten khams kyi tshad sogs bshad pa yang dag ma yin te mngon pa dang ma mthun pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ 'o na bde dgyes gsang gsum ga yang dag ma yin par thal te thun mong gi sde snod gsum ga dang ma mthun pa'i phyir/ byang sgra mi snyan sdom pa'i zhing yin par 'dir yang ma smras shing gser gyi — 'khor los bsgyur ba'i khrims 'jug par mngon par yang bshad do/ /de lta mod 1483

kyi 'phags pa bha ku la 'khor bcas bzhugs pa dran par gyis cig /de lta mong kyi/ rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod/ /ces pa la khyed ni 'og ma 'og ma dag yi/sa gnod ces 'chad par snang ngo / khams gong sogs na sa bon dkar po dngos su 'dzag pa yod par thal 'dzag pa'i bag chags yod pa'i phyir snyam pa 'di ni dgun gyi sa gzhi la chos can/ myu gu dngos su yod par— thal/ myu gu'i sa bon yod pa'i phyir zhes pa kho na yin no/ /kun+da spangs ba rtsa ltung lnga pa yin yang spro ba'i dus bdun bshad pa go bar gyis shigaphar phyin theg par bshad pa'i zad par bcu dang 'dir bshad pa'i zad par ming gcig kyang don mi mtshungs te 'dir khams gong gi rgyu stoms 'jug gi bsam gtan khams de dang de shas che ba la 'chad do/ /grub mtha' bzhi sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs na/ de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /zhes sogs ji ltar drang /mu stegs rnams sngon dge slong rkun pos bcom pa cig gi cha lugs mthong bas byung ba dang / ston pa nyid brgya byin du gyur pa na snod dang mi ldan pa la lam sna tshogs bstan pas byung ba sogs mdo so sor bshad pa ma mthong ngam/ 'dul ba glegs bam la 'god par ston pas ma gnang na 'dul ba'i glegs bam mi srid pa'am srid na bka' dang 'gal ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /'bri bar 'gyur la bris zhes bshad pa'ang drang srong sgra la chags pa rnams gdul phyir ched du rnam dbye dang rkyen nyams su bcug pa du ma yod par ma thos sam/ sbyor drug yang gsang 'dus las bshad pa dang 'gal lo zhes pa gsang 'dus kho nas chog na rgyud gzhan ga la dgos/ gal te dus 'khor las sor sdud kyi dbang sogs yul la mi 'jug par bshad la/ gsang 'dus las yu/ga yang yang len par bshad do snyam na yul la mi 'jug pa ni tha mal pa'i gzugal sogs la mi 'jug pa yin la de mi 'jug par zin pa'i rtags su du sogs snang ba yin la yang yang len pa ni stong 1484

gzugs de la ma yengs pa yin no/ /'di yi sgrub byed don du mna' chu 'thung //de las gzhan pa'i sgrub byed yod re gan/ /zhes par rab tu byung bas mna' dor bar mi bya'o zhes pa dang 'gal te mna' bsgag po med par yang lan gnyis bstud nas ngor ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'phags pas mdzad dam min yang sla/ /legs par bshad pa'ang mang du mthong bas na/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis 'jug bya ma yin zhes/ kho bo'i 'di la gcig tu skur mi 'debs/ /ces zer ba ni mu stegs kyi lugs su sngon yang yang bstan pa dang thar 'dod kyi 'jug byar khas len pa 'gal zhing / 'phags pas mdzad pa'i dogs pa yod bzhin du/ /'phags chen rnams kyi rigs pa 'di la gzigs/ /zhes pa 'gal zhing mna' dor ba'i de ma thag tu 'phags pas mdzad dam zhes dang legs bshad mang du mthong ba dang thar 'dod kyi 'jug byar khas blangs pas ma rabs kyi chos sbyang pa yin no/ /sngon rje btsun grags pas dus 'khor gyi rtsa ltung lnga pa 'gog pa dang /bcom ral pas dus 'khor 'di drang srong rgyas— ba'i gzhung dang mthun pas phyi nang gang yin dang bka' bstan bcos gang yin mi shes pas po ti zur du byas la zhog zer dgos byung mod kyang bod kyi bla ma re gnyis kyis dgag sgrub byas pas ltar snang du sgrub nus na rgya gar gyi tshad ldan de tsam gyis bkral ba 'dis yang dag du'ang cis mi grub la/ spyir rtsod bcas kyi rtags kyis dngos btags gang du'ang sgrub mi nus pa/ spyod 'jug las/ theg chen rtsod bcas phyir zhe na/sogs dang mtshungs la/ dman pa'i blor mi shong pa nyid kyis mchog tu byams pas bshad do/ /de ltar rgyud chen po la skur pa 'debs pa'i dogs pa bsal nas deng sang 'dzam gling gi mi rnams la grags pa'i rgyud rnams kyi rgyal po ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ste/ de yang sngon 'phags skyes po dang ma la gnod kyis ser skya bskor tshe shākya rnams phal cher bden pa mthong zhing thams cad dge 1485

bsten yin pas 'jigs pa bstan pa tsam ma gtogs sus brgal na'ang nye du 'i gral nas dbyung ngo zhes khrims byas te mdas gzhu'i rgyud rnams gcod pa dang khrab kyi rgyun bu bcad nas byang bu snyil pa dang gos lhung ba tsam byed tshe shākya sham+bha ka ri brag cig na gnas pa sar skyar 'ongs tshe bskor ba mthong / khrims ma thos pas mda' gcig gis kyang skye bo lnga brgya bsad pas shākya rnams kyis nye du'i nang nas phyung nas nye 'khor khrid/ ston pa'i dbu skra dang sen mo zhus te yul 'ba' gu tarwa chas te rang nyid pho nya bar byas te sngon du phyin nas shākya sham+bha ka zhes pa 'byon zhing yod pas rgyal po zhus shig gzhan du brlag par 'gyur ro byas pas khyod rang la nus pa ci yod zer bas pha bong ral gris bcad pas skrag ste khyod nyid la skyabs zhu zer bas rgyal po byas par 'dul ba las bshad de/ la bzung ba'am 'dzin pa la 'jug pas de phyin sham+bha la zhes sham+bhas bzung ba zhes grags la/yul de shin tu thag ring bas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon par rigs so/ /rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od ces kyang bya bas/ /'das pa'i rgyal po nyi ma'i 'od/ /de ni bgegs dgra'i sprul pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa yin la/ de'i lha mo rnam par rgyal ma las phyag rdor zla bzang du 'khrungs shing 'di ni 'phags yul nas 'byon dus gzhon nur yod par rigs shing sham+bha la pa'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams/ nga yi shākya'i rigs 'di la/ /zhes shākya'i rgyal rigs yin tshul yang de lta bu'o/ /de yang yul drug dus sbyor gyi dbang du byas na yul drug po nyi ma la nye ring ma gtogs 'phel 'grib mtshungs pas tshad mnyam la/ 'on kyang 'phags yul ni mtshams bzung gi 'phel 'grib tsam smos kyi de phan ma smos pa yin no/ /des na rdo rje gdan dbus su byas pa'i byang dum bu drug tu bgos pa'i dum bu byang ma pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs gangs ris bcad pa 'dab ma re re la grong bye ba yod pa 'i yul chen po bcu gnyis re yod cing de re re la lha dang klu'i rigs 1486

sogs kyi rgyal po re yod pas rgyal po dgu bcu rtsa drug yod la/ yul re re zhing tsam pa ka dang spre'u dang rugla la sogs pa'i ming dang skad rigs so so ba can/ de'i dbus na sum cha tsam du mtho ba'i pad+ma'i lte ba ni sham+bha la ste de'i dbus na pho brang chen po ka lā pa dang lho phyogs na ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal dang de'i shar nub na nye ba'i yid kyi mtsho dang pad+ma dkar po'i mtsho dang bcas pa yod de de bzhi ga'ang dpag tshad bcu gnyis rer mnyam mo/ /shākya'i rgyal rgyud rnams der yul go drug po thamasu cad la dbang bsgyur zhing chos kyis rgyal srid skyong ngo //yang rgya gar lho phyogs 'gro lding ba'i yul zad mtshams gaṅgā dang sī ta rgya mtshor 'dre ba'i bar na shrīdhu na ka ṭaṃ ces pa dpal 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten yod de/de ni sngon sangs rgyas gser thub kyi bstan pa'i mjug tu mu ge chen po byung ba na dge slong grub thob cig gis bum pa bsgrubs pas 'bras sā li'i char 'dzam gling khyab par bol nub tsam dang nyin lam bcu gnyis kyi rgya la gyang rim gsum tsam dang bum pa'i steng du mchod rten gyi dbyibs su 'bras kyi ri chen po chags pa'i phud las rdzu 'phrul can rnams kyis 'bras phye las snga ma dang tshad mnyam pa'i mchod rten bzhengs/ khyab 'jug gis beḍūr+ya'i bdar bum brgya rtsa brgyad phul pa la sogs lha klu kun gyis mchod pa sna re byas/ lcags ri'i nang na yul khams chen po du ma dang grong khyer dpal yon can tshong 'dus dang bcas pa yod pa'i bum pa'i nang steng na dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'og na chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor blos bslang ba bzhugs pa cig yod do/ /ston pa lo brgyad bcu pa mya ngan las 'da' pa la phyogs pa'i nyi khyim gyi dbang gis sa gas lo mgo bzung ba nag pa zla ba'i nya la dpal ldan 'bras spungs der gshegs te dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin la stoms par zhugs nas sham+bha la nas 'ongs pa'i rgyal po zla ba bzang po la sogs skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la dus kyi 1487

'khor lo'i dbang bskur zhing rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gsungs la/ lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i los/ /sogs dang / phreng 'dzin tshigs bcad sum bcu ni/ /lhag pa'i phyogs brgya le'u lngas/ /dpal ldan rgyud dag rdzogs par ni/ /smra ba'i rgyal pos de ston 'gyur/ /zhes bsdus rgyud sdud pa dang / rgyas 'brel byed po pad dkar 'dzin/ /zhes ma 'ongs pa lung du bstan te zla ba phyi ma'i nya la sprul pa'i sku mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan to/ /rgyud thos pa'i de ma thag tu zla ba bzang pos sras lha dbang chos ston por bskos nas lo gnyis su ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal du sku dkyil khru bzhi brgya pa'i dkyil 'khor blos bslang pa rin po che las bzhengs shing 'grel chen stong phrag drug bcu pa mdzad de shar khyams su ston pa'i srol btsugs te sprul sku bsdus so/ /kun mkhyen bu la sogs pa sangs rgyas pa'i phyi lo dus 'khor gsungs par bzhed kyang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyang nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo drug brgya na zhes dang / lo 'di ste chos bstan pa'i lo 'di nas so zhes dus 'khor gsungs pa'i lo dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i lo gcig tu gsungs pa dang / theg pa gsum bstan nas zhes pa chos 'khor bskor zin pa'i don yin pas na/ rgyal bas brgyad bcu'i bar dag tu/ /sems can rnams la chos bstan nas/ /dam pa dang po'i dpal ldan rgyud/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i nya la gsungs/ /zhes rje rang byung zhabs bzhed cing / lha dbang gi lo brgya'i dang po dang zla ba bzang po'i lo gnyis kyi snga ma gcig tu byas pas lo lhag chad mi 'byung ba yin no/ /lha dbang gzi brjid can/ sna tshogs gzugs/lha'i dbang phyug zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang ldan te chos rgyal 'ba' zhig pa drug gis lo drug brgya 'das pa na 'jam pa'i dbyangs grags pa seng ge'i khrir byon nas rtsa rgyud dang 'grel chen bstan te lo brgya pa la nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la rdo rje'i theg par zhugs shig 148 8

gang mi 'jug pa rnams sham+bha la yul go drug dang bcas par ma 'dug cig gzhan du mas 'ongs par khyed rnams kla klor 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas thams cad yul bor gnyen 'dun khrid de nyi ma bcur song ste nags tshal zhig tu slebag pa na 'jam dpal gyis de rnams skal pa dang ldan par gzigs shing de rnams song na rigs bzhi dad par mi 'gyur bar gzigs te mu stegs thams cad rmongs par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas de rnams myos nas gnyid log bzhin mi ma yin rnams kyis khyer nas ka lā pa'i sgo drung du slebs so/ /dad nas ngo mtsha ra du byung ba na blon po chen po rgya mtsho'i blo gros kyis rgyal po chen po grags pa ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa'i sku ste 'di nyid la skyabs su dong zhig zhes bskul bas sems sad de nyi ma'i shing rta la bskul te dbang bskur ba dang bsdus rgyud mdzad par gsol ba btab pas de rnams dang yul go drug gi mi rigs bzhi skal pa dang ldan pa thams cad la nag pa'i nya la dkyil 'khor gyi khang par dbang bskur zhing bsdus pa'i rgyud man ngag bstan pas thams cad sa ga'i nya'i tho rengs ye shes kyi sku grub bo/ /de nas sras pad dkar chos ston pa dang 'grel pa mdzad par bskos te longs spyod rdzogs skur thim mo/ /pad dkar gyis bsdus rgyud la 'grel chen dri med 'od stong phrag bcu gnyis pa mdzad do/ /de ltar grags pas rigs bzhi rdo rje'i rigs gcig tu mdzad pa phyin rigs ldan du mtshan 'don no/ /bsdus rgyud mdzad nas lo brgyad brgya na kla klo sbrang rtsi'i blo gros 'byung bar lung bstan te de yang sham+bha la'i lho phyogs kla klo stag gzig pa'i yul du stag gzig pa'i rgyal po asto zhes pas dha maṇa'e 'jug pa'i log chos brtsams/ kla klo'i ston pa a no bha la sogs pa byung / khyad par du sog po'i yul tri ti zhes pa grong bye ba yod par bā ga ra'i grong du sbrang rtsi'i blo gros byung ste nang pa'i gtsug lag khang drug bcu rtsa brgyad bshig mu stegs pa 'khyer yang 1489
