kla klor gyur to/ /kla klo a dzño byung ba rigs ldan khyab 'jug sbas pa'i lo nga gcig pa de kla klo'i lo stong dang brgyad brgya'i thog ma yin par chag lo gsum pa'i dus 'khor chos byung na snang ngo / /pad dkar phyin/ bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang / /phyag dmar khyab 'jug sbas nyi grags/ /shin bzang rgya mtsho dam par rgyal/ /rgyal dga' nyi ma sna tshogs gzugs/ /zla 'od mtha' yas sa skyong dang / /dpal skyong seng ge rnam par gnon/ /stobs chen ma 'gag mi'i seng ge /dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas dang / /rnam rgyal drag po 'khor lo can/ /zhes bya ste/ gdan ni nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams rim par bgrangs pa dag gi dus kyi mthar/ /zhes dang / gdan so gnyis kyi mthar drag po 'byung bar gsungs pa'i rgyud tshig bzhin byas pa ste/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal gcig tu byed pa dang nyer gsum pa drag po byed pa'ang snang ngo / /ma 'ongs pa bod dang 'phags yul sogs 'dzam gling phal cher kla klos gang ba'i tshe 'jam dpal nyid rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can du gyur pas rdo'i rta bcibs shing mdung thung 'dzin pa dang rta pa'i dmag dpon ha nu man dang / shing rta pa'i dmag dpon drag po dang rgyal po dgu bcu rtsa drug rlung gi shugs can gyi rdo'i rta pa bye ba dgu glang po che 'bum phrag bzhi/ shing rta pa 'bum phrag lnga/ dpung bu chung mig mthong drug sogs lha dang mi'i dmag dpung mtha' yas pa bshams te yul go drug brgal nas chu bo sī ta'i lhor byon te/ kla klo'i dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi 'joms shing kla klo'i rgyal po byed pa'i blo gros dang dmag dpon zla ba chen po'i bu dang dbang po'i mgon po sogs bcad cing btubs par snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyis btul te chos la 'god par mdzad cing de nas gling 'dir rdzogs ldan 'jug la sras lha dbang dang tshangs pa gnyis 'byung ba'i lha dbang gis lho gling nub mar kla klo 'dul ba sogs rgyal rgyud sa dum bu bcu gnyis po thams cad du 'khor ba 1490

yin no/ /rigs ldan gyis kla klo'i steng du byon nas 'dul ba yin gyi/ de tshe kla klo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /sham+bha la ru dmag 'dren 'gyur/ /zhes 'chad pa de'ang min la/ de tshe phyag na rdo rje yi/ /sprul pa drag po zhes bya bas/ /zhes bshad 'jam dpal dang phyag rdor nor ba yin no/ /rgyud 'grel rgya gar du phebs pa'i tshul la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas bde mchog gi sgrub thabs su dri med 'od kyi mchod brjod bkod pa dang / be+erlu pas gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'phrul 'khor gyi cho ga dus 'khor la bsten nas mdzad pa sogs grub pa rnams kyi spyod yul du sngon nas gyur yang thun mong gi snang bar ni tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tas spyan drangs pa ste/ de yang rgyal po de wa pā la'i dus rgya gar shar phyogs o rbe sar rnal 'byor pa cig gi sras su 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas rab tu byung zhing rig gnas dang sde sgod thams cad la bla med kyi mkhas par gyur te btsun chung bas dge tshul zhes tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tar grags/ zhag re la slo ka stong zin pa'i gzungs thob/ des nā lan+da sogs dang byang bar du tu ru ṣ+ka'i gnod pa med pa rin chen ri bo'i gtsug lag khang du gsung rab thams cad gzigs pas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba gsang sngags la rag zhing de sprul pa'i rgyal pos dngos su ston pa sham+bha la na yod zer ba gzigs shing yi dam gyis kyang lung bstan te rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i tshong pa dang lhan cig zla ba drug tu gzings la byon/ de nas tshong pa rnams zla ba drug gi dus byas nas rin po che'i gling so sor song / slob dpon gyis sham+bha la'i lam yig bzung nas ri chen po cig la 'dzegs pas ri'i rtser slebs pa na dge slong gzugs bzang ba zhig dang phrad de 'dri ba la sham+bha lar chos nyan du 'gro byas pas/ de shin tu bgrod par dka' ste shes pa byung na 'di nyid du nyan pas chog mod gsungs pas rigs ldan gyi sprul par shes te rjes su bzung bar zhus pas de nyid du sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing rgyud 'grel man ngag thams cad rdzogs par 1491

gnang ste spyi bor me tog bzhag nas sems 'grel rnams kyi tshig don ji lta pa khong du chud par gyur cig ces brjod pa'i mod la tshig don thams cad thugs su chud/ sprul pa mi snang bar gyur te slar byon pas tshong pa rnams dang 'dzom ste tshur byon/ nā lan+da dang ka ta kha'i rgyal po'i sar bzhugs nas dus kyi 'khor lo bstan pas slob ma gsum byung ste de dag gis zhus nas thugs la gnas pa yi ger bkod/ slob ma rgyal 'byung sbas pas grub pa thob kyang slob ma ma bskyangs/ piṇ+ḍa pa'am li to bas rgyud pa bzung ste da bhaṅga lar 'khrungs/ mkhas pa zla med par gyur cing khyad par tsi lu pa'i chos bum pa gang byor mkhyen/ sbyangs yon bsod stoms pa mdzad pas pi to ba'i bin+tu ā tsār+ya ste slob dpon bsod stoms pa zhes grags/ yul der dmag byung ba na dpe rnams sbas nas bros pa slar bton tshe ma tshang nas slar 'bri bar zhus pas mkha' 'gro mas sbas pas 'bri mi rung gsungs nas tsi lu ba shar phyogs me tog khyim du byon ste ye shes kyi klu sgrub/ ma tshang ba sems 'grel gnyis kyi smad du grags kyang ma yin te phyag rdor stod 'gre'/ ni tshiṭa bcad phyed dang bcu gsum kho na'i 'grel par bshad pa dang / rdo rje snying 'grel du'ang 'di las phyi ma spyod pa'i le'u la sogs pa rgya cher rtogs par bya'o zhes dang / lho dang byang gi yul du 'tshol dgos par zhal 'phangs pa'i phyir/ des na ma tshang ba ni rtsa rgyud rtsa 'grel lo/ /piṇ+ḍa pas dus 'khor gyi sgrub thabs snying po'i rgyan mdzad cing de'i slob ma bram ze dā ri dra pas dbang gi rab byed kyi 'grel pa mdzad do/ /slob ma'i gtso bo ni dus zhabs pa chen po ste/ shar phyoṭa b.ren+d+rar geshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa yab yum gyis rgyud las gsungs pa'i rigs rgyud 'jog pa'i rnal 'byor byas te sras bskrun pas 'jam dpal 'od dang bcas nas byon par mthong zhing khye'u blo gros thogs pa med pa cig byung nas sgrol ma bsgrubs pas tshegs med du grub ste nam dgos lung ston/ chung ngu la rab tu 1492

byung nas mkhas pa zla med rnga/ra gyur nas klu byang la yang bsten/ ngatsi lu pa chung bar yang grags/ be+e to pa las dus 'khor gas na te bum pa gang byor gyur kyang thugs ma tshim ste sham+bha lar 'byon par dgongs/ sgrol mas lung bstan te mya ngam gyi thang la zla ba bzhi 'gro dgos pas rgya mtshor gzengs la zhugs te phyin/ tshong pa rnams nor bu'i gling so sor song / slob dpon gyis ri zhig la 'dzegs pas rtse mor rigs ldan gyi sprul pas rjes su bzung ste dbang rgyud man ngag nod/ ri de'i rtsa bar zhag bdun bsgoms pas grub pa thob ste skad cig gis sham+bha lar byon nas rigs ldan dngos la chos thams cad gsan/ bsdus rgyud rtsa 'grel rgyud phyi dang bcas pa/ dbang mdor bstan/ lta 'dod mdor bstan/ don dam bsnyen pa/ rnal 'byor gsum snying / sems 'grel gzhan gnyis rnams kyi glegs bam yang spyan drangs te 'phags yul du rgyas par gyur to/ /de la slob ma'i mchog a wa dhū ti ba/ shrī bha dra bo dhi/ nā lan+da pa ste 'di gsum ga la dus zhabs pa chung bar so sor grags/ na ro ba/ sā dhu bu tra/ rat+na kā gur/ thar 'byung sbas pa/ 'dul 'byung blo groXs/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal sogs byung ngo / / ོde la a wa dhū ti pa ni/ dge slong blo shin tu brtul ba zhig gis rig byed ma'i shes rab sgrub pa byas pas byu ru la rig byed ma'i sku bzos bud med kyi ro ma nyams pa zhig gi khar chug ro kha sbub pa'i rgyab tu skyil krung gis 'dug la zhag bdun sgrubs cig zhes lung bstan byung ste de ltar bsgrubs pas zhag bdun na ro de steng du kha log ste khyod shes rab ji tsam 'dod zer ba la 'jam dpal dang mnyam par 'dod byas kyang 'ong ba la bris zin tshad zin par 'dod byas pas de ltar byung / yul dbus su bzhugs pas ngag gi dbang phyug tu grags/dngul gzhong du mchil ma dor tshad longs spyod du gyur pas sbyin pa phyogs med du 1493

gtong / phyogs bzhir paṇa chung gsum gsum 'khod pa la chos mi 'dra ba bzhi dus gcig la ston skad/ des dus 'khor zhabs la rgyud ji tsam mkhyen dris pas lan gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi ming yang ma zin skad/ der rgyud man ngag gsan te dka' 'grel pad+ma can ngadang sbas pa mig 'byed rtsa 'grel dang dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil chog sogs mdzad/ slob ma rnal 'byor pa mang du byung la/ dge bsnyen bo dhi dang nā lan+da pa'ang slob ma yin no/ /dge bsnyen po dhi ni shar phyogs mañdzu ha de ṣār 'khrungs/ mkhas pa chen por gyur pas dus 'khor zhabs las rgyud man ngag gsan te nags la bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/ bod du'ang gyi jos spyan drangs te byon/ rten dge bsnyen mtshan shrī bha dra bo dhi/ 'dis dus zhabs snyan rgyud mdzad to/ /nā lan+da ba ni dge bsnyen de'i sras yin la mkhyen rab zla med cing a wa dhū ti pa la sogs kyi yon tan rdzogs kyang ma tshim bar bod du byon nas gser btsal bas srang gang rnyed pa dus zhabs pa chen po la phul te rgyud dang gdams pa gsan pas dus zhabs pa chen po dang yon tan mnyam par gyur/ des rgyal po ra ma pā li'i dus nā larja'i sgo gong du rnam bcu dbang ldan bris/ 'og tu gang dus 'khor mi shes pas mtshan brjod mi shes/ mtshan brjod mi shes pa des gsang sngaṭa mi shes/ sngags mi shes pa thams cad 'khor ba pa ste des na gsang sngags mayin par bya'o zhes pa'i 'grel tshig dngos bris pas paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya tsam gyis brtsod pas thams cad btul nas zhabs la btud de a bhu dang tsa mi dang a bhi yu sta dang mañdzu gīrti dang kha che zla mgon dang ri bo ba dang a ce la galte dang dun shri dang ma hā pu tu dang kha che gasnyir dang shārnya gubha dang gu na rakhri ta la so/gas pa mkhas pa chen po mang du byung zhing khyim pa rnams kyang dpe 'bri zhing bag chags 'jog go / 1494

na ro pa ni phyi nang sus kyang rtsod mi nus pas rtsod med ces pa ste dus zhabs pa las gsan nas dbang mdor bstan dang brtag gnyis la 'grel pa mdzad de kha che'i lugs su grags/ /('di na ro pa paṇ+ḍi ta mdzad pa'i dus yin par 'dug)sā dhu bu dra ni legs pa'i sras zhes bya ste mtshan dngos shrī dha ra dpal 'dzin no/ /des slob dpon dpe med 'tsho zhes pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mas lung bstan ste he ru gas de kho na nyid dngos su bstan pa de dang dus 'khor zhabs gnyi ga las gsan te mngon dkyil dang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa mdzad/des 'od byed lha/ chos 'byung zhi ba sogs te bod du'ang bik+ṣu ti tsan+d+ra'i lugs dang paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyang ring rgyud 'di las byung ba'o/ /radhā kā ra budha ni gzhon nu la shin tu mkhas par gyur te paṇ+ḍi ta rab byung mang po'i 'khor yod/ ma rgan mo gso phyir rten dge bsnyen du yod pa la ma gadhar blon po chen po cig gis ma'i 'tsho ba gser srang sum bcu byin nas rab tu 'byung bar bskul te rab tu byung / rin 'byung sbas par btags/ dus zhabs pa/ dze ta ri/ na ro pa sogs bsten/ ston pa dang mtshungs pas rdo rje'i gdan du bzhugs/ 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa'i sbyin bdag blon po des byed do/ /phyi zhig na po ṭa lar spyan ras gzigs mjal du 'byon par dgongs te byon nas sau ri'i yul du phebs pa na yul de'i rgyal po'i rmi lam du rdo rje gdan gyi thub pa chen pos nga'i bstan pa lho phyogs su ma btang bar zung zhig gsung ba rmis pas slob dpon du shes nas mi bzhugs na lceb par byas pas bzhugs te bstan pa dar bar mdzad pas sau ri pa zhes grags so/ /thar 'byung sbas pas sa ra ha'i dmangs do sbyor drug tu bkral/ seng ge rgyal mtshan nas nyi ma'i 'od sogs paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyi dbang rgyud byung ngo / /dus zhabs pa chung 1495

bas seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pas btul pa'i slob ma rnams kyi nang nas a bhu kā ra gubha ni 'jigs med /'byung gnas sbas pa ces bya ste lho phyogs su bram ze phun sum tshogs pa cig tu 'khrungs/ sgra tshad gzo gso la mkhas par gyur nas sgo bsdaca/sa nas sgra'i po ti cig lta ba'i tshe bu mo mdzes ma zhig 'ongs te bdag ni gdol pa mo ste dga' mgur spyod du 'ongs so zer ba na reg tu yang mi rung ngo byas pas khyod kyis skye pa mang por nga la yi dam byas pas 'ongs pa zhin/ nga la nyan na sangs rgyas pa gyis la dbang skur zhus/ ma ga dhar song zhig zer nas yal lo/ /de nas bhaṅga lar byon rab tu byung / rgyud gsan nas sgom pa'i tshe bud med sha khrug dmar rtsa re thogs pa cig gis bdag gdol pa mo yin/ 'di zo zhig zer bas mi rung ngo smras pas/ ma ga dhar song zhig zer nas yal/ de nas ma ga dhar byon/ dpe med 'tsho la sogs la gsang sngags mang du gsan/ sau ri pa la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ man ngag zhus nas sgo sum rim bsdams nas mun khang du sgom pa na bu mo sha chang thogs pa cig byung ste nga bla ma'i g.yog mo yin/ bla ma rat+na ka ras tshogs skal skyel du btang ba yin pas longs spyod cig lan gsum du zer ba la mi rung ngo smras pas khyod kyis skye ba mang por nga la tshogs bsags pas ngas dngos grub lan gsum du bskyal yang khyod mi 'dod par 'dug zer te ci yang mi snang bar yal/ sgo yang bcad pa sngar bzhin 'dug bla ma la de skad zhus pas khyod rtog pa che bar 'dug pas skyel du ma btang / yi dam gyis byon par 'dug ste ma shes par 'dug gsungs/ de nas 'gyod de yi dam gyis dngos su lung mi ston na shi ba sla'o zhes pa ste btsugs pas zhag bdun na rmi lam du rgan mo zhig byung ba mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas bstan bcos mang du rtsoms shig bar dor mchog gi dngos grub thob bo zhes gsungs/ de nas dus zhabs pa la dus kyi 'khor lo gsan te bi kra ca/ shī la'i gnas brtan dang po mdzad//496

sangs rgyas lta bur bzhugs pas rgya gar ba rnams kyis mtshan brjod mi nus par be+e kra ma shī la paṇ+ḍi ta zer bar grags so/ /shi ba slong nus/ rgyal pos grong khyer gcig phul ba la paṇ+ḍi ta'i gtsug lag khang dge 'dun lnga brgya dang nyi shu'i 'tsho ba sbyor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung sgrub phyir 'dul ba snang ba/ mngon pa bsdus pa/ dbu ma'i snye ma/ brgyad stong 'grel pa gnad kyi zla 'od/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ sasbru ṭa'i 'grel pa man ngag snye ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i 'grel pa mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel/ dus 'khor la 'jug pa/ rgyud 'grel gyi brgal lan/ dus 'khor gsal ba/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i 'grel pa zla 'od/ bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ rang byin rlabs/ rdor sems ser po dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/ lū yi ba'i mngon rtogs te sgrub thabs grags pa can bzhi/dbang chos rdo rje phreng ba rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i phreng ba sbyin sreg 'od kyi phreng ba —ste phreng ba skor gsum/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho ste spyir 'bum sde gcig mdzad/dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes so//de'i slob ma shu bham kā ra gup+ta dge 'byung sbas pa dang / swā gī shwa ra gusta ngag dbang sbas pa/ bai byuta de wa rnam grags lha/ niṣ+ṭha li ka de wa rtog med lha/bha sa ka ra gup+ta 'od byed sbas pa/ nā ya ka 'dren pa'i thabs sogs mkhas grub dpag med dang bod kyi lo tsā ba grags pa rnam gsum zhes tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ spong zho gsal ba grags/ kher gang 'khor lo grags dang /gzhan nā lo/ gnyan lo/ she'u lo tsā/ rong gling lo tsā/ ldi ri chos grags/te bo shes rab dpal la sogs kyang yin no/ dge 'byung sbas pa la grub thob legs spyod zhabs dang mu nin+d+ra shrī bha dra thub dbang dpal bzang gnyis byung la/legs spyod nas bzung ste rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang ma ṇi ka shrī dzña na sogs byung zhing mu nin+d+ra nas rā hu la shrī bha dra dgra gca na zin dpal bzang po ste bstan pa'i bdag 1497

por grags pa de 'a sogs pa byung ngo / /bi khru ta de wa rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po yin zhing de'i slob ma paṇa chen shā3gle'o/ / ni lka lam ka ni rtse gcig tu bsgrubs pas grub pa thob ste rdo rje gdan pa mdzad/ des bal por 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta re len+d+ra de wa nyi dbang lha la gsungs te rdo rje gdan du chos dpon grub thob bzhi bstud nas byung ba'i phyi ma yin la phyis bal por bzhugs so/ / tsa mi ni mi nyag snyar 'khrungs/ dus zhabs pa dang a bhu sogs la bsten yang phyis a bha sogs paṇa grub thams cad kyis 'dud/ kun gyis tshad ma'i skyes bur bkur/ rdo rje gdan dang nā lan+da'i dge 'dun gyi 'dren pa mdzad/ /dā na shrī ni dha byang chub sems dpa' zhes jo bo rje'i dbon po de'o/ /shān+ta kā ra gup+ta zhi 'byung sbas pa ni paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad kyi bla ma/ bka' bstan bcos kyi glegs bam phal cher phyag na yod pa/ dga' ldan du 'byon bar zhal gyis bzhes pa de'o/ / kha che zla ba mgon po ni kha cher bram ze chen po zhig gi sras su 'khrungs/dbugs thengs re la bloka re zin zhing bloka bcu drug lan res 'dzin nus pas lo bcu gcig yan la reg byed ma lus pa shes/ yum sangs rgyas pa yin pas bram ze bzang po zhabs la chos nyan du bcug ste mkhas par gyur/ slob ma'ang mkhas pa lnga tsam byung / dbang mdor bstan gyi dpe gzigs pas shin tu dad de yul dbus su byon/ dus 'khor zhabs chung ba yab sras dang mjal/ rgyud man ngag la shin tu mkhas shing bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes/ byang sems la brtan pa thob/ zag pa zad/ 'jam dpal dngos su grags/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar pos lung bstan te bod du byon no/ /rgyud 'grel chen po bod du dar tshul 1498

ni me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'das lo sre ba'i thog ma'i rab byung la gyi jo zla 'od dang dus zhabs pa shrī bha dras bsgyur bas gyi jo 'gyur byung / de ma thag slob ma lo paṇa rnams kyis bgos nas bsgyur bas 'gyur mang du grags pa byung / de bzhin du rma dge ba'i blo gros kyi rma 'gyur/ mang 'or byang chub shes rab kyi 'gyur/blo gros snying po'i 'gyur/ bsod nams ye shes kyi 'gyur/ 'bro lo'i 'gyur/'gos lo'i 'gyur/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gnyan dar ma grags kyi 'gyur/ rgya gar nyid du bsdus rgyud ldi ri chos grags dang 'grel chen tsa mi'i 'gyur/ rong gling lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ steng pa lo tsā ba'i 'gyur/ rwa chos rab kyi 'gyur/ chag chos rje dpal gyi 'gyur/ shong ston gyi 'gyur/ dpang lo'i 'gyur/ rnam gnyis 'gyur sogs glegs bam gcig la dus 'khor 'gyur mang bar grags shing / spyir dus 'khor phyogs la rgya gzhung po ti lnga tsam bzhugs theb/ /yang man ngag gi bka' ni kha che zla mgon gyis sgom pa kun mchog srung la rdzogs par gnang / de nas rim bzhin sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ mkhas pa bre bo mgon po/ sdum ra sgang pa/ snye mdo ba bsod nams dpal/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub/ rje rang byung pa ste gar lugs dang /yang grub chen yu mo nas sras dharme shār/ nam mkha' 'od/ grub thob se mo che/'jam sar/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu rin po che ste bu lugs dang / kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer nas kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dol po ba ste jo nang lugs sogs yin la/ 'di la 'bro lo brgyud pa la mi dgos kyang paṇ+ḍi tas 'bro 'gyur las bshad pas 'bro lugs ces grags so/ /gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi gsung khrom pad+ma 'od zer gyis bris pa nas gyi jo lugs dang /1499

tsa mi lo tsā/ dpal rmā lo/ zhang rin po che sogs tshal lugs dang / tsa mi/rgu lo/ sa chen sogs sa lugs dang / se lo tsā/ gnyos 'od ma/ bkra shis rin chen/ de gnyis la dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rjes tshar so gnyis gsan/de la o rgyan pas bshad pa gsan/ dbang sde'i slob ma lha chen rdo rje tshul khrims la gsan/ de la rje rang byung pas dbang lung gsan/ bshad sgrub la snye mdo ba kun don bar du 'jug pa sogs tsa mi lugs dang / she'u lo tsā/ rgya thams cad mkhyen pa/ snye mdo ba yab sras te she'u lugs dang / sa man+ta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ kre bo mgon po sogs dang / rwa chos rab nas rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng / rong pa rmā lo/ rong pa shes seng / rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/dpal ldan seng ge de la bu rin po che ste rwa lugs dang / rarno rakhri ta dang re wen+d+ra la sogs nas chag chos rje dpal/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ o rgyan pa sogs chag lugs dang / paṇa chen shākrā dpyal lo sogs paṇa chen 'u/gas dang / khyad par sha wa ra dbang phyug gis sngon bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra rnal 'byor zla ba dang phyis paṇ+ḍi ta nags kyi rin chen rjes su bzung ba las 'phel ba sha wa ra'i sbyor drug sogs dus 'khor gyi sbyor drug bod yul khyab par 'phel zhing / rje rang byung pas 'jig rten khams le la rtsis kun bsdus pa/ nang le la zab mo nang don/ dbang le/ sgrub le la mngon dkyil/ ye le la rnal 'byor gsum snying gi 'grel pa mdzad pas don gyis rgyud 'grel yongs rdzogs kyi don tshang ba dang / grub chen yu ma'i gsal sgron rnam bzhi dang / dpal ldan bla ma'i 'grel chen dang / mkhan chen pad+ma bzang bo'i 'grel chen dang / phyis byams gling pa'i 'grel chen dang / bu dol rjes 'breng dang bcas pa'i skyed rdzogadzo kyi bstan bcos ches mang du byung ngo / /gsang sngags kyi deng sang grags che ba ni gtso che ba de dag yi/na la gzhan man ngag la sogs pa'i sgo nas dngos grub brnyes pa ni 1 500

rgya bod du bgrang gis mi lang la/ cung zhib par kun nga/khyen bu'i bde gsang dus gsum gyi chos byung dang / chag lo gsum pa'i dus 'khor chos byung sogs las shes par bya'o/ /grub thob brgyad bcur grags pa ni grub thob ji tsam byon pa'i grangs ma yin yang rdo rje gdan du bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi dngos grub thob pas sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par grags pa gsum rim par byung ba'i che ba mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ 'di jo bo rje bod na bzhugs pa'i dus yin/ 'bring po rol pa'i rdo rje/ chung ba don yod rdo rje gsum las chen po des dur khrod gsil ba tshal du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams nas grub thob thams cad la gsol ba btab pas brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi byon pa la snga rim gyis bstod pa blo ka re dang phyag re mdzad pa dang so sos rdo rje'i glu re'ang gsungs pa nas dar ba yin la/ kha cig rdo rje gdan pa che ba 'di rgyal ba shing rta 'dzin pa chen po zhes grags pa tsa mi lo tsā ba yin yang zer ro/ /nang rig pa las sngags kyi chos byung ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa nang rig pa'i skabs so/ /bstan 'gyur na dus 'khor gyi skor po ti lnga/ gsang 'dus skor po ti nyi shu rtsa gcig bde mchog skor po ti gnyis/ dgyes rdor skor po ti dgu yo ga'i skor po ti bcu gcig la sogs pa yod/ phyi nang thun mong gi rig gnas sgra tshad gzo gso bzhi'i sgra tshad ni/ deng sang bod phal cher gyis bka' spyi'i tshig gi cha 'grel pa sgra dang don gyi cha 'grel pa tshad mar 'chad mod kyang de ni ma yin te de lta na bshad bya bka' las 'chad byed bstan bcos snga bar 'gyur te/bka' ni thun mong gi snang bar 'khor lo dang po snga ma yin la sgra tshad ni de'i sngon nas yod pa'i phyir te/ shā ri'i bus lo bcu drug pa la dbang po'i brda sprod pa bklags te rgol ba thams cad tshar bcad do zhes lo bcu drug nas in+d+ra bya kā 1501

raṇa shes par bshad pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba las 'grel pa snga ba ni gang na'ang med do/ /de lta mod kyi sgra'i bstan bcos kyis bka' thams cad kyi tshig gi cha 'grel mi nus te sangs rgyas so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pas tshig dang nges pa'i tshig thams cad pa la dbang 'byor ba yin pas san+ti ta 'ba' zhig ston pa ma yin la gdul bya so so bzhin/ lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad sogs thams cad pas ston gyi lha'i skad legs sbyar 'ba' zhig pa gsung ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag gi tshig kyang brjod byed thams cad tshig yin no snyam pa zhig deng sang mkhas blun kun 'don par snang bas de la bsams mod kyang 'di ni gsung rab las cher mi 'byung la/ mngon pa las ni a lta bu ming / a yig lta bu tshig ste don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa ming dang / don gyi khyad par ston pa tshig tu bshad la/ 'di ni skad rigs bzhi ka la yod pas legs sbyar gyi khyad chos ma yin pa'i phyir dang / sgra pa'i lugs la byings la rkyen byin pas don tsam ston pa ming ngam rtags yin la/ de la rnam dbye si sogs nyer gcig byin pa'am byings la ti sogs brgya brgyad bcu byin pa na tshig yin la/ de'i tshe'ang ming tshig gi zlas phye ba'i tshig kho na 'grel pa la rgyu mtshan dang dgos pa ci yang med pa'i phyir dang / rang bzhin dang rkyen rnam 'gyur gyis sbyar ba'i legs sbyar bzang po ni rig byed kyi bstan bcos sogs phyi rol pa'i gzhung rnams la yod kyang snying po ci yang med la/ rgyal chen bzhi la'ang ston pas gnyis la yul dbus pa'i skad dang gnyis la mtha' 'khob pa'i skad ste pra kṛ ta rang bzhin pa'i skad du chos bstan pas mthong lam la bkod pa'i phyir/ des na sgra'i e waX kho na la zhen pa spang phyir rtsa bsdus kyi rgyud du sgra'i waṃ ma brjod par don gyi e waX bshad pa yin la/ sdud pa sogs ma ga dha'i skad dang / ma rgyud mang po skad rigs bzhi las gzhan rnal 'byor ma'i kla klo'i skad sogs su gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di 1502

ni bka' thams cad legs sbyar du yod do snyam pa dag gi 'dod par zad do/ /glegs bam gyi thog mar rgya gar skad du smos pa yang gang nas bsgyur ba'i yul shes pa'i ched du ste mdo sde kha cig la rgya nag skad du zhes yod do/ /sgra'i don tshad ma las 'tshol dgos pa ma yin te sgra shes na don la mi rmongs zhes 'chad cing / gzhan yang rjes 'jug shes pa yis/ /don gyi sbyor ba ma mthong yang / /don dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba shes/ /zhes sgra shes na rang skabs kyi don gzhan la ma bsten par rtogs par 'chad pa yin no/ /tshad mas kyang bka'i don 'grel ba ma yin te tshad ma ni bka'i sngon nas mu stegs rtog ge pa rnams la cher grags pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi pa'i tshad mas min yang nang pa'i tshad mas 'grel lo snyam na ma yin te rnam nges las/ rtog ge'i lam gyis chos nyid la khrid na/ /bde gsheṭa bstan las cher bsrings nyams pa yin/ /ston pa bla na med pa'i bstan pa yang / /gal te gzhan du gyur na dpyad pa'i rigs/ /zhes dang / jo bos/ mngon sum rjes dpag dgos pa med/ /mu stegs zlog phyir byas pa yin/ /zhes so/ 'di dag la kun mkhyen bus kyang / /zhes grags so kho bo ni gzhan du sems so zhes bshad pa yin no/ /des na tshad ma la phyi nang gnyis las phyi pa'i tshad ma ni khyad gzhi bdag khas blangs nas yul yul can dang 'grel pa sna tshogs pa rtog pas btags te 'jog pa ste de ni nang pa'i tshad ma'i phyogs snga rnams so/ /nang pa'i tshad ma ni tshad ma zhes pa'i ming kho na phyi pa dang thun mong ba yin gyi don khyad parwa ba yin no/ /spyir gsung rab kyi dgongs par gnas mod kyang khyad par du tshad ma'i rigs par tha snyad btags pa ni 'jam dpal gyis dgra bcom pa chos skyob la gsungs/ des tshad ma'i bstan bcos smra ba'i sgrom zhes pa mdzad/ des mkhas pa rmi dbang lha la bshad/ des dbyig gnyen la bstan/ des tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs kyi glang po la bshad/ des tshad ma'i mdo mdzad cing de'i 1503

yang slob chos kyi grags pas sde bdun mdzad nas dar zhing phyis rje chos grags rgya mtshos bshad bya'i mdo kun las btus bkod/ de la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi bshad lugs gsum bkod/ de nyid la lha/ shā / rgyan sogs kyis ji lta ra bkral ba rnams smos/ yan lag gi bstan bcos bzhi rang skabs su smos pa rirngarwa/sa gzhung rgya mtsho mdzad pa 'di gzur gnas mchis na tshad ma'i legs bshad zla ma mchis par snang ngo / /rgyas 'bring bsdus pa zhes pa'ang tshad mar gyur pa la rgyas bshad yod pas rgyas pa dang tshad ma ngos 'dzin tsam smos pa bsdus pa'o/ /spyir chos kyi grags pa nyid kyis/ rjes su dpag pa ma zlog phyir/ /zhes pa las ma byung yang / 'dir bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /zhes pa'i dpe gsum gyis rjes dpag gsum po rim pas bstan par bzhed cing theg chen gyi mngon pa las dbang shes rtog med du bshad pa dang / mdo gzhan las dge slong dag gzugs shes pa ni rnam pa gnyis te mig dang yid do zhes pas dbang mngon yid mngon bstan pa dang / 'khor lo phyi ma'i mdo du ma las rang rig mngon sum dang / spyir sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas bshad pang rnal 'byor mngon sum bstan zhing / dpe ni mi zhig rgya mtsho'i chu ni lta phyir 'gro ba yis/ /gal te shing dang nags tshal ri mthong da dung ring / /ci ste rtags ma mthong na rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /nye bar gyur to snyam du de la som nyi med/ /sogs dang / bstan bcos las/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chu bzhin du/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyis/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes pa la sogs pas rjes dpag bshad pa yin no/ /des na phyi rol pa'i 'dod pa bkag pas lan ma thebs par khegs/ slar rtags dang mtshan mtshon sogs ji bzhin pa bzhag ste gnyi ga sgrub byed la khas len mthun pa na ston pa sangs rgyas yid 'chis pa'i gnas su bsgrubs nas/ gnas 1504

gsum par ni 'pho pa na/ /bstan bcos len pa rigs ldan yin/ /zhes des bstan pa'i chos la 'gong pa ste tshad ma'i bstan bcos kyi dgos pa de yin no/ /de ltar dpyad nas 'jug pa'i phyi rol pa de ston pa sangs rgyas la yid 'ches pa na des bstan pa'i chos 'dul ba ltar tshul khrims len/ mdo sde dang mngon pa ltar zhi lhag bskyed dgos te de dag gzhung gzhan la rag las pas/ rtog ge'i lam gyis sogs gsungs shing mngon rjes kyi dpyad pa ma zhugs par yang chos nyid rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ mngon sum rjes dpag dgos pa med/ /ces gsungs so/ /des na tshad ma'i bstan bcos kyis nges don gtan mi ston pa ni ma yin te/'phags chen rnams kyis de kho na nyid ma yin pa'i chos ma gzigs pa dang / phyis kyi mkhas grub dag gis tshad ma rnam 'grel 'di chos kyi grags pa'i do ha yin gsung ba don la gnas te/ de phyir gnyis stong gang yin pa/ /de ni de'i yang de nyid yin/ /sogs dang / tshad 'bras kyi mthar thug kyang / chos kyi dbyings gzhal bya/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes tshad ma/ chos nyid ji lta ba rtogs pa 'bras bu zhes thob pa rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi nges don dang / mkhas pa rnams kyis gang gsungs pa/ /de ni dngos stobs 'ongs pa yin/ /zhes dang / stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /zhes spros pa bsal bas 'jug pa zab mo lta ba'i nges don gnyi gar du gnas pa'i phyir/ theg chen yang dag pa'i dbang du byas te theg chen gyi rigs pas dpyad na rang rig kyang tshad ma ma yin te rang gzhan ni rtog pas btags pa yin la rig mi rig kyang bstos zlas bzhag pa'i bstos pa yin pa'i phyir/ dbang yid kyang tshad ma ma yin te/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ mig dang rna ba sna yang tshad ma min/ /lce dang lus dang yid kyang tshad ma min/ /gal te dbang po 'di dag tshad ma na/ /su la 'phags pa'i lam gyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes so/ /nyan rang byang sems kyi mngon sum yang tshad ma min te/ sangs rgyas pa na 1506

mi bden pas slu ba'i phyir/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rjes dpag yang tshad ma ma yin ste me sa gzhi la yod kyang du ba nam mkha' la mthong ba dang me shi yang du ba gnas pa mthong ba'i phyir/ grags pa'i rjes dpag yang tshad ma mi na te/ yin na bdag yod par 'gyur te bdag yod par grags pa'i phyir/ yid 'ches rjes dpag yang tshad ma min te de ni lung yid 'ches su mthong ba yin la don dam pa lung la mi gnas pa'i phyir/ des na rnam pa kun du tshad ma go chod po ni sangs rgyas kho na yin te de'i phyir 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon pos rdo rje'i gsung tshad ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin zhes bzhed pa yin la dbu ma'i rigs pa 'di ni dbu ma pa man la ma grags pas tshad ma rang skabs su tshad ma mi 'grub par thal ba'i skyon yang med do/ /tshad ma la bstan 'gyur na po ti nyi shu rtsa gnyis bzhugs/ tshad ma'i rig pa'i skabs so/ /sgra'i rig pa ni/ sngon sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi gnas su sarba dzñā na de wa ste thams cad mkhyen pa ces bya ba byung / des sarba dzñā bya kā ra ṇa zhes pa'i sgra'i bstan bcos mdzad/ de'i slob ma brgya byin gyis in+d+ra bya kā ra ṇa brtsams/de'i slob ma phur bu nga rgyal gyis dregs pa na brgya byin gyis phyi'i rgya mtsho las chu bum pa gang blangs/ de las kyang ku shas thigs pa gcig blangs te/ sgra'i rig pa mtha' yas pa/ /yongs su rdzogs pa rgya mtsho tsam/ /dbang pos shes pa bum chu tsam/ /phur bus shes pa thigs pa tsam/ /zhes brjod pas phur bu sgyid lug pa na ji ltar shes pa bzhin lha rnams la ston cig par bsgo bas/ tshes brgyad slob dpon nges par 'joms/ /bcu bzhi la ni slob ma 'joms/ /gnam stong la ni rig pa 'joms/ /tshes gcig la ni thams cad 'joms/ /zhes rang nyid bsnyen gnas srung ba'i dus gnyan bzhi spangs te bshad pas lha yul du dar zhing rgyas la lha'i yul skad kyang yin la phur bu la sgra mkhan dang lha'i bla mar grags 1506

so/ /mi yul du bstan pa 'di la dar tshul ni/ laṅkar gshegs pa'i mdor/sgra byed pa ni pā ṇi'o/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ bram ze'i khye'u pā ṇi ni/ /nges par nyan thos byang chub tu/ /nga yis— lung bstan byas pa yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bdag nyid che/ /de nyid de yi sngags grub bo/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas ci zhig na bram ze'i khye'u pā ṇi byung ste sgra shes par 'dod nas lag ris mkhan la lag pa bstan pas sgra shes pa'i mtshan ma 'di lta bu yin te mi 'dug zer bas mtshon gyis mtshan ma bcos pa na/ brtson 'grus 'di lta bu yod na gang yang 'grub bo zer bas spyan ras gzigs bsgrubs pas zla ba drug la zhal mthong ste ci 'dod gsung ba na sgra shes par 'tshal lo zhus pas a i u ces sogs yi ge'i bsdu ba cung zad gnang ba tsam gyis sgra la lhag par mkhas par gyur te pā ṇi bya kā ra ṇa zhes blo ka nyis stong yod pa zhig mdzad/ de la klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas bus 'grel pa ma hā bha ṣa zhes pa slo ka 'bum yod pa zhig mdzad de rtsa 'grel de gnyis la bshad nyan tshar re byed pa la mi'i lo skor re dgos par grags so/ /ka tsan gnyis ni 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi sbyin bdag rgyal po bde spyod bzang pos btsun mo legs sbyar gyi skad cung zad shes pa zhig la khrus kyi tshe chu cung zad gtor bas btsun mos ma mo da kā si ñtsa zhes legs sbyar gyi skad du bdag la chu ma 'thor byas pa rgyal pos phal skad du bdag la la du slang zhes par go nas la du bskur bas btsun mos rgyal rigs ngan pa ba lang lta bu 'di dang lhan cig mi gnas so zer ba na rgyal pos sgra shes par bya'o zhes spro ba bsrings te rgyal po'i zhang po nanya ra warmas garti ka bsgrubs pas zhag bdun na smin drug rma bya la bzhon pa mthong nas sgra shes par 'tshal lo zhus pas/ si t+t+waṃ war+ṇa sa mas+thā la/ grub pa'i yi ge yang dag par brjod pa'o sogs kun bshad rkang bzhi'i bar bstan pa na mkhas par gyur te 1507

'tshal lo zhes smras pas rma bya'i bzhon pa gyen du bskyod nas mjug sgro khra bun gyis mthong ba na/ ka lā pa bzod par gsol lo zhes smras te yi ger bkod la kun bshad rkang pa phyi ma bzhi dang bṛtra rkang pa drug shā ra warma nyid kyis mdzad par grags la/ rgyal po la bslabs pas de ma thag mkhas par gyur te/ bdag gi lag g.yas pad+ma yod/ /g.yon pa na ni ut+pa la/ /yu ba 'jam dang rtsub pa dag /gang 'dod spros shig bzhin bzang ma/ /zhes pa bskur bas dpe med par dga' zhing mgu par gyur to/ /bstan bcos de la durga sidhas 'grel pa dur sing mdzad/ uṇa sogs kyi 'grel pa'ang mdzad/ 'di la le'u nyer lngar 'chad/slob tshul yang dper brjod dngos bestan tsam ston pas rgyal po lugs zer/bram ze grags 'byor gyis nang pa'i slob ma rnams kyi don du 'grel pa slob ma la phan pa mdzad/ lugs 'di la mtshams sbyor la drug pa mi zad pa'i mtshams sbyor te drug dang ming le la bdun pa bud med kyi le'u bsnan pas rkang pa bdun sogs le'u nyer bdun byed cing slob tshul yang dang por bcu bzhi rnams dbyangs so nas dper brjod thams cad byings sgrub 'ba' zhig byed pas dang por slob pa dka' yang ming le tsam shes pa na ka lā pa yongs rdzogs shes par 'gyur bas paṇ+ḍi ta'i slob tshul zhes grags shing mang du mi spel ba las phyis bu dong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan la snar thang lo tsā ba saṃ bha shrīs 'bul ba bgyis nas dar bcug pa yin no/ kha che ra sgrotra ste rin chen gdugs kyis 'grel pa mdzad/ si sogs kyi mtha' dpyad la bram ze paṇa bho ras mdzad pa dang 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad pa gnyis byung / spyan gsum 'bangs kyis dur sing la 'grel pa mdzad/de thams cad bod du'ang 'gyur ro/ /tsan+d+ra pa ni slob ma zhig 'dul ba'i don du tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad/ de la rang gi zhang po snyamarā las 'grel pa stong phrag drug pa dang / seng ge bzang po'i 'grel pa su ban+tu dang / nyi ma'i snying po'i 'asdel pa 1508

grub pa sogs byung zhing / stong phrag drug pa'i 'grel pa'i ta sa tis stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / pūr+ṇa tsan+d+ras de'i 'grel pa stong phrag so drug pa mdzad/tsong rā dzā shrīs ka tsan gnyis ku'i don bsdus pa rā dzā shrī bya kā ra ṇa mdzad /paṇ+ḍi ta smṛ tis bod du bod la phan pa'i phyir smra sgo mtshon cha mdzad/ 'di la a e i o u ra li rnams la rim par drang po mda' lta bu sgreng pa bse ru lta bu bkug pa glang po che'i sna lta bu bstod pa gdugs lta bu dmad pa rkang rten lta bu bsgrims pa me ris lta bu glod pa chu ris lta bu zhes 'chad do/ /bod du'ang sa paṇa gyis mkhas pa'i kha rgyan dang / dpang lo'i brda sprod tshogs gsum gsal ba dang snar thang pa'i slob phan gyi 'grel chen sogs pa gzhung dang gzhan 'grel mang du byung la/ khyad par bod skad la rtags dang rnam dbye ston pa thon mi'i sum rtags gnyis so/ /de ltar skad rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo yin zhibayul dbus na ya rabs rnams skad rigs gzhan la ngo mtshar byed pa'i phyir dang sgra mi shes na ba lang dang 'dra bar grags pa'i phyir mkhas pa'i 'jug bya gcig po yin no/ /sgra'i yan lag gi bstan bcos rig gnas chung ba gzhan bzhi ste mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ tshig rgyan shes na snyan ngag la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs zhes 'chad do/ /de yang mngon brjod ni chos re re la ming gi rnam grangs du ma brjod pa ste slob dpon a mar go las 'chi med mdzod mdzad pa la su bhu ti tsan+d+rag 'grel pa 'dod 'jo mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /sdeb sbyor ni sngon drang srong ser skyas byas pa rtsa ba'i mdo dang de'i dper brjod rgyal ba'i lhas byas pa sogs de thams cad las/ mdor bsdus tshigs bcad gsal ba dang / /mdo nyid dper brjod gyur pa dang / /ma 'dres rim can 'don sla dang / /sdod dang tshogs te yon tan brgyad/ /ces pas khyad par du byas pa sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rang 1509

'grel dang bcas pa slo ba dpon rat+na a kā ra shārtas mdzad/ snyan ngag ni sngon gyi snyan ngag mtha' dag las rmad du byung ba slob dpon dañdzi'am dbyug pa can gyis lhug pa tshigs bcad spel ma gsum gyis lus rnam par gzhag pa/ lam rnam par phye/ don rgyan so lnga/ sgra'i rgyan/ gab tshig bcu drug skyon bcu spang ba rnams kyis rdzogs par bstan pa me long gi bstan bcos mdzad cing / dper brjod ni shar pa'i lam la dpag bsam 'khri shing dang lho pa'i lam la dpa' bo'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa lta bu'o/ /zlos gar ni sngon byung gi gtam bzhin gyi gzugs byas te skad rigs so so'i gtam dang glu zlos shing gar byed pa ste rgyal po sprin gyi gzhon pas klu'i srog bskyabs pa'i skyes rabs klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar dga' ba'i lhas mdzad pa dang / gtsug na nor bus gtsug gi nor bu'i bar btang nas bram ze'i dbul ba bsal phyir rang 'tshong du bcug ste dgra la ster du bcug pas thams cad btul ba'i skyes rabs 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa la sogs pa'o/ /spyir bod du thog mar sgrung dang lde'u dang bon gyis blo kha phye/ yig rtsis sogs dar bas blo rnon por gyur pa na bstan pa dngos phebs pa ltar spyir 'jig rten du yang thun mong gi rig gan ca/ bzhis blo gros rnon por gyur pa na bstan pa dngos 'byung ba yin pas 'di dag bstan pa dngos la mi stos mod kyang rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga gsung rab las mi 'byung ba ni ma yin te/ rnga bo che las/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i skad kyi byings ni mkhas shing rtogs pa'i skad kyi byings yin te sangs rgyas kyi skad kyi byings dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i skad kyi byings ni de lta bu yin no/ /zhes skad kyi byings bshad pa dang / rgyud du mar/ yi ge a dang yi ge u/ /zhes sogs sgra sgrub dang /— dus 'khor las/ thig le zla ba rtsa ba sku/ /zhes sogs e waṃ gyi sgra sgrub dang / mdo'i tshigs bcad rnams la snyan ngag gi rgyan shin tu legs pa 1510

dpag dka' ba dang sgrig pa la ma stos pa'i sdeb sbyor yod pa dang / re re'ang ming gi mngon brjod du mas brjod par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na mdo dran nye las snyan ngag gtso bor byed pa rnams lha yul gyi bya gzhan la tshigs bcad kyis bskul zhing rang bag med du sdod par skye ba dang / des na dge slong gis thos pa ngan pa snyan ngag sdeb par mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni 'dod pa'i gtam gyi snyan ngag mi bya bar dgongs pa ste de ma thag tu sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la bstod pa dang bstan pa gsal bar 'gyur ba'i snyan ngag bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /des na snyan ngag me long gi mjug dgos pas don bsdu ba'i skabs su/ de ltar skyon bral skal bzang ldan pa yi/ /snyan ngag bzang pos dkon mchog rnam gsum gyi/ /yon tan tshul bzhin rab tu bsngags byas na//grags dang 'byor dang rgyal mchog 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes mkhas pa la 'os pa'i don bsdu bdag gis kha bkang ba yin no/ /sgra'i skabs so//bzo rig pa la spyir rnam par ma gyur pa sems kyi bzo ni 'khor 'das ji ltar 'byung ba sogs thams cad de/ nang rig pa rnams kyang 'dir gtogs so//brjod pa sgra'i bzo ni ngag gi 'gyur ba ste sgra snyan ngag dang dbyangs dang glu dang brjod pa thams cad 'dir 'dus so/ /rnam par gyur pa dbyibs kyi bzo la byed pa po dang ma 'brel pa 'jig rten chags pa sogs dang / tsho byed po dang 'brel ba skabs 'di'i bzo nyid do/ /de'i yang gtso bo sku gsung thugs rten yin la de las thog mar byung ba ni ri mo ste/ sngon mi rnams tshe lo 'bum las bri ba'i tshe mi'i rgyal po 'jigs thul zhes bya ba byung ste des chos bzhin sa bskyangs pas tshe lo 'bum du 'phel zhing shin tu bde bar gyur/ de nas rgyal po des dka' thub chen po spyad pas dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad thob cing tshangs pas lha'i mtshon dang dmag gis kyang mi'i yul mi phebs pa dang bstan bcos thams cad shes pa'i 1511

mchog byin no/ /de'i tshe bram ze zhig gi ba gzhon na gces pa zhig blo bar da ring ring ring ring shi bas bram ze des rgyal po khyod kyis rgyal srid chos bzhin ma bskyangs pa 'dra ste khyod kyi 'bangs la dus min gyi 'chi ba byung ste bdag gi bu phrogs so/ /bu slar ma bstsal na bdag 'di gar lceb bo zhes byas pas rgyal pos bram ze khrid de gshin rje'i rgyal po nyi ma ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba'i drung du phyin te phyag btsal nas bram ze'i bu bstsal du gsol byas pas bdag gis ma lan te rang rang gi las su zad do/ /rgyal pos byin cig dang gshin rjes mi rung ngo yang yang smras te mthar g.yul bshams te phan tshun mtshon cha'i char phab cing rgyal pos lha'i mtshon gyi char gyis gshin rje'i 'khor thams cad pham par byas pas gshin rjes kyang dbyug pa thogs shing rgyal pos kyang dbyug pa tshangs mgo can thogs te 'jig rten thams cad dngangs pa na tshangs pa byon te so so'i las su zad kyis gshin rjes ma nyes so/ /'on kyang bram ze'i bu ri mor bris shig zhes pa ltar rgyal pos bris te tshangs pas gson por bslangs te brasnya ze la gtad/ yi dwags gcer bu zer bas de btul bas legs so zhes rgyal po la gcer thul dang dang por ri mo bri ba po yin pas dang por bri pa zhes btags/ tshangs pas bsgo ste rgyal pos kyang gshin rje la phyag dang mchod pa byas te kun dga' bar gyur to/ /slar rgyal pos tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du song ste ri mo bri tshul zhus pas/ ri yi mchog ni ri rab yin/ /sgo nga las skyes rnams kyi ni/ /gtso bo nam mkha' lding yin no/ /mi yi gtso bo sa bdag ste/ /de bzhin ri mo sgyu rtsal gtso/ /sogs dang / rgyal po de bzhin sgyu rtsal kun/ /ri mo'i las la yang dag bsten/ /zhes sogs kyis bsngags nas bi shā garmas ston par lung bstan zhing des 'khor los bsgyur ba'i tshad gtso bor byas te tshad dang mi ldan pa'i nyes pa/ ldan pa'i phan yon sogs bstan zhing / lus la mdzes pa ma tshang na/ /tshad dag gis ni ci zhig bya///512

zhes mdzes dgos par yang bstan pa la sogs ri mo'i mtshan nyid tshangs patī tshad yig zhes bya ba drang srong ma te'i bus sbyar ba las byung ba/ khyad par du dus kyi 'khor lo dang bde mchog sdom 'byung las gsungs so/ /phyi rabs rgyud 'di dag gi dgongs par kha g.yar ba'i chag tshad kyi bstan bcos snang ba ni de dag gi dgongs pa min par mthong ste bde dgyes sogs sku sgeg cing rgyas pa dgos pa la skam po phra ring du byed pa dang / phyag mtshan 'chol pa dogs pa'i rgyud gcig gnyis yod la/ slob dipon a bhu kā ras phyag mang g.yas rnams yas 'gyed dang g.yon rnams mas 'gyed du byed/ gzhan bris sku rgya gar ma dang li ma 'di tsam zhig la phyag mtshan yas 'gyed kho na yod pa la phyag mtshan rnams mas 'gyed kho na byed pa dang / g.yas brkyang sogs la mtho lngar bshad pa'i gdan gyi bzhi cha ma non pas rgyal pos rgyal sa ma non pa sogs 'di byung ba yin pas gnad bcos pa 'di rnams dor na legs so/ /rig pa'i gnas thams cad dang grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa kun gyi'ang yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ni yi ge kho na yin zhing kun la med du mi rung ba ni bri klog kho na yin pas nan tan bya'o/ /spyir be+e shā garmas bstan pa'i bzo mtha' dag gi bstan bcos yod rigs kyang bod du ma 'gyur bar snang la bi shā kurma ni 'jam dbyangs dkar po yin par bal po rnams 'dod par snang ste bstod pa la'ang sha shabha ra kho na 'don par snang ngo / /gzo rig pa'i skabs so//sman mchog byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi yis/ /dug gsum nad chen drungs nas 'byin mdzad pa/ /sman pa'i gtso bo dpal ldan bla ma la/ /btud nas gso rig ji ltar byung ba brjod/ /de yang chos dang nor dang 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa'i rten gyi gtso bo mi lus rin po che mi na bar bde bar gnas pa dang / na ba las gso bar byed pa thar pa 'dod mi 'dod kun la med du mi 1513

rung ba ni gso ba rig pa ste/ de ji ltar byung tshul la/ phyi rol pa ni/ gang phyir tshangs pa yi ni zhal/ /dbus ma nas ni tshe'i rig byed/ /ces sogang kyis snyan tshig mchod sbyi na srid srung nges brjod de rig byed/bzhi/ brla/ba pa/ brda sprod/ sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis/ thos pa/ rtog pa ste yan lag drug dran pa dang chos ste nye ba'i yan lag gnyis dang bcas tshangs pa'i zhal bzhi la sa byung bar 'chad do/ /sha li ho tra sogs las sngon rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las byung bar 'chad pa ni dus 'khor sogs las bkag la/ zla zer du ni/ yi ge oX dang a tha'i sgra/ /gnyis po 'di dag sngon tshangs pa'i/ khur tshos rdol te mngon par byung / /zhes sogs drangs so/ /tshangs pas skye rgu'i bdag po myur ba/ des nyi ma'i chung ma nyi ldan ma'i sna las skyes pas sna skyes sam tha skar la skyes pas tha skar skyes dang kun 'gyed bu ste tha skar bu gnyis/ des brgya byin/ tshangs pas gso dpyad 'bum pa sogs de rnams kyi gzhung so sor byas/ brgya byin la lha'i drang srong rgyun shes/ 'od zer can/ 'od yangs/ yan lag skyes/ lha min 'joms/mchod sbyin can/ gnas 'jog ste slob ma gtsug phud can bdun du grags pa pha dang ma mi'i bud med 'dus pa las bu byung ba ni drang srong rgyun shes kyi bu (nab so skyes kyang zer)/ me bzhin 'jug thang la 'bar/ rkang gnyis spyod/ mu khyud 'dzin/ 'gro skyong bu/ gshol 'gro skyes rnams kyis brgya byin dang pha las thos te gzhung 'grelā re byas shing / de nas drang srong lug rgya skyegs sna/ mda'i mchog lan tshwa'i lag dpal ldan phreng ba/ dpal ldan phun tshogs/ nyi snying /zla ba'i 'od zer sogs kyis gzhung mang du byas sha li ho tra/ legs thos/ dza las rgyal sogs kyis rgyas par byas te rdo 'jog gi sman pa rgyun shes kyi bu'i bar du byung ngo / /spyir /rikhor los bsgyur ba'i gso dpyad kyi gzhung yod nga ra bshad do/ /mi yul du dar tshul la/ sngon bcud chags nas ring po ma lon pa na shed 1514/

bu zhig sa zhag ma zhu bar na ste smre sngags 'don pa na tshangs pas 'ongs te chu skol btang bas zhi ste nad pa la snga ba shed bu/ sman pa la snga ba tshangs pa/ mi na la snga ba chu skol zhes grags so/ /spyir rig pa'i gnas thams cad dang por sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mthu las byung ba dang / tshangs pa'ang bskal bzang gi sems dpa' yin pas sangs rgyas kyi mthu las byung ba yin no/ /sman dpyad nyid kho na bstan pa'i mdo rgyud phed mod kyang zhar byung 'dul ba las dge slong nad pas sman pa la dris te bya'o zhes lung sman gyi gzhir bshad pa dang / 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i byung ba dang / sman pa nad dang sman la mkhas pa'i dpes sangs rgyas kyi rga nad 'chi ba sel bar gsungs pa dang / gser 'od du chu 'bebs kyi byung ba'i skabs su/ zla gsum dbyar te zla gsum ston du shes/ /gsum ni dgun te gsum ni dpyid yin no/ /de ltar zla ba'i go rim dus ni drug /lo gcig la ni zla ba bcu gnyis 'dod/ /gsum gsum du ni tshigs rnams bsdus par shes/ /zla ba gnyis gnyis kyis ni dus su bstan/ /zas dang skom ni de ltar 'ju bar 'gyur/ /sman dag dang ni khams dang dus kyang bstan/ /dbang po dang ni khams rnams de dag kyang / /lo gcig nang gi tshigs tshigs yongs su 'gyur/ /dbang po dag ni yongs su 'gyur bas na/ /lus can rnams la sna tshogs nad kyang 'byung / /de nyid la ni sman pas zla gsum bzhi/ /tshigs kyi bar dang dus drug rnams dang ni/ khams drug mkhas par bya ba shes par bya/ /zas skom sman rnams go rim ji bzhin te/ /rlung gi shas che'i nad ni dbyar na ldang / /ston du gyur pa na ni mkhris pa g.yo/ /dgun gyi dus su de bzhin 'dus pa ste/ /bad gan shas che'i nad ni dpyid ldaX ngo / /dbyar ni snum dro lan tsha skyur ba'i ro/ /ston ni mngar dang snum dang bsi' bag go /dgun ni mngar dang skyur dang snum pa ste/ /dpyid kyi dus na rtsub dro tsha pa'o/ /bad gan che ba 1515

zos ma thag tu sdang / /mkhris pa che ba 'ju ba'i dus su ldang / /rlung shas che ba zhu ma thag tu ldang / /nyes gsum g.yo ba de ni de lta'o/ /rlung gi bdag nyid la ni bcud kyis gso/ /bkru sman gyis ni mkhris pa bsal bar bya/ /'dus pa la ni gsum dang mthun ldan pa/ /bad kun tshigs su bab na skyugs sman btang //rlung shas che ba mkhris dang 'dus pa dang / /bad gan shas che'i tshigs rnams shes par bya/ /dus gang khams gang lus ni gang yin pa/ /de yi sman dang zas skom bste na par bya'o/ /zhes blo ka dgu po 'dis gso rig mtha' dag bstan pa yin te/ nyi ma yar ngo la zlog pa dbyar dgun ra ba dang / mar ngo la zlog pa dbyar dgun 'bring bor bzung ba'i zla ba gsum gsum gyis dbyar dgun ston dpyid bzhi/ yang dus mtshams bzhi la zhag bco brgyad res zhag don gnyis/ dus bzhi la zhag don gnyis re ste tshigs bcad phyed dang gnyis kyi dus dang / tshigs bcad gcig gis gso bya lus/ tshig rkang gnyis kyis nad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ tshigs bcad gcig gis dus dang bstun dgos pa/ tshigs bcad gcig gis dus bzhi la nad gang ldang ba/ gcig gis de'i gnyen por zas sman gang bsten pa/ gcig gis nyes gsum ldang ba'i dus/ de nas gcig gis rlung la 'jam rtsi las mi 'da'/ mkhris pa sbyongs las mi 'da'/ ban kun skyugs las mi 'da' ba mi 'da' ba'i bcos gsum ste sel thabs/ rkang pa gnyis kyis ldan 'dus shes dgos pa dang / gnyis kyis don bsdus pa ste sman gzhung mtha' dag 'dir 'dus so/ /gser 'od che ba rgya 'gyur du/ nad kyi gso dpyad la bsten nas/ /sogs de bas mang bar bsgyur/ myang 'das chen por rgyal por shes rab 'chal pa la sman pa blun po yod pa sman pa mkhas pas thabs kyis bskrad pa'i dpe dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ de nas sems can kun phan phyir/ /thams cad snying por bsdus pa yi/ /sgrub pa'i 1 516

sbyor ba bdud rtsi mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /ga bur daX ni gur kum dang / /nas/ de ltar rdzas ni bco brgyad po/ /sogs dang / 'das pa'i dus su sngon byung ba/ /bde chen bskal pa dang po ru/ /so gas dang / dngul chu'i byung ba dang / ro drug gi sde tshan/ sman dang rin po che rnams kyi yul bzang ngan sogs dang / nyes gsum ldang ba'i dus sogs kyi mthar/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can rnams kyi don du sbyar bar bya bas phyi nang gi sman gyi sbyor pa 'di dag bslab par bya'o/ /sogs dang / dub/ 'khor du/ rlung 'joms lan tshwa skyur pa dag du rab tu 'gyur te mngar dang ska ba dag ni mkhris pa'i dgra/ /sogs du ma bshad do/ /bstan bcos ni klu sgrub zhabs kyis sbyor ba brgya pa 'tsho ba'i mdo tshigs su bcad pa rtsa a wa'i cho ga dngul chu rin chen phreng ba gser 'gyur sbyor pa rnams mdzad/ snga rabs pa rnarmas mdo lnga/ dpyad gzhung bcu sogs mdzad zer yang rgya gzhung gi mtshan nyid med do/ /slob dpon dpa' bos yan lag brgyad pa chen po/ yan lag brgyad pa la 'jug pa/ de'i snying po bsdus pa/ yan lag brgyad pa bsdus pa ste bzhi mdzad/ khyad par snying po bsdus pa rtsom tshe/ sa gsum dge legs 'byung ba yi/ /dge ba'i ltas ni sna tshogs byung / /zhes bshad/ gzhung de la rang 'grel yang mdzad do/ kha che zla dga' ni slob dpon gyi sras dang dngos slob tu grags kyang skra sbyor nges par/chags la mngon par dga' ba'i bu/ /zla ba mngon dga' zhes bya bas/ ces dang / zla zer las/ bdag gi mes por gyur pa ni/ /dpal chen dge ba zhes grags yin/ /de ni da lta'ang sa gsum na/ /grags pa dri med sgrog par byed/ /de sras chags la mngon par dga'/ /de'i bu zla ba mngon dga' bdag /slob dpon blo gros chen po ni/ /rgyud shes don ldan ming btags pa/ /don dam zhes bya sman pa'i mchog kha che'i yul du skyes pa yin/ /zhes dpal chen dge 1517

ba'i sras chags la mngon dga' de'i sras zla dga' yin ba dang kha che'i sman pa ngon mchog gi slob ma yin la/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i gzhung rnams la brten nas snying po bsdus pa la 'grel pa tshig don zla zer/ sman ming zur du bkol pa sgra sbyor nges pa sogs mdzad/ brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed kyi khog dbu/ba legs snang sgron mer/ kha che zla dga' slob dpon dpa' bo'i dngos slob tu byar/ nang de nas dga' byed dam pa yul can snying po kun 'tsho dam pa rigs rgyal gzhon nu nges pa brnyed pa rlung mkhris 'joms/ gso ba dag pa 'gro ba'i pha rgan 'tsho byed grub pa nges pa'i mthu can g.yo med stobs ldan bhu dz+dzar ma tshe brtan lhas byin thabs kyi dge bsnyen rtse mung dang mchog dza na ra dha na zhes 'dod cing / che rje zhang ston gyi rgyal mtshan rtse 'bar du ni/ 'tsho byed grub pas zla dga' la thug par 'dod/ mi nyag mi skyod rdo rje sogs ni/ slob dpon dpa' bo/ bdud rtsi zla ba dga' byed dam pa zhes sogs 'dod de yan lag brgyad pa gtso bor ston pa rgya gar du dar tshul lo//rgya nag tu ni 'jam dpal gyes byin gyis brlabs te rgyal blon dang ha shang dang ni tso sogs kyis bshad de ci 'u'i skabs nas dar ro/ /bod du sman dpyad byung ba'i thog ma ni zas spyod spang blang phra mo shes pa tsam sngon nas byung ba/ gzhung rgya bza'as sman dpyad chen mo zhes pa bsnams ha shang ma ha de wa dang dharma ko ṣas bsgyur/ de'i tshe rgya gar nas badz+ra dh+wa dza/ rgya nag nas nyen phreng hang de/ stag gzig gi khrom nas ga le nos ste sman pa gsum spyan drangs/so so'i lugs du ma bsgyur/ thun mong du mi 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha zhes bam po bdun pa brtsams/ ga le nos bla sman du bzhugs/ rus chung ba bzhi slob tu bstsal te rigs mtho dman mede par slob par gnang / phyis gyim shang kong jos rtsis dang sman dpyad mang du bsnams/ ha shang ma hā thi tha dang rgya phrug gar 1518

mkhan la sogs pas so ma ra tsa le'u brgya dang bco lnga pa sogs bsgyur/ de'i tshe khro ma nas bi ci tsan pa shi la ha bya ba spyan drangs/ rgyal po'i rje yin zhes lha rjer / btags te thams cad kyis blar bkur ba gral gyi dgung la 'jog pa stan bzang du 'ding pa zas skom spyan gzigs kyi mchog stob pa skyel bsu rtas byed pa yon gser du 'bul ba byas pa drin du gzo ba sogs kyi bkar btags/ sman pa rnams kyis kyang khyim mtshes nas bos kyang skyel baspu dang zhabs gla/ gnyen tshan yin yang lag dkar dang zhu rten/ bran khol yin yang bkur sti dang gus pa/dus min du phrad kyang mdongs gsol dang bsnyen bkur/ dgra bo yin yang dad gus kyis blo gtod pa/ zas nor la 'dod sred byas rung skur ba mi 'debs/nad pa gso ba la zhu 'bul/ drag nas gtang rag rting bskul sgye'u skyel sogs bco lnga gtsigs su bzung / mnga' bdag gis sman pa bla ma dang pha yin pas byams pa bskyed/ nad pa bu dang slob ma yin pas mtshang ngan phyir ma brjod/mdzangs kyi khrel 'chor bas khyim nas lag ngan ma byed/ ya rabs kyi tshul la gnod pas zas la ma ngan/ sman dpyad la lag nyes yong pas chang la ma dga'/zug gcog pa la khyad yod cing thal nyen yod pas le lo dang tshod yod ma byed/sman dpyad gnad du mi phog pas nad pa la ngo tsha dang tshul 'chos ma byed ces zhal ta bdun mdzad/ byang khog le'u lnga bcu pa sogs dpyad rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i sman dpyad kyi bstan bcos mang du byung / gzhan yang rgya gar nas shārta gar+bha/ kha che nas gu h+ya badz+ra/ rgya nag nas stong gsum gang ba/ ha shang ba la hang shi ba ta/ stag gzig nas ha la shārti/ gru gu nas se mdo 'od chen sogs spyan drangs te bla sman dgur grags/ gzhung mtha' yas pa bskyur stong gsum gang ba bod du bzhugs te g.yor stod gnang nas mtha' bzhir grags te bla sman gyi gtso sdo'o/ /bai ci'i slob ma stong gnyer mes po/ thang ti rgyal mnyes/ zhang 1519

lha mo gzigs rnams kyang mkhas par gyur te rgyal po'i bla sman du bkur skad/mnga' bdag rtse lde'i dus su o rgyan nas rgyal po'i chad pas bsad du phangs nas sprugs pa'i drang srong me lha zhes bya ba mkhas pa phul du byung ba byon te rde skor phyi nang gsang gsum sogs mdzad cing gzhung mang du bsgyur/ khyad par yan lag brgyad pa ni paṇ+ḍi ta dza na ra dha na lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po la gser slong du bod du byon/ myang 'das seng ge sgra stag phri ye shes 'byung gnas/ yod sman a me/ mang mo sman btsun ste mnga' ris kyi sman pa mi bzhi dang bcas 'gyur yon gser srang brgya phul te snying po bsdus pa rtsa 'grel kha che dkar po'i yig sna las nyi thigs zla thigs yan lag nag po'i rgyud sogs bsgyur ro/ /lo chen rin bzang gi slob ma mang mo sman btsun la che rje ti bam nas bzung ste che rje'i brgyud pa la che rje zhig po sogs mkhas pa mang du byung / yang lo chen gyi slob ma zhang zhung pa shes rab 'od/ des rgya ston grags pa shes rab/ des g.yu thog rgya gar rdo rje/ yang zhang zhung pa nas rngog gyod sman g.yung drung 'od/ g.yu thog grags pa/ g.yu thog mgon po/ yang yar lung pa zhang gzi brjid 'bar gyis dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi dgu bsten yang yid ma tshim ste rgya gar du byon/ rngog lo chen po la sgra mkhas par sbyangs te sman la mkhas pa drang srong tsan+d+ra pi bya ba la yan lag brgyad pa thugs nas tshar gcig dang / gzabs bshad sag len dang bcas pa tshar gcig gsan/ yig sna rtsoms gsungs pas gzhung dri med gzi brjid rtsa 'gre' sogs dang gdams pa sum bcu pa rtsa 'grel sogs mdzad/slob ma chung gsum rog dang bzhi nye gnas skyogs dang lnga bya ba sogs byung /stod ston dkon mchog skyabs kyis rgya gar du shārti pa phyi ma la sbyangs/ de so soja/ kyang yig cha mang du ma‘dzad/ rgyud pa'i bka' thams cad g.yu thog mgon po la babs so/ /yul gru sna tshogs nas bod du sman dpyad ji ltar byung ba'i skabs 1520

so/ /sman gyi gzhung man ngag thams cad kyi snying po rgyud bzhi ni g.yu thog mgon po ces bya ba sprul pa'i sku dngos su byon pa/ bod du grags pa'i gzhung man ngag thams cad kyi bka' babs pa/ rgya gar du lan drurgo byon/ shog dril bskor gsum las/ kho bo g.yu thog mgon po yis/ /lo brgyad lon nas sman dpyad bskyangs/ /ces sogs bsdus na myang stod 'bre dang khyung gi yul nas gdung 'bre/lugs gnyis la dbang 'byor ba rgya gar rdo rje zhes bya ba'i mkhas pa des rgya raṭa ka pa phrang gi gzhi bdag gi nad bsal pas bud med g.yu rgyan shin du mchor ba'i ro dang spud de g.yu thams cad khang thog tu bdal bas g.yu thog par thogs/ drang srong drug bcu bsgrubs pas drug dngos su byon te brgyud pa byin gyis brlabs/ sras brjid po grags se khyung po gsum byung / brjid po'i sras 'bum seng mched gnyis/ khyung po'i sras yon tan mgon po 'di yin/ 'dis drang srong tsa ra ka la sogs bsten/ khyad par ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal ldan 'phreng mas rjes su bzung ste yan lag brgyad pa bsil zer gyi gnad rgyud rigs drug bcu rtsa lnga sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/ sman gyi lha mos rjes su bzung ste zhus lan skor gsum sogs dang rma rtsi 'chi med bcad 'byor sogs gsan/ 'jigs pa chen po du ma las lha mos bskyabs/ gzhan yang rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa yin pas mu stegs kyi ston pa grags pa can lnga brgya btul/ rdo rje gdan du paṇa grub mang po'i tshogs dpon mdzad/ dpal gyi ri'i lam du lta stangs kyis byag pa thams cad rengs/ o rgyan du sha za mkha' 'gros thog phab pa la sdigs mdzub bstan pas mkha' 'gro 'gyel/sid+ngha la'i gling du chu dbus su gru zhig pa'i tshe nam mkhar 'phur te grogs rnams bsgral/ dug sbrul gyi kha rlangs sprin ltar gtibs pa snying rje bsgoms pas zhi/ stag gzig gi yul du ri la ma thogs par byon/ bal bor bon dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran 1521

tshe nam mkhar nyin phyed bzhugs/ rdo rje gdan nas bod du nyin bcig gis byon/tshong 'dus mgur mor nyi ma gtod la mnan zhing a ru ra gse/ra ma dog gi/ char phab/ de sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa bstan/ shangs dpal skyed du bzhugs nas dgung lo don drug gi bar 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ sku gdung ma bayi ga par 'od du yal bar grab/sa/ 'di nyid mchog gi sprul sku dngos yin zhing khong rang gi bzhugs gnas de'i shar na spang ri sngo sman mang po skye ba spos ngad ldang dang 'dra ba dang lho na sngo sman tsha ba skye ba byang na gangs ri dang bsil sman skye ba nub na nags tshal sogs cha mthun yod pas khong rang gi bzhugs gnas de sman gyi 7 grong khyer lta na sdug dang thugs chos kyi dbyings sangs rgyas sman gyi bla dang kun rtog sna tshogs pa rnams 'khor sde bzhi dang rtsom 'dod kyi rtog pa drang srong yid las skyes dang rig pa'i ngo bo drang srong rig pa'i ye shes —su mdzad nas rgyud bzhi bshad do zhes rje phrin las zhabs gsungs la/ thun mong gi snang ba de nyid la snang ba dag pa'i gdul bya'i ngor gleng gzhir ji ltar bshad pa ltar snang ba yang mi 'gal lo zhes bdag sems so/ /'o na gleng gzhi bka' ltar bcos pas nongs so zhe na sangs rgyas kyi mthus byin gyis brlabs te sprul pa'i sku de'i thugs la rang byung du shar ba yin pas ches ngo mtshar to/ kha cig sangs rgyas sman bla lkenyid kyi bka' 'dod pa dang ri rab kyi rtser rnam snang du sprul nas rnal 'byor rgyud gsungs pa ltar shakya'i dbang po nyid kyi sprul bshad du 'dod pa dang gter mar ོ'dod pa dang rtsa rgyud bzhi chung ngu zhig yod pa la 'dis rgyas par mdzad par 'dod pa sogs mang na'ang mdzad po de sprul pa'i skur 'bras bu'i rtags kyis nges la reg pa rtsa dang mthong ba chu la brtag pa ni gzhung gzhan na med pas 'dzam gling na sman dpyad kyi gzhung la rgyud bzhi las mchog tu gyur pa mi srid par 'dug 4 cing khyad par pod kyi yul dus dang 'tshams pa 'di'i bka' drin gzhal du med 1522

pas sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin du spyi bor blang ngo / /jo bo'i lam yig rnying pa kha cig las/ jo bo bod du byon dus bod na sman med pas nga'i sman dpyad 'di nub 'gro dgongs/ bod du phebs nas sgrol mas ne tsor mdzad de sman gzigs su gshegs gsungs nas ri lung kun bstan pas rgya gar gyi sman kun la bod na tshab re 'dug la lhag par bod kyi sman nus pa che bar 'dug gsungs jo bos snye thang du yan lag brgyad pa gsungs pa brag rgyab kyi sman pa kha cig gis zhus pas mkhas par gyur/ de dag gi zin bris g.yu thog mgon po'i phyag tu byung bas mkhas par gyur te jo bo'i sman rgyun yin zhes kyang snang / 'dis yan lag brgyad pa che chung gi snying po yan lag bsdus pa dang mdo gnas dang po'i 'grel pa mthong ba me long mdzad cing gzhung la smar mchan btab/ spyir rtsa dpyad reg pa rang gsal/ sde tshan lnga dang lag len pod chung / rgyud chung bdud rtsi snying po/man ngag shog dril skor gsum/ gser gyi lde mig skor drug mdzad/༄ rgyud la gser mchan dang zong mchan gnyis btab/ 'dis cha lag bco brgyad mdzad zer yang khog dbub khyung chen lding ba dang gtong thun mdzes pa'i 'ja' ris ni tha snyad shin tu mi mdzes pas gzhan gyi kha g.yar du zad la/ ṭīka mun sel sgron me dang / gegs sel rtsod ldog 'khor lo/ 'bum chung gsal sgron sogs kyang rje ye shes gzungs sogs rjes 'breng gis byas par 'dod do/ /g.yu thog pas mdzad nges pa gzhan yang skor tshom bcu gcig rin chen gter spungs/ smar khrid yig chung gab pa bco brgyad/ med thabs med pa rnam gsum/ kha 'thor rin — spungs/ zab pa rnam gsum/ ngo mtshar bzhi phrugs/ bdud rtsi snying po/ mu tig phreng ba/ sngo 'bum chen mo/ 'bum ther/ thor bu me len/ deb chings rgyogs solaca/ kyi dpe ris/ byang khog rtsa bka chu pra'i 'khor lo che chung / gso ri ga gis mchog sgrub thabs bla ma gsang sgrub kyi skor sogs mdzad/ slob ma sa'i 1523

rdul tsam byung yang gtso bo ljang sman leb be/ 'bal sman nyi ma dpal/ rdza ye shes gzungs/ ston pa a tshes pa/ shag ram nyi ma dpal/ g.yu thog bsod seng / sum ston ye shes gzungs/ dge bshes rog chung sogs byung la/ g.yu thog 'bum seng gi slob ma 'bal nyi ma dpal gyis gces bsdus yid bzhin nor bu brtsams/ de'i slob ma brang ti 'jam dpal bzang pos le'u dang po'i 'grel pa 'bum ṭīka gsal ba mdzad/ des brang ti rgyal ba bzang po/ des brang ti dpal ldan 'tsho byed de 'dis brgyad pa'i khog dbub gces bsdus/ mdo gnas sum bcu'i sam 'grel sogs mdzad/ 'di'i slob ma brang ti dpal ldan rgyal mtshan te 'di gnyis 'phrin las shin tu che'o/ /gzhan yang mang sgom chen gyis gsal byed me long / g.yu thog bkra shis mgon gyis le grangs kyi bsdus don/'phel zad ro sbyor/ ni ru ha'i las rim mtshan nyid nyi shu sogs mdzad/ g.yu thog rgyal tshas gtong thun chen mo lung drangs nyi ma'i snying po mdzad/ che rje shākya dpal gyis le'u dang po'i ṭīka zla zer me tog bya mo khud pa ye shes bzang pos ṭīka shin tu rgyas pa don gsal nyi ma'i snying po/ mtha' bzhi shī la sam bha was khog dbub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ mi nyag rdo rje 'bum gyis zab 'grel/ rdza jo gzungs kyis spyi khog gsal ba/ gshag ram nyi ma dpal gyis bshad 'bum nyi ma'i 'od zer/ rog ston gyis tshig don gsal byed 'bum ṭīka/ khon dpal chen 'od pos brgyad chung nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ sa paṇa gyis brgyad pa'i don bsdus dang rgyal po'i dkor mdzod/ bcom ral pas gso rig rgyan gyi me tog grub thob o rgyan bas dngul chu'i bstan bcos/ rje rang byung bas brgyad pa'i snying po sdus pa dar sman rnams kyi nus pa bstan pa/ sgra pa shes rin pas khog dbub dang lag len gces bsdus/ stod sman 'tsho byed gzhon nus snying po bsdus pa/ skyor lung pa don yod dpal gyis mchan bu hor bar can sogs 'di phal cher yan lag 1524

brgyad pa la bsten pa yin la/ brgyud bzhi la'ang rjes 'breng gis 'grel pa mang du byung ngo / /phyis sman dpyad gzugs brnyan du gyur pa na dgas po la thog zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje de spyir chos du ma la mnga' 'byor yang khyad par sman dpyad kyis 'phrin las bskyangs te man ngag bye— ba ring srel grangs can grangs med dang bla sgrub gegs sel sogs mdzad de gso rig gi bstan pa gzhi nas gsos/phyis sman pa mkhas pa mang da byang ba ni 'di kho na'i bka' drin yin no/ khog ༄ ༄dbub rnams las bka' dngos dang klu sgrub dang rigs gsum mgon po sogs kyis mdzad zer ba sogs mdzad byang dang 'gyur byang bzang po smos pa rnams khungs de ltar smos pa tsam du zad la/ rgyal po'i bla sman dgu yang stod na be+e ji che rje phug pa gsum/ smad na gnya' dang stong dang mtha' bzhi gsum/ bar na g.yu thog brang ti mi nyag gsum zer yang 'di thams cad chos rgyal gyi dus na dus mnyam du yod pa min la phyis rim pas byung ba yin no/ /spyir yongs su grags pa'i sman pa chen po drug bcu rtsa lnga'am don gcig gam brgya dang bzhi zhes grags pa'i lo chen rin bzang la paṇ+ḍita ltar mkhas pa gcig ces dang / skyes bu me lha nam mkha' ltar khyab pa gcig dang / myang sman lo tsā dang stod sman stag chung ni nyi zla ltar grags pa gnyis dang / de bzhin du rgyal po'i bla sman dgu o rgyan pa sogs sprul pas 'gro don mdzad pa bcu/ mang mkhar 'tsho byed dkon skyabs sogs sbyangs stobs kyis che ba drug g.yu thog mgon po sogs sman bla lta bu bcu/ snye mdo kun don sogs las 'phro sad pa bcu/ gze sman nag po sogs dpyad mgo so sor thon pa bcu/ nyang ro stong gsum grags sogs grags pa blo bur du thon pa bcu/ 'bal nyi ma dpal sogs grags pa hor gyis bton pa lnga/byang khog la nang byan tshud pas bcos log kyang 'tsho ba brtson 'grus seng ge/thur dpyad la nang byan tshud pas dpyad thal yang 'tsho ba sba ras lha rje ste dpyad 1525

la nang byan tshud pa gnyis zhes don gcig dang / yang 'jang pa ye shes blo gros sogs srog 'ing lta bu gcig ces sogs bsnan nas lnga dang bzhir 'dod pa ngang / yang lo tsā ba zhwa ser can sogs dar byed kun la grags pa lnga bcu rtsa brgyad ces kyang sgrog cing de rnams kyi ring la bcos gang dar ba yang / shān+ti gan+tas 'dze nad sman gso dar/ /sogs dang / lo chen rin 'brang brgyad pa'i sman gso dar/ /zhes sogs 'chad par snang ngo / /sman dpyad la bstan 'gyur na po ti bdun bzhugs/ gso rig pa'i skabs so/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa las/ yul spyi dang bye brag ma phye bar shes bya'i gtso bo rig gnas lnga ji ltar byung ba bshad pa ste yan lag lnga pa'o// //de ltar bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid kyi/ /bzhi pa shākya seng ge'i bstan pa mchog /gsal bar mdzad pa'i skyes chen dam pa'i tshogs/ /grangs med kun tu khyab par byon pa las/ /'phags yul rgya nag hor dang li yul dang / /byang phyogs bod kyi yul du byon pa rnams/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi cha shas dpag med 4las/ /cung zad tsam re bdag gis dad pas brjod/ /'dir 'bad dge bas bod kyi rgyal khams 'di'i/ /dus 'khrug yams nad thams cad rgyun chad cing /'gro kun dal 'byor don dang ldan byed pas/ /dam pa'i chos kyi snod du rung bar shog /tshe rabs kun tu snying po'i bstan la 'jug /sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla mas rjes su 'dzin/ /legs pa'i rten 'brel mtha' dag lhun grub pas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis cig char 'grub gyur cig /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa las yan lag dang po'i 'jig rten gyi khams spyir bstan pa'i 1526

skabs/ yan lag gnyis pa rgya gar gyi skabs la ston pa'i mdzad pa bshad pa bka' bsdu ba khyad par du bshad pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten ji ltar byung tshul rgyal po byon tshul ste nang tshan du le'u bzhi/ yan lag gsum pa bod yul gyi skabs la dang por spyan ras gzigs kyis bod bdag gir mdzad tshul gnyis pa chos rgyal gyi rgyal rabs/ gsum pa 'dul ba'i chos byung / bzhi pa lo paṇa ji ltar byon pa/ lnga pa gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos byung / drug pa bka' gdams kyi chos byung / bdun pa bka' rgyud spyi'i chos byung / brgyad pa kurma kaX tshang gi chos byung / dgu pa 'bri khung bka' rgyud kyi chos byung / bcu pa chos rgyud sna tshogs pa'i chos byung ste nang tshan le'u bcu/ yan lag bzhi pa rgya nag sogs su chos byung tshul/ yan lag lnga pa spyir rig gnas ji ltar byung tshul ste skabs chen po lnga/ nang tshan le'u bcu bdun gyis legs par grub pa ste/ rang gi dad pa'i blo dang / sa skyong pa chen po bsod nams rab brtan gyis bskul bar mdzad pa'i rkyen las/ shākya'i dge slong dus kyi dbang gis chos smra ba'i re mos su son pa ma pham chos kyi rgyal po don yongs su grub pa ming gzhan gtsug lag gi phreng ba 'dzin pas rang lo zhe gnyis pa la skabs dang po gsum pa brtsams shing /phyis rang lo drug bcu pa'i skabs ci rigs par le'u lhag ma rnams bris shing re gcig pa shing pho byi ba'i lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la dpal sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por grub par bgyis pa dge bar mthar phyin to// //rig gnas lnga yi chos kyi byung ba 'di/ /gnam gshegs dpal 'byor bzang mo'i dgongs rdzogs phyir/ /sto brag gnas kyi gzhis khar par du bsgrubs/ /yig brkos gnyis ka byed po g.ye ba yin/ /dge 'dis 'gro kun thams cad mkhyen thob shog // //1527

〈chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉 rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus/ chos 'byung 'di'i mdzad pa po ni dpa' bo sku phreng gnyini pa gtsug lag phreng ba yin/4 rab byung brgyad pa'i shing byi spyi lo 1504/derab byung dgu pa'i me stag spyi lo 1566lo bar dgung lo drug cu re gsum bzhugs/'khrungs yul lha sa snye thang nas yin cing / gdung rus gnyags kyi rigs las yab bla ma dar dang / yum lam snyed sgrol ma gnyis la sras 'ga' zhig yod pa'i 'bring ba yin/ dgung lo lnga la slebs skabs dge bsnyen cha lung pas/dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub kyi sku phreng gnyis par ngos 'dzin zhus te sto brag gro bo dgon pa'i gdan sar bkod/ bla ma rtogs ldan dge 'dun rgya mtsho dge rgan du bsten nas bod yig 'bri klog bslabs/ dgung lo dgu la garma pa zhwa dmar sku phreng bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa'i drung nas dge bsnyen dang dge tshul nga bye bas te mtshan la mi pham chos kyi rgya mtshor btags/ dgung lo bcu gnyis la shar dwags po paṇ+ḍi ta chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgya'/ mtshan gyi drung nas gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos mang po gsan zhing / dbus smyon he ru ka kun dga' bzang po'i drung nas phyag chen gyi khrid gsan cing / zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu la kong por phebs skabs zing po 'bum pa sgang du kurma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang mjal nas chos 'brel zhus shing / mtshan la dpal gtsug lag phreng ba zhes btags/ de nas bzung mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gsan sbyong mang che ba bla ma 1528

'di'i drung du mdzad de mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par gyur/ gsung rtsom la 〈phag mo'i rnam bshad chen mo〉dang / 〈spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa〉 〈rtsis kyi bstan bcos rin chen gter mdzod〉 〈gso ba rig pa'i rgyud bzhi'i rnam bshad〉 〈chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉sogs mang po yod/ chos byung 'di ni/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa rab byung dgu pa'i shing sbrul spyi lo 1545lor brtsams 'go tshugs te dgung lo drug cu re gcig pa shing byi spyi lo 1564lo la yongs su rdzogs par brtsams grub pa'i bar lo ngo nyi shu rtsa gcig ring dka' ngal dang 'gog rkyen mang po bsal te cha tshang bar mdzad pa yin/chos byung 'di la khyad chos mang po yod pa las gtso che ba ni/ 1 dgung grangs mang po'i ring dpyad gzhi'i yig cha ha cang mang po gzigs te brtsams par mdzad pa yin pas/ bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha gzhan dag tu ma gsal ba'i dpyad gzhi mang po gzigs te brtsams par mdzad pa yin pas nang don phun sum —tshoṭa po yod pa/ 2 skabs der khong gis gzigs myong ba'i dpyad gzhi galta chen mang po zhig gi tshig dang / rdo ring thog 'khod pa'i bka' gtsigs khag gsum/(rba bzhed zhabs btags ma〉cha tshang gcig de min gyi lo rgyus yig rnying mang po zhig skabs dang 'tshams par drangs te lta klog byed mkhan la dpyad gzhi mang po'i khungs sne 'tshol bde bar mdzad pa/ 3 deng sang rgyal khab phyi nang du skad grags yod pa'i lo rgyus yig rnying gras tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig rnying nang gsal ba dang 'dra ba'i lo rgyus gal chen mang po zhig gsal por 'khod yod pa des skabs der khong yis gzigs myong ba'i lo rgyus yig rnying de dag khungs med rdzun bzo min par sngar las lhag par ra sprod byed thub pa/1529

4 dpyad gzhi'i yig cha mang po zhig deng sang mthong rgyu med par gyur zin pa'i dbang gis/ chos byung 'di'i nang du drangs pa'i btsan po'i bka' gtsigs dang / yig rnying gi lung tshig (rba bzhed〉 〈deb ther dmar po'i〉dum bu sogs ma yig la bzo bcos ma mdzad par thad gar ma dpe ji lta ba bzhin du bkod par mdzad pa des rang cag phyi rabs pa rnams la lo rgyus zhib 'jug gi bya thabs dang mig dpe bzang po 'don gnang mdzad pa/ 5 deng sang rgyal khab phyi nang du chos byung 'di la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i mthong chen byed mkhan je mang je mang du 'gro bzhin yod pa ོbcas yin/chos 'byung 'di'i nang don ni/ chos byung 'di la 'go nas mjug bar ma yig par mar ka kha'i rim pa ltar bkod par le tshan bcu gsum yod/ le tshan dang po ‘ka nas ca’’bar dum bu bzhir byas pa'i nang 'jig rten chags tshul dang / shākya'i gdung rabs/ bka' bsdu rim pa gsum/ rgya gar rgyal rabs bcas la shog grangs 51dang / le tshan gnyis par cha’’par 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bod khams bdag bzung mdzad tshul la shog grangs 24 / le tshan gsum pa ja’’par bod kyi rgyal rabs la shog grangs 155 / le tshan bzhi pa nya par 'dul ba'i chos byung la shog grangs 22 / le tshan lnga pa ‘ta’ par paṇ+ḍi ta dang lo tsā ba'i byung tshul la shog grangs 14 / le tshan drug pa thari’par/gsang sngags rnying ma'i byung tshul la shog grangs 65 / le tshan bdun pa cad ’par bka' gdams pa'i byung tshul la shog grangs 45 / le tshan brgyad pache na nyapar bka' brgyud spyi'i byung tshul la shog grangs 61/ le tshan dgu pa6‘pa ’par garma bka' brgyud byung tshul la shog grangs 253/ le tshan bcu pa ra pha’’par 'bri gung bka' brgyud sogs byung tshul la shog grangs 12/ le tshan bcu gcig pa ba ’par chos brgyud gzhan dag byung tshul la shog grangs 13//530

le tshan bcu gnyis pa ‘ ma par li yul dang / mi nyag sog po/ rgya nag bcas su chos byung tshul la shog grangs 25 / le tshan bcu gsum pa tsa par rig gnas che chung bcu'i byung tshul la shog grangs 51 bcas yin/gong du bshad pa'i ngo sprod 'di bzhin/ krung dbyang mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas chos byung 'di bzhin 'go nas mjug bar cha tshang ba'i par skrun gnang bzhed skabs rtsom pa po'i lo rgyus ngo sprod gnad bsdus shig dgos zhes bka' gnang ba'i thags re ltar si ta chos kyi 'byang gnas kyis mdzad pa'ir rin ri'i(karma kum tshang gi chos 'byung rab 'byams nor bu'i zla shel〉nang rtsom pa po 'di'i rnam thar nyung bsdus 'khod pa dang / 'brel yod dpe tho/ bla ma'i rnam thar khag bcas nas phyogs bsdas byas te bsgrigs pa yin pas zhib par gong ༄gsal chos byung der gzi gas par zhu zhes sngon 'gro'i ngo sprod tsam du/pe cin krung dbyang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i ༄ bod kyi skad yig slob dpyod khang gi dge ming dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/1985 7༷1 la bris/ ོ 1531
